　　其名为魔凯，是纳菲召唤来的虚空恶魔。在地上时，魔凯总是以犬类的形态跟随纳菲，不过这并不代表魔凯毫无智慧，恰恰相反，很多时候是魔凯的计谋救了纳菲。不过据史料记载，纳菲似乎不太喜欢它，因为魔凯总是会在纳菲得意洋洋时说出不合时宜的话。

Mookaei is a Void Demon summoned by Naphee. On land, Mookaei appears as a canine, but this form does not reflect a lack of intelligence; rather, Mookaei's cunning has frequently aided Naphee. TChinese:
納菲的寵物：
　　其名為魔凱，是納菲召喚來的虛空惡魔。在地上時，魔凱總是以犬類的形態跟隨納菲，不過這並不代表魔凱毫無智慧，恰恰相反，很多時候是魔凱的計謀救了納菲。不過據史料記載，納菲似乎不太喜歡它，因為魔凱總是會在納菲得意洋洋時說出不合時宜的話。

Chinese: \u3000\u3000在人间非常有名的天使，也是天界的欢乐源泉。她很喜欢与人间打交道，并聆听他们的愿望。虽说丘吉尔的力量并不强大，但她却广为凡人所知并为大众所喜爱着。\n\u3000\u3000她所持的弩有两种箭矢，一种能够治愈他人，并让人爱上某人。另一种则是沉重的铅箭，能让人受伤并且使其变得不幸。

Chinese:
（第二纪元23年－第三纪元18194年）落日之战后，大地崩裂由原来的平面世界逐渐变为球状，在动荡的年代，人间需要更好的管理，因此元素之神创造了诸多天使来掌管世间一切法则。
　　丘吉尔就在这样的情况下被创造出来，她的出现让米伦一切有情众生变得井井有条，命运之线也开始有迹可循。
　　得益于丘吉尔的出现，杰西斯终于能够触碰到命运与灵魂的规则，米伦也因此更为壮大。只是丘吉尔本性顽皮，她的活跃也一度给沉闷的天界带来不少麻烦。
　　丘吉尔不仅在天界到处恶作剧，私自下界玩耍的情况更是屡见不鲜。
　　大天使长自然对她这种行为非常不满，也曾亲手惩罚过丘吉尔。
　　但丘吉尔是谁？她掌管米伦一切有情众生的喜好，没有她，凡间众生将会变得缺乏情感与创造力，就更谈不上发展文明，因此萨拉也不能真的拿她怎么样。
　　这位天使还喜欢写文章画画，她将自己笔下所描绘出的人间故事分发给天界的天使，可惜，天使们并不理解凡间众生的情感，自然也就不能理解丘吉尔创作的“无用之物”。
　　这自然让丘吉尔心里相当不爽。丘吉尔纯真烂漫的品性让她更接近人间，而非天界，长久单调而乏味的生活完全违背了她的天性，让她怎么也按捺不住对人间的向往。
　　而在所有天使中，最让丘吉尔不爽的还是神光。作为维系世间情感法则的天使，丘吉尔本身也会影响他人情感，天使们对此有很强抗性，但也不会完全免于影响。
　　因此，每次丘吉尔闯了祸，虽然会被责罚，但是负责惩罚的天使们因为受到丘吉尔的影响，总是会倾向于从轻发落。
　　唯独神光几乎不会受到丘吉尔的影响，每次她抓到丘吉尔，都会铁面无私的“秉公处理”，更具体来说是倾向把丘吉尔的恶作剧视作挑战天界权威的严重罪行。
　　一来二去，丘吉尔和神光就结下了梁子。但神光毕竟地位崇高，丘吉尔一直没找到什么报复的机会。
　　不过，有句老话说得好，只要时间够久，任何机会都会自己找上门……
English:
(Era of Rebirth 23–Era of Eternal Flame 18194) After the Dusk War, the land fractured from flat to spherical. In turbulent times, the God of Elements created angels to govern and maintain order in the world.
Churchill was created to bring order to Mirren, marking the start of Mirren's threads of destiny.
Thanks to Churchill, Jancis could finally empower Mirren with an understanding of destiny and soul rules. Yet, Churchill's mischief occasionally troubled the usually solemn Heavenly Realm.
Churchill often played pranks in the Heavenly Realm and frequently slipped down to the human world for fun.
The Archangel was displeased with her behavior and had punished Churchill with her own hands.
But the Archangel remembered Churchill's role: she governed the emotions and desires of all sentient beings in Mirren. Without her, humanity would lack emotion, creativity, and civilization, leaving Sarah powerless against her.
Churchill shared her writings and paintings of human stories with the angels in Heaven. Sadly, the angels, unable to grasp human emotions, dismissed her creations as meaningless.
This frustrated Churchill. Her playful and innocent nature clashed with the boring life in the Heavenly Realm. Feeling closer to humans than to angels, Churchill longed for the human world.
Among all the angels, Churchill was the most annoyed by Sinkou. As the angel of emotions, Churchill could manipulate others' emotions, including those of angels.
When Churchill caused trouble, the angels tasked with punishing her were often lenient due to her manipulation.
Only Sinkou remained unaffected, always impartially treating Churchill's pranks as serious offenses against the Heavenly Realm's authority.
Over time, a grudge formed between them. But Sinkou's high status made it hard for Churchill to find a chance for revenge.
Still, as the saying went, good things happened to those who had waited.

　　而那源于创世之初的光明会吸收几乎所有类型的能量，不巧的是，天使的形体正是由能量构成。换句话说，如果没有强大的法则固化，恐怕任何天使都会在这光球前消融殆尽。
　　丘吉尔只好悻悻而回。不过，这点困难可拦不住丘吉尔，至少没法打消她的念头。在查阅了很多资料后——丘吉尔还是头一次看那么多书——丘吉尔终于找到了方法。
　　光明可是米伦诞生之初就存在的两个基础法则之一，有了光明，才有万物的生长，神光的力量便来源于此。
　　然而，有光必有暗，能够中和光明的，必然是黑暗。
　　而掌管黑暗法则的，便是那位大天使长萨拉。
　　只要拿到了萨拉的力量，应该就能接近神光——丘吉尔如此确信。
　　现在萨拉正替神光代行职责，她将自己的黑暗法则尽数封印于武器“荣耀”之中，只要想办法拿到“荣耀”，她的计划就一定能顺利完成。
　　想到这里，丘吉尔甚至禁不住发出了傻笑。但情感天使此时还不知道，她的行为会闯下怎样的大祸。
English:
Despite the plentiful energy in the Heavenly Realm, Sinkou's daily rounds demand so much that they ultimately strain her body.
As a result, Sinkou occasionally has to recharge with energy from the Heavenly Realm. When Luzvinia is resting, Sarah steps in to fulfill her duties.
Gazing at the glowing orb enveloping Sinkou, Churchill is struck with inspiration for a cunning plan. Aware of her vulnerability, he contemplates using his emotional influence to make her feel guilt.
Indeed, even the lofty "Sun Deity" would be brought to tears and inspired to apologize for her past severity!
Having quietly evaded the guards, Churchill faces Sinkou, yet the blinding light of the orb makes it impossible for him to approach and evoke guilt.
Churchill berates herself for overlooking that Sinkou radiates the primordial light of creation, which now cocooned her in protective brilliance.
The primordial radiance absorbs nearly all energy, threatening to dissolve angels, whose very forms are made of energy, unless a potent force stabilizes them.
Feeling disheartened, Churchill withdraws but remains resolute; after poring over various texts, she uncovers a new approach, a surprising feat for a reluctant reader.
Light is one of the two primal forces that were present at Mirren's birth; it fosters all growth and is the source of Sinkou's power.
For every light, there is an equal darkness; they are intrinsically linked.
She who wields the dark as an art is the Archangel Sarah.
With Sarah's power, Churchill is certain that she can approach Sinkou.
Currently, Sarah, fulfilling Sinkou's role, has trapped her dark forces in the weapon "Glory," which Churchill must acquire to advance her strategy.
At this thought, a foolish grin monsters over Churchill's face. The Angel of Emotion has yet to realize the dire consequences that may be wrought by her intended actions.
TChinese:
神光每天的巡迴需要消耗巨量能量，即便是在能量充足的天界，也讓她的身體漸漸吃不消了。

　　沒錯，即便是那個天天高高在上的“太陽神”，也會痛哭流涕的向自己道歉，平時對她那麼嚴苛吧！

Chinese:
丘吉尔不知用什么手段，居然真的偷来了萨拉的武器“荣耀”，屏气凝神对着神光形成的光球便是一刀。
　　丘吉尔原本以为黑暗的力量和光明的力量将会融合，两者力量将会彻底消弭，但大大超出她的预料，光球发生了剧烈震荡，然后字面意义上爆炸了。
　　无数火舌从光球中窜出，四散飞往人间，虽然大部分都落入海洋但仍旧有少数砸在了大陆板块，好在绝大多数都砸在了艾尔格隆的荒漠地区。
　　天界同样面临着前所未有的危机，神光本能地想要保护自己，对周围一切可能存在威胁的目标发起攻击。
　　幸好此时丘吉尔手持“荣耀”，黑暗的法则保护着这位惹祸的天使。
　　在神光终于清醒了意识，停止攻击后，她茫然的看着呆立在自己身前的丘吉尔，完全不知道发生了什么事情。
　　事后，因为这次丘吉尔闹得事情实在太大，杰西斯亲自降下神谕，要求丘吉尔在天界禁足。对丘吉尔来说，天天呆在天界的有限空间，简直比死了还难受。
　　不过，即便如此，也有不少天使不满，认为惩罚太轻。只是因为这是杰西斯亲下的谕令，也就接受了这种裁决。
　　直到漫长的时间过去，丘吉尔再次犯下了大错。
　　“掌管情感的卫尔特斯丘吉尔，你让人间大乱，下界君王焚毁神灵雕像，却将你供奉，你可知罪？”
　　一众卫尔特斯紧紧地围绕在天使长身前聆听神谕，这次丘吉尔所犯之罪远比偷走“荣耀”严重得多，没有任何天使敢为她辩护。
　　“尊敬的天使长大人，焰心认为现在最重要的并不是如何处罚丘吉尔，现如今人间陷入混乱，信仰缺失，我们需要做的是挑选先知，带领凡人重新稳定秩序。”
　　焰心出于理性提出了自己的建议，这可算救了丘吉尔的命。
　　丘吉尔前阵子确实没怎么注意人间所发生的事情，但指使人间君王捣毁杰西斯神像这种事情，借她一万个胆子也是想都不敢想的。
　　现如今杰西斯并未降下神谕说要处罚丘吉尔，而天使长的目光又被焰心所吸引，丘吉尔知道她这是逃过一劫了。
　　毕竟自己是掌管情感的天使，萨拉刚在气头上，后面冷静下来，应该不会再对自己动粗。
　　经此一事，一向胆大包天的丘吉尔也被吓坏了，再也不敢无事往返人间，但人间对她的崇拜却从未消减过。她也逐渐成为了人间最为著名的天使之一。
　　而她的结局我们也都有所耳闻，第三纪元18194年，七圣星痕之伊丝塔于弑神之战中剿灭“情感天使丘吉尔”。
　　目前这位天使正在秩序之海中沉睡，没了杰西斯与萨拉的约束，不知道这个胆大包天的家伙还能做出什么事情来。
English:
No matter how she did it, Churchill stole Sarah's weapon, the "Glory." With intense focus, she slashed at the glowing orb created by Sinkou.
Churchill once thought the power of darkness would merge with light and eventually disappear. But unexpectedly, the glowing orb exploded after shaking violently for a moment.
Millions of flames burst from the orb, shooting into the human world. Most landed in the oceans, but some reached the continents, with the desert region of Elgron bearing the brunt of the attack.
The Heavenly Realm faced an unprecedented crisis. Sinkou, acting on instinct, began attacking anything she perceived as a threat.
Churchill was fortunate to possess the "Glory," which shielded her from the chaos created by the law of darkness.
When Sinkou regained her composure and ceased her attacks, she stared blankly at the bewildered Churchill, unsure of what had transpired.
The fallout was severe enough for Jancis to personally order Churchill's grounding in the Heavenly Realm. Churchill would rather die than be confined in such a restricted space.
Still, many angels felt she deserved harsher punishment but accepted Jancis's decision.
That was until Churchill made another major mistake later on.
"Churchill, a Werth Angel responsible for human love, you've caused chaos among mortals. Monarchs burned statues of many gods and began to worship you instead. Do you plead guilty?"
A group of Werth Angels surrounded the archangel, who had committed a crime far worse than stealing the "Glory." No one dared to defend her.
"Honorable archangel, I believe we should prioritize the current chaos over deciding Churchill's punishment. Humanity urgently needs faith; we should select a prophet to restore order and stability."
Homura offered this rational suggestion, ultimately saving Churchill.
Churchill hadn't really paid attention to the human world. The thought of inciting the Monarchs to destroy Jancis's statues was unbearable to her.
Jancis chose not to punish Churchill, swayed by Homura's argument. Churchill realized she had narrowly escaped this time.
After all, she was the angel of love. Sarah was just upset and wouldn't bring it up again once she calmed down.
This incident genuinely frightened Churchill. Despite her boldness, she refrained from visiting the human world without good reason. Still, her followers continued to grow, and she gradually became one of the most renowned angels among humans.
Her fate is well known. In 18194, the Era of Frost Veil, Churchill the Angel of Emotion was slain in the Godslayer War by Istar, one of the Seven Sacred Asters.
Now, the angel rests peacefully in the Sea of Order. Without Jancis and Sarah around, who knows what trouble the bold angel might cause?

Chinese:
流星雨：
　　第二纪元24188年，一颗流星在洛伊丝城上空爆炸，爆炸的余波让洛伊丝的墙体开裂，此时城内恰巧诞生了一位女婴。她就是维拉尔第90代国王爱莲恩·塔利尔，有人认为是她的啼哭阻止了那道毁灭性的巨浪，她火红色的长发仿佛天意一般，此论获得了贵族们的极大支持。也正是她将王国推向鼎盛。在杰西斯之约时期，流星雨逐渐被赋予了神话色彩，直到第三纪元才有史学家对此提出了不同论点。他们认为流星是天使对人间的警告，而后来维拉尔的灭亡也似乎能够印证这一观点。

卫尔特斯：
　　以某种规则为核心塑造成的天使，要比一般的安琪强大得多，他们负责帮助杰西斯管理人间。根据初始被赋予力量的强弱有四翼和双翼两种情况，卫尔特斯负责管理由杰西斯赋予的权能，维护天界与人间的秩序，不少时代人们口中的神明也是对这些天使的称呼。
English:
Meteor Shower:
In 24192 of the Era of Rebirth, a meteor exploded over Loisford, cracking its walls. At that moment, Elene Talier was born; her cry reportedly halted the destructive wave, and her fiery red hair was seen as a divine sign, a belief upheld by the nobility. She led the kingdom to its peak. During the Pact of Jancis, the meteor shower gained mythic significance, and by the Era of Frost Veil, historians interpreted it as a warning from angels, a view reinforced by Velarra's decline.

Werth:
These angels, created under specific rules, are stronger than ordinary Engjells and assist Jancis in overseeing the mortal realm. Depending on their initial power, they may have two or four wings. Werth manage the powers granted by Jancis and maintain order between the Heavenly Realm and earth. Many deities mentioned in various eras refer to these angels.
TChinese:
流星雨：
　　第二紀元24188年，一顆流星在洛伊絲城上空爆炸，爆炸的餘波讓洛伊絲的牆體開裂，此時城內恰巧誕生了一位女嬰。她就是維拉爾第90代國王愛蓮恩·塔利爾，有人認為是她的啼哭阻止了那道毀滅性的巨浪，她火紅色的長髮仿佛天意一般，此論獲得了貴族們的極大支持。也正是她將王國推向鼎盛。在傑西斯之約時期，流星雨逐漸被賦予了神話色彩，直到第三紀元才有史學家對此提出了不同論點。他們認為流星是天使對人間的警告，而後來維拉爾的滅亡也似乎能夠印證這一觀點。

衛爾特斯：
　　以某種規則為核心塑造成的天使，要比一般的安琪強大得多，他們負責幫助傑西斯管理人間。根據初始被賦予力量的強弱有四翼和雙翼兩種情況，衛爾特斯負責管理由傑西斯賦予的權能，維護天界與人間的秩序，不少時代人們口中的神明也是對這些天使的稱呼。

Chinese: \u3000\u3000在人类最早的记载中，神光从天边的早霞里出现，随后苍穹变为赤红。神光所照耀之处，皆是神灵的恩泽。她是旁人眼中冷漠而强大的天使，但实际上只是……不善言语罢了。
English: According to the most ancient chronicles, Sinkou emerged from dawn's early light, casting the heavens in a scarlet hue. Her touch is said to be a blessing from the heavens. Perceived as an aloof and formidable angel by onlookers, in reality, she is simply... reticent in speech.
TChinese: \u3000\u3000在人類最早的記載中，神光從天邊的早霞裏出現，隨後蒼穹變為赤紅。神光所照耀之處，皆是神靈的恩澤。她是旁人眼中冷漠而強大的天使，但實際上只是……不善言語罷了。

Chinese:
（第二纪元元年－第三纪元18194年）光明星灵奥德温陨落，极夜伴随寒冷与恐惧席卷大地，人间生灵饱受磨难。
　　神光诞生之日，一道金光划破夜幕，如烈焰一般的霞光驱散了大地的黑暗。
　　她是太阳，为人间驱散邪秽，带去光明与温暖。
　　人间欢呼着黎明的到来，赞颂神光的名字，称赞她煌煌如神光降世，恰如其名。
　　然而神光并不理解为什么这些人会崇拜自己，她甚至不理解什么是“崇拜”，即使是对于杰西斯的命令，神光也只是单纯的执行，并没有多余的情绪，更不用说有什么对于杰西斯的崇拜。
　　看着这些动不动就手舞足蹈、大呼小叫的人类，神光产生了疑惑与兴趣。
　　也许只是单纯的出于无聊，她动身来到人间询问，但她发现自己的双脚明明还未触及大地，人间却早已变得酷热干旱，湖泊河流也几乎干涸，之前还在崇拜她的人们，也开始乞求她重返天上。
　　“为什么……会露出这种表情呢？为什么……要乞求呢？”
　　“为什么……那边人类的眼睛里流出了水滴？又是为什么……有些人类的眉头紧紧拧在一起？”
　　神光漫步在大地上，人间的一切都很新鲜，一切都很有趣。
　　等神光意识到时，人间已是一片狼藉。地表的一切生命、生命存在过的痕迹，全部燃烧殆尽，甚至连石头都开始融化、形成岩浆。
　　“为什么……都不见了？”
　　周围只有热浪的呼啸。

She was the sun, driving away evil and bringing light and warmth to the world.
People cheered as dawn arrived and praised the name Sinkou, celebrating her radiant arrival just as her name suggests.
Sinkou didn't grasp why people worshipped her. The concept of "worship" eluded her entirely. Even when following Jancis' commands, Sinkou acted purely out of duty, devoid of any sense of worship towards Jancis.
As Sinkou watched the humans dancing and shouting dramatically, she felt puzzled and intrigued.
Maybe out of sheer boredom, she descended to Earth to investigate. But before her feet touched the ground, the world had turned scorching and arid, with lakes and rivers nearly dried up. Those who once worshiped her now pleaded for her return to the heavens.
"Why do they have that look on their faces? Why do they beg me? "
"Why are there water drops running down the eyes of those humans over there? And why are some humans frowning?"
As Sinkou wandered the earth, everything seemed new and interesting to her.
By the time Sinkou realized it, the world had become a wasteland. All life on the surface had been burned away, with even the stones melting into lava.
"Why... is everything gone?"
There was only the howling of the heat waves around her.
Sinkou was unfamiliar with loneliness, yet she now experienced a new emotion unlike anything she felt in the Heavenly Realm.
"It's so.. cold."
Sinkou stretched out her hand, clenched her fist. It was a simple action that now felt so substantial, affirming her presence here.
Sinkou imitated humans, standing on the ground and gazing at the sky, pondering her feelings. It was Jancis' call that reminded her of her duty.

　　然后，那里的一切都融化，如尘埃般消失了。

　　那到底是什么……神光忘记了杰西斯的指令，她只是想赶紧回到那个属于自己的天界角落，仔细思考这个问题。

English:
Sinkou stands guard at the horizon, musing over what she might have forgotten, and why she even cares.
As time flows, Sinkou carries out "divine retribution" for Jancis, earning the title "Fire of Vengeance" and gaining more worshippers.
Sinkou pays no mind to such titles; indeed, she is puzzled why humans bestow such odd names upon her when she is called "Sinkou."
She is but a ray of light, a flame, an angel.
What is an angel?
Each sunset, Sinkou retreats to a secluded spot in the Heavenly Realm, contemplating peculiar and curious questions.
Surrounded only by wispy clouds at the edge of the heavens, Sinkou gazes at familiar clouds and pebbles, feeling a sense of grounding.
Why was it that only this exact spot in the Heavenly Realm provided such a feeling within her?
Standing there, she felt as though she had always been present here and would remain so eternally.
As Sinkou pondered, Archangel Sarah interrupted with a decree for divine retribution against the Velarra for their offenses.
And so, Sinkou made her descent upon the frozen lands.
In her wake, all that had existed there melted away into nothingness, as if it were made of mere dust.
"What is divine retribution?"
Although Sinkou had not yet found an answer, she believed clarity might emerge after many years.
Tilting her head and yawning, Sinkou watched as the distant mountains slowly dissolved from view.
Speculating on their fall, Sinkou quietly counted the passing moments, assured she would return shortly.
At that moment, a group of mortals appeared from afar, suddenly materializing within her sight.
Without glancing their way, Sinkou remembered the mortals who once clamored for her attention, only to quickly become quiet.
So, Sinkou focused on the peak, contemplating its northward or southward descent...
Then, suddenly, a force rushed toward her like a tidal wave. It was the icy air.
Caught off guard, Sinkou felt time stand still as the flames that surrounded her dispersed like dawn's rosy light, leaving her feeling oddly refreshed yet chilled for the first time.
It was akin to feeling the crispness of an early morning right upon waking.
Unable to contain herself, Sinkou spread her wings wide, experiencing a sacred joy she had never felt before.
Soaring high, Sinkou gazed at the pale blue horizon, feeling truly alone and aware of her existence for the first time.
That insight brought a deep unease; the world she had watched for millennia now seemed alien, and new questions emerged one after another.
My name is Sinkou, but who is Sinkou? Why am I here? What am I doing?
When Sinkou came to her senses again, she stood upon the ground, surrounded by a vast, charred chasm.
Her thoughts were scattered, driven by the emotions that had so utterly captivated her.
Lost in thought, Sinkou forgot Jancis' orders and longed to retreat to her secluded corner of the Heavenly Realm to ponder her questions.
Spreading her wings again, she flew skyward.

Pain, fear, joy, grief, and the azure horizon... Sinkou felt overwhelmed.

She emerged from the rosy dawn... Now she was about to burn out in the sunset glow.

　　那是烙印在她稀薄靈魂中的那些呼喊。
　　痛苦、恐懼、欣喜、悲傷、以及那一抹淡藍色的地平線……神光的心仿佛像要被撐破了一樣。

　　天色漸暗，神光最後一次望向人間，然後閉上了眼。

太阳：

The Final Battle:
This series of conflicts fought by Lord Deity in 18194 of the Era of Frost Veil is known as the Last Trial of the Mortal Realm, featuring battles against Danni, Sinkou, Phoebe, Vivian, Ariel, Celeste, and Sarah.

Chinese:
（第三纪元11202-11354）天膳忍宗家主之女，家中排行第三，在极重长幼血亲的天膳忍宗中，这就使得雷雷几乎没有学习核心传承的机会。
　　而且在年长之后她便会被派往天晴山负责担任王族侍卫，从此便极有可能永远隐匿于黑暗之中。
　　对于这些雷雷早有准备，毕竟千百年来都是如此，她也不是那种有野心的女孩儿，只要自己能够学好本事做好职责内的事情就好，能否光大宗门那是哥哥们需要考虑的事情。
　　他们家族代代都负责皇帝的人身安全，虽然现在是大哥在陛下身边保护，可过阵子他就要回来继承宗主之位了，到时候就得靠自己了保护陛下了，可不能辱没了宗门名声。
　　天膳忍者的训练异常艰苦，日复一日的训练也让雷雷展现出远超同龄人的天赋，年仅7岁便成功通过下忍考核。自此她才可以称得上是一名忍者。
　　与如月忍族不同的是，天膳忍族通过考核的忍者都需要在面部篆刻铭文，这往往能极大提升他们与忍术的相性。从此他们也会戴上面罩，除了死亡没有人能打开这个面罩。
　　他们这些活在阴影中的家族，是王室保持万世一系的重要力量，忠诚根植于天膳家的血脉之中。
　　为了众神之子的血脉得以永耀丰缇，他们付出了一代代人的希望，这一代的守护者正是雷雷，她以9岁年龄通过了中忍的考核，成为有史以来最年轻的中忍。
　　明天就是她10岁的生日，这是位于丰缇的奥卡兹特有的成年仪式。父亲也会亲自给雷雷戴上花环。
　　下个月她就会被派往天晴山，接过大哥的任务，保护陛下，到时候一定让他大吃一惊。自己可是比他这个天才都早了两年成为中忍。
　　一想到马上就能见到陛下了，她心里就有些紧张，听大哥说，陛下的年纪还没自己大，是个温柔的孩子。
　　赞美众神~幸好自己遇到的不是像“成阳”时期的那位暴君。真要按哥哥信中所说，那自己今后的日子应该过得不错~
　　在离开宗门之前她还有一件要紧事儿要办，那就是安顿好自己的宠物“大花儿”。
　　大花儿原本是附近野猫，脾气暴躁，经常和其他家伙们打架，雷雷见它总是受伤就拿些草药给它敷上，忍者的草药让大花体格远超同类，最后便成了远近闻名的猫王。
　　天膳忍宗的忍者不能在人前漏出弱点，但毕竟雷雷还是个未成年的孩子，难免会有训练辛苦或是觉得受了委屈的时候，这时她就会来找大花儿倾诉一番。
　　大花儿也像是能听懂她在说什么一样，一来二去，一人一猫便成了好朋友。雷雷马上就要前往天晴山，自然得和自己的好朋友道个别。
　　可今天的大花儿和往常有些不一样，甫一露面便显得焦躁异常，拽着雷雷的裤脚就往森林中拉，雷雷知道它想要带自己去某个地方，于是便跟了上去。
　　当时的雷雷绝没想到，这一去就是一个月，而一场酝酿已久的风暴也在悄然逼近。
English:
(11202–11354, Era of Frost Veil) ReiRei, the third child of the Tenzen Ninja Order's leader, had little opportunity to learn its core teachings due to the order's emphasis on seniority and bloodlines.
As she aged, she would be sent to Sunnyhill as a royal guard, likely to stay hidden in the shadows forever.
ReiRei had long accepted this fate, as it had been the norm for centuries. She wasn't ambitious; her focus was on mastering her skills and fulfilling her duties, leaving the sect's future to her brothers.
Their family had safeguarded the emperor for generations. Her eldest brother, now guarding His Majesty, would soon return to lead the Order. Then, it would be her duty to protect the emperor, and she must uphold the family's honor.
The Tenzen ninja training was extremely tough, and after years of intense practice, ReiRei surpassed her peers. At just seven, she passed the Junior Ninja Exam, officially becoming a ninja.
Unlike the Kisaragi ninjas, Tenzen ninjas had inscriptions carved on their faces after passing the exam, greatly enhancing their ninja technique compatibility. They would then don masks that could only be removed upon death.
These shadow families were vital to preserving the royal family's eternal lineage. Loyalty was in the Tenzen family's blood.
Generations of Tenzens dreamed of ensuring the divine children's bloodline in Fontiera would thrive eternally. At nine, ReiRei became the youngest senior ninja in history after passing the Senior Ninja Exam as this generation's guardian.
Tomorrow was her 10th birthday, the day an Ocatzian of Fontiera came of age. Her father would place a garland on her.
Next month, she would go to Sunnyhill to take over her brother's duty of protecting His Majesty. She was determined to surprise him, having become a senior ninja two years earlier than her genius brother.
The thought of meeting His Majesty soon made her nervous. Her brother had said the emperor was a gentle child, even younger than her.
Thank goodness! She was relieved this emperor wasn't like the tyrant of the Daystar era. If her brother's letters were true, the days ahead would be pleasant.
Before leaving home, she had one more important thing to do: to settle her pet, Poppy.
Poppy was once a wild cat with a bad temper, often getting into fights. ReiRei saw it injured and used herbal medicine on it. The herbs made Poppy much stronger, eventually becoming the strongest in the area.
Tenzen ninjas couldn't show weakness, but ReiRei was still a child. When training was tough or she felt wronged, she'd confide in Poppy.
Poppy seemed to understand her, and they became close friends. Now, with ReiRei about to leave for Sunnyhill, she had to say goodbye.
But today, Poppy was unusually agitated. It tugged ReiRei's pant leg, leading her to the forest. ReiRei understood it wanted to show her something, so she followed.
ReiRei had no idea this trip would last a month, and a brewing storm was quietly closing in.

Chinese:
走了大概半个小时的路程，一人一猫来到了一个山洞之外，虽还未深入，但身为忍者的灵敏直觉仍让雷雷感受到了极度危险的，陌生的气息。
　　稍作思忖，雷雷决定立即返回宗族，向父亲禀明情况，在任务交接时期，家族境内出现如此异常的情况，令她感到不安。

　　“进来吧，小猫咪。”
　　她的声音仿佛有种特殊的魔力，让自诩意志坚定的小忍者心神荡漾，一步都无法迈出。
　　雷雷知道这是极为高深的精神控制，饶是她意志坚定但双方的实力相差巨大，现在也只能走一步算一步了。
　　刚刚对方的语气中并没有杀意，而且这人居然需要自己的帮助？雷雷知道，凭她自己的力量绝难逃走，更何况还有大花儿，她决定带着大花儿一起进洞。
　　深入洞内，里面没有任何照明措施，手倚着两侧墙壁前进，居然还能摸到石粉，可见这座洞穴是刚刚挖造不久。
　　继续往前走去，洞穴深处开始散发出一股海藻的清香，周遭的夜明珠也开始点亮了周围，雷雷终于看到了那声音的主人。

After a thirty-minute trek, ReiRei and her feline companion stood at the cavern's entrance. The ninja's sharp instincts picked up on an unfamiliar aura and a looming threat.
After a brief reflection, ReiRei chose to return to her Order and notify her father, her unease growing over the anomaly during the mission handoff.
ReiRei was stopped by Poppy just before she could run, and the perilous aura from the cave vanished. A hoarse, uncaring voice called out from within.
"Come in, little kitty."
The mesmerizing voice held ReiRei, a young ninja proud of her determination, spellbound and rooted to the spot.
Realizing the advanced mental manipulation, ReiRei understood that her strong will was no match for the vast power difference, forcing her to move slowly.
ReiRei sensed no malice in the stranger's voice. Was it possible they needed her? Understanding her chances of escaping alone were slim, she decided to step into the cave with Poppy.
Delving deeper into the cave, they navigated in darkness, using the walls for support, and the dust on the stone suggested recent excavation.
Deeper inside, a subtle scent of seaweed emerged, and the surrounding night pearls began to glow, finally revealing the owner of the voice.
ReiRei saw a pale woman on a bed of crushed stones, her body scarred by ghastly wounds. Some signs of healing were visible, but her injuries were grave.
Barely any blood remained in her battered body, and her skin looked as white as porcelain beneath the glow of the night pearls.
An intense aura of danger emanated from the injured woman, causing ReiRei's tail fur to bristle. It was difficult to grasp how powerful she once was.
Clearly, not even her father could rival her strength. How had she endured such severe injuries? The idea that someone could harm her so deeply felt nothing short of miraculous.
If someone like her had malicious intentions toward the royal family, could the Tenzen and Kisaragi Ninja Orders together safeguard His Majesty?
ReiRei's mind was flooded with thoughts, yet addressing the crisis was her foremost concern.
First, ReiRei needed to understand the woman's intentions; she likely sought healing, not harm, but Trueno's skills were limited.
"In my bag is a precious elixir. Create a magical circle with it, and my wounds will heal swiftly, granting you and your cat significant benefits."
"Who are you? Why have you come to the territory of the Tenzen Ninja Order?"
"Once I recover, I'll reveal my identity to you. Do you choose to aid me or face death?"
Silence lingered. Without clarity on her origins and intentions, the woman would remain beyond anyone's power post-healing, leading ReiRei to contemplate a great sacrifice.
Poppy bared its teeth at the woman, and ReiRei was both annoyed and amused. Poppy had insisted on following the voice, and if ReiRei was nearly enchanted, Poppy must have felt it even more.
"I understand your concerns, but I'm not interested in your factional disputes. Once I'm somewhat recovered, I'll head to Ciaran."
Still, silence prevailed...
"I swear by the name of the Sea God to uphold my promise."
Convictions define great individuals, who honor their oaths as they grow stronger. Facing death bravely isn't suicide. Trusting her instincts, ReiRei took the elixir.
As the bottle opened, a wave of life energy surged forth, causing ReiRei's skin to tingle with its staggering power.
Though expected, the sheer magnitude of energy was astonishing. Once amplified by the magical circle, it became nearly overwhelming.
Over the next month, ReiRei and Poppy underwent a dramatic transformation, leaving the cavern with bodies greatly enhanced.
Once healed, the woman radiated a pure, sacred glow, outshining the cave's luminous pearls like an angel.
Her name was Gail, and she came from the far-off Zinew Archipelago, where a ruthless ruler exploited the sea creatures.
Once a member of an elite suicide squad tasked with ending the tyrant's rule, she had failed. Her comrades were slaughtered, and she ended up here.
Despite the odds, Gail hoped to liberate her suffering people from the tyrant. She first had to travel to Ciaran, the land of promise, to find the key to defeat evil.
Gail had no interest in Fontiera's affairs and planned to leave for Ciaran as soon as she recovered.
ReiRei was stunned by Gail's tale. Could a foe be so powerful that even Gail and her companions had failed? The malevolent ruler sounded overwhelmingly strong.
Could such a being be human? Even a god's reincarnation would struggle against such power. Trueno had no ties to her, and her departure suited him. It was wise to avoid her attention.
The little cat needed to see this daunting powerhouse off to sea first. Thoughts of returning home could wait.

在送别盖尔后，雷雷骑着大花儿飞奔回家，本以为父亲会大骂自己一顿，没曾想却只是不温不火地问候了一句，竟丝毫不提前往天晴山一事。
　　如今的雷雷早已是今非昔比，她很快便瞧出眼前的这位“父亲”不对劲，此人虽然声音外貌与父亲一般无二，却多了几分阴柔之气。
　　雷雷此时定了定心绪，借由说明自己这些天去处，接近这位“父亲”，近距离之下偷袭，伸手之下便可制服此人。
　　她可不是侍之一族那帮武士，为达目的，偷袭什么的不会有任何心理负担。可令她没想到的是此人还没等自己接近竟能抽身远遁。
　　要知道，现在的雷雷虽然并未习得新的忍术，但是速度力量较之前提升何止10倍？近身之下竟然有人能够逃脱？
　　“小猫咪，别生气，你的父亲在谷仓中，我可没把他怎么样。”
　　此人似乎并没有什么敌意，也可能是知道雷雷的厉害，留下这句话便迅速远遁。雷雷担心父亲安危也不敢多追。
　　虽然顺利地救出父亲，但是天膳忍宗宗主被俘，甚至被人冒名顶替近一个月，简直是名誉扫地，天膳流苌辞去宗主之位，由长子代为管理宗族。
　　而雷雷也因此事名声大噪，此后在保护皇帝的任期内更是屡立大功，为了表彰这位伟大的忍者，天膳宗更是破格授予了她史上第一位超忍的称号。
　　在皇帝驾崩以后雷雷便回到天膳忍宗颐养天年，心情好时也能指导一下后辈们的身法。
　　这时的雷雷和早年那个一本正经的酷酷忍者大有不同，她是彻底解放了天性，整日以逗耍年轻忍者为乐，最后变成了宗族鬼见愁。
　　而我们的这位超忍因为一些原因寿命极长，远超一般奥卡兹的寿命上限，这可苦了这帮年轻忍者，对这个老祖宗是又爱又恨。
　　她对于晚辈从来都是倾囊相授。但是也会做出些令人抓狂的事情，比如说她有时候会乔装打扮成扫地的人员，然后故意在教师面前指指点点，一旦有人对她提出异议，她就会大显神威并乐此不疲。
　　其实到了后来小忍者们也都知道了这位老祖宗的脾气，大多数情况下都是配合着她演好这场戏。
　　对于雷雷来说她的一生是幸运的，天赋极高，年纪轻轻就获得了很多人一生都无法得到的力量，效忠的国家又是出了名的强大。

After parting ways with Gail, ReiRei hurried home on Big Flower, anticipating a scolding from her father. To her surprise, he greeted her normally without mentioning her trip to Sunnyhill.
ReiRei felt something was off about her "father." He looked and spoke like him but had a hint of femininity.
Calming herself, ReiRei planned to approach him and explain where she had been, intending to launch a sneak attack to take him down.
Unlike the Lord Oracle samurai, Trueno had no shame in sneak attacks. To her shock, her target dashed away before she could reach him.
Although ReiRei hadn't learned new ninja skills, her speed and strength had increased tenfold. How could anyone escape?
"Easy, kitty. Your father is in the barn. And I never laid a finger on him," the man said. He seemed harmless, and realizing ReiRei's strength, he quickly left. Concerned for her father, she chose not to pursue him.
Her father, Tenzen Ryutyo, was safely rescued. However, the disgrace of being kidnapped and replaced by an impostor for over a month forced him to resign, leaving his son to manage the Tenzen Ninja Order in his stead.
Meanwhile, ReiRei gained fame for her role in the incident and distinguished herself multiple times as an emperor's guard. In recognition of her contributions, the Tenzen Ninja Order bestowed upon her the title of Super Ninja, making her the first to hold that honor.
After the emperor's death, ReiRei returned to the Tenzen Ninja Order for retirement. Occasionally, she would teach young ninjas if she felt like it.
Having abandoned her serious ninja persona, ReiRei embraced her true nature, relishing in teasing the young ninjas and becoming a headache for the Order.
Due to her longevity, which far surpassed that of typical Ocatzians, Trueno was both adored and exasperated by the younger generation.
On one hand, she was eager to teach them everything; on the other, she loved playing pranks. For instance, she would sometimes disguise herself as a cleaner and challenge instructors. When someone confronted her, she would promptly reveal her true identity.

　　在皇帝駕崩以後雷雷便回到天膳忍宗頤養天年，心情好時也能指導一下後輩們的身法。
　　這時的雷雷和早年那個一本正經的酷酷忍者大有不同，她是徹底解放了天性，整日以逗耍年輕忍者為樂，最後變成了宗族鬼見愁。
　　而我們的這位超忍因為一些原因壽命極長，遠超一般奧卡茲的壽命上限，這可苦了這幫年輕忍者，對這個老祖宗是又愛又恨。
　　她對於晚輩從來都是傾囊相授。但是也會做出些令人抓狂的事情，比如說她有時候會喬裝打扮成掃地的人員，然後故意在教師面前指指點點，一旦有人對她提出異議，她就會大顯神威並樂此不疲。
　　其實到了後來小忍者們也都知道了這位老祖宗的脾氣，大多數情況下都是配合著她演好這場戲。
　　對於雷雷來說她的一生是幸運的，天賦極高，年紀輕輕就獲得了很多人一生都無法得到的力量，效忠的國家又是出了名的強大。
　　但是作為一名忍者，她的一生是缺少關注的，這可能也是她晚年性格如此的原因之一。

Chinese:
雷雷的亲人：
　　父亲，天膳流苌，天膳宗第276代宗主。大哥，天膳风（第三纪元11192-11287），42岁通过上忍考核，天膳宗第277代宗主。大姐，天膳雨（第三纪元11197-11285），天膳宗中忍。

天膳忍宗：
　　保护王室成员安全的影卫，天膳忍者注重尊严，擅长隐匿，为保护主公不惜战死。

如月忍宗：
　　保护王室成员安全的影卫，如月忍者擅长伪装，刺杀，在执行任务时不计代价。

天晴山：
　　丰缇的圣山，当年盖娅就是在此山之上被众神所祝福。现在的天晴山仍旧是整个丰缇的代表性地标，也是天之扉所在的地方。

铭文：
　　这种铭文是天膳宗的一种特殊手段，叫流水撰，它不仅仅能够帮助忍者们更好地驾驭自身的忍术，更是曾经的统治者埋下的诅咒。当天膳忍族的忍者忍术越高就会越加依赖流水撰，对掌控着流水撰的王室几乎是没有任何反抗的手段。

奥卡兹：
　　丰缇的奥卡兹多数情况下是希尔拜亚半兽人与当地人的混血儿而成，几乎很少有纯正的半兽人血脉了，这也让当地的血脉更加均衡。

成年仪式：
　　丰缇的奥卡兹兽人成年仪式有着特殊的意义，一般情况下会由母亲编制一顶花环，再由直系亲属的长辈将花环带上，并在后辈头上点三次黑土，仪式就算完成了。花环以春季的三青藤编织而成，所以被称为三青环。实际上三青环并不是以青色为主，它上面有白花，绿叶，突刺。

众神之子：
　　“众神之子”盖娅（第二纪元28633年－第三纪元27年），盖娅的后裔能够控制整个丰缇数万年之久，依靠的极有可能是操纵灵魂的力量，让其不能产生反抗之念。

丰缇：
　　位于希瑞安大陆东南方，文明起源于希尔拜亚，二王之战后盖娅带领希楠派克服困苦，远渡重洋到达丰缇之地，在这片与世隔绝的桃源之地扎根。为了避免希尔拜亚的惨剧重演，他们痛定思痛，将教权完全排除在权利阶级外。排外，隐忍，忠诚是刻在他们文化中的基因，忍者就正是这种文化土壤中孕育出来的果实。最早的忍者作为盖娅的影卫，保护主公与暗杀敌人，在随后的时间中这种分工愈发明确，从而形成了两种不同的流派。也就是后来的如月忍者与天膳忍者，天膳忍者擅长保护，如月忍者擅长刺杀。

侍之一族：
　　即黑神家族，主神的父系血脉，现任上议院之主，旧丰缇贵族。最早起源于希楠聚落，后追随“众神之子”盖娅流亡丰缇，作为王族手中对外的利刃。并且与盖娅定下世代效忠的契约，作为侍之一族守卫众神之子的血脉。

神之血：
　　“众神之子”盖娅（第二纪元28633年－第三纪元27年）的直系血脉，侍与影卫受到古老契约的约束被剥夺了多神之血的任何恶意。

成阳时期：
　　丰缇以年号作为统治者的称呼，雷雷所生活的时代为弥生时期。成阳（第三纪元4976-5007）是丰缇历史上一位性格乖僻的主君，年少有为的成阳被人寄予厚望，但正是在他的统治时期“侍之一族”分裂，部分成为无业游民，从事海盗等行业。

神秘女人：
　　“海上塞壬”盖尔（第三纪元11180-11239）活跃于西努群岛的海上霸主，是无数商船的噩梦。

Shadow guards protecting the royal family, specializing in honor and stealth, willing to die for their lord.

Shadow guards responsible for royal safety, excelling in disguise and assassination.

Sacred mountain in Fontiera, where Gaia was blessed, now a symbolic landmark and location of the Gate of Heaven.

A technique called Flow Script used by the Tenzen Ninja Order, enhancing ninjutsu control and serving as a curse from past rulers.

In Fontiera, hybrids of Hilbeyan Orccodro and locals, resulting in a balanced bloodline.

Significant for Fontiera's Ocatzian Orccodro; an elder places an Emerald Ring wreath on the youth's head, completing the ritual with black soil.

Gaia (Era of Rebirth 28633–Frost Veil 27) likely bestowed soul-manipulating powers to her descendants, enabling their rule over Fontiera for millennia.

Located in southeast Ciaran continent, it was settled by Gaia and the Hinans post-Monarchs' War, creating a culture of exclusivity, loyalty, and patience, leading to the emergence of ninjas.

The Kurokami family, paternal lineage of Lord Deity and leaders of the Upper House, serve as guardians of Gaia's lineage, originating from the Hinan settlement.

Blood of God:
Direct descendants of Gaia, bound by oaths, lacking ill will towards the polytheistic bloodline.

Daystar Period:
ReiRei lived during the Yayoi Period; Daystar (4976–5007, Era of Frost Veil) was an eccentric ruler whose reign saw the Samurai split, with some turning to piracy.

Mysterious Woman:
Gail, "Sirena of the Sea" (11180–11239, Era of Frost Veil), a sea queen and a nightmare for merchants in the Zinew Archipelago.

Chinese:
（第三纪元3—1748年）人偶才刚刚苏醒，环顾周围看到的便是一个巨大的熔炉旁堆着一层层的尸体。一群身着暗紫色长袍的人挥舞着法杖向她冲来，这群家伙眼中透露的是一种疯狂的气息。
　　人偶毫不犹豫地捏断了这些人的脖子。她对杀戮没有什么特殊的感觉，当然，对善良也是如此。
　　只过了一会儿便又来了一群自称是她仆人的家伙，并声称外面的叛乱者已经全部被消灭，请求“安普莎”大人的原谅。
　　安普莎？是在说自己么？原来自己叫安普莎么？
　　她根本无所谓自己是谁，名字对她来讲也只是个代称。她不讨厌自己叫安普莎，但你要是问她你为什么叫安普莎，人偶也许会痛打你一顿。
　　安普莎不喜欢这些自称为仆人的人，难得的人偶心目中居然有“不喜欢”这个概念，这恐怕是因为她嗅到了让她讨厌的味道。
　　奇怪的是她并没有杀死这些人的想法，是因为这群人对她恭敬么？也不是，但是人偶已经不想再去追究下去了。
　　她心中有一个声音告诉她，她有非常重要的事情去做，但要问具体是什么事情，人偶便又不知道了。
　　很久以后她才知道自己现在所在的地方被称为黑暗议会，是圣域与人间沟通的重要桥梁，议会成员虽多由人间种族组成，但是他们对圣域的信仰，较之最狂热的信徒犹有过之。
　　人偶总是会觉得这些家伙好笑，这些背叛自己种族的人，却能异常虔诚地效忠另外一个种族，他们甚至没有亲眼见过圣域种族究竟是什么样子。
　　这些人对强者的盲目崇拜，是为了将自己区别于普罗大众的一种疯狂的认同感。距离产生了足够的幻想空间，为了这份虚无的幻想甚至于可以献出自己生命。
　　他们会对握有暴力权柄的人抱有尊重或是恐惧。安普莎从不缺乏应对暴力的手段，亦或者她才是暴力本身。这个获得黑暗之源青睐的人偶，从力量维度来讲，已经走到了魔法生物的极致。
　　当一切物质上的满足已经变得无关紧要之后，绝大多数人都会感到茫然。于是他们便会寻求另一种精神上的追求，总是浑浑噩噩的人偶于是便有了精神上的追求。
　　由于自身无可匹敌的力量，黑暗世界的勾心斗角肮脏龌龊离她非常遥远，没有人敢去算计一位“不死魔王”的传承者。
　　现在这位传承者想要知道，自己诞生的意义是什么，又是谁创造了她。
English:
(3–1748, Era of Frost Veil) The Doll awakened to see piles of corpses around a giant furnace. People in dark purple robes, with madness in their eyes, waved their staffs and rushed toward her.
Without hesitation, the Doll snapped all their necks. She felt nothing special about killing, and the same applied to kindness.
Soon, another group arrived, calling themselves her servants. They informed her that the rebels outside were all eliminated and pleaded for Lady Ampsa's forgiveness.
Ampsa? Are they talking about me? So my name is Ampsa?
She didn't care about her name; it was just a label. She didn't mind being called Ampsa, but asking her why could lead to trouble.
Ampsa couldn't stand those who claimed to be her servants. It was unusual for the Doll to "dislike" something, but she likely sensed something off.
Strangely, she didn't feel like killing them. It wasn't because they were respectful, but the Doll chose not to think about it further.
A voice inside her told her that she had something very important to do, but she didn't know what it was.
Much later, she learned this place was the Dark Parliament, a vital link between the Holyscape and earth. Though mostly human, the council's faith in the Holyscape surpassed even the most fanatical believers.
The Doll found them amusing. They betrayed their race to serve another with extreme devotion, despite never seeing the Holyscape beings.
Their blind worship of strength was a mad attempt to stand out from the masses. Distance fueled their fantasies, and they were willing to die for that illusion.
They respected or feared those with violent power. Ampsa knew how to handle violence, or perhaps she was violence itself. Favored by the Source of Darkness, the Doll had reached the peak of magical power.
When material satisfaction no longer mattered, most people felt lost and sought spiritual pursuits. The once aimless Doll now found a spiritual purpose..
Her unmatched power kept the dark world's schemes distant, as no one dared to plot against the heir of the "Deathless Overlord".
Now, the Doll sought to understand her purpose and creator.

议会内部并非全都是抱有崇高理想之人，更多的是为主流社会所不容的流亡者，只不过这样的人往往不会担任重要的职位。

　　“为什么？你能让她如此恐惧，她连死都不怕，为什么向你求饶？”
　　“尊敬的传承者，她的恐惧源自于对家人的爱。”
　　安普莎有些迷惑，她不知道爱是什么，于是便问周围的人，什么是爱？但这些以他人痛苦为乐的家伙们又怎么会懂得什么是爱？
　　尊贵的安普莎阁下怎么能容忍有人回避自己的问题。刚才还在施虐的猎人成了猎物，可惜的是这些猎物连求饶的机会都没有。
　　人偶心情好了不少，至于为什么，她不知道。是伸张了所谓的正义么？人偶不想知道。她现在只想知道那些人口中的爱是什么，这愿望竟如此强烈。
English:
Not everyone in the council had noble intentions; many were exiles rejected by society, though they rarely held important roles.
To the Doll, there's no distinction between good and evil; only the conflict between the powerful and the weak. Ideals are merely rhetoric used to gain power.
It was a sorrowful event that shifted her viewpoint: a traitor had breached the spy network for the Elaira Kingdom, leading the council to dispatch agents to apprehend him.
The cambion endured three days of torture. As the executioner severed her finger, he whispered to the delirious woman:
"Your impurity won't be overlooked; your husband and daughter will follow. However, for our past, I might grant you mercy."
These words shattered the woman, whose defiance crumbled under torture and death as she clung to a final, desperate hope.
Lying prostrate with a broken spine, the woman sobbed, her tears mingling with blood as her mutilated mouth rendered her speechless.
She uttered indistinct sounds, likely pleas for mercy, as laughter from former peers echoed, some stifling true feelings while others reveled in cruelty.
"Only one of them shall live; the choice is yours. You have but ten seconds to decide which, impure one."
Exposing her bald head, the woman trembled and traced "kid" with blood from her severed finger, hoping for her child's survival as she shared in her husband's suffering.
A voice echoed in the cavern, laughing, "Bring that child to me alive; the man is irrelevant."
Ampsa found the tragic scene, her first taste of displeasure. Approaching the woman's lifeless body, she noticed the antler ring on the ground and asked.
"Why? You instilled such terror in her; she feared not death but begged for mercy from you."
"Esteemed Heir, her dread stemmed from the love she held for her family."
Confused about love, Ampsa asked those nearby what it meant, but how could those who thrived on suffering grasp its essence?
How could Lady Ampsa tolerate someone avoiding her question? The tormentor was now the hunted, and sadly, there was no opportunity for mercy.
The Doll's mood lifted, but she didn't know why. Was it justice? She had no interest in finding out. Her sole desire was to grasp love.

Chinese:

　　于是大陆上便出现了一位逢人便问爱是什么的人偶，如果答案没有让她满意的话，你可能就要遭受一些皮肉之苦了。
　　安普莎从未得到过令自己满意的答案，但不知为何她从未想过放弃，因为总有一个声音告诉她，这件事情非常重要。
　　黑暗世界的不断壮大，再加上无法无天的魔偶，早已让天界极度不满。于光明之中诞生的卫尔特斯“破魔者”贝希丽丝，降临人间。
　　她秉承太阳的意志而生，要将这人间的一切黑暗尽数扫除。身为黑暗议会的利剑，安普莎首当其冲。
　　于是黑暗与光明在人间相遇。
　　“这位天使小姐，你知道什么是爱么？”
　　这与天使所构想的场景完全不同，在她心中，所有黑暗生物都应该是面目狰狞恐怖。可面前的这位人偶只是面露笑意的问她，什么是爱。
　　光明使者是一切黑暗的克星。难到对人偶来说知道爱是什么要比或者更加重要么？
　　黑暗之源谱系中，“不死魔王”的灵魂本该永不消散，可破魔者手中的“光明使者”正是净化一切黑暗的利刃，人力不可违逆的黑暗力量被这位天使撕碎。
　　人间追求的物质，情爱，在永生种面前终究会随着时间消散，唯有神灵永恒。
　　直到最后，人偶还是不懂得爱是什么。想要与安普莎合作的魔女们可要注意了，万一不能给人偶满意的答案，那么你可能会有些危险噢。
English:
Ampsa questioned everyone about the meaning of love, but as expected, those incompetent beings couldn't provide a satisfactory answer. Consequently, the parliament suffered significant losses.
As the parliament grew, the world of darkness became increasingly powerful, a force too large for any individual to control. They could have abandoned the troublesome Doll earlier but chose to endure the instability she brought.
To mitigate losses, parliament members lured Ampsa into human society, claiming that she would finally find her answer there. Thus, the Doll emerged, asking everyone what love was. If she didn't receive a satisfying response, those who tried to answer would face consequences.
Ampsa had never encountered a satisfying answer and was determined not to give up. A voice in her head reminded her that finding the answer was crucial.
The Heavenly Realm was displeased with the news of the dark world gaining power and the Puppet losing control. In response, Beatrice, the "Demon Slayer," a Werth born of light, descended to the human world.
Gifted with the will of the sun to eradicate dark forces, she saw Ampsa as a prime target.
In the human world, light and dark clashed.
"Miss Angel, do you know what love is?" Ampsa asked. This question caught the angel off guard; she expected darkness to be associated with hatred. Yet, the Doll simply smiled and inquired about love.
The Lightbringer was an enemy of all darkness. Was the Doll's quest for love more important than her own survival?
According to the Source of Darkness, the "Deathless Overlord" was supposed to possess an eternal soul. However, the Demon Slayer's sharp blade ultimately shattered that invincible dark force.
All material and emotional desires of humanity fade with time; only the gods endure eternally.
The Doll did not learn what love was before her demise. Those who wish to ally with Ampsa must tread carefully; failing to provide a satisfying answer could lead to grave danger.

Chinese:
雷米尔：
　　（第二纪元28627－第三纪元3年）“光辉的余烬”雷米尔，希尔拜亚帝国最后一位皇储，二王之战的导火索，黑暗议会的缔造者。雷米尔出生在希尔拜亚帝国晚期，时任女王洛佩西正是希楠嫡系所出，此时希楠派系主政已经持续三代，极端种族主义的希楠人甚至开始染指教会，这早就引起金穗派与教廷的强烈不满。时任教宗卡米拉三世与当时的金穗派领袖，雷米尔之父德里克·内兹联合，不顾女王反对以神谕为借口将德里克之女雷米尔任命为王储。而女王洛佩西的意外身亡，则加剧了这一矛盾。两派爆发了激烈的冲突，二王之战后希尔拜亚分崩离析。

黑暗议会：
　　（第二纪元28647－第三纪元1749年）由“光辉的余烬”雷米尔所建立的地下组织，这位王储为了逃避追杀，不惜将灵魂出卖给恶魔以获得更强大的实力，在通过试炼之后她联系父亲旧部建立名为“复仇者”的组织。后来为了壮大势力她接纳魔人，以及对数量庞大的流亡者提供庇护，组织更名为黑暗议会。

贝希丽丝：
　　（第三纪元1748-1753），“破魔者”贝希丽丝是掌管净化规则的卫尔特斯。

圣域贵族：
　　这里指深渊议会的五大世袭家族，他们在主宰沉睡之时代替管理深渊事物，一般在五大家族选出七人作为常任议员，由于主宰经常陷入沉睡导致常任议员几乎成为实际意义上的深渊最高长官。五大家族分别为：坎贝尔（2），霍洛韦尔（2），莱克希儿（1），阿里安（1），蓬托（1）

母神：
　　一般指“禁忌之轮”艾琳娜，她是深渊实质上的主宰。艾琳娜建立了一系列的深渊制度，并放弃永恒的生命将自身化为“黑暗之源”，记载与传承所有深渊血脉，抽取古树的力量给予深渊诸族生育的权利，福泽后代，被深渊生物称为母神。
English:
Remiel:
Remiel (Era of Rebirth 28627–Frost Veil 3), known as the "Ember of Radiance," was the last heir of the Hilbeyan Empire and instigator of the Monarchs' War. Born during Queen Lopesie's reign, her birth coincided with the Hinan faction's oppressive policies. Discontent grew among the Wheatears and the papacy, leading to a divine decree from Holy Shepherd Camilla III and Remiel's father, Derek Nez, appointing her as heir. Lopesie's unexpected death escalated tensions, culminating in the Hilbeyan Empire's collapse.

Dark Parliament:
Founded by Remiel (Era of Rebirth 28647–Frost Veil 1749) to escape persecution, the Dark Parliament began as the "Avengers," composed of her father's allies. After selling her soul to a demon for power, she expanded the organization to include cambions and exiles.

Beatrice:
Beatrice (1748–1753, Era of Frost Veil), known as the "Demon Slayer," was a Werth who oversaw purification rules.

Nobles of the Holyscape:
Refers to the five hereditary families of the Abyssal Council managing Abyss affairs during the Overlord's slumber. The families are Campbell (2 seats), Holowell (2 seats), Lexir (1 seat), Arian (1 seat), and Ponto (1 seat).

Mother Goddess:
Typically refers to Elena, associated with "Taboo and Betrayal," the de facto ruler of the Abyss. She sacrificed her eternal life to become the "Source of Darkness," establishing Abyssal systems, preserving bloodlines, and blessing future generations with the ability to reproduce.

　　（第二紀元28647－第三紀元1749年）由“光輝的餘燼”雷米爾所建立的地下組織，這位王儲為了逃避追殺，不惜將靈魂出賣給惡魔以獲得更強大的實力，在通過試煉之後她聯繫父親舊部建立名為“復仇者”的組織。後來為了壯大勢力她接納魔人，以及對數量龐大的流亡者提供庇護，組織更名為黑暗議會。

貝希麗絲：
　　（第三紀元1748-1753），“破魔者”貝希麗絲是掌管淨化規則的衛爾特斯。

聖域貴族：
　　這裏指深淵議會的五大世襲家族，他們在主宰沉睡之時代替管理深淵事物，一般在五大家族選出七人作為常任議員，由於主宰經常陷入沉睡導致常任議員幾乎成為實際意義上的深淵最高長官。五大家族分別為：坎貝爾（2），霍洛韋爾（2），萊克希兒（1），阿裏安（1），蓬托（1）

母神：
　　一般指“禁忌之輪”艾琳娜，她是深淵實質上的主宰。艾琳娜建立了一系列的深淵制度，並放棄永恆的生命將自身化為“黑暗之源”，記載與傳承所有深淵血脈，抽取古樹的力量給予深淵諸族生育的權利，福澤後代，被深淵生物稱為母神。

English: Living in the contemporary metropolis of Luthart, she is a tribal leader bearing the moniker of "Inferno". She is formidable and pugnacious, engaging foes with a magical iron staff enshrouded in flames. She is also capable of powerful punches that are seldom employed.

（圣堂历2004-2021）库萝爱并不知道自己的来历，自打记事起，她就和自己的妹妹库萝心一起流浪。
　　艰难的生活让库萝爱养成了睚眦必报、冲动火爆的性格。要不是有库萝爱威胁性的低吼和张牙舞爪，姐妹俩个一定会饱受欺凌。但库斯的出现改变了一切。
　　“别，别过来！你想干什么？我可是很强的！”
　　“……我问你，你想要吃饱饭，住大房子，而不是桥洞吗？跟我走吧。”
　　库斯在垃圾箱旁发现了这对姐妹。一开始，库萝爱对库斯非常警惕，对库斯将她们带离流浪生活的画饼更是嗤之以鼻，毕竟什么人会突然收养两个流浪儿？
　　然而，库斯的眼神非常认真，库萝爱本能地觉得自己似乎可以相信这个人。在犹豫了一下后，库萝爱还是握住了库斯伸出的手。
　　就这样，库斯将姐妹俩带回了炎鬼族，并给她们分别取名为爱和心。
　　而之后的事情证明了库斯并没有看走眼。库萝爱在15岁的时候便觉醒了炎鬼血脉，召唤出了炎鬼一族中故老相传的炎鬼长子玛利。整个炎鬼族为此而疯狂，很多人认为有了库萝爱，他们便有机会可以堂堂正正的生活。
　　库斯也没有一丝犹豫，将自己的族长之位传给了库萝爱，速度之快甚至让库萝爱都有些惊讶。话虽如此，库萝爱毕竟年幼，很多族群事务仍然是库斯和其部下在打理。
　　而在同时，库萝爱也醉心于提升自己的力量，她牢记着养父对自己的教导：没有力量，就什么都无法保护。反过来说，要证明自己具有力量，就能以最直接的力量打碎任何想要阻碍自己的东西。
　　当然，库萝爱并非纯粹地热衷于暴力。对她而言，暴力只是最为行之有效，能够保护她的妹妹以及她所珍视的炎鬼帮成员的方法，而这毫无疑问地来源于她童年时的街头经验。
　　炎鬼一族对库萝爱而言是收留她的地方，这么多年过去，库萝爱早已将之视作自己的家，而所有炎鬼族的成员都是她的家人。为了保护自己的家人，库萝爱什么都做得出来。
　　唯一令库萝爱相当烦恼的是，库萝心贵为炎鬼族的二当家，却不听她的劝阻，执意当什么偶像。
　　“库萝心，不要那么频繁地抛头露面了，和泉市可是高岛家族的大本营，被他们发现了你怎么办？”
　　“诶？有什么关系嘛，姐姐没听说过，最危险的地方就是最安全的地方吗~而且有姐姐在，他们真想做什么，你也一定会教训他们的！”
　　“真拿你没办法……”
　　对外强硬的库萝爱唯独对自己的妹妹没办法，她不会说什么煽情的话，只能以实际行动——加倍小心地保护自己妹妹——来体现她对妹妹的关心。
　　然而，正是库萝爱的强势崛起，使得门萨的守护者高岛家族和圣职者教会终于感受到了她的存在。
　　高岛家的现任族长元宗说服了军方采取行动，他们要扼杀尚未完全成长的玛利，年幼的族长明白，炎鬼一族的危机即将来临。

(2004–2021, Sanctum Calendar) Kuroae didn't know her origins. For as long as she could remember, she had been wandering with her sister Kurogo.
The harsh life made Kuroae vengeful, impulsive, and fierce. Her threats and bluffs were how the sisters survived on the streets. But Kus' arrival changed everything.
"Stop, don't come closer! What do you want? I am an ass-kicker!"
"Let me ask you. Do you want to be well-fed and live in a big house instead of under a bridge? Come with me."
Kus found the sisters near a garbage bin. Initially, Kuroae was wary of Kus and dismissed his offer to rescue them from their vagrant life. Why would anyone adopt two stray children without a reason?
However, Kus' sincere gaze made Kuroae feel she could trust him. After a brief hesitation, she took his outstretched hand.
Then, Kus brought the sisters back to the Infernos and named them Kuroae and Kurogo.
Kus' judgment was soon proven right. At 15, Kuroae awakened her Inferno lineage and summoned Mali, the first child of the Infernos. The Inferno clan was ecstatic, believing Kuroae could lead them to a better life.
Kus swiftly made Kuroae the chieftain, surprising her with the speed of his decision. However, since Kuroae was still young, Kus and his subordinates continued handling most of the clan's affairs.
Meanwhile, Kuroae focused on growing her strength, always recalling her adoptive father's advice: Without strength, you can't protect anything. But with enough power, you can crush any obstacle.
Kuroae wasn't solely driven by violence. For her, it was simply the most effective way to protect her sister and the Infernos, a belief shaped by her childhood on the streets.
The Infernos gave Kuroae a home, and over time, she saw them as her family. Kuroae would do anything to protect them.
What troubled Kuroae was that Kurogo, the Infernos' second-in-command, insisted on being a celebrity against her wishes.
"Kurogo, stop showing up so much. Malspring is Takashima territory. What if they discover you?"
"Huh? What's the big deal? Sis, haven't you heard the safest place is the most dangerous one? And if they try anything, I know you'll take care of them!"
"What should I do about you?"
Kuroae was tough, but always made exceptions for her sister. Unable to express her feelings, she showed her care by being extra protective.
Kuroae's swift rise finally caught the attention of the Takashimas, Mensa's Defenders, and the Church of Clerics.
Takashima's chieftain Genzo persuaded the military to act against the young Mali. The chieftain realized a crisis was approaching for the Infernos.

Chinese:
库萝爱的性格让她不会就这么坐以待毙，看着高岛家族张开对付炎鬼一族的巨网。何况，库萝爱深知“云端”带给高岛家族的优势，有了“云端”，高岛家族可以轻易监控炎鬼族的动向。
　　在这种绝对的信息差面前，任何大规模的对抗行动都会让炎鬼一族陷入极端被动不利的局面，他们的一举一动都会被“云端”所捕捉。对此，库萝爱做出了非常符合她性格的行动——孤身一人对付高岛家族。
　　炸掉高岛家族的军火工厂、妨碍军方和高岛家的交易，诸如此类等等，库萝爱几乎是以一己之力在对抗高岛家的行动。这段时期，库萝爱终于让门萨人见识到了她的力量。
　　于是库萝爱终于遇到了她的对手——在鬼族中口耳相传的“剧毒”，狩猎鬼族，令鬼族闻风丧胆的佣兵。刚一交手，库萝爱便感觉剧毒并没有传闻中的那么可怕，以至于她怀疑那些鬼族们只是在为自己的失败找借口，夸大了这个门萨佣兵的实力。
　　然而，剧毒很快就展现了她捕捉时机和对手弱点的能力——趁库萝爱因放松警惕而产生的片刻大意，剧毒以受到重伤为代价逃走了，库萝爱知道，这不会是她们之间最后一次交手。
　　之后剧毒和库萝爱又交手了几次，剧毒每次一开始都落于下风，却都可以利用自己对城市的了解和她的那台机车逃脱。库萝爱也敏锐地发现，每次与剧毒交手，她都会变得更强。
　　这样下去的话，迟早有一天，剧毒将会和获得和她匹敌的力量。为了一劳永逸地解决问题，库萝爱不想再让她逃脱了，她决定召唤玛利。
　　“你就这么憎恨鬼族吗？哪怕牺牲自己的性命也要消灭我们？”
　　“当然！你们不仅害死了我的母亲，还掳走了门萨人小孩，把他们当做你们训练的工具！”
　　“门萨人小孩？我掳走他们做什么？”
　　“事到如今，还想否认吗！”
　　无所谓了，今天她必须解决掉剧毒，玛利澎湃的能量将周围的一切融化，正在剧毒逐渐不支时高岛家的人却闯了进来，剧毒也得以顺利脱身。
　　但相比剧毒逃跑，更令库萝爱在意的是掳走门萨人小孩这件事。库萝爱并不知情，她必须知晓其中真相。
　　经过调查得知，原来是族中的元老暗中与门萨人交易，用炎鬼族的武器资源交换门萨人的孩童，以此训练部队。
　　知晓了一切的库萝爱暴跳如雷，她无法容忍这接近于背叛的行径。尽管她的养父库斯提醒她，炎鬼族需要有生力量，况且交易本身也未必会对炎鬼族不利，库萝爱却仍然难以容忍这样的事情发生。
　　不过库斯说对了一点：四鬼将长期作为炎鬼族的实际掌控人，仅仅是这点事迹还不足以扳倒他们，直接发难一定会导致他们的疯狂反抗，最终引发炎鬼族的内战。而现在，处境危险的炎鬼族最不需要的就是内部冲突。
　　在她最尊重的养父库斯的建议下，库萝爱决定暂时忍耐下来，寻机处理这些人。而在此事以后，库萝爱也意识到了，自己与剧毒的相似之处。她明白了剧毒不断变强的理由可能与自己一样，也是为了守护自己的亲人和伙伴。
　　但库萝爱心底清楚，门萨人与炎鬼族间的血海深仇不会仅仅因为这点事就改变，她们之间必然会有一场生死之战。而这个日子并不遥远。
English:
Kuroae cannot sit back while the Takashimas try to capture the Infernos; it's not in her nature. She's aware of how "Cloud" allows them to track the Infernos effectively.
The Takashimas' advantage with "Cloud" would severely handicap the Infernos in a large-scale fight. In line with her nature, Kuroae chose to face the Takashimas by herself.
Kuroae targeted the Takashimas' arms factory and military transactions, significantly impacting their operations and finally revealing her power to the Mensa.
Kuroae met her equal in the mercenary "Poison," who was feared among the Infernos. Yet, she found him less terrifying than the whispers suggested, leading her to think the Infernos might be inflating his threat to excuse their shortcomings.
Demonstrating a talent for seizing opportunities, Poison capitalized on Kuroae's momentary lapse in focus to escape, suffering a significant injury in the process. Kuroae realized this wouldn't be their last meeting.
Kuroae and Poison crossed paths repeatedly, with Poison often at a disadvantage yet always escaping through his city knowledge and motorcycle skills. Kuroae noted his increasing strength each time.
If this continued, Poison's growing strength would eventually rival Kuroae's. Determined to end it, Kuroae resolved that Poison wouldn't escape again and decided to summon Mali.
"Do you truly hate the Infernos so much that you'd risk your own life to destroy us?"
"Absolutely! You not only killed my mother, but you also abducted Mensa children and used them as training tools!"
"Mensa children? Why would I abduct them?"
"After everything you've done, how can you still try to deny it!"
Today, Kuroae must eliminate Poison. Mali's energy melted everything nearby, but just as Poison was about to give in, the Takashimas arrived, letting him escape.
Kuroae was more troubled by the abduction of Mensa children than Poison's escape. Unaware of the situation, she felt driven to uncover the truth.
It was discovered that the elders of her clan had been secretly exchanging weapons from the Infernos for Mensa children, training them as troops.
Furious at the betrayal, Kuroae couldn't accept the elders' actions. Her adoptive father, Kus, argued that the Infernos needed a fighting force and that the trade might not harm them, but Kuroae still found it unacceptable.
Kus had a point: the Four Devils had effectively led the Infernos for years, and this incident didn't warrant their removal. Confronting them could spark a desperate resistance and civil war, which the beleaguered Infernos desperately needed to avoid.
Following Kus's wise counsel, Kuroae decided to bide her time and look for an opportunity to confront those at fault. She recognized that her drive to become stronger, like Poison's, stemmed from a desire to protect her loved ones.
Kuroae knew deep down that the longstanding animosity between the Mensa and the Infernos wouldn't be resolved by this incident, and a life-or-death confrontation was inevitable—and soon.

庫蘿愛的性格讓她不會就這麼坐以待斃，看著高島家族張開對付炎鬼一族的巨網。何況，庫蘿愛深知“雲端”帶給高島家族的優勢，有了“雲端”，高島家族可以輕易監控炎鬼族的動向。
　　在這種絕對的資訊差面前，任何大規模的對抗行動都會讓炎鬼一族陷入極端被動不利的局面，他們的一舉一動都會被“雲端”所捕捉。對此，庫蘿愛做出了非常符合她性格的行動——孤身一人對付高島家族。
　　炸掉高島家族的軍火工廠、妨礙軍方和高島家的交易，諸如此類等等，庫蘿愛幾乎是以一己之力在對抗高島家的行動。這段時期，庫蘿愛終於讓門薩人見識到了她的力量。
　　於是庫蘿愛終於遇到了她的對手——在鬼族中口耳相傳的“劇毒”，狩獵鬼族，令鬼族聞風喪膽的傭兵。剛一交手，庫蘿愛便感覺劇毒並沒有傳聞中的那麼可怕，以至於她懷疑那些鬼族們只是在為自己的失敗找藉口，誇大了這個門薩傭兵的實力。
　　然而，劇毒很快就展現了她捕捉時機和對手弱點的能力——趁庫蘿愛因放鬆警惕而產生的片刻大意，劇毒以受到重傷為代價逃走了，庫蘿愛知道，這不會是她們之間最後一次交手。
　　之後劇毒和庫蘿愛又交手了幾次，劇毒每次一開始都落於下風，卻都可以利用自己對城市的瞭解和她的那臺機車逃脫。庫蘿愛也敏銳地發現，每次與劇毒交手，她都會變得更強。
　　這樣下去的話，遲早有一天，劇毒將會和獲得和她匹敵的力量。為了一勞永逸地解決問題，庫蘿愛不想再讓她逃脫了，她決定召喚瑪利。
　　“你就這麼憎恨鬼族嗎？哪怕犧牲自己的性命也要消滅我們？”
　　“當然！你們不僅害死了我的母親，還擄走了門薩人小孩，把他們當做你們訓練的工具！”
　　“門薩人小孩？我擄走他們做什麼？”
　　“事到如今，還想否認嗎！”
　　無所謂了，今天她必須解決掉劇毒，瑪利澎湃的能量將周圍的一切融化，正在劇毒逐漸不支時高島家的人卻闖了進來，劇毒也得以順利脫身。
　　但相比劇毒逃跑，更令庫蘿愛在意的是擄走門薩人小孩這件事。庫蘿愛並不知情，她必須知曉其中真相。
　　經過調查得知，原來是族中的元老暗中與門薩人交易，用炎鬼族的武器資源交換門薩人的孩童，以此訓練部隊。
　　知曉了一切的庫蘿愛暴跳如雷，她無法容忍這接近於背叛的行徑。儘管她的養父庫斯提醒她，炎鬼族需要有生力量，況且交易本身也未必會對炎鬼族不利，庫蘿愛卻仍然難以容忍這樣的事情發生。
　　不過庫斯說對了一點：四鬼將長期作為炎鬼族的實際掌控人，僅僅是這點事蹟還不足以扳倒他們，直接發難一定會導致他們的瘋狂反抗，最終引發炎鬼族的內戰。而現在，處境危險的炎鬼族最不需要的就是內部衝突。
　　在她最尊重的養父庫斯的建議下，庫蘿愛決定暫時忍耐下來，尋機處理這些人。而在此事以後，庫蘿愛也意識到了，自己與劇毒的相似之處。她明白了劇毒不斷變強的理由可能與自己一樣，也是為了守護自己的親人和夥伴。
　　但庫蘿愛心底清楚，門薩人與炎鬼族間的血海深仇不會僅僅因為這點事就改變，她們之間必然會有一場生死之戰。而這個日子並不遙遠。

Chinese:
终于，库萝爱找到了处理四鬼将的机会。在她与妹妹的合谋之下，一名鬼族不慎卷入了四鬼将的交易中，四鬼将为了避免自己的罪行败露，而决定让这名鬼族“消失”。
　　与门萨人交易是一回事，蓄意谋杀自己的同族就是另一回事了。四鬼将的行径被披露，鬼族内部几乎是顷刻间沸反盈天，库萝爱“听从众人建议”处决了四鬼将。

　　库萝爱与剧毒陷入了持久战中，而这对库萝爱尤为不利，召唤和驱使玛利不是没有代价的，她能感觉到自己的精力正在迅速流失。再不快点取胜的话……

　　库萝心这时候才堪堪处理完了埋伏的高岛家族军队，赶来助阵。随着库萝心领域的张开，局势瞬间逆转，库萝爱得到了恢复，而剧毒却受到了强烈影响，无法再发挥原有实力。
　　毫不意外地，剧毒落败了。库萝爱站在倒下的剧毒面前，冷冷望着满脸不甘的她。她拿起“剧毒”的匕首缓缓的插入到了她的胸口。
　　但杀死剧毒并非战斗的结束。得到片刻喘息的库萝爱扭过头去，恰好目睹库斯被高岛元宗斩杀的一幕。库萝爱这才意识到，正是因为库斯，高岛元宗才没有赶过来和剧毒一起对付自己。
　　在库萝爱撕心裂肺的呼喊中，玛利失控了。丧父的悲痛和愤怒让库萝爱失去了理智，也失去了对玛利的掌控；在玛利不祥的笑声中，岩浆和火焰涌出她的身体，淹没了街道。
　　——这就是库萝爱最后的记忆。之后再次睁开眼，库萝爱已经身处米伦。
English:
\u3000Kuroae finally found a chance to deal with the Four Devils. She teamed up with her younger sister to lure one of the Infernos into a trade with the Four Devils, who decided to eliminate their comrade to prevent their crimes from being exposed.
While trading with Mensa was one thing, killing one of their own was another. Once the Four Devils' wrongdoings became known, nearly all the Infernos were outraged. Kuroae, claiming to "listen to public opinion," executed the Four Devils.
Unity was the only means of survival.
However, Takashima Genzo never expected to see a united group of Infernos, especially since they posed a significant threat to the "Cloud."
The final battle occurred as expected. In 2021 of the Sanctum Calendar, Takashima Genzo and her daughter Takashima Rin participated in the crackdown campaign.
"Are you the Takashima girl? No wonder you disgust me."
"Kuroae, let's settle this today."
Kuroae did not hide her true strength and summoned Mali directly. To her surprise, victory didn't come easily; instead, Poison responded effortlessly.
Engaging in a prolonged battle with Poison was disadvantageous for Kuroae, as summoning and controlling Mali drained her energy. She thought, If I can't finish this quickly…
"Kuroae! Don't worry. I'm here to help!" Kurogo suddenly cleared the Takashima corps in ambush and rushed to assist her sister. With Kurogo showcasing her abilities, the tide of battle quickly turned. Kuroae seized the moment to recover, while Poison began to falter.
Predictably, Poison was defeated. Kuroae stood over her, who lay collapsed on the ground, and coldly regarded her vanquished foe. She picked up Poison's dagger and slowly plunged it into her chest.
But killing Poison didn't end the battle. After a brief pause, Kuroae turned around just in time to see Takashima Genzo slay Kus. Realization dawned on Kuroae: it was Kus who had prevented Genzo from reinforcing Poison.
Mali lost control amidst Kuroae's desperate cries. The grief and rage of losing her father overwhelmed her, rendering her incapable of managing Mali. As a result, Mali unleashed ominous laughter, allowing lava and flames to erupt from her body, flooding the streets.
That was Kuroae's last memory. The next time she opened her eyes, she found herself in Mirren.

Chinese:
（第三纪元12965-13001年）出身于伊德公国的琳文阜地区，是家中独女。
　　贝拉的母亲出自于前伊德时期的著名锻造家族，她对贝拉的教育异常严格，但是小贝拉的性格更加像父亲一些，总是一副天不怕地不怕的样子。
　　为了应付母亲，父女二人也经常同仇敌忾，当然这其中自是少不了互相出卖，但大多数情况下镇子里响彻的总是贝拉的惨叫，父亲远比小贝拉更懂得怎样获取母亲的原谅。
　　脑回路清奇的贝拉将一切都归于自己是个独生女这一点上，如果自己有个弟弟或者妹妹的话母亲大人就会分身乏术，再不会这么严苛地要求自己。而且自己年纪大，弟弟妹妹一定是没自己聪明的，到时候犯错也好嫁祸。
　　等他稍微长大一点也学会甩锅的时候，贝拉大人早就能自力更生了，那岂不是美哉？
　　于是乎小贝拉干出了令人瞠目结舌的事情。她居然潜入教会，把教会收留的孤儿带到自己家中，玩过家家。
　　教会的孩子丢失可是件大事儿，搞不好就是魔物入侵，当地主教立即下令全城戒严，到处张贴告示让民众减少外出，甚至一度影响了矿石的开采交易。
　　贝拉这时候也知道自己闯了大祸了，但母亲罕见地并没有责罚她，而是带着贝拉和那些孩子前往教会祈求宽恕。
　　母亲是戴尔芬教会的虔诚信徒，这样的拐卖事件已经严重触及了教规，贝拉眼中一向无所不能的母亲静静跪在教会门口，这幅画面给贝拉造成了极大的震撼。
　　她虽然仍执拗地不肯下跪，心中为自己开脱，想着自己如此做法还不是因为母亲过于严格才导致出此下策，就在这时她听到了母亲的话。
　　“伟大的繁育之神，我，莫灵家族后裔，您虔诚的信徒，被欲望蒙蔽了双眼，我的心灵受到了玷污，我的行为触及教规，恳请您降下神谕以惩罚净化我污浊的灵魂。”
　　母亲没和自己讲什么敢作敢当的大道理，她甚至欺骗了信仰的神明，只为女儿能够免受责罚。
　　由于莫灵家族毕竟是矮人大贵族，这场闹剧最终以母亲被永久革去教藉，鞭罚二十五下作为惩戒收场。
　　母亲的后背虽然被藤鞭抽打得血肉模糊，但所有人都知道对于一个戴尔芬信徒，革去教藉带来的伤害远比身体所受到的痛苦要严重得多。
　　人总是在经历重大挫折之后才学会成长，从此贝拉终于学会了循规蹈矩，虽然这代价有些太大了些。
English:
(12965–13001, Era of Frost Veil) Bella was born in Lyrsmoor, Eude, as her family's only daughter.
Bella's mother was from a famous smithing family before Eude's founding, and she was strict. But young Bella was fearless, like her father.
Bella and her father often teamed up to deal with her mother, though their alliance could waver. Bella's cries often echoed through town, as her father was better at winning her mother's forgiveness.
Bella, in her peculiar mindset, blamed her problems on being an only child. She thought if she had siblings, her mother would be too busy to be strict, and being the older, smarter one, she could easily shift the blame.
By the time her siblings learned to shift blame, Bella would already be self-sufficient. How perfect would that be?
With these thoughts, little Bella did something shocking. She sneaked into the church, taking the sheltered orphans to her home to play house.
Children missing from the church was a serious issue, potentially indicating a monster invasion. The local bishop quickly imposed a citywide lockdown and posted notices urging people to stay indoors. Even mining operations were temporarily disrupted.
Bella realized she was in big trouble, but her mother didn't punish her as usual. Instead, she took Bella and the orphans to the church to seek forgiveness.
Bella's mother, a devout Delfin Church follower, saw the abduction as a grave breach of church law. Bella was deeply shocked to see her usually powerful mother quietly kneeling outside the church.
Though she stubbornly refused to kneel, she justified her actions by blaming her mother's strictness. Then, she heard her mother's words.
"Great God of Fertility, I, a Morins descendant and your faithful follower, blinded by desire, have defiled my spirit and violated church teachings. Please send an oracle to punish and purify my tainted soul."
Bella's mother didn't lecture her about responsibility. Instead, she deceived her deity to protect her daughter from punishment.
Because the Morins were a noble dwarf family, the incident ended with Bella's mother being whipped 25 times and expelled from the church permanently.
Bella's mother's back was bloody and mangled from the whipping, but everyone knew that for a Delfin believer, being expelled from the church was a far greater torment than any physical pain.
People often grow after major setbacks. Though the cost was high, Bella finally learned to follow the rules.

　　腦回路清奇的貝拉將一切都歸於自己是個獨生女這一點上，如果自己有個弟弟或者妹妹的話母親大人就會分身乏術，再不會這麼嚴苛地要求自己。而且自己年紀大，弟弟妹妹一定是沒自己聰明的，到時候犯錯也好嫁禍。
　　等他稍微長大一點也學會甩鍋的時候，貝拉大人早就能自力更生了，那豈不是美哉？
　　於是乎小貝拉幹出了令人瞠目結舌的事情。她居然潛入教會，把教會收留的孤兒帶到自己家中，玩過家家。
　　教會的孩子丟失可是件大事兒，搞不好就是魔物入侵，當地主教立即下令全城戒嚴，到處張貼告示讓民眾減少外出，甚至一度影響了礦石的開採交易。
　　貝拉這時候也知道自己闖了大禍了，但母親罕見地並沒有責罰她，而是帶著貝拉和那些孩子前往教會祈求寬恕。
　　母親是戴爾芬教會的虔誠信徒，這樣的拐賣事件已經嚴重觸及了教規，貝拉眼中一向無所不能的母親靜靜跪在教會門口，這幅畫面給貝拉造成了極大的震撼。
　　她雖然仍執拗地不肯下跪，心中為自己開脫，想著自己如此做法還不是因為母親過於嚴格才導致出此下策，就在這時她聽到了母親的話。
　　“偉大的繁育之神，我，莫靈家族後裔，您虔誠的信徒，被欲望蒙蔽了雙眼，我的心靈受到了玷污，我的行為觸及教規，懇請您降下神諭以懲罰淨化我污濁的靈魂。”
　　母親沒和自己講什麼敢作敢當的大道理，她甚至欺騙了信仰的神明，只為女兒能夠免受責罰。
　　由於莫靈家族畢竟是矮人大貴族，這場鬧劇最終以母親被永久革去教藉，鞭罰二十五下作為懲戒收場。
　　母親的後背雖然被藤鞭抽打得血肉模糊，但所有人都知道對於一個戴爾芬信徒，革去教藉帶來的傷害遠比身體所受到的痛苦要嚴重得多。
　　人總是在經歷重大挫折之後才學會成長，從此貝拉終於學會了循規蹈矩，雖然這代價有些太大了些。

第三纪元12976年贝拉与当时的大部分矮人一样选择加入了教会，帝国国教“艾普莉”教会。
　　经过三年的历练，贝拉被当地主教授予教名，并在帝国高层的引荐下前往南方特米亚城就任主教。
　　虽然离家时有些不舍，但一想到终于能够摆脱母亲的高压教育，贝拉对特米亚城还是非常向往的。
　　终于到了出发的日子，即便是平时再烦母亲的絮叨，看着她已有些斑白的两鬓，贝拉也忍不住眼眶一酸。
　　赶紧转身别让父亲看了笑话，仍旧是大大咧咧的声音，故作漫不经心的样子，头也不回地踏上了离家的路，心中却一直在想母亲是不是一直在看自己远走的背影。
　　虽然路上少不了一些波折，但总归是顺利抵达了任地。
　　特米亚城的艾普莉教会与想象中的差距巨大，非但没有任何国教应有的富丽堂皇，甚至连教职人员都少得可怜。
　　看来她贝拉大人是被老头给骗了，说什么南方富庶之地，离王都又近，可不比西北苦寒之地，你去了就知道啦。
　　贝拉现在算是知道了，富庶不假，但是和她这个穷酸主教却是没有半毛钱的关系。
　　特米亚位处于戴尔芬教会与加布里埃尔教会势力的缓冲地带，两大教会明争暗斗数千年，城中势力盘根错节，利益早已经被瓜分得所剩无几。
　　能有一间破败的艾普莉教堂都算是给了皇帝陛下天大的面子，当然礼数还是要做足的，新任主教上任，城中贵族自是一顿接风洗尘少不了的。
　　但只要谈及修葺教堂的事情，各位老爷都是顾左右而言他。
　　“一个矮人，还是修格斯矮人，要是没有帝国皇帝令在身，怕是连给咱们这些“安雅”提鞋的机会都没有，还在那里什么修教堂，他要是能从克拉克家拿走一个子儿，我名字倒过来念！”
　　后来的事情大家也都有所耳闻，贝拉加入了心愿会，这个帝国上下最为神秘的组织，在圣母的帮助下，不仅他克拉克家族，城中大小贵族无一例外，全都给了捐赠。
　　胆大包天的矮人主教甚至伪装魔物袭击，趁机拆了加布里埃尔的教堂，其手脚之干净可不像是第一次做这样的事情。
　　国教在南方重镇站稳根基，让帝国皇帝韦布里斯大为开怀，又因为贝拉矮人的身份正符合自己倡导的种族融合观念，加之其出身名门，得到重用自然也是顺理成章。
　　第三纪元12983年，18岁的贝拉被调往永恩，进入帝国魔法学院成为当时最年轻的讲师，前途一片光明。
　　贝拉只想回家让母亲看看，她的孩子在外面混得还不错，可不是像她说的那样，谁也比不上。还一定要不经意间去显示自己的优秀，要不然会被人说成爱显摆。
　　自己可是见过帝国皇帝与教宗陛下的人了，即便是整个莫灵家族能做到这一点的也不多吧。
　　可是，身在帝国权力中心，有些事情不是想怎样就能够怎么样的。
English:
In 12976, the Era of Frost Veil, Bella, like many Dwarves, decided to join the imperial religion known as the April Church.
After three years of training, Bella received her ministerial name and, recommended by the hierarchy, became the bishop of Termia.
Though hesitant to leave home, Bella eagerly anticipated life in Termia, hoping to escape her mother's strict upbringing.
The day of departure finally came. Despite her annoyance at her mother's nagging, Bella felt emotional seeing her mother's graying hair.
Bella quickly turned away to hide her tears from her father. With a loud farewell, she left home, though she secretly wondered if her mother was watching her go.
Although there are always some difficulties on the road, Bella eventually arrived at her destination safely.
The April Church in Termia was nothing like Bella had imagined; it was less grand than she expected and had a small clergy.
Bella felt misled by the old bishop, who claimed the south was prosperous near the royal capital and not like the harsh northwest. "You'll see when you get there," he had told her.
Bella now understands that while the south is prosperous, it has nothing to do with her, a broke bishop.
Termia sits in the conflict zone between the Delfin and Gabriel Churches, both fighting for centuries. Forces are entrenched, and all resources are scarce.
The rundown Epria Church was a significant concession to the Emperor, and proper etiquette dictates a welcome banquet for the new bishop from the city's nobles.
But when it comes time to discuss repairing the church, the gentlemen are all eager to change the topic.
"A Dwarf, and a Sugeth one at that! If it weren't for an imperial edict, he wouldn't serve the Anyas. And church repairs? If the Clarks contribute a penny, I'll eat my hat!"
Later, Bella joined the enigmatic Wish Association. With the Holy Mother's aid, the Clarks and all the city's nobles generously contributed.
The daring Dwarf bishop faked a monster attack to dismantle the Church of Gabriel, leaving no trace behind. It seemed well-rehearsed.
The national religion took root in the southern stronghold, pleasing Emperor Webris. Bella, with her noble Dwarf heritage, became a key asset for the Emperor's vision of racial integration.
In 12983, the Era of Frost Veil, 18-year-old Bella entered the Imperial Magic Academy as its youngest instructor, poised for a bright future.
Bella's greatest desire was to go home and demonstrate to her mother that she was more than a weak girl, wanting to recount her achievements without coming across as arrogant.
After all, she had been honored by the Emperor and the Holy Shepherd—privileges not often granted, even to the illustrious Morins.
Yet, even in the center of the empire's power, not every desire could be easily fulfilled.

出身名门，年纪轻轻就担任外派主教，为国教在南方开辟新的根据地，并被帝国魔法学院破格录用，贝拉俨然是帝国内一颗冉冉升起的明星，然而身为这一切的主人公确实全然不觉。

English:
Bella was born into a distinguished family and became a bishop at a young age, gaining recognition as a rising star at the Imperial Magic Academy. However, she remained unaware of her own prominence.
The academy president continually complained to the Holy Shepherd, insisting that Bella should be removed from the institution, claiming that traditional Yagol students couldn't coexist with the "crude" Dwarf. He argued that the future of the Empire was at stake, and the Holy See should not allow Bella to act recklessly.
Thanks to the Holy Shepherd's backing, Bella remained at the academy, where her laid-back demeanor made her popular among students.
Her class, "Golden Photos," won the academy championship, establishing her as a leading instructor.
Despite her success, Bella often thought of returning home but felt trapped by various obligations. She considered bringing her parents to Eon, but the stark contrast in living conditions and her family's needs made it seem daunting.
Just as Bella fantasized about her triumphant return, the Holy Shepherd who had supported her was accused of treason. The resulting political turmoil engulfed her like a collapsing mansion.
In 12987, during the Era of Frost Veil, the Forest Witch and the Emperor falsely accused Natalie, the Holy Shepherd of April Church. Natalie fled after facing the accusations.
As a trusted aide to Natalie, Bella lost her position and was summoned to court.
As rebellions erupted throughout the Sanctgard Empire and indifferent nobles ignored the chaos, the Emperor became too preoccupied to notice a Dwarf teacher.
With assistance from the Morins, Bella returned home, where the local children were mostly unaware of her past as a prominent instructor.
Reunited with her parents, Bella found joy in the simplicity of life away from the empire's hustle and bustle, appreciating the peace she had longed for.
She had witnessed both the empire's prosperity and its turmoil, ultimately realizing that her life was richer than most.
Change is the only constant in life. Although she had distanced herself from her past, Bella felt sympathy for the Holy See and wished to repay them one day.
Perhaps that was her only regret in life: wondering how her former students were faring.

　　伊德王国（第三纪元11933-17250年），瓦格姆公国与吉鲁特公国合并后的产物，修格斯人与艾扎格尔人摒弃前嫌建立的国家。两种锻造工艺的互相融合为米伦文明发展做出了巨大贡献。

　　因盛产琳文石闻名，是西北方的小型贸易区，矮人会将魔法纹路附着到琳文石上，这种石头是根据被矮人奉为魔法与锻造始祖的多琳·欧文（第一纪元2595年-2609年）而起名的。艾扎格尔矮人善于锻造，修格斯矮人则因为和精灵族长久的贸易而学会了符文能量，所以他们才有共同尊多琳·欧文为始祖的契机。正是这种相同的信仰让两个部族的矮人融合在一起，在黄金时代创造出神乎其技的科技，以凡人之力撼动天界。而琳文阜盛产的琳文石则正是矮人文明发展的基础。

帝国：
　　圣加尔特帝国（第二纪元4529-13004年）王族为戴维家族。贝拉所在的伊德公国名义上向希瑞安共主、圣加尔特帝国大皇帝韦布里斯·戴维效忠，但一直保持着相对独立。

永恩城：
　　杰西斯之约时期半兽人所建立的城市，经过数万年的发展，此时的永恩城极度繁荣，作为圣加尔特帝国的王都，代表着当时生产力水平的极限。

心愿会：
　　“圣母”娜特莉（第三纪元12905-13047年）所创建。心愿会成员会定期服用一种叫兰草的枝叶汁水，她们笃信这样可以与神明沟通。

教名：
　　贝拉的教名是爱莎，由于母亲的姓氏高贵，一般情况下并不会直接称呼她的本姓，官方记载她的全称是：爱莎·贝拉·莫灵。艾普莉教会的教名与其他宗教有所不同，一般是加入教会、取得一定成就的人才会获得教会洗礼并获得教名，被赐予教名的信徒身体的各项素质都会得到显著提升。

艾普莉：
　　“天佑永恩”艾普莉（第一纪元2456-至今），最为古老的天使之一，在艾普莉诞生之后人类才得以构建文明。艾普莉行为低调，她并不像神光，萨拉等天使，对待尘世种种较为关注，而是一直作为底层规则存在于米伦。即便圣加尔特帝国尊艾普莉为神明，但她从未于人间显圣。这位智慧天使知道米伦的命运从来都取决于那几个人而已，不去做多余的事情才是祂们所希望的。

安雅：
　　一些雅戈尔人的自称，意为正统之源，现在基本摒弃了这种说法，只在南方少部分地区仍有这类传统，我小时候在鸟埔城曾听到过这种叫法，但已经失去了其原本的意义，只作为一种方言来使用。在古代多用在高贵之人身上，如上古之战时期的光辉王朝，他们便自称安雅人，再后来这种称呼被一些极端的种族主义者所利用。
English:
Eude Kingdom:
The Eude Kingdom (11933–17250, Era of Frost Veil) formed from the union of the Duchy of Wargum and Girot, resulting from the reconciliation of the Sugeths and Ezagels. This merger significantly advanced Mirren civilization through their distinct forging techniques.

Lyrsmoor:
Lyrsmoor is a small trading district in the northwest, renowned for its abundant rune stones inscribed with magical runes by dwarves. Named after Dorine Owen (2595–2609, Era of Firstlight), the progenitor of magic and forging, Lyrsmoor's rune stones were fundamental to Dwarf civilization. The Ezagel Dwarves excelled in forging, while the Sugeth Dwarves mastered rune energy through trade with the Elves, achieving extraordinary technological feats during the Golden Age.

The Empire:
The Sanctgard Empire (4529–13004, Era of Rebirth) was ruled by the Davies dynasty. Though nominally under the Ciaran overlord, Emperor Webris Davies maintained relative independence, including in the Kingdom of Eude, where Bella resided.

Eon:
Founded by Orccodros during the Pact of Jancis, Eon City evolved into a bustling metropolis and the capital of the Sanctgard Empire, symbolizing contemporary productivity.

Wish Association:
The Wish Association, established by "Holy Mother" Natalie (12905–13047, Era of Frost Veil), involved members consuming a concoction made from Bluetus leaves to commune with the divine.

Sacred Name:
Bella's sacred name was Aisha, derived from her mother's noble surname, and was rarely used directly. Officially, her name was Aisha Bella Morin. Sacred names, unique to the April Church, are bestowed upon members who achieve significant accomplishments, granting them considerable enhancements.

Epria:
"Eon's Blessing" Epria (2456–Present, Era of Firstlight) is one of the oldest angels, born at the dawn of human civilization. Discreet in her ways, unlike more involved angels such as Sinkou or Sarah, Epria serves as a fundamental guiding force within Mirren. Though venerated as a deity by the Sanctgard Empire, she has never manifested in the mortal realm, understanding that Mirren's fate relies on a select few.

Anya:
Anya, meaning "source of orthodoxy," was a term used by some Yagols, now mostly obsolete and retained only in certain southern regions. Historically, it denoted nobility during the Glorious Dynasty of the Ancient Wars but later became associated with extreme racialists.

Chinese:
第四纪元（1734-1750），贝儿·布兰德生来就是不正常的，在他人看来，她简直是个不可理喻的孩子。
　　会哭会闹，干的全是些很无聊，很没道理的事情。像个残次品，尤其需要父母管教。如果不是路过的医生治疗了她。一家人真不知道该怎么办。
　　贝儿进学校后，学习和运动都不擅长。她的“笨拙”经常连累到其他人，引起各种各样的意外。同学们会照应她，但她就是会把他们的努力浪费到奇怪方向。自卑的心理深深植根在她的生活中，因而渐渐不合群。
　　路过的魔女说，“信仰得救赎。你们若有信心，不疑惑，你们祷告，无论求什么，只要信，就必得着。”
　　父亲对贝儿较为冷淡，但妈妈始终悉心照料着她，他们也告诉贝儿，要笃信主神。
　　像每个小孩子那样，童年的贝儿对听到的每件事都深信不疑。她在信仰里找到了寄托。在那里，崭露了新的希望，她可以变好。虽然一时半刻还不会发生，但只要信念足够，它总会发生的。
　　她对主神怀着一种好似家犬眷恋主人一般的崇奉与敬畏之情，连最简单的事情，也看得十分宝贵。然而，生活却……总是一成不变。挑战试炼、察看启示、注意最神圣的时刻、约定实现的日期……所有这些弥漫着神圣气氛的事情都没有用。
　　但即便都毫无结果，她也不愿意放弃，只想到该绞尽脑汁地设法讨好主神。这一次，他们告诉她，主神的仁爱与怜悯适用在每个人身上，只是有人以健康、幸运来彰显其神意，有人以疾病和不幸彰显其神意。
　　她突然感到自己完全可以心情愉快地接受这种后遗症。于是她走向主神的雕像。她的肢体依旧很拘束，僵硬，手臂和手不怎么动。然而，贝儿深切地感受到残缺的美，渴望牺牲的火苗在她心底燃烧，她的眼睛闪射出宝石般的光彩。
　　这残缺是一份供品，而将在这残缺上成就的事业必定会远超众人，把它奉献给主神，贝儿·布兰德会得到所有人的尊敬。
　　梦想将缺陷变得神圣，为了成为自己所想象的、憧憬的侍者，贝儿每天奋斗着。
English:
(1734–1750, Era of Eternal Flame) Belle Brande was born different. Everyone thought she was an unruly child.
She would cry and fuss, doing senseless things. She was like a wild child in desperate need of discipline. Thankfully, a passing doctor treated her. Otherwise, her family would have been completely lost.
When Belle started school, she struggled with both academics and sports. Her "clumsiness" often caused problems for others, leading to various mishaps. Though her classmates tried to help, she would squander their efforts in odd ways. A deep sense of inferiority took hold, making her increasingly withdrawn.
A passing Nova said, "Faith brings salvation. If you have faith without doubt, whatever you pray for will be granted."
Belle's father was distant, but her mother cared for her lovingly. They also told Belle to have faith in Lord Deity.
Like any child, young Belle believed everything she was told. She found comfort in her faith. Through it, she gained hope that she could improve. It might not happen right away, but with strong faith, it would happen eventually.
She revered Lord Deity with deep devotion, valuing even the simplest things. Yet, her life remained unchanged. She faced tests, observed revelations, and marked sacred moments, but none brought results.
Yet, she refused to give up. She kept trying to please Lord Deity. Eventually, they told her that Lord Deity's love and mercy apply to everyone, but manifest differently—some experience it as health and luck, others as illness and misfortune.
She quickly embraced these signs. Approaching Lord Deity's statue, her body remained stiff, her arms and hands heavy. Yet, Belle sensed the beauty in imperfection, felt a sacrificial urge, and her eyes gleamed.
This imperfection was an offering, and the success it would bring would surpass others. By dedicating it to Lord Deity, Belle Brande would gain everyone's respect.
Her dream made her flaws sacred. Belle worked hard every day to become the ideal servant she envisioned.

Chinese:
16岁的贝儿被圣殿召唤、命令、安排，像许许多多的年轻人一样，即使不安，也凭着信心离开家，进了米德加尔城，在那里工作。
　　她在一家小餐馆做侍者，并把这任务视为天赋的职责和义务。但对顾客的服务却怎么都做不好，她总是行为笨拙，像是不小心把酒溅到别人身上，打碎盘子，撞到人，所有这些“意外”在她这里总能并且确实会发生。
　　有人衣服被弄脏了，有人受伤了，有人就餐受到妨碍了，有人工作不能继续了，她就，“对不起，对不起……”
　　她最讨厌这时候自己的样子，因为那一定是看着既呆又笨，又重又不协调，她只在水洼里看过一次，就再也不想看见了。
　　每当这时候，她会幻想自己是一个马戏演员。一个小丑。穿着特大的鞋子及五颜六色的奇怪衣服，脸上涂得红的白的，鼻子上戴个大红球。
　　贝儿看过那些人的表演，里面就有这样的，一个人哧溜一下滑倒，而大家都在轻松地笑。她根本不用去练习，她天生就能做到这样的事情。但是世袭的工种绝对不会变。就像现实不会有丝毫改变。
　　那些厉害的人，做事总不出意外，总有条理。而不幸但又不可避免地已经习惯了失败，已经厌倦了说话，总不过先道歉的她，是个残次品。
　　由于和工作不适配，贝儿转岗频繁，经常工作不到半年就换地方。到最后，心中只剩下了不想给别人添麻烦，这样的思考，却连这也难以做到。
　　在圣城中不为人知地一直生活下去。这个打算还没有真正开始便破产了。她得病了。一种怪病，过食症。
　　每次病情一发作，一切都会变得一团糟。人、桌椅都被撞倒，瓷盘、肉和奶油飞上半空，被踩扁的食物噗噗吐气，令人毛骨悚然的吞食声，和泛红的脸颊上停不住的泪水，伴随着“你不能再吃了，会把胃撑破的。”“把她绑起来。”的呼喊。
　　贝儿较之过去更加畏首畏尾，更加落落寡合，好像在噙着眼泪这样做似的——这时，她仍然相信救恩的存在，只不过对苦难的笃信已经远远超过了它。
　　她还总是给别人添麻烦。只要她还在工作，这问题就避免不了。
　　她还是想着要努力，比如说，法定的婚配日子到来时，那一整天，她都奇迹般地没有犯错和给人添麻烦。
　　但一天、一段时间的奇迹，放在漫长的人生面前，实在是太微不足道了。她没办法坚持到最后。所以在旁人看来，这个人到途中就是会失败。
　　在接踵而至、令人目不暇接的不幸的影响下，她的身躯疲惫不堪，整个人毫无生气。
　　所以她显得有些……力不从心，在不幸和疾病中长期生活，就像上了岸的鱼。
　　可能谁也没有足够的信念。突然奇特地，有了这个念头后，她最初心中盈满的信仰热情失去了生机。
　　又过了几天，她开始忘了无所不在的主神，尽管她还会祈祷，但只是流于形式而已。开始她还后悔地责怪自己途中退缩。
　　信仰的心思一度重聚起来。但又在现实面前一触即溃。他们裁定她，不能工作，也不适合婚育。
　　在该成年的时候，却不能成年，所以她就一直是个孩子了？不，她变不回那个笨拙的孩子了。
　　……这一切注定会是闹剧一场，就看笨拙的贝儿怎么收拾了。她无法收拾，靠信念是结束不了这种裁判和状况的。而没有了信念，靠害怕去信仰，害怕却是不弥久的。所以便怎么也信仰不下去了。

At 16, Bella was summoned and assigned by the Sanctuary. She left home for Midgard City, feeling both anxious and hopeful, and soon found her place in the workforce.
As a waitress in a humble eatery, Bella viewed her job as a calling. However, she often fumbled, spilling wine, breaking dishes, and colliding with patrons.
Soiled garments, injuries, disrupted meals, and halted work... her only possible response was a feeble, "I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry..."
Bella loathed her clumsiness and felt foolish. A glimpse in a puddle made her wish she hadn't looked.
At times like this, Bella envisioned being a clown, donning oversized shoes and colorful outfits, with a painted face and a big red nose.
Having seen clowns tumble in the circus, Bella felt no need for practice; mishaps were effortless, yet her reality stayed the same.
Clowns were skilled and deliberate in their actions, while Bella felt burdened by her failures, always apologizing and seeing herself as inherently flawed.
Struggling at work, Bella switched jobs frequently, rarely staying more than six months. She aimed to not be a burden, a hard goal to reach.
Her dream of an anonymous life in the sacred city crumbled before it began; she fell ill with bulimia.
Each episode threw Bella into chaos—people fell, dishes shattered, and food flew. "You can't eat anymore, you'll burst!" someone shouted. "Hold her down!"
Belle grew more timid and isolated, always on the brink of tears. Yet she clung to her belief in salvation, her faith in suffering overshadowing her hope.
Yet she remained a burden to others; her work made it inevitable.
On the day of her legally mandated marriage, she surprisingly made no mistakes and caused no disruptions at all.
Yet one perfect day couldn't outweigh a lifetime of struggle; others believed she was bound to fail.
Beset by an unending and dizzying array of misfortunes, her body grew weary, her spirit listless.
She often seemed overwhelmed, like a fish out of water, burdened by a life of misfortune and illness.
Perhaps true, unwavering faith is a myth; after this thought took hold, her vibrant passion began to lose its glow.
Before long, she forgot the ever-present Lord Deity; her prayers turned into mere formalities, and she felt regret as she blamed herself for veering off her path.
Reality quickly snuffed out her briefly rekindled devotion, labeling her unfit for work and unsuitable for marriage and children.
Would she be stuck as a child forever? No, she couldn't go back to that awkward little girl.
Her destiny felt like a farce, depending on clumsy Belle to fix her mistakes. She couldn't manage it; faith alone wouldn't change her fate, and without faith, belief became fear.
After losing her beliefs, Belle's connection to the world weakened, and the unsettling changes within her deepened her distress.
She moved more slowly, her confidence waning, as if a hidden illness lurked within. She felt something was off but was unsure how to address it.
"What does life mean?" she thought. Despite living fully, luck never came, and she complained of stagnation. In truth, she had long given up on new beginnings.
Bathed in sunshine, the sacred city felt stifling to Belle. She sensed deception and nursed a vague grievance that simmered inside her.

口渴，饥饿之际，贝儿发现了一只拿着奇怪的日历、会说话、打扮得像小丑的白兔子。她和它对话，还在它的邀请下，品尝了它偷来的食物。
　　因为无事可做，第二天，贝儿也等那只兔子。说起那只怪模怪样的兔子，她有时觉得是个老相识，转念又想，哪里说得上，自己根本不认识它。但她似乎笃定，只要兔子一来，自己便可“得救”。
　　兔子先生来了，它说贝儿是被选召的孩子，还说要领她去它们的世界——幻真兽国。贝儿迟疑了一下，最终还是被兔子描述的前景吸引。
　　她追着兔子跑过街道，她的世界就开始逐渐变化。柱子变成了大树，地板上长满了草，接着一颗颗的树拔地而起、草也长得更长了，还多了一些灌木，松鼠和麻雀在树上叫，而原来房子的门、窗、衣架乃至墙壁变得模糊了起来，到最后这些都消失了。藤蔓爬满了旷野。而她自己似乎也变回了孩子一样。
　　贝儿追赶着兔子而一路下到了一个好像无底的洞里，由此坠入了神奇的另一边的世界。
　　在这个世界里，有能随时现身随时消失的猫小姐，它和兔子绝对不会同时出现，有巨大却温和的野兽，吃一个蘑菇就能缩得如同毛毛虫大小，举着蒲公英的小伞，等一阵风来就能出发，研究着怎么变大，好向贝儿报仇雪恨的醍醐医生。在这个世界里，似乎所有的东西都有一种有趣的古怪。
　　贝儿遇到了一大堆稀奇古怪的野兽，还做了它们的国王。她跟着它们对月嚎叫、像松鼠一样在林间跳来蹦去、骑在最大的那只野兽身上，带着它们巡游整个丛林，又制定了新的规矩，以后都不准欺负人。
　　好欺负人的野兽反对她说，丛林的规矩没法改。被欺负的野兽也说，弱肉强食才是道理。她有办法，“都是笨蛋。我，最强。你们，都弱。以后只有我能欺负人！”
　　贝儿给它们分工明确，各有专责，规定世袭罔替，比如说，记录下她的非凡事迹，养鱼给大家提供食物，等等。
　　在天未亮时，匆匆飞来的醍醐医生向贝儿发出仇恨的叫喊声。
　　贝儿有点儿厌倦了。她决定不再当这个丛林的王了。贝儿要离开了。可是野兽们哭喊着挽留他，它们发出震动丛林的可怕的吼声，尖利的牙齿上下砸在一起冒出火星，吓人的眼睛盯着她一转不转，挥舞着锋利的爪子。但是，她还是和野兽们说了再见。贝儿又开始了她漫长的冒险旅程。
　　这一次，在旷野上，她又遇到了那只兔子。它和她求助，说有个粗暴的龙女王，专横又暴戾，成天叫嚷着要砍掉人们的脑袋，现在还要砍掉它的兔脑袋。
　　贝儿打定主意，要去仙境推翻了残暴的龙女王，解放了这些可怜的动物——兔子先生、猫小姐、看门巨兽、毛毛虫们、稀奇古怪的野兽们、仇恨她的醍醐医生。
　　贝儿和兔子一起合计着，要返回原来的世界，拿点土特产证明自己是被选召的孩子，再想办法筹备一些军粮。
　　兔子的办法就是偷。贝儿被她连哄带骗，稀里糊涂地上了贼船。
　　贝儿在放偷来的食物的地方、一个大屋子的仓库里遇到了一些可怜的动物，按兔子的建议，给它们分了一些蘑菇，它们就神气活现起来了。
　　她刚高兴自己又有了许多新朋友，很大的黑色狐狸和猎犬就邦邦地追撵了过来。辛苦借来的吃的和新朋友都没了，就在贝尔垂头丧气的时候，兔子先生说它挽救了他们的计划，虽然不是全部。缺的部分，他们还要再干一票。
　　在一扇小门后的大花园里，贝儿和朋友们推啊搬啊，像蚂蚁一样忙碌，可黑毛大狐狸和猎犬又来了。朋友们都倒下了，她去找兔子，兔子却求她，把狐狸和猎犬都引走。
　　为了保护朋友，贝儿连吃了好几个蘑菇，变成了巨人。狐狸和猎犬就朝她扑过来。但它们太小了，她轻轻地吹了一口气，对它们来说就是大风了。她把脚往上猛地一蹬，它们都站不稳。
　　贝儿大声抗议他们对好人的诬陷，又想到之后，她要帮助那边世界的朋友们战胜残暴的龙女王，还要把借的东西都还回去，如果见到了像她一样生病的小姑娘，她也要帮助她，把她带到那边的世界。
　　但最终她还是模模糊糊意识起自己大概是被利用了，在做坏事……
　　——穿过弱肉强食丛林，在眼泪池遇见醍醐医生，当稀奇古怪的野兽们的国王，丛林的再前面是影子广场，在那里交出自己的影子，乘着每日晨昏时强烈的旋风就能到仙境了。仙境里面有龙女王，是大坏蛋。
　　这些都是假的。
　　而在这个时候，她也记起来，在她放弃了自己的这段时间里，还有人想要拯救她、保护她。
　　所以在没办法的时候，为了保护自己的恩人，为了已经倒下的他们，贝儿也鼓起了勇气，自己走向了行刑之地。

　　貝兒有點兒厭倦了。她決定不再當這個叢林的王了。貝兒要離開了。可是野獸們哭喊著挽留他，它們發出震動叢林的可怕的吼聲，尖利的牙齒上下砸在一起冒出火星，嚇人的眼睛盯著她一轉不轉，揮舞著鋒利的爪子。但是，她還是和野獸們說了再見。貝兒又開始了她漫長的冒險旅程。
　　這一次，在曠野上，她又遇到了那只兔子。它和她求助，說有個粗暴的龍女王，專橫又暴戾，成天叫嚷著要砍掉人們的腦袋，現在還要砍掉它的兔腦袋。
　　貝兒打定主意，要去仙境推翻了殘暴的龍女王，解放了這些可憐的動物——兔子先生、貓小姐、看門巨獸、毛毛蟲們、稀奇古怪的野獸們、仇恨她的醍醐醫生。
　　貝兒和兔子一起合計著，要返回原來的世界，拿點土特產證明自己是被選召的孩子，再想辦法籌備一些軍糧。
　　兔子的辦法就是偷。貝兒被她連哄帶騙，稀裏糊塗地上了賊船。
　　貝兒在放偷來的食物的地方、一個大屋子的倉庫裏遇到了一些可憐的動物，按兔子的建議，給它們分了一些蘑菇，它們就神氣活現起來了。
　　她剛高興自己又有了許多新朋友，很大的黑色狐狸和獵犬就邦邦地追攆了過來。辛苦借來的吃的和新朋友都沒了，就在貝爾垂頭喪氣的時候，兔子先生說它挽救了他們的計畫，雖然不是全部。缺的部分，他們還要再幹一票。
　　在一扇小門後的大花園裏，貝兒和朋友們推啊搬啊，像螞蟻一樣忙碌，可黑毛大狐狸和獵犬又來了。朋友們都倒下了，她去找兔子，兔子卻求她，把狐狸和獵犬都引走。
　　為了保護朋友，貝兒連吃了好幾個蘑菇，變成了巨人。狐狸和獵犬就朝她撲過來。但它們太小了，她輕輕地吹了一口氣，對它們來說就是大風了。她把腳往上猛地一蹬，它們都站不穩。
　　貝兒大聲抗議他們對好人的誣陷，又想到之後，她要幫助那邊世界的朋友們戰勝殘暴的龍女王，還要把借的東西都還回去，如果見到了像她一樣生病的小姑娘，她也要幫助她，把她帶到那邊的世界。
　　但最終她還是模模糊糊意識起自己大概是被利用了，在做壞事……
　　——穿過弱肉強食叢林，在眼淚池遇見醍醐醫生，當稀奇古怪的野獸們的國王，叢林的再前面是影子廣場，在那裏交出自己的影子，乘著每日晨昏時強烈的旋風就能到仙境了。仙境裏面有龍女王，是大壞蛋。
　　這些都是假的。
　　而在這個時候，她也記起來，在她放棄了自己的這段時間裏，還有人想要拯救她、保護她。
　　所以在沒辦法的時候，為了保護自己的恩人，為了已經倒下的他們，貝兒也鼓起了勇氣，自己走向了行刑之地。

贝儿的过食症：

　　指人认知活动或认知过程，包括信念和信念体系、思维和想象。

星痕贝儿的特殊性质：

　　这种全局性混乱，又反过来给贝儿供给混乱能量，而得到能量供给的贝儿，势必将更进一步提升污染的程度。其结果便是——无限的增殖。无限供给混乱能量。
