Japanese: プロフィール3
TChinese: 資料三

Chinese: 真理圣殿的审判长，同时也是神国暴力机构的最高长官。主神童年时期饲养的宠物，后来逐渐成为其强大的助力。在进化为人形后成为米伦史上唯一的半星痕。
English: The Lord Inquisitor of the Sanctuary of Truth, the supreme commander of the Divine Kingdom's enforcement agency. Muu was a childhood pet of the Lord Deity, later becoming a formidable ally. After evolving into a humanoid form, Muu becomes the only Demi-Aster in Mirren's history.
TChinese: 真理聖殿的審判長，同時也是神國暴力機構的最高長官。主神童年時期飼養的寵物，後來逐漸成為其強大的助力。在進化為人形後成為米倫史上唯一的半星痕。

Chinese: 她是历史上仅有的两位撒拉弗之一，最古老的天使，神灵旨意的解读者与执行者，神仆——萨拉。
English: One of only two Seraphs in history, she is the oldest angel, the interpreter, and executor of divine will. She is Sarah, the Servant of God.
TChinese: 她是歷史上僅有的兩位撒拉弗之一，最古老的天使，神靈旨意的解讀者與執行者，神僕——薩拉。

Chinese: 在人类最早的记载中，神光从天边的早霞里出现，随后苍穹变为赤红。神光所照耀之处，皆是神灵的恩泽。她是旁人眼中冷漠而强大的天使，但实际上只是……不善言语罢了。
English: According to ancient chronicles, Sinkou emerged with the dawn, casting the heavens in a scarlet hue. Her touch is said to be a blessing from the heavens. Perceived as an aloof and formidable angel by onlookers, in reality, she is simply... reticent in speech.
TChinese: 在人類最早的記載中，神光從天邊的早霞裏出現，隨後蒼穹變為赤紅。神光所照耀之處，皆是神靈的恩澤。她是旁人眼中冷漠而強大的天使，但實際上只是……不善言語罷了。

Chinese: 圣龙王国的最后一位君王，继承了先祖传承的丹妮是世间一切美好的集大成者。身为光荣的龙神后裔，她在出生时便注定为神而奉献自己的一切，建立人间的神国。
English: As the last monarch of the Dividraggon Kingdom, she embodies the ultimate legacy of her ancestors. She is a proud descendant of the Divine Dragon, knowing her destiny was set at birth. She dedicates herself fully to creating a Divine Kingdom in the mortal world.
TChinese: 聖龍王國的最後一位君王，繼承了先祖傳承的丹妮是世間一切美好的集大成者。身為光榮的龍神後裔，她在出生時便註定為神而奉獻自己的一切，建立人間的神國。

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅可以说是历史上最著名的人类之一，由于先知的身份，后世的记载逐渐将她神化。她在维拉尔人、努海尔人以及半兽人等民族中都有着极高的影响力。
English: As was one of history's most famed humans, her prophetic status led to her deification in later accounts. Her influence was experienced by many races, including the Velarra, Nuheillu, and Orccodro.
TChinese: 耶坦尼婭可以說是歷史上最著名的人類之一，由於先知的身份，後世的記載逐漸將她神化。她在維拉爾人、努海爾人以及半獸人等民族中都有著極高的影響力。

Chinese: 在崇尚强者的深渊诸族，小闪被誉为史上最伟大的恶魔之一。拥有如此盛誉的原因却并非是她有多么强大的战斗能力，而是这位白发女孩几乎以一己之力改变了整个米伦的历史走向。
English: In the Abyss, where the strong are revered, she is hailed as one of the greatest devils in history. Her fame is not due to her combat prowess. Rather, it is because this white-haired vixen nearly single-handedly changed the course of Mirren's history.
TChinese: 在崇尚強者的深淵諸族，小閃被譽為史上最偉大的惡魔之一。擁有如此盛譽的原因卻並非是她有多麼強大的戰鬥能力，而是這位白髮女孩幾乎以一己之力改變了整個米倫的歷史走向。

Chinese: 天膳忍宗首位获封超忍的忍者，对于稳定丰缇政权起到了极为重要的作用。由于忍者大多数隐藏于暗处，雷雷成年后的资料极少。
English: As the first "Super Ninja" of the Tenzen Ninja Order, her efforts were key to unifying Fontiera's governance. As ninjas predominantly operate in the shadows, scant records exist of her life after reaching adulthood.
TChinese: 天膳忍宗首位獲封超忍的忍者，對於穩定豐緹政權起到了極為重要的作用。由於忍者大多數隱藏於暗處，雷雷成年後的資料極少。

Chinese: 疑似“元素天使”昔菈，堕天使领袖之一，“禁忌之轮”事件中被放逐至深渊。
English: Suspected Shillae, the "Elemental Angel",one of the Fallen Angel leaders, exiled to the Abyss after the "Taboo and Betrayal" incident.
TChinese: 疑似“元素天使”昔菈，墮天使領袖之一，“禁忌之輪”事件中被放逐至深淵。

Chinese: 西努群岛无冕之王、叙亚金库的继承人。她通过十余年的努力打开了黄金时代的大门，让不同的大陆间再度有了交流。海洋贸易在她的掌控下，不仅促进了相关地区的经济发展，更加强了种族之间的文化融合。
English: The uncrowned queen of the Zinew Archipelago and heir to the Shirre Treasury. After over a decade of effort, she ushered in the Golden Age, restoring communication between continents. Under her leadership, ocean trade boosted regional economies and fostered cultural integration among diverse races.
TChinese: 西努群島無冕之王、敘亞金庫的繼承人。她通過十餘年的努力打開了黃金時代的大門，讓不同的大陸間再度有了交流。海洋貿易在她的掌控下，不僅促進了相關地區的經濟發展，更加強了種族之間的文化融合。

Chinese: 年幼丧亲的森精灵,机缘巧合下得以侍奉精灵女王。几百年来博览群书，让她成为了魔法构造领域的大师。从圣龙战争到TORAH，这个有些胆小的精灵是众多历史的见证者。
English: She began as an orphaned forest elf but came to serve the Elf Queen by chance. She read a lot and became a master in magical constructs over the centuries. From the Sacred Dragon War to the Rise of Torah, this timid elf witnessed numerous historical events.
TChinese: 年幼喪親的森精靈,機緣巧合下得以侍奉精靈女王。幾百年來博覽群書，讓她成為了魔法構造領域的大師。從聖龍戰爭到TORAH，這個有些膽小的精靈是眾多歷史的見證者。

Chinese: 红龙亲王艾莉克希娅之女，吉拉蒂亚是极为罕见的独生龙种，这也使艾莉克希娅的力量完全遗留给了这个女儿。随着年龄的增长吉拉蒂亚变得愈发强大，她几乎代表着凡人力量的极限。
English: As the daughter of the Red Dragon Princess Alexia, she is a rare single-child dragon who inherited all her mother's might. As she grew, she became a symbol of mortal strength at its peak.
TChinese: 紅龍親王艾莉克希婭之女，吉拉蒂亞是極為罕見的獨生龍種，這也使艾莉克希婭的力量完全遺留給了這個女兒。隨著年齡的增長吉拉蒂亞變得愈發強大，她幾乎代表著凡人力量的極限。

Chinese: 上古之战时期塞拉摩王国贵族，被杰西斯亲自指引成为第一个由人类转化的天使。作为第二纪元最具代表性的人物之一，“黎明前的曙光”改变了整个米伦历史的后续发展。
English: During the Ancient War, Cecily, a noble of the Seramo Kingdom, was personally guided by Jancis to become the first human-turned-angel. As a pivotal figure of the Era of Rebirth, "Dawnbreaker" significantly impacted the subsequent history of Mirren.
TChinese: 上古之戰時期塞拉摩王國貴族，被傑西斯親自指引成為第一個由人類轉化的天使。作為第二紀元最具代表性的人物之一，“黎明前的曙光”改變了整個米倫歷史的後續發展。

Chinese: 安普莎想要知道人们口中所说的“爱”到底指的是什么，她自身或许也在寻求爱。请不要回应她的问题，否则一定会被“爱到底是什么”而被质问到底，若是得不到满意的回答，那么你便危险了。
English: She seeks to comprehend the essence of "love" as spoken of by humans, and may herself be in pursuit of it. Refrain from engaging with her inquiries, lest you be subjected to relentless questioning on the nature of love. Failure to provide a satisfactory explanation could put you in danger.
TChinese: 安普莎想要知道人們口中所說的“愛”到底指的是什麼，她自身或許也在尋求愛。請不要回應她的問題，否則一定會被“愛到底是什麼”而被質問到底，若是得不到滿意的回答，那麼你便危險了。

Chinese: 被丢弃在森林中的半兽人婴儿，因为有着操纵雷电的能力，所以在危险的黑森林中也能如鱼得水。在成年后，阿涅克丝在好奇心的驱使下开始了向全大陆的旅行，并沿途留下了不少传说，久而久之被吟游诗人们称为“雷鸣之妖兽”。
English: This Orccodro was abandoned in the woods as an infant. Thanks to her ability to command thunder and lightning, she can navigate the treacherous Black Forest with ease. Driven by insatiable curiosity, she embarked on a journey across the lands. Her legendary exploits earned her the title "The Thunderous Beast."
TChinese: 被丟棄在森林中的半獸人嬰兒，因為有著操縱雷電的能力，所以在危險的黑森林中也能如魚得水。在成年後，阿涅克絲在好奇心的驅使下開始了向全大陸的旅行，並沿途留下了不少傳說，久而久之被吟遊詩人們稱為“雷鳴之妖獸”。

Chinese: 人间的人口急剧增加，信仰之力爆发，神灵需要一位公正严苛的执法官来确保禁忌不再被触发，于是象征秩序的天使炽爱诞生了。
English: As the human population grew and faith gained power, the divine created Dia, the angel of order, to prevent forbidden acts.
TChinese: 人間的人口急劇增加，信仰之力爆發，神靈需要一位公正嚴苛的執法官來確保禁忌不再被觸發，於是象徵秩序的天使熾愛誕生了。

Chinese: 海歌氏族的公主，用枪的高手，说话毫不客气但也不会不看气氛，往往是在对方膨胀之时用毒舌给对方的自满降温。曾经和著名的诗娅公主以及龙骑士卡米拉一起并肩战斗过。
English: The Wavechant princess is adept with a spear. She speaks bluntly, yet astutely gauges the atmosphere, often puncturing others' conceit with her acrid tongue. She once stood in combat beside the renowned Princess Sia and the Dragon Knight Camilla.
TChinese: 海歌氏族的公主，用槍的高手，說話毫不客氣但也不會不看氣氛，往往是在對方膨脹之時用毒舌給對方的自滿降溫。曾經和著名的詩婭公主以及龍騎士卡米拉一起並肩戰鬥過。

Chinese: 出身于大后氏，作为丰缇历史上最著名的巫女之一，哀歌与她的主公一同开创了足以名留史册的盛世王朝。
English: From the esteemed Daigos, she is a famed witch who, with her princess, shaped a prosperous era in Fontiera's history.
TChinese: 出身於大後氏，作為豐緹歷史上最著名的巫女之一，哀歌與她的主公一同開創了足以名留史冊的盛世王朝。

Chinese: 异世界位面“莱哈特”的当红偶像，暗地里却是“炎鬼”的二公主。虽说一言一行都像是普通的女高中生，但只要惹怒她的话……她也就只会报复性的恶作剧。
English: In addition to being the celebrity idol from the "Luthart" realm, she is also the covert second princess of the "Inferno." Though her demeanor is that of a regular high schooler, provoke her and you'll face her mischievous retribution.
TChinese: 異世界位面“萊哈特”的當紅偶像，暗地裏卻是“炎鬼”的二公主。雖說一言一行都像是普通的女高中生，但只要惹怒她的話……她也就只會報復性的惡作劇。

Chinese: 奥卡兹人，维拉尔人与雅戈尔人共主，希瑞安的最高统治者，希尔拜亚帝国大皇帝——普琳普顿一世。关于她的一生褒贬不一，但毫无疑问普琳普顿绝对是影响了米伦历史走向的重要人物。
English: The monarch of the Ocatzians, Velarras, and Yagols, the paramount ruler of Ciaran, the sovereign of the Hilbeyan Empire—Empress Princeton I. Her life is a tapestry of praise and criticism, yet her impact on Mirren's historical trajectory cannot be denied.
TChinese: 奧卡茲人，維拉爾人與雅戈爾人共主，希瑞安的最高統治者，希爾拜亞帝國大皇帝——普琳普頓一世。關於她的一生褒貶不一，但毫無疑問普琳普頓絕對是影響了米倫歷史走向的重要人物。

Chinese: 黄金时代时期丰缇的著名君主，身为君主却因大力推广教会而被人铭记。弥生时期皇权与教权开始合二为一，并且重创侍之一族以至于其分崩离析。
English: She is the celebrated ruler of Fontiera's Golden Age, praised for strengthening the theocracy while wearing the crown. In the epoch of Mithon, the crown and the church commenced their convergence, decimating Lord Oracle's lineage to the point of collapse.
TChinese: 黃金時代時期豐緹的著名君主，身為君主卻因大力推廣教會而被人銘記。彌生時期皇權與教權開始合二為一，並且重創侍之一族以至於其分崩離析。

Chinese: 曾不顾家人反对，前往传说中的希望之地，然而却被残酷的现实所打醒。为了生存，艾什尔建立了名为灰风的团队。与凯瑟琳、科特里克希尔一同被称为梅尔莉蒂王冕上的明珠。
English: Despite her family's opposition, she went out in search of the fabled land of aspirations. However, she was cruelly awakened from such dreams by the harshness of reality. In order to survive, she established a team called Greywind. Together with Katherine and Countric of Melidie, the three are revered as the jewels adorning Queen Melidie's crown.
TChinese: 曾不顧家人反對，前往傳說中的希望之地，然而卻被殘酷的現實所打醒。為了生存，艾什爾建立了名為灰風的團隊。與凱瑟琳、科特裏克希爾一同被稱為梅爾莉蒂王冕上的明珠。

Chinese: 出身于艾尔格隆的科隆半兽人，她漂洋过海寻找所谓的梦想。阿波菲斯本身不是魔物，但却建立起了声势浩大的魔物王国，因此被人称为“魔物女王”。
English: An Orccodro from Cologne in Elgron, she crossed the sea in search of her dreams. She is not a monster herself, but she has established the powerful Kingdom of Monsters and is thus called the "Monster Queen."
TChinese: 出身於艾爾格隆的科隆半獸人，她漂洋過海尋找所謂的夢想。阿波菲斯本身不是魔物，但卻建立起了聲勢浩大的魔物王國，因此被人稱為“魔物女王”。

Chinese: “魔君”沃尔斯海姆最后的子嗣，在她出生的那一刻便传出了一条预言——“她会成长为不亚于魔君的大魔王”。
English: She is the last scion of "Demonic Sovereign" Wolsheim. At her birth, a prophecy was foretold — "She is destined to rise as a mighty archdemon, the equal of the Demonic Sovereign himself."
TChinese: “魔君”沃爾斯海姆最後的子嗣，在她出生的那一刻便傳出了一條預言——“她會成長為不亞於魔君的大魔王”。

Chinese:
在人间非常有名的天使，也是天界的欢乐源泉。她很喜欢与人间打交道，并聆听他们的愿望。虽说丘吉尔的力量并不强大，但她却广为凡人所知并为大众所喜爱着。
她所持的弩有两种箭矢，一种能够治愈他人，并让人爱上某人。另一种则是沉重的铅箭，能让人受伤并且使其变得不幸。
English:
An angel renowned throughout the world and a beacon of joy in the Heavenly Realm. She delights in engaging with humanity and heeding their wishes. Though her power is not overwhelming, she is loved and well-known by mortals.
Her crossbow is armed with arrows of two kinds: one that bestows healing and can inspire love, and another, a weighty leaden bolt, capable of inflicting harm and misfortune.
TChinese:
在人間非常有名的天使，也是天界的歡樂源泉。她很喜歡與人間打交道，並聆聽他們的願望。雖說丘吉爾的力量並不強大，但她卻廣為凡人所知並為大眾所喜愛著。
她所持的弩有兩種箭矢，一種能夠治癒他人，並讓人愛上某人。另一種則是沉重的鉛箭，能讓人受傷並且使其變得不幸。

Chinese: 现代都市莱哈特，继承炎鬼称号的族长，实力很强而且好斗，使用带火焰的魔法的铁棒攻击敌人，虽然拳头也非常有力但几乎不用。
English: In the modern metropolis of Luthart, she is a tribal leader known as "Inferno." Fierce and combative, she wields a flaming iron staff in battle, though her devastating punches are rarely unleashed.
TChinese: 現代都市萊哈特，繼承炎鬼稱號的族長，實力很強而且好鬥，使用帶火焰的魔法的鐵棒攻擊敵人，雖然拳頭也非常有力但幾乎不用。

Chinese: 圣加尔特帝国魔法学院首席讲师，也是为数不多的矮人圣职者之一。也许是因为曾经的过错，“我知道的越多，我想的越多，我犯的错误就越少，我就越不会伤害别人”是她一生的信条。
English: She is the preeminent instructor at the Sanctgard Empire's Imperial Magic Academy and a part of the rare dwarven cleric. Haunted by her past, she has developed a mantra to guide her life: "The more I learn, the more I ponder, the fewer my errors, and the less harm I inflict on others".
TChinese: 聖加爾特帝國魔法學院首席講師，也是為數不多的矮人聖職者之一。也許是因為曾經的過錯，“我知道的越多，我想的越多，我犯的錯誤就越少，我就越不會傷害別人”是她一生的信條。

Chinese: 卡萝琳是不被世界允许降生的孩子，一生中从未见过自己的父母。虽是混血儿，但她阻止魔物们干扰正常的人类，从内心深处憎恨着一切魔物。
English: As a child that the world had forbidden to be born, she never met her parents. Despite being a half-breed, she fights against monsters to protect humanity, harboring a deep-seated hatred for monsters.
TChinese: 卡蘿琳是不被世界允許降生的孩子，一生中從未見過自己的父母。雖是混血兒，但她阻止魔物們干擾正常的人類，從內心深處憎恨著一切魔物。

Chinese: 擅长弹琴的遗落精灵，曾见证过两个时代的交替，并参与了旧神教会的复兴。失败后罗莎莉独自踏上旅行，而她留下的歌谣则铭刻在这片大地上，至今仍在传唱。
English: Rosalie, a lost elf skilled in the harp, witnessed the transition of two eras and participated in the revival of the Order of Old Deities. After its failure, she embarked on a solitary journey. Her songs are still sung across the land.
TChinese: 擅長彈琴的遺落精靈，曾見證過兩個時代的交替，並參與了舊神教會的復興。失敗後羅莎莉獨自踏上旅行，而她留下的歌謠則銘刻在這片大地上，至今仍在傳唱。

Chinese: 尽职尽责的女武神，将凡间英魂引入天界，组建天军，并率领军队跟随萨拉征服了附近星域。她穷极一生，从最初的坚定到后来产生迷惘，这一切的原因都是那场漫长的星间征程。
English: A loyal Valkyrie who guides brave souls to the Heavenly Realm, builds the Heavenly Army, and leads its legions in conquest under Sarah's command. She has spent her entire life, from initial resolution to later bewilderment, on this long interAster journey.
TChinese: 盡職盡責的女武神，將凡間英魂引入天界，組建天軍，並率領軍隊跟隨薩拉征服了附近星域。她窮極一生，從最初的堅定到後來產生迷惘，這一切的原因都是那場漫長的星間征程。

Chinese: 亚尔夫历史上第一位森精灵统领，参与过圣龙战争，拥有极为丰富的战斗经验。在弑亲者战争中，她抵抗叛军守护精灵最后的荣耀，战斗到了最后。
English: The first forest elf leader in the history of the Yarve, she participated in the Sacred Dragon War and has extremely rich combat experience. She fought to the very end during the Kinship War to defend the final glory of the elves from the rebels.
TChinese: 亞爾夫歷史上第一位森精靈統領，參與過聖龍戰爭，擁有極為豐富的戰鬥經驗。在弑親者戰爭中，她抵抗叛軍守護精靈最後的榮耀，戰鬥到了最後。

Chinese: 幸运地受到深渊能量影响变成高等魔物，在和人类的交往中渐渐有了个性，并且学习了人类的知识。对自己的出身非常介意，所以被人问起自身的详细情况时就会变得很不坦率，本心非常善良，想要成为人类，但是无法实现。
English: Fortuitously transformed into a higher-tier monster by the influence of abyssal energy, she gradually developed a personality and learned things through her interactions with humans. She is very concerned about her origin and becomes evasive when asked for details. She is kind-hearted and holds the unattainable desire of becoming a human.
TChinese: 幸運地受到深淵能量影響變成高等魔物，在和人類的交往中漸漸有了個性，並且學習了人類的知識。對自己的出身非常介意，所以被人問起自身的詳細情況時就會變得很不坦率，本心非常善良，想要成為人類，但是無法實現。

Chinese: 生活在托莱特城邦的孤儿，在街头表演魔术为生，自称会召唤许许多多的生物，实际上只会召唤白鸽，不过这一招玩得非常好。奈奈芙与很多白鸽伙伴都形成了信赖关系，但是她并没有意识到这点其实是很难做到的。
English: An orphan of Toret, she earns her keep with street-side illusions. She claims she can summon myriad beings, however she is truly a mistress of avian conjuration. She has cultivated bonds of trust with her coterie of doves, a feat she doesn't realize is rare.
TChinese: 生活在托萊特城邦的孤兒，在街頭表演魔術為生，自稱會召喚許許多多的生物，實際上只會召喚白鴿，不過這一招玩得非常好。奈奈芙與很多白鴿夥伴都形成了信賴關係，但是她並沒有意識到這點其實是很難做到的。

Chinese: 从小就经常给精力过剩的姐姐疗伤而对草药学异常精通。年长后参与了大大小小无数场战争让她的医术更加纯熟。玛瑙是一位真正的医者，无论对象是谁只要决定救助就一定会负责任到底。
English: She cultivated extraordinary herbal acumen by mending her exuberant sister's wounds when they were younger. As she got older, she become engaged in innumerable conflicts that allowed her to hone her craft into an art. Ameth is a healer in the truest sense and remains committed to her charge regardless of who they may be.
TChinese: 從小就經常給精力過剩的姐姐療傷而對草藥學異常精通。年長後參與了大大小小無數場戰爭讓她的醫術更加純熟。瑪瑙是一位真正的醫者，無論對象是誰只要決定救助就一定會負責任到底。

Chinese: 在圣龙战争末期的时候生活在莎法利尔的半兽人，体质纤弱，性格懦弱，原本只是一个不可能成为星痕的普通角色。但即使是她这样的小人物也能成为推动历史发展的关键角色。
English: As an Orccodro of Safaril in the final days of the Sacred Dragon War, she was fragile and meek, an unremarkable figure destined to be a Aster. Yet, even a seemingly insignificant individual could prove pivotal in the annals of history.
TChinese: 在聖龍戰爭末期的時候生活在莎法利爾的半獸人，體質纖弱，性格懦弱，原本只是一個不可能成為星痕的普通角色。但即使是她這樣的小人物也能成為推動歷史發展的關鍵角色。

Chinese: 莎法利尔的二公主，师从大贤者，在群众之中颇有声望。由于其卓越的政治智慧，让莎法利尔从内政到外交坐稳了联盟首席的位置。
English: As the second princess of Safaril, she is apprenticed to the Grand Sage and holds the adoration of her people. Her unparalleled wit in governance has affirmed Safaril's dominance as the alliance's leader in both statecraft and international relations.
TChinese: 莎法利爾的二公主，師從大賢者，在群眾之中頗有聲望。由於其卓越的政治智慧，讓莎法利爾從內政到外交坐穩了聯盟首席的位置。

Chinese: 森林女巫的弟子，天赋极高可个性急躁冒失，离开师父的时候还掌握不好扫帚以至于经常掉下来。维达做事全凭喜好所以常常犯错，不过靠着运气好却躲开了很多麻烦。
English: As the protégé of the Forest Witch, she boasts remarkable talent. However, her impetuous and brash nature leads to frequent mishaps on her broom. Driven by whimsy, she often makes mistakes, but her good luck has allowed her to sidestep great misfortune.
TChinese: 森林女巫的弟子，天賦極高可個性急躁冒失，離開師父的時候還掌握不好掃帚以至於經常掉下來。維達做事全憑喜好所以常常犯錯，不過靠著運氣好卻躲開了很多麻煩。

Chinese: 坎特维尔出生的女孩，从小就憧憬着所谓的骑士精神。混乱的世界让她见惯了各种冷血之人，但这只是更加坚定了她成为骑士的信念。
English: Born in Cantwell, she has aspired to knighthood since she was a child. The world's harsh lessons have only galvanized her resolve to uphold chivalric virtues.
TChinese: 坎特維爾出生的女孩，從小就憧憬著所謂的騎士精神。混亂的世界讓她見慣了各種冷血之人，但這只是更加堅定了她成為騎士的信念。

Chinese: 黄金时代的航海英雄之一，最后自愿留在了人类的国度。经常因为被叫做长耳族的乡巴佬而生气，一生气就喜欢去酒馆找老朋友发泄，然后打闹搞得周围一塌糊涂，被老板催着要维修费的事情常有发生。
English: She is a maritime legend from the Golden Age who chooses to reside in the human realms. She gets upset when called the "hick of Long Ears" and vents her anger at the tavern with old friends, often ending in a ruckus and having to pay for the damages.
TChinese: 黃金時代的航海英雄之一，最後自願留在了人類的國度。經常因為被叫做長耳族的鄉巴佬而生氣，一生氣就喜歡去酒館找老朋友發洩，然後打鬧搞得周圍一塌糊塗，被老闆催著要維修費的事情常有發生。

Chinese: 旧神教的圣职者，比起那娇小的身躯意外的是武斗派，看上去口无遮拦内心却很虔诚，身穿圣职者战斗套装，手持两把与娇小身躯不符的巨大的圣银手枪。
English: A cleric of the Ancient Faith, her small frame hides a fierce warrior spirit. With an unfiltered tongue and a pious heart, she wears the regalia of a holy warrior and wields two massive sanctified silver guns.
TChinese: 舊神教的聖職者，比起那嬌小的身軀意外的是武鬥派，看上去口無遮攔內心卻很虔誠，身穿聖職者戰鬥套裝，手持兩把與嬌小身軀不符的巨大的聖銀手槍。

Chinese: 古代艾雅人后裔，焰心出生在一个动乱的年代，维拉尔大军南下冲击着这片大陆。心中秉持宽容与善良的她被神灵选中成为天使。她历经多次历史重要转折，是维护天界稳定的重要基石。
English: A scion of the ancient Aiyans, she emerged at a tumultuous time when the Velarra hordes were marching south, shaking the very earth. Due to her compassion and virtue, she was divinely appointed as an angel. As a steadfast presence through pivotal historic moments, she stands as a sentinel for the Heavenly Realm.
TChinese: 古代艾雅人後裔，焰心出生在一個動亂的年代，維拉爾大軍南下衝擊著這片大陸。心中秉持寬容與善良的她被神靈選中成為天使。她歷經多次歷史重要轉折，是維護天界穩定的重要基石。

Chinese: 矮人公主，天生神力，与伊卡洛斯、芙洛拉是好友，三人组成的团队被后世称为黄金篇章小队。矮人族在她的领导下开始走向繁荣，与人类之间的交流增多，同时建立起与亚尔夫和西努群岛的友谊。
English: She is a dwarven princess endowed with incredible strength and is in league with Icaruth and Flora. The three of them form a trio that has been christened the Golden Chapter squad. Together, they have ushered in prosperity for the dwarves, fostering greater rapport with humanity and forging alliances with the Yarve and the Zinew Archipelago.
TChinese: 矮人公主，天生神力，與伊卡洛斯、芙洛拉是好友，三人組成的團隊被後世稱為黃金篇章小隊。矮人族在她的領導下開始走向繁榮，與人類之間的交流增多，同時建立起與亞爾夫和西努群島的友誼。

Chinese: 中学便辍学在家的电波系少女，网络世界的天才。家里的巨大号望远镜能够连接“云端”，看到她想看到的一切。
English: She is a schoolgirl who opted out of traditional education to embrace her quirky genius within the digital realm. Through the lens of her family's colossal telescope, she peers into the "Cloud," unveiling all she seeks.
TChinese: 中學便輟學在家的電波系少女，網路世界的天才。家裏的巨大號望遠鏡能夠連接“雲端”，看到她想看到的一切。

Chinese: 杏林家庭的世袭工种为医师，母亲却因病而死，她便发誓要成为最好的医师，拯救患者。她是最乐于奉献，治病救人的医师，却在torah的诱导下走上了不归路。
English: Heiress to a lineage of medical practitioners, she pledged to transcend her mother's untimely death by becoming an eminent healer. Her selfless dedication to mending and saving lives was, however, derailed by the machinations of Torah.
TChinese: 杏林家庭的世襲工種為醫師，母親卻因病而死，她便發誓要成為最好的醫師，拯救患者。她是最樂於奉獻，治病救人的醫師，卻在torah的誘導下走上了不歸路。

Chinese: 寄居在人类王国的精灵公主。诗娅作为一名优秀的剑士，在圣龙战争中屠龙的英勇事迹让她成为传奇。
English: She is a fairy princess in exile within the human domain. As a paragon of swordsmanship, her valiant dragon-slaying exploits during the Sacred Dragon War have etched her name into legend.
TChinese: 寄居在人類王國的精靈公主。詩婭作為一名優秀的劍士，在聖龍戰爭中屠龍的英勇事蹟讓她成為傳奇。

Chinese: 打扮非常时尚的魔女，虽然外表很可爱，但是性格却非常怠惰。不愿意和他人多说一句，时常拿着一个名为“奥德修斯”的布偶自言自语。奥德修斯体内装着这位魔女的心脏。
English: She is a stylish Nova with a cute appearance but an incredibly lazy personality. She seldom speaks to others, yet often talks to a doll named "Odysseus". This doll contains the Nova's heart.
TChinese: 打扮非常時尚的魔女，雖然外表很可愛，但是性格卻非常怠惰。不願意和他人多說一句，時常拿著一個名為“奧德修斯”的布偶自言自語。奧德修斯體內裝著這位魔女的心臟。

Chinese: 熊穴的小公主，父亲在肃清之战中战死，母亲殉葬，在师傅的教导下仙蒂并没有吃过什么苦头。她鲁莽地去闯荡人类社会，导致了大量的悲剧产生，而这也使她真正成长了起来。
English: A princess from Bear Cave, she lost her father in the Purge War and her mother followed him in death. Thanks to her master's guidance, she didn't face much hardship. Recklessly venturing into human society, she caused many tragedies, but these experiences helped her grow.
TChinese: 熊穴的小公主，父親在肅清之戰中戰死，母親殉葬，在師傅的教導下仙蒂並沒有吃過什麼苦頭。她魯莽地去闖蕩人類社會，導致了大量的悲劇產生，而這也使她真正成長了起來。

Chinese: 笨手笨脚的少女侍者，曾经饱受歧视，以为在米德加尔城可以得到尊重。可是一切都没有改变——自己越努力，事情越糟糕。贝儿倒在了那个理想幻灭的黑暗之夜。
English: She was once a scorned bumbling maid who sought solace and dignity in Midgard City. However, she found that her plight remained unchanged—the more she strived, the more dire her circumstances became. On that dark night of shattered dreams, Belle succumbed to her despair.
TChinese: 笨手笨腳的少女侍者，曾經飽受歧視，以為在米德加爾城可以得到尊重。可是一切都沒有改變——自己越努力，事情越糟糕。貝兒倒在了那個理想幻滅的黑暗之夜。

Chinese: 从机灵可爱的贵族少女安娜到美丽干练的艾露维尔女伯爵，她愈发看清了身上的重重桎梏。向往月亮的花朵最终凋零在真理的土壤之中。
English: Transforming from the astute and charming noblewoman Anna to the elegant and formidable Countess of Elvir, she has come to recognize the inescapable fetters that bind her. The blossom yearning for the moon will ultimately perish within the soil of truth.
TChinese: 從機靈可愛的貴族少女安娜到美麗幹練的艾露維爾女伯爵，她愈發看清了身上的重重桎梏。嚮往月亮的花朵最終凋零在真理的土壤之中。

Chinese:
来自异界“锦绣江山”的神明——桃。其拥有魅惑众生的容貌与冷酷的性格，掌握着杀戮的权能。
在战争结束后，不愿被遗忘的祂成为了人们口中的欺诈之神，并最终招致破灭。只是，这并非一切的结束。在湮灭时见到的那道光，成为了新的开始——
English:
From Splendid World, a holy deity—Momo. She possesses a bewitching charm and a cold personality, wielding the power of slaughter.
After the war, unwilling to be forgotten, she became known as the God of Deception, eventually bringing about her own demise. However, this was not the end. The light she saw during her obliteration became a new beginning.
TChinese:
來自異界“錦繡江山”的神明——桃。其擁有魅惑眾生的容貌與冷酷的性格，掌握著殺戮的權能。
在戰爭結束後，不願被遺忘的祂成為了人們口中的欺詐之神，並最終招致破滅。只是，這並非一切的結束。在湮滅時見到的那道光，成為了新的開始——

Chinese: 落日聚落最后一任领袖，“禁忌之轮”事件中改信杰西斯，保全了源精灵的族群。
English: She was the last leader of the Dusk Settlement. During the "Taboo and Betrayal" incident, she converted to Jancis, ensuring the survival of the primal elf tribe.
TChinese: 落日聚落最後一任領袖，“禁忌之輪”事件中改信傑西斯，保全了源精靈的族群。

Chinese:
塞蕾丝蒂娜具有龙族血统，为战斗而生，平息了黎比赫忒游民叛乱，在“中庭邪典”、“圣别之塔陷落”等事件中功勋卓著。
在孤身一人击溃极端游民群体后，真理圣殿为塞蕾丝蒂娜授勋，可受重伤的她在历史记录中失去战斗的能力。
English:
With dragon blood in her veins, she was born to fight. She quelled the Lybiehte Vagabond Rebellion and achieved great feats in events like the "Dark Tome of Midgard" and the "Fall of the Tower of Sanctity."
After defeating an extremist vagabond group, she was honored by the Sanctuary of Truth, but records show she was gravely injured and lost her combat abilities.
TChinese:
塞蕾絲蒂娜具有龍族血統，為戰鬥而生，平息了黎比赫忒遊民叛亂，在“中庭邪典”、“聖別之塔陷落”等事件中功勳卓著。
在孤身一人擊潰極端遊民群體後，真理聖殿為塞蕾絲蒂娜授勳，可受重傷的她在歷史記錄中失去戰鬥的能力。

Chinese:
瑞比娅具有龙族血统。从小时起便被选定为圣别之塔守塔人。接受主神的祝福，身体停留在12岁，只在战斗时变成成年的形态。
这决定了她的一生都将献给守塔这一事业。在漫长的守护过程中，她的心态逐渐变化，开始怨恨甚至仇恨主神。
最终，她接受了秘石商会的邀请，离开圣别之塔前往珀莉所在的群落，明面协助珀莉，暗地里却筹划起了邪恶的召唤仪式。最终，她脱离了圣别之塔的束缚，获得自由，却因贪心不足想要涉及灵魂的变化而招致毁灭。
English:
She possesses the blood of a dragon. As a child, she was selected to guard the Tower of Sanctity. Blessed by Lord Deity, her body remains that of a 12-year-old girl. It is only during combat that she changes to an adult form.
This blessing determined that her lifelong duty would be to guard the Tower. As she continued to guard the Tower over the years, her feelings shifted, leading her to resent and hate Lord Deity.
She accepted the Secret Stone Society's invitation, leaving the Tower of Sanctity for Peri's settlement. While publicly supporting Peri, she secretly plotted a dark summoning ritual. In the end, she broke free from the Tower of Sanctity, gaining freedom, but her greed to tamper with the soul's essence led her to her demise.
TChinese:
瑞比婭具有龍族血統。從小時起便被選定為聖別之塔守塔人。接受主神的祝福，身體停留在12歲，只在戰鬥時變成成年的形態。
這決定了她的一生都將獻給守塔這一事業。在漫長的守護過程中，她的心態逐漸變化，開始怨恨甚至仇恨主神。
最終，她接受了秘石商會的邀請，離開聖別之塔前往珀莉所在的群落，明面協助珀莉，暗地裏卻籌畫起了邪惡的召喚儀式。最終，她脫離了聖別之塔的束縛，獲得自由，卻因貪心不足想要涉及靈魂的變化而招致毀滅。

Chinese:
因为一些巧合来到了异世界，成为了“生肖卫士”。在自己不熟悉的环境中努力适应着，一步步成长起来，最终得以击败此处强大的妖魔鬼怪。
最后回到了原来的世界，但她和太一世界之间的牵连似乎仍然没有断过。
English:
She somehow arrived in another world and became a "Zodiac Sentinel". However, she worked hard to adapt and gradually became stronger in this strange world, ultimately defeating powerful monsters.
Eventually, she returned to her original world, but her connection with the Taeuno World seems to persist.
TChinese:
因為一些巧合來到了異世界，成為了“生肖衛士”。在自己不熟悉的環境中努力適應著，一步步成長起來，最終得以擊敗此處強大的妖魔鬼怪。
最後回到了原來的世界，但她和太一世界之間的牽連似乎仍然沒有斷過。

Chinese:
原本是托莱特城邦一个贵族家庭的小姐，因为父母的意外死亡，成了孤儿。
长大后，奈奥米成为了远近皆知的“女仆侦探”。
她把当年的那场“意外”视为案件，一直在追查父母死亡的真相。
English:
Originally a lady from a noble family in Toret, she became an orphan after her parents' untimely deaths.
She grew up to become the renowned "Detective Maid".
She continuously investigates the "incident" that claimed her parents' lives as though it were a case to be solved.
TChinese:
原本是托萊特城邦一個貴族家庭的小姐，因為父母的意外死亡，成了孤兒。
長大後，奈奧米成為了遠近皆知的“女僕偵探”。
她把當年的那場“意外”視為案件，一直在追查父母死亡的真相。

Chinese: 第一纪元末落日聚落领袖，在第一次落日之战中率领落日聚落抵抗德罗伊城邦的侵略并获得胜利。在第二次落日之战中，因受“禁忌之轮”事件牵连，被放逐至深渊。
English: As the leader of the Dusk Settlement at the end of the Era of Firstlight, she led her people to victory against the invasion of Droy in the First Dusk War. During the Second Dusk War, she was exiled to the Abyss due to the "Taboo and Betrayal" incident.
TChinese: 第一紀元末落日聚落領袖，在第一次落日之戰中率領落日聚落抵抗德羅伊城邦的侵略並獲得勝利。在第二次落日之戰中，因受“禁忌之輪”事件牽連，被放逐至深淵。

Chinese:
出生于诺德拉矿区的恶魔少女，是布雷萧夫妇的次女。伊拉是十年前诺德拉矿难的幸存者之一，也是三年前混乱潮汐造成影响的受害者之一。
在第四纪元1750年，常年郁积着愤怒和不满的伊拉觉醒了，成为大罪使徒，开始以复仇为目标行动。
English:
Hailing from the Nordla mining district, the fiendish lass is the second daughter of the Bradshaws. She is one of the survivors of the Nordla mining disaster ten years ago and one of the victims of the Chaos Tide three years ago.
She awoke in 1750 of the Era of Eternal Flame, driven by years of anger and dissatisfaction. She became the sin apostle, embarking on a quest for vengeance.
TChinese:
出生於諾德拉礦區的惡魔少女，是佈雷蕭夫婦的次女。伊拉是十年前諾德拉礦難的倖存者之一，也是三年前混亂潮汐造成影響的受害者之一。
在第四紀元1750年，常年鬱積著憤怒和不滿的伊拉覺醒了，成為大罪使徒，開始以復仇為目標行動。

Chinese: 自诸多的祈祷中出现的圣女，艾斯塔利亚出生在杰西斯教国的贫民区，她拥有出色的水魔法天赋，并且从不吝啬为他人使用自己的力量，因而受到教国民众的尊敬。在反抗腐烂的教会的民众运动中，艾斯塔利亚被推举为教皇。
English: A Saintess born from the fervent prayers of the faithful, she emerged from a poor district in the Holy Theocracy of Jancis. Her powerful water magic aids those in need, earning her the people's veneration. In the uprising against the decaying ecclesiasticism, Estaria was exalted to the papacy.
TChinese: 自諸多的祈禱中出現的聖女，艾斯塔利亞出生在傑西斯教國的貧民區，她擁有出色的水魔法天賦，並且從不吝嗇為他人使用自己的力量，因而受到教國民眾的尊敬。在反抗腐爛的教會的民眾運動中，艾斯塔利亞被推舉為教皇。

Chinese:
红簌国的辰龙圣卫，位列十二圣卫之首。
十一岁时失去双亲，毅然开启辰龙试炼并成功容纳圣卫传承，成为历史上最年轻的圣卫。
每年年关都会强行苏醒，与十二圣卫一同抵抗年兽。为此付出了不可逆转的代价。
English:
The Drago Sentinel of the Crimson Kingdom, ranked first among the Twelve Sentinels.
Orphaned at eleven, she became the youngest Sentinel by passing the Drago Trials.
Each year, she is forced to awaken and fight the Nian Beast with the other Sentinels. She has paid an irreversible price for this.
TChinese:
紅簌國的辰龍聖衛，位列十二聖衛之首。
十一歲時失去雙親，毅然開啟辰龍試煉並成功容納聖衛傳承，成為歷史上最年輕的聖衛。
每年年關都會強行蘇醒，與十二聖衛一同抵抗年獸。為此付出了不可逆轉的代價。

Chinese: 圣龙战争期间，在一场围城战中幸存下来的半兽人孩子，曾经担任过半兽人军阀的辎重官，最后加入了多洛莉丝的小队，在盗取月之匙和潜入神殿的行动中发挥了无可替代的作用。
English: An Orccodro child who survived the Sacred Dragon War siege, served as a warlord's logistics officer, and later joined Dolores' team, playing a key role in stealing the Key of the Moon and infiltrating the temple.
TChinese: 聖龍戰爭期間，在一場圍城戰中倖存下來的半獸人孩子，曾經擔任過半獸人軍閥的輜重官，最後加入了多洛莉絲的小隊，在盜取月之匙和潛入神殿的行動中發揮了無可替代的作用。

Chinese: 看似只是一名早早流亡至教国的普通人类女孩，在城内开着一间糕点店谋生，每日都过着普通而宁静的生活。其实还有着完全不输给糕点制作手艺的制毒能力……以及另外一点小秘密。
English: Seemingly just a human girl who fled to the Holy Theocracy early on, running a pastry shop in the city and living an ordinary, peaceful life. However, she also has poisoning skills that rival her pastry-making talent... along with another small secret.
TChinese: 看似只是一名早早流亡至教國的普通人類女孩，在城內開著一間糕點店謀生，每日都過著普通而寧靜的生活。其實還有著完全不輸給糕點製作手藝的制毒能力……以及另外一點小秘密。

Chinese: 圣龙战争期间，辗转在各个半兽人军阀手下担任幕僚的半兽人少女，最后加入了多洛莉丝的小队，为小队出谋划策并解决了不少关于魔法的问题，尤其是在打开深渊传送门时发挥了巨大作用。
English: An Orccodro girl who served as an advisor to various warlords during the Sacred Dragon War, later joined Dolores' team, solving magical problems and playing a key role in opening the Abyssal Portal.
TChinese: 聖龍戰爭期間，輾轉在各個半獸人軍閥手下擔任幕僚的半獸人少女，最後加入了多洛莉絲的小隊，為小隊出謀劃策並解決了不少關於魔法的問題，尤其是在打開深淵傳送門時發揮了巨大作用。

Chinese: 圣龙战争期间，从外海小岛登陆希瑞安的半兽人旅行家，早期曾担任过一段时间向导，直到成为多洛莉丝小队的向导，引领着凡人英雄们达到了几乎不可能达到的深渊神殿。
English: An Orccodro traveler from a small island in the outer seas, she arrived in Ciaran during the Sacred Dragon War, briefly worked as a guide, and later joined Dolores' team, leading the mortal heroes to the Abyss Temple.
TChinese: 聖龍戰爭期間，從外海小島登陸希瑞安的半獸人旅行家，早期曾擔任過一段時間嚮導，直到成為多洛莉絲小隊的嚮導，引領著凡人英雄們達到了幾乎不可能達到的深淵神殿。

Chinese: 曾是被教会收养的普通孤儿，在教会长大。后进入裁判所，成为裁判所首席战斗修女，在史料留有“报丧鸟”之名。
English: Once an orphan raised by the Church. She later entered the Inquisition and became the Chief Battle Nun, known as the "Mourning Bird."
TChinese: 曾是被教會收養的普通孤兒，在教會長大。後進入裁判所，成為裁判所首席戰鬥修女，在史料留有“報喪鳥”之名。

Chinese: 坎贝尔家族的成员，绝对不会被否认的美丽的大恶魔。在前往地面时离开族群，成为利斯特王国的守护者。
English: Member of the Campbells, the alluring Great Demon who will never be denied. She left her clan when heading to the surface and became the Kingdom of Lister's Defender.
TChinese: 坎貝爾家族的成員，絕對不會被否認的美麗的大惡魔。在前往地面時離開族群，成為利斯特王國的守護者。

Chinese: 传说中的忍“半藏”的竞争对手“黑影”的孙女。作为忍的父母很早就去世了，从小被黑影抚养长大。为了贯彻自己的正义正在日夜努力修行。
English: The granddaughter of "Black Shadow," rival of the legendary ninja, Hanzō. Her ninja parents died early, and she was raised by Black Shadow. She diligently trains day and night to fulfill her sense of justice.
TChinese: 傳說中的忍“半藏”的競爭對手“黑影”的孫女。作為忍的父母很早就去世了，從小被黑影撫養長大。為了貫徹自己的正義正在日夜努力修行。

Chinese: 忍与妖魔混血的孩子，曾经在传说中的忍“黑影”身边与雪泉一起度过一段时光。虽然有一段时间是敌人，但经过曲折，现在作为同伴相处。
English: A child of both ninja and demon blood, she once spent time with Yumi by the side of the legendary ninja, "Black Shadow." Although they were enemies for a while, they now get along as comrades.
TChinese: 忍與妖魔混血的孩子，曾經在傳說中的忍“黑影”身邊與雪泉一起度過一段時光。雖然有一段時間是敵人，但經過曲折，現在作為同伴相處。

Chinese: 曾经是一位小有名气的冒险家，却最终建立了统一整个希瑞安大陆的圣加尔特帝国。
English: Once a moderately famous adventurer, she eventually established the Sanctgard Empire, which unified the entire Ciaran continent.
TChinese: 曾經是一位小有名氣的冒險家，卻最終建立了統一整個希瑞安大陸的聖加爾特帝國。

Chinese: 魔女评议会的缔造者，在第三纪元末建立了只有魔女的城市，并将其延续到今天。
English: The founder of the Board of Novas, who established a city of only Novas at the end of the Era of Frost Veil, a city that continues to exist to this day.
TChinese: 魔女評議會的締造者，在第三紀元末建立了只有魔女的城市，並將其延續到今天。

Chinese: 卡洛蒂是被托莱特流放到极北之地的流放者最后的后裔，同时也是冰魔法的集大成者，在受邀去帮助抵抗巨龙后自我解除了流放，南下到了卡里布蓝，在卡里布蓝战役末期施放了“冰封之冬”，最终力竭身亡。
English: Carlotti, the last descendant of the exiled Torets, is a master of ice magic. After lifting her exile to aid in the fight against dragons, she traveled to Cariblue, where she cast the "Winter's Embrace" spell during the Battle of Cariblue, exhausting herself to death.
TChinese: 卡洛蒂是被托萊特流放到極北之地的流放者最後的後裔，同時也是冰魔法的集大成者，在受邀去幫助抵抗巨龍後自我解除了流放，南下到了卡裏布藍，在卡裏布藍戰役末期施放了“冰封之冬”，最終力竭身亡。

Chinese: 原本是圣龙王国的储君，但实际却是通过追求天使的禁忌力量而诞生的意外产物。当发现她的力量无法被使用后，随即便沦为了王室间权力角逐的工具，并最终遭到抛弃。尽管身份高贵，但终其一生的存在感都很低，说是透明也不未过，后世很少有人知道她。
牧，真理圣殿的审判长，是神国暴力机构的最高长官。曾是主神童年时期饲养的宠物，后来逐渐成为其强大的助力，在进化为人形后成为米伦史上唯一一个半星痕。
English: Muu is the Lord Inquisitor and heads the Divine Kingdom's enforcement agency. Formerly Lord Deity's childhood pet, Muu evolved into human form and became Mirren's only Demi-Aster.
TChinese: 牧，真理聖殿的審判長，是神國暴力機構的最高長官。曾是主神童年時期飼養的寵物，後來逐漸成為其強大的助力，在進化為人形後成為米倫史上唯一一個半星痕。

Chinese: 克蕾尔，神赦司司主，拥有“净化混乱力量”的特殊能力，因为特殊的身份和强大的实力而受三大家族所尊敬。在主神消失之后，克蕾尔一直在努力维护着真理圣殿的统治，消灭净化那些因混乱能量而产生的敌人。
English: Claire leads the Absolving Theocracy and can purify Havoc Energy. Her unique ability and strength earn her respect from the three major families. After Lord Deity's disappearance, Claire tirelessly maintains the Sanctuary of Truth's rule by purging Havoc Energy-born enemies.
TChinese: 克蕾爾，神赦司司主，擁有“淨化混亂力量”的特殊能力，因為特殊的身份和強大的實力而受三大家族所尊敬。在主神消失之後，克蕾爾一直在努力維護著真理聖殿的統治，消滅淨化那些因混亂能量而產生的敵人。

Chinese: 露西，卡尔佩恩家族现任家主，国民议会领袖。她身上的返祖现象给予了她极为强大的魔力储备与肉体强度。露西·卡尔佩恩是这个时代乃至历史上最为强大的魔女之一。
English: Lucy is the current head of the Calpines and leader of the National Assembly. Her atavistic trait grants her immense magic and great strength. She is one of the most powerful Novas in this era or even of all time.
TChinese: 露西，卡爾佩恩家族現任家主，國民議會領袖。她身上的返祖現象給予了她極為強大的魔力儲備與肉體強度。露西·卡爾佩恩是這個時代乃至歷史上最為強大的魔女之一。

Chinese: 罗德，克莱因家现任家主，下议院领袖。他为人刚正忠诚，同时又刻板固执，在律法和规则方面有着近乎教条般的恪守，对于认定正确的事会坚定不移的执行下去，是一位称职且典型的克莱因。
English: Rod is the current head of the Kleins and leader of the Lower House. Righteous and loyal, Rod is rigid in his adherence to laws and rules, executing his convictions unwaveringly. He is a model Klein.
TChinese: 羅德，克萊因家現任家主，下議院領袖。他為人剛正忠誠，同時又刻板固執，在律法和規則方面有著近乎教條般的恪守，對於認定正確的事會堅定不移的執行下去，是一位稱職且典型的克萊因。

Chinese: 黑神伊娜，黑神家现任家主，上议院领袖。黑神伊娜从未展现出作为魔女的天赋。在很多人看来，她远远无法与自己的女儿黑神月咏相提并论。但黑神月咏的身世至今成谜，直到主神亲自为她洗礼，才让家族内部的反对声音为之一空。如今黑神伊娜虽然身居高位，但却常年深居简出，很少出现在大众视野。
English: Kurokami Ina is the current head of the Kurokamis and leader of the Upper House. She lacks the magical talent expected of a Nova, and is often compared unfavorably to her daughter, Kurokami Tsukuyo, whose origins remain mysterious. Since her baptism by Lord Deity, opposition to her within the family has quieted. Kurokami Ina now leads a reclusive life, rarely appearing in public.
TChinese: 黑神伊娜，黑神家現任家主，上議院領袖。黑神伊娜從未展現出作為魔女的天賦。在很多人看來，她遠遠無法與自己的女兒黑神月詠相提並論。但黑神月詠的身世至今成謎，直到主神親自為她洗禮，才讓家族內部的反對聲音為之一空。如今黑神伊娜雖然身居高位，但卻常年深居簡出，很少出現在大眾視野。

Chinese:
凯尔丝，罗德·克莱因与蜜莉恩·坎贝尔之女。凯尔丝诞生在混乱潮汐最顶峰之时，这间接导致了她母亲的死亡，所以家族中人将她视为不祥之人。凯尔丝对于这些误解与偏见并不在意，现在的她已经成为了主神最虔诚的信徒，守护着米伦的和平与安宁。
凯尔丝诞生时因为难产加之混乱潮汐的影响而险些夭折，是她母亲拼尽全力地保护以及主神出手赐福才得以顺利诞生，但是她的母亲却也因此深染混乱能量而被罗德亲手净化。
English:
Kelsi is the daughter of Rod Klein and Milian Campbell. During the peak of the Chaos Tide, her birth indirectly caused her mother's death, leading the family to view her as a cursed one. Unperturbed by these prejudices, Kelsi has become the most devout follower of Lord Deity, protecting the peace of Mirren.
She was saved during a difficult birth by her mother's efforts and a blessing from Lord Deity, though her mother succumbed to Havoc Energy and was purified by Rod.
TChinese:
凱爾絲，羅德·克萊因與蜜莉恩·坎貝爾之女。凱爾絲誕生在混亂潮汐最頂峰之時，這間接導致了她母親的死亡，所以家族中人將她視為不祥之人。凱爾絲對於這些誤解與偏見並不在意，現在的她已經成為了主神最虔誠的信徒，守護著米倫的和平與安寧。
凱爾絲誕生時因為難產加之混亂潮汐的影響而險些夭折，是她母親拼盡全力地保護以及主神出手賜福才得以順利誕生，但是她的母親卻也因此深染混亂能量而被羅德親手淨化。

Chinese: 艾露维尔女伯爵，本名安娜，本是艾林家族的长女，因为艾露维尔家原定的继承人意外死亡，也拥有艾露维尔家血脉的安娜被过继给艾露维尔家，继承了艾露维尔家的世袭工种，后来也顺利成为家族掌舵人。
English: Countess Elvir is originally named Anna, the eldest daughter of the Elins. After the heir to the Elvirs passed away, Anna, who shared Elvir blood, was adopted to inherit the family title, eventually becoming the head of the Elvirs.
TChinese: 艾露維爾女伯爵，本名安娜，本是艾林家族的長女，因為艾露維爾家原定的繼承人意外死亡，也擁有艾露維爾家血脈的安娜被過繼給艾露維爾家，繼承了艾露維爾家的世襲工種，後來也順利成為家族掌舵人。

Chinese: 贝儿，一名普通的侍者。因为从小患病、身体不协调，她经常在工作中犯错。在遭受一系列打击之后，贝儿的精神逐渐失控，后被人蛊惑感染了混乱能量。她最终变身成为使徒，在中庭内犯下众多罪行。
English: Belle was a regular servant. She frequently made mistakes in work due to a lifelong illness that affected her coordination. After many setbacks, her mind deteriorated, and Havoc Energy corrupted her. Eventually, she transformed into an Apostle, committing various crimes in Midgard.
TChinese: 貝兒，一名普通的侍者。因為從小患病、身體不協調，她經常在工作中犯錯。在遭受一系列打擊之後，貝兒的精神逐漸失控，後被人蠱惑感染了混亂能量。她最終變身成為使徒，在中庭內犯下眾多罪行。

Chinese: 伊拉，矿工。父母死于诺德拉矿难，在姐姐病逝后孤苦无依。
English: Ira is a miner. Orphaned by a disaster in the Nordla mines, she was left alone after her sister's death.
TChinese: 伊拉，礦工。父母死於諾德拉礦難，在姐姐病逝後孤苦無依。

Chinese: 迪亚里托，在边缘区里很有名声的医生，医术高超，还拥掌握着一些特殊的本事。
English: Diarito, a renowned Periphery doctor, excels in both medicine and unique abilities.
TChinese: 迪亞裏托，在邊緣區裏很有名聲的醫生，醫術高超，還擁掌握著一些特殊的本事。

Chinese: 玛莎，伊莉丝家族的魔女。身为魔女，玛莎已经为真理奉献多年，本该赋予她因荣誉而设的闲职或者虚职。也正是因为她经验丰富，所以真理圣殿特意安排她来教导后辈魔女。

Chinese:
贝儿很努力，但她没有朋友。
她勤奋工作过，埋头苦干过，拥有过某种充实的信仰生活，梦想终有一天，自己将受大家尊敬。然后绝望将她淹没。
对她的审判不存在争议。但拜它所赐，她再不会长大了。
一只来自“另一边世界”的兔子，领她痴迷于疯狂的仙境，再也辨不出什么是真实，什么不是。
贝儿变成了某种黑暗而可怕的存在。
English:
Belle toils away, yet friendship eludes her.
She's poured her heart into her work, devoted herself to a life of faith, all while nurturing a dream that someday, she'd win the respect she craves. But in the end, despair swallowed her whole.
Her judgment came swift and uncontested. Yet because of it, her growth has been forever stunted.
A rabbit from "the other side" lured her into an obsession with a mad wonderland, blurring the lines between reality and fantasy.
Belle transformed into a being of darkness and terror.

貝兒很努力，但她沒有朋友。
她勤奮工作過，埋頭苦幹過，擁有過某種充實的信仰生活，夢想終有一天，自己將受大家尊敬。然後絕望將她淹沒。
對她的審判不存在爭議。但拜它所賜，她再不會長大了。
一只來自“另一邊世界”的兔子，領她癡迷於瘋狂的仙境，再也辨不出什麼是真實，什麼不是。

Chinese:
“……终于连表面道歉的心思都没有。
消失吧，消失吧。
消失吧，消失吧。
给我立刻从视野内消失！”

无法确认理性的存在。
她处于深深的幻梦之中。这是基于谁的魔法的问题，还是她自己的意愿，这两者都可以说得通。
由于魔女的攻击，从幻梦中分出部分意识，服从本能，在若不打倒敌人，自己就会被杀的极为原始的动机驱使下行动。
因为她只将自卑，对弱肉强食不切实际的愚想……不好的、不完整的东西放了出来，所以与幻梦中理想的自己不同，现实中的她显得情绪化，共情能力差，进食欲望强烈，道德意识混乱。
然而这样却恰巧符合了她作为使徒的力量的特征，才使她能最大限度地发挥自己的力量——不断创造混乱生物协助自己作战或作为食物，无限再生和吸收，增殖化为混乱的源泉。
世界在她情绪的动荡中被侵染，变得面目全非，开始浸透可怕的、恐怖的混乱感。
贝儿·布兰德终于强大到不可思议，谁也不能再用“善意”忽视她，她想要的东西靠她自己的强大就能拿到，现在不是她，而是别人必须自求多福了！
——她此刻的欢乐和她曾经的痛苦一样是无边的，她的需求和欲望也是无尽的。但极端的欢乐，像极端的痛苦一样，是人不能在里面待太久的，因为它过于猛烈，所以她成了名副其实的怪物。
English:
"So, you've finally abandoned even the pretense of an apology.
Vanish! Just vanish!
Vanish! Just vanish!
Get out of my sight this instant!"

Rationality seems to have abandoned this place entirely.
She's lost in the depths of a vivid hallucination. Whether this state stems from an external magical influence or her own volition remains unclear—both explanations seem equally plausible.
The Nova's assault fractures her dreamscape, forcing a part of her consciousness to surface. This fragment, driven by raw instinct, acts on the most primal of motivations—kill or be killed.
She's unleashed only the darker fragments of herself—her insecurities, her misguided notions of survival of the fittest. Unlike her idealized dream self, this real-world manifestation is a creature of raw emotion, devoid of empathy, driven by an insatiable hunger, and unbound by moral constraints.
Yet, this twisted state perfectly aligns with her role as an Apostle, unleashing her full potential. She endlessly spawns chaotic creatures to battle alongside her or serve as sustenance, perpetually regenerating and absorbing, multiplying into an inexhaustible wellspring of chaos.
The world becomes infected in her emotional turmoil, changes beyond recognition, and begins to saturate with a terrible, horrible sense of chaos.
Belle Brande has ascended to unfathomable power. No longer can anyone dare to dismiss her with false kindness. She seizes what she desires through sheer might. Now, it's not Belle who must tread carefully, but everyone else who must pray for mercy!
Her ecstasy now mirrors the vastness of her former anguish. Her needs and desires stretch endlessly, an infinite Abyss of want. Yet, just as one cannot endure endless agony, neither can one sustain such intense rapture. The sheer intensity of her emotions has transformed her into a true monster.

Chinese:
在茫茫黑夜中，艾露维尔女伯爵面前有两条路：一是向她所仇视的那个神明和她所抱定决心加以反抗的社会屈膝投降，乞求和接受它的恩赦。
这样她在道德上虽然能够得生，但在精神上却将宣告死亡。
另外，就是忠实于自己觉醒的信念和理想，把对人生的挑战坚持到底。这样，她就必须堕落下去。
安娜·艾露维尔选择了堕落。
勇敢、冷酷、残暴，充满征服欲和占有欲的Madam就此而生。
“在这个圣洁社会中，爱是虚伪的，人们仅仅把它挂在口头上，谁也没有能力真正遵守的，虚伪的爱的信条。”
English:
Amidst the engulfing darkness, Countess Elvir stands at a crossroads: One path leads her to kneel before the deity she loathes and the society she's sworn to defy, pleading for mercy and acceptance.
This path might preserve her morally, but it would mean the death of her spirit.
The other path beckons her to stay true to her awakened beliefs and ideals, to see her challenge to life through to its bitter end. This path, however, demands her fall from grace.
Anna Elvir embraces her descent.
And so, the Madam is born—brave, cold, cruel, with an insatiable hunger for conquest and possession.
"In this so-called sacred society, love is nothing but hypocrisy. It's just lip service, a false creed that no one truly has the power to obey. "

這樣她在道德上雖然能夠得生，但在精神上卻將宣告死亡。
另外，就是忠實於自己覺醒的信念和理想，把對人生的挑戰堅持到底。這樣，她就必須墮落下去。
安娜·艾露維爾選擇了墮落。
勇敢、冷酷、殘暴，充滿征服欲和佔有欲的Madam就此而生。
“在這個聖潔社會中，愛是虛偽的，人們僅僅把它掛在口頭上，誰也沒有能力真正遵守的，虛偽的愛的信條。”

Chinese:
“罪孽深重的爱欲。
被我舍弃的神啊，这就是您的旨意吗？”

安娜·艾林是快乐的贵族小姐。
安娜·艾露维尔是孤独的囚犯。
生活的意义就像是苹果核，啃食掉果肉才能见到，但她想去品尝它的滋味却被告知有毒，人们说，任何一个有志于真理的、高尚的人都应该对它避而远之。
听从他们的话，她在这种如钢铁般牢固的秩序中取得了自己的一席之地，充当着保证一个将换人的世袭工种得以稳定运行的保障。
然而爱欲就是一把锋利的刀，干净利落刨开了她的灵魂——就算丰腴的果肉已经出现腐烂，至少也亲眼见到或美好或丑陋的果核——安娜冒险砸碎了牢笼和枷锁，越狱而出。
她是毫无条件地，又义无反顾地爱上了不应该爱的人，但那条路……没有有意的阴谋，违心的狠手，追求过程中没有恐惧和担心，有的只是兴奋、热情、快乐，在二十年前她就已错过，所以她只能横下心，残酷地去追逐他。
无穷无尽的欲求渴望，光看到就觉得不寒而栗的执着——就好似熊熊燃烧的青色烈焰，直至死亡与她比邻，但是安娜还未停下，全都抛之脑后，“将时间遗忘，燃烧吧！”翩然起舞，魔性将敌我的身体心灵都摧残致尽。
——她现在的自由同她痛恨的孤独是一样的质地，她在过去那种生活中待得太久了，久到她身心其实也成了那牢狱的一部分。即使爱，降临此牢狱，即使走出人生的“囚笼”，她的生存也依然是欺骗性的，而且这将持续下去。
因为欺骗，她能安抚孤独，却最终无法治愈孤独，哪怕宣泄了情欲、万事顺遂，安娜也绝得不到救赎，而永远是怪物。
English:
"The profound sin of desire.
Oh, Him whom I have forsaken, is this truly Your divine plan?"

Anna Elin, the picture of a joyous noblewoman.
Anna Elvir, a solitary captive.
Life's meaning is like an apple's core—hidden until you've devoured the flesh. Yet when she yearned to taste it, she was warned of its toxicity. Society preached that any soul truly devoted to truth and nobility must shun such dangerous curiosity.
Heeding their counsel, she carved out her niche in this unyielding societal machine, becoming a cog that ensures the smooth transition of power in a hereditary system—a living guarantee of stability in a world resistant to change.
However, love was like a sharp blade, slicing through her soul. The once-lush fruit may have rotted, but at least she has seen the core, whether beautiful or ugly. Anna dared to shatter the cage and chains, escaping her prison.
She fell in love unconditionally and crazily with someone she shouldn't have, but that path held no schemes or forced cruelty, and no fear or worry in the pursuit—only excitement, passion, and joy. She had missed out on him 20 years ago, so she must now pursue him at all costs.
Her overwhelming desire and unreasonable persistence kept burning like a big fire till the last most of her life. Still, Anna hasn't stopped. She casts everything aside, shouting, "Forget time, just burn!" She dances wildly, her demonic nature ravaging both her body and soul.
Her newfound freedom feels like the loneliness she despised. She had lived that past life for so long that her body and soul had become part of that prison. Even though love has entered the prison and she has escaped the "cage" of life, her life is still a lie, and it will continue to be.
Deception eases her loneliness but cannot cure it. Even if her desires are satisfied and everything goes well, Anna will never find redemption. She will always be a monster.

被我捨棄的神啊，這就是您的旨意嗎？”

English:
The cracks in this holy façade are just beginning to show, but society remains blissfully unaware of the coming storm.
The foundations haven't truly shaken yet. Her enemies still stand united, bound by life, death, and shared destiny.
Victory seems but a distant dream.
Yet Ira can no longer afford to wait.
Years of repression and festering hatred, long buried deep within, have finally bubbled to the surface. Now unleashed, this fury refuses to be contained.
Thus, despite the mismatch between title and reality, the stark contrast between appearance and truth, she unflinchingly embraced her role as the leader of the Thanksgiving Society.
TChinese:
聖潔的世界內部矛盾還剛剛萌芽，社會還沒有明顯表示出什麼徵兆。
秩序並沒有從根本上被動搖，自己的敵人還是“同生死，共命運”的鐵板一塊。
勝利的希望是渺茫的。
但伊拉卻已經不能再等下去了。
積年的壓抑，一直鬱結、沉澱於此的恨意，一浮出水面，就再難以遏制下去。
所以，縱然名實不符，表與裏是背反而行，她也毅然決然地成為了感恩會的領袖。

Chinese:
“他们说，我们生下来就欠了债。
这辈子，做什么也还不清。
他们说，是主神在人间建立神国，才给了我们本应只存在于理想中的一切。
我们是神的债务人。
凭什么？”

她用牙齿咬住了过去，从早到晚都无法放松。
生活在现在的各色人等理所当然地述说着自己学到的正义，对此毫无疑心。他们幸福的度日，合理的做人。
而逾越了这个划定好的框架，因而成了茫茫大众的局外人、说谎者的伊拉·布雷萧，她只能蔑视映入眼帘的这一切。
愤怒以及偏见与复仇……她将这些混杂在一起，产生怒火。
在遭到排斥、于遗忘中腐朽的人群中，伊拉以怒火竖起旗帜，向已然走投无路的人们宣言：世界的不正义，独善以及冷漠都将被燃至灰烬。
但在一片喊叫和欢呼声中，她仍然无法理解自己，理解身在此处并能露出冷酷的、却又非理性面容的自己，是一味掩饰着不断从内心涌起的孤单感，十五岁的小女孩。
她只是知道——
忘却仇恨的罪孽自不必说，杀戮的罪孽、煽动人群的罪孽自己也无疑应当背负。
“去履行职责将一切焚烧殆尽！”
愤怒在挥舞它的使徒，她的爱和她的恨，软弱和后悔，最大的快乐和最汹涌的愤怒……
愤怒沉酣于它的舞弄，那用憎恨与复仇熊熊燃烧，能将一切化为灰烬的残暴的使者。
——她耗尽了自己，而被复仇和憎恨推开的生活日益萎缩，无法为她提供力量，于是她只能下坠，放任怒气蔓延，在罪孽与邪恶之中取得力量来支撑自己。
可人是不能那么做的；能那样做的，只有怪物。
English:
"They say we are born with a debt.
That we can never repay it no matter what we do.
They say it is Lord Deity who established the Divine Kingdom that gave us everything we could only dream of.
We owe Lord Deity.
But why?"

She clenched the past in her teeth, unable to relax for even a second.
The people of today preach the justice they've learned without a second thought. They live happy lives and do what they are supposed to do.
Ira Bradshaw, who stepped outside these boundaries and became a liar in the eyes of the masses, could only disdain everything she saw.
Wrath, prejudice, and vengeance… she mixed them all together, igniting her blazing fire.
Among the outcasts, those rotting in forgetfulness, Ira raised her banner of fury, declaring to the people who had nowhere left to turn: The injustice, self-righteousness and indifference of the world will all burn to ashes.
Yet amid the shouts and cheers, she still could not understand herself, this 15-year-old girl with a cold yet irrational appearance and a growing loneliness hiding inside.
All she knew was that—
beyond the sin of forgetting her hatred, she must bear the guilt of slaughter, of inciting the masses.
"Fulfill your duty and burn everything down!"
Wrath swings its Apostles—her love and hate, her weakness and regret, and her greatest joy and her fiercest anger...
Wrath revels in its dance, as the burning hatred and vengeance consume everything in brutal flames.
She has exhausted herself, and the life driven away by vengeance and hatred withers, offering her no strength. Thus, she can only fall, letting her rage spread, drawing power from sin and evil to sustain herself.
But humans can't live that way only monsters can.

身長：30m
體重：2361kg
特點：通過儀式獲得了無敵的再生能力

通過儀式晉升成偽神的魔女。

Chinese:
有人的地方就有规则。贫民窟的规则与自然极为相近，而狄妮莎则不幸地没能感受到其中善的那部分。对那些生在贫民窟的女孩来说，美丽也是一种不幸。而能够完好无损地逃出来的，也只有狄妮莎了。
只靠幸运是做不到这一点的——狄妮莎生来就比旁人聪明。她能轻易洞穿别人的心思，瞬间想到事情发展的方向。在规则的内外，她的狡猾给她带来不少好处。
美丽，聪明，但还差一点。真正的宠儿是没有弱点的，她笃信这一点。整个西斯坦因的地下组织都知道，有个阴毒狠辣的女疯子，只要跟她动手一定会留下点什么。但还差一点，地痞流氓的小打小闹上不了台面。她知道，她必须拥有力量，真正的力量。
她是一位魔女——原来如此。还有什么能证明她不是神的宠儿？她最渴求的力量也来了。那一天，她被擦肩而过的魔法师赛琳娜收为学生。她知悉了自身的天赋，魔女的秘密，看到了无限的未来。
不兑现这种未来实在是一种罪恶。拥有上天的宠爱却不作为实在是一种罪恶。她应当站在人群的顶点，那才是属于她的位置。从得知了身份的那一刻开始，她所做的一切都是为站在那个位置上而努力。
第三纪元18085年，魔法师阿祖丝晋升失败，西斯坦因大地震爆发。在她的误导下，西斯坦因王室误认为是巨龙入侵，抛弃国家向外流亡，西斯坦因陷入无政府状态。狄妮莎鼓动赛琳娜及魔法师协会接管了秩序，并趁机搜寻具有魔法天赋的孩子，组建自己的板底。同年，在她的主导下，魔法师协会发动了对王室的政变，大部分王室在返回西斯坦因后被杀，西斯坦因魔导国成立。
用了十年时间，她从那个除了美丽一无是处的贫民窟女孩，变成了国家五人议会的成员之一。
但这还不够。
生命一定有尽头吗？当她思考这个问题的时候，似乎是神为她送来了答案。
English:
Wherever people gather, rules are inevitable. The rules of the slums are as wild as nature itself, but unfortunately, Teresa never experienced their kinder side. For the girls born in such poverty, beauty becomes a curse. And Teresa was the only one to escape unscathed.
It wasn't just luck—she was born with a sharper mind than others. She could read people's thoughts and predict outcomes in an instant. Her cunning won her many advantages, both within the rules and beyond them.
Beautiful, clever, but still lacking something. The truly favored have no weaknesses—and Teresa held this truth in her heart. The entire underground network of Systein knew of the vicious, cruel woman—cross her path, and you'd be marked forever. But that wasn't enough the petty brawls of thugs never made it to the grand stage. She knew she needed power—true, unassailable power.
She was a Nova—that much was clear. What else could prove she wasn't a favored one of the gods? The very power she had longed for came to her. One day, the mage Selina, who passed her by, took her on as an apprentice. Teresa discovered her own potential, the secrets of the Nova, and glimpsed an endless future.
To not fulfill this destiny would be nothing short of sinful. To waste the favor of the gods was a crime. She was meant to stand at the top—there, she would find her rightful place. From the moment she uncovered her true identity, everything Teresa did was for the sole purpose of claiming that position.
In 18085of the Era of Frost Veil, the mage Azuth failed in his ascension, triggering a massive earthquake in Systein. Under Teresa's deception, the Systein royal family mistakenly believed a dragon invasion was underway, and fled the kingdom, plunging the realm into chaos. Teresa manipulated Selina and the Mage Association to seize control of the fractured order, secretly recruiting magically gifted children to build her own power. That same year, under her leadership, the Mage Association staged a coup against the royal family. When the royals returned to Systein, most were slain, and the Systein Magic Kingdom was born.
In just ten years, Teresa transformed from a beautiful girl with nothing but a grim future in the slums into one of the Council of Five.
And yet this is not enough.
Did life have an inevitable end? As she pondered this question, it seemed the gods themselves were sending her an answer.

Chinese:
在成为魔法师协会——魔导国的领导者之后，狄妮莎通过她的老师接触到了西斯坦因大地震的真相——晋升仪式。至今还没有人成功过——如果是旁人恐怕会望而却步，但狄妮莎就会认为，这是命运要让她拔得头筹。如果不是这样，上天为什么会把另一位天赋超群的魔女送到她身边呢？
她悉心豢养着这个魔女。呵护她——绝不让她夭折。但也不让她过得太痛快，仪式也不是只看天赋的。在女孩成长的过程中，她甚至产生了一种别样的、从未体验过的情感。这种旁人称之为亲情的东西，在她看来像具有致命腐蚀性的炼金试剂，会完全破坏她的人格。于是这种情感被她人为地扭曲向另一个方向——收获。种下种子，收获果实。丰收也是一样的快乐。
一切顺理成章。到了毁灭国度的时候，她不由得更生感慨——真是一场伟大的收获。
从死亡的国度中重获新生——以这样的仪式，她达到了伪神的境界。随后，她马上开始筹备下一场仪式：成为无敌的轮回之神。在这一两千年中，她一次又一次在死亡的国度中转生，一点又一点积蓄着力量。狄妮莎很有耐心——收获与代价总是相关的。于是，在第四纪元1750年的牺牲节，她终于等到了机会。
在一遍又一遍的轮回中，一次又一次杀死对方。越来越熟稔，越来越轻松——这都得益于她所积蓄的力量、她所做的准备。
终于，只需要再赢一次了。再杀死她一次，就能完全掌控仪式的主导权。与以往的每一天相比，这一次有一些小小的变数，但狄妮莎已经做好了准备。
她将在魔女的血与泪中获得新生。轮回往复，不死不灭的，就是狄妮莎，魔女之癌。
English:
After becoming the leader of both the Mage Association and the Magic Kingdom, Teresa learned the true cause behind the Systein earthquake from her mentor—the Ascension Ritual. No one had ever succeeded in it—Any other person would have feared to try, but Teresa believed it was destiny that she would be the one to overcome it. If it weren't, why else would the gods send another Nova of extraordinary talent to aid her?
She carefully nurtured this Nova. She protected her—and kept her alive. But never allowed her to live too easily, for the ritual wasn't merely about innate talent. As the girl grew, Teresa began to feel something entirely unfamiliar, a feeling she had never experienced before. What others called familial affection felt like a deadly corrosive alchemical potion to her—one that could utterly destroy her very being. So, she twisted this emotion into something else—something she could harvest. Plant the seed, reap the fruit. The bounty was just as sweet.
Everything unfolded as it should. When the time came to destroy the kingdom, she couldn't help but reflect—what a magnificent harvest it had been.
From the ashes of the fallen kingdom, she was reborn—through this ritual, she ascended to the level of a false god. Without wasting time, she began preparing for her next ritual: To become the invincible god of reincarnation. For the next one or two thousand years, she reincarnated over and over again in the realm of death, slowly amassing power with each cycle. Teresa was patient—she knew that harvest and sacrifice always went hand in hand. Then, in 1750 of the Era of Eternal Flame, during the Sacrifice Festival, she finally saw her chance.
In the endless loops of reincarnation, she killed her opponent over and over. It grew easier with each time, all thanks to the power she had built and the meticulous preparation she had made.
Finally, she needed just one more victory. One more death, and she would take full control of the ritual. This time, there was a slight deviation from the norm, but Teresa was prepared.
She would be reborn in the blood and tears of the Nova. Reincarnation, endless and eternal—that was Teresa, the cancer of Novas.

Chinese:
曾经的自豪感也荡然无存。萦绕西蒙心中的是迷惘和痛苦。
荒谬的世界令他无法接受。
他最后都不敢承认自己错了，只是在罪业的熏陶下有了些感悟，最终在大吃特吃中迷失，——他所推崇的真理是牺牲掉他身上所有的人性，将荒诞的毁灭误认为典范。
西蒙痛哭流涕，然而他的人生也近结束。
混乱吞噬懊悔，也吞噬了他。
English:
His once-cherished pride now lies in tatters. Simon's heart now brims with bewilderment and anguish.
This world, in all its absurdity, remains utterly incomprehensible to him.
He refuses to admit his errors, clinging to twisted insights born from sin. Ultimately, he loses himself in gluttony—his championed 'truth' now nothing more than the sacrifice of his own humanity, mistaking catastrophic destruction for enlightenment.
Simon weeps bitter tears, but the curtain on his life is already falling.
Chaos devours regret, and him as well.
TChinese:
曾經的自豪感也蕩然無存。縈繞西蒙心中的是迷惘和痛苦。
荒謬的世界令他無法接受。
他最後都不敢承認自己錯了，只是在罪業的薰陶下有了些感悟，最終在大吃特吃中迷失，——他所推崇的真理是犧牲掉他身上所有的人性，將荒誕的毀滅誤認為典範。
西蒙痛哭流涕，然而他的人生也近結束。
混亂吞噬懊悔，也吞噬了他。

Chinese:
在恍惚中，西蒙似乎察觉到了自己与过去已经变得大不相同。这或许是因为自己从原本腐朽的人生中解脱出来，获得了从未有过的自由的缘故。可自己作为一个人还是不完整的，身心皆充满了空虚。
必须先用什么来填满它，西蒙像这样说着。
渐渐地，漫无目的地徘徊变成了不必去在意结果的旅行，西蒙发现这个世界远比自己原本所想的美妙。
当他认识到这点的时候，他便走出了自己的困境。和过去的一切告别，着眼于当下理所应当的索取，让自己变得充实。情感也好，尊严也罢，所有的遗失的东西他都会慢慢找回来的。
只是，在这样的转变下，他也永远无法认清其他人眼中的自己——一个毫无意识，横冲直撞的臃肿怪物。
English:
In a daze, Simon realized he had become very different from his past self. Perhaps it was because he had freed himself from his once decaying life and gained a new sense of freedom. Yet, as a person, he still felt incomplete—empty inside.
"I must first fill this void with something," Simon thought aloud.
Gradually, aimless wandering became a journey unconcerned with outcomes, and Simon found that the world was far more wondrous than he had imagined.
When he realized this, he walked out of his predicament. He left the past behind and focused on taking what was rightfully his in the present, making himself whole. He would reclaim all that he had lost one by one, including emotions and dignity.
However, even with this change, he would never be able to see himself through the eyes of others—a reckless, bloated monster with no self-awareness.
TChinese:
在恍惚中，西蒙似乎察覺到了自己與過去已經變得大不相同。這或許是因為自己從原本腐朽的人生中解脫出來，獲得了從未有過的自由的緣故。可自己作為一個人還是不完整的，身心皆充滿了空虛。
必須先用什麼來填滿它，西蒙像這樣說著。
漸漸地，漫無目的地徘徊變成了不必去在意結果的旅行，西蒙發現這個世界遠比自己原本所想的美妙。
當他認識到這點的時候，他便走出了自己的困境。和過去的一切告別，著眼於當下理所應當的索取，讓自己變得充實。情感也好，尊嚴也罷，所有的遺失的東西他都會慢慢找回來的。
只是，在這樣的轉變下，他也永遠無法認清其他人眼中的自己——一個毫無意識，橫衝直撞的臃腫怪物。

Chinese:
身高：153cm
体重：55KG
特点：善于伪装成弱小，在持久的战斗中会是一个相当麻烦的敌人
能量倾向：混乱
“来和莉莉一起玩嘛~”
一位无辜的受害者所听到的最后一句话。
English:
Height: 153cm
Weight: 55kg
Trait: Good at disguising as weak, a quite troublesome enemy in prolonged battles.
Energy: Chaos
"Come play with Lily!"
The last words an innocent victim heard.
TChinese:
身高：153cm
體重：55KG
特點：善於偽裝成弱小，在持久的戰鬥中會是一個相當麻煩的敵人
能量傾向：混亂
“來和莉莉一起玩嘛~”
一位無辜的受害者所聽到的最後一句話。

Chinese:
莉莉·布朗尼原本只是边缘区的一个普通孩童，但是在感染了情绪病后，她的命运便已被决定了。
她被从家中掳走，最终成为了使徒，这时候在她身上最后一点曾经天真孩童的影子也便消失不见了。
至于其本身的意识究竟残留多少，也再无法知晓，唯一能确认的是如今的莉莉·布朗尼徘徊在夜晚的街道，用原来稚嫩的声音创造错觉，只是为了降低人们的戒备心，让它的猎物们“自愿”走进它的陷阱中。
English:
Once an ordinary child from Periphery, Lily Brownie's fate was sealed the moment she contracted the emotional plague.
Snatched from her home, she was molded into an Apostle. In that transformation, the last flicker of her innocent childhood was extinguished.
How much of her original self remains is a mystery. We only know this: Lily Brownie now stalks the night streets, her childish voice a lure, creating illusions to disarm her victims, enticing them to "willingly" step into her deadly trap.
TChinese:
莉莉·布朗尼原本只是邊緣區的一個普通孩童，但是在感染了情緒病後，她的命運便已被決定了。
她被從家中擄走，最終成為了使徒，這時候在她身上最後一點曾經天真孩童的影子也便消失不見了。
至於其本身的意識究竟殘留多少，也再無法知曉，唯一能確認的是如今的莉莉·布朗尼徘徊在夜晚的街道，用原來稚嫩的聲音創造錯覺，只是為了降低人們的戒備心，讓它的獵物們“自願”走進它的陷阱中。

Chinese:
成为使徒后的莉莉·布朗尼尽管表面上似乎仍然有着孩童的天真面貌与性格，但那不过是一种伪装。
对于使徒莉莉·布朗尼而言，它的面目与声音都不过是捕食的利器，当受害者听到它的声音并认为只是一个孩子在嬉闹或是在发出求助时，往往就意味着已经走进了它的陷阱之中。
一种猜测认为，莉莉·布朗尼之所以会采用这种狩猎方式，也是一种过往意识残留的表现。也许在使徒莉莉·布朗尼的潜意识中，它将自己的狩猎活动识别成了与他人的游戏与玩乐，当然，这种“游戏”的结果只会是悲剧。无论最后的真相是什么，它的下场都表明一旦沾染上情绪病，最终是不会有什么好结局的。
English:
Lily Brownie continued to appear like an innocent child after becoming an Apostle, but that was just a disguise.
That childish face and voice were just the hunting tools of Apostle Lily Brownie. When victims heard its voice and mistook it for laughter or the cry for help from a child, they were already stepping into its trap.
Some speculate that Lily Brownie's hunting method is a remnant of past consciousness. Perhaps, in its subconscious, Apostle Lily Brownie perceives its hunting as a game with others, though this "game" always ends with tragedy. Regardless of the reason, its fate proves that once touched by emotional affliction, no good ending awaits.
TChinese:
成為使徒後的莉莉·布朗尼儘管表面上似乎仍然有著孩童的天真面貌與性格，但那不過是一種偽裝。
對於使徒莉莉·布朗尼而言，它的面目與聲音都不過是捕食的利器，當受害者聽到它的聲音並認為只是一個孩子在嬉鬧或是在發出求助時，往往就意味著已經走進了它的陷阱之中。
一種猜測認為，莉莉·布朗尼之所以會採用這種狩獵方式，也是一種過往意識殘留的表現。也許在使徒莉莉·布朗尼的潛意識中，它將自己的狩獵活動識別成了與他人的遊戲與玩樂，當然，這種“遊戲”的結果只會是悲劇。無論最後的真相是什麼，它的下場都表明一旦沾染上情緒病，最終是不會有什麼好結局的。

Chinese:
身高：510cm
体重：？？？
特点：巨大的破坏力，能操控多种属性的魔法
能量倾向：混乱
善恶与否，本身并不具有价值，真正有意义的是让这世界留下只属于自己的位置，那才是决定性的结果。在无尽的岁月与变迁中，这头名为咎瓦尤斯的龙抉择出了它的唯一信条。
English:
Height: 510cm
Weight: ???
Trait: Tremendous destructive power, able to manipulate various types of magic.
Energy: Chaos
Good and evil in themselves have no value, what truly matters is to leave a place in this world that belongs only to oneself, that is the decisive result. Through endless ages and changes, this dragon named Zealous has chosen its only creed.
TChinese:
身高：510cm
體重：？？？
特點：巨大的破壞力，能操控多種屬性的魔法
能量傾向：混亂
善惡與否，本身並不具有價值，真正有意義的是讓這世界留下只屬於自己的位置，那才是決定性的結果。在無盡的歲月與變遷中，這頭名為咎瓦尤斯的龍抉擇出了它的唯一信條。

Chinese:
一度肆虐诺德拉矿区的邪龙，咎瓦尤斯。
……在黝黑的地底之中，有一面墙。
墙后，是火焰遍布四面八方的溶洞，是光亮，却为日光永不会射入的“暗处”，这正是邪龙咎瓦尤斯的世界。

“不，这并不是他者树起的墙壁。
回想起来，那是你自身——”
“黑神月咏……！”

就好像是显示耻辱、恐惧的象征一样的墙壁。
也就是说，邪龙，绝不会越过墙壁，再度现身于地面之上。
直至在生命尽头，在他的面前出现了那双眼睛。

“真是让人啼笑皆非。……你瞧，你不是龙吗？”
English:
The malevolent dragon, Zealous, once terrorized the Nordla mining district.
Deep in the pitch-black underground, there stands a wall.
Beyond this wall lies a cavern ablaze with fire, a realm of light paradoxically untouched by the sun's rays—this is the domain of Zealous, the wicked dragon.

"No, this wall was not built by the hands of others.
Reflecting on it now, it was your own doing—"
"Kurokami Tsukuyo!"

It stands as a symbol of your shame and fear.
This means the wicked dragon will never again cross this barrier to surface above ground.
Only at the twilight of his existence did those eyes appear before him.

"How utterly laughable. Don't you see? You're a dragon, aren't you? "
TChinese:
一度肆虐諾德拉礦區的邪龍，咎瓦尤斯。
……在黝黑的地底之中，有一面牆。
牆後，是火焰遍佈四面八方的溶洞，是光亮，卻為日光永不會射入的“暗處”，這正是邪龍咎瓦尤斯的世界。

“不，這並不是他者樹起的牆壁。
回想起來，那是你自身——”
“黑神月詠……！”

就好像是顯示恥辱、恐懼的象徵一樣的牆壁。
也就是說，邪龍，絕不會越過牆壁，再度現身於地面之上。
直至在生命盡頭，在他的面前出現了那雙眼睛。

“真是讓人啼笑皆非。……你瞧，你不是龍嗎？”

Chinese:
咎瓦尤斯意识到自己仅剩的存在正受到威胁。不，应该说那更像是挑战。
即使想要奋力一搏，实际上也不过只是在这不被注意的角落中挣扎，随后被人遗忘。
可到底是何种事物在支撑着，咎瓦尤斯并没有答案。

“无论如何，你我之间终会有一个人葬身在这可憎的坟墓中。”
“至少不是今天，不是现在，”对方的淡然是对咎瓦尤斯最有力的回击。

渺小的身躯中潜藏着令它感到熟悉的东西，就在那凝视着自己的眼睛中。
“所以，代价是什么？“
“你的一切将被燃烧殆尽，“
那并不重要，因为咎瓦尤斯看到了自己在化为灰烬前散发出的辉耀之光。
在同对方立下誓约的瞬间，它的生命再次熊熊地燃烧，与周围遍布的火焰融为一体。
“是啊，支撑自己的早已经不是什么身为龙族的荣誉。“
这种跟小孩子没有区别的想法理应被摒弃，而至于接下来要做的，便是尽可能将更多的事物拖入这运作着的熔炉中。
当然，也包括那个人。
English:
Zealous realized that his very existence was under threat. No, it felt more like a challenge.
As much as he wished to make a final stand, it would only be a struggle in a forgotten corner, soon to be erased from memory.
Zealous had no idea what exactly was sustaining him.

"One of us will end up buried in this cursed grave."
"Not today, not now." The calm response was a strong retort to Zealous.

In that small body, Zealous sensed something familiar, lurking in those eyes that stared back at him.
"So, what's the price?"
"Everything about you will be consumed by fire."
"That didn't matter, for Zealous saw the radiance he would emit before turning to ash.
At the moment he made the pact, his life flared up once more, merging with the surrounding flames.
"Yeah, what sustains me is no longer the honor of being a dragon."
This childish notion should have long been discarded. The only thing left to do now is drag as much as possible into the ever-turning furnace.
Of course, that person is included.
TChinese:
咎瓦尤斯意識到自己僅剩的存在正受到威脅。不，應該說那更像是挑戰。
即使想要奮力一搏，實際上也不過只是在這不被注意的角落中掙扎，隨後被人遺忘。
可到底是何種事物在支撐著，咎瓦尤斯並沒有答案。

“無論如何，你我之間終會有一個人葬身在這可憎的墳墓中。”
“至少不是今天，不是現在，”對方的淡然是對咎瓦尤斯最有力的回擊。

渺小的身軀中潛藏著令它感到熟悉的東西，就在那凝視著自己的眼睛中。
“所以，代價是什麼？“
“你的一切將被燃燒殆盡，“
那並不重要，因為咎瓦尤斯看到了自己在化為灰燼前散發出的輝耀之光。
在同對方立下誓約的瞬間，它的生命再次熊熊地燃燒，與周圍遍佈的火焰融為一體。
“是啊，支撐自己的早已經不是什麼身為龍族的榮譽。“
這種跟小孩子沒有區別的想法理應被摒棄，而至於接下來要做的，便是盡可能將更多的事物拖入這運作著的熔爐中。
當然，也包括那個人。

Chinese:
身高：320cm
体重：？？？
特点：太一世界之神明，对人世怀抱着强烈的怨恨。
能量倾向：混乱
描述：年兽，万灾之因。和平从不属于她，她即是灾难本身。
怪物攻略：
年兽在回合开始与释放怒气技能后，为自己提供无月之夜效果，持续期间会获得强化。当魔女消耗一定能量后，会使年兽失去该效果。
English:
Height: 320 cm
Weight: ???
Traits: The Holy Deity of the Taeuno World, consumed by a deep hatred for humanity.
Energy Affinity: Chaos
Details: The Nian Beast, the source of all calamities. Peace is a foreign concept to her she is the embodiment of disaster.
Monster Tutorial:
At the start of each round, and after unleashing its Rage Skill, the Nian Beast gains the Moonless Night effect, which lasts for a period and enhances its power. When the Nova expends a certain amount of ENG, this effect can be nullified.
TChinese:
身高：320cm
體重：？？？
特點：太一世界之神明，對人世懷抱著強烈的怨恨。
能量傾向：混亂
描述：年獸，萬災之因。和平從不屬於她，她即是災難本身。
怪物攻略：
年獸在回合開始與釋放怒氣技能後，為自己提供無月之夜效果，持續期間會獲得強化。當魔女消耗一定能量後，會使年獸失去該效果。

Chinese:
福祸相依。简单的四个字，蕴含无数哲理的同时，也断绝了年兽的变化。物极必反，而她永远是反着的那一面，用灾祸、用怨恨，去衬托人世的幸福。
众灾难道都是年兽引起的么？自然不是。这人间贪官横行，人欲突破伦理与秩序，带来种种灾祸。人们将这些祸事推到年兽头上，好像将之消灭就能够世间太平了似的。
年兽听着人们的恐惧与咒骂，无声地嘲笑着。
推过来吧，尽情地将一切归在我的头上吧。万灾之果，也可作万灾之因。
灾祸不会消失，每一年她都会变得更强。
总有一天，太一会倾覆于她的手中，而她的帮凶不是别的，正是太一所爱的人类。
English:
Fortune and Disaster are Intertwined. A simple phrase, yet one that holds countless truths, and at the same time it seals the Nian Beast's fate, never allowing for change. When extremes reach their limit, they must reverse. She will always trigger that shift, using disaster and resentment to shatter humanity's fleeting happiness.
Are all the calamities caused by the Nian Beast? Of course not. The human world is rife with corruption, with desires that break moral and ethical boundaries, unleashing numerous disasters. People blame the Nian Beast for these misfortunes, as if eliminating her will somehow restore peace to the world.
The Nian Beast hears their fearful curses and laughs silently.
Come, place all the blame on me. The cause of all disasters can also be the result of them.
Disasters will never vanish every year, she only grows stronger.
One day, Taeuno will fall at her hands, and the humans Taeuno holds dear will be her unwitting accomplices.
TChinese:
福禍相依。簡單的四個字，蘊含無數哲理的同時，也斷絕了年獸的變化。物極必反，而她永遠是反著的那一面，用災禍、用怨恨，去襯托人世的幸福。
眾災難道都是年獸引起的麼？自然不是。這人間貪官橫行，人欲突破倫理與秩序，帶來種種災禍。人們將這些禍事推到年獸頭上，好像將之消滅就能夠世間太平了似的。
年獸聽著人們的恐懼與咒罵，無聲地嘲笑著。
推過來吧，盡情地將一切歸在我的頭上吧。萬災之果，也可作萬災之因。
災禍不會消失，每一年她都會變得更強。
總有一天，太一會傾覆於她的手中，而她的幫兇不是別的，正是太一所愛的人類。

Chinese:
祸福相依，这点在她自己的身上也不可避免。身为神明，她也有祥瑞的一面，只是随着太一的发展，混乱越来越多，她属于灾祸的能力也越来越强。
但是，这一年有所不同。那个一直用来充数的卯兔圣卫觉醒了卯兔之魂，给了她出乎意料的重击。她的灵魂溃散，祥瑞之兽——廿穗，那仅存的，她的伙伴、她的囚徒，也与她分开了。她并不担心，在如今的红簌国，廿穗只会冻毙在街角，转化为更大的灾祸。
然而廿穗没有。她遇到了那个人，那个让卯兔圣卫觉醒的人，同样点亮了祥瑞之兽的希望。灾祸仍然存在于世间，可是幸福又从这个男人的手中诞生，叫这从灾祸深渊里爬出的兽挪不开视线。
作为廿穗的半身，她自然也感觉得到这种变化。温暖的感情消融着她的力量，让她感到烦躁。
不能再等了。再等下去，自己只会越来越弱。
期待是如此不稳，比毁灭更面目可憎。
必须立刻收回廿穗，并且开战才行。
必须……立刻毁灭那个充满变数的人才行。
English:
Fortune and disaster are inseparable, and for her, this truth is inescapable. As a Holy Deity, she possessed a side of auspiciousness, yet with the rise of Taeuno, chaos only intensified, amplifying her powers tied to disaster.
This year, however, was different. The long-forgotten Bunnic Sentinel awakened the Bunnic Soul, delivering an unexpected and devastating blow. Her soul fractured, and the last of her companions—Niya, the auspicious beast and her prisoner—was torn away from her. She was untroubled in the current Crimson Kingdom, Niya would freeze to death on a street corner, transforming into an even greater disaster.
But Niya did not. She met the one who awakened the Bunnic Sentinel, and in doing so, rekindled hope in the auspicious beast. While disaster still plagued the world, happiness was born from the hands of this man. The beast that crawled from the abyss of calamity could not tear its gaze away.
As Niya's other half, she could feel this change with clarity. The warmth of this new connection eroded her power, and she was consumed with frustration.
No more waiting. If she delayed any longer, she would only grow weaker.
Hope, so fragile, was more detestable than destruction.
She had to act immediately—reclaim Niya and ignite the war.
She had to...destroy that unpredictable man before it was too late.
TChinese:
禍福相依，這點在她自己的身上也不可避免。身為神明，她也有祥瑞的一面，只是隨著太一的發展，混亂越來越多，她屬於災禍的能力也越來越強。
但是，這一年有所不同。那個一直用來充數的卯兔聖衛覺醒了卯兔之魂，給了她出乎意料的重擊。她的靈魂潰散，祥瑞之獸——廿穗，那僅存的，她的夥伴、她的囚徒，也與她分開了。她並不擔心，在如今的紅簌國，廿穗只會凍斃在街角，轉化為更大的災禍。
然而廿穗沒有。她遇到了那個人，那個讓卯兔聖衛覺醒的人，同樣點亮了祥瑞之獸的希望。災禍仍然存在於世間，可是幸福又從這個男人的手中誕生，叫這從災禍深淵裏爬出的獸挪不開視線。
作為廿穗的半身，她自然也感覺得到這種變化。溫暖的感情消融著她的力量，讓她感到煩躁。
不能再等了。再等下去，自己只會越來越弱。
期待是如此不穩，比毀滅更面目可憎。
必須立刻收回廿穗，並且開戰才行。
必須……立刻毀滅那個充滿變數的人才行。

Chinese:
身高：172cm
体重：57kg
特点：掌握着杀戮与欺诈的权能，将不分敌我地毁灭一切生灵。
能量倾向：混乱
欺瞒，扭曲世间因果之恶神。——那是“桃”在锦绣江山留下的恶名，亦是她如今对自己的定义。为了消灭最后的美梦，毁灭自身，如今她站在了你的面前。
English:
Height: 172cm
Weight: 57kg
Trait: Possesses the power of killing and deception, destroying all living things, allies or not.
Energy: Chaos
The evil god of deception, distorting the causalities of the world. —That was the infamy "Momo" left in the Splendid World, and it is also her current definition of herself. To destroy the last sweet dream, to destroy herself, now she stands before you.
TChinese:
身高：172cm
體重：57kg
特點：掌握著殺戮與欺詐的權能，將不分敵我地毀滅一切生靈。
能量傾向：混亂
欺瞞，扭曲世間因果之惡神。——那是“桃”在錦繡江山留下的惡名，亦是她如今對自己的定義。為了消滅最後的美夢，毀滅自身，如今她站在了你的面前。

Chinese:
欺瞒他人，欺瞒自身，继而用欺瞒扭曲事实。然而，若是忘记自己正在“欺瞒”，神力便会消退。骗局便会如太阳下的薄冰般溶解。
这就是名为“桃”的恶神，曾经给她的信徒们赏赐过的“恩泽”。她会得到多少信徒的感谢与信仰，便会在之后得到多少诅咒与仇恨。
慢慢地，她得到了另一个称号。在愿力强大的锦绣江山，这看似荒谬的事也成了真。她曾经洁白的皮肤染上了黑色，曾经走在战场中的光芒，终究变成了水中的黑影。
桃低头看向自己映在水中的影子，那黑色的九尾狐向她露出狰狞的笑容。
“你也想欺骗自己吗？”
“……嗯。给我一个美梦吧。”
English:
You deceive others, deceive yourself, and then use these lies to warp reality. Yet, when you forget you're weaving these deceptions, your divine power begins to wane. Your grand illusion melts away like thin ice under the scorching sun.
This is the "blessing" that Momo, the malevolent deity, once bestowed upon her faithful. The gratitude and faith she reaps from her followers will be matched only by the curses and hatred she'll later endure.
Gradually, she earned herself a new moniker. In the potent realm of the Splendid World, even the absurd becomes reality. Her once-pristine skin darkened, and the radiance that once illuminated battlefields faded to a mere shadow lurking beneath the water's surface.
Momo gazed down at her reflection, only to see a black nine-tailed fox grinning back at her with a sinister smile.
"Are you now trying to deceive even yourself?"
"Mm. Grant me a sweet dream. "
TChinese:
欺瞞他人，欺瞞自身，繼而用欺瞞扭曲事實。然而，若是忘記自己正在“欺瞞”，神力便會消退。騙局便會如太陽下的薄冰般溶解。
這就是名為“桃”的惡神，曾經給她的信徒們賞賜過的“恩澤”。她會得到多少信徒的感謝與信仰，便會在之後得到多少詛咒與仇恨。
慢慢地，她得到了另一個稱號。在願力強大的錦繡江山，這看似荒謬的事也成了真。她曾經潔白的皮膚染上了黑色，曾經走在戰場中的光芒，終究變成了水中的黑影。
桃低頭看向自己映在水中的影子，那黑色的九尾狐向她露出猙獰的笑容。
“你也想欺騙自己嗎？”
“……嗯。給我一個美夢吧。”

Chinese:
桃在梦境中建立起了最初到达的村子，捏出那些曾对她笑过的村民。
但是这一切都只会一遍又一遍地毁灭。越是欺骗，就越是快速地倒塌，而不去欺骗他们的结果，亦是一场又一场死亡。桃发觉欺诈的神格本身就是一种诅咒，作为诅咒源头的她从未知晓一件事真正好的发展是什么样子，自然也无法祈愿一个好结局。
她选择离开这个村庄，在空荡荡的世界里漫步，等待一切自然地倒塌。
起初，这场梦中的神明只有一个。不知道第几次村庄毁灭又重建后，梦中出现了巨大的黑影，那是她的绝望。
那如同黑云一般遮天蔽日的恶神无比强大，桃被打得节节败退，不得不拱手让出大半的领土，退居在最初的小小村庄之中。
奇怪的是，这次的美好反而持续得久了一些。桃本来已经放弃了欺诈的权能，然而她惊讶地意识到，让人们觉得她虚弱，反而能使得大家勠力同心，共抗恶敌，即使毁灭，也不悔战斗的一切。
真实一定就是好事吗？欺瞒一定不能得到幸福吗？哪怕心怀不安，桃仍然一步步地，重新走向了欺瞒的道路。
变得弱小吧。变得无害吧。变得无助吧。变得就像自己的信徒那样，成为一个悲惨的、负隅顽抗的可怜人吧。
桃就这样坠入了自己给自己编织的新骗局之中。
而恶神始终笑着。
English:
In her dreams, Momo rebuilt the village she first arrived at, molding the villagers who had once smiled at her.
But it would all be destroyed again and again. The more she deceived, the faster it would collapse, and not deceiving them led to death after death. Momo realized that the power of deception itself was a curse. As the source of this curse, she never knew what health development looked like, so she could never wish for a good ending.
She chose to leave the village and wander through the empty world, waiting for everything to fall apart naturally.
At first, there was only one holy deity in this dream. After countless cycles of the village's destruction and rebirth, a massive shadow appeared in the dream—her despair.
That evil deity, covering the sky like clouds, was powerful. Momo was relentlessly beaten back, forced to relinquish most of her territory and retreat to the small village where it all began.
Strangely, this time the peace lasted a bit longer. Momo had given up her power of deception, but she was surprised to find that her appearing weak made everyone band together to fight the evil enemy. Even if destroyed, they did not regret the battle.
Is truth always good? Is deception always unable to bring happiness? Despite her doubts, Momo walked the path of deception once again.
Be weak. Be harmless. Be helpless. Be a pitiful, desperate soul fighting a losing battle, just like your followers.
Momo thus fell into the new web of lies she had woven for herself.
Meanwhile, the evil deity continued to smile.
TChinese:
桃在夢境中建立起了最初到達的村子，捏出那些曾對她笑過的村民。
但是這一切都只會一遍又一遍地毀滅。越是欺騙，就越是快速地倒塌，而不去欺騙他們的結果，亦是一場又一場死亡。桃發覺欺詐的神格本身就是一種詛咒，作為詛咒源頭的她從未知曉一件事真正好的發展是什麼樣子，自然也無法祈願一個好結局。
她選擇離開這個村莊，在空蕩蕩的世界裏漫步，等待一切自然地倒塌。
起初，這場夢中的神明只有一個。不知道第幾次村莊毀滅又重建後，夢中出現了巨大的黑影，那是她的絕望。
那如同黑雲一般遮天蔽日的惡神無比強大，桃被打得節節敗退，不得不拱手讓出大半的領土，退居在最初的小小村莊之中。
奇怪的是，這次的美好反而持續得久了一些。桃本來已經放棄了欺詐的權能，然而她驚訝地意識到，讓人們覺得她虛弱，反而能使得大家勠力同心，共抗惡敵，即使毀滅，也不悔戰鬥的一切。
真實一定就是好事嗎？欺瞞一定不能得到幸福嗎？哪怕心懷不安，桃仍然一步步地，重新走向了欺瞞的道路。
變得弱小吧。變得無害吧。變得無助吧。變得就像自己的信徒那樣，成為一個悲慘的、負隅頑抗的可憐人吧。
桃就這樣墜入了自己給自己編織的新騙局之中。
而惡神始終笑著。

Chinese:
身高：210cm
体重：230kg
特点：十分强大但生性警惕，对人类抱有强烈敌意
English:
Height: 210cm
Weight: 230kg
Trait: Very powerful but cautious by nature, harboring strong hostility toward humans
TChinese:
身高：210cm
體重：230kg
特點：十分強大但生性警惕，對人類抱有強烈敵意

Chinese:
第三纪元早期，旧日的帝国轰然倒塌，大陆上烽烟四起，深渊的力量暗中搅动风雨，在这个黑暗混乱的年代，一切变得百无禁忌。
一位天资卓越的大魔法师为了探寻生命的奥秘，抓捕了众多魔物进行研究，甚至利用魔法与技术疯狂的融合多个物种，最终创造出了咒行鵺这种生物。虽然它们散失了原本的心智，变得与野兽无异，但是力量得到极大的增强并且还兼具优秀的魔法能力。
最终，这批完美的创造物在某天夜里联合起来杀死了它们的创造者，逃离了法师的高塔。
English:
In the tumultuous dawn of the Era of Frost Veil, the ancient empire crumbled. War beacons blazed across the continent as Abyssal powers secretly sowed chaos. In this dark age, all became permissible.
To explore the mysteries of life, a gifted mage captured many monsters for research, and even used magic and technology to frantically merge multiple species, and finally created Anathemie.
TChinese:
第三紀元早期，舊日的帝國轟然倒塌，大陸上烽煙四起，深淵的力量暗中攪動風雨，在這個黑暗混亂的年代，一切變得百無禁忌。
一位天資卓越的大魔法師為了探尋生命的奧秘，抓捕了眾多魔物進行研究，甚至利用魔法與技術瘋狂的融合多個物種，最終創造出了咒行鵺這種生物。雖然它們散失了原本的心智，變得與野獸無異，但是力量得到極大的增強並且還兼具優秀的魔法能力。
最終，這批完美的創造物在某天夜裏聯合起來殺死了它們的創造者，逃離了法師的高塔。

Chinese:
咒行鵺身上具有多种生物的特征，类似于狐狸的耳朵、虎豹的前肢、狼类的大腿，还有身后异化成利爪的羽翼，种种证据都表明它们并非是自然的产物。
它们的听觉特别灵敏，能够清楚的听见千米之外的声响。虽然背后的翅膀异化成了利爪，但在魔法的作用下它们依旧具有飞行能力，其飞行速度甚至比鹰隼还要快。
不论是在魔法还是力量上，咒行鵺都有着强悍的实力，再加上其凶狠的性格。可以说在野外的怪物中，咒行鵺绝对是最为危险的那一档。
English:
Anathemies bear traits of multiple creatures: fox-like ears, leopard-like forelimbs, wolf-like hindlimbs, and wings mutated into claws. All these features point to their unnatural origins.
They have acute hearing that allows them to detect sounds from miles away.
TChinese:
咒行鵺身上具有多種生物的特徵，類似於狐狸的耳朵、虎豹的前肢、狼類的大腿，還有身後異化成利爪的羽翼，種種證據都表明它們並非是自然的產物。
它們的聽覺特別靈敏，能夠清楚的聽見千米之外的聲響。雖然背後的翅膀異化成了利爪，但在魔法的作用下它們依舊具有飛行能力，其飛行速度甚至比鷹隼還要快。
不論是在魔法還是力量上，咒行鵺都有著強悍的實力，再加上其兇狠的性格。可以說在野外的怪物中，咒行鵺絕對是最為危險的那一檔。

Chinese:
身高：视宿主而定
体重：视宿主而定
身高（幼体）：2cm
体重（幼体）：5g
特点：寄生，擅长干扰敌人
能量倾向：混乱
对于被夺心魔寄生的人来说，死亡或许才是最好的结局！
English:
Height: Depends on the host
Weight: Depends on the host
Height (juvenile form): 2cm
Weight (juvenile form): 5g
Trait: Parasitic, good at interfering with enemies.
Energy: Chaos
For those unfortunate souls infested by Mind-flayers, the sweet release of death may be the only mercy left!
TChinese:
身高：視宿主而定
體重：視宿主而定
身高（幼體）：2cm
體重（幼體）：5g
特點：寄生，擅長干擾敵人
能量傾向：混亂
對於被奪心魔寄生的人來說，死亡或許才是最好的結局！

Chinese:
夺心魔原本只是深渊中的一个弱小物种，主要靠寄生在其他大型恶魔身上生存，因为黑暗议会的某次恶魔召唤仪式而被一同召唤到了地表上。
随后黑暗议会的成员们惊喜地发现，这个附属品的意义要远比那头虚空恶魔更重要。在经过一系列的培养与改造之后，这些原本只能苟且偷生的家伙摇身一变成了最臭名昭著的邪恶生物。即便后来黑暗议会被摧毁，但这些恶心的怪物依旧如附骨之蛆般存在于大陆的阴暗角落中。
English:
Mind-flayers, once a feeble species in the Abyss surviving by parasitizing larger demons, were inadvertently summoned to the surface during one of the Dark Parliament's demon-summoning rituals.
To their surprise, the Dark Parliament members soon realized this 'byproduct' held far greater significance than the Void Demon they had intended to summon.
TChinese:
奪心魔原本只是深淵中的一個弱小物種，主要靠寄生在其他大型惡魔身上生存，因為黑暗議會的某次惡魔召喚儀式而被一同召喚到了地表上。
隨後黑暗議會的成員們驚喜地發現，這個附屬品的意義要遠比那頭虛空惡魔更重要。在經過一系列的培養與改造之後，這些原本只能苟且偷生的傢伙搖身一變成了最臭名昭著的邪惡生物。即便後來黑暗議會被摧毀，但這些噁心的怪物依舊如附骨之蛆般存在於大陸的陰暗角落中。

Chinese:
夺心魔从出生之后就会寄生在宿主体内，它们通过吞噬宿主的魔力与精神成长，初时宿主除了偶尔头痛之外不会有任何异常。然而夺心魔在成为完全体后将会从宿主头骨中破体而出，利用触须连接着宿主的大脑，将宿主变成自己的活体傀儡。
虽然宿主生理上尚未死亡，甚至有例子表明某些被寄生者还存有微弱的自我意识，但这种情况下宿主无疑更加悲惨。
English: A Mind-flayer parasitizes a host immediately after birth, growing by devouring the host's magic power and energy. At first, the host experiences nothing more than occasional headaches. However, once the Mind-flayer reaches maturity, it bursts through the host's skull, connecting its tentacles to the host's brain, turning them into its living puppet.
TChinese:
奪心魔從出生之後就會寄生在宿主體內，它們通過吞噬宿主的魔力與精神成長，初時宿主除了偶爾頭痛之外不會有任何異常。然而奪心魔在成為完全體後將會從宿主頭骨中破體而出，利用觸鬚連接著宿主的大腦，將宿主變成自己的活體傀儡。
雖然宿主生理上尚未死亡，甚至有例子表明某些被寄生者還存有微弱的自我意識，但這種情況下宿主無疑更加悲慘。

Chinese:
身高/身长：220cm/460cm
体重：400kg
特点：战斗欲望强烈，杀戮会刺激它们的战意
能量倾向：混乱
深渊刺身上的每一处棱角，尖刺都是为了战斗而生。
English:
Height/Length: 220cm/460cm
Weight: 400kg
Trait: Strong desire for battle, while killing stimulates their fighting spirit.
Energy: Chaos
Every angle and spike on the Abyssal Thorn's body is born for battle.
TChinese:
身高/身長：220cm/460cm
體重：400kg
特點：戰鬥欲望強烈，殺戮會刺激它們的戰意
能量傾向：混亂
深淵刺身上的每一處棱角，尖刺都是為了戰鬥而生。

Chinese:
在深渊创造之初，包含深渊刺在内的虚空恶魔们就已经存在，它们诞生于塑造深渊的黑暗能量中，是地下世界最早的统治者。
然而当堕天使们进入深渊之后，一场关于深渊主宰权的战争就爆发了。这场波及整个深渊的战争以一场旷世大战而终结，堕天使们取得了最后的胜利。
失去了领导者之后，大多数力量强悍但智力低下的虚空恶魔更加无法与外来者抗衡，最终剩余的虚空恶魔大多都被驱赶到了结晶海附近生存。
English:
When the Abyss was formed, Void Demons like the Abyssal Thorn already existed. Born from the dark energies that shaped the Abyss, they were the primordial rulers of the underworld.
However, when the fallen angels descended into the Abyss, a war for supremacy erupted. This all-encompassing war culminated in a cataclysmic battle, with the fallen angels emerging victorious.
TChinese:
在深淵創造之初，包含深淵刺在內的虛空惡魔們就已經存在，它們誕生於塑造深淵的黑暗能量中，是地下世界最早的統治者。
然而當墮天使們進入深淵之後，一場關於深淵主宰權的戰爭就爆發了。這場波及整個深淵的戰爭以一場曠世大戰而終結，墮天使們取得了最後的勝利。
失去了領導者之後，大多數力量強悍但智力低下的虛空惡魔更加無法與外來者抗衡，最終剩餘的虛空惡魔大多都被驅趕到了結晶海附近生存。

Chinese:
即便不知道深渊刺的人在第一眼看见它时都会明白眼前的这个浑身长满尖刺的生物的危险。除了手上两柄尖锐的短枪之外，深渊刺身上的每一部分都可以成为它们的武器，必要时它们甚至可以将整个身体变成一柄利刃刺向敌人。
而最适合深渊刺的舞台，无疑是在战场上，作为纯粹为战斗而生的恶魔，深渊刺在战争的人潮中将会彻底化身杀戮利器，无情的收割掉战场上所有敢阻拦它的人，直到面前再无活物。
English: Even without knowing much, anyone will recognize the danger of this thorny thing at the first sight of an Abyssal Thorn. Aside from the sharp spears it wields, every part of its body can serve as a weapon. In dire situations, the Abyssal Thorn can even turn its entire body into a blade to impale its enemies.
TChinese:
即便不知道深淵刺的人在第一眼看見它時都會明白眼前的這個渾身長滿尖刺的生物的危險。除了手上兩柄尖銳的短槍之外，深淵刺身上的每一部分都可以成為它們的武器，必要時它們甚至可以將整個身體變成一柄利刃刺向敵人。
而最適合深淵刺的舞臺，無疑是在戰場上，作為純粹為戰鬥而生的惡魔，深淵刺在戰爭的人潮中將會徹底化身殺戮利器，無情的收割掉戰場上所有敢阻攔它的人，直到面前再無活物。

Chinese:
身高：185cm
体重：0.3kg
特点：掌握着特殊的守护之力
能量倾向：混乱
在落日森林的旧址中，徘徊着这样一群生物，它们圣洁的模样常常让无知的路人误以为它们就是传说中的天使。
English:
Height: 185cm
Weight: 0.3kg
Trait: Possesses a special protective power.
Energy: Chaos
In the ruins of the Sunset Woods, these beings roam. Their divine visage often beguiles the unwary, leading them to mistake these entities for the fabled angels of lore.
TChinese:
身高：185cm
體重：0.3kg
特點：掌握著特殊的守護之力
能量傾向：混亂
在落日森林的舊址中，徘徊著這樣一群生物，它們聖潔的模樣常常讓無知的路人誤以為它們就是傳說中的天使。

Chinese:
传说在落日之战后的审判中，整片天空都燃烧着血红的火焰，大地被神力撕开一道巨大的裂口，来自深渊黑暗气息在其中弥漫，背叛神灵的天使们纷纷从高空坠下，圣洁的羽毛一时间如雪花般飘落。
而一群原本生活在落日森林中的普通生灵，因此被天使羽毛上圣洁的神力与来自深渊的黑暗力量共同塑造成了奇特的模样。
虽然传说未必全然可信，不过在这次事件之后，落日森林的中就出现了一种既具有天使般圣洁又有着恶魔般邪异的生物。
English: Legends tell of the judgment after the Dusk War: the sky blazed with blood-red flames, divine power rent the earth asunder, Abyssal miasma seeped through the cracks, and the traitorous angels plummeted from the heavens, their holy feathers drifting down like snowflakes.
TChinese:
傳說在落日之戰後的審判中，整片天空都燃燒著血紅的火焰，大地被神力撕開一道巨大的裂口，來自深淵黑暗氣息在其中彌漫，背叛神靈的天使們紛紛從高空墜下，聖潔的羽毛一時間如雪花般飄落。
而一群原本生活在落日森林中的普通生靈，因此被天使羽毛上聖潔的神力與來自深淵的黑暗力量共同塑造成了奇特的模樣。
雖然傳說未必全然可信，不過在這次事件之後，落日森林的中就出現了一種既具有天使般聖潔又有著惡魔般邪異的生物。

Chinese:
虽然炽炎翼存在族群，不过多数时候她们还是会独自在森林中游荡。通常情况下她们都较为平和，这只是因为她们很少会对外在的事物感兴趣。可以肯定的是炽炎翼具备相当程度的智慧，然而却没有人能够和她们进行交流。
对于闯入领地的外来者，炽炎翼也很少进行驱赶，但是绝对不要因此而肆意妄为，否则炽炎翼们会让那些胆敢破坏她们居所的家伙见识到真正恐怖的力量。
English: While Fiery Wings exist in groups, they are often found wandering alone through forests. They are generally peaceful, mainly because external affairs don't interest them much. Fiery Wings have reached a certain intelligence level, but no one has been able to communicate with them.
TChinese:
雖然熾炎翼存在族群，不過多數時候她們還是會獨自在森林中游蕩。通常情況下她們都較為平和，這只是因為她們很少會對外在的事物感興趣。可以肯定的是熾炎翼具備相當程度的智慧，然而卻沒有人能夠和她們進行交流。
對於闖入領地的外來者，熾炎翼也很少進行驅趕，但是絕對不要因此而肆意妄為，否則熾炎翼們會讓那些膽敢破壞她們居所的傢伙見識到真正恐怖的力量。

Chinese:
身高：170cm
体重：5kg
特点：会庇佑弱小的同类
能量倾向：混乱
虽然她们被混乱能量侵蚀，但是对于身边的小妖精，宁芙妖们还是一如既往的庇护着它们。
English:
Height: 170cm
Weight: 5kg
Trait: Protects weaker members of their kind.
Energy: Chaos
Despite the taint of Havoc Energy coursing through their essence, the Nymphs maintain an unwavering vigil over their diminutive fairy companions.
TChinese:
身高：170cm
體重：5kg
特點：會庇佑弱小的同類
能量傾向：混亂
雖然她們被混亂能量侵蝕，但是對於身邊的小妖精，寧芙妖們還是一如既往的庇護著它們。

Chinese:
在米伦大地上的诸多精怪之中，妖精是最广为人知的一类，其中宁芙妖精又因为在妖精中特殊的巨大体型而被人们所熟知。它们一般都生活在森林、湖泊等野外，生性天真烂漫爱好和平。
但是因为混乱潮汐的爆发，有些宁芙妖精感染了混乱力量而异化，变得富有攻击性，人们也称呼改称这些宁芙妖精为宁芙妖。虽然它们外表看上去弱不禁风，但是每只宁芙妖精都极具魔法天赋。
English: Among Mirren's myriad magical beings, fairies are the most renowned. The Nymphs, known for their unusually large size, stand out even among their fairy kin. They typically inhabit wild places like forests and lakes, possessing an inherently innocent and peace-loving nature.
TChinese:
在米倫大地上的諸多精怪之中，妖精是最廣為人知的一類，其中寧芙妖精又因為在妖精中特殊的巨大體型而被人們所熟知。它們一般都生活在森林、湖泊等野外，生性天真爛漫愛好和平。
但是因為混亂潮汐的爆發，有些寧芙妖精感染了混亂力量而異化，變得富有攻擊性，人們也稱呼改稱這些寧芙妖精為寧芙妖。雖然它們外表看上去弱不禁風，但是每只寧芙妖精都極具魔法天賦。

Chinese:
宁芙妖精在众多妖精中属于特殊的存在，它们虽然的群居，但却不是和同类宁芙妖精，而是和其他的小型妖精一起。每一只宁芙妖精身边通常都会生活着数量众多小型妖精，小家伙们侍奉它，而它则利用自身的力量为小型妖精提供庇护，毕竟森林中并不十分安全。
谁也不知道这种共生关系是怎么形成的，但毫无疑问，这是一个对双方都有利的局面。只有在繁殖的年份，宁芙妖精才会离开聚落寻找自己的同类，之后又会重新回到小型妖精身边。
English: Nymphs are a special goblin species. Though they are social, they do not live with their fellow Nymphs but instead with smaller goblins. Each Nymph is typically surrounded by many small goblins who serve them. Nymph offers them protection in return, as the forest is far from safe.
TChinese:
寧芙妖精在眾多妖精中屬於特殊的存在，它們雖然的群居，但卻不是和同類寧芙妖精，而是和其他的小型妖精一起。每一只寧芙妖精身邊通常都會生活著數量眾多小型妖精，小傢伙們侍奉它，而它則利用自身的力量為小型妖精提供庇護，畢竟森林中並不十分安全。
誰也不知道這種共生關係是怎麼形成的，但毫無疑問，這是一個對雙方都有利的局面。只有在繁殖的年份，寧芙妖精才會離開聚落尋找自己的同類，之後又會重新回到小型妖精身邊。

Chinese:
身高/身长：185cm/160cm
体重：200kg
特点：鲜血与死亡会加剧它们狂暴
能量倾向：混乱
当混乱的能量侵蚀意识，撕裂躯体时，支撑噬命刃坚持下来的唯一原因就是对力量无限渴望。
English:
Height/Length: 185cm/160cm
Weight: 200kg
Trait: Blood and death intensify their frenzy.
Energy: Chaos
When Havoc Energy erodes consciousness and tears apart the body, the only reason supporting the Death Blade to persist is the endless desire for power.
TChinese:
身高/身長：185cm/160cm
體重：200kg
特點：鮮血與死亡會加劇它們狂暴
能量傾向：混亂
當混亂的能量侵蝕意識，撕裂軀體時，支撐噬命刃堅持下來的唯一原因就是對力量無限渴望。

Chinese:
在深渊古老的法则中，弱肉强食是亘古不变的真理，在这里，力量就是一切。所以为了变得更加强大，当混乱能量出现时，深渊中总不乏选择铤而走险的疯狂之辈。
虽然其中大多数都被混乱的力量扭曲成了不可名状的恐怖怪物，但也有一小部分幸运儿获得它们梦寐以求的力量，噬命刃便是其中之一。如今被混乱能量改造后的他们已经从当初的弱小的低级恶魔摇身一变成了能在深渊占据一席之地的存在。
English:
In the Abyss's primordial laws, survival of the fittest reigns supreme. Here, power is everything. In the Abyss, the allure of power breeds recklessness. When Havoc Energy emerges, there's no shortage of fools willing to gamble their very existence.
While most succumb to the chaos, twisting into unspeakable horrors, a fortunate few emerge with the power they crave. The Death Blade stands among these rare victors.
TChinese:
在深淵古老的法則中，弱肉強食是亙古不變的真理，在這裏，力量就是一切。所以為了變得更加強大，當混亂能量出現時，深淵中總不乏選擇鋌而走險的瘋狂之輩。
雖然其中大多數都被混亂的力量扭曲成了不可名狀的恐怖怪物，但也有一小部分幸運兒獲得它們夢寐以求的力量，噬命刃便是其中之一。如今被混亂能量改造後的他們已經從當初的弱小的低級惡魔搖身一變成了能在深淵佔據一席之地的存在。

Chinese:
噬命刃是一种领地意识极强的生物，他们如同君王一般，每日都会在自己的领地内巡视，攻击任何胆敢擅自闯入他们领地的生物，直到对方逃离出自己的领地或者倒在自己的巨刃之下方才罢休。
而若是两个噬命刃相遇，他们大概率会立刻先打一架，直到一方臣服或者死亡，确认胜利者的地位之后，这场战斗才会停止，所以除非面对圣殿围剿，几乎很少会看两个或以上的噬命刃同时出现的情况。
English:
Death Blades are highly territorial. They patrol their domains daily, attacking any trespasser until the latter flees out of their domain or falls with wounds from their massive blades.
When two Death Blades meet, they are likely to fight immediately until one submits or dies. That is why two or more Death Blades are rarely seen together unless facing a Sanctuary siege.
TChinese:
噬命刃是一種領地意識極強的生物，他們如同君王一般，每日都會在自己的領地內巡視，攻擊任何膽敢擅自闖入他們領地的生物，直到對方逃離出自己的領地或者倒在自己的巨刃之下方才甘休。
而若是兩個噬命刃相遇，他們大概率會立刻先打一架，直到一方臣服或者死亡，確認勝利者的地位之後，這場戰鬥才會停止，所以除非面對聖殿圍剿，幾乎很少會看兩個或以上的噬命刃同時出現的情況。

Chinese:
身高：180cm
体重：70kg
特点：对于痛苦有着近乎癫狂的渴望
能量倾向：混乱
‘唯有血水与泪水，才能证明信仰的虔诚。’
English:
Height: 180cm
Weight: 70kg
Trait: Has an almost manic desire for pain.
Energy: Chaos
'True devotion is etched in blood and written in tears. '
TChinese:
身高：180cm
體重：70kg
特點：對於痛苦有著近乎癲狂的渴望
能量傾向：混亂
‘唯有血水與淚水，才能證明信仰的虔誠。’

Chinese:
在圣龙战争后期，龙族的谜团被揭开，旧神的信仰崩塌，人们无法接受他们虔诚信奉的神灵竟然背弃了他们——如果神灵不正确，那么祂便不是真正的神。
随着旧教会的覆灭，大陆上一时间出现了数量众多五花八门的新生教派，人们企图为信仰找到真正的归宿，影巫女便是诞生于这一时期。
即便后来主神净化原罪，这些人也没有放弃崇拜异端邪神，虽然圣殿曾进行过数次清缴，不过却仍旧能在游民之中发现她们身影。
English:
