English: Yes, you.
TChinese: 嗯，你——

Chinese: 一周前，在陆陆续续听闻了好些人足足小半个月的“伊卡洛斯是不是怪怪的”的反应后，我留了点心思，撞着时间在图书室里找到了她。
English: *A week ago, after hearing bits and pieces for over two weeks like "Icaruth seems off lately", I found her in the library.*
TChinese: 一周前，在陸陸續續聽聞了好些人足足小半個月的“伊卡洛斯是不是怪怪的”的反應後，我留了點心思，撞著時間在圖書室裏找到了她。

Chinese: ——讲道理，“图书室”和“伊卡洛斯”……这个地点和人物的组合本身就不太寻常了吧。
English: *Honestly, "library" and "Icaruth" aren't exactly a common pairing.*
TChinese: ——講道理，“圖書室”和“伊卡洛斯”……這個地點和人物的組合本身就不太尋常了吧。

Chinese: 你怎么了？心情不好？
English: What's wrong? Are you feeling down?
TChinese: 你怎麼了？心情不好？

Chinese: 哈……真的假的，我表现得这么明显啊？
English: Huh... is it that obvious?
TChinese: 哈……真的假的，我表現得這麼明顯啊？

Chinese: 这是当然的吧。
English: Yes, it is.
TChinese: 這是當然的吧。

Chinese: 我抽走被她当成枕头的书，有点无可奈何地叹了口气。
English: *I pulled away the books she was using as a pillow and sighed helplessly.*
TChinese: 我抽走被她當成枕頭的書，有點無可奈何地歎了口氣。

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯——饶是神谕司星痕人数众多，与我而言，她也是属于老交情的那几个之一……
English: *Among all the Oracle Division Asters, Icaruth is one of the few I've known the longest...*
TChinese: 伊卡洛斯——饒是神諭司星痕人數眾多，與我而言，她也是屬於老交情的那幾個之一……

Chinese: 唔，也是“最不守纪律”、“最需要重点关注”的人员之一。
English: *And also one of the "least disciplined" and "most in need of special attention".*
TChinese: 唔，也是“最不守紀律”、“最需要重點關注”的人員之一。

Chinese: 我自认为对你还是有几分了解的……来吧，不兜圈子，直说如何？
English: I like to think I know you quite well...so come on, just tell me what's going on.
TChinese: 我自認為對你還是有幾分瞭解的……來吧，不兜圈子，直說如何？

Chinese: 哎……行。
English: Sigh... fine.
TChinese: 哎……行。

Chinese: 她由着我动作，眼神和肢体都懒洋洋地，看着我把她那边折腾过的书一本一本收走，支着胳膊从卧到倚。
English: *She lazily watched me and leaned back in the chair as I took away the books she'd messed up one by one.*
TChinese: 她由著我動作，眼神和肢體都懶洋洋地，看著我把她那邊折騰過的書一本一本收走，支著胳膊從臥到倚。

Chinese: 我……无聊啊。
English: Well... I'm bored.
TChinese: 我……無聊啊。

Chinese: 无聊？
English: Bored?
TChinese: 無聊？

Chinese: 是啊。
English: Yes.
TChinese: 是啊。

Chinese: 她的嗓音沙沙的，听起来真有点儿区别于以往。
English: *Her voice was raspy, sounding different from usual.*
TChinese: 她的嗓音沙沙的，聽起來真有點兒區別於以往。

Chinese: “一个人一辈子能握紧的东西很少，所以有想做的就立刻去做吧”——这句话侍主肯定还记得吧？我可是说过好多回的。
English: "There are few things in life one can truly hold onto, so if there's something you want to do, do it now." You remember this, right? I've said it plenty of times.
TChinese: “一個人一輩子能握緊的東西很少，所以有想做的就立刻去做吧”——這句話侍主肯定還記得吧？我可是說過好多回的。

Chinese: 但是最近啊——啧，侍主，虽然我知道无事就是绝顶的好事，但无聊到全身没力气，连喝酒都提不起兴趣了，听着就可怕，没错吧？
English: But lately... While I get that peace is a blessing, it's so dull it drains me and even drinking loses its appeal—it sounds scary, doesn't it?
TChinese: 但是最近啊——嘖，侍主，雖然我知道無事就是絕頂的好事，但無聊到全身沒力氣，連喝酒都提不起興趣了，聽著就可怕，沒錯吧？

Chinese: 所以你才到处乱转啊。
English: So you've been wandering around.
TChinese: 所以你才到處亂轉啊。

Chinese: 我哑然失笑。
English: *I can't help but chuckle.*
TChinese: 我啞然失笑。

Chinese: 那转出什么结论没有？
English: Did you figure anything out?
TChinese: 那轉出什麼結論沒有？

Chinese: 没有。完全没有。
English: No. Absolutely not.
TChinese: 沒有。完全沒有。

Chinese: 她翻了个身，半边脸都埋进手臂里。
English: *She flips over, half her face buried in her arm.*
TChinese: 她翻了個身，半邊臉都埋進手臂裏。

Chinese: 米德加尔太平静了……侍主唷，给我找点事情做吧，什么都行啊。
English: Midgard is too quiet... Lord Oracle, just find me something to do, anything.
TChinese: 米德加爾太平靜了……侍主唷，給我找點事情做吧，什麼都行啊。

Chinese: 当然，最好是来点让人心潮澎湃的大冒险——就像侍主平时会做的那些。
English: Something thrilling would be best—just like the things you usually do.
TChinese: 當然，最好是來點讓人心潮澎湃的大冒險——就像侍主平時會做的那些。

Chinese: 哪有这种东西。
English: There's no such thing.
TChinese: 哪有這種東西。

Chinese: 我摇头，将伊卡洛斯手里晃来晃去的最后一本书拿走。她还是没个正行，坐不是坐，躺不是躺的，一脸百无聊赖，但坚持把腿横在我面前。
English: *I shook my head and took the last book she was idly waving around. Still as careless as ever, she sprawled lazily, one leg deliberately blocking my way.*
TChinese: 我搖頭，將伊卡洛斯手裏晃來晃去的最後一本書拿走。她還是沒個正行，坐不是坐，躺不是躺的，一臉百無聊賴，但堅持把腿橫在我面前。

Chinese: 可以可以，我退一步，心情激荡的小冒险也可以。
English: Alright, fine, I'll settle for something mildly exciting.
TChinese: 可以可以，我退一步，心情激蕩的小冒險也可以。

Chinese: 总之给我来点和现在不一样的——侍主大人也不想看我为了摆脱无聊对你做出别的事情吧？
English: Just change from now. Lord Oracle, you don't want me to do anything to you out of boredom, right?
TChinese: 總之給我來點和現在不一樣的——侍主大人也不想看我為了擺脫無聊對你做出別的事情吧？

Chinese: 无赖啊。
English: Are you threatening me?
TChinese: 無賴啊。

Chinese: 没错，我就是这样的存在唷。
English: Yep, that's exactly what I'm doing.
TChinese: 沒錯，我就是這樣的存在唷。

Chinese: 没办法了……
English: *There doesn't seem to be any choice...*
TChinese: 沒辦法了……

Chinese: 你想做什么别的事？
English: So, what do you want to do?
TChinese: 你想做什麼別的事？

Chinese: 出海！
English: Go out to sea!
TChinese: 出海！

Chinese: 她立刻抛出这两个音节，掷地有声。
English: *She blurts out the answer, resolute and clear.*
TChinese: 她立刻拋出這兩個音節，擲地有聲。

Chinese: 侍主，你是有船的，这个骗不过我哦？
English: Lord Oracle, I know you have a ship. Don't lie to me.
TChinese: 侍主，你是有船的，這個騙不過我哦？

Chinese: 既然有船，那就跟我出海去吧！
English: Take me out to sea with your ship!
TChinese: 既然有船，那就跟我出海去吧！

Chinese: 不用担心别的，我可是大名鼎鼎的神眷者伊卡洛斯！让我当船长，那么危险也好惊慌也罢，不管是什么样的厄运都会被海水带走。
English: Don't worry about safety. I'm Icaruth, the Favored One! With me as captain, all danger and misfortune will be swept away by the waves.
TChinese: 不用擔心別的，我可是大名鼎鼎的神眷者伊卡洛斯！讓我當船長，那麼危險也好驚慌也罷，不管是什麼樣的厄運都會被海水帶走。

Chinese: 留下的只会是惊心动魄——以至于余生都无法忘怀的航行回忆。
English: What's left will only be the thrills. It will be a voyage you can never forget.
TChinese: 留下的只會是驚心動魄——以至於餘生都無法忘懷的航行回憶。

Chinese: 怎么样，很不错吧，侍主大人？
English: How about it, Lord Oracle?
TChinese: 怎麼樣，很不錯吧，侍主大人？

Chinese: 噢，原来是在这等着我呢。
English: *Oh, so that's what she's aiming for.*
TChinese: 噢，原來是在這等著我呢。

Chinese: 不过，既然是她想要这样，那也没什么不能配合的。
English: *If that's what she wants, there is no reason not to go along.*
TChinese: 不過，既然是她想要這樣，那也沒什麼不能配合的。

Chinese: 好啊，那就这样决定了。
English: Alright, it's decided then.
TChinese: 好啊，那就這樣決定了。

Chinese: none
English: None
TChinese: none

Chinese: 就这样，和伊卡洛斯说定之后，没过两天，我们就登船前往目的地——那片曾让伊卡洛斯也留下惊心动魄回忆的海域。
English: *A few days later, Icaruth and I boarded the ship and headed toward our destination—the sea region that had once left Icaruth with thrilling memories.*
TChinese: 就這樣，和伊卡洛斯說定之後，沒過兩天，我們就登船前往目的地——那片曾讓伊卡洛斯也留下驚心動魄回憶的海域。

Chinese: 只不过在顺利到达后，我与伊卡洛斯都有些怔忡。
English: *However, upon our smooth arrival, both Icaruth and I were stupefied.*
TChinese: 只不過在順利到達後，我與伊卡洛斯都有些怔忡。

Chinese: none
English: None
TChinese: none

Chinese: 就像看到的这样，海面的广阔与深蓝一如既往，
English: *The sea remained vast and blue as always.*
TChinese: 就像看到的這樣，海面的廣闊與深藍一如既往，

Chinese: 而那些让伊卡洛斯在来路上兴致勃勃回忆的风浪与海兽毫无踪影，连风与云都在千年的变化中改变了性格。
English: *But no sign of the waves or sea beasts that Icaruth had excitedly talked about along the way. Even the wind and clouds had changed over the centuries.*
TChinese: 而那些讓伊卡洛斯在來路上興致勃勃回憶的風浪與海獸毫無蹤影，連風與雲都在千年的變化中改變了性格。

Chinese: 没有咆哮，不再愤怒，海浪推搡出的声音像是温和的摇篮曲。
English: *No more roars, no more rage. The waves sounded as gentle as a lullaby.*
TChinese: 沒有咆哮，不再憤怒，海浪推搡出的聲音像是溫和的搖籃曲。

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯反复对比了几次地图，确定无误后，还是不死心地开着船绕了好大一圈，试图找寻记忆中的景象——但很显然，我们无功而返。
English: *Icaruth checked the map repeatedly but found no mistakes. Still, she stubbornly circled around to search for the sights in her memory—only to get disappointed.*
TChinese: 伊卡洛斯反復對比了幾次地圖，確定無誤後，還是不死心地開著船繞了好大一圈，試圖找尋記憶中的景象——但很顯然，我們無功而返。

Chinese: 而刚刚那段海钓……就是在这个前提下的打发时间行为了。
English: *That's how we end up here fishing to pass the time.*
TChinese: 而剛剛那段海釣……就是在這個前提下的打發時間行為了。

English: Hoo...

Chinese: 甩开鱼竿，伊卡洛斯站起身来，颇有些自暴自弃意味地踢开了椅子，大咧咧地往甲板上一躺，不动作了。
English: *Throwing aside the fishing rod, Icaruth stands up, kicks her chair away in frustration, and sprawls on the deck with an air of surrender.*
TChinese: 甩開魚竿，伊卡洛斯站起身來，頗有些自暴自棄意味地踢開了椅子，大咧咧地往甲板上一躺，不動作了。

Chinese: 唉……真是的。只不过隔了段时间没来，这儿的变化竟然这么大啊。
English: How disappointing... It's only been a while since I last came, yet the changes here are so drastic.
TChinese: 唉……真是的。只不過隔了段時間沒來，這兒的變化竟然這麼大啊。

Chinese: 以前这个地方可不是现在这样。那时候的人们，谁不是在听到这儿的名字之后就大变脸色？
English: This place wasn't like this before. Back then, anyone would pale upon hearing this place's name.
TChinese: 以前這個地方可不是現在這樣。那時候的人們，誰不是在聽到這兒的名字之後就大變臉色？

Chinese: 狂风与大雨——哈，家常便饭罢了！哪会像现在这样？
English: Storms and torrential rain were just everyday occurrences! How did it become like this?
TChinese: 狂風與大雨——哈，家常便飯罷了！哪會像現在這樣？

Chinese: 我们都已经空了这么多杆，等了这么久，结果天气一点都没变化！没意思。
English: We've been fishing with no catch for so long, but there's still no weather change! It's boring.
TChinese: 我們都已經空了這麼多杆，等了這麼久，結果天氣一點都沒變化！沒意思。

Chinese: 一边说一边捶了几下甲板……看得出来她是真的在失望了。
English: *She pounds the deck a few times... obviously very disappointed.*
TChinese: 一邊說一邊捶了幾下甲板……看得出來她是真的在失望了。

Chinese: 想想办法。
English: Figure something out.
TChinese: 想想辦法。

Chinese: 好了好了，别重复空杆了。空杆说不定是没什么好办法，但天气还是可以的。
English: Fine, fine, no more fishing. There may be no way to fix the no catch, but we can do something about the weather.
TChinese: 好了好了，別重複空杆了。空杆說不定是沒什麼好辦法，但天氣還是可以的。

Chinese: 喔？！侍主，你想到了什么？
English: Oh?! Lord Oracle, what have you come up with?
TChinese: 喔？！侍主，你想到了什麼？

Chinese: 这还能想到什么？你不是在怀念狂风暴雨吗？
English: What else could it be? Aren't you nostalgic for storms and raging waves?
TChinese: 這還能想到什麼？你不是在懷念狂風暴雨嗎？

Chinese: 我抬眼看了看天。
English: *I glance at the sky.*
TChinese: 我抬眼看了看天。

Chinese: 也还算幸运吧，伊卡洛斯，你看，天边的云——
English: Well, we're not entirely unlucky, Icaruth. Look at the clouds at the horizon—
TChinese: 也還算幸運吧，伊卡洛斯，你看，天邊的雲——

Chinese: 你要是真的这么想重温穿云破浪时，那现在就是机会了。
English: If you truly want to relive breaking through storms, now's your chance.
TChinese: 你要是真的這麼想重溫穿雲破浪時，那現在就是機會了。

Chinese: 好啊！真不愧是侍主！
English: Yes! You are a genius!
TChinese: 好啊！真不愧是侍主！

Chinese: 一拍即合。
English: *We agree in an instant.*
TChinese: 一拍即合。

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯一扫方才的神情，立刻生龙活虎了起来。
English: *The listless Icaruth instantly becomes exciting.*
TChinese: 伊卡洛斯一掃方才的神情，立刻生龍活虎了起來。

Chinese: 我盘算了一下，才招了招手示意她靠近，她便心领神会，大跨步地走了过来，然后……单手拦腰把我抱了起来。
English: *I think for a moment, then wave her over. She strides up to me, and then... lifts me by the waist with one arm.*
TChinese: 我盤算了一下，才招了招手示意她靠近，她便心領神會，大跨步地走了過來，然後……單手攔腰把我抱了起來。

Chinese: 哈哈哈哈，侍主，你真是给了一个好点子啊！那就不用你动手了！让我来吧！我已经准备好迎接风浪了！
English: Hahaha, you came up with a great idea! You don't need to do anything! I'll take over! I'm already prepared to face the storm!
TChinese: 哈哈哈哈，侍主，你真是給了一個好點子啊！那就不用你動手了！讓我來吧！我已經準備好迎接風浪了！

Chinese: 嗯？这么看我干嘛？这只手不舒服吗？那我换一只。
English: Hmm? Why are you looking at me like that? Does this arm feel uncomfortable? I'll switch arms then.
TChinese: 嗯？這麼看我幹嘛？這只手不舒服嗎？那我換一只。

Chinese: …………是左右手的问题吗？
English: *Is it an issue of which arm?*
TChinese: …………是左右手的問題嗎？

Chinese: 总之，风浪在即，侍主不能离开我，完全没问题啊！
English: Anyway, with the storm coming, you're not leaving my side. There's no issue at all!
TChinese: 總之，風浪在即，侍主不能離開我，完全沒問題啊！

Chinese: 她的热情完全被点燃了，那股昂扬的情绪简直可以直接透过皮肤的相贴传达给我。我心下好趣，脸上也不由得跟着露出了笑。
English: *Her enthusiasm is so high that it radiates through our skin contact. I feel amused, a smile spreading across my face.*
TChinese: 她的熱情完全被點燃了，那股昂揚的情緒簡直可以直接透過皮膚的相貼傳達給我。我心下好趣，臉上也不由得跟著露出了笑。

Chinese: 算了，算了。
English: *Forget it, forget it.*
TChinese: 算了，算了。

Chinese: ……嗯，那你注意脚下。
English: Mm, just watch your step.
TChinese: ……嗯，那你注意腳下。

Chinese: 哈哈哈哈——来吧！
English: Hahaha— Let's go!
TChinese: 哈哈哈哈——來吧！

Chinese: 她抬手，调起驱动海水与云层的力量——平稳的海面立刻有了波纹，天边的舒展的云层也开始翻涌，海上的这块区域立刻阴沉了下来。
English: *She raises her hand, summoning her power to drive the water and clouds. The sea starts to ripple, the clouds begin to churn, and the whole area darkens.*
TChinese: 她抬手，調起驅動海水與雲層的力量——平穩的海面立刻有了波紋，天邊的舒展的雲層也開始翻湧，海上的這塊區域立刻陰沉了下來。

Chinese: 哈哈哈！好！就是这个味道——该干活了，风精们！
English: Hahaha! Sure! This is the feeling! Let's get to work, Sylphs!
TChinese: 哈哈哈！好！就是這個味道——該幹活了，風精們！

Chinese: 听从我的号令！全速前进！就让侍主见识一下——航行大海的我们所面对的是怎样的事物！
English: Follow my command! Full speed ahead! Let's show Lord Oracle the kinds of things we face when sailing the seas!
TChinese: 聽從我的號令！全速前進！就讓侍主見識一下——航行大海的我們所面對的是怎樣的事物！

Chinese: 乘风——！
English: Ride the wind—!
TChinese: 乘風——！

Chinese: 巨大的浪头应声而来，狂猎的风卷起海水与雨水冲刷着甲板，整艘船都在风暴中嗡鸣起来。
English: *Giant waves respond in kind, fierce winds lifting seawater and rain to batter the deck. The entire ship hums under the onslaught of the storm.*
TChinese: 巨大的浪頭應聲而來，狂獵的風卷起海水與雨水沖刷著甲板，整艘船都在風暴中嗡鳴起來。

Chinese: 而伊卡洛斯始终神情高昂，她稳稳扶着船舷，简直没有受到丝毫影响。
English: *Yet Icaruth remains as spirited as ever, firmly gripping the rail.*
TChinese: 而伊卡洛斯始終神情高昂，她穩穩扶著船舷，簡直沒有受到絲毫影響。

Chinese: 更甚至——在船头几乎笔直迎上浪头的瞬间，伊卡洛斯的声音破开嘈杂，带着惊人的热度，要在这番情景之上再添一场。
English: *Even more so—as the ship nearly collides head-on with a wave crest, Icaruth's voice breaks through the noise once again.*
TChinese: 更甚至——在船頭幾乎筆直迎上浪頭的瞬間，伊卡洛斯的聲音破開嘈雜，帶著驚人的熱度，要在這番情景之上再添一場。

Chinese: 抱紧我啊，侍主大人唷！
English: Hold on tight to me, Lord Oracle!
TChinese: 抱緊我啊，侍主大人唷！

Chinese: 等等，你这是要飞——
English: Wait, are you planning to fly—
TChinese: 等等，你這是要飛——

Chinese: ——破云！
English: —Break through the clouds!
TChinese: ——破雲！

Chinese: none
English: None
TChinese: none

Chinese: 还真是……破云。
English: *We did...break through the clouds.*
TChinese: 還真是……破雲。

Chinese: 呼啊——
English: Hah—
TChinese: 呼啊——

Chinese: 以浪尖为梯，伊卡洛斯兴致勃勃地带着我，破开了风暴与雨幕，一步跨到了蓝天之上。
English: *Using a wave as a ladder, Icaruth enthusiastically carries me through the storm and rain and into the blue sky.*
TChinese: 以浪尖為梯，伊卡洛斯興致勃勃地帶著我，破開了風暴與雨幕，一步跨到了藍天之上。

Chinese: 适才包裹着我们的风在她的操纵下，此刻又摇身化作了翅膀，带着我们从天上往下滑翔。
English: *The winds that once wrapped around us now, under her control, transform into wings, carrying us as we glide down from above.*
TChinese: 适才包裹著我們的風在她的操縱下，此刻又搖身化作了翅膀，帶著我們從天上往下滑翔。

Chinese: 区域里的风暴来去都快，我顶着旺盛的天光往下看，在那艘还没有停下摇晃的船只后方看到了远去的浪头。
English: *The storms come and go quickly. I look down against the radiant sunlight and at the receding waves behind the still-swaying ship.*
TChinese: 區域裏的風暴來去都快，我頂著旺盛的天光往下看，在那艘還沒有停下搖晃的船隻後方看到了遠去的浪頭。

Chinese: 侍主在看什么呢？
English: What are you looking at?
TChinese: 侍主在看什麼呢？

Chinese: 我们还在滑翔，伊卡洛斯也眯着眼睛找船，应该是见我盯着那个方向，她的脸挤过来，故意撞了我一下。
English: *As we continue to glide, Icaruth also squints at the ship, noticing me staring in that direction. She leans over, purposely bumping me.*
TChinese: 我們還在滑翔，伊卡洛斯也眯著眼睛找船，應該是見我盯著那個方向，她的臉擠過來，故意撞了我一下。

Chinese: 啊，船在那啊。
English: Huh, the ship is over there.
TChinese: 啊，船在那啊。

Chinese: 什么嘛，怎么还是侍主大人先找到？
English: How come it's you who spot it first again?
TChinese: 什麼嘛，怎麼還是侍主大人先找到？

Chinese: 我们没有在比赛什么吧。
English: This isn't a competition, is it?
TChinese: 我們沒有在比賽什麼吧。

Chinese: 在空中也做不出别的动作，我就势撞了回去。
English: *Unable to do much mid-air, I bump her back.*
TChinese: 在空中也做不出別的動作，我就勢撞了回去。

Chinese: 开心一些了吗？
English: Feeling happier now?
TChinese: 開心一些了嗎？

Chinese: 开心一些了！
English: Much happier!
TChinese: 開心一些了！

Chinese: 她立刻这样说道。深色的皮肤在光与水的照射下泛出生命力勃勃的光。
English: *She answers immediately. Her dark skin glistens with vitality under the interplay of light and water.*
TChinese: 她立刻這樣說道。深色的皮膚在光與水的照射下泛出生命力勃勃的光。

Chinese: 虽然只有一瞬间，但开心可是不论时间长短的。
English: Even though it's only for a moment, happiness isn't defined by its duration.
TChinese: 雖然只有一瞬間，但開心可是不論時間長短的。

Chinese: 真是久违了啊……这种面对风暴的感觉，这种风暴过后的空气味道……
English: I miss this... the thrill of facing a storm, the scent of the air after it passes...
TChinese: 真是久違了啊……這種面對風暴的感覺，這種風暴過後的空氣味道……

Chinese: 真是好久好久之前的记忆了啊。
English: It's been so long since I last did this.
TChinese: 真是好久好久之前的記憶了啊。

Chinese: 刚刚开船到这边来却看到一点波澜都没有的时候，还以为会白跑一趟——哈哈哈，果然还是侍主大人有主意！
English: When we first got here and saw the utterly calm sea, I thought this trip would be a total disappointment. But you came up with a perfect idea!
TChinese: 剛剛開船到這邊來卻看到一點波瀾都沒有的時候，還以為會白跑一趟——哈哈哈，果然還是侍主大人有主意！

Chinese: 谢啦，侍主。
English: Thank you, Lord Oracle.
TChinese: 謝啦，侍主。

Chinese: 她道谢的嗓音里也是带着笑的，和风一起钻进我的耳朵……明明也不是多么罕见的组合，
English: *Her thanking voice, carrying a hint of a smile, drifts into my ears with the breeze... It isn't a rare combination.*
TChinese: 她道謝的嗓音裏也是帶著笑的，和風一起鑽進我的耳朵……明明也不是多麼罕見的組合，

Chinese: 但就是生出些与平时不一样的感觉，我的心头一痒，无端让那已经习惯性到了嘴边的打趣拐了个弯，变成了别的。
English: *But it stirs a feeling unlike usual. With my heart skipping a beat, I swallow the words of making fun of her and say something else instead.*
TChinese: 但就是生出些與平時不一樣的感覺，我的心頭一癢，無端讓那已經習慣性到了嘴邊的打趣拐了個彎，變成了別的。

Chinese: 那还想要再来一次吗？
English: Would you like to do it again?
TChinese: 那還想要再來一次嗎？

Chinese: 再来一次？
English: Again?
TChinese: 再來一次？

Chinese: 嗯，小区域的风暴而已，如果想要尝试，再多几次也无所谓。
English: Yes, just another small storm. If you'd like, we can do it as many times as you want.
TChinese: 嗯，社區域的風暴而已，如果想要嘗試，再多幾次也無所謂。

Chinese: 你要是累了，就由我来操纵。
English: If you're tired, I can take over.
TChinese: 你要是累了，就由我來操縱。

Chinese: 想吗？
English: What do you think?
TChinese: 想嗎？

English: Uh-huh—

Chinese: 不用啦！这种事——
English: No need! This sort of thing—
TChinese: 不用啦！這種事——

Chinese: 哎，侍主唷，别总想着让我说这些话啊，我又不像你，三两句说不清楚这种心情啊。
English: Hey, don't always push me to say these things. I'm not good at expressing this kind of feeling, unlike you.
TChinese: 哎，侍主唷，別總想著讓我說這些話啊，我又不像你，三兩句說不清楚這種心情啊。

Chinese: 什么叫不像我啊。
English: What do you mean by unlike me?
TChinese: 什麼叫不像我啊。

Chinese: 想说就说嘛，难道我还会笑话你吗？
English: Say whatever you want. Do you think I'd laugh at you?
TChinese: 想說就說嘛，難道我還會笑話你嗎？

Chinese: ……啧，又明知故问啊。
English: Tch, there you go asking the obvious again.
TChinese: ……嘖，又明知故問啊。

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯哼了一声。
English: *Icaruth lets out a huff.*
TChinese: 伊卡洛斯哼了一聲。

Chinese: 行吧……那我可就说、咳，承认了吧。
English: Fine… I'll say... I'll admit it.
TChinese: 行吧……那我可就說、咳，承認了吧。

Chinese: 不用担心我会继续觉得无聊……真的，侍主，多谢你，我真的已经很开心了。
English: No need to worry about me feeling bored anymore… Truly. Thank you, Lord Oracle. I'm genuinely happy.
TChinese: 不用擔心我會繼續覺得無聊……真的，侍主，多謝你，我真的已經很開心了。

Chinese: 哈……是嘛。
English: Uh-huh… is that so?
TChinese: 哈……是嘛。

Chinese: 被看出来了啊。
English: *So she noticed after all.*
TChinese: 被看出來了啊。

Chinese: 我侧过去一眼——饶是我们已经下落了一会儿，但此刻我们仍在空中。
English: *I glance sideways. Even as we've been descending for a while, we're still in the air.*
TChinese: 我側過去一眼——饒是我們已經下落了一會兒，但此刻我們仍在空中。

Chinese: 海风匀速地吹过我们的周身，扬起我的斗篷，也扬起伊卡洛斯长长的发丝。
English: *The sea breeze flows steadily around us, lifting my cloak and tangling in Icaruth's long hair.*
TChinese: 海風勻速地吹過我們的周身，揚起我的斗篷，也揚起伊卡洛斯長長的發絲。

Chinese: 嗯，是。
English: Hmm, yes.
TChinese: 嗯，是。

Chinese: 侍主，你刚刚那么问，肯定就是在担心我吧？担心我觉得不够过瘾，或者是过瘾的时间太短——
English: Lord Oracle, you only asked because you were worried about me, right? Worried I might find it underwhelming, or that the thrill would be too brief.
TChinese: 侍主，你剛剛那麼問，肯定就是在擔心我吧？擔心我覺得不夠過癮，或者是過癮的時間太短——

Chinese: “米德加尔太平静了”、“无聊到全身没劲”……
English: "Midgard is too quiet", "so dull it drains me"...
TChinese: “米德加爾太平靜了”、“無聊到全身沒勁”……

Chinese: 我都这么说了，你当然会担心。要不然也不可能同意陪我这么玩吧。
English: You must be worried after hearing that. Otherwise, you wouldn't have agreed to do this with me.
TChinese: 我都這麼說了，你當然會擔心。要不然也不可能同意陪我這麼玩吧。

Chinese: 但是……唉，这要怎么说啊，怪不好意思的。
English: But…ugh, how do I even explain this? It's a little embarrassing.
TChinese: 但是……唉，這要怎麼說啊，怪不好意思的。

Chinese: 她难得嘟囔。
English: *She rarely mumbles like this.*
TChinese: 她難得嘟囔。

Chinese: 老实讲，在侍主你开口之前，我还真有这么想过呢——“区区一次穿云破浪”、“这不是马上又回到无聊的平静了嘛”什么的……
English: Honestly, before you asked, I'd been thinking stuff like "Just another wave-riding thrill" and "It'll be back to dull calm soon."...
TChinese: 老實講，在侍主你開口之前，我還真有這麼想過呢——“區區一次穿雲破浪”、“這不是馬上又回到無聊的平靜了嘛”什麼的……

Chinese: 可是，真神奇啊，你那样一问，我忽然就不觉得了。
English: However, the moment you asked me, I stopped feeling that way.
TChinese: 可是，真神奇啊，你那樣一問，我忽然就不覺得了。

Chinese: 惊心动魄的冒险当然是有趣的，我是喜欢，可就算是当年的我也知道，大海不会永远咆哮。
English: Thrilling adventures are fun. I do enjoy them. But even in the past, I knew: the sea doesn't always roar.
TChinese: 驚心動魄的冒險當然是有趣的，我是喜歡，可就算是當年的我也知道，大海不會永遠咆哮。

Chinese: 战胜风浪的瞬间当然是令人热血沸腾的，但我不会忘记自己究竟是为了什么才去战胜风浪——
English: The moments of triumph over storms are exhilarating, sure. But I never forget why I faced them.
TChinese: 戰勝風浪的瞬間當然是令人熱血沸騰的，但我不會忘記自己究竟是為了什麼才去戰勝風浪——

Chinese: 曾经的我是为了责任，作为叙亚金库唯一的继承人，海洋对我而言就是金库本身。而风浪，则是我必须攥在手中的钥匙。
English: Back then, it was duty. As the sole heir to the Shirre Treasury, the ocean was my vault. And storms were the key to it.
TChinese: 曾經的我是為了責任，作為敘亞金庫唯一的繼承人，海洋對我而言就是金庫本身。而風浪，則是我必須攥在手中的鑰匙。

Chinese: 我需要、也理所应当做到比所有人都熟悉它，了解它。
English: I must know them better than anyone, I did.
TChinese: 我需要、也理所應當做到比所有人都熟悉它，瞭解它。

Chinese: 只有在当所有人都认为它唯独不能成为我的阻碍时，我才真正成为那一切财富的主人。
English: Only after I convince everyone that I've conquered it could I claim true ownership of all those riches.
TChinese: 只有在當所有人都認為它唯獨不能成為我的阻礙時，我才真正成為那一切財富的主人。

Chinese: 所以啊，那一时的惊心动魄，绝不仅仅只是冒险本身为我带来的。我怀念它，自然也并不是在怀念那个瞬间本身。
English: So, the thrill wasn't just about the storm or the risk. And what I miss isn't just that momentary high.
TChinese: 所以啊，那一時的驚心動魄，絕不僅僅只是冒險本身為我帶來的。我懷念它，自然也並不是在懷念那個瞬間本身。

Chinese: 就像现在——
English: Just like now—
TChinese: 就像現在——

Chinese: “神眷者”的过往已经是历史中的事，现在的我是侍主你的星痕。
English: "Favored One" has become history. Now, I'm your Aster.
TChinese: “神眷者”的過往已經是歷史中的事，現在的我是侍主你的星痕。

Chinese: 我与我以后的岁月都是在此之上的新时新事，这样的我想要重新拥有一份和平时的平静不同的感觉，当然只能从你身上索……唔啊？！
English: My days ahead are built on this new foundation. If this version of me wants something beyond peace, I can only rely on you to…Ugh?!
TChinese: 我與我以後的歲月都是在此之上的新時新事，這樣的我想要重新擁有一份和平時的平靜不同的感覺，當然只能從你身上索……唔啊？！

Chinese: none
English: None
TChinese: none

Chinese: 说话间，我们已经滑翔到了船的上方。伊卡洛斯解除风魔法，我们便一同朝甲板上落去——
English: *As she speaks, we reach right above the ship. Icaruth lifts her wind magic, and we fall toward the deck together.*
TChinese: 說話間，我們已經滑翔到了船的上方。伊卡洛斯解除風魔法，我們便一同朝甲板上落去——

Chinese: 可能是被连成片的阳光晃了眼睛吧，直到踩上甲板，我和伊卡洛斯谁都没发现甲板上还湿漉漉的。
English: *Maybe blinded by the sunlight, neither Icaruth nor I notice the deck is wet and slippery until we land.*
TChinese: 可能是被連成片的陽光晃了眼睛吧，直到踩上甲板，我和伊卡洛斯誰都沒發現甲板上還濕漉漉的。

English: Hiss—
Oof!

Chinese: 海浪起起落落，船只摇摇晃晃，我们滚做一处，各给对方垫了半身，穿浪破云了一场都没打湿的衣服到底没逃过去，湿哒哒地揉在了一起。
English: *The waves sway the ship, and we roll to bump against each other. Our clothes that survived the wave-riding finally get soaked through.*
TChinese: 海浪起起落落，船隻搖搖晃晃，我們滾做一處，各給對方墊了半身，穿浪破雲了一場都沒打濕的衣服到底沒逃過去，濕噠噠地揉在了一起。

Chinese: 哈哈哈哈……
English: Hahaha…
TChinese: 哈哈哈哈……

Chinese: ……哈哈哈哈哈……
English: Hahaha…
TChinese: ……哈哈哈哈哈……

Chinese: 这也是不约而同的。
English: *We burst into laughter, in perfect sync once more.*
TChinese: 這也是不約而同的。

Chinese: 我们又一次不约而同地笑了，正好摔了，那就躺着吧。
English: *Since we've fallen, we just lie on the deck.*
TChinese: 我們又一次不約而同地笑了，正好摔了，那就躺著吧。

Chinese: 侍主，你快起来啊。我先躺下的。
English: Lord Oracle, get up. I lay down first.
TChinese: 侍主，你快起來啊。我先躺下的。

Chinese: 说了我们没有在比赛什么吧，甲板这么大，完全有一起躺的位置啊。
English: I told you, we're not competing. There's plenty of space to lie down together.
TChinese: 說了我們沒有在比賽什麼吧，甲板這麼大，完全有一起躺的位置啊。

Chinese: 还有，你刚刚话没说完呢。从我身上索什么？
English: Right, you didn't finish your sentence. What were you trying to rely on me for?
TChinese: 還有，你剛剛話沒說完呢。從我身上索什麼？

Chinese: 那个啊……
English: About that…
TChinese: 那個啊……

Chinese: 她拖长了音调，顿了一会儿，又笑了。
English: *She stretches the word out, pausing before breaking into a grin.*
TChinese: 她拖長了音調，頓了一會兒，又笑了。

Chinese: 侍主唷，你这是明知故问吧？
English: Lord Oracle, you already know the answer, don't you?
TChinese: 侍主唷，你這是明知故問吧？

Chinese: 有吗？我就是这样的存在啊。
English: Have you? You know me well.
TChinese: 有嗎？我就是這樣的存在啊。

Chinese: 我笑着看她——是啊，确实是明知故问了。
English: *I smile back at her. Yes, I do know the answer already.*
TChinese: 我笑著看她——是啊，確實是明知故問了。

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯回视我，她也笑，笑着说话，慢慢吞吞地。
English: *Icaruth meets my gaze and chuckles, speaking slowly.*
TChinese: 伊卡洛斯回視我，她也笑，笑著說話，慢慢吞吞地。

Chinese: 侍主大人觉得是什么……那就是什么喽。
English: It is whatever you think it is.
TChinese: 侍主大人覺得是什麼……那就是什麼嘍。

Chinese: 我要说的话差不多说完了，非要有最后一句……不，两句的话，就是这样喽。
English: I've said my piece. If I must add something, that's it.
TChinese: 我要說的話差不多說完了，非要有最後一句……不，兩句的話，就是這樣嘍。

Chinese: 别把我想得像是只会追逐刺激本身的冒险狂人一样啊，侍主。
English: Don't think I'm just some thrill-seeker chasing danger, Lord Oracle.
TChinese: 別把我想得像是只會追逐刺激本身的冒險狂人一樣啊，侍主。

Chinese: 还是说，其实是侍主你没有玩过瘾？
English: Or… are you the one who isn't satisfied?
TChinese: 還是說，其實是侍主你沒有玩過癮？

Chinese: 要是我说是呢？
English: What if I say I'm not?
TChinese: 要是我說是呢？

Chinese: 简单啊——那就继续。
English: Easy. We can continue.
TChinese: 簡單啊——那就繼續。

Chinese: 多少次我都奉陪——就算重复做到把这艘船撞碎，我也毫无意见！
English: As many times as you want. Even if it means breaking this ship!
TChinese: 多少次我都奉陪——就算重複做到把這艘船撞碎，我也毫無意見！

Chinese: 行啊，那就玩到撞碎。
English: Fine, let's go until it breaks.
TChinese: 行啊，那就玩到撞碎。

Chinese: 真的？说话算话。
English: Really? Do you mean it?
TChinese: 真的？說話算話。

Chinese: 这有什么假的。
English: Yes, I mean it.
TChinese: 這有什麼假的。

Chinese: 真撞碎了，我们就一起游回去好了。我也没有意见。
English: If it breaks, we'll swim back together. No complaints here.
TChinese: 真撞碎了，我們就一起遊回去好了。我也沒有意見。

Chinese: 行啊。
English: Alright.

Chinese: 丘吉尔在夜晚来到侍主的房间，告知他危机到来，并带来了自己的解决方式。
English: Churchill arrived at Lord Oracle's quarter at night, bringing dire news of an impending crisis—and her own proposed solution.

Chinese: 稀薄的晨光探出地平线，缓慢地溶解了夜幕。
English: The faint morning light creeps over the horizon, slowly dissolving the night.

Chinese: 圣城之中已亮起点点灯火，勤劳的工人们起身预备进行白天的劳作，而更多人还沉浸在睡梦中，等待晨光来唤醒。
English: The sacred city begins to flicker with lights as the diligent workers rise to prepare for the day's labor, while many others remain in slumber, waiting instead for dawn to wake them.

Chinese: 此时，一位天使轻轻推开了面前的房门……
English: At this moment, an angel gently pushes open the door in front of her...

Chinese: 侍主大人！侍主大人别睡啦！
English: Lord Oracle! Lord Oracle, wake up!

Chinese: 呜呃——！
English: Ugh!

Chinese: 我有超——级重大的事要告诉你哦！
English: I have something super important to tell you!

Chinese: 最好真有这么重大的事，让你不得不这个时间点骑到我被子上来，丘吉尔，现在可是凌晨……
English: It had better be that important for you to climb onto my bed at this hour, Churchill. It's still early morning...

Chinese: 别这么严肃嘛侍主大人~牧可真是严防死守，就连我这个天使也是好不容易才绕开牧进来的——
English: Don't be so uptight, Lord Oracle~ Muu guards this place like a hawk—I had to work really hard to sneak past her—

Chinese: 侍主大人，我真的有非常紧急的事！
English: But Lord Oracle, I really have something urgent for you!

Chinese: 嗯嗯好好好，牧呢，怎么还没上来把你拎走？
English: Sure, sure. Where's Muu? Why hasn't she come to drag you away yet?

Chinese: 别不信我呀！真的是事关世界安危的大事哦！
English: Come on, it's really about the fate of the whole world!

Chinese: 说说看。
English: I'm listening.

Chinese: 我观测到有一个神秘的领域正在发展！
English: I observed a mysterious field developing!

Chinese: 它似乎是从归墟方向出现的，正朝着米伦的方向延伸，一路吞并了许多游离在星海里的力量……
English: It's spreading from the Spirit Cairn toward Mirren, engulfing a lot of free-floating power in the Celestial Sea as it goes...

Chinese: 如果它不减速的话，说不定会在米伦引起翻天覆地的大灾变呢！
English: If it doesn't slow down, it could cause a catastrophic disaster in Mirren!

Chinese: 这听起来是需要紧急召唤所有人讨论的大事件。
English: You're right, that does sound important. I'll call for a meeting at once.

Chinese: 别打岔呀侍主大人！我正要说呢——
English: Don't interrupt, Lord Oracle! What I'm trying to say is—

Chinese: 要是我们没有应对办法的话，就只能硬碰硬了。
English: If we don't have a countermeasure, we might have to face it head-on.

Chinese: 说不定侍主和侍主所在意的大姐姐小妹妹们，都会死在这场恶战之中……呜呜，想想就很难过……
English: What if you and everyone you care for die fighting it? It's so sad to think about...

Chinese: 但争端始终不如爱与和平，对吧~？
English: Love and peace are so much better than fighting, don't you think?

Chinese: 所以，你有其他的解决办法？
English: So, you have something else in mind?

Chinese: 没错！
English: Exactly!

Chinese: 根据我的观测，这位来客百分百，绝对，一定和侍主大人有关哦。
English: According to my observation, this visitor is definitely, absolutely, most certainly connected to you personally, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 你的意思是……
English: You mean...

Chinese: 这是侍主大人的桃花缘！
English: It must be your destined romance!

Chinese: 一段翻天覆地的大灾变中的桃花缘？
English: A romance in the midst of a catastrophic disaster?

Chinese: 如果侍主大人能响应这段缘分的话，大灾变自然会消弭，侍主大人也会得到一位红颜知己哦~
English: If you embrace this destiny, the disaster will fade away—and you'll gain a confidante as well~

Chinese: 看来我只能去了。
English: It seems I have no choice but to go.

Chinese: 这才对嘛！为了挽救倾颓的世界与毁灭之星，侍主大人迈出了关键性的一步！
English: That's the spirit! To save the breakable world and the star of destruction, you have taken a crucial step forward!

Chinese: 听起来功利性也太强了吧。
English: That sounds a little too calculated.

Chinese: 桃花缘，讲究的可是双边奔赴哦。
English: Romance is a two-way street, you know.

Chinese: 试试嘛，不会后悔的~
English: Give it a try. You won't regret it.

Chinese: 总之！拜托侍主大人尽快行动起来吧，缘分可是转瞬即逝的东西！
English: Anyway! Lord Oracle, please act quickly, as fate waits for no one!

Chinese: 好吧，那我们要去哪里？
English: Alright, what do I do next?

Chinese: 哼哼，这个就要看我爱与情感天使丘吉尔的能力了！
English: Hmph! That's where I, Churchill—angel of love and emotions—come in!

Chinese: “远在锦绣画卷中的染血桃花啊，我已洞悉你的期望；我已见证你的一生。”
English: "Oh blood-stained peach blossom in the splendid painting, I have seen your desires, I have witnessed your life."

Chinese: “我将以爱之权能，跨越无垠时空，将命定之人与你联结。”
English: "With the power of love, I will cross the vast space and time to connect you with your destined one." "

Chinese: （真难得，能见到她这样空灵神圣的样子……）
English: (It's rare to see her looking so ethereal and holy...)

Chinese: （魔法的力量酝酿起来了，是要搭建空间通道吗？）
English: (Is she conjuring a spatial passage?)
Hmm...

Chinese: 丘吉尔的咏唱停顿了一下，双臂微微颤抖，似乎遇到了什么阻力。
English: Churchill's chant paused, her arms trembling slightly, as if encountering resistance.

Chinese: “呈现吧！缘分的……”
English: "Reveal yourself!" "Fate's..."

Chinese: <size=40>丘吉尔！</size>你怎敢打扰饲主大人的睡眠！
English: <size=40>Churchill!! </size>How dare you disturb the Master's sleep!
What?!

Chinese: 糟、糟糕！咏唱被打断了——
English: Oh no! The chant was interrupted...

Chinese: ……是时空乱流？
English: Is it a space-time turbulence?

Chinese: 呜哇哇失控了！都怪你啦牧——
English: Waaah, it's out of control! It's all your fault, Muu...

Chinese: 要被吸进去了！！救命啊——
English: We're being sucked in! Help!

Chinese: 无法挣脱，这到底是什么……糟糕，要脱离这个时空了！
English: I can't break free. What is this... We're leaving this dimension!

Chinese: 赶上了！饲主大人请抓住我的手！
English: I'm here! Master, grab my hand!

Chinese: 牧跳起来抓向我的手，然而我们的手掌却互相穿透，没能抓紧彼此。
English: Muu jumps to grab my hand, but our hands pass through each other, unable to connect.

Chinese: 怎么会？！可恶，丘吉尔，你到底搞了什么鬼！
English: How can this be?! Damn it, Churchill, what have you done?!

Chinese: 呜哇哇哇我也不知道啊！可、可能是因为我把侍主大人和空间通道另一边连起来了所以——
English: I don't know either! M-maybe I connected Lord Oracle with the other side of the passage, so—

Chinese: 你这家伙，我绝不饶你！
English: I will never forgive you!

Chinese: 或许这也是一种命定。
English: Perhaps… This is also fate?

Chinese: 牧，我回来之前，神谕司就拜托你了……
English: Muu, until I return, please take care of the Oracle Division...
Ugh...

Chinese: 牧双手交握在胸前，担忧地仰起头望着在时空隧道中越来越远的我。
English: Muu clasps her hands over her chest, looking up anxiously as I drift further away in the space-time tunnel.

Chinese: 我必将维持米伦的稳定。所以……
English: I will maintain Mirren's stability in your stead. So...

Chinese: 要平平安安地回来啊，饲主大人！
English: Come back safely, Master!

Chinese: 不要超过一个月哦！
English: Don't stay away for more than a month!

Chinese: 那如果我不去呢？
English: And if I don't?

Chinese: 世界毁灭。
English: The world ends.

Chinese: 你的回答流畅得像是早就排练过。
English: That answer was way too rehearsed.

Chinese: 拜托了嘛侍主大人！为了我的八卦来源，就请你努力一下吧！我也会帮你的！
English: Please, Lord Oracle! For my gossip sources, do your best! I'll help you too!

Chinese: 这么快就不装了？
English: You dropped the act pretty quickly, huh?

Chinese: 吼！

Chinese: 休想伤害侍主大人！

Chinese: 怎么了，丘吉尔……？

Chinese: 我努力睁开眼睛。

Chinese: 面前是一片混沌的场景，植物以难以想象的扭曲姿态生长，天地也仿佛倒转。丘吉尔挡在我面前，拉满了弓箭。

Chinese: 绝不让你伤害侍主大人！

Chinese: 丘吉尔，这是怎么了？

Chinese: 我站起身，看到一头奇特的野兽站在我们面前。

Chinese: 虽然有些匆忙，但只能试试看在这里能不能召唤星痕了。

Chinese: 请侍主大人快点！我来应付——嘿，吃我一箭！

Chinese: 怪物轻松躲开了这一箭，但仍然忌惮丘吉尔手中的弓箭，不敢靠近。

Chinese: 从地升天，又从……不对。

Chinese: ……无法响应。沟通不到秩序之海。
English: It's not working. I can't connect to the Sea of Order.

Chinese: 呜哇，怎么会有这种事！
English: Whoa, how can this be?!

Chinese: 多亏你了，丘……

Chinese: 呜呜！侍主大人，你是不是要死掉了——

Chinese: ……还没有，但如果你继续压在我肋骨边的话就不一定了。

Chinese: 哭声一停，丘吉尔茫然地眨了眨眼。

Chinese: 诶，平时不是压在这里吗？

Chinese: 你平时哪次不是直接骑到我的被子上来的？
English: No, normally you just jump onto my bed.

Chinese: 嗯……这不是因为怕你死掉了嘛！下次就骑，不，现在就——

Chinese: 丘吉尔作势要往我身上骑，我眼疾手快地坐起来阻止了她。
English: Churchill tries to climb on me, but I quickly sit up to stop her.

Chinese: 还是不了。这是哪里？

Chinese: 侍主大人……有个坏消息。
English: Lord Oracle... I have bad news.

Chinese: 我有心理准备，你说。

Chinese: 因为侍主大人睡得太久，文明已经毁灭了……
English: You were asleep for too long… Civilization has collapsed.

Chinese: 我们现在，正在一万两千年后重建的文明之中。
English: We're now living in the remnants of a world rebuilt 12,000 years later.

Chinese: ……什么？

Chinese: 来自丘吉尔的消息太过震撼，我一时间沉默了。

Chinese: 一万两千年……神谕司呢？

Chinese: 真理圣殿一直都没有采取方案吗？

Chinese: 不知道，我们都没有被联系过。呜……侍主，我现在只剩你了……
English: I don't know. We've had no contact. Ugh... Lord Oracle, you're all I have now...

Chinese: 在我的脑海里，同伴们的音容笑貌一闪而过。
English: Images of my companions flash through my mind.

Chinese: 那些时光还如此鲜活，恍如昨日，她们真的已经一去不复返了吗？
English: Those times were so vivid, just like they were yesterday. Are they really gone forever?

Chinese: 我不愿多想，抱了抱靠过来的丘吉尔。
English: I push the thought aside and pull Churchill into a hug.

Chinese: ……没事的，丘吉尔，冷静一点。事已至此，我们一起想办法。
English: It's OK, Churchill, stay calm. We'll find a way through this together.

Chinese: 侍主大人，你没有醒来的这段时间，我好害怕……有人来威胁我……
English: Lord Oracle, while you slept, I was so scared... Someone threatened me...

Chinese: 有人威胁你？是谁，对方做了什么？
English: Someone threatened you? Who? What did they do?

Chinese: 是一个黑黑的，很可怕的，长着很多尾巴的人，她威胁我说，如果我不能建成一座油豆腐村庄的话，我就会被杀！
English: A scary person! All shadowy, with many tails! She said if I can't build a Tofu Village, she'll kill me!

Chinese: 我不禁细细打量起周围的环境来。

Chinese: 侍主大人，我们帮帮她吧！
English: Lord Oracle, let's help her!

Chinese: 好啊，我没意见。
English: Sure.

Chinese: ……像您这么干脆地决定帮助他人的人，真是少见呢。
English: It's rare to see someone offer help so readily.

Chinese: 哼哼，那是当然的！我们侍主大人心地超级好！
English: Hehe, of course! Lord Oracle has a very kind heart!

Chinese: 也许只是一种习惯，或者交易。桃小姐也是，丘吉尔你也是，不用这么快高兴。
English: Maybe it's just a habit, or a trade. Miss Momo, Churchill, don't celebrate too soon.

Chinese: 侍主这个傲娇鬼，早就被丘吉尔大人看穿了哦！
English: You can keep pretending, but I've seen right through you!

Chinese: 所以，妾身姑且认为，两位是想施以援手了？
English: So, shall I assume you two are willing to help?

Chinese: 如果我和丘吉尔有什么能帮助你的地方，但说无妨。
English: If there's anything we can do to help, feel free to let us know.

Chinese: 诶，原来我也要来？
English: Eh, I have to help too?

Chinese: 你提议，你担责。
English: You suggested it, so you take responsibility.

Chinese: 怎么这样——
English: That's not fair...

Chinese: 那么，我就直说了。
English: Then, I'll cut to the chase.

Chinese: 请帮妾身将村庄重新建造起来吧，妾身会去救援流落在外的平民。
English: Please help me rebuild the village, and I will rescue the scattered survivors.

Chinese: 有安居之所，有信仰妾身的民众，二者齐备，妾身便能慢慢恢复力量了。
English: With a place to call home and people who believe in me, I can slowly regain my strength.

Chinese: 我怎么记得我们不是来做这个的？
English: I thought we weren't here to do this?

Chinese: 侍主大人好冷酷哦！我可是感觉得到的，侍主的桃花缘就在这个世界哦！
English: You are so cold-hearted! I can sense it, your destined romance is unfolding right in this world!

Chinese: 说不定……
English: Maybe...

Chinese: 丘吉尔用目光示意了一下桃。
English: Churchill glanced at Momo.

Chinese: 总之，如果我们能拯救这里，说不定就遇到侍主的有缘人了呢！
English: In any case, if we manage to save this place, maybe you'll meet your destined one, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 第五节 佳愿
English: EP 5: Wishing Star

Chinese: 丘吉尔尝试逃跑，失败了。
English: Churchill attempted to flee, but her efforts were in vain.

Chinese: 诶，帮忙重建村庄？
English: Eh, help rebuild the village?

Chinese: 是的。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 而且，如果我当下距离实现愿望很远，就不能用许愿的方式……
English: And if the wish is far from reach, I can't just wish it into being...

Chinese: 是的。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 也就是说……如果我要帮忙的话，就得亲手去搬东西……
English: So, in other words, if I want to help I'm going to have to do some heavy lifting!

Chinese: 正是如此。不过，妾身也不会袖手旁观哦。
English: Exactly. But I won't just stand by and watch.

Chinese: 呜哇！我才不要！
English: Waah! I don't want to!

Chinese: 丘吉尔跳起来就想飞走，被我一把抓住。
English: Churchill leaped up to fly away but I grabbed her.

Chinese: 你自己提的方案，临阵脱逃可不行。
English: You're the one who made the suggestion—no backing out now.

Chinese: 呜哇哇放开丘吉尔——
English: Waah, let go of me!

Chinese: 当然，妾身也不会让两位平白帮忙的。
English: Of course, I wouldn't ask you to help for free.

Chinese: 锦绣江山地大物博，若是能够恢复，利用民众逸散的愿力将二位送回米伦只是举手之劳。
English: Splendid World is vast and resource rich. If it can be restored, harnessing the scattered wishes of the people to send you both back to Mirren would be a simple task.

Chinese: 若是丘吉尔小姐想要实现什么愿望，也可许下一个，妾身以自身的神力完成。
English: If Miss Churchill wishes for something, you need only say it, and I shall grant it with my divine power.

Chinese: 嗯……总觉得没有什么实质性的内容呢。
English: Hmm... It still feels insubstantial.

Chinese: 在空白的纸上落下印章，乃是妾身最大的诚意哦。
English: Putting my seal on a blank scroll is the highest show of sincerity I can offer.

Chinese: 也是！那我也帮帮忙好了。
English: Alright! Then I'll help too.

Chinese: 还以为能看见侍主搬砖呢……
English: I was hoping to see Lord Oracle carrying bricks...

Chinese: 当然，[var=Actor]先生，也能如此实现一个愿望。
English: Of course, Mr. [var=Actor], you can also make a wish come true in this way.

Chinese: 多么夸张的都可以吗？
English: Even something extravagant?

Chinese: 呵呵，您听起来已经怀有宏伟的计划了呢。哪怕要妾身随您前去米伦，也无不可哦？
English: Hehe, it sounds like you already have a grand plan. Even if it means bringing me to Mirren with you... that is possible.

Chinese: 那么，我也要一张空头支票就好。
English: In that case, I'll take a blank scroll too.

Chinese: 但是桃，我还有一个问题。
English: But Momo, I have another question.

Chinese: 先生请讲。
English: Please ask.

Chinese: 村子外面的恶神，她叫什么名字？
English: The evil god outside the village, what's her name?

Chinese: 桃温柔的面容上，骤然笼上了一层阴影。
English: A shadow suddenly fell over Momo's gentle face.

Chinese: 妾身并不知晓她的名字。甚至，妾身从未真正见过那人……
English: I do not know her name. In fact, I have never actually seen her...

Chinese: 诶，怎么会？
English: Huh, how is that possible?

Chinese: 妾身无法匹敌她的恶念，甚至无法将身边人保护周全。
English: I cannot match her malevolent thoughts, nor can I fully protect those around me.

Chinese: 请看，这小小的狐狸团，便是妾身仅剩的孩子。
English: Look, this small fox cub is my only remaining child.

Chinese: 仅剩的……孩子？桃小姐居然有孩子——！
English: Your only remaining... child? You actually have children!

Chinese: 呵呵，说是孩子，实为妾身的化身。因性格稚拙，故当做孩子来看。
English: Hehe, although I call it a child, it's actually an incarnation of me. Because of its innocent nature, I regard it as a child.

Chinese: 妾身还有八个化身，均是下落不明……
English: I have eight other incarnations, but they have all gone missing.

Chinese: 唯一知晓的，就是她们应该没有落入那恶神之手，只是在外逃窜，没有找到归家的路。
English: The only thing I know for sure is that they have not fallen into the hands of that evil deity, they are just wandering, and unable to find their way home.

Chinese: 那么，这位恶神的目的就是毁灭锦绣江山的所有东西吗？
English: So this evil deity wants to wipe out everything in the Splendid World?

Chinese: 是的，包括妾身……乃至于她自己在内。
English: Yes, including me... and even herself.

Chinese: 若是锦绣江山被毁至空无一物，她也会自尽的吧。
English: If the Splendid World is completely destroyed, she will probably take her own life as well.

Chinese: 呜哇，怎么会有这么混沌的神明啊……
English: Ugh, how could there be such a chaotic deity?

Chinese: 等等，那就算桃小姐恢复了，也打不过她的吧？！
English: Do you think you can defeat her if you recover?

Chinese: 这倒不会。
English: I think I should be able to.

Chinese: 驱使她灭世的恶念乃是她神力的根源，那恶神在掀起灾难时，应当已经消耗了许多。
English: The malevolent thoughts driving her to destroy the world are the source of her divine power. When she caused the disaster, she have spent much of it.

Chinese: 如今只要没有新的亡者，妾身恢复力量，便可与她一战。
English: Now, as long as there are no more deaths, I can regain my strength and fight her.

Chinese: 现在看来，也只能相信桃小姐了。
English: It seems like we have no other option but to trust Miss Momo.

Chinese: 丘吉尔。
English: Churchill.

Chinese: 在！侍主大人要做什么？
English: Yes. What do you want to do?

Chinese: 走，我们去搬砖。
English: Come on. Let's go carry some bricks here.

Chinese: 诶……哎呀我有点困，好像时空乱流对我造成了一些影响，头好晕哦……
English: Eh... Oh no, I feel a bit dizzy. Maybe the space-time turbulence affected me, my head is spinning...

Chinese: 走了。
English: Let's go.

Chinese: 呜哇哇哇侍主你这个大坏蛋放开我啊——
English: Waaah! You're such a bully, Lord Oracle! Let me gooo—!

Chinese: 第六节 恶神传说
English: EP 6: Dark Deity Legend

Chinese: 村民向侍主讲起了恶神的传说。
English: The villagers spoke of an ancient legend—the tale of the Dark Deity.

Chinese: 我行走着，走在尘土和湿润的花草之间。
English: I walk, treading on dust and damp grass.

Chinese: 我听得到人们的欢呼，但却不再有祈祷声了。人们建立起新的规则，我……不，妾身……不，是我……是我自己。
English: I can hear the cheers of people, but the prayers have ceased. People have established new rules, and I... no, she... no, it's me... it's myself.

Chinese: 人们得到了他们想要的，那么……我该做什么？为什么向我祈祷的声音消失了？
English: People got what they wished for... so what am I supposed to do now? Why did they stop praying to me?

Chinese: 我不再被需要了吗？
English: Am I no longer needed?

Chinese: 我想要再次听见声音。
English: I long to hear the voices once more.

Chinese: 又是这样的梦。这到底是谁的记忆？
English: Another dream like this... Whose memories are these?

Chinese: 你心里已有答案了，又何必问我？
English: You already know the answer. So why do you still ask?

Chinese: 居然能把我和她联系在一起，让我翻阅她的梦境，你到底是谁？
English: How can you connect me with her and have me explore her dreams? Who are you exactly?

Chinese: 比起提问，不如亲自寻找答案。总有一天，你会亲自见到我。
English: Find the answers yourself. One day, you'll see me in person.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 侍主大人！该起床啦！
English: Lord Oracle! It's time to get up!

Chinese: 呜呃——！
English: Ugh!

Chinese: 你最好真有这么紧急的事需要现在骑到我被子上来，丘吉尔，现在……几点了？
English: You'd better have a good reason for waking me up, Churchill. What time is it anyway?

Chinese: 太阳晒肚皮了哦，侍主大人！我们该去搬砖了！
English: The sun is already shining, Lord Oracle! We should go move some bricks!

Chinese: ……对哦，要开始工作了。
English: Right, we need to start working.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 帮忙重建的工作比想象中要繁重。即使村民们都在一起工作，忙完时也已经是下午。
English: Rebuilding is tougher than I expected. Even with everyone working together, we're not done till afternoon.

Chinese: 这样一来，这个房子也建好了。
English: And with that, another house is finished.

Chinese: 看不出啊，你这样的年轻人，又有一把子力气在身上，又会指挥和筹划！
English: Can't tell by looking at you young man, but you've got muscle and a good head on your shoulders!

Chinese: 筹划是本职，搬砖……我也适应了两天。
English: Planning is my job, as for carrying bricks... I've gotten used to it in the past two days.

Chinese: 哈哈，以前没干过粗活吧？一看就知道，你这么细皮嫩肉的公子哥儿，手上都没什么老茧。
English: Haha, never done hard labor before, huh? It's pretty obvious. You have no calluses on your hands at all.

Chinese: 能这么快适应也挺不容易了。
English: It's impressive how quickly you've adapted!

Chinese: 桃还没有回来吗？
English: Momo hasn't returned yet?

Chinese: 桃大人从前也偶尔会这样出去一天多。她是有大本事的人，相信她吧。
English: Lady Momo sometimes goes out for a whole day or more. She's quite capable. Trust her.

Chinese: 有大本事的人？
English: Capable?

Chinese: 是啊，她就像神明一样从天而降，拯救了我们。
English: Yes, she descended from the heavens like a god and saved us.

Chinese: ……这样。
English: I see.

Chinese: （桃对这些人隐瞒了自己的身份吗……）
English: (Momo is hiding her identity from these people...)

Chinese: 我以前是在地主手下干活儿的，地主也有好有坏，我是比较倒霉的那种，摊上个脾气坏的肥猪。
English: I used to work for a landlord, and they could be either good or bad. Unfortunately, I ended up with a bad-tempered one.

Chinese: 听起来会过得很辛苦。
English: It sounds like it was quite difficult for you.

Chinese: 嘿咻！我的事情也做完啦。
English: Huff! I've finished too.

Chinese: 有八卦吗？我要听！
English: Got any gossip? Spill it—I want in!

Chinese: 小丫头想听当然行，不过这也不是什么有趣的事儿。
English: Of course, little girl, but it's not very interesting.

Chinese: 当时我和我老婆，都是给地主干活的，也算能糊口。
English: Back then, my wife and I were both working for the landlord, just trying to get by.

Chinese: 后来有了丫头，日子就变得不大好过。
English: Then we had a girl, and things got harder.

Chinese: 咦，为什么？
English: Why?

Chinese: 因为要养孩子啊。总不能把她送了人。
English: Because raising kids ain't easy. We couldn't just send her away.

Chinese: 她又皮，又爱闹，但我伸手过去，她就抱着嘬，跟嘬奶嘴儿似的。
English: She's such a cheeky little rascal, but the moment I reached out, she grabbed my fingers and started sucking on them like they were her pacifier.

Chinese: 为人父母，就会有怜子之心。
English: That's how it is for parents—you just end up soft-hearted.

Chinese: 哎，小哥很懂啊。本来这日子过得也还能凑活，谁曾想，仗打到我们这儿了！
English: You get it, lad. Things were tough, but manageable—until the war reached us.

Chinese: 地主早早知道，拔腿就跑了，我也差点被抓去当兵……
English: The landlord caught wind of it and fled. I was nearly drafted...

Chinese: 是桃救了你？
English: Did Momo save you?

Chinese: 差不多。当时啊，军队不仅要把我拖走，还想连我老婆一起带走！
English: More or less. They wanted to take me and also my wife!

Chinese: 我急眼了，就准备跟那帮兵拼命，谁知天突然黑了……
English: I lost my sanity and was ready to fight the soldiers to the death, but then suddenly, the sky went dark...

Chinese: 接着我们就被桃大人救下，桃大人告诉我们，那黑天是一场天灾。
English: That's when Lady Momo saved us. She said that darkness was a natural disaster.

Chinese: 天灾？让天黑下来的天灾？
English: A natural disaster? That darkened the sky?

Chinese: 我估摸着是。
English: I reckon so.

Chinese: 那场灾难还有别的特征吗？
English: Anything else about that disaster you remember?

Chinese: 我不大记得了，回头仔细想想说给你听。今天干活干得脑子都蒙了。
English: I can't remember much at the moment but if I recall anything I'll let you know. My brain is exhausted from working all day.

Chinese: 就是就是，好累的。侍主大人还使唤我到处跑，我也晕乎乎的！
English: Same here! Lord Oracle had me running all over. I'm dizzy too!

Chinese: 那我就得说了，小妹妹，这位小哥可厉害着呢。
English: Well, I have to say, this young man here is quite impressive.

Chinese: 本来这些活儿啊，桃大人不在，我们都凭感觉干，现在好了，有小哥在，效率高了不少。
English: When Lady Momo's away, we just muddle through. But with him here? Things are way smoother.

Chinese: 哼哼，我们侍主大人当然，他不仅可以搬起砖头，还能使出超厉害的法术！
English: Hmph, of course, Lord Oracle is amazing. He not only moves bricks but can also use incredibly powerful magic!

Chinese: 这倒是不稀奇，肯发愿的话，大家都能办得到啊。
English: That's not surprising. Anyone can do it if they make a wish.

Chinese: 侍主大人才不用愿力呢！他自有伟力——
English: Lord Oracle doesn't use wish power, he's got his own mighty strength!

Chinese: 这么厉害？
English: That powerful?

Chinese: 他厉害的地方还不止这一点呢！要是我们还在原本的地方，侍主大人能一口吃掉外面的恶神——
English: That's not all! If we were still in our homeland, Lord Oracle could swallow that evil deity in one bite!

Chinese: 我不能。
English: I could not.

Chinese: 切，侍主大人一点都不配合。
English: Tch, you are not helping at all.

Chinese: 丘吉尔小姐还是这么活力四射呀。
English: Lady Churchill is still so enthusiastic.

Chinese: 桃大人！
English: Lady Momo!

Chinese: 怎么偏偏是这时候桃小姐回来了啊——
English: Why now, of all times...

Chinese: 哎呀，看来妾身回来的不巧？
English: Oh dear, did I come back at a bad time?

Chinese: 不，你回来得正好。
English: No, your timing is perfect.

Chinese: 呼呼……先生如此自然，怕是惯会哄人呢。
English: Hehe... You speak so smoothly. You must be good at sweet-talking.

Chinese: 就是就是。
English: Indeed.

Chinese: 丘吉尔小姐呢，则一看便是调皮捣蛋的惯犯。若是我创造出了这样的天使，非要打屁股惩戒不可。
English: Lady Churchill, in contrast, is obviously a mischievous troublemaker. If I had created such an angel, I'd have to spank her as punishment.

Chinese: 诶？！桃小姐上次还说要是你，你就不会收回去的——
English: Eh?! Miss Momo, last time you said if it were you, you wouldn't take me back…

Chinese: 妾身确实那么说了，可打屁股与收回去，也是两件不同的事吧？
English: I did say that, but spanking and taking you back are two different things, right?

Chinese: 糟糕，中计了！侍主大人救我！
English: Oh no, I've been tricked! Lord Oracle, help!

Chinese: 乖乖看炉子就救你。
English: Behave and watch the furnace. Then I'll save you.

Chinese: 呜呜……好吧！
English: Ugh... fine!

Chinese: 既然这里有可靠的丘吉尔小姐，侍主就请随妾身来一下？
English: Since Lady Churchill is here, sir, would you please come with me?

Chinese: 这里就交给你了，丘吉尔。
English: I'll leave it to you, Churchill.

Chinese: 呜呜，为了侍主大人能结下良缘，我就忍耐一下……
English: For Lord Oracle's good fortune in finding a great match, I'll endure it...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 那么调皮捣蛋的丘吉尔，你居然也能把她收拾得服服帖帖的。
English: I'm surpirsed that you even managed to tame a mischievous girl like Churchill.

Chinese: 呵呵，纵使丘吉尔小姐拥有天使级别的力量，她的心性也还只是个孩子呢。
English: Hehe, Miss Churchill may have power as an angel, but inside, she's still just a child.

Chinese: 她甚至忘记了自己并非从属于你的天使。
English: She even forgets that she isn't actually your angel.

Chinese: 只要抛出一个小钩，稚子们便会只关注闪亮的钩子，忘记垂钓之人的存在……
English: Toss them a shiny hook, and they'll forget the fisherman entirely...

Chinese: 简单又有效的策略。
English: A simple yet effective strategy.

Chinese: 不过是一点小计谋罢了。
English: It's just a small trick.

Chinese: 桃牵起我的手，轻轻揉着我因为搬运而酸痛的肌肉。
English: Momo takes my hand and gently massages the muscles that have become sore from carrying things.

Chinese: 她的手柔软细腻，掌心却有一层薄薄的茧子，触感矛盾又奇妙。
English: Her hands are soft and delicate, but her palms have a thin layer of calluses. Her touch is both contradictory and fascinating.

Chinese: 越是漂亮的女人，便越是会骗人呢。
English: The prettier the woman, the more deceitful she can be.

Chinese: 按你这么说，你应当是骗术极高的那类吧。
English: By that logic, you must be very skilled in deceit.

Chinese: 您的嘴这么甜，恐怕桃花缘已经足以连成一片树林了吧？
English: To have words this sweet, you must eat nothing but candy.

Chinese: 如果未来你有兴趣，可以来米伦看看。
English: If you're ever curious, come visit Mirren someday.

Chinese: 不过现在先说正事吧，你出去做什么了？
English: But for now, let's talk about serious matters. What did you do when you went out?

Chinese: 这一天辛苦先生了。这次出去，妾身带回了一些民众。
English: You've worked hard today. I went out to bring back some people.

Chinese: 若他们能在村中安居乐业，并信仰于妾身，先生与丘吉尔小姐便也不必再做苦力了。
English: If they can settle and thrive in the village and believe in me, you and Miss Churchill won't have to do hard labor anymore.

Chinese: 进展意外地快啊。
English: That's faster than I expected.

Chinese: 妾身只是苦于无法分身。现在有先生分忧，自然是进展神速。
English: If only I could be in two places at once... But with you here to share the burden, things are moving along splendidly.

Chinese: 说来，妾身之前遇到先生的地方，如今已安全了。
English: By the way, the place where I met you before is now safe.

Chinese: 再过数日，安全区进一步扩大，也许可以请先生出游。
English: In a few days, the safe zone will expand further, and perhaps I can take you on a trip.

Chinese: 听起来，再远一些的地方有好风景？

Chinese: 叽啾？！

Chinese: ……所以丘吉尔呢？

Chinese: 好，听侍主哥哥的！

Chinese: 啊啊……真是……太好了。

Chinese: 村庄内。

Chinese: 啊，侍主大人，欢迎回来……

Chinese: 丘吉尔回来过吗？
English: Did Churchill come back?

Chinese: 丘吉尔小姐？我没见到过啊。
English: Miss Churchill? No, I haven't seen her yet.

Chinese: 她不是带着这些孩子去安全的地方做游戏了吗？
English: Didn't she take the children out to play somewhere safe?

Chinese: 怎么是侍主大人带着孩子们回来……
English: Why are you back with the children?

Chinese: 别慌，丘吉尔很强。这些孩子拜托你照顾，我去找桃。
English: Don't worry, Churchill can handle herself. Please watch over the kids. I'll go find Momo.

Chinese: 好……请交给我吧。
English: Alright... Leave them to me.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 桃！
English: Momo!

Chinese: 妾身在此。难得见侍主大人如此急躁，不知是发生何事了？
English: I'm here. It's rare to see you this flustered, what's happened?

Chinese: 你见到丘吉尔了吗？孩子们说她回来找你——
English: Have you seen Churchill? The kids said she came back to you...

Chinese: ……丘吉尔小姐？妾身不曾见过。
English: Miss Churchill? I haven't seen her.

Chinese: 孩子们说丘吉尔小姐回来找妾身了？那么，她所为何事？
English: The children said Miss Churchill came back to find me? What for?

Chinese: 孩子们说是“黑漆漆的大姐姐”。那是恶神吗？
English: They mentioned a "shadow lady." Could that be the evil deity?

Chinese: 若说是黑色的女性，那恐怕是恶神了……
English: If they saw a woman cloaked in darkness, then yes—it was likely her.

Chinese: 她恐怕遇到了大麻烦，我得去找她。
English: Churchill’s likely in danger. I have to go find her.

Chinese: 且慢，侍主大人！对方若是恶神，此事多半凶险至极。还请从长计议……
English: Easy, Lord Oracle! If this involves the evil goddess, it could be extremely dangerous. Think it through...

Chinese: 你的力量恢复了多少？
English: How much have you recovered?

Chinese: ……约莫八成。若是正面对上恶神，恐无胜算。
English: About eight out of ten. But if I face her head-on, I may not stand a chance.

Chinese: 我必须要去找丘吉尔，桃。她是我重要的同伴。
English: I have to go after Churchill, Momo. She's an important companion.

Chinese: 我与那恶神彼此感应，若我出面，您必将与她正面对上。
English: If I show up, that evil deity will sense me. You’ll be forced to face her directly.

Chinese: 正在我们彼此僵持时，外面忽然传来了声音。
English: Caught in a deadlock, a shout broke through from outside.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 桃大人！侍主大人！我们也要去！
English: Lady Momo! Lord Oracle! We're coming too!

Chinese: 我踏出房门，看见一群人挤在祠堂前。
English: I stepped outside and saw a crowd gathered in front of the shrine.

Chinese: 你们在这里做什么？
English: What are you all doing here?

Chinese: 侍主大人，我听我老婆说，丘吉尔小姐失踪了！
English: Lord Oracle, I got the word from my better half—Churchill's gone missing!

Chinese: 唉，我实在太担心了，将这些告诉了当家的……还请侍主大人莫要见怪。
English: I was so worried I told him everything… Please don't be offended, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 丘吉尔小姐是个好姑娘，她曾为我出头，我也不能坐视不管。
English: Miss Churchill is a really good girl. She stood up for me once and I can't just stand by and do nothing.

Chinese: 身为信徒，我要奉献自身，努力积累功绩！
English: As a follower, I must do my part and earn merit through action!

Chinese: 我、我也……呃我只是被我爹拖来的……好痛！
English: Same here... OK, maybe pops dragged me out here... Ouch!

Chinese: 瞧你那怂样子！若是害怕，就留在村里吧。
English: Look at you! If you're scared, stay behind in the village.

Chinese: 爹你要是不在，我也没法在这里独活啊！还、还是带上我吧！
English: If you die out there, I won't survive either! Just… take me with you!

Chinese: 我们也去！都是伙伴，怎么能放着丘吉尔小姐不管！
English: We're all friends and we can't just leave Miss Churchill behind!

Chinese: ……诸位，感谢你们的心意，但丘吉尔是在安全区被袭击的，城外并不安全。
English: I appreciate the sentiment, folks, but Churchill was attacked in what was supposed to be a safe zone. It's not safe to leave the village.

Chinese: 我可是高贵血脉之后……大不了祈求神明大人的帮助便是！
English: I am of noble blood... The least I can do is send up some prayers!

Chinese: 听您说的，要是安全区不安全，我们缩在村里也难逃一死啊！
English: If even the safe zones aren't safe anymore, hiding in the village won't help us either!

Chinese: 还是一起去找找吧，说不定丘吉尔小姐只是藏在哪里了呢。
English: Let's go look. Maybe Miss Churchill’s just hiding somewhere.

Chinese: 人们七嘴八舌地说着自己的想法，不管原因是什么，至少这一刻没有人提出不去。
English: Everyone chimed in with their thoughts—whatever the reasons, they all agreed to go.

Chinese: 好吧。请各位和我一起出村，寻找丘吉尔。
English: Fine. Tag along with me. Let's scout for Churchill.

Chinese: 说着，我转头看向桃。
English: I turned to Momo.

Chinese: 你能给我们护佑吗，桃？
English: Can you give us blessings, Momo?

Chinese: ……您的意思，是要向妾身许愿吗？
English: Are you making a wish to me?

Chinese: 是。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 为了丘吉尔小姐，宁可以身涉险？
English: For Churchill's sake, you'd risk your neck?

Chinese: 如果今天陷入危险的是你，我也一样会这么做。
English: If you were in danger today, I'd do the same for you.

Chinese: ……呼。妾身明白了。
English: Phew. Got it.

Chinese: 还请侍主大人不要忘记此刻的许诺。
English: Don't forget this moment, the promise we're making.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我在桃面前低下头，虔诚地向她祈祷。
English: I bowed my head to Momo and prayed in earnest.

Chinese: ——向吾献上祈愿之人，将汝渴望之物启明。
English: Those who offer me prayers will have what they desire.

Chinese: 我希求使同伴平安归来之力量。
English: I hope for the strength to bring my crew home safe and sound.

Chinese: “汝之愿望必将实现。”
English: "Your prayers will be answered. "

Chinese: 伴随着桃的话语，某种力量涌入了我的身体。
English: Momo's chant works like magic, a surge of energy wrapped around me.

Chinese: 那是一种玄妙的感觉，似乎被某个人所拥抱，又像是被从高天之上投下的注视所笼罩。
English: It's an incredible sensation, akin to being cradled in someone's arms while simultaneously being bathed in a celestial gaze.

English: none

Chinese: ……若是您与她正面对上，妾身便会亲自出手。
English: If you're going toe-to-toe, I've got your back.

Chinese: 你不是还没有恢复好吗？
English: But your strength isn't fully restored yet, is it?

Chinese: 呼呼……若是不能护得妾身的信徒周全，神之存在又有何意义？
English: Hehe... What's the use of being a goddess if I can't shield my flock?

Chinese: 谢谢你，桃。
English: Thank you, Momo.

Chinese: 快去吧。若是耽搁了时间，妾身恐怕会后悔。
English: Now, get going. If I stall any longer, I know I'll regret it.

Chinese: 在欺诈之尾的引领下，侍主站到了恶神的面前。

English: none

Chinese: 村外。太阳已经慢慢沉落，余下的温暖一寸寸地抽离了土地。
English: Outside the village. The sun dips below the horizon, and its lingering warmth begins to fade from the earth.

Chinese: 我们高声呼喊丘吉尔的名字，回声在树林与草原间回荡。
English: We shout for Churchill, our calls bouncing off the trees and rolling over the fields.

Chinese: 这里也没有。

Gee?

Chinese: 我一把捞起这个小毛球，把她抱在怀里。

Ugh...

English: Why are you so scared of me? You were pretty bold when you pretended to be Churchill.

Chinese: 因为，骗子，大家都不喜欢。
English: Nobody's got love for fibbers.

Chinese: 那也要分情况。只要别在大事上骗我，我就不会讨厌你。
English: Well, that's up for debate. Keep the tall tales out of things that truly matter, and we're cool.

Chinese: 可那是我的力量……
English: But fibbing's my power…

Chinese: 总之，我现在还不讨厌你。
English: Anyway, I don't dislike you.

Chinese: 为什么？
English: Why?

Chinese: 因为你挺可爱的？
English: Because… you're kinda cute?

Chinese: 侍主大人，竟然，看脸！
English: Lord Oracle, you just judge by appearances!

Chinese: 看脸也不是什么罪过吧。
English: There's nothing wrong with liking a cute face.

Chinese: 欺诈之尾安静下来。她的尾尖在我怀里一扫一扫。
English: The Tail of Deception falls silent, her tail flicking gently over my arm.

Chinese: 侍主大人，你这边怎么样？
English: How's it going on here, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 没找到。
English: Nothing yet.

Chinese: 天色这么晚了，再走下去什么也看不清，不如先回去吧……
English: Night's closing in, tough to make anything out. Maybe we should get back...

Chinese: 说什么呢！我们身上可是有加护的，怎么会怕这个！
English: What's got you jittery? We've got a divine blessing!

Chinese: 不过确实是挺危险的……侍主大人怎么想啊？
English: But indeed, it's kinda risky... What do you think, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 丘吉尔恐怕是真的被带走了。但是，也不能就这么放着她不管……
English: Churchill might've been snatched up. But we can't just leave her hanging...

Chinese: 你们先回去吧。
English: You all go back first.

Chinese: 侍主大人难道要一个人去找吗？！
English: Are you going to search for her alone?!

Chinese: 再往前走，就要跨过安全区了。
English: Go any farther and you'll be outside the safe zone.

Chinese: 就算有桃的加护，也会很危险。
English: Even Momo's magic has its limits.

Chinese: 就算这样，我……
English: Even so... I still have to go.

Chinese: 男人回头看了一眼村子的方向。从这个距离，能看见村子里已经燃起了灯火。
English: The man glanced back toward the village. From this distance, its lights flickered like distant stars.

Chinese: 她们还在等你回去。
English: They're still waiting for you to come home.

Chinese: ……可恶啊！
English: Damn it!

Chinese: 欺诈之尾的视线在我们之间来回转了转，忽然低下头，轻轻咬了咬我的手腕。
English: The Tail of Deception's eyes darted between us. Then she nipped my wrist.

Chinese: 我，能带侍主大人，在安全区外行动。
English: I can guide you, outside the safe zone, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 你？
English: You?

Chinese: 我从那里，逃回来。路很清楚，吱。
English: I escaped from there. I know the way. Gee.

Chinese: 小狐狸望着我，眼睛里流露出恳求的意味。
English: The little fox gazes up, her eyes begging.

Chinese: 好，我相信你。带我去吧。
English: Alright, I believe you. Lead the way.

Chinese: 我们……我也去！
English: We're tagging along!

Chinese: 富贵险中求，富贵险中求……那我也去！儿子你先回去。
English: Fortune favors the bold... Count me in! You'd better head back home, kiddo.

Chinese: 嗯，先派一些人回去报信。
English: Well, let's send a few back to spread the word.

Chinese: 愿意跟来的人，和我一起来。
English: Whoever's game, fall in behind me.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 大约一半的村民选择回去，有些人脸上带着愧疚，有些人则露出安心和庆幸的表情。
English: The ranks are split. Half the villagers turn back, some sheepish, others relieved.

Chinese: 我领着剩下的人，跨过了安全区的范围。
English: I rally the rest, and we venture beyond the safe area.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 越过某条无形的线，空气忽然变得冰冷。
English: As we cross that unseen line, a chill settles in.

Chinese: 入目的所有景物都像是被一只无形的手所扭曲，看起来异样且狰狞。
English: The world around us twists as if warped by some unseen hand, eerie and foreboding.

Chinese: 真是恐怖……桃大人竟是从这样的地方把我救了出去。
English: This place is terrifying... Hard to believe Lord Momo rescued me from somewhere like this.

Chinese: 神会影响自己所居住的领域，这样也很正常。
English: A goddess can influence the realm she inhabits. Par for the course.

Chinese: 我是第一批被桃大人救走的，这还是头回见村外边的样子。她真如神明般强大莫测……
English: I was one of Momo's first saves, never laid eyes on the land outside the village before. She's got that wild goddess vibe?

Chinese: 我还是觉得她就是神明。
English: I still believe she's a true deity.

Chinese: 神的威能可不止这样。
English: The power of a deity goes far beyond this.

Chinese: 真难想象，要变得像她那么强，究竟要消耗多少生命去许愿啊。
English: Hard to imagine how much lifespan it takes to grow that powerful through wishes.

Chinese: 也许代价不止有生命一种。
English: Maybe life isn't the only price.

Chinese: 先左边，然后右边，再右边。从那朵白色的桃花，往前走。
English: Take a left, then a double right. Keep an eye out for those white peach blossoms, then march straight on.

Chinese: 白色的桃花？我没看到。
English: White peach blossoms? Why don't I see them?

Chinese: 再往前，然后往这边……
English: A bit further... then this way...

Chinese: 嘶，有点冷。
English: Brr, can you feel that chill?

Chinese: 呵，钱多事多。
English: Oh, more money, more problems.

Chinese: 什么叫钱多事多，你看我现在还有钱吗？！
English: Why? You reckon I still got deep pockets?

Chinese: 轻点声！小心惊动了……惊动了……总之万一危险呢。
English: Shush! Quiet down! Don't tip off anyone... or anything... Let's not stir up trouble.

Chinese: 然后，一直往前走。
English: Alright, let's keep moving.

Chinese: 侍主……侍主大人……
English: Lord... Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 怎么了？
English: What's the matter?

Chinese: 等我意识到的时候，我身边已经一个人都没有了。
English: By the time I noticed, everyone around me was gone.

Chinese: 而我的面前，彻底混沌的景物正缓慢地扭动着。
English: Before me, the scene of utter chaos was gradually contorting.

Chinese: 欺诈之尾，这就是你带我找到的路吗？
English: Tail of Deception, is this the trail you're leading me down?
Ugh...

Chinese: 你感到后悔吗？
English: Do you regret it?

Chinese: 轻易地相信了欺诈的化身。
English: Believing in the avatar of deception so easily?

Chinese: 为什么要后悔？我选择相信她，就已经做好了被骗的准备。
English: Why would I? I took a leap of faith knowing full well she might pull a fast one.

Chinese: 没有、相信过，我吗……？
English: You never believed in me...?

Chinese: 不，只是做好了万一被骗的准备而已。
English: Nah, I had my guard up just in case.

Chinese: 毕竟，如果你让相信你的人遭遇不幸，会比骗人失败更难过吧？
English: After all, failing to protect someone who trusted in you would make you sadder than failing to deceive someone, wouldn't it?

Chinese: 看来你和她处得很不错呢。
English: Looks like you two hit it off.

Chinese: 过来吧，孩子。
English: Come on over here, kid.

Chinese: （摇头摇头）
English: (Shake head)

Rhaar!!

English: As if sensing Naomi's challenge, the fox bristles, pressing her paws against my thigh in a tense, battle-ready stance.

Chinese: 你什么时候又会驯兽了？
English: Since when did you know how to tame beasts?

Chinese: 算了，不是重点。帮我叫牧过来，桃的事有点麻烦。
English: Never mind, that's not the point. Get Muu over here. Something's seriously wrong with Momo.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在一段毛茸茸的搏斗后，我终于带着桃走到了餐厅。
English: After an exhausting, fur-filled struggle, I finally wrestle Momo into the dining hall.

Chinese: 啊！！饲主大人，你怎么一身都是狐狸的味道！
English: Ah!! Master! Why do you reek of fox?

Chinese: 呃……这个味道让我好不爽……我的味道全都被盖掉了……
English: Ugh… This smell is awful… It's completely smothered my scent!

Chinese: 桃的状态不太对。我想听听你的意见。
English: Momo's condition isn't normal. I need your insight.

Chinese: 我感觉到她的灵魂处在很特殊的状态里，似乎在自我争斗什么，导致出现了异变。
English: I can sense that her soul's in turmoil, likely causing the transformation.

Chinese: 以前的星痕有过这种情况吗？
English: Have any other Aster gone through something like this before?

Chinese: 唔，饲主大人看到的东西也是我看到的，至于星痕有没有出现过这种情况，让我想想……
English: Hmm… whatever you see, I see too. Let me think if this has happened to other Asters.

Chinese: 牧思考片刻后，遗憾地摇了摇头。
English: Muu ponders for a moment before shaking her head.

Chinese: 在我的记忆里是没有的。
English: As far as I know, this has never happened before.

Chinese: 星痕一般是很稳定的，神恩仪式和魔女的灵魂是星痕稳定状态的双保险。
English: Asters are usually stable, with the Divine Grace Ceremony and the Nova's soul acting as dual safeguards.

Chinese: 饲主大人用自己的力量给她们打开了“特例”，使她们平时不需要消耗魔女的灵魂也能存在。
English: But you, Master, granted them a special exception using your own power, allowing them to exist without constantly relying on a Nova's soul.

Chinese: 虽然这很好，但也带来了一些问题。很多时候，饲主大人身边星痕出现的问题，都是历史上从来没有过的。
English: While that's certainly a blessing… it also comes with its own set of challenges. Most of the issues with the Asters around you? Completely unprecedented.

Chinese: 因为保险不存在了，所以规则也跟着需要重新摸索？
English: So, without the built-in safeguards, we have to figure out the new rules as we go?

Chinese: 就是这种意思。
English: Exactly.

Chinese: 所以，你也没什么办法了吗？
English: So, you don't have a solution either?

Chinese: 在我们交谈时，闹累了的桃就坐在我脚边，脑袋亲昵地贴着我。
English: As we talk, Momo, tired from her outburst, curls up at my feet, nuzzling me affectionately.

Chinese: 我摸了摸狐狸的头，又摸了摸牧的头发。
English: I reach down to stroke the fox's head—then, on a whim, ruffle Muu's hair as well.

Chinese: 嗯……要我说的话，桃看起来更像是在做梦。
English: Hmm… if you ask me, Momo seems more like she's lost in a dream.

Chinese: 也许侍主大人进她的梦里去看看，能找到什么线索呢？
English: Master, maybe you'll find some clues if you enter her dream.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 嗨！爱情遇到了困难吗？看来此时正是爱神丘吉尔现身的好时机！
English: Hi! Struggling with love? It seems this is the perfect moment for the great Goddess of Love—Churchill—to make her entrance!

Chinese: 伴随着一团心形的雾气炸开，一位天使凭空出现在我们之间。
English: With a sudden pop of heart-shaped mist, an angel materializes right between us.

Chinese: 当侍主大人遇到困难的时候，就应该叫出我的名——
English: When Lord Oracle is in need, all you must do is call my name—

Chinese: 唔啊啊——
English: Ah… ah…

Chinese: 牧一把抓住丘吉尔的脸，强制静音了她。
English: With a single motion, Muu grabs Churchill's face, effectively muting her.

Chinese: 这里没你的事。
English: This has nothing to do with you.

Chinese: 需要为饲主大人准备入梦的魔法吗？
English: Master, shall I prepare a spell to enter the dream?

Chinese: 说到梦境……我倒是想到了一种可能性。谢谢你，牧。
English: Speaking of dreams… that actually gives me an idea. Thanks, Muu.

Chinese: 丘吉尔，你怎么突然来了？我记得你今天应该是和萨拉一起在筹划日报的事吧。
English: Churchill, why are you here? Weren't you supposed to be working on the daily reports with Sarah today?

Chinese: 听到我问她，牧松开了握着她脸的手。
English: As I speak, Muu finally lets go of Churchill's face.

Chinese: 呼……呼哇……真是残忍，好凶哦审判长……
English: Ugh… Wow!… So cruel… You're so mean, Lord Inquisitor…

Chinese: 我是来申诉的，侍主大人，萨拉大人实在是太无聊了！好无聊，好刻板哦！
English: I came to file a complaint, Lord Oracle! Lady Sarah is just unbearably boring! So dull! So stiff!

Chinese: 怎么感觉在你嘴里大家都有问题……有问题的真的不是你吗？
English: Why does it feel like, in your world, everyone else is the problem… but the actual problem is you?

Chinese: 可是神谕司是充满爱的地方，报纸难道不该是粉红色的吗？
English: But the Oracle Division is all about love! Shouldn't the newspaper be pink?

Chinese: 原色纸更好。
English: Plain paper is better.

Chinese: 呜哇，侍主大人偏心——
English: Ugh! Lord Oracle, you're playing favorites!

Chinese: 总之，我应该有办法进梦境去看看。
English: Anyway, I think I have a way to enter the dream and take a look.

Chinese: 按说不会有什么危险，但一定要现在吗？
English: There shouldn't be any danger… but does it really have to be now?

Chinese: 听奈奥米小姐的日程报告，饲主大人今天要出席节日庆典，如果迟到的话，其他工作人员会很难办的。
English: According to Miss Naomi's schedule report, Master, you're expected at the festival today. If you're late, the staff will be in a bind.

Chinese: 梦里的时间流动很快，按之前的经验，即使是待上一个月现实中也不会过去太久。
English: Time moves quickly in the dream. Based on past experience, even staying a whole month won't mean much time passes in reality.

Chinese: 不过，一起吃顿早餐的时间还是有的。
English: But we've still got time for breakfast.

Chinese: 马恩。
English: Mann.

Chinese: 我去准备，五分钟后就好。
English: I'll get it ready—give me five minutes.

Chinese: 好耶！
English: Hooray!

Chinese: （不悦的咕噜声）
English: (A low, disgruntled growl)

Chinese: （再缓片刻）
English: (Just a moment longer)

Chinese: 既然奈奥米和马恩都没有进来，那就证明现在还早。
English: Since neither Naomi nor Mann has come in yet, it must still be early.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我往窗户的方向挪了挪，然而，狐狸立刻就跟了过来，整只趴在我身上。
English: I shift toward the window, but the fox immediately follows and sprawls across me.
Uh.

Chinese: 不算特别沉重，但分量也不轻。
English: Not too heavy, but definitely not light either.

Chinese: 比重量更要命的是闷热加倍了。
English: More than the weight, though, is the real issue—the stifling heat has practically doubled.

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 少女
English: Girl
"Momo"

Chinese: 桃？
English: Momo?

Chinese: 纯黑
English: Pure Black

Chinese: 纯白
English: Pure White

Chinese: 入梦
English: Into the Dream

Chinese: 侍主与恶神桃僵持时，遇到了熟悉又陌生的她……
English: As Lord Oracle faces off against the so-called Demon Momo, an eerily familiar yet foreign figure appears…

Chinese: 虽然说得很轻松，不过实际走进梦境的时候，我仍然提起了警戒。
English: I spoke lightly of entering the dream, but the moment I stepped in, my instincts went on high alert.

Chinese: ……至于原因——她正站在我的面前。
English: And with good reason. She stands right in front of me.

Chinese: <color=#b22222>你怎么来了？</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Why are you here?</color>

Chinese: <color=#b22222>难道是等不及了，所以赶来见我吗？</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Couldn't wait any longer, so you came to see me instead?</color>

Chinese: 黑色的神明笑着。混沌的雾气蔓延在周围，天空，植物与大地，似乎都受其影响。
English: The dark deity smiles. A creeping mist spreads across the land, twisting the sky, the earth, and all it touches.

Chinese: 桃，这些异象是怎么回事？
English: Momo, what's with all of this?

Chinese: 我向她走去。
English: I step toward her.

Chinese: <color=#b22222>呵呵，不仅不躲开，反而向我走来了吗？</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Oh? Instead of running away, you're approaching me?</color>

Chinese: 就直说吧……桃，你遇到难题了。
English: Let's not dance around the issue—Momo, you're struggling with something, aren't you?

Chinese: <color=#b22222>我遇到的并非难题，而是已经做出了决定。</color>
English: <color=#b22222>This isn't a struggle. I've already made my decision.</color>

Chinese: <color=#b22222>本来，你在外面等等我就好……</color>
English: <color=#b22222>You could have just waited for me outside…</color>

Chinese: <color=#b22222>怎么偏要进来呢？我可是不会放过这个良机的。</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Why insist on coming in? I wouldn't let a chance like this slip by.</color>

Chinese: 你到底在说什么？
English: What are you even talking about?

Chinese: 把话说清楚点，不要拐弯抹角、意有所指的。
English: Enough cryptic remarks—just say what you mean.

Chinese: <color=#b22222>……</color>
English: <color=#b22222>...</color>

Chinese: 她没有继续说下去，轻笑一声，向我扑了过来。
English: She doesn't answer. Instead, with a soft laugh, she lunges straight at me.

Chinese: 天地间瞬间化作一处棋盘，我似乎就被困在一枚漆黑的棋子之中。
English: In an instant, the world shatters into a vast chessboard, and I find myself trapped in a pitch-black piece.

Chinese: （能躲，不难反抗。）
English: (I can dodge. Resisting wouldn't be difficult.)

Chinese: <color=#b22222>呵呵……捉迷藏、捉迷藏……不乖的孩子在哪里？</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Hehe… Hide and seek, hide and seek… Where's the naughty child hiding?</color>

Chinese: 我在经纬之间辗转，与她一追一逃，游走半晌。
English: I weave through the shifting fabric of reality, caught in a fleeting chase with her—now ahead, now behind.

Chinese: （真是熟悉的情景，好在这一次不是锦绣江山……等等。）
English: (This feels… familiar. At least it's not the Splendid World again… Wait.)

Chinese: （那次也是梦境，难道说现在黑桃和平时的桃又分开了？）
English: (That was a dream too. Did Demon Momo and Momo split again?)

Chinese: <color=#b22222>抓住你了~</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Got you.</color>

Chinese: 漆黑的指爪迎面笼罩下来，将我完全盖在她掌心里。
English: Dark, clawed fingers sweep toward me, engulfing me completely in their grasp.

Chinese: <color=#b22222>你就在这里乖乖地等着结果吧……</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Now, be good and wait here for the final outcome…</color>

Chinese: （要是认真，肯定会伤到她。）
English: (If I retaliate with full force, I will hurt her.)

Chinese: （应该怎么做呢……）
English: (So what should I do…?)

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 嚓。一道细长的刀光，一声什么东西被切断的声响。
English: Slash. A thin arc of silver light flashes through the dark, followed by the sharp sound of something being severed.

Chinese: 虚幻的黑色囚笼被打破，天地恢复了本色。
English: The illusionary black prison shatters, and the world around us is restored.

Chinese: <color=#b22222>……</color>
English: <color=#b22222>...</color>

Chinese: <color=#b22222>你还没有放弃啊，小狐狸。</color>
English: <color=#b22222>You're still not giving up, little fox.</color>

Chinese: （小狐狸？克萝萝？）
English: (Little fox? Kuroro?)

Chinese: 顺着恶神桃的视线看去，首先映入眼帘的是一双纤细修长的、属于少女的小腿。
English: Following Demon Momo's gaze, my eyes land on a pair of delicate, slender legs—those of a young girl.

Chinese: 再往上看，是一张神情冰冷的青涩面容。
English: As I look further up, I find myself staring at a cold, expressionless face—youthful, yet sharp.
Momo?

Chinese: 虽然这张脸青涩又冷漠，与我认识的桃完全不同，但毫无疑问，这张脸也是桃。
English: Though colder and more aloof than the Momo I know, there's no doubt—it's still her.

Chinese: 她打量了我一眼，用剑鞘把我拨到她身侧，挺起直刀指向恶神桃。
English: She glances at me, nudges me aside with her sword sheath, and levels her blade at Demon Momo.

Chinese: 九尾狐到底被你藏到哪里去了？
English: Where have you hidden the nine-tailed fox?

Chinese: <color=#b22222>说得好。我又凭什么告诉你呢？</color>
English: <color=#b22222>A fine question. But what makes you think I'd tell you?</color>

Chinese: <color=#b22222>还是说，你找到杀死我的办法了？</color>
English: <color=#b22222>Unless… you've finally found a way to kill me?</color>

Chinese: 似乎是被戳中了什么要害，少女桃的脸色变得铁青。然而，这时她忽然看了我一眼。
English: As if struck by some hidden weakness, Momo's expression shifts—her face turning an ashen shade. But then, her gaze flickers toward me.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 这是你的珍贵之物吧。
English: This… is your precious thing, isn't it?

Chinese: <color=#b22222>你想做什么？</color>
English: <color=#b22222>What are you trying to do?</color>

Chinese: 看来是了。
English: So it seems.

Chinese: 少女桃一把抓住我的手腕，将我扯离了如墨色般包围上来的黑雾牢笼。
English: Momo grabs my wrist and pulls me away from the inky mist closing in around me.

Chinese: 想要回他，就告诉我九尾狐在哪。
English: If you want him back, tell me where the nine-tailed fox is.

Chinese: 丢下这句话，少女桃便抓着我离开了这片弥漫黑雾的王座。
English: Leaving those words behind, she grabs me and pulls me away from that black mist-shrouded throne.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 跟着少女桃跑出了不知道多远，黑雾终于远离了我们。
English: Through unknown terrain—until, at last, the oppressive black mist is nowhere in sight.

Chinese: 我们跑了很远啊。现在算是脱离危险了吗？
English: We ran quite a distance. Does that mean we're safe now?

Chinese: 对你而言可不是。
English: For you? Not in the slightest.

Chinese: 少女桃冷淡地打量着我。
English: Momo regards me with a cold, unreadable stare.

Chinese: 你很镇定。你不怕我吗？
English: You're surprisingly composed. Aren't you afraid of me?

Chinese: 我习惯了突发状况。
English: I've learned to expect the unexpected.

Chinese: 听到我的回答，她皱了皱眉。
English: She frowns at my response, brows furrowing slightly.

Chinese: 一般人在这时候已经开始呼唤神明了，像你这样冷静又不是自暴自弃的人，我还是头一次见。
English: Most people would be calling on their gods by now, but you—calm, yet not giving in to despair—are a rare one.

Chinese: 你是从哪一个国家来？信奉哪一位神明？
English: Which land do you hail from? Which god do you follow?

Chinese: 我没有信仰。
English: I have no faith.

Chinese: 没有信仰？简直就像是说自己不是人类一样夸张。
English: No faith? That's as outrageous as claiming you're not human.

Chinese: 我信仰莉莉娅。
English: I believe in Lillia.

Chinese: 李莉亚……没听过的神明。
English: Lillia… Never heard of such a god.

Chinese: 少女桃完全不相信我的样子。见她这样，我只好抬了抬一直被她握着的手腕。
English: Momo looks at me with clear disbelief. I lift my wrist—the one she is still gripping.

Chinese: 我信仰桃。
English: I believe in Momo.

Chinese: 桃是谁？
English: Momo? And who is that?

Chinese: 少女桃用更怀疑的目光看着我。
English: Her gaze grows even more doubtful.

Chinese: 你叫什么名字？
English: What is your name?

Chinese: 名字？那是凡人的东西。
English: My name? That is something meant for mortals.

Chinese: 那我该怎么称呼你？
English: Then what should I call you?

Chinese: ……杀戮。我是杀戮的化身。
English: Slaughter. I am the embodiment of slaughter.

Chinese: （……对了。桃告诉过我，她的名字是后来才得到的。）
English: (That's right. Momo told me once… she didn't have a name at first.)

Chinese: （这个时候……她还没有名字。）
English: (Back then… she still had no name.)

Chinese: 意识到这一点，我又重新抬起头去看她。
English: Realizing this, I raise my head to look at her again.

Chinese: 她已经不再看着我，而是看着天的另一边，黑雾隐隐约约侵蚀的地方。
English: She no longer looks at me, her gaze fixed on the horizon, where the black mist steadily encroaches.

Chinese: 你去找那个神，是为了什么？
English: Why are you seeking that god?

Chinese: 这个世界正被她危害着。我要杀死她，还这个世界以和平。
English: This world is drowning in her corruption. I will kill her and return this world to peace.

Chinese: 还是说，你找到杀死我的办法了？
English: Unless… you've finally found a way to kill me?

Chinese: 但她似乎认为……你杀不掉她。
English: But from what I can tell… she doesn't believe you can.

Chinese: 那不是你该考虑的事情。你只要在这里做好人质的职责就够了。
English: That's not your concern. Just stay here and be a good hostage.

Chinese: 我只是个初来乍到的旅人，你拿我当人质，怎么可能成功呢？
English: I'm just a traveler who happened to find his way here. You think taking me hostage will actually work?

Chinese: 一个初来乍到的旅人，能走到恶神的巢穴去，你在开什么玩笑？
English: A mere traveler… who somehow walked straight into the demon's lair? Don't make me laugh.

Chinese: 事实是最好的答案，我就是出现在那里了。
English: The truth is simple: I was there. That's all that matters.

Chinese: 她不再说话，像是在思索什么。我也乐得在这时候等待她的答案。
English: She falls silent, as if mulling something over. I am happy to wait for her response.

Chinese: 那么你为什么会出现在那儿？
English: Then tell me—why were you there?

Chinese: 我来找我的爱人。
English: I was looking for my beloved.

Chinese: 那是恶神的巢穴，除了恶神之外什么也没有。
English: That place was the demon's domain. Nothing existed there but her.

Chinese: 你的爱人是那个恶神？
English: So are you telling me… she is your beloved?

Chinese: 我想这个答案不太对。
English: That's not entirely correct.

Chinese: 你，恶神，还有你提到的“九尾狐”，合在一起，才算是我的爱人。
English: You, the demon, and the nine-tailed fox—together, you're the one I love.

Chinese: 在我说完的刹那，一把刀横在我的颈间。
English: A blade crosses my throat the moment I finish speaking.

Chinese: 锋利的剑锋轻吻我的脖颈，带来些微灼烧感。衣领被微微沾湿。
English: It's sharp enough to leave a faint, searing burn in its wake. A warm trickle dampens my collar.

Chinese: 是你要我回答，现在又是你在生气。
English: You asked me for an answer. Now you're the one getting upset.

Chinese: 这是很难接受的事吗，“桃”？
English: Is it really that hard to accept… "Momo"?

Chinese: 一派胡言。
English: Nonsense.

Chinese: 你和恶神本为一体，不觉得奇怪吗？
English: You and the demon are one and the same. Don't you find it strange?

Chinese: 她什么时候对人这么好，任由对方和她捉迷藏这么久，却不下杀手？
English: When has she ever had the patience to play hide-and-seek for so long without striking to kill?

Chinese: 你不好奇我是怎么出现在那里的吗？
English: Aren't you curious how I got there?

Chinese: 无论你说什么，我对你毫无印象，只觉得你是个轻浮之人。
English: I don't care what you say—you strike me as nothing but a flirt.

Chinese: 你除了皮囊好看，有好身手之外，没什么特别的地方，我又怎就爱上你了？
English: Except your good looks and impressive skills, there's nothing special about you. So how could I have fallen for you?

Chinese: 你等待着一个人把你带出梦境，结束无望的等待。然后我来了，我带走了你。
English: You were waiting for someone to take you out of the dream and end your endless waiting. Then I came and took you away.

Chinese: ……一派胡言。为什么我要离开？
English: Nonsense. Why would I leave?

Chinese: 可你最后就是离开了。我也很好奇你离开的理由，但这是既定的事实。
English: But you did leave. I'm also curious about why you left, but that's an undeniable fact.

Chinese: 真是荒谬……这种答案叫我怎么相信？
English: It makes no sense. How am I supposed to believe you?

Chinese: 你可以慢慢观察和了解我，确认我是不是个值得相信的人。
English: Take your time to observe and get to know me, then you'll see whether I'm trustworthy.

Chinese: 以神明的权能，不难做到吧。
English: With divine power, that shouldn't be difficult.

Chinese: ……看起来人模人样，竟然这样轻狂孟浪。
English: You look like a decent guy, yet you act so frivolous.

Chinese: 她收回剑坐在一边。因为她的个子实在太小，我也不得不被她牵着一起坐下了。
English: She withdraws her sword and sits down. Because she's so small, I have no choice but to sit down with her as she pulls me along.

Chinese: 我说的都是真的。
English: Everything I said is true.

Chinese: 过了片刻，她转过脸来，苦恼又认真地看着我的脸。
English: After a moment, she turns to study my face, looking troubled yet serious.

Chinese: 所以，你是怎么出现在这里的？
English: So, how did you get here?

Chinese: （忍俊不禁）
English: (Suppress laughter)

Chinese: 你笑什么！
English: What's so funny?

Chinese: 竟敢戏耍神明。
English: How dare you toy with me!

Chinese: 少女恼羞成怒，立起了眉头。
English: The girl frowns, both angry and embarrassed.

Chinese: 伤口很痒……
English: The wound itches…

Chinese: 痒吗，我可以让你永远都不再痒。
English: Really? I can make sure you never itch again.

Chinese: 咳，我们还有要紧的事要说……
English: Ahem, we have more pressing matters to discuss…

Chinese: 因为我和桃——我是指你们融合起来的那一位，有契约的牵系，所以我能出现在这里。
English: I was able to get here because I'm bound by covenant with Momo—the one you merged into.

Chinese: 她现在在外面变成了九尾狐的形态，完全失去了理智，我来是为了找到她异变的理由。
English: She's turned into a nine-tailed fox and lost control. I'm here to find out why.

Chinese: 这就是你出现在这里的原因？
English: So that's why you're here?

Chinese: 是啊。
English: That's right.

Chinese: ……我不明白。
English: I don't understand.

Chinese: 也许等找到九尾狐，我们就会得到答案了。
English: Maybe we'll get our answer once we find the nine-tailed fox.

Chinese: ……或许吧。
English: Fair enough.

Chinese: 走吧，我们得尽快找到它才行。
English: Let's go. We need to find it quickly.

Chinese: 说着，她松开了一直抓着我不放的手。
English: She finally lets go of my hand.

Chinese: 这算是信任我了？
English: Does this mean she trusts me now?

Chinese: 你说是我的信徒，是吗？
English: You said you were my follower, right?

Chinese: 当然。
English: Of course.

Chinese: 她伸手按在我的小腹上，一阵冰冷后，她挪开手，留下一个发光的印记。
English: She presses her palm to my abdomen—cold seeps in, then she pulls away, leaving a glowing mark.

Chinese: 这是神明的印记。我将注视着你，无论你要去哪里。
English: This is a divine mark. No matter where you go, I'll be watching.

Chinese: ……一定要在这个位置吗？
English: Did it have to be placed here?

Chinese: 怎么了？
English: Is that a problem?

Chinese: （唉……恶作剧是你的某种本性吗？）
English: (Sigh… Is mischief just part of your nature?)

Chinese: 算了……出发吧。
English: Never mind… Let's go.

Chinese: （直言以告）
English: (Tell her outright)

Chinese: 你看起来不像坏人。
English: You don't seem like a bad person.
