English: The Goddess of Slaughter and Lord Oracle enter the depths of the dream together. She's intrigued by Lord Oracle's story.

Chinese: 所以……虽然你是杀戮之神，但你擅长的只有剥夺生命。
English: So, even though you're the goddess of slaughter, the only thing you excel at is taking lives.

Chinese: 你一定要在这种时候、强调这件事吗？
English: Do you have to emphasize that right now?

Chinese: 没有嘲讽你的意思，只是有点意外。
English: I wasn't mocking you, just a little surprised.

Chinese: ……意外于你竟然……

English: <size=40>Shut up!</size>

English: I raise my hands in surrender and crouch down to untangle the vines wrapped around her feet.

Chinese: 这些藤蔓老韧虬结，不容易斩开，也很难解开——早就断了，剥夺生命更是不起作用。
English: These vines are old and tough, hard to cut and even harder to unravel. They're long dead, immune to life-draining powers.

Chinese: （不过其实不难解开，知道窍门就很容易了。）
English: (But honestly, they aren't that hard to untangle once you know the trick.)

Chinese: 解开了。
English: There, it's done.

Chinese: ……谢谢。
English: Thank you.

Chinese: 不客气。这是猎人设置的陷阱，既然有这么多，看样子离村子不远了。
English: You're welcome. These are traps set by hunters. Given how many there are, the village must be close.

Chinese: （真没想到居然能全部都踩了……）
English: (Seriously, how did she manage to trigger every single one…?)

Chinese: 听你的意思，你来过这儿？
English: It sounds like you've been here before.

Chinese: 算是我和你定情的地方吧。
English: It's where you and I made our vow.

Chinese: 别再这么说了，听起来很奇怪。
English: Don't say it like that. It sounds weird.

Chinese: 好吧，这是我和桃定情的地方。
English: Alright, then it's where Momo and I made our vow.

Chinese: 那是一场绮丽的相遇，就像梦一样。
English: It was a dazzling encounter, like a dream.

Chinese: ……你爱她什么？
English: What do you love about her?

Chinese: 她强大的力量，还是脸，或者个性？
English: Her immense power? Her face? Or her personality?

Chinese: 综合起来吧。
English: All of it.

Chinese: 我喜欢她的每一个地方。
English: I love everything about her.

Chinese: 这回答太敷衍了。
English: That's not even a real answer.

Chinese: 能够用一两个理由说清的爱，可能只是一种需要。爱是不讲道理的东西。
English: If love can be explained with a reason or two, it's probably not love—just a need. Love itself isn’t rational.

Chinese: 比如说，就连你现在不信任我，随时准备对我动手，我也觉得你很可爱。
English: For example, even though you don't trust me and might attack me at any moment, I still find you adorable.

Chinese: 我不明白。
English: I don't get it.

Chinese: 好吧，那我们先走。小心陷阱。拉着我的手，从这边走。
English: Alright, let's just keep moving. Watch out for traps. Hold my hand and walk this way.

Chinese: 对，踩着我的脚印。
English: Yes, follow my footsteps.

Chinese: 或许是刚才连续中陷阱吃足了苦头，少女这次乖乖按我说的做了。
English: Having suffered enough from the traps earlier, the girl obediently follows my lead.

Chinese: 她的个头还没长足，只是初见未来丰盈美丽的影子。
English: She is still maturing, just starting to show a hint of the elegance she'll have one day.

Chinese: 我牵着她，像在领着一只幼狐。
English: Leading her by the hand feels like guiding a young fox.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 你在想什么？
English: What are you thinking?

Chinese: 我在想你看起来确实比桃小得多。
English: I was thinking that you do look much smaller than Momo.

Chinese: ……所以，你为什么喜欢她？
English: So, why do you like her?

Chinese: 你怎么总执着于这个原因？
English: Why are you so hung up on that?

Chinese: 她是未来的你，你是过去的她……总有一天你会明白的。
English: She is your future, and you are her past… One day, you will understand.
I…

Chinese: 算了，跟你这种没有信仰又不肯痛快回答的狂人没话好讲。
English: Never mind, I have nothing to say to a faithless madman who won't give a straight answer.

Chinese: 半天前不是才确认了我是你的信徒吗？为此还给了我一个印记——神明大人？
English: Didn't you confirm just several hours ago that I was your follower? You even gave me a mark for it. Have you forgotten?

Chinese: 那是战术需要。
English: That was for tactical purposes.

Chinese: 好吧，不逗你了。其实，我也弄不明白。
English: Alright, no more jokes. Actually, I don't understand it either.

Chinese: 要论容貌，桃确实美丽；但我见过很多美丽之人。
English: Momo is indeed beautiful. But I've seen many beautiful people.

Chinese: 有的如玫瑰般艳丽张扬……
English: Some are as dazzling as roses...

Chinese: 也有的像太阳一般明亮纯粹。
English: Others shine as brightly and purely as the sun.

Chinese: 若说力量，我也见过更加强大之人。
English: If it's about power, I've seen even stronger individuals.

Chinese: 掌握着天界一神之下、万神子之上力量的神仆。
English: Servant of God wielding power just below Lord God and above all Divinitas.

Chinese: 也有某个时代最强大的魔女，敢将武器指向至高的神灵。
English: And there's a Nova so powerful, she dared to raise her weapon against the highest Divine Spirit.

Chinese: 个性这东西就更难说了，每一位都有可爱之处。
English: Personality is even harder to define. Everyone has their own charm.

Chinese: 有将自己一生都用来等待的至纯至真之人……
English: Some dedicate their entire lives to waiting, sincere and unwavering...

Chinese: 也有用尽计谋与算计，掀起偌大波澜，只为确认心意的魔女。
English: While others scheme and manipulate, creating chaos just to be sure of their feelings.

Chinese: 谋略，言谈，经历……每个人更是完全不同。
English: Strategy, speech, experiences… each person is entirely unique.

Chinese: 如果你没有吹牛，那你确实见多识广。
English: If you're not exaggerating, you've truly seen a lot.

Chinese: 既然有这么多人都凌驾在桃之上，或者和她各有千秋，你又为什么爱桃？
English: With so many others who outshine Momo, or are at least her equal, what is it about her that you love?

Chinese: 所以爱才奇怪。我见过那么多的人，每一项都不难挑出比她更优秀的存在。
English: That's what makes love so strange. Having met countless people, I can always find someone who surpasses her in some way.

Chinese: 她沉默着，走到我的前面去了。
English: She falls silent and walks ahead of me.

Chinese: 我看着她的后脑，浓紫色的卷发镶着阳光的金边，跟着少女的动作不住地跳跃着。
English: I look at the back of her head. Her dark purple curls edged with golden sunlight bounce with her movements.

Chinese: 在我认识桃的时间里，桃从不会这样——我从未感到她的过去离我如此之近，触手可及。
English: Momo has never acted like this before—and never has her past felt so close, so within reach.

Chinese: （走过去和她并肩）
English: (Walk up beside her)

Chinese: 我加快脚步走到她身边，她看了我一眼，加快步子，我也再次跟着她加速。
English: I quicken my pace to walk beside her. She glances at me, then speeds up again. I follow suit.

Chinese: 别再快了，你还想再踩几个陷阱？
English: Slow down. Do you want to step into another trap?

Chinese: 就算踩了又怎么样？
English: So what if I do?

Chinese: ……我会再帮你解开的。
English: I'll help you out of it again.

Chinese: 我问得不是这个！
English: That's not what I meant!

Chinese: 算了！你总是说些恼人的话！
English: Forget it! You always say such annoying things!

Chinese: 虽然这么说，她却放慢了步伐，让我追上。
English: Despite her words, she slows down so I can catch up.

Chinese: （拉住她的手）
English: (Grab her hand)

Chinese: 放开。
English: Let go.

Chinese: 我想跟上你的步子可不容易，帮帮我吧，神明大人。
English: It's not easy keeping up with you. Give me a hand, please.

Chinese: 这样紧绷的桃太少见了，在安慰之前，我又卖了个乖。
English: Momo rarely looks so tense. Before comforting her, I play along a bit more.

Chinese: 她扭开头去，不愿意看我。
English: She turns her head away, refusing to look at me.

Chinese: 不用拉着我，你也能走得很快。
English: You can walk just as fast without taking my hand.

Chinese: 你不需要我的赐福，也不用管我的问题。
English: You don't need my blessing, nor should you care about my troubles.

Chinese: 生气了？
English: Are you angry?

Chinese: ……这有什么好生气的，没有生气。
English: There's nothing to be angry about. I'm not angry.

Chinese: 像是为了佐证她“没有生气”的话语，她没有再试图甩开我的手，任由我牵着放慢了步子。
English: As if to prove her words, she doesn't try to shake off my hand again.

Chinese: 我还没有说完刚刚的回答呢。不想听了？
English: I haven't finished answering your question yet. Don't you want to hear it anymore?

Chinese: 想说就说，我没说我不想听。
English: If you want to say it, then say it. I never said I didn't want to hear it.

Chinese: 那么，我就继续说了。
English: Then I'll continue.

Chinese: 少女头顶的狐狸耳朵诚实地向我转过来。
English: The fox ears atop her head twitch toward me.

Chinese: 虽然每一项都不难挑出比她更优秀的存在，但是，当这些东西聚合在桃的身上，我发现我爱着她。
English: Although I can find someone better than Momo in every aspect, when all those traits come together in her, I realize I love her.

Chinese: 所以综合所有的方面，她是最好的那个？
English: So, combining everything, she's the best?

Chinese: “好”是很主观的东西，我很难说谁是“最好”的那个。
English: "Best" is subjective. I can't say who is the best.

Chinese: 但我确定我爱她。
English: But I am sure that I love her.

Chinese: 你怎么能确定？
English: How can you be so sure?

Chinese: 因为爱不是比对之后的最优选择，而是一种感觉，它太主观。
English: Because love isn't about choosing the best option. It's a feeling, entirely personal.

Chinese: 我知道我喜欢和她一起漫步在夕阳下，那是我们很珍贵的回忆。
English: I know I love walking with her at sunset. Those moments are precious to me.

Chinese: 我也知道我喜欢握着她的手，喜欢和她独处。每一次她来到我身边，我都很感谢她。
English: I know I love holding her hand, being alone with her. Every time she comes to me, I feel grateful.

Chinese: ……我不理解……
English: I don't understand.

Chinese: 爱会诞生需要，但爱本身不是一种需要。
English: Love may create needs, but love itself is not a need.

Chinese: 不。
English: No.

Chinese: 她一转迷茫的态度，果断地表达了否决。
English: She swiftly rejects the idea, shaking off her confusion.

Chinese: 因为需要，所以会爱。人类就是这样爱着神明的。
English: Love comes from need. That's how humans love gods.

Chinese: 信徒们需要我，所以爱我。
English: My followers need me, so they love me.

Chinese: 这不是同一种爱。
English: That's not the same kind of love.

Chinese: ……完全没法理解，你简直在说一种异世界的东西。
English: I can't understand this at all. You're talking about something from another world.

Chinese: 那就先不说这个了。
English: Then let's drop the topic for now.

Chinese: 你看，我们要到了。
English: Look, we're almost there.

Chinese: 让主上担忧，实在是妾身的失职——我们回去吧。

English: I have never thought of this as ugly.

English: Don't you want a better Momo?

English: This is the best Momo there is.

English: I... I'm a goddess made up of everyone's prayers.

Chinese: 不是说这次旅途漫长，是说在梦外的那个早晨，可真是漫长。
English: The journey itself doesn't feel so long, but the morning outside the dream… It felt like it would never end.

Chinese: 妾身专注于自身意念的分离，外界之事，倒是不曾注意……
English: I was so focused on separating my consciousness that I barely paid attention to the outside world…

Chinese: 这段时间，外界可是遇到了什么麻烦？
English: Was there any trouble while I was away?

Chinese: 在你离开的这一个早晨里，发生了很多事。
English: A lot happened in the single morning.

Chinese: 下午有节日的庆典，我想和你一起去，可是狐狸穿不上准备好的礼服。
English: There's a festival this afternoon. I want to go with you, but a fox can't wear the evening dress I prepared.
Hmm...

Chinese: 桃露出了有些疑惑的神色，没有立刻回答。
English: Momo looks puzzled, not answering right away.

Chinese: 你不在，萨拉也不怎么管得住丘吉尔。你再不回去，下周神谕司的报纸就会变成嫩粉色了。
English: Without you around, Sarah couldn't keep Churchill under control. I'm afraid next week's gazette would be printed in pastel pink.

Chinese: 她的嘴唇抿着，努力忍着笑，耳尖却快活地摆了摆。
English: Her lips press together as she tries to stifle a laugh, but the tips of her ears twitch happily.

Chinese: 那一大蓬尾巴向我偏过来，流淌的光色恍惚如霞。
English: Her tails sway toward me, their shimmering colors as soft as the evening glow.

Chinese: 牧来过，和我一起吃了早餐。
English: Muu came over and had breakfast with me.

Chinese: 本来是很快乐的事，可是本来会坐在我身边的另一个人却没有在。
English: It should've been a pleasant moment, but the seat beside me, where someone should have been, is empty.

Chinese: 说着，我握住她的手。
English: As I speak, I reach for her hand.

Chinese: 和我一起去下午的节日庆典吧。
English: Come with me to the festival this afternoon.

Chinese: 她的手在我手里抖了抖，缓慢又坚定地回握紧了。
English: Her fingers tremble slightly in mine. Then slowly and firmly, she tightens her grip.

Chinese: 妾身，自然是愿意的。
English: I would love to.

Chinese: 这般良辰，怎能不伴在妾身的主上身边？
English: On such a special occasion, how could I not be by your side?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 桃姐姐！桃姐姐回来了！
English: Miss Momo! Miss Momo is back!

Chinese: 当我们回到村子，小女孩是第一个发现我们的。她高兴地跑过来，先抱了抱我的腿，然后又抱了抱桃的腿。
English: As we return to the village, the little girl is the first to spot us. She runs over, hugging my leg first, then Momo's.

Chinese: 侍主哥哥好厉害！桃姐姐真的恢复正常了！
English: You're amazing, Lord Oracle! Miss Momo is really back to normal!

Chinese: 哎哟喂，怎么又回来了……
English: Hmph… Why are they back again…?

Chinese: 你鬼鬼祟祟说什么呢？
English: What are you mumbling about over there?

Chinese: 那，那当然是祝贺侍主大人与桃大人顺利归来！
English: N-Nothing! Just… congratulating Lord Oracle and Lady Momo on their safe return!

Chinese: 都好就好啊，都好就好……
English: It's good that everything's fine now.

Chinese: 不会说话就一边儿去！
English: If you can't talk properly, then shoo!

Chinese: 侍主大人，桃大人，欢迎回来！这几天还住村子里吗？
English: Lord Oracle, Lady Momo, welcome back! Will you be staying in the village for a few days?

Chinese: 住下吧，多住一阵子，今晚村子里开个庆祝会，摆摆宴席。
English: Stay a while longer! We're having a feast tonight to celebrate.

Chinese: 谢谢你们的好意，不过还是下一次吧。
English: Thank you for your kindness, but maybe next time.

Chinese: 我牵着桃的手，稍微举高了些。
English: I lift Momo's hand slightly in mine.

Chinese: 我们还有事要做！
English: We still have things to do!

Chinese: 呼呼……
English: Whoosh...

Chinese: 草叶被吹过我们之间，纤细的光影浮动着散开，一片叶子承着阳光，映亮了神明遮藏的眼眸。
English: A breeze stirs the grass between us, scattering light and shadow. A leaf catches the sunlight, reflecting in the deity's veiled eyes.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 侍主大人醒了！
English: Lord Oracle is awake!

Chinese: 呼……饲主大人，欢迎回来！
English: Phew. Welcome back, Master!

Chinese: 我们回来了。
English: We're back.

Chinese: 我抱了抱扑过来的牧，又摸了一下丘吉尔的脑袋。
English: I hug Muu as she rushes over, then pat Churchill's head.

Chinese: 奈奥米，现在还来得及为桃准备一套礼服吗？
English: Naomi, is there still time to prepare an evening dress for Momo?

Chinese: 我明白了。在主人和桃小姐进入准备室时，礼服会放在那里。
English: Got it. By the time you and Miss Momo enter the dressing room, the dress will be ready.

Chinese: 呼呼……感谢你，奈奥米小姐。
English: Phew… Thank you, Miss Naomi.

Chinese: 咳咳，都没什么事的话，我就先回去了。不然待会儿小克蕾尔又要怀疑我在偷懒。
English: Ahem. Well, if there's nothing else, I gotta go. If I stay too long, little Claire will suspect I'm slacking off again.

Chinese: 好，晚上再见。
English: Alright, see you tonight.

Chinese: 那么我也先行告退了。
English: Then I'll take my leave as well.

Chinese: 丘吉尔，你也先出去吧，留我和桃聊一聊。
English: Churchill, you should go too. I'd like to talk with Momo alone.

Chinese: 哦哦！那种羁绊事件密谈对吧？
English: Ohh! A deep and meaningful event scene, huh?

Chinese: 要充分地让爱包围你们两个哦！
English: Make sure both of you are surrounded by love!

Chinese: 丘吉尔一手举起报纸，另一手推着奈奥米，两人一同离开了房间。
English: Churchill lifts her newspaper with one hand while pushing Naomi out the door with the other.

Chinese: 现在只剩我们两个人了。
English: Now, it's only the two of us.

Chinese: 是呢……
English: Yes...

Chinese: 现在还会觉得心里不舒服吗？
English: Do you still feel uneasy?

Chinese: 我要你诚实地告诉我。
English: I want you to tell me the truth.

Chinese: ……自然还是会有的。
English: Of course, I still do.

Chinese: 但，妾身并不恐慌，也不再厌恶自己了。
English: But I no longer fear it, nor do I despise myself anymore.

Chinese: 即使妾身有着黑暗和野性的一面，不甚美丽，主上也会喜欢妾身。
English: Even if I have darkness and wildness within me, you will still love me.

Chinese: 妾身啊，也真是滑稽。
English: How laughable I was.

Chinese: 此事一直摆在面前，妾身偏生就是未能瞧见……
English: This truth has always been before me, yet I was blind to it…

Chinese: 爱让你成了盲眼的狐狸，这也可以理解。
English: Love made you a blind little fox. It's understandable.

Chinese: 主上尽管取笑妾身。既然这样，那妾身日后被冷落时若是报复主上，主上可不许躲了。
English: You may mock me all you like. But if that is the case, then when you neglect me in the future, you must not avoid my revenge.

Chinese: 我怎么觉得你已经想好计划了？
English: Why do I feel like you've already planned it out?

Chinese: 呼呼……纵使惩罚，也会是甜蜜的，主上不必忧心。
English: Huh… Even a punishment will be sweet. You don't need to worry.

Chinese: ……我能提前申请减刑吗？
English: Can I apply for a lighter sentence in advance?

Chinese: 那便请您再说一遍梦中的话吧。
English: Then you need only say those words from the dream again.

Chinese: 哪一句来着？
English: Which ones?

Chinese: 我喜欢你的每一个地方。
English: I love everything about you.

Chinese: 还有一句呢，主上。
English: There's one more, my lord.

Chinese: 还有最重要的——
English: The most important one—

Chinese: 我喜欢和你一起漫步在夕阳下，那是我们很珍贵的回忆。
English: I love walking with you at sunset. Those moments are precious to me.

Chinese: 她眼波流转，含苞待放。
English: Her eyes shimmer, soft as petals about to bloom.

Chinese: 那么，汝之愿望……必将实现。
English: Then, your wish… shall be granted.

Chinese: 床边两人相依的影子融成一处。
English: By the bedside, two shadows melt into one.

Chinese: 落花流水，春光似梦。
English: Petals fall, the water flows, springtime's dream in soft light glows.

Chinese: 熟悉的感觉终于回来了。
English: The familiar feeling is finally back.

Chinese: 每一次你来到我身边，我都很感谢你。
English: Every time you come to me, I feel grateful.

Chinese: 晚安。
English: Good night.

Chinese: 侍主召唤出了一位特别的星痕，只是……她和想象中不太一样？
English: Lord Oracle has summoned a special Aster... though she’s not quite what anyone had imagined.

Chinese: 不知什么时候下起了雨。
English: The rain begins to fall before anyone notices.

Chinese: 饲、饲主大人，您慢点呀——
English: Master, can we slow down a bit?

Chinese: 嗯……我太着急了。
English: I can't help it, I'm getting ahead of myself.

Chinese: 牧正捧着一支瓶子，瓶子里有一团灰色的光。雨水滴滴哒哒地打在瓶子上，那团光则缩在瓶底，像在躲着那声音。
English: Muu clutches a bottle with a quivering orb of grey light. Each raindrop seems to make the orb cower further.

Chinese: 我抬起头，云层浓得像刚洗过墨的水，瞧不见一点儿月光。
English: I glance skyward, the clouds are a thick smear of ink, hiding any trace of the moon.

Chinese: 一时半会儿停不了……
English: The rain won't let up any time soon.

Chinese: 魔法阵可能会影响这份回响的有序程度，只能先淋着了，呜……
English: The magic circle may affect the orderliness of this Echo, so for the moment, I can only endure the rain. Ugh...

Chinese: 牧看向我。雨水顺着她的刘海滴到脸上，可怜兮兮的。
English: Muu looks at me. Her soaked bangs drip onto her face, making her look rather forlorn.

Chinese: 我脱下大衣，举到我们两个的头顶。
English: I shrug off my coat and hold it over us.

Chinese: 走吧。
English: Let's go.

Chinese: 她抬起头，开心地冲我笑了笑。久违地，竟觉得她有点傻。
English: She peeks up and grins, a goofy expression I hadn't seen in ages.

Chinese: 笑什么？淋雨很开心吗？
English: What's so funny? You like getting drenched?

Chinese: 嘿嘿。
English: Hee hee.

Chinese: 我们没再闲聊，就这么慢慢地走向圣殿。
English: We trudge on in silence, making our way back to the Sanctuary.

Chinese: 呼，到家咯！
English: Finally, we're back!

Chinese: 小心瓶子。你先别动，我去拿回响水晶。
English: Watch that bottle. Hang tight, I'll grab the Echo Crystal.

Chinese: 我从抽屉里取出回响水晶，用袖子擦了擦，递到瓶口。
English: I take out the Echo Crystal from the drawer, give it a good wipe with my sleeve, and line it up with the bottle's mouth.

Chinese: 那团光芒像是受到了指引，一缕一缕地向水晶中涌去。不一会儿，所有的光芒都被它吞没了。
English: The light inside seems to know where to go, streaming into the crystal bit by bit. Soon, it's all inside.

Chinese: 我细细端详着回响水晶。它躺在我手心里，凉丝丝的，一闪一闪，发出黯淡的灰光。
English: I turn the Echo Crystal over in my hand, its cool surface flickering with a soft grey glow.

Chinese: 这样贝卡丝的回响就被保护起来了？
English: Beccas's Echo is safe now, right?

Chinese: 嗯……现在就安全了。
English: Well... it's safe now.

Chinese: 我正用手指摩挲着这颗晶石，突然感觉到腰被环住了。
English: As I fiddle with the crystal, I suddenly feel arms wrap around my waist.

Chinese: 唔……饲主大人。
English: Master,

Chinese: 辛苦啦。
English: you've been working so hard.

Chinese: 我摸了摸牧的脑袋。雨水混着汗水，她的头发也糊成一团糟了。
English: I ruffle Muu's damp hair, now a tangled mess from the rain.

Chinese: 快去洗个澡。
English: Go shower.

Chinese: 不碍事啦，不会生病的！
English: I'm fine, really!

Chinese: 湿乎乎的，手感并不好。
English: It's all wet and uncomfortable.

Chinese: 那我现在就去！
English: Fine, I'll shower!

Chinese: 饲主大人，要不要……一起？
English: Wanna come with me?

Chinese: 当然——不要。
English: Sure—no, I mean no.

Chinese: 诶——您以前经常给人家洗澡的嘛！
English: You used to bathe me all the time!

Chinese: ……那时候你还是一条狗。
English: That was when you were still a pup.

Chinese: 现在难道是两条？汪？
English: So, I'm not your pup anymore? Woof?

Chinese: 好了，别闹。一会儿还要召唤呢。
English: Don't be ridiculous. I'll summon you soon.

Chinese: 那您得补偿我——您得给我梳毛！
English: Then you owe me one—you've gotta brush my hair!

Chinese: 好吧好吧，快去。
English: Alright, alright, get on with it.

Chinese: 嘿嘿！得逞~
English: Hee hee! Getting away with it!

Chinese: 牧冲进了浴室，我不自觉地看向回响水晶。不知为何，灰色的光虽然让它看上去并不起眼，却总吸引着我的视线。
English: Muu zips into the bathroom, and I find myself staring at the Echo Crystal. That grey glow has a way of catching my eye, subtle as it is.

Chinese: ♪我爱饲主~饲主爱我~
English: ♪I love my Master. And the Master loves me back!

Chinese: 饲主大人，我洗好啦！该您了~
English: Master, I'm done showering! It's your turn.

Chinese: 这么快？
English: So fast?

Chinese: 花两秒钟，用水系魔法制作一盆热水；再花两秒钟，用木元素和火元素混合反应，把生成物加入水中；跳进去，花五秒钟旋转！
English: In 2 seconds, I whip up a pot of hot water with a bit of water magic, then zap some wood and fire elements together, mixing them into the water in another 2 seconds. I jump in and do a quick twirl with a little wind magic in 5 seconds.

Chinese: 然后跳出来，两秒钟，水魔法！五秒钟，旋转甩干！风魔法，吹干！
English: Then I hop out in 2 seconds with water magic. In just 5 seconds, I've finished spinning and drying! I use wind magic to blow my body dry!

Chinese: 怎么啦？
English: What is it?

Chinese: 会魔法的狗，一定是世界上洗澡最快的生物吧……
English: Magic-using dogs must be the world champs of quick baths...

Chinese: 那个，梳毛？说好的梳毛呢？对了，梳子……
English: Hey, what about brushing my hair? You promised. Right, the brush...

Chinese: 她跳过去，用嘴叼起梳子，然后跑回来，一边用手扒拉着我，一边“呜呜”地叫。
English: She bounds over, comb in mouth, and tugs at me, whimpering.

Chinese: 我伸手取下梳子，看着梳子上沾着的口水，哭笑不得。
English: I take the slobbery comb from her, a bit taken aback.

Chinese: 好好拿不行吗，非要作怪？
English: Why not just hand it over like a normal girl instead of playing fetch?

Chinese: 听说失忆的人要是经历一些熟悉的事，脑子里就会划过一道闪电！唰！然后就都想起来了！
English: They say a familiar experience can jolt an amnesiac's memory! Voilà! And then they remember it all!

Chinese: 您想起来没？以前我还是一条狗的时候，就是这个样子的！
English: Got any memories coming back? That's how I did things when I was still a pup!

Chinese: ……想起来了。
English: I see...

Chinese: 真的？真想起来了？
English: Really? Do you, though?

Chinese: 啊！好痛……
English: Ahhh! Ouch—

Chinese: 想起来个头啊！
English: Remember my foot!

Chinese: 我用梳子敲了一下牧的头，然后捧着她的脸，开始给她梳头。
English: I give Muu a playful tap with the comb, then brushing her hair.

Chinese: 说起来……饲主大人还记得在回响中发生的事吗？
English: By the way... do you recall anything from the Echo?

Chinese: 只记得一些关键的东西……比如，为什么要进去，怎么样才能把回响带回来……之类的。
English: I've got bits and pieces... like why we went in there, how to bring the Echo out... stuff like that.

Chinese: 啊？那……您、您不记得贝卡丝了？
English: Huh? What about Beccas, though?

Chinese: 唔……我和她很熟悉吗？
English: Beccas... do I know her?

Chinese: 我只记得，我们找到了她的回响。至于为什么找，怎么找到的……
English: All I've got is that we found her Echo. No idea why we searched for it or how we stumbled upon it...

Chinese: 嘶……和之前还不太一样，脑子里有些东西像是整整齐齐地丢掉了。
English: Shh... it's not like before. Feels like someone's wiped my memory clean.

Chinese: 奇怪……忘了这么多吗？
English: Weird... you lost that much?

Chinese: 就好像……您所有有关贝卡丝的记忆，都留在了回响里似的。
English: It's like... all my memories of Beccas are stuck in the Echo.

Chinese: 牧仰起头，眨巴着眼睛看我。我取来束带，帮她扎好头发。
English: Muu looks up at me, her eyes wide and questioning. I secure the band in her hair, giving it a final pat.

Chinese: 唔，好了。
English: Alright then.

Chinese: 经历的事多了……总会忘记点儿东西。如果全都记住的话，也挺累的吧。
English: With everything you've been through, it's normal to let some things slip your mind. Remembering it all would be exhausting.

Chinese: 忘记本身不一定是坏事。比如，你忘掉了我给你梳头的感觉——
English: Sometimes, forgetting can be a blessing. Like, maybe you don't recall how it feels when I comb your hair...

Chinese: 呜哇！这个不行！不能忘！
English: Waah! No way I'm forgetting that It's too special.

Chinese: 我还没说完。忘掉了这种感觉，然后我再给你梳一次头……那岂不是又重新经历了第一次？
English: I'm not done yet. Isn't it delightful to make this sensation a part of your memories all over again?

Chinese: 诶……听上去倒也不坏？
English: Hmm, that's actually kind of nice.

Chinese: 回响既然拿到了，见面就是迟早的事。如果是重要的人，那重逢变成初见也未尝不可。
English: With the Echo safe, we're bound to cross paths with them again. Getting to know a person important to you again could be pretty exciting.

Chinese: 去准备神恩仪式吧。我先去洗个澡。
English: You should get ready for the Divine Grace Ceremony. I'm gonna hit the shower.

Chinese: 要把律喊起来吗？
English: Should we take Ritsu along with us?

Chinese: 不用了，都是些繁文缛节。
English: Nah, let's keep it simple.

Chinese: 让她好好睡吧。
English: Better to let her catch up on some sleep.

Chinese: 呃，好，就听您的……
English: Alright, if you say so...

Chinese: 我走向了淋浴间。才走出去两步，身后就传来了一阵急促的蜂鸣声。
English: I'm just about to hit the shower when a frantic buzzing stops me in my tracks.

Chinese: 回响水晶正急剧的颤动着。晶石上的灰光不断向外闪烁出近似火花的声音，甚至还能听见细微的爆响。
English: The Echo Crystal is going haywire, its gray light flickering like a stormy sky, even popping like tiny fireworks.

Chinese: 这？！回响要消散了！
English: What's this about?! The Echo is fading out!

Chinese: 我快步走回桌前，回响又恢复了正常，以一种柔和的频率向外律动着光芒。
English: I hurry back to the table, and just like that, the Echo calms down, pulsing gently with a soft glow again.

Chinese: 诶？
English: Huh?

Chinese: （难道说……）
English: (Could it be...)

Chinese: 我看着回响水晶，慢慢向后退了一步。果然，回响变得极为不稳定。当我走上前去，回响又恢复了正常。
English: I look at the Echo Crystal, slowly stepping back and forth. Sure enough, the Echo freaks out when I move away, but mellows when I get close.

Chinese: 牧的耳朵跳了跳，眼睛在我和晶石之间转了转。
English: Muu's ears perk up, her gaze bouncing from me to the crystal.

Chinese: 饲主大人……
English: Master...

Chinese: 她的回响……好像离不开您……
English: Master, it looks like her Echo can't bear to be away from you.

Chinese: 算了，不洗了……
English: Guess the bath can wait...

Chinese: 直接去召唤室吧。
English: Let's head to the summoning room.

Chinese: 我们来到了召唤室，牧捧着回响水晶，站在了我的面前。
English: Once there, Muu stands ready with the Echo Crystal in hand.

Chinese: 您准备好了吗？
English: All set?

Chinese: 嗯。开始吧。
English: Yeah. Let's start.
Whew...

Chinese: 奉我之名——
English: In my name...

Chinese: 灰光所附着的秩序晶石散发出橙色的光芒，与灰光逐渐融为一体。
English: The Order Crystal, now mingling with the gray light, glows a warm orange,

Chinese: 光芒塑成一道纤细的身影。她在原地站了片刻，然后向前倒下了。
English: taking shape into a slender silhouette. She appears, then tips right into my arms,
What?!

Chinese: （接住她。）
English: *catches her*

Chinese: 那道身影跌在了我怀里，正沉沉地睡着。
English: She falls asleep in my arms.

Chinese: 米白色的头发，消瘦的身形——
English: Beige hair, slight frame—

Chinese: 这就是……贝卡丝？
English: Is this... Beccas?

Chinese: 唔……睡着了？第一次召唤出睡着的星痕呢。
English: Um... asleep? Never summoned a snoozing Aster before.

Chinese: 嘿，醒醒！
English: Hey, wake up!

Chinese: 牧伸手去拍贝卡丝的头，被我挡住了。
English: Muu tries to rouse her with a pat, but I intervene.

Chinese: 她还在睡觉。
English: Let her be.

Chinese: 哎？！饲主大人，这还没说上话呢，拍一下就不行了？
English: What?! Master, you may not have remembered her yet, but you have already been very protective of her.

Chinese: 我没理会陷入某种情绪的牧，低头仔细打量着怀里的星痕。
English: I ignore Muu's grumbles and gaze at the Aster cradles in my arms.

Chinese: 米白色的头发上缀着水蓝色的发卡，耳朵长长的，耳尖还透着一丝粉。淡棕色的睫毛长长的，随着呼吸的频率，微微起伏着。
English: Her beige locks are pinned with aqua-blue, and her long ears blushed pink at the tips. Her lashes, a soft brown, quiver as she breathes.

Chinese: （试着唤醒她。）
English: (Try to wake her up.)

Chinese: 贝卡丝？
English: Beccas?

Chinese: 我轻声在她耳边呼唤着。她的眉毛轻轻皱了皱，睫毛也抖了两抖。过了一会儿，又恢复了之前的表情。
English: I whisper wake-up calls, but her brows only twitch, her lashes flutter—still, she sleeps on. Eventually, her expression reverts to its original state.

Chinese: 之后我又叫了好几次，也试过轻轻拍她，但她一直没有醒来。
English: Following that, I call out numerous times and gently pat her, yet she did not wake up.

Chinese: ……怎么办？
English: What do we do?

Chinese: 怎么办？现在想起您的狗狗了？
English: What can we do? Now you need my help, huh?

Chinese: ……别闹。
English: Don't be absurd.

Chinese: ……我也没见过这种情况。以前主人召唤的星痕都是醒着的。
English: This is new to me. The Asters you summoned before were all wide awake.

Chinese: 唔……先让她睡吧，可能明天就醒了。
English: Well, we'll let her sleep it off. She'll probably come around by morning.

Chinese: 后宅的空房间不是很多吗？醒了让马恩通报一下就好。
English: We've got spare rooms, right? Mann can keep an eye on her.

Chinese: 还是睡我那里吧。
English: You should crash at my place tonight.

Chinese: 毕竟是星痕，如果有什么突发情况，马恩不一定能应付得过来。
English: She is an Aster, after all. Mann might not handle a crisis.

Chinese: 饲主大人……
English: Master...

Chinese: 牧凑了过来，仔细的看着我的脸。
English: Muu leans in, eying me closely.

Chinese: 大半夜的，让星痕和您一起睡觉……
English: Just so you know, if you let an Aster bunk with you in the dead of night...

Chinese: 我也会不高兴的好不好！
English: I won't be thrilled, OK!

Chinese: 那让她跟你走？
English: How about taking her with you?

Chinese: 我作势要把贝卡丝抱给牧，贝卡丝突然环住了我的脖子，脚也勾住了我的腰。
English: I attempt to hand Beccas in my arms over to Muu, but Beccas suddenly clings to my neck and wraps her legs around my waist.
Um...

Chinese: 我低头看贝卡丝，她没有半点醒来的迹象。
English: Looking down at Beccas, she shows no signs of awakening.

Chinese: 怎么回事……
English: What's going on...

Chinese: 我扭曲着上身，从贝卡丝的双臂中“钻”了出来。
English: I contort my torso and wriggle out of Beccas' grip.

Chinese: 她的双手在空中摸索了半天，最后微微颤抖着、紧紧抱着胸口，眼角沁出了一丝泪花——
English: Her hands flail in the air for a while, and eventually, she shivers slightly, clutching herself tightly as a hint of tears.

Chinese: 我把她抱在怀里，她又不哭了。
English: I cradle her in my arms, and once again, she ceases her crying.

Chinese: 不会是在装睡吧……
English: Could she be feigning sleep?

Chinese: 我仔细打量着贝卡丝。她的眼睛微微眯着，那颗泪珠还挂在眼角，鼻尖也透出几分红色来。
English: I observe Beccas closely. Her eyes are narrowly opened, with tears lingering, and her nose is faintly red.

Chinese: 不像是装的……
English: It seems more than mere pretense.

Chinese: 就睡我那里吧。在我身边的时候，大多数星痕的形态都比较稳定，她应该也差不多。
English: Just stay at my place. The forms of most Asters are quite stable in my presence, and she's likely to be the same.
Eh...

Chinese: 我下次能用这个理由跟您一起睡吗？
English: May I use this as an excuse to sleep with you?

Chinese: ……谢谢你提前告诉我啊。
English: I appreciate you letting me know beforehand.

Chinese: 回去休息吧。今天也辛苦你了。
English: Now go back and rest. You've had a long day.

Chinese: 嗯，您也一样。
English: Well, so do you.

Chinese: 牧打着哈欠，没心没肺地走了。
English: Muu yawns and walks away without a second thought.

Chinese: 我就这么让贝卡丝挂在身上，回到了卧室。精灵的身体都很轻，挂在身上倒不觉得累。
English: I allow Beccas to cling to me as I head back to my bedroom. The elf is surprisingly light, hardly a burden.

Chinese: 来到床边，我轻轻把贝卡丝从身上“解”了下来。
English: Upon reaching the bed, I "detach" Beccas from myself.

Chinese: 在她发抖的时候轻轻拍着她的后背，低声安抚着她。她渐渐平复了下来，侧躺着，蜷缩成了一团——看着有点可怜。
English: Her body shivers slightly, so I sooth her with gentle pats on the back and whispered words of comfort. Slowly, she relaxes, settled onto her side, and curls up, looking somewhat forlorn.
Whew...

Chinese: 我帮她褪下靴子。指尖不小心划到了贝卡丝的脚趾，她的足弓微微收紧，被划到的地方也微微颤了颤。
English: As I assist her with removing her boots, my fingertips inadvertently graze Beccas' toes. Her arches contract subtly, and the area touched quivers.

Chinese: 刚想道歉，却意识到眼前的人还在睡着，我挠了挠头。
English: I nearly offer an apology before realizing she's still asleep, prompting me to scratch my head in bemusement.

Chinese: 终于有时间清洗一下自己了。之前在城外虽然没有发生战斗，但也耗费了不少心神。
English: At last, I find some time to take a bath. Even though I wasn't engaged in conflicts, I still feel worn out.

Chinese: 脑海里突然浮现出贝卡丝的睡相。洗完澡之后，又去卧室看了她一眼。
English: Suddenly, the image of Beccas' peaceful slumber pops into my head. After my shower, I go to the bedroom to check on her.

Chinese: 她整个人都缩在被子里了。我掀开被子的一角，她正团着，抱着膝盖，头深深地埋着。
English: She's nestled under the quilt. Gently lifting a corner, I find her curled up, clutching her knees, her head deeply buried.

Chinese: 我替她理了理纷乱的头发，再掖好被角，便也回沙发上睡了。
English: I smooth her disheveled hair, make sure she's snug in bed, and then return to the sofa to sleep.

Chinese: 好重……
English: So heavy...

Chinese: 喘不过气了……
English: I'm gasping for air...

Chinese: 好像被什么东西压着——
English: It's as though I'm burdened by something.

Chinese: 我揉了揉眼睛。雨好像停了，窗外依稀能听见鸟儿清脆的叫声。清晨的阳光正照在眼里，看什么都朦胧不已。
English: I rub my eyes. The rain has stopped, and now the distinct chirping of birds comes from outside the window. The morning sun glares into my eyes, blurring my vision.

Chinese: 什么东西……压着我？
English: Why do I feel so... heavy?

Chinese: 贝卡丝不知道什么时候钻到了我怀里。她的头埋在我的胸前，眉头轻展，正均匀地呼吸着——睡得正熟。
English: Beccas settled into my arms before I know it. Her head is nestled against my chest, her eyebrows slightly furrow, breathing steadily as she sleeps soundly.
Hiss...

Chinese: 喂，大懒虫——
English: "Hey, sleepyhead..."

Chinese: 噢……是律来喊我起床了……
English: It's Ritsu who comes to wake me.

Chinese: 不过这样子……会被误会的吧？
English: This could lead to a misunderstanding, couldn't it?

Chinese: 我轻轻推了推贝卡丝的肩膀。她好像察觉到了什么，手突然环住我的肩——并且随着我推开她的动作，环得越来越紧……
English: I gently nudge Beccas' shoulder. She must've sensed something because she suddenly clasps her arms around my shoulders. As I attempt to push her away, her embrace only tightens.

Chinese: 我急忙撑起上半身，贝卡丝则挂在我身上。我伸手去挪她的胳膊，她反而用手臂勾住了我的脖子，头倚在了我的肩上。
English: I hurriedly elevate my torso, only to be met with Beccas' firm embrace. As I reach to gently disengage her arm, she instead secures it around my neck, resting her head against my shoulder.

Chinese: 非但如此，连双腿也锢在了我的腰上——就像昨晚召唤时那样。
English: Complicating the matter, her legs entwine around my waist—just like they're when she's summoned last night.

Chinese: 你又在睡懒觉吧……
English: Are you sleeping in again...

Chinese: 贝卡丝正以一个非常暧昧的姿势趴在我身上——我则半撑着身体，和刚刚走进门的律对视着。
English: Beccas lies on top of me in a very intimate posture—I half-support my body, looking at Ritsu, who just walked in the door.

Chinese: <size=45>你，你！！！！</size>
English: <size=45>You, you!!!</size>

Chinese: <size=40>啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！！！</size>
English: <size=40>Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!</size>

Chinese: 律捂着脸跑掉了，甚至没看见和她擦肩而过的牧。
English: Ritsu covers her face and runs away, not even noticing Muu, who just passed by her.

Chinese: 你干嘛去？
English: Where are you going?

Chinese: 律，回来！
English: Ritsu, come back!

Chinese: 律这是怎么了？
English: What's going on?

Chinese: 牧看着跑掉的律，嘟囔着。回过头来，也看见了身上挂着贝卡丝的我。
English: Muu mutters as she looks at Ritsu, who was running away. When she turns around, she sees me with Beccas clinging to my body.

Chinese: 额，还在您身上挂着呢？
English: Um, is she still hanging on you?

Chinese: 摘下来了，可能半夜又挂上来了……
English: I took her off, but she might cling to me again in the middle of the night.

Chinese: 等等……
English: Wait...

Chinese: 她衣服呢？！
English: Where are her clothes?!

Chinese: 饲主大人，您？！
English: Master, you?!

Chinese: 衣服是我脱的，但是不是在我身上的时候脱的……
English: I took off her clothes, but not while she was on my body...

Chinese: 您要不要听听您在说什么？
English: Do you even realize what you're saying?

Chinese: 算了，我演示一下……
English: Never mind, let me show you...

Chinese: 我像昨天晚上那样，轻轻把贝卡丝从身上解了下来，然后一边轻拍着她的后背，一边安抚着她的情绪。
English: I untangle Beccas from my body like I did last night, then pat her back gently, trying to comfort her.

Chinese: 就这样。
English: That's all.

Chinese: 嘿，醒醒？
English: Hey, wake up?

Chinese: 牧拍了拍贝卡丝，后者却没有丝毫醒来的迹象。
English: Muu gives Beccas a pat, too, but she doesn't show the slightest sign of waking up.
Hmm...

Chinese: 您到底在回响里都干了些什么啊？
English: What did you do in the Echo, exactly?

Chinese: 我也想知道。不过……你不是告诉我——回响是已经发生的事实，是不可能被改变的。
English: I wish I knew. But... didn't you say the Echo reflects things that have already happened and can't be changed?

Chinese: 我在回响里做了什么，会影响到她吗？
English: Will what I did in the Echo affect her?

Chinese: 那得看您在回响里折腾出了多大动静……
English: It depends on how much you altered in the Echo...

Chinese: 和真实的历史差距越大，就像……脑子里突然被塞进了第二段人生一样。
English: The bigger the difference between the memories you created and the real history, the more it's like... she's got a whole new life story in her head.

Chinese: 您制造的误差越大，她睡得就越久。她必须得理清楚，哪些是原来的记忆，哪些是新的记忆。
English: The bigger the difference, the longer she'll sleep. She needs to figure out which memories are old and which are new.

Chinese: 那……她的记忆被我篡改了？
English: Then... did I mess with her memory?

Chinese: 也不算吧，其实就像是做了一场美梦一样。
English: Not exactly, it's more like having a sweet dream.

Chinese: 具体……我也不清楚。不过以后应该就清楚了，因为您大概也许可能应该不会只犯这一次……
English: I don't know all the details though... But we'll figure it out later because you'll probably end up doing it again in the future.
Oh...

Chinese: 莉莉娅以前召唤过贝卡丝吗？
English: Has Lillia summoned Beccas before?

Chinese: 我想想……
English: Let me see...

Chinese: 这得翻记录。您等我一下。
English: I need to check on the records. Just give me a second.

Chinese: 牧拉开书桌的抽屉，翻出了一本厚重的册子。
English: Muu opens a desk drawer and pulls out a heavy book.

Chinese: 嗯……召唤过一次。
English: Well... she had been summoned once before.

Chinese: “贝卡丝·希泽尔，召唤后表现出对主神的强烈抵触，拒绝签订任何契约”。处理方式是，放逐至秩序之海。
English: "Beccas Hitzer, upon being summoned, exhibited strong resistance to Lord God and declined to sign any contract." Consequently, she was exiled to the Sea of Order.

Chinese: 想起来了！她刚被召唤出来的时候还好，听说主人的身份之后，就一句话也不说了。
English: I remember now! Initially, she seemed fine, but upon learning the identity of her master, she became silent.

Chinese: 贝卡丝不是第一纪元末的精灵吗？又不是天界或者龙族的星痕，为什么会对主人强烈抵触？
English: Isn't Beccas an elf from the end of the Era of Firstlight? She is not an Aster from the Heavenly Realm or dragon clan, so why did she resist her master so strongly?

Chinese: 也许她抵触的不是莉莉娅，而是“神”这个身份？
English: Maybe it's not Lillia she resists, but the idea of a "god"?
Oh...

Chinese: 没关系。至少现在看来，应该不会抵触我。
English: It's OK. At least she hasn't opposed me yet.

Chinese: 就让她接着睡吧。要是一直醒不过来，我们再想办法。
English: We'll let her keep sleeping for now. If she doesn't wake up, we'll come up with another plan.

Chinese: 我抬起头，正看见律正躲在门后，探着头，悄悄偷看。
English: I glance up to see Ritsu peeking from behind the door.

Chinese: 见我看过来，她连忙探出身子，装作路过。
English: As our eyes meet, she steps out, feigning nonchalance as if just passing by.

Chinese: 喂！
English: Hey!

Chinese: 干、干什么？
English: Why are you sneaking around?

Chinese: 你没有对我产生什么奇怪的误会吧？
English: You don't have any weird ideas about me, do you?

Chinese: 才没有呢，哼！
English: Absolutely not, Hmph!

Chinese: 她假装并不在意的样子，大摇大摆的走开了。
English: She retorts with feigned indifference and struts off.

Chinese: 等牧也离开之后，我看着贝卡丝皱起了眉。
English: After Muu leaves, I look at Beccas, who frowns.

Chinese: 关于她总想挂在我身上这件奇怪的事……如果说是我在回响中做了什么，倒也说的通？
English: Concerning Beccas's unusual tendency to cling to me... Could this be linked to an action of mine in the Echo?

Chinese: 但明明半夜醒来过，还专门钻到我怀里。律进门那会儿也是，突然主动用手臂环住我，轻轻推一下反而勾上来了……
English: She evidently awoke in the night and snuggled into my arms. Similarly, when Ritsu came into the room, she abruptly embraced me, and my soft efforts to disengage only resulted in her gripping my neck...

Chinese: 她还窝在沙发里。我的眼睛在她身上转来转去，最后停在了她的脚心。
English: Now, she's still lying on the sofa. My eyes wander over her body and finally stop at the soles of her feet.

Chinese: 我拿起办公桌上的羽毛笔，蹲在沙发前。
English: I pick up a quill from the desk and squat in front of the sofa.

Chinese: 如果你是在装睡的话……
English: If she's pretending to sleep...

Chinese: 她没有一点儿反应。
English: Yet she doesn't react at all.

Chinese: 唔……挠挠脚心什么的，应该不会干扰你吧？
English: Hmm... lightly brushing the soles of her feet shouldn't bother her, right?

Chinese: 我用羽毛轻轻扫过她的脚心。她也没什么反应，只是被羽毛扫过的脚心泛起了一片红色。
English: I softly stroke the soles of her feet with the feather. There is no reaction, yet the spots where the feather touched redden.

Chinese: 我站起身去看她的脸。她那样窝着，我只看得见她的侧脸——她的眼角流着泪，表情却还是睡着的那副表情。
English: Rising to my feet, I observe her face. Only the side is visible to me—tears pool at the corners of her eyes, yet her expression is unaltered, as though she just falls asleep.
Oh...

Chinese: 我讪讪地抽出纸巾，帮她擦了擦泪水，再盖好被子。
English: Feeling awkward, I pull out a tissue to wipe away her tears and then drape the quilt over her.

Chinese: （感觉……哪里不太对。）
English: (Something seems amiss.)

Chinese: （刚刚她是不是动了？）
English: (Has she just moved?)

Chinese: 我又掀开被子，紧盯着她的脸。
English: Peeling back the quilt once more, I gaze at her face.

Chinese: 继续挠。
English: As I persist in gently

Chinese: 我用羽毛扫她的脚心。她的表情还是没什么变化。倒是胳膊开始非常轻微的颤抖着。
English: scratching with the feather, her expression remains unchanged, yet her arms start to quiver faintly.

Chinese: 我丢下羽毛笔，直接用手指轻轻刮她的脚板。
English: I set the quill aside and softly run my fingers across her feet.

Chinese: 她突然开始流泪，头不自然地抬了抬，露出雪白的脖颈。随着我的挠动，青红色的血管也微微凸起。
English: Abruptly, she starts crying and lifts her head in an odd manner, revealing her pale neck. With each scratch, the bluish-red veins on her neck become more pronounced.

Chinese: 你醒着吗？
English: Are you awake?

Chinese: 我加快了挠动的频率。今天非要让她“醒”过来不可。
English: I intensify the tickling. Today, I'm resolute in rousing her from "sleep."

Chinese: 贝卡丝突然抱住了我，开始小声抽泣起来。
English: Suddenly, Beccas embraces me and begins to weep softly.

Chinese: 我不为所动，手变本加厉的挠动着整个脚掌。可贝卡丝除了一边喊我的名字一边哭，也没有别的反应了。
English: I stand firm and tickled her entire sole with greater intensity. Yet, Beccas only responds by uttering my name amidst her tears.

Chinese: 我只好停下手，近距离观察着她的表情，她的脸颊泛起红晕，双眸依旧闭着，泪水从眼角缓缓流下，打湿了两鬓的发丝。
English: Left with no alternative, I cease my actions and examine her face closely. Her cheeks are rosy, her eyes remain shut, and tears trickle down, dampening the hair at her temples.

Chinese: 额，好像有点儿过……
English: It appears I may have overstepped...

Chinese: （到底在没在装睡呢……）
English: (Could she be feigning sleep?)

Chinese: 我回到客厅的办公桌前，在家里开始了工作。我时不时会看向沙发上的贝卡丝，观察她的姿势变化，聆听她呼吸的节奏。
English: I settle back at my desk in the living room to work from home. Occasionally, I'd look over at Beccas on the sofa, noting the shifts in her posture and the cadence of her breaths.

Chinese: 由于不清楚她会不会像昨晚那样——明明睡着了，却还能钻进我的怀里——我也没敢丢下她，去主殿处理事务。
English: Uncertain if she might, as she did the previous night, find her way into my arms while sleeping, I refrain from leaving her alone to attend to tasks in the main hall.

Chinese: 于是那些一直对我抱有好奇心的魔女们终于有幸窥探我住宅内部的装饰了。
English: This presents the Novas, who always harbor curiosity about me, with a chance to glimpse the interior design of my home.

Chinese: 她们找着各种各样的借口，打着稀奇古怪的名号，甚至越级来向我汇报。
English: They concoct various pretexts, engage in odd subterfuge, and even overstep their ranks to report directly to me.

Chinese: 有的一本正经地谈着工作（虽然也没什么可谈的，大多数时间是在胡扯八道），眼神不自觉地向沙发上的少女身上瞟——
English: A few engage in discussions about work with a straight face (though there is little of substance, and it is largely gibberish), yet their gazes invariably stray to the girl on the sofa.

Chinese: 我隔着她的眼神都能听见她的心声：“哇，这个少女是谁？竟然睡在侍主大人的沙发上！天呐，我要告诉XXX，这可是个劲爆的消息！”
English: I could almost hear their thoughts through their gazes: "Wow, who is this girl? She's actually sleeping on the Lord Oracle's sofa! Oh my god, I must tell XXX this breaking news! "

Chinese: 有的则干脆不加掩饰，直勾勾地看着我，直勾勾地看着贝卡丝——“侍主大人，您有配偶了吗？是这位美丽的精灵小姐吗？”
English: Some don't even try to hide their curiosity, looking directly at me and then at Beccas. "Lord Oracle, do you have a spouse? Is it this adorable elf lady? "

Chinese: 就这么吵吵闹闹的，一天过去了。不知道什么时候，马恩已经帮我点上了灯——天早就黑了下来。
English: The day flow by amid the constant bickering and fussing. Suddenly, Mann lights the lamp, darkness already falls.

Chinese: 明明工作了一整天，却一点儿也没有能做完的迹象……这群魔女什么时候这么活泼了？
English: Despite their seeming diligence, there is no end in sight to their work... When had these Novas become so perky?

Chinese: 明天再说吧。
English: Let's continue tomorrow.

Chinese: 我伸了个懒腰，扭了扭脖子，打算去看看贝卡丝醒了没有。
English: I crane my neck, attempting to see if Beccas is awake,

Chinese: 沙发空荡荡的。
English: only to find the sofa vacant.

Chinese: （嗯？人呢？）
English: (Um? Where is she?)

Chinese: 贝卡丝？
English: Beccas?

Chinese: 我走到沙发边探了探被子，还残留着一丝体温。阳台的门开着，我屏着呼吸，走了过去。
English: I approach the sofa and caress the quilt, feeling the lingering warmth of her presence. The balcony door stands ajar, and I head toward it with bated breath.

Chinese: 贝卡丝？！
English: Beccas?!

Chinese: 我推开门走上阳台，贝卡丝正站在那，抬头看着天上朦胧的月亮。听见我的动静，这才转过头来，看着我的眼睛。
English: Swinging the door wide, I step out onto the balcony to find Beccas, her gaze fixed upon the misty moon. As she hears me approach, she turns, and our eyes meet.

Chinese: 她灰蓝色的眼睛里流转着一些说不清道不明的东西。
English: There is an indescribable quality to her gray-blue eyes.

Chinese: 就这么看了一秒，她慢慢地走了过来，把头靠在了我的胸口，双手轻轻环住了我的腰。
English: She walks over slowly, lies her head against my chest, and wraps her arms around me gently.

Chinese: 米白色的发丝间，水蓝色的发卡挽着鬓角。发卡上的宝石映着月光，晃得人有些失神。
English: Her beige hair on the temples is secured with aqua-blue hairpins, the gems of which catches the moonlight, briefly dazzling my eyes.

Chinese: 她很久都没有说话。我想喊她，又觉得这样会破坏某种气氛……
English: She remains silent for a long stretch. I'm tempted to call out her name but hesitate, worried it may ruin the moment.

Chinese: 于是又这么过了一会儿，直到腰僵住了……
English: Thus, we stay that way for some time until stiffness creeps into my waist.

Chinese: 贝卡丝……
English: Beccas...

Chinese: 贝卡丝？
English: Beccas?

Chinese: 我轻轻捧起少女的脸，她的嘴角和我的胸口拉出了一道晶亮的口水……
English: I gently hold her face, and a stream of sparkling saliva trickles from the corner of her mouth onto my chest.

Chinese: 睡着了？！看来问题还是没解决。
English: Fall asleep?! I muse, acknowledging the issue remains unsolved.

Chinese: 我摇摇头，把贝卡丝抱回了床上。给她盖被子时，脖子却被勾住了。
English: Shaking my head, I hoist Beccas back to bed. As I tuck her in, my neck gets caught.

Chinese: 我连忙用手撑着床，才不至于跌倒在她身上。灰蓝色的眼睛瞪得大大的，声音则夹杂着一丝胆怯。
English: Hastily, I brace myself against the bed with my hands to prevent collapsing onto her. Her grey-blue eyes are wide open, and her voice carries a trace of timidity.

Chinese: 额……你把手拿开……
English: Um... please take your hands away...

Chinese: 她的眼里突然泛起了水光，眼看就要哭出来了——
English: Her eyes suddenly brim with tears, and she's on the verge of crying.

Chinese: 好好好，不拿开，不拿开……
English: OK, OK, you can keep them...

Chinese: 我只好侧躺下来，替她擦了擦眼角的泪水。她的呼吸逐渐平复下来。很快，又睡着了。
English: I have to lie down beside her and gently wipe away her tears. Her breathing slowly steadies, and before long, she drifts back to sleep....

Chinese: 她拉着我的手，使我从背后抱住她，然后用双手轻轻扣住我的大拇指。我试着抽出来，她却闷哼了一声。我怕惊醒她，只好作罢。
English: She takes my hand, asks me to hug her from behind, and gently clasps my thumbs with both hands. I try to pull away, but she groans. Afraid of waking her, I have to give up.

Chinese: （回响里，我们之间究竟发生了什么呢……）
English: (In the Echo, what happened between us...)

Chinese: 做了一个模糊的梦。梦里，贝卡丝躺在我的怀里，正要摸我的脸。
English: I have a vague dream. In it, Beccas is lying in my arms, reaching to touch my face.

Chinese: 只是……躺在怀里的贝卡丝一会儿变成了牧，一会儿又变成了律……
English: Yet, she keeps changing—first into Muu, then into Ritsu.

Chinese: 昨天……昨天可能真的误会他了吧……
English: Yesterday... perhaps I really misunderstood her yesterday...

Chinese: 大笨蛋！
English: Idiot!

Chinese: 诶？怎么不在沙发上……在卧室吗？
English: Huh? Why not on the sofa? Maybe in the bedroom?

Chinese: <size=50>你你你你你……</size>
English: <size=50>You, you, you, you...</size>

Chinese: 我艰难地睁开眼，律正在门口尖叫着。
English: I crack open my eyes, only to find Ritsu screaming at the door.

Chinese: <size=50>啊啊啊！！</size>
English: <size=50>Ahhh!!</size>

Chinese: 我看向旁边，贝卡丝不知道什么时候又钻进了我怀里。
English: I see that, once again, Beccas somehow found her way into my arms.

Chinese: 你听我解释——
English: Please, let me explain—

Chinese: 律又跑掉了。和昨天一样，她没注意和她擦肩而过的牧。
English: But Ritsu already ran away, just like yesterday, oblivious to Muu, who just passed by.

Chinese: 饲主大人！！！
English: Master!!!

Chinese: 您还有什么好说的！！！
English: You don't need to explain anything!!
Hmm...

Chinese: 诶？醒了？
English: Huh? Awake?

Chinese: 睡醒的贝卡丝看着牧，又往我怀里缩了缩。
English: Beccas wakes up and, upon seeing Muu, retreats into my embrace.

Chinese: 我一离开她就要哭……然后半夜又钻进来了。
English: She'd bawl her eyes out the second I stepped away, only to sneak back to me in the dead of night.

Chinese: 所以呢？会哭的孩子有抱抱？
English: So? Is she just using tears to win your hugs?

Chinese: 您以为我不会哭吗！
English: Reckon I should use the same tactic!

Chinese: 咳，这不是担心她的记忆融合出现问题么……
English: Aren't you worried about her memory fusion problems?

Chinese: 您最好是……
English: You'd better...

Chinese: 不过，总觉得哪里怪怪的！
English: But something's off!

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 她以前……是这种性格吗？
English: Was she always like this?

Chinese: 你知道的，她的事我一点儿都想不起来了。档案里有写吗？
English: I'm drawing a blank on her. Got anything in the records?

Chinese: 档案上写着，她是希泽尔家族的领袖……德罗伊城的政要，深不可测。
English: The file pegs her as the leader of the Hitzers, an unfathomable political figure in Droy City.

Chinese: 我低下头看了看贝卡丝。她抱着我的胳膊，清澈的眼睛呆呆地看着我。
English: I peer down at Beccas, who's holding onto my arm, looking up at me with those clear-as-day eyes.

Chinese: 领袖？深不可测？
English: Leader? Unfathomable?

Chinese: ……会不会是记忆出现了问题？
English: Could there be something wrong with her memory?

Chinese: 也不是不可能……
English: Wouldn't rule it out...

Chinese: 有了！再召唤一次贝卡丝吧！
English: I have an idea! Let's summon Beccas again!

Chinese: 就拿贝卡丝举例，她已经被您召唤过一次了，那么当您再次召唤出她时，不是召唤一个新的贝卡丝，而是对贝卡丝的灵魂进行补完。
English: Take Beccas as an example. Since you've summoned her once, doing it again won't summon a new Beccas but might patch her soul.

Chinese: 在这一瞬间，她会回想起更多的记忆，所以哪个星痕出了什么记忆方面的毛病，再召唤一遍就好了！
English: Could jog some memories loose. Got memory trouble with an Aster? Just summon them again.

Chinese: ……再召唤？可是召唤是随机的啊？
English: Another summoning? Isn't it all a roll of the dice?

Chinese: 我摸了摸鼻子。牧说得很轻松，我听起来却完全不觉得会是什么轻松的事……
English: I touched my nose. Muu is all confidence, but I have my doubts. It isn't going to be a walk in the park...

Chinese: 我把贝卡丝抱到床边，帮她穿好靴子。
English: Then, I scoop up Beccas and get her boots on her feet.

Chinese: 走吧，我们去召唤室。
English: Come on, let's hit the Summoning Room.

Chinese: 神谕司，召唤室。
English: Summoning Room, Oracle Division.

Chinese: 律捧着星魂结晶，脸却扭到了一边，不看我。
English: Ritsu clutches the Mana Crystal, not even glancing my way.

Chinese: 还在生气啊？
English: Still steamed?

Chinese: 我都解释过了，不信你问牧……
English: I explained it all for you. If you're doubting me, just grill Muu about it...

Chinese: 平时看着还挺正经的……安洁跟我说，你会和星痕偷偷摸摸做坏事，我还不相信，替你说好话！
English: You're usually Mr. Righteous... Angie ranted about you getting up to no good with the Aster. I had your back, you know!

Chinese: 你对得起我的信任吗！
English: Did I bet on the wrong horse?

Chinese: 你看看贝卡丝，是能做坏事的样子吗……
English: Take a look at Beccas. Does she strike you as the scheming type?

Chinese: 贝卡丝正靠着我睡觉……
English: Beccas was asleep next to me...

Chinese: 她能不能做不好说，你嘛……哼！
English: Whether she's scheming, I can't say, but you? That's another story. Humph!

Chinese: 律没再和我争论，看样子是先不和我计较了。
English: Ritsu huffs, still ticked off.

Chinese: 不吵啦？那开始召唤吧？
English: Done with the back-and-forth? Let's start the summoning, right?

Chinese: 彩色的光华化作一道蓝色的身影——安娜被召唤了出来。
English: The colorful light transformed into a blue figure—Anna had been summoned.

Chinese: 这是……这是哪里……
English: Where... where am I...
Ahem...

Chinese: 咦，[var=Actor]？
English: Huh, [var=Actor]?

Chinese: 你……你在召唤星痕吗？！
English: You... are you summoning an Aster?!

Chinese: 啊……对。
English: Ah... right.

Chinese: ……之前跟我说的“重要的工作”，就是召唤星痕吗？
English: Is this the "big gig" you mentioned?

Chinese: 你都两天没来看我了，我都没去找你……
English: You haven't come to see me for two days, and I didn't even bother touching bases...
Ahem...

Chinese: 不理你了！
English: Consider yourself snubbed!

Chinese: 嗯……明天一起吃个饭怎么样？
English: Hey, how about we grab dinner tomorrow?

Chinese: 哼，哄不好了！
English: Humph, I'm done with your sweet talking!

Chinese: 我拉住安娜的手，悄悄挠她的手心，听她冲我撒娇。
English: I hold Anna's hand, gently scratching her palm while she plays hard to get.

Chinese: 背后突然传来抽泣声。
English: Out of nowhere, a sob breaks the silence.

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 咳。这位是？
English: Ahem. Who's that?

Chinese: 安娜刚注意到我背后的贝卡丝。贝卡丝正拉着我的衣角，怯怯地喊着我。
English: Anna peers over at Beccas. Beccas tugs at the corner of my clothes and calls out to me in a timid voice.

Chinese: 这位是贝卡丝，她的记忆出了点儿问题，导致她会不定期陷入沉睡。
English: This is Beccas. There is something wrong with her memory, making her zonk out now and then.

Chinese: 所以我们才来召唤星痕。如果能重新召唤出她来，也许记忆上的问题就能解决了。
English: That's why we are here. If she can be summoned again, we may fix her memory issue.

Chinese: ……那好吧。
English: Fine.

Chinese: 原谅我啦？
English: Truce?

Chinese: 安娜白了我一眼，理了理头发，慢慢凑到我耳边——
English: Anna gives me the side-eye, fixes her hair, and leans in close.

Chinese: ……明天来找我哦，别放我鸽子。
English: You better show up tomorrow, don't leave me hanging.

Chinese: 说完，耳朵上传来一点温热的触感。
English: With that, she leaves a warm whisper in my ear.

Chinese: 我摸了摸耳朵，干咳了一声。
English: I touch my ear and clear my throat awkwardly.

Chinese: 咳，继续。
English: Ahem, let's keep it moving.

Chinese: 律红着脸，又捧来一堆星魂结晶。
English: Ritsu's cheeks go pink as she whips out more Mana Crystals.

Chinese: 主上……
English: Lord...

Chinese: 您有没有想我？
English: Do you miss me?

Chinese: 咳，嗯，当然有。
English: Ahem, um, of course.

Chinese: 那，您为什么不来看妾身呢……
English: So why haven't you dropped by?

Chinese: 明天——不，后天！后天就去看你！
English: Tomorrow—no, the day after! I'll catch you then!

Chinese: 那妾身就——咦，这位是？
English: And I—Well, who is this?

Chinese: 贝卡丝抱住了我的胳膊，引起了桃的注意。
English: Beccas latches onto my arm, drawing Momo's gaze.

Chinese: 这位是贝卡丝，出了点儿小状况，现在还不太清醒。
English: This is Beccas. She's got herself in a pickle and can't wake up.

Chinese: 不清醒吗？
English: Can't wake up?

Chinese: 妾身闻到了谎言的味道哦……
English: Smells fishy...

Chinese: 嗯？你说我吗？
English: Hmm? You're not talking about me, are you?

Chinese: 贝卡丝用头蹭着我的胸口，桃捂着嘴轻笑了一声，摆了摆手，走开了。
English: Beccas nuzzles into me with her head. Momo giggles behind her hand, gives a wave, and strolls off.

Chinese: ……还、还要继续吗？
English: Still up for this?

Chinese: ……当然。
English: Of course.

Chinese: 侍主大人……
English: Master...

Chinese: 这里，空空的……
English: Look here, it's all empty...

Chinese: 神光低着头，看着自己的胸口。
English: Sinkou hangs her head, eying her chest.

Chinese: 您说过，会填满这里……
English: You promised to fill this void...

Chinese: 唔……大后天你有时间吗？
English: Do you have any plans for three days from now?

Chinese: 你平时似乎也没什么事，每天都在看太阳……
English: Seems like you're just sun-gazing all day...

Chinese: 那就大后天，我去找你——
English: I'll swing by three days from now...

Chinese: 贝卡丝突然整个人扑了上来，头埋在我胸口的位置，吓了神光退了一步。
English: But before I can finish, Beccas darts in, burying her face in my chest. Sinkou steps back, spooked.

Chinese: 我……我走了。
English: I'll take my leave.

Chinese: 仆、仆人哟！
English: S... servant!

Chinese: 你、你什么时候来与深渊混沌至高——咳，咳咳咳……
English: When are you gonna show up at the Abyss and Chaos Supreme—Eh-hem...

Chinese: 你慢点儿说，别呛着……
English: Take it easy, don't choke...

Chinese: 你什么时候来与深渊混沌至高暗黑天魔纳菲大人共、共进晚餐？！
English: So, when will you have dinner with Lord Naphee, the Supreme Demon of Darkness and Chaos from the Abyss?!

Chinese: 你等我一下，我算一下……
English: Hold on, let me check my schedule...

Chinese: 下周一你有空吗？
English: Are you free next Monday?

Chinese: 啊，本、本大人应该有空吧！
English: Uh, yeah, I should be!

Chinese: 等等……
English: Wait...

Chinese: 仆从哟，你身上的是什么东西？
English: Servant, what's that on you?

Chinese: 你被什么魔法困住了吗？如果是的话……咳，本大人为你解决一下也不是不行……
English: Some kind of spell got you? If so... I can deign myself to fix it for you...

Chinese: 额，这是贝卡丝，和你一样，是一位星痕……
English: Um, this is Beccas. She's an Aster, just like you...

Chinese: 原来如此，免礼吧……什么？星痕？！
English: Drop the formalities... Wait, what? An Aster?!

Chinese: 这、咳，星痕怎么能挂在身上？！这、这——
English: This, hey, how come this Aster is hung on your body?! This—
Ah!!!

Chinese: 纳菲大叫着跑掉了。
English: Naphee shrieks and bolts.

Chinese: 侍主，今晚老地方等你？
English: Lord Oracle, how about we chill at our usual spot tonight?

Chinese: 今晚……再说吧。
English: Tonight? We'll see, let's chat later...

Chinese: 哟，刚刚没注意。您身上爬着的是什么？
English: Whoa, I totally missed it. What's clinging to you?

Chinese: 我倒是在无尽海的某些丛林里见过这架势……那些猴子会把小猴子挂在自己身上，在树林里蹦来蹦去。
English: I've seen this move in the Endless Sea jungles... those monkeys carry their young like that while leaping around.

Chinese: 哈，别介意，我开个玩笑。您玩儿您的，我去那边聊聊。
English: Ha, just messing with you. I'll leave you to it and go mingle over there.

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯拍拍我的肩膀，和贝卡丝对视了一眼，走开了。
English: Icaruth claps my shoulder, gives Beccas a look, and wanders off.

Chinese: 日程已经排到下个月了，但是还没召唤出贝卡丝。
English: The calendar's marked for next month, but Beccas has still not been summoned.

Chinese: 站在后面看热闹的星痕们围了一大圈，叽叽喳喳的。
English: The Asters, hanging back for the show, buzz in a big circle.

Chinese: 侍主这手气，啧，今晚我肯定把他内裤都赢走。
English: Lord Oracle's been in a funk, and I'm gonna clean up betting against him.

Chinese: 我赌1000。十次召唤之内，他肯定还是召唤不出来——
English: I bet 1,000. Ten tries, and he still won't pull it off—

Chinese: 她话还没说完，就出现在了我的面前——我又召唤出了伊卡洛斯。
English: Before she can finish, Icaruth pops up—I summoned her again.

Chinese: 嗨，侍主大~人~
English: Hi, Lord Oracle!
Hi?

Chinese: 保持住手气，我压了重注~
English: Ride that winning streak, I'm all in!

Chinese: 去去去……一边儿呆着去！
English: Back off... keep clear!

Chinese: 晚上别跑，我喝不死你！
English: Don't vanish at night, I'm not letting you off easy!

Chinese: 哼，我等着~
English: I'll be waiting!

Chinese: 不过……您可别到晚上还没召唤出来哦~
English: But... I doubt you can make it tonight!

Chinese: 饲主大人！让我来吧！
English: Master! I'll take over!

Chinese: 说到底，是律的手气太差了吧！
English: It's all down to Ritsu's rotten luck at the end of the day.
What?!

Chinese: 我来！
English: Let me give it a shot!

Chinese: 牧接过律手中的星魂结晶，笑嘻嘻地看着我。
English: Muu snags the Mana Crystal from Ritsu and shoots me a grin confidently.

Chinese: 她信心满满的闭上了眼睛，我不由得被她的笑容所感染，将手放在了星魂结晶上——
English: She closes her eyes, and I can't help but be infected by her optimism. I place my hand on the Mana Crystal...

Chinese: 一道彩色光芒闪过，牧凭空消失了。那颗星魂结晶落在了地上，滚了又滚。
English: A flash of colored light appears, and Muu vanishes into thin air. The Mana Crystal falls to the ground, rolling several times

Chinese: 那颗星魂结晶爆散开来，重组成牧的样子。她看着我，抽了抽嘴角。
English: before it explodes and reorganizes into Muu's form again. She looked at me, the corners of her mouth twitching.

Chinese: 呃……嗨？
English: Uh... hi?
Woo... wow!!!!

Chinese: 牧突然一屁股坐在地上，嚎啕大哭起来。
English: Suddenly, Muu sits down on the ground and bursts into tears.

Chinese: 至于这么伤心吗……
English: Is it really that bad?

Chinese: 您根本就不懂……
English: You just don't get it...

Chinese: 我……我想起悲伤的事情……
English: I get all these sad thoughts...

Chinese: 呜呜呜呜……
English: Boo hoo hoo...

Chinese: 每次，每次主人让我看好您，您那张嘴随便说点儿什么，我就相信了，放您出去了……
English: Every time, every time you tell me to keep tabs on you, you sweet-talk your way out, and I fall for it...

Chinese: 您说的话，一次都没算过！呜……
English: But you always ditch your promises! Ugh...

Chinese: 每次都出去沾花惹草，回来主人就怪我看不好您，当天晚上我就只能在门外看门……呜哇！！！！
English: Whenever you go out to mess around with girls, the Master scolds me for not keeping a close eye on you upon his return. Then I'm the one who gets the heat, stuck guarding the door... Ugh!!!!

Chinese: 星痕们的议论声都小了很多。她们交头接耳，窃窃私语，好像在沟通一些花花草草的心得……
English: The chatters among the Asters grow quieter, their whispers now a murmur of gossips or something.

Chinese: 咳，看来你的运气也不太好，怎么就想起来这种糟心事了……
English: Ahem, looks like your luck's taken a hike. Why get hung up on the downers?

Chinese: 我安抚着牧。太阳已经快落山了，必须得想个办法，赶快结束这件事。
English: I try to cheer Muu up. The sun's dipping low, and we have to wrap this up quickly.

Chinese: 贝卡丝……
English: Beccas...

Chinese: 我转过身来。贝卡丝抬着头，用那双水汪汪的眼睛看着我。
English: I turn to Beccas, who is giving me these puppy dog eyes.

Chinese: 捧着这个。
English: Here, take this.

Chinese: 我把星魂结晶递给她。她小心翼翼地捧着星魂结晶，呆呆地看着我。
English: I hand her the Mana Crystal. She takes it, looking lost, just staring.

Chinese: 我看着那双眼睛，把手放在了星魂结晶上。
English: I meet her gaze and touch the Mana Crystal.

Chinese: 她的身影坍缩成一团灰光，消失在某个时空中。
English: Her form folds into a sphere of gray light and disappears into another dimension.

Chinese: 那颗星魂结晶开始坠落，然后迸发出像阳光一样温暖的橙色光芒。
English: The Mana Crystal, beginning its descent, suddenly erupts in an orange glow as warm as the sun's rays.

Chinese: 贝卡丝的身影出现了。不同于那个消瘦又惹人怜爱的样子，她倒提着剑，灰蓝色的眼睛直直的盯着我。
English: Out pops Beccas, looking all different, sword in hand, giving me this intense look with her stormy eyes.

Chinese: 贝……贝卡丝？
English: Be... Beccas?

Chinese: 好久不见，侍主大人。
English: It's been ages, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: ……这是治好了？
English: You all good now?

Chinese: ****（叙亚脏话）！倒霉。走了！
English: **** (Shirre expletives)! Pity. Time to jet!

Chinese: 星痕们咿咿呀呀地散去了。
English: The Asters scatter, all abuzz.

Chinese: 咳，嗯……不小心全忘掉了。
English: Hey, uh... I kinda space on everything.

Chinese: 没关系，我会帮您回忆起来的。
English: No sweat, I'll jog your memory.

Chinese: 那么……您希望我怎么称呼您呢？
English: So... what would you like me to call you?

Chinese: 她凑了过来，轻轻低语——
English: She leans in, whispering...

Chinese: [var=Actor]，我的神，还是……侍主大人？
English: [var=Actor], my god, or... Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 她鼻尖的热气呼在我的脸上。我猛地一躲，她却已经退到一米开外，面无表情地看着我。
English: Her breath is like a summer breeze on my cheek. I quickly duck, but she already steps back a meter, gazing at me without expression.

Chinese: 您果然不记得了呀。以前……您可不会躲呢。
English: You've forgotten, huh? Back in the day... you wouldn't have flinched.

Chinese: 咳。我是安娜。冒昧地打扰一下。这位的问题已经解决了吗？
English: Ahem. I'm Anna. Excuse me. Is this mess sorted?

Chinese: 安娜突然走上前来，隔开了我和贝卡丝。
English: Anna cuts in between me and Beccas.

Chinese: 还没有。
English: Not yet.

Chinese: 贝卡丝冲安娜礼貌地笑了笑，示意她可以离开了。
English: Beccas gives Anna a polite nod, signaling she should leave.

Chinese: 哼。
English: Hmph.

Chinese: 虽然语气不善，但安娜的微笑，谁也挑不出任何毛病。
English: Anna's tone is icy, but her smile says otherwise.

Chinese: 我们去花园吧！
English: Let's hit the garden!

Chinese: 当然。
English: Of course.

Chinese: 贝卡丝退了半步，右手反搭在右肩上，向我微微屈身——这是格罗瑞希兰源精灵的礼仪。
English: Beccas steps back and gives me a bow, placing her right hand on her right shoulder, straight out of a primal elven etiquette book from Gloryhylan.

Chinese: 夜晚，神谕司后花园。
English: At night, the back garden of the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 侍主大人，您又输咯。
English: Lord Oracle, you're down again.

Chinese: 两杯哦。
English: Two cups.

Chinese: 不玩了。他心思根本就不在这儿，没意思……
English: Enough games. He can't focus on the game, which is boring...

Chinese: 今天这小妞儿什么来头？我说，你一会儿不会就归她了吧？
English: What's the deal with this girl today? You gonna bet your soul away to her or what?

Chinese: ……你们可别欺负她。
English: Ease up on her.

Chinese: 哎哟喂，侍~主~大~人~
English: Whoa, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 侍主大人这是在怜香惜玉？
English: Lord Oracle is such a softie.

Chinese: 嘁……我还不稀得做这种事呢！
English: Hey... I'm not stooping that low!

Chinese: 咳咳！
English: Cough!

Chinese: 侍~主~大~人~
English: Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 好怕被您欺~负~呀~
English: The idea of being bullied by you makes me shake in my boots!
Gross!

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯……
English: Icaruth...

Chinese: 你这样真的好恶心……
English: seriously, cut it out...
Ugh...

Chinese: 行了，就喝到这儿吧。
English: Alright, let's wrap this up and call it a night.

Chinese: 下次……下次是什么时候儿？
English: When's the next round?

Chinese: 得了吧芙洛拉，识趣儿点儿。侍主要去欺负人了~
English: Flora, give it a rest. Lord Oracle is out to get someone!

Chinese: 普琳普顿和伊卡洛斯夹着芙洛拉走出了花园。很快，笑声和骂声都听不见了。
English: Princeton and Icaruth lead Flora out of the garden, their laughter and curses fading into the distance.

Chinese: 我摇摇头，向屋里走去。
English: I shake my head and head back toward the house.

Chinese: 我循着声音回过头，贝卡丝正站在树下。
English: Then, I hear a sound and turns to find Beccas standing under a tree.

Chinese: 贝卡丝？
English: Beccas?

Chinese: 这么晚了，还不回去睡吗？
English: Still up? It's late.

Chinese: 她眨了眨眼睛。树影昏暗，她的眼瞳中倒映着一种幽邃的蓝。她笑了一声，慢慢走了过来。
English: She blinks, her eyes shimmering blue in the shadowy moonlight. She chuckles and strolls over.

Chinese: 我在等您回家，[var=Actor]。
English: I'm waiting for you to come home,[var=Actor].

Chinese: 她拉着我回到了客厅，轻轻扯了扯我的领子。我不由得微微弯下腰，看着她的脸越靠越近。
English: She tugs me back to the living room, adjusting my collar. I unconsciously leaned down a bit as her face got closer.

Chinese: 您在想什么？
English: What's on your mind?

Chinese: 领口突然被松开了。她手上拿着神谕司的黑服，嘴角带着一丝若有若无的微笑。
English: Suddenly, she lets go of my collar, holding up the black Oracle Division uniform with a faint smile.

Chinese: 酒意还没退去，她身上那股淡淡的香味飘进了我的鼻子。
English: Her delicate scent hits me, even through the lingering buzz of alcohol.

Chinese: 我在想……我们之前到底发生了什么？
English: I've been wondering... what went down between us before?

Chinese: 她轻轻推了推我的肩膀，让我坐到沙发上。把衣服挂在衣架上之后，又绕到了沙发后面，手指抚摸着我的眼睛，轻柔地按摩着。
English: She nudges my shoulder, guiding me to the sofa. After hanging up the clothes, she circles behind the couch, her fingers soothingly massaging my eyes.

Chinese: 您想起来了吗？
English: Remember anything?

Chinese: 看来，您把我忘得一干二净啦。
English: Seems like I've slipped your mind.

Chinese: 她的手离开了我的眼睛。我不由得抬起头，她却正微笑着看着我，像是在等待和我对视。
English: Her touch leaves my eyes, and I look up. She meets my gaze with that smile, waiting for my response.

Chinese: 不会的。
English: Nope.

Chinese: 我抬起手，轻轻拨开她垂在我脸上的发丝，摩挲着她的脸颊。她微眯着眼睛，让我有些看不清她眼底的意味。
English: I reach out, brushing her hair aside and tracing her cheek. She squints a little, her expression hard to read.

Chinese: 我记得……你好像……特别想摸我的脸。但我没有给你摸。
English: I remember... you seemed to... fixate on touching my face. But I never gave the green light.

Chinese: 可是……后来……好像一直都没摸到。
English: But... then... it seemed like I never touched it at all.

Chinese: 她脸上的玩味消失了。然后，有什么东西滴在了我的脸上。
English: The amusement disappears from her face. Then something drips on my face.

Chinese: 她轻轻捧起我的脸，在我耳边细细地呢喃着。
English: She gently holds my face and whispers in my ear.

Chinese: 你没有不让我摸哦，[var=Actor]。
English: You never refused to let me touch it, [var=Actor].

Chinese: 我嗅到她脖子间淡淡的香气。然后，嘴唇上传来了柔软的感觉。
English: Her neck smells faintly sweet. The next thing I know, her lips brush mine.

Chinese: 有人比我先尝过它吗。
English: Someone else beats me to it with a kiss, right?

Chinese: 我睁开眼，她似笑非笑地看着我，眼底的星空像有一种引力，却怎么也看不见底。
English: I open my eyes, and there she is, half-smiling. The starry glimmer in her eyes pulls me into a rabbit hole.

Chinese: 看来是有了。
English: I'll take that as a yes.

Chinese: 唔……但你应该是第一个挂在我身上的。
English: But... you're the first one clinging to me while kissing.

Chinese: 她的手指点着我的脖子，坐进了我的怀里，像之前那样，缠在了我的身上，用额头贴着我的额头，又轻轻吻了吻我的嘴角。
English: Her fingers trace my neck as she settles into my arms and hangs on my body, just like before. Foreheads touching, she kisses the corner of my mouth.

Chinese: 那第一个挂在您身上品尝它的，就也是我了。
English: Then, I'll be the first one to cling to you while getting a taste of you.

Chinese: 所以，是从什么时候开始的……我是说装睡。
English: So, when did you start pretending to be asleep?

Chinese: 您猜？
English: Take a guess.

Chinese: 又是装睡，又是装傻……真是的。
English: Pretending to be asleep and acting all dumb... it's ridiculous.

Chinese: 贝卡丝向后仰了仰身子，用手捂着胸口，变了一幅表情。
English: Beccas leans back, covering her chest with her hands, and changes her expression.

Chinese: 这里……空空的……
English: Here... it's empty...

Chinese: 您说过，会填满这里……
English: You promised to fill it up...

Chinese: 打住……
English: Stop it...

Chinese: 她的头又凑上来，嘴几乎贴着我的耳朵，手轻轻在我腰上拧着。
English: She leans in again, her mouth almost touching my ear, her hands gently twisting on my waist.

Chinese: 再装下去，您什么时候才有空欺负我呀？
English: If I keep pretending, when will you have time to tease me?

Chinese: 不是已经欺负过了吗？
English: Haven't I already been teased enough?

Chinese: 我顺势褪下她的鞋子，轻轻挠着她的脚心。
English: I take off her shoes and gently tickle the soles of her feet.

Chinese: 她的身体猛得绷直，红着耳朵尖，从我怀里退了出去。
English: She stiffens, her ears turning red, and she pulls away from my arms.

Chinese: 原来……您是故意的啊。
English: So... you did it on purpose

Chinese: 我没有承认，也不否认。可能是喝过酒，刚刚的举动有些太轻浮了。我有点尴尬地挪开了视线，不去看她。
English: I neither confirmed nor denied it. Maybe it's the alcohol making me a bit too bold. Feeling a little embarrassed, I look away, avoiding her eyes.

Chinese: 回过神来，她却把我按在了沙发靠背上，手捧住了我的脸——
English: Once she composes herself, she presses me against the back of the sofa and holds my face in her hands—

Chinese: 呀。又摸到了。
English: Ah. Touched it again.

Chinese: 总想摸您的脸，您不会介意吧？
English: I always want to touch your face. Does it bother you?

Chinese: 睡不醒的梦里，这可是最深重、最扭曲的执念了。所以……不管您介不介意——
English: This is the deepest and most twisted obsession in a dream I couldn't wake up from. So, whether it bothers you or not—

Chinese: 她突然从眼前消失了，声音也飘散在了空中。
English: She suddenly disappears from sight, her voice lingering in the air.

Chinese: 晚安，我的[var=Actor]。以后的一切，就都献给您吧。
English: Good night, [var=Actor]. From now on, everything of mine is yours.

Chinese: 不挠。
English: Do not scratch.

Chinese: 还是算了……
English: Forget it...

Chinese: 我喜欢蓬松干爽的你。
English: I like you fluffy and dry.
