Chinese: 序 屉中泣
English: Prelude: Drawer Lament

Chinese: 波斯菊求助于侍主，其房间内的抽屉里传出呼救声。侍主前去调查，发现抽屉里竟是一片未知的空间，过程中波斯菊和侍主不慎被空间吞没……
English: Calliopsis turns to Lord Oracle for help—cries echo from a drawer in her room. During investigation, they discover a mysterious space hidden within, which swallows them...

Chinese: 阳光和煦，清风拂面，一个令人愉悦的午后。
English: The sun shines and the breeze is gentle. What an enjoyable afternoon.

Chinese: 我眨着眼，不由得开始希望这难得的静谧可以停留得再久一些，最好不要有人来打搅……
English: I blink, hoping that this rare peaceful moment can last longer without interruption...

Chinese: 啊！饲主先生，你果然在这里！
English: Ahhh! I knew you would be here, Master!

Chinese: 我站起身，转向声音传来的方向，是波斯菊。她踉踉跄跄地跑了过来。
English: I stand up and turn to the voice. It's Calliopsis. She blunders toward me.

Chinese: 饲、饲主先生，我、我遇到大、大事了！
English: M-Master, I'm in big trouble!

Chinese: 是胡萝卜被偷吃了吗？
English: Someone stole your carrots?

Chinese: 凭我对波斯菊的了解，应该没有什么事能比胡萝卜被偷吃更严重了。
English: Knowing Calliopsis, few things could be worse for her than her carrots being stolen.

Chinese: 不、不是啦，饲主先生，虽然那的确也是大事……
English: N-No, Master, though that would also be big trouble...

Chinese: 你对“大事”的定义，我们应该抽空好好聊一下。
English: We should discuss your definition of "big trouble" sometime.

Chinese: 相信我，饲主先生，这件事真的不得了！我的房间，好像闹鬼了！
English: Trust me, Master, this is serious! My room... I think it's haunted!

Chinese: 闹…鬼……？之前当班的星痕从没反映过这个情况啊。
English: Haunted? The Asters previously on duty never reported anything of the sort.

Chinese: 饲主先生怎么一副不相信我的表情呀？
English: Why do you look so skeptical?

Chinese: 闹鬼这种事，无论说给谁听，应该都不会立刻就相信吧。
English: Anyone would be skeptical about claims of a haunted room, wouldn't they?

Chinese: 是真的！我的抽屉里时不时就会有怪声音传出来，可打开之后里面却什么都没有……
English: It's true! Strange sounds keep coming from my drawer, but when I open it, there's nothing inside...

Chinese: 那种情况下，你居然敢打开抽屉？
English: You actually dared to open the drawer in that situation?

Chinese: 胆量大了不少嘛，不错，这也是一种成长。
English: Good for you. More courage means growth.

Chinese: 饲主先生，现在不是夸我的时候吧，虽然挺开心的就是了……
English: Master, this isn't the time for praise... though I appreciate it!

Chinese: 那么，抽屉里的声音是什么样的，怪物的吼叫吗？
English: So, what kind of sound was it? A monster's roar?

Chinese: 不是的，是有个女孩子在说话，唔，应该是女孩子，总之是个女声。
English: No, it's like a girl talking... Mm, yes, it sounded like a girl. Definitely a female voice.

Chinese: 还记得具体的内容吗？
English: Can you remember the content?

Chinese: 呃……因为太紧张，我没记住全部……
English: Er... I was too nervous, I couldn't remember everything...

Chinese: 只记得她一直在说“什么什么之魂”、“谁来帮帮我”之类的话，有时还会哭……
English: I only remember her saying something about a "soul," and "Someone help me," things like that... Sometimes she was crying too...

Chinese: 不管她是不是“鬼”，显然是碰上了一些困扰。
English: A ghost or not, she must be troubled.

Chinese: 可她也不能因为自己困扰，就来困扰我吧，弄得我晚上连觉都睡不好……
English: But she can't trouble me with her own trouble. I can't sleep...

Chinese: 走，去看看吧。
English: Let's go have a look.

Chinese: 去看看？去哪儿？咦！诶——！！饲主先生是打算去我的房间吗？
English: Take a look? Where? Huh? Wha—?! Master, are you going to my room?

Chinese: 你为闹鬼的事来找我，难道不是希望我去调查一下？
English: I thought you wanted me to investigate it.

Chinese: 我只是想，如果可以换个房间，大概也是一种办法，毕竟，值完这一轮班，我就要住回星海去了……
English: I just want another room. After all, I should go back to the Celestial Sea after my shift...

Chinese: 抽屉闹鬼总得想办法解决，不然，下一轮当班的星痕还是会碰到一样的问题。
English: But the haunted drawer needs to be solved, or the next Aster on duty will face the same problem.

Chinese: 必须把那个声音是怎么来的搞清楚，所以，这就带我去你的房间吧。
English: We should find out what's behind the voice. Take me to your room.

Chinese: 可、可是……（小声）房间现在超级乱的，不要说垃圾了，贴身衣物也被我丢得到处都是……
English: B-But... *whispers* It's messy... I've even got underwear tossed everywhere...

Chinese: 饲主先生要是看见了，我的印象分一定会大打折扣的……啊…怎么办……
English: He will think less of me if you see that... Aw... What should I do...

Chinese: 你在那嘀咕些什么呢？
English: What are you mumbling about?

Chinese: 为了不让波斯菊纠结到太阳落山甚至是更晚的某个时间，最好的办法就是直接拽住她一起走起来。
English: The best way to stop Calliopsis from dwelling on the trivial is to simply take her by the arm and lead the way.

Chinese: 快点走了。
English: Gotta go.

Chinese: 饲主先生，要不，你先给我几分钟，让我回去打扫一下？
English: Master, how about you give me a few seconds to clean my room?

Chinese: 不用那么麻烦，垃圾和衣服满地都是的房间我并不是没见过。
English: No need. I saw messy rooms a lot.

Chinese: 咦！饲主先生原来都听到了吗？！
English: Huh! You heard all that?!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我还是高估了自己，或者说低估了房间的凌乱程度。看来波斯菊和抽屉里的鬼魂打了一场恶仗。
English: I either overestimated myself or underestimated the sheer chaos of the room. It looks as though Calliopsis fought a pitched battle with the ghost in the drawer.

Chinese: 在正式调查那个抽屉之前，波斯菊与我一起进行了一次大扫除，连姗姗来迟的牧也没有逃过这场清洁大作战。
English: Before the investigation, Calliopsis and I take some time cleaning the room. Even Muu, who arrives later, has to join us.

Chinese: 呼……终于打扫完了，多亏了饲主先生和牧大人。
English: Phew... I made it, thanks to Master and Muu.

Chinese: 要不是侍主大人的要求，这种大规模的打扫，我绝对是会问你收费的。
English: I would have charged you for this if it was not Lord Oracle's request.

Chinese: 不过，千万不要以为我没注意到，很多家具都出现了不同规模的损坏，关于赔偿和修复的费用，我回去后会给你开张清单的。
English: And I notice that several pieces of furniture are more or less damaged. I will make a list of the repair expenses and compensation for you.

Chinese: 魔、魔鬼……
English: D-Devil...

Chinese: 波斯菊，关于抽屉里闹鬼这件事。它一般会在什么时间开始呢？
English: Calliopsis, in terms of the haunting ghost. When does it usually appear?

Chinese: 那该不会是瞎编的吧？为了把饲主骗过来。谁给你支的招数？
English: This isn't some story you've fabricated to lure Master here, is it? Whose idea was this little trick?
Huh?!

Chinese: 怎、怎么会呢？我绝对没有骗饲主先生！
English: H-How come? I will never lie to Master!

Chinese: 可那个抽屉没有发出过一丝声响。
English: But the drawer never made a sound.

Chinese: 而且这是神谕司，有结界的！怎么可能闹鬼？
English: This is the Oracle Division. We have a barrier! Haunting is impossible.

Chinese: 话是这么说…可、可是……
English: I know... B-But...

Chinese: <size=30>呜呜…………</size>
English: <size=30>Mmph...</size>

Chinese: 都安静！
English: Quiet!

Chinese: 虽然很短暂，但刚才的那一瞬间，的确有一声女孩子的哭咽，一旁的牧警觉地竖起了耳朵，波斯菊则捂住了自己的嘴，用力地指向抽屉。
English: Though brief, in that instant, there was indeed the sound of a girl's sob. Muu, beside me, pricked up her ears, alert, while Calliopsis clapped a hand over her mouth, pointing emphatically at the drawer.

Chinese: 抽屉看起来毫无异常，没有异动，也没有冒出什么可疑的气息，但三个人谁都没有说话，静静地等待着那个声音的下一次响起。
English: The drawer looks ordinary without anything suspicious. None of us speaks. We wait for the voice to appear again.

Chinese: <size=30>呜……卯…魂……谁……帮…呜……</size>
English: <size=30>Boohoo... Bun... Soul... Who... help... Mmph...</size>

Chinese: 抽屉里的声音是存在的，波斯菊的确没有在撒谎，只是这声音断断续续，根本听不明白她在说些什么。
English: The voice is real. Calliopsis didn't lie. But the voice is too fragmented to make any sense.

Chinese: 牧看向我，似乎是在等待我的指示，在看到我的出击手势后，她一个箭步冲到了抽屉前，一把将它抽了出来，往里一看，满脸写着惊讶。
English: Muu turns to me, waiting for my order. Seeing my gesture, she leaps and opens the drawer. She seems shocked as she looks inside.

Chinese: 怎么样？里面是什么？
English: How does it look? What's in it?

Chinese: 您最好过来看一下……
English: You should come and see for yourself, Master...

Chinese: 虽然牧的表情已经说明抽屉里绝不寻常，但当我实实在在地看到占据着整个抽屉的星海时，
English: The look on Muu's face says it can't be anything normal, but when I see the galaxy in the drawer...

Chinese: 那种震撼，是几十个波斯菊的凌乱卧房一起砸在眼前都无法比拟的。
English: I am a hundred times more shocked than when I saw the messy room of Calliopsis.

Chinese: 这是…星空？
English: That's... galaxy?

Chinese: 只能说看起来很像，但不管它是什么，正常来说都不可能出现在一个……抽屉里。
English: Seems like one. Whatever it is, it can't be in a... drawer.

Chinese: 所以，就说有闹鬼啦！
English: I told you so!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 唔……我刚才真的好委屈，快哭出来的那种！
English: Boohoo... I was sad. I almost cried!

Chinese: 明白了，明天给你买两筐胡萝卜过来。
English: I see. I'll buy you two baskets of carrots tomorrow.

Chinese: 饲主先生最好了。
English: That's so nice of you, Master.

Chinese: 只要有胡萝卜吃，波斯菊就会不由自主地开心起来，虽然这份纯粹很值得提倡，但一开心起来就要抱住我的这种忘我，就值得稍微商榷。
English: Calliopsis cheers up as long as she has carrots. Pure and valuable, this side of her is good as long as she won't have to hug me.

Chinese: 特别是，在当下的场景中，并不是只有我们两个人……
English: Especially since, in the current situation, we aren't the only two people present...

Chinese: 咳咳，虽然但是，请记得我还在这里！
English: Ahem, I'm still here!

Chinese: 短暂的闹剧过后，便是对抽屉中的神秘空间进行研究，话虽如此，但面对着完全未知的领域，我和牧都拿不出什么有效的主意。
English: After the interlude, we begin to study the mysterious space in the drawer. However, we don't know what to do with the completely unknown realm.

Chinese: 说话的人是谁？她是被困在了这片空间之中吗？又或者，她正在某个诸如锦绣江山的靠这片空间连接的位面？
English: Who's the talking girl? Is she trapped in the galaxy? Or perhaps she's on another plane like the Splendid World?

Chinese: 有桃的那次事件在先，这也并不是没有可能。
English: Given the previous incident with Momo, it isn't entirely out of the question.

Chinese: 当然，还有一个很容易被忽视的疑点，为什么偏偏是波斯菊的抽屉？一个奇怪的观点，在我的脑海中浮现……
English: But what we can't ignore is why it's in this very drawer. A strange idea appears in my mind...

Chinese: 波斯菊，你是不是有什么过往，是我们并不知道的？
English: Calliopsis, is there something about your past that we don't know?

Chinese: 应该没有吧……
English: I suppose not...

Chinese: 波斯菊的眼睛瞪得又大又圆，看起来的确不像是会隐藏什么过去的样子。
English: Calliopsis stares at me wide-eyed. She doesn't seem to hide anything.

Chinese: 侍主大人怎么突然问起这个？
English: Why do you suddenly ask that?

Chinese: 我在想，神谕司那么大，偏偏是波斯菊的抽屉出现了这样的情况，当然可以解释为巧合，但巧合，往往也是建立在某种必然之上……
English: In such a large Oracle Division, it happens only to Calliopsis's drawer. A coincidence, maybe. But coincidences are often built on certainties...

Chinese: 我大概检索了一下，波斯菊是将近1000多年前被莉莉娅召唤的，主要的功绩……
English: I did some searching. Calliopsis was summoned by Lillia a thousand years ago and she achieved...

Chinese: 嗯，没有…主要的经历，是参与了圣龙战争，在风暴之殇后便选择了隐居。
English: Emm, nothing... She fought in the Sacred Dragon War and lived in seclusion after the Storm of Sorrow.

Chinese: 刚被召唤的时候我就说过了嘛，我只是一个平凡的小角色。
English: I told you so when I was summoned. I'm nobody.

Chinese: 真是如此吗…？莉莉娅真的会特意去召唤这样一名没什么功绩的小角色？
English: Really? Could Lillia make efforts to summon someone who achieved nothing?

Chinese: 只能从那个声音着手了吗？“卯”、“魂”……不行，信息太少了。
English: Is the voice our only clue? "Bun", "Soul"... No, we need information.

Chinese: 不过说起来，侍主大人可能没有发现，那个声音，和波斯菊倒真的是有点像。
English: Speaking of which... Lord Oracle, perhaps you didn't notice, but that voice... it actually sounds quite a bit like Calliopsis'.

Chinese: 有这回事？
English: Did it?

Chinese: 我的耳朵，什么时候出过错。
English: My ears make no mistake.

Chinese: 所以绕了一圈，还是只能从波斯菊身上找答案吗？
English: After all our efforts, we still have to find answers in Calliopsis.

Chinese: 转头看向波斯菊，她正目不转睛地盯着抽屉里的空间，好似着了迷一般…？
English: I turn to Calliopsis and find her staring at the galaxy in the drawer, enchanted...

Chinese: 波斯菊，你怎么看得那么入神？
English: Calliopsis, why are you staring so intently?

Chinese: 不对，这不是“着了迷”，或许用“着了魔”来形容才更加合适。
English: No, she is more like haunted.

Chinese: 她不仅像是没有听到我的声音，同时，正在无意识地向那片神秘的空间伸出手去。
English: She doesn't seem to hear me. Meanwhile, she reaches out her hand to the mysterious galaxy.

Chinese: 波斯菊？你怎么了？
English: Calliopsis? What's wrong?

Chinese: 牧也发现了波斯菊的异常，在没搞清楚这片空间究竟是何物之前，冒然的触碰是很危险的。
English: Muu also finds Calliopsis strange. It's dangerous to touch the galaxy before we know what it is.

Chinese: 一向处事小心的波斯菊显然应该明白这一点，所以，此刻的她并不正常。
English: Calliopsis has been very careful, so she should know it. She is acting weird.

Chinese: 波斯菊！清醒一点！别去碰它！！
English: Calliopsis! Snap out of it! Don't touch it!

Chinese: 可能是因为我突然提高了音量，也可能是因为我用力地抓住了波斯菊的手臂，她似乎清醒过来，对我眨巴着眼睛，一幅如梦如醒的样子。
English: Maybe it's because I raise my voice or because I grasp her arm with force, Calliopsis seems awakened from a dream and blinks at me.

Chinese: 你刚才是怎么了？
English: What happened to you?

Chinese: 咦？我做了什么奇怪的事吗？
English: Huh? Did I do something strange?

Chinese: 你死死地盯着抽屉，还试图去触碰它。
English: You stared at the drawer and tried to touch it.

Chinese: 诶？我怎么完全没有印象？
English: Huh? I have no memory of that...

Chinese: 看来这片空间并不友善，好在制止得还算及时，要是真的触碰到了，不好说会发生什么事。
English: The galaxy isn't nice. Luckily, I stopped you. Who knows what would happen?

Chinese: 有点不妙啊，侍主大人，您看她的手……
English: Crap. Lord Oracle, look at her hand...

Chinese: 这绝不是一句我想听到的话，视线慢慢地下移，虽然只有一点点，但波斯菊的指尖，的确已经伸进了那片空间之中。
English: That's the last thing I want to hear now. I look down and find Calliopsis's fingertip, though just the very top of it, is in the galaxy.

Chinese: 波斯菊也缓缓地看向了自己的手，抬起头，和我面面相觑。
English: Calliopsis slowly turns to her hand and then to me.

Chinese: 饲、饲主先生，现在收回手，还来得……
English: M-Master, if I draw it back now, will it...

Chinese: 话都未能说完，波斯菊的身体便被吸入到了那片空间之中，等我和牧反应过来的时候，尚在我们面前的，只剩下被我抓着的手臂。
English: Before she can finish, her whole body is absorbed by the galaxy. And we can only see the arm I am grasping before Muu and I can react.

Chinese: 我试图将波斯菊拉回来，但巨大的吸力并没打算让我这样做，连站起身的时间都没有争取到，我便和波斯菊一样，被那空间吸了进去。
English: I try to pull her back, but the huge force of the galaxy doesn't even give me a chance. Soon, I fall into the galaxy like Calliopsis.

Chinese: 侍主大人！！
English: Lord Oracle!!

Chinese: 牧一把抓住了我的手臂，死命地想要把我往外拉，但和预想的一样，毫无成效。
English: Muu hurries to grab my arm and help me out. But her efforts are apparently in vain.

Chinese: 更糟糕的是，空间竟然开始了收拢，抽屉内本身的样貌慢慢地显现出来。
English: The worst thing is, the galaxy is shrinking and turning back to the original drawer.

Chinese: 牧，放手吧，不然你也会被吸进来的。
English: Muu, let go! Or you'll be pulled in too!

Chinese: 不行，我不能让侍主大人遭遇意外。
English: No way. I can't allow anything to happen to you.

Chinese: 来不及了，空间正在收拢，不管里面是什么，我只能去走一遭了。
English: Too late. The galaxy is shrinking and I have to go through whatever this is.

Chinese: 可是……
English: But...

Chinese: 放心吧，不会有事的，我不在的这段时间里，神谕司暂且就交给你来打理了。
English: Don't worry. I'll be fine. The Oracle Division is all yours when I'm away.

Chinese: 牧并没有松手的意思，为了不让她也被吸进来，我只能奋力扭转一下手臂，挣脱了她的手，也顺势让她向后倒下，避免被这片空间波及。
English: Muu doesn't seem to feel like giving up. I have to twist my arm to shake her off and let her fall backward so that she won't be sucked in the galaxy.

Chinese: 啊！侍主大人……！！
English: Ahhh! Lord Oracle!!

Chinese: 没有了牧的外力，巨大的吸力猛地将我拉向了深邃之中，一瞬间，我便失去了意识……
English: Without the pulling force, I am dragged deep into the galaxy and soon lose consciousness...

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 波斯菊
English: Calliopsis

Chinese: 丘吉尔
English: Churchill

Chinese: 魔兽？
English: Magical beast?

Chinese: 怪物
English: Monster

Chinese: 怪物2
English: Monster 2

Chinese: 第一节 林间兽
English: EP 1: Forest Creature

Chinese: 侍主和波斯菊被传送到了一片森林，没走两步便遭遇了“异兽”的袭击，侍主认为仅靠波斯菊一人难以抵挡，便用星魂结晶召唤出了丘吉尔……
English: Transported to a forest, Lord Oracle and Calliopsis are soon attacked by a beast. Realizing Calliopsis alone can't hold it off, Lord Oracle summons Churchill with Mana Crystal...

Chinese: 波斯菊，你醒醒，波斯菊！
English: Calliopsis, wake up, Calliopsis!

Chinese: 醒来的时候，我和趴在一旁的波斯菊已经置身在眼前的森林之中，仅凭这些到哪都长得差不多的树，根本没法推测出我们身在何处。
English: Calliopsis lies beside me as I awake, already deep within the forest. The trees, indistinguishable from one another, offer no clue to our whereabouts.

Chinese: 答案显然不会从天而降，必须尽快离开这里，不过在此之前，得先把波斯菊给弄醒。
English: Knowing that no solution will present itself, we have to depart without delay. But first, I need to wake Calliopsis.

Chinese: 耳边的轻语、戳脸、挠痒……该用的办法都用上了，波斯菊依然睡得死沉，我只能深吸一口气，准备祭出杀手锏。
English: Whispering in her ear, prodding her cheek, even tickling... I tried everything. Yet Calliopsis remained fast asleep. Taking a deep breath, I prepare to resort to my trump card.

Chinese: ——快起来吃新鲜的胡萝卜啦！！！
English: —Get up and eat fresh carrots!!!

Chinese: 胡萝卜！新鲜的！在哪里？！
English: Carrot! Fresh! Where?!

Chinese: 前一秒还在熟睡的波斯菊上演了华丽的弹射起身，节奏丝滑，毫不拖沓。
English: Calliopsis, who was deeply asleep just moments before, leaps to her feet with astonishing nimbleness.

Chinese: 她绷直着身体，左顾右盼，眼神中没有丝毫的杂念，完全是一副顶级猎食者的模样，搜索着胡萝卜的踪迹。
English: She stands up straight, her gaze sweeping over her surroundings with sharp concentration, like an apex predator on the hunt.

Chinese: 只是，当她确定周围并没有胡萝卜的存在后，紧绷着的神经瞬间又松懈了下来，脸上的失望没有丝毫的隐藏。
English: Yet, the absence of carrots softens her alert stance, and a look of disappointment washes over her features.

Chinese: 什么呀，根本没有胡萝卜嘛，饲主先生怎么也骗人呢？
English: What? There aren't any carrots at all! Master, how could you trick me?

Chinese: 那只是为了让你清醒起来的必要手段，别抱怨了，把你对胡萝卜的执念暂时放一放，看看周围的环境，稍微有点紧张感吧。
English: That's merely a necessary means to wake you up. Stop complaining, set aside your obsession with carrots for now, assess our surroundings, and let your survival instincts take over.

Chinese: 唔……饲主先生，我们这是在哪里呀？
English: Um... Master, where the heck are we?

Chinese: 一片森林，这是我们唯一能掌握到的信息，想要知道更多的话，必须得动起来。
English: A forest. That's all we know for certain. If we want to learn more, we need to get moving.

Chinese: 可是，要往哪个方向走呀？
English: But which way?

Chinese: 就选前面吧，先摸着一个方向，试着走出这片森林再说。
English: Let's head straight for now. We'll pick a direction and try to find our way out of this forest.

Chinese: 那…饲主先生一定要牵着我！！
English: Alright, let's hold hands!!

Chinese: 与其说是“牵”手，不如说是波斯菊抱着我的手臂，虽然动作有些别扭，但我们终于踏出了探索未知的第一步。
English: Instead of grabbing my hand, she latches onto my arm. It's a bit clumsy, but we start making our way through the unknown woods.

Chinese: 如果牧在的话，多少还能借助一下她的嗅觉，选择一个绝对不会出错的方向，但在一个全新的环境里，实际上也不存在“冤枉路”这个概念。
English: If Muu were here, we could at least rely on her sense of smell to choose a foolproof direction. But in a completely new environment, there's really no such thing as taking a "wrong path."

Chinese: 此刻的森林正沐浴在阳光之中，没有波斯菊最害怕的恐怖气氛，趁着她的状态正好，是时候抛出那个我在意到现在的问题了……
English: The forest is all lit up with sunshine, not spooky at all. Calliopsis seems chill, so I figure it's a good time to ask something that'd been bugging me.

Chinese: 波斯菊，刚才盯着抽屉的时候，你都看到了什么？
English: Hey, Calliopsis, what was up with that drawer you were staring at before?

Chinese: 其、其实，我也不太记得了……
English: A-Actually, I don't really remember much...

Chinese: 黑雾…？不，一开始是一片黑雾，它好像看到了我，慢慢地变成了我的样子。
English: A black mist...? No, it was a black mist at first. It seemed to see me, and then it slowly transformed into my likeness.

Chinese: 向我伸出了手，然后我就不太记得了，直到饲主先生叫了我一声……
English: It reached out its hand, and then everything was a blur until you snapped me out of it...

Chinese: 黑雾变成了你？
English: So, the black mist transformed into you?

Chinese: 嗯…硬要说，似乎又有点不像，但是它肯定也长着兔子的耳朵。
English: Yeah... I mean, it was kinda like me, but with bunny ears for sure.

Chinese: 抽屉里的声音和波斯菊很像，也只有波斯菊看到了黑影，而连接着这里的空间通道偏偏又是在波斯菊的抽屉里……
English: That noise from the drawer sounded just like Calliopsis, and she was the only one who saw that shadow. Plus, the portal to this place was in her drawer...

Chinese: 这显然不是巧合，波斯菊和这个地方一定有某种必然的联系。
English: That can't be just random. There has to be some deep link between Calliopsis and this spot.

Chinese: 饲主先生怎么不说话了？是在生我的气吗？
English: Master, why have you gone quiet? Are you angry with me?

Chinese: 生气？为什么？
English: Angry? Why?

Chinese: 如果不是因为我碰了抽屉，饲主先生根本不用来这个地方受累……
English: If I hadn't messed with that drawer, you wouldn't be stuck here...

Chinese: 别这么想，这不是你的错，确切地说，这都不能算是“错”。
English: Hey, don't beat yourself up. It's not on you. And honestly, it's not really a "mess-up."

Chinese: 即便身在神谕司，也会在门牌上写着“求求坏人们都回去吧”的你，是不会主动去找麻烦的，如果遇到麻烦，一定是麻烦来找的你。
English: You're the type who, even in the Oracle Division, would hang a sign saying "No baddies allowed!" You would never trouble until trouble troubles you.

Chinese: ……怎么有种被饲主先生看光光的感觉…？
English: Why do I feel naked under your scrutiny?

Chinese: 我能听懂你的意思，但下次最好斟酌一下你的用词。
English: I understand what you mean, but perhaps choose your words more carefully next time.

Chinese: 嘻嘻，只要饲主先生不怪我就好，不然，再新鲜的胡萝卜也会不香的。
English: Haha! Your lectures could turn the freshest carrot bitter.

Chinese: 至少这句话，我是不信的。
English: I doubt that.

Chinese: 而且，能像这样与饲主先生单独相处的机会可真不多呢，在温暖的阳光下手牵手走在森林里，就像约会一样。
English: Anyway, it's not often we get to hang out just us two, strolling through the woods, the sun shining down. Feels kinda like a date.

Chinese: 被你这么一描述，怎么听起来有点怪……
English: When you put it that way, it does sound a little... strange.

Chinese: 不过，能让你感觉轻松，那是最好的，我一直很担心陌生的环境会影响到你的情绪，看来是我想多了。
English: Still, if it helps you relax, then that's for the best. I was worried you'd be all tense in this weird place. Looks like I worried unnecessarily.

Chinese: 我成为星痕也已经很长时间了，饲主先生怎么能小看我呢？
English: I've been an Aster for a long time now, Master. You think I'm that fragile?

Chinese: 是吗？那是谁的手心一直在出汗呢？
English: Really? Then why are your hands all clammy?

Chinese: 饲主先生讨厌啦！不说出来也没关系的吧！
English: Ugh, you're such a pain! You don't have to say it out loud!

Chinese: 还是不要太过无忧无虑了，我们的这次旅程，大概不会太轻松。
English: We should stay on our toes, though. This trek might get rough.

Chinese: 只要有饲主先生在，什么困难我都能克服过去！
English: Long as you're by my side, I can handle anything that comes our way!
Rhaar!!!

Chinese: 呀！！！什么声音？！
English: Aah!!! What was that sound?!

Chinese: 突如其来的吼声带着明显的恶意，把刚才还说着“什么困难都能克服过去”的波斯菊直接吓到了我的身后，
English: The abrupt roar, laden with hostility, strikes fear into Calliopsis, who just declared, "I can handle anything that comes our way." She swiftly takes refuge behind me, visibly shaken.

Chinese: 前后的反差之大，言语根本无法形容。
English: The stark contrast between her previous declaration and her present demeanor is beyond words.

Chinese: 波斯菊，做好战斗的准备。
English: Calliopsis, gear up for a brawl.

Chinese: 唔……好！
English: Well... OK!
Rhaaar! Rhaaar!!!

Chinese: 一头奇异的野兽从树丛中窜了出来。
English: Out of the trees lunges this weird beast.

Chinese: 魔、魔兽？！
English: M—Magical beast?!

Chinese: 好像不是，至少不是咱们那里的魔兽。
English: It doesn't seem to be. At least, not like the beasts we know.

Chinese: 从它的身上能强烈地感受到灾厄的气息，与锦绣江山的祸兽相似，但仍有明显的区别……
English: I sense a disaster vibe, kinda like the Disaster Beast from the Splendid World, but with its own twist.

Chinese: 先撇开应该怎么定义它的问题，直觉告诉我，它并不好对付。
English: Setting aside the question of how to classify it, it is not an easy opponent.
Rhaar!!!

Chinese: 饲主先生请退后，把、把它交给我。
English: Master, step back. I got this.
Rhaar!!!

Chinese: 伴随着一声长啸，眼前的家伙以肉眼难辨的速度分裂成了若干个分身。
English: The beast roars, splitting into clones too fast for the eye to catch.

Chinese: 饲主先生…怎、怎么办！！
English: Master... wh-what do we do?!

Chinese: 拖住它们至少30秒，我得给你找个帮手。
English: Stall them for at least thirty seconds. I need to summon some help for you.

Chinese: 30秒吗？好，一定不辱使命！
English: Thirty seconds? Alright, I won't let you down!

Chinese: 我用最快的速度进行了召唤仪式，一道金色的光闪过后，丘吉尔出现在了我和波斯菊的身前。
English: I execute the summoning ritual with haste. Following a flash of golden light, Churchill materializes before Calliopsis and me.

Chinese: 应侍主大人的召唤，丘吉尔前来报道！诶，是通常召唤呢？可是没有魔女！？
English: Churchill, at your command, Lord Oracle! Wait, is this a regular summon? Where's the Nova!?

Chinese: 啊， 是丘吉尔！
English: Oh, it's Churchill!

Chinese: 波斯菊？你怎么也在……
English: Calliopsis? Why are you here...

Chinese: 呜哇！这些都是什么呀？怎么和锦绣江山的祸兽有点神似？
English: Waah! What's with these critters? They look like Disaster Beasts from the Splendid World!

Chinese: 虽然很高兴见到丘吉尔，但对于这次召唤，我本来的期望是给波斯菊增加一个擅长近战的帮手，然而现在的局面却是…两个射箭的……
English: I hoped for a close-combat ace to support Calliopsis, but we receive two archers instead. Nevertheless, I'm grateful to have Churchill on board for the mission.

Chinese: 抱歉了，丘吉尔，刚把你召唤来就要你应付这样一场战斗，详细的情况我一会儿再给你说明，先和波斯菊配合，肃清眼前的敌人。
English: Sorry, Churchill, I gave you short notice of this fight. Details later. For now, team up with Calliopsis and mop up these foes.

Chinese: 好嘞，侍主大人叫我射谁，我就射谁！
English: OK, you call the shots. I will follow!

Chinese: 我、我也会加油的！
English: I-I'll do my best too!

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 波斯菊
English: Calliopsis

Chinese: 丘吉尔
English: Churchill

Chinese: 魔兽？
English: Magical beast?

Chinese: 怪物
English: Monster

Chinese: 怪物2
English: Monster 2

Chinese: 第一节 林间兽
English: EP 1: Forest Creature

Chinese: 侍主和波斯菊被传送到了一片森林，没走两步便遭遇了“异兽”的袭击，侍主认为仅靠波斯菊一人难以抵挡，便用星魂结晶召唤出了丘吉尔……
English: Transported to a forest, Lord Oracle and Calliopsis are soon attacked by a beast. Realizing Calliopsis alone can't hold it off, Lord Oracle summons Churchill with Mana Crystal...

Chinese: 呼……总算打赢了，还好有丘吉尔帮忙。
English: Whew... we pulled through, thanks to Churchill.

Chinese: 你表现得不是挺好嘛，说得好像全是我的功劳一样，不过，如果你只是想变着法子夸我的话，我是不会拒绝的。
English: Great job, though you put it as if it was all my credit. And if you want to flatter me, you are welcome.

Chinese: 诶？刚经历完一场恶战，心态居然那么放松，好、好厉害……
English: Huh? We just survived a fierce battle, yet you're so relaxed. Th-That's amazing...

Chinese: 教你一个保持好心态的秘诀，只要想着“有侍主大人在”就可以了。
English: Let me tell you a secret to maintaining such a good attitude: just remember, "Lord Oracle is with us."

Chinese: 唔…你说的很有道理。
English: Huh... makes sense.

Chinese: 我很高兴交集并不多的你们俩能那么快打成一片，但眼下，还是尽快往前走吧，
English: Nice to see you two getting along so quickly, but we gotta keep moving.

Chinese: 刚才的敌人和米伦、锦绣江山的都不一样，我们很可能到了又一个异世界。
English: These enemies aren't like the ones in Mirren or the Splendid World. We're in a whole new world.

Chinese: 所以，必须快点找到一个有人的地方，把这里到底是哪儿给问清楚才行。
English: Gotta find a local and figure out where we are.

Chinese: 咦…又是其他的世界吗？怎么每次到异世界冒险就会有我的份呀。
English: Huh? Another world again? How come I'm always part of adventures into other worlds?

Chinese: 目前来说，只是巧合，万一不小心有下次，我会修改这个结论。
English: For now, let's call it a coincidence. If, by chance, there's a next time, I may have to revise that conclusion.

Chinese: 那到时候……嗯！请给我一个“侍主大人钦点异世界拓荒者”的称号！
English: Alright, then... Please grant me the title of "Lord Oracle's Designated Pioneer of Uncharted Worlds"!

Chinese: 我觉得可以把“侍主大人钦点”给去……唔——！！
English: I think we can remove the "Lord Oracle's Designated" part... Nngh—!!

Chinese: 饲主先生！！您怎么了？！
English: Master!! What's wrong?!

Chinese: 侍主大人！你的样子…………果然，没有魔女在，由你自己来进行星痕凭依还是太勉强了！
English: Lord Oracle! Your look... Without the Nova, performing the Aster Possession solo is a bit much!

Chinese: 我不用照镜子也知道自己正在发生什么变化。
English: No mirror needed to see what's going down.

Chinese: 抬起手稍微看了一眼，果然，我的皮肤正在开裂，就像有某种力量正在从内部撕扯我的身体，虽说不足以伤及性命，但疼痛却难以抑制。
English: I raise my hand to look. Sure enough, my skin cracks as if some force is tearing me apart from the inside. Though it isn't life-threatening, the agony is excruciating.

Chinese: 无妨，不用担心我，这种状态只是暂时的。
English: It's nothing. Don't worry about me. This condition is only temporary.

Chinese: 饲主先生看起来好像很痛的样子，真的不用坐下来休息一下吗？
English: You're hurting badly. Shall we take a rest and a load off?

Chinese: 不行，森林里一定还有其他的敌人，停下来等于是在邀请它们来攻击。
English: Nah, more enemies in the forest. If we stop now, we're sitting ducks.

Chinese: 要是立刻再进行一次战斗，我的情况只会更糟，边走边恢复才是良策。
English: Another flight would make me worse. Recovering while on the move is the best course of action.

Chinese: 可、可是……
English: Bu—But...

Chinese: 走起来吧，要相信侍主大人的判断。
English: Let's get moving. We must trust Lord Oracle's judgment.

Chinese: 唔……好、好吧。
English: Mmm... A-Alright then.

Chinese: 话说得虽然漂亮，但犹如刀割的疼痛还是让我有些举步维艰。
English: It's easier said than done. The pain, sharp as a blade, hinders my movement.

Chinese: 好在有波斯菊和丘吉尔一左一右的搀扶，才勉强可以移动，希望直到我恢复前，不会再发生什么意外。
English: Fortunately, with Calliopsis and Churchill supporting me on either side, I could manage to move. I wish for no further mishaps until my recovery.

Chinese: 前面的人！请等一下！
English: You there, up ahead! Please wait a moment!

English: [Options]

Chinese: 第二节 影猫卫
English: EP 2: Shadow Panther

Chinese: 叫住侍主一行的少女名为飞玉，自称红簌国的影猫卫，双方进行过信息交换后，侍主决定去皇宫见当世的卯兔圣卫，同行的飞玉决定带路……
English: A girl named Jady stops them, claiming to be the Shadow Panther of the Crimson Kingdom. After a chat, she offers to guide them to the palace, where the Bunnic Sentinel awaits.

Chinese: 身后传来一个女孩子的声音，虽然也有是敌人的可能，但来到这里以后，我们还没见过活生生的人类。
English: Suddenly, a girl's voice emerges from behind us. Despite the possibility of a foe, we didn't encounter another soul since our arrival here.

Chinese: 我顾不上身上的痛感，急忙转过身，却什么人都没看见……
English: Disregarding the pain, I spin around swiftly, but there's nobody in sight...

Chinese: 嗯？明明听到有人叫住我们了呀，怎么什么都没看见？
English: Hmm? We clearly hear someone. Why is there no one to be seen?

Chinese: 我们该不会是幻听了吧？
English: D-Do you think we imagined it?

Chinese: 都在往哪儿看呢？我在上面！
English: Where are you looking? I'm up here!

Chinese: 闻声抬起头去，只见一个女孩站在大树的树枝上，因为背光的关系，看不清楚她的样貌，但依稀能看到一对猫耳正在微幅地前后动弹着。
English: We raise our heads and see a girl standing on a tree branch. Due to the backlight, her appearance is unclear, but we vaguely see a pair of cat ears twitching slightly.

Chinese: 这些灾兽，是你们干掉的吗？
English: These Disastrous Beasts... did you take them down?

Chinese: “灾兽”？又是一个新的名词……
English: "Disastrous Beasts?" Another new term...

Chinese: 嘿~嗖~！
English: Whoosh!

Chinese: 自配了一记跳跃的拟声词后，那女孩用力地一蹬，向着我们的方向纵身一跃，可是，伴随着她离我们越来越近，我逐渐发现了事态的不对。
English: After making her own sound effect for the jump, the girl springs toward us. However, as she draws closer, I gradually realize something is amiss.

Chinese: 显然，她估算错了那一蹬的力道，原本估计是想落在我面前的她，已经脱离了预定的轨道，径直地朝我砸了过来。
English: She misjudges the strength of her leap. Rather than landing before me, she heads straight for me instead.

Chinese: 换作平时，想躲开并不难，但此刻的我……
English: Under normal circumstances, dodging her won't be a challenge, but at that moment...

Chinese: 波斯菊和丘吉尔不约而同地想到要将我拉到一边，然而，两人都只想到了将我往各自的方向拉。
English: Calliopsis and Churchill both attempt to yank me to safety, yet their simultaneous tugs in opposite directions

Chinese: 两边的拉力不仅加剧了我的疼痛，还顺带地固定了我的位置。
English: only intensified my agony, rendering me immobile.

Chinese: 呀！快躲开啊！！！
English: Ah! Watch out!!!

Chinese: 没有任何的意外，那个女孩实实在在地将我撞翻在地，连波斯菊和丘吉尔也未能幸免。
English: Unsurprisingly, the girl collides squarely with me, sending me to the ground. Calliopsis and Churchill aren't spared either.

Chinese: 至于那一刻从前胸到后背的痛感，我实在不想进行任何的描述。
English: The pain that pierces from my chest to my back is off the charts.

Chinese: 待扬起的尘土消散后，我终于看清了女孩的样貌，猫型半兽人，衣服和别在腰间的剑皆是东方的质感，
English: When the dust settles, I finally get a clear view of her. She's an Orccodro with feline features, adorned in traditional oriental attire and arms with a sword.

Chinese: 因为吸入了不少的烟尘，她正轻声咳嗽着……
English: Her coughs from the dust reverberate through me

Chinese: 然而，因为正骑在我身上的缘故，她的每一次咳嗽，对我来说都宛如一次地震，
English: as if an earthquake as she's perched atop me.

Chinese: 咳了整整几十秒之后，她终于意识到了自己尴尬的坐姿，连忙站起身，鞠躬道歉。
English: After coughing for a good many seconds, she finally realizes her awkward position, hastily scrambles to her feet, and bows in apology.

Chinese: 对、对不起，我一直控制不好跳跃的力度，你、你没事吧？
English: S-Sorry! I'm still figuring out how to land these jumps. Are you good?

Chinese: 如果你再多骑几秒钟，可能就真的有事了……
English: If you'd sit around any longer, I'd be in real trouble...

Chinese: 一旁的波斯菊和丘吉尔也坐起了身，看到动弹不得的我，无不是一脸的惊恐。
English: Calliopsis and Churchill scramble up on their feet, looking scared.

Chinese: 饲、饲、饲、饲主先生！！！您还好吗？！！
English: M-M-M-Master!!! Are you alright?!!

Chinese: 侍主大人？！要不要射她，您不用说话，点头或点头就好了！
English: Lord Oracle?! Should we shoot her? You don't have to speak, a nod will suffice! Or another nod!

Chinese: 怎、怎么还有两个人……嗫？等等！为什么突然就要射人家？！
English: Wh-Where did these two people come from... Nya? Wait! Why the sudden talk of shooting me?!

Chinese: 不应该是点头或摇头吗？
English: Shouldn't it be "nod or head shake"?

Chinese: 她对侍主大人做了那么过分的事，还想要摇头的选项？做梦！
English: She did such an outrageous thing to you, so there is no other option for her!

Chinese: 嗫……又是侍主大人的，又是什么饲主先生的，你们到底是什么关系呀？倒在地上的那位，是很了不起的人物吗？
English: Huh... Why do you call him Lord Oracle and Master? What's your deal? The guy on the ground, is he a big shot?

Chinese: 嗫…他的皮肤看起来好可怕……
English: Ugh... his skin's a mess...

Chinese: 别问那么多了，先帮忙把饲主先生扶起来吧。
English: Enough with the questions for now! Just help us get Master back on his feet.

Chinese: 嗫……嗫啊？！兔子耳朵、是兔裔？！
English: Huh... Huh?! Rabbit ears? Are you a Bunnician?!

Chinese: 咦？是在说我吗？兔裔？那是什么呀？
English: Huh? Me? Bunnician? What's that about?

Chinese: 等一下等一下，兔裔应该是灭绝了，只剩下当今的卯兔圣卫？难道你是……可为什么，感觉好像看不清嗫？
English: Hold on. Bunnician are supposed to be history, except for the Bunnic Sentinel. Could you be... But why cannot I see you clearly?

Chinese: 好像看见了，又好像没有看见…………着装和脸……好像变得眼熟起来了，嗫，盯着一看，又错乱了。
English: It's like I see you, but then I don't... the clothes and face... seem familiar. But the more I look, the more my head spins.

Chinese: 她们两个比较特别，最好别一直盯着看。
English: These two are rather... unique. It's best not to stare at them for too long.

Chinese: 不对不对，我差点忘了最重要的问题，能打赢灾兽，你们绝不是普通人，快表明身份，以及，来红簌国的目的！
English: No, no, wait! I almost forgot the most important question! You defeated Disastrous Beasts, so you're clearly not ordinary people. State your identities and your purpose in the Crimson Kingdom!

Chinese: 我们应该都有不少的问题需要问对方，不过，在正式的你问我答之前，能不能先把我扶起来……
English: Sure, we've all got a ton of questions, but can you lend me a hand first?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 结束了这场闹剧后，我们四人席地而坐，交换起彼此的信息，虽然有违继续赶路的原计划，但提前遇到了这个世界的住民，也算是意外的收获。
English: After the chaotic introduction, the four of us sat on the ground and began to exchange information. Although it deviated from our original plan to press on, encountering an inhabitant of this world so soon was an unexpected boon.

Chinese: 这里既不是米伦，也不是锦绣江山，而是一个名为“太一”的世界，我们正身处在太一最强盛的国家——“红簌国”的边境区域。
English: This place is not Mirren, nor is it the Splendid World, it is a world known as "Taeuno." Here, we stand at the frontier of Taeuno's mightiest nation—the Crimson Kingdom.

Chinese: 而少女名叫“飞玉”，自称是红簌国的影猫卫。
English: The girl, named Jady, claims to hold the title of Shadow Panther in the Crimson Kingdom.

Chinese: 米伦……在太一之外，居然还有别的世界呀，噗嗫，感觉世界又扩大了，好有趣~~
English: Mirren... So there's a whole new world out there beyond Taeuno. Pff-nya, it feels like the world has suddenly expanded. How fascinating~

Chinese: ……不过！前提是你们没有骗人！
English: But! Just hoping you're not pulling my leg!

Chinese: 听起来是有些离谱，但我们真的没有说谎，请相信我们。
English: It's a wild tale, but cross my heart, no lies.

Chinese: 嗫…和兔裔说话的感觉，好微妙。
English: Nya... Talking with a Bunnician... it's such a strange feeling.

Chinese: 飞玉小姐，你刚才有提过“卯兔圣卫”，那是什么？
English: Miss Jady, you mentioned the "Bunnic Sentinel." What's that about?

Chinese: 相传，在红簌国的建立之初，开国皇帝将伴随着他打下江山的十二名兽裔勇士封为了十二圣卫，
English: Legend has it that when the Crimson Kingdom was founded, the emperor named the twelve Orccodro Warriors who helped him conquer the country the Twelve Sentinels.

Chinese: 卯兔圣卫是其中的一席，在红簌国的地位可高了嗫。
English: The Bunnic Sentinel is one of them, and they hold a high status in the Crimson Kingdom.

Chinese: 哇~~这个世界的兔兔半兽人居然那么有出息，波斯菊，学着点儿~
English: Wow! A bunny Orccodro in this world is a force to be reckoned with. Calliopsis, take notes!

Chinese: 你一定要多说这一句吗？
English: Do you have to add that last part?

Chinese: 波斯菊？嗫……当今的卯兔圣卫也叫波斯菊来着……
English: Calliopsis? Huh... The current Bunnic Sentinel is also named Calliopsis...

Chinese: 诶？！怎么会……？
English: What?! How could it be...

Chinese: 果然，波斯菊和这个世界的确存在着某种联系。
English: Sure enough, there seems to be a connection between Calliopsis and this world.

Chinese: 嗫，对了，叫我飞玉就好，太拘束的称呼会让我不自在。
English: Oh, by the way, just call me Jady. Titles make me squirm.

Chinese: 你认识那位卯兔圣卫吗？
English: Do you know the Bunnic Sentinel?

Chinese: 不认识嗫，我只是一个负责边境治安的影卫，圣卫都是宫里的大人物。
English: I haven't met her personally. I'm just a Shadow Guard responsible for border security. The Sentinels are big shots in the palace.

Chinese: 不过我曾经听说过一些传闻，说是当世的卯兔圣卫刚上任时，总说自己来自别的世界……
English: But I've heard rumors that when the current Bunnic Sentinel took office, she claimed to come from another world...

Chinese: 对嗫，以前我一直不理解，但遇到你们以后就不一样了，其他的世界是存在的，也许当今的卯兔圣卫，也和你们一样吧！
English: I didn't get it then, but meeting you makes it click. Other worlds must exist. Maybe the current Bunnic Sentinel is like you—hails from another world!

Chinese: 这么说，你已经不怀疑我们说的话了吧？
English: So, you're not doubting our story anymore?

Chinese: 虽然还是很可疑，但也不是不能相信嗫。
English: It still sounds wild, but it's not impossible.

Chinese: 这种第一眼会认成另一个人，再盯着看一会，又会觉得陌生，不注意又变得眼熟起来的体质……如果不是骗人的故事，那肯定就是异世界了。
English: That feeling of recognizing someone at first sight, then feeling weird and familiar again... If it's not a lie, it's gotta be from a different world.

Chinese: 飞玉，如果我们想见见这位卯兔圣卫，可能吗？
English: Jady, can we meet this Bunnic Sentinel?

Chinese: 嗫……？可能有些困难嗫，她的居所可是在皇宫里的哟。
English: Nya...? It might be a bit difficult. Her residence is within the Palace, you see.

Chinese: 不过，碰上了你们这样的奇人异事，职责所系，也不能不管……嗫，这样吧，正好我也打算去都城，如果你们愿意，可以跟着我一起去。
English: But I can't ignore folks like you who need help... Well, I'm heading to the capital, and if you're up for it, tag along.

Chinese: 到时候，嗫，应该会有大官负责接待你们，你们和他说想见卯兔圣卫就好了。
English: When we get there, there should be a senior official responsible for receiving you. Just tell them you wanna see the Bunnic Sentinel.

Chinese: 你好像很想让我们去都城。
English: Sounds like you're nudging us toward the capital.

Chinese: 暴露了嗫，其实……我有别的事情要办，必须去都城，面见圣上才行。
English: You caught me. The truth is, I've got other business. Need to chat with the Empress.

Chinese: 可按规矩，是不能擅离辖区的……有什么情报，也该发密信给上级，更别说面圣了。
English: But the rules say I can't leave my post without permission. Normally, I'd send a secret message to my superiors instead of meeting the Empress face-to-face.

Chinese: 嗫……如果咱们一起上路，你们可以见到卯兔圣卫，我有面圣的机会……那个，不可以吗？
English: Nya... If we travel together, you can meet the Bunnic Sentinel, and I'll have a chance for an imperial audience... Um, would that be alright?

Chinese: 饲主先生，我们……咦？饲主先生的身体看起来好像好一些了？
English: Master, we... huh? Master's looking better.

Chinese: 的确，和飞玉交换信息的这段时间虽说不长，但身体的恢复情况非常可观，开裂的情况减弱了许多，全身的痛感也有所缓解。
English: Indeed, although our time exchanging information is brief, my recovery is remarkable. The cracks in my skin diminishes greatly, and the pain that was spread throughout my body subsides.

Chinese: 已经没什么大碍了，再走上一段路应该就会恢复如初。
English: I'm good to go. A little walk should sort me out.

Chinese: ……飞玉，请你帮我们带路吧。
English: Jady, you're up.

Chinese: 好嗫！
English: Hooray!

Chinese: 好耶，又可以去没去过的地方了！
English: Excellent! We get to explore another new place!

Chinese: 丘吉尔还真是有活力啊，究竟怎么做到的……
English: Churchill, how are you always so upbeat...

Chinese: 一路上可能还会遇到灾兽，到时交给我就好，侍主先生不用太勉强。
English: Keep an eye out for Disastrous Beasts. I'll handle them if they pop up. Lord Oracle, please don't push yourself too hard.

Chinese: 为什么连你也叫我侍主先生？
English: Why do you call me Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 嗫~各取她们的一半嘛。
English: Ugh! Just going with the flow.

Chinese: 第三节 云梦镇
English: EP 3: Cloudie Town

Chinese: 侍主一行来到了离皇城不远的云梦镇暂时落脚，吃饭时店小二不知为何认准了波斯菊是当今的卯兔圣卫，与此同时，镇子遭到了灾兽的袭击……
English: The group stops in Cloudie Town. During a meal, the innkeeper oddly insists Calliopsis is the Bunnic Sentinel. And the town is suddenly besieged by Disastrous Beasts...

Chinese: 呼……总算甩掉那些灾兽了。
English: Huh... finally got rid of those Disastrous Beasts.

Chinese: 吓死我了，它们怎么穷追不舍的，看我的眼神，好凶哦。
English: That was terrifying! Why were they chasing us so relentlessly? The way they were looking at me... so fierce!

Chinese: 就是嗫。
English: I'm scratching my head over that, too.

Chinese: 这种情况是正常的吗？
English: Is this the usual deal around here?

Chinese: 不正常嗫，现在离年关还早，灾兽应该不会出现得这么频繁才对。
English: Not at all, nya. The new year is still a ways off. Disastrous Beasts shouldn't be appearing this frequently.

Chinese: 算了，不管了不管了！总之，我们抵达了安全地带。
English: Let's just drop it! The main thing is, we're out of the woods now.

Chinese: ……哎呀，虽然只是个普通小镇，不过这里总算是……已经离都城不远了！
English: Oh, it's just a regular town, but we've made it... somewhere kinda close to the capital!

Chinese: 不远是多远，你每次都这么说！
English: Kinda close? You always say that!

Chinese: 这次是真的不远了。
English: But this time it's really not far!

Chinese: 呼……那就好。
English: Alright... that's a relief.
Purr!
Eek!

Chinese: 好、好像有什么声音……又、又追上来了吗？那些灾兽……
English: I-I think I heard something... A-Are they back? Those Disastrous Beasts...

Chinese: 别这么一惊一乍的，放心好嗫！那真的不是什么灾兽……
English: Don't be so jumpy! Relax, nya! That really wasn't a Disastrous Beast...

Chinese: 没错，应该只是飞玉饿得肚子叫了。
English: You just heard Jady's stomach growling.

Chinese: ……那是灾兽。
English: ...That was a Disastrous Beast.
Er...

Chinese: 那，是，灾，兽！
English: That. Was. A. Disastrous. Beast!

Chinese: 对不起，毕竟侍主在……没注意维持你的形象是我的错……
English: Oops. My bad for making you look silly in front of Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 不管有没有灾兽，我们先进去再说啦！
English: Disastrous Beast or not, let's find a place to eat first and talk then!

Chinese: 这就对了嗫，赶了那么久的路，你们都饿了吧？
English: Couldn't agree more. All this trekking's got to have worked up an appetite, right?

Chinese: 这儿我熟！我带你们先去填饱肚子嗫，你们都想吃些什么？
English: I know this place like the back of my hand! I'll fill you up first. What's everyone craving?

Chinese: 那个……胡萝卜有吗？越多越好……
English: Um... Got any carrots? Can't have too many of those...

Chinese: 饿的不应该是……算啦。
English: Shouldn't the hungry one be... Oh, never mind.

Chinese: 虽然在街上走了那么久好像都没看到，不过还是问一下……面包之类的有吗？
English: We've been walking the streets for a while and I haven't seen any, but I'll ask just in case... do you have anything like bread?

Chinese: 我跟着波斯菊吃点素。
English: Maybe a veggie option for me and Calliopsis?

Chinese: 嗫，虽然也不是不行……难得到了城镇，就别顾忌我的钱包了，放开了吃嗫！
English: Sure thing, but you guys deserve a feast... Don't worry about my wallet. Go wild with whatever you find in town!

Chinese: 真的只要胡萝卜就好，我最喜欢胡萝卜了！
English: I'm all serious about the carrots. They're the tops!

Chinese: 嗫……你对胡萝卜的爱大概能和卯兔圣卫比一比？
English: Nya... Your love for carrots could probably rival the Bunnic Sentinel's.

Chinese: 你不是没见过她吗？
English: But you've never met her, right?

Chinese: 不要小看小道消息嘛，听说卯兔圣卫的行宫里挂满了胡萝卜呢。
English: Never underestimate the rumor mill. Word is, the Bunnic Sentinel's palace is practically a carrot wonderland.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 面对着街上琳琅满目的美食摊，我们实在拿不定主意。
English: With so many tempting food stalls lining the street, we're spoiled for choice.

Chinese: 最后还是在飞玉的推荐下，挑了一家最有名的菜馆，点上了满满一桌从未见过的好菜，大快朵颐起来。
English: Led by Jady, we settle on one of the top-rated restaurants. We order a spread of exotic dishes and dig in.

Chinese: 唔！这个好吃！嗯嗯！！这个味道也好棒！
English: Mmm! This is delicious! Oh!! And this one tastes great too!

Chinese: 可是这个叫“筷子”的餐具，怎么能这么难用？！
English: These "chopsticks" are tricky, though!

Chinese: 慢慢吃，后面还有点心呢……
English: No rush, there's dessert coming later...

Chinese: 飞玉，真不好意思，这样一桌菜，应该会花掉你不少钱吧。
English: Jady, I apologize.This must have cost you quite a lot.

Chinese: 没事，嗫……到了这，这个就有用了！
English: Don't sweat it. Huh... Check this out—this will sort us out!

Chinese: 飞玉从身后掏出了一块银色的金属递给我，但很可惜，我看不懂上面的文字……
English: Jady whipped out a shiny silver token and handed it over. The characters were a mystery to me...

Chinese: 这是，某种身份的象征？
English: Is this... some kind of status symbol?

Chinese: 嗫……抱歉抱歉，忘了你看不懂红簌国的字了，
English: Oops... my bad. I forgot that you can't read the Crimson Kingdom script.

Chinese: 这叫做令牌，我的这块是代表士官的银制令，已经是仅次于十二圣卫令的存在了，她们的令牌可是纯金打造的嗫。
English: This is a token. Mine's silver, for sergeants. It's a step below the Twelve Sentinels' gold ones.

Chinese: 可是，这和吃饭有什么关系？
English: But what does that have to do with our meal?

Chinese: 因为出示令牌可以打折呀，银质令能打不少折呢，所以尽管吃吧，我负担得起。
English: Showing the token gets you a discount! A silver token gets a pretty big one, so eat up! I can afford it.

Chinese: 令牌竟然可以这么用，真是长见识了。
English: Never knew a token could get you a great deal.

Chinese: 我们正聊着，被飞玉称为“店小二”的店员小心翼翼地走了过来……
English: While we were chatting, the waiter came over, looking a bit unsure...

Chinese: 请问……坐在这边的这位，是士官吗？
English: Excuse me... are you a sergeant?

Chinese: 士官？
English: Sergeant?

Chinese: 怎么还有两个人，是四个人吗……噢对，刚才上菜的时候就是四个人……
English: Two more guests... no, four... Oh, right, there were four of you when we served the food.

Chinese: 哈哈，瞧我这记性。
English: Haha, forgive my poor memory.

Chinese: 嗫，我是士官，怎么了？
English: Yeah, I'm a sergeant. What's the issue?

Chinese: 没怎么，就是——卯兔圣卫大人！？
English: Nothing, it's just—the Bunnic Sentinel?!

Chinese: 您来店里用餐，怎么不提前托下人来说一声呢？我们也好提前给您准备最新鲜的食材……
English: Next time you come, let us know ahead. That way, we can get the freshest stuff ready for you...

Chinese: 这回好像真的是在叫我……？卯兔圣卫？
English: It looks like you're talking to me this time... Bunnic Sentinel?

Chinese: 您看，您还在卖关子，这在座的，即使没见过您，也都听说过您的大名——波斯菊！
English: You're still being modest. Everyone here, even if they've never seen you in person, has heard of your great name—Calliopsis!

Chinese: 店小二站直了身体，对着波斯菊头顶的空气谄媚地笑着。
English: The waiter straightened up and offered a flattering smile toward the space just above Calliopsis' head.

Chinese: 饲主先生（小声），我难道长高了吗？
English: Master, *whispers* did I get taller?

Chinese: 我也是第一次遇到这种情况（小声）。
English: I've never seen anything like this *whispers*.

Chinese: 正常来说，星痕的存在感十分稀薄，或者该说，其他人会下意识地忽视她们。
English: Typically, the presence of an Aster is quite subtle, often going unnoticed or being subconsciously overlooked by others.

Chinese: 除非是像安娜那样的情况，她活过的痕迹还没有完全消失，记得她的人还有很多，可这里是异世界，波斯菊应该并没有在这里活过吧？
English: Except Anna, whose life's traces haven't totally vanished and who's still remembered by many. But this is another world... Calliopsis shouldn't have ever lived here, right?

Chinese: 而且店小二的视线，就像波斯菊其实是一个更高大的人一样。
English: Furthermore, the waiter's gaze seemed to perceive Calliopsis as being much taller.

Chinese: 卯兔圣卫大人大驾光临，我们这小破店真是蓬荜生辉了。
English: To what do we owe this unexpected honor, Bunnic Sentinel?

Chinese: 今天这顿的费用，无论如何请让我们免去，如果还有什么想吃的，只要还有食材，保证给各位端上！
English: Today's meal is on the house. Anything else you fancy, just say the word!

Chinese: 还有这种好……嗫！可是已经吃饱——
English: I definitely didn't see this one coming... ugh! But I'm stuffed—

Chinese: 呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——！
English: UAhhhhhhhhhhhhhh-!

Chinese: 快跑啊！灾兽打过来了！！！
English: Run! The Disastrous Beasts are coming!!!

Chinese: 为什么灾兽会进来……噫！它们真的来了！
English: Why did the Disastrous Beasts come... ugh! They're really here!

Chinese: 灾兽？
English: Disastrous Beasts?

Chinese: 卯兔圣卫大人，既然您正好在这里，请您帮我们驱逐灾兽吧，我、我先往安全的地方跑了，愿胜利与您同在！
English: Bunnic Sentinel, since you happen to be here, please help us drive away the Disastrous Beasts! I-I'm going to run to safety first! May victory be with you!

Chinese: 周围的平民一溜烟地逃走之后，菜馆中只留下我们四人，安静得连丘吉尔的吞咽声都十分地清晰。
English: Chaos ensues as the townspeople scatter, leaving only the four of us in the restaurant. The silence is so profound that even Churchill's swallowing is audible.

Chinese: 呃……该不会是，刚才追着我们跑的那群家伙吧？
English: Uh... could it be the ones who were chasing us earlier?

Chinese: 怎么会呢，我明明应该把它们甩干净了，而且城镇是有驻军守备的嗫。
English: How could it be? I thought I shook them off, and the town's got soldiers.

Chinese: 不管是不是它们，我们都不能坐视不管，过去看看吧。
English: Them or not, we can't just sit here. Let's check it out.

Chinese: 给我来份跟丘吉尔一样的。
English: I'll have what Churchill's having.

Chinese: 面包……是什么东西？没听说过，至少这个小镇子里应该没有。
English: Bread... what's that? Never heard of it in this small town.

Chinese: 没有面包，那就吃蛋糕吧。
English: If there's no bread, then how about cake?

Chinese: 不要说奇怪的话……在这里吃饭的问题上还是入乡随俗吧。
English: Don't get too fancy... just do as the locals do.

Chinese: 嗫，总之我先带你们去吃饭的地方看看吧。
English: Alright, let's head to the restaurant.

Chinese: 第四节 卯兔卫
English: EP 4: Bunnic Sentinel

Chinese: 侍主四人赶到战场抵抗灾兽，但寡不敌众，落入险境，千钧一发之际，卯兔圣卫率领禁军前来，侍主惊讶地发现，卯兔圣卫几乎就是长大了的波斯菊……
English: Racing to defend the town, the group finds themselves overwhelmed. At the last second, the Bunnic Sentinel arrives with the royal guards—and to Lord Oracle's shock, she looks like an older version of Calliopsis...
Rhaaar!!!

Chinese: 居、居然追到了这里……
English: Th—They've been tailing us all the way here...

Chinese: 为什么啊……
English: Why...

Chinese: 啊……我懂了，我射出去的箭还插在领头那个的腿上……
English: Ah... I see now. The arrow I shot is still stuck in the leader's leg...

Chinese: 诶？这么记仇的吗？！
English: Huh? Are they really that ticked off?!

Chinese: 哈！你们会后悔对我们死缠烂打——
English: Hah! They're gonna regret pestering us—

Chinese: ——嗫！这数量也太多了吧！比刚才在外面追我们的时候还多，难怪驻军挡不住它们！
English: Nya! There are way too many! Even more than when they were chasing us outside! No wonder the garrison couldn't hold them back!

Chinese: 饲、饲、饲、饲主先生，我们该怎么办？交出胡萝卜它们会放过我们吗？
English: M-M-Master, what should we do?! Do you think they'll spare us if I give them my carrots?

Chinese: 就不要胡思乱想了，现在只能上了。
English: Get real. We gotta tough it out.

Chinese: 诶？真的要上吗？
English: Huh? Are we really going to fight them?

Chinese: 这个数量冲过来，我们岂不是要被踩得像刚才吃的葱油饼一样扁？
English: If we do, we'll be squashed flatter than those scallion pancakes we just scarfed.

Chinese: 那至少味道还不错……
English: At least those pancakes tasted good...
Ugh...

Chinese: 确实是对付不了了，还是逃吧。
English: This is impossible... We should run.

Chinese: 逃？可、可是这个镇子里的平民怎么办？
English: Run? But what about the townsfolk?

Chinese: 我是让你们跟着那些平民逃！我在这里帮你们拖时间！
English: You guys gotta split with the civilians! I'll hold the line!

Chinese: 哈！？开什么太一玩笑，我们怎么可能让你独自留下来被它们踩！你难道觉得我们会丢下一个刚刚请了我们大吃一顿的人不管吗？
English: Ha!? What kind of Taeunian joke is that? There's no way we'd let you stay here to get trampled alone! You just treated us to a huge feast!

Chinese: 就算你们留下来，也只是能拖多久的问题……
English: Even if you stay, they'll catch up eventually...

Chinese: 可、可是……
English: Bu—But...

Chinese: 好啦！你们的心意我心领嗫，但你们是从远方来的客人，这不是你们的战争，哪有让你们陪我的道理。
English: Fine! I appreciate the thought, but you're the guests from afar. This ain't your fight.

Chinese: 而我……
……是影猫卫，这是我应该做的……从我穿上这身衣服开始，我就知道这一天总会来的。
English: ...I am a Shadow Panther. This is my duty... I knew this day would eventually come when I put on this armor.

Chinese: 放心好嗫，都城已经不远啦，沿着后面的大路走出城镇一直往前，就能到这附近的厢军军营，通知他们来收复这个城镇，他们会送你去都城的。
English: Don't worry, the capital is close. Follow the road at the back of town, straight ahead. You'll hit the Chamber Guard's military camp. Tell them to retake the town, and they'll send you to the capital.
Rhaaar!!!

Chinese: 好啦，快走吧！它们要冲过来了！
English: Alright, let's roll! They're closing in!

Chinese: 波斯菊、丘吉尔……
English: Calliopsis and Churchill...

Chinese: 跟着飞玉，帮她制造进攻的空间！
English: Stay with Jady! Help her to attack!

Chinese: 都听侍主大人的！
English: We're on it, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 遵、遵命！
English: R-Right away!

Chinese: 等等，等一下，不是说了让你们快逃！而且侍主先生的身体会受不了的！
English: Wait, wait! Didn't I say run? And Lord Oracle's still not fully recovered.

Chinese: 放心好了，已经考虑到了，所以只是让她们负责掩护……
English: Don't sweat it. I've got a plan. I'll let 'em cover you...

Chinese: 当然这是编的，很遗憾，只要进入了凭依的状态，哪怕星痕们什么都不做，我的身体仍然会有损伤。
English: Of course, that was a lie. Unfortunately, as long as I am in the state of possession, my body will sustain damage even if the Asters do nothing.

Chinese: ……而且我们作为远方来的客人，就这么一走了之，是不是太失礼节？
English: We are guests, so it'd be rude to bail.

Chinese: 丘吉尔说得很对，来，再把刚才说的那句话重复一遍。
English: Churchill's right. Come now, repeat what you said to Jady earlier.

Chinese: “我们要不惜一切代价寻找自己的伴侣，无论花多大的代价——”
English: "We gotta find our mate, no matter what..."

Chinese: “我们要在海上恋爱。我们要在海滩恋爱，我们要在乡村和城市恋爱，我们要在高山恋爱，我们永不孤独！”
English: "We will fall in love on the sea, on the beach, in the countryside, in the city, and in the mountains, and we'll always have each other's company! "

Chinese: 不是这句傻话！是刚才你对飞玉说的那句……
English: No, not that goofy line! What you told Jady earlier...

Chinese: 啊！我知道了！
English: Ahhh! I see.

Chinese: “你难道觉得我们会丢下一个刚刚请了我们大吃一顿的人不管吗？”
English: "There's no way we'd let you stay here alone! You just treated us to a huge feast! "
Ugh—

Chinese: 好吧！我知道啦，虽然不知道你们是不是疯了，那就一起上吧！要是被干掉了我可不管哦。
English: Alright, fine! I get it! I don't know if you're all crazy, but let's do this together! But I'm not taking any responsibility if you get yourselves killed!

English: EP 4: Bunnic Sentinel

Chinese: 侍主四人赶到战场抵抗灾兽，但寡不敌众，落入险境，千钧一发之际，卯兔圣卫率领禁军前来，侍主惊讶地发现，卯兔圣卫几乎就是长大了的波斯菊……
English: Racing to defend the town, the group finds themselves overwhelmed. At the last second, the Bunnic Sentinel arrives with the royal guards—and to Lord Oracle's shock, she looks like an older version of Calliopsis...

Chinese: 嗫……这几头灾兽怎么打不死？和森林里碰到的完全是另一个级别。
English: Ugh... why won't these Disastrous Beasts kick the bucket? They're on a whole other level than the ones in the forest.

Chinese: 对啊，明明连铅箭都用上了……
English: Yeah, I even used lead arrows...

Chinese: 饲主先生，您的情况好像不是太好，还是结束凭依吧。
English: Master, you're not looking too good. You should end the possession.

Chinese: 不、不行，光靠飞玉一个，是拦不住它们的。
English: Na—Nah, Jady alone won't cut it.

Chinese: 身体开裂的情况的确不容乐观，全身的疼痛甚至已经影响到了我的感知……
English: The condition of my body deteriorating is certainly not promising, and the pain is distorting my senses...

Chinese: 即便如此，我还是能清晰地从灾兽的身上感受到愤怒的气息，可见这种气息有多么强烈，但有件事，似乎有些奇怪……
English: Nevertheless, I can distinctly perceive the furious aura emanating from the Disastrous Beasts. However, something is amiss...

Chinese: 不同的个体，应当有各自的气息，可眼前明明有七、八只灾兽，我能感受到的气息却只有一个，确切说，是重复叠加着的同一个气息。
English: Each Disastrous Beast should radiate a unique aura, but as I face seven or eight of them, I detect only a singular aura, duplicated repeatedly.

Chinese: 灾兽的力量之源，究竟是个什么样的存在……
English: The source of the Disastrous Beasts' power... what kind of entity could it be?
Rhaar—Rhaar—Rhaar!!

Chinese: 嗫嗫！！我快要撑不住了！
English: Ugh, ugh!! I can't keep this up!

Chinese: 波斯菊！丘吉尔！从现在起，全力攻击！
English: Calliopsis! Churchill, go all out from now on!
What?!

Chinese: 不行！饲主先生的身体会承受不住的！
English: No way! But your body—

Chinese: 这是我的命令！
English: This is an order!

Chinese: 可、可是……
English: Bu—But...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 大人，那些逃难的平民说的没错，镇子里果然冲进来了很多灾兽……
English: My lady, the fleeing civilians were right. The town really has been overrun by Disastrous Beasts...

Chinese: 但还没到年关，怎么可能有那么多——算了，这个之后再说。
English: It's not even close to year's end, so why the horde—Ah, let's deal with that later.

Chinese: 全、全军出击！将那些灾兽赶出我们的城镇！！！
English: E—Everyone, charge! Let's kick these Disastrous Beasts out of our town!!!
Yes, Commander!!!

Chinese: 咦……？是谁？
English: Huh? Who is it?

Chinese: 身后突然传来了一声稍显怯懦的女声，紧随其后的，则是铿锵有力的呐喊和气势雄厚的阵阵脚步，地面都跟着震颤起来。
English: Out of nowhere, a timid voice pipes up, soon overtaken by the resonant shouts and the forceful march of soldiers, making the ground quiver.

Chinese: 啊！得救了！是这附近的厢军！！
English: Ahhh! We're saved! It's the Chamber Guard nearby!!

Chinese: 回头望去，排列整齐的红簌厢军正朝着我们的方向冲来，所有士兵无不是视死如归的表情，实力暂且不说，但着实是训练有素。
English: Glancing back, we observe the Chamber Guards advancing in a neatly organized formation. Each soldier bears an expression of intense determination. It's uncertain if they can defeat the Disastrous Beasts, but their rigorous training is unmistakable.

Chinese: 冲在最前列的，是一名……粉色头发的兔耳少女？！她似乎也注意到了我们的存在。
English: A girl with pink hair and rabbit ears led the charge! She seemed to notice our presence.

Chinese: 全军！散成两列，避开前方的四人，两、两翼包抄灾兽！
English: All troops! Form two columns, avoid the four people ahead, and f-flank the Disastrous Beasts!
Yes, Commander!!!

Chinese: 随着一声令下，援军迅速地散作了两列，从我们的身边掠过，冲向了灾兽。
English: The reinforcements split as ordered, bypassing us and charging at the Disastrous Beasts.

Chinese: 少女则在我们的身前停下，用不可思议的眼神看着我身边的波斯菊。
English: The girl, however, stops in front of us, staring at Calliopsis beside me with an expression of utter disbelief.

Chinese: 怎、怎么会……
English: How—How is this possible?
Hmm... ugh...

Chinese: 波斯菊的脸上也写满了惊讶，虽然已是一副大人的模样，但少女和波斯菊，完全就是共用着同一张脸。
English: Calliopsis looks equally baffled. Despite the newcomer appears to be an adult, they look exactly the same.

Chinese: 得益于战场被援军接管，飞玉退回了我们身边，二话不说便对少女行了跪拜礼。
English: As the reinforcements take control of the battlefield, Jady falls back to our ranks and silently bows to the girl.

Chinese: 您一定是卯兔圣卫吧！在下，影猫卫飞玉，听从卯兔圣卫大人调遣！
English: You must be the Bunnic Sentinel! I'm Shadow Panther Jady, at your service, Bunnic Sentinel!

Chinese: 影猫卫…？啊，碧桂大人有提起过……
English: Shadow Panther? Oh, Lord Emerina mentioned you...

Chinese: 波斯菊？
English: Calliopsis?

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 啊！是叫我……没叫你……啊？
English: Ahhh! You called me... not you... huh?

Chinese: 怎么会这样，你你、我……？
English: What's going on, you, me?

Chinese: 打扰一下，你是从米伦过来的吗？
English: Wait, are you from Mirren?

Chinese: 你竟然知道米伦？
English: How do you know about Mirren?

Chinese: 唔……因、因为我们就是从米伦来到这里的呀。
English: Well... be—because we came here from Mirren.
Huh? What!!!

Chinese: 我好像，有点被搞糊涂了……
English: I'm getting a little confused...

Chinese: 嗫…我也…差不多。
English: Nya... Me too...

Chinese: 糊涂的不止她们，我也是一样，身体的负担并不允许我进行过深的思考，面前的诸多疑团，也不是三两句话便能解释清楚的。
English: We're all scratching our heads. My recovering body isn't up for deep thinking, and there are too many questions to tackle in a few sentences.

Chinese: 大家都有很多的疑问，但此时此地并不适合讨论这件事，波斯…不，卯兔圣卫，我们这边还有一定的余力，先一起对付灾兽吧。
English: We all have many questions, but this is neither the time nor the place to discuss them. Calli—no, Bunnic Sentinel. We still have strength to spare. Let's deal with the Disastrous Beasts together first.

Chinese: 请下令吧，卯兔圣卫大人！
English: Give the order, Bunnic Sentinel!

Chinese: 那、那就有劳各位了！
English: Th-Then, I shall be counting on all of you!
