Chinese: 战斗以胜利告终，卯兔圣卫波斯菊了解了情况后，带着侍主一行一起回到皇宫，向丞相碧桂复命，飞玉上奏了边境村庄的瘟疫事件……
English: With the beasts defeated, Calliopsis the Bunnic Sentinel leads them to the palace to report to Chancellor Emerina. Meanwhile, Jady informs a plague has spread in the border villages...

Chinese: 呼……终于打完了，这些士兵还挺厉害的嘛，我的参与感直线下降。
English: Phew... The fight's finally over. These soldiers pack a punch. My sense of accomplishment has taken a nosedive.

Chinese: 那不是挺好的嘛，不用徒增饲主先生的负担。
English: That's a good thing, isn't it? We don't have to add to Master's burden.

Chinese: 各位可还安好？
English: Is everyone alright?

Chinese: 在下好歹是影猫卫嗫，这点程度还挨得住，倒是侍主先生的情况不知道怎么样了？
English: I'm a Shadow Panther, after all, nya. I can handle this much. But I'm not sure about Lord Oracle's condition.

Chinese: 还好，不用波斯菊和丘吉尔搀着我走路了。
English: I'm fine. I no longer need Calliopsis or Churchill to help me walk.

Chinese: 唔……（小声）痛失了与饲主先生贴贴的机会……
English: Mmm... (whispering) I've lost my chance to be close with Master...

Chinese: 你的小声是认真的吗？连我都听到了哦。
English: Your whisper's loud enough for the whole room.

Chinese: ……诶！那饲主先生岂不是也听见了，啊，就请当我什么都没有说吧！
English: What! Did Master hear it too? Ah, just pretend I didn't say anything!

Chinese: 唔……“饲主先生”……？
English: Hmm... Master?

Chinese: 这边的波斯菊，有件事我有些在意，你刚才使用的力量……
English: May I ask you a question, Calliopsis from the Crimson Kingdom? The power you just wielded......

Chinese: 禁军的汇报打断了我的问话，在如此严肃的场合下，我也不便再开口，只好之后再找机会继续这个话题了。
English: An Imperial Guard's report cuts off my question. Given the gravity of the situation, I decide to address it later.

Chinese: 报告卯兔圣卫大人，灾兽已被歼灭，经核查，我军无人死亡，受伤六人！
English: Reporting to the Bunnic Sentinel! The Disastrous Beasts have been annihilated. Our forces have suffered no fatalities, with six wounded!

Chinese: ……尽快安排受伤的将士前往最近的医斋，进行救治。
English: Get the injured soldiers to the nearest med facility.

Chinese: 得令！
English: Yes!

Chinese: ……留两队人驻守在这里，防备灾兽再来，一队人去帮忙救灾，维持秩序。
English: Leave two squads to garrison here in case the Disastrous Beasts return. Send one squad to assist with disaster relief and maintain order.

Chinese: 得令！
English: Yes!

Chinese: 大人，这些人该怎么处置，嗯？人数……变了？！
English: My lord, what about these people? The number of people... has changed?!

Chinese: 不、不必在意，他、他们是特意来找我的几位故人，由我安置便可。
English: D-Don't mind them. Th-They are old acquaintances who came looking for me. I will arrange for their accommodations.

Chinese: 得令！
English: Yes!

Chinese: 大人……
English: My lord...

Chinese: 飞玉走上前，和太一的波斯菊讲起来我们的事情。
English: Jady steps forward to brief Calliopsis from Taeuno about our situation.

Chinese: 噢噢。
English: I see.

Chinese: 居然还有这样的事情。
English: I've never seen anything like this.

Chinese: 你有什么头绪吗，毕竟你和波斯菊好像有什么关系的样子。
English: Any clues? You and Calliopsis seem to have some connection.

Chinese: ……我刚才回忆了一下，我也没有妹妹啊。
English: I just thought back, and I don't have a sister.
Hmm...

Chinese: 这类……奇闻轶事，我印象里也只有碧桂大人清楚一些。
English: From what I remember, Lord Emerina is an expert on those... paranormal phenomena.

Chinese: 那各位……不妨明日和我一起上路……？
English: So... perhaps you would join me on the road tomorrow?

Chinese: 谢谢大人！嗫……我官位低微，本来还不知道能不能第一时间进宫，这下我心里也有底了！
English: Thank you, my lord! Nya... My rank is low, so I wasn't sure if I could enter the palace right away. Now I can rest easy!

Chinese: 唔……就这么顺势……就去了，会不会不太好啊侍主大人！
English: Well... just going along with the flow like this... Is that really alright, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 嗫？你们不会反悔吧？
English: Hmm? You won't regret it, right?

Chinese: 我们只是想见卯兔圣卫啊，如今已经见到了。
English: We just wanted to meet the Bunnic Sentinel, and we did.

Chinese: 嗫……？哇，等等——那个，对了，可是卯兔圣卫大人知道的也不多啊！
English: Nya...? Whoa, wait—that's true, but... But the Bunnic Sentinel doesn't know much about this either!

Chinese: 去还是要去的，只是我们初来乍到，不知道都城中有什么需要注意的地方，还请两位不吝赐教。
English: We still need to go. Since we're new here, we don't know what to be mindful of in the capital. We would be grateful for your guidance.

Chinese: 嗫……当今圣上刚刚即位，尚还年幼，且体弱多病，如今，暂且是由丞相碧桂大人代为执政。
English: The current Empress has only just ascended the throne. Young and frail. Chancellor Emerina is governing in her stead.

Chinese: 那你说的面圣是，要面见谁？
English: Who're you gonna meet with?

Chinese: 其实要见的是丞相大人，嗫……但是名义上，就是面圣！
English: In fact, I want to meet with the Chancellor, not the Empress.

Chinese: 好绕诶。
English: It's a maze.

Chinese: 影猫卫，不要把碧桂大人说得像是坏人一样。
English: Shadow Panther, don't paint Lord Emerina as a villain.

Chinese: 嗫，在下没有这个意思啊……
English: Hey, I don't mean that...

Chinese: 丞相代替皇帝管理朝政吗？或许是我的固有思维在作怪，一般这样的情况，多少会夹杂着一些阴谋的味道……
English: A Chancellor governing in the Empress' stead? Perhaps it's just my own preconceptions, but situations like this are often tinged with an undertone of conspiracy.

Chinese: 看来，红簌国也不完全是一副太平。
English: Seems the Crimson Kingdom is not entirely at peace.

Chinese: 其实不用有什么心理负担的，红簌国一向欢迎各方来客，我当初也是——
English: In fact, no need to stress. The Crimson Kingdom is always open to visitors from all walks. I was one once—

Chinese: 我甩了甩头，虽然没有感觉太虚弱，但还是有些头晕眼花的。
English: I shake my head. Though I'm not too weak, I felt a bit woozy.

Chinese: 对了，一直站在这里说话也不是办法，毕竟刚刚战斗完……这位先生也很需要休息的样子……
English: Standing here talking won't help. After all, we've just finished a battle. This gentleman looks to be in great need of rest...

Chinese: 我先给各位找个落脚的地方。
English: Allow me to find a place for you all to stay.

Chinese: 各位休息好，等明天早上，上了路，咱们再继续未完的话题。
English: Rest up, everyone. We'll pick up the conversation tomorrow morning.

Chinese: 那就有劳了。
English: Thanks.

Chinese: 好说，嘿嘿。
English: You are welcome.

Chinese: 太一的波斯菊在前面领路，我们慢慢地跟着。
English: Calliopsis from Taeuno leads the way, and we trail behind.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 就是这里了。
English: This is it.

Chinese: 好棒的房间！
English: Check out this room!

Chinese: 嗫……上房！感动！
English: Nya... The best room! I'm so moved!

Chinese: 回想起来，这一路上，每次进城都只能住最便宜的房间，一出城赶路就要被灾兽追，风餐露宿的……
English: Reflecting on our journey, I recall that we could only afford the most modest accommodations in each city we visited. And upon departure, the relentless Disastrous Beasts forced us to camp out in the wilderness.

Chinese: 人家还要租马车嘛，身上的盘缠已经有点吃紧了。
English: I still gotta rent a carriage, and my wallet's already wheezing.

Chinese: 嗯，打断一下你们的兴奋。
English: Well, hate to burst your bubble,

Chinese: 我可能……要睡一会儿了……
English: but I might... need a nap...

Chinese: 进入房间之后，我一坐下来，就感觉有种昏昏欲睡的感觉，不得不眨着眼睛。
English: Sleepiness washes over me as soon as I plop down in the room. My eyelids droop, and I fight to stay awake.

Chinese: 还是有点乱来了……我身体的损伤……需要进行更深层次的修复……
English: My body's still a bit wonky and... needs some deeper repair...

Chinese: 有事……就提前叫醒我。那就这样。
English: If anything goes down... just wake me up. That's it.

Chinese: 睡意越来越浓，我不再抵抗它。
English: The sleepiness is getting to my head, and I surrender to it.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 这里就是红簌国的不夜皇都，万枝城。
English: Welcome to Multilitchi, the capital of the Crimson Kingdom that never sleeps.

Chinese: 呜哇……好热闹！！！
English: Whoa... it's buzzing!!!

Chinese: 明明已经入夜，但还是一副张灯结彩、人头攒动的景象……原来如此，叫它不夜城，一点都不为过。
English: Even though night had fallen, the city was alive with festooned stalls, neon lights, and a sea of people. Multilitchi truly lived up to its reputation as a city that never sleeps.

Chinese: 我睡醒的时候，已经到了万枝城。听丘吉尔说，离开边境后，一路上都很平稳，也没有灾兽出现。
English: When I wake up, we already arrive in Multilitchi. Churchill fills me in—smooth sailing after leaving the border, no Disastrous Beasts in sight.

Chinese: 厉害呀，整个都城就是一个超级大的市集……
English: It's wild. The whole capital is like one giant market...

Chinese: 饲主先生，那边卖的一串一串的东西看起来好诱人呀！
English: Master, the skewers on sale look so tempting!

Chinese: 一串一串的东西？我看看，啊，那是糖葫芦嗫~
English: Skewers? Let me see. Ah, those are sugarcoated haws on sticks!

Chinese: 糖葫芦……？嗯！光听名字就知道很好吃，饲主先生，我们能去买一些吗？
English: Sugarcoated haws on sticks? Mm! Just hearing its name makes me drool. Master, can we snag some?

Chinese: ……我们没有红簌国的货币。
English: We don't have the currency of the Crimson Kingdom.

Chinese: 咦？啊，也对……
English: Huh? Ah, right...

Chinese: 不能自由支配财富的感觉……突然觉得有些忧伤。
English: The inability to freely manage our wealth brings a sense of sadness.

Chinese: 其实，如果只是几串糖葫芦的话……
English: In fact, if it were just a few sugarcoated haws on sticks...

Chinese: 飞玉，还有先生……我们先进宫吧，把要紧事办完之后，我请大家好好在都城里逛逛。
English: Jady, and you, sir... Let's go to the palace first. Once we've handled the important stuff, I'll treat everyone to a city tour.

Chinese: 嗫……可是大人，红簌宫此时不是已经封禁了吗？
English: Ugh... But my lord, isn't the Crimson Kingdom Palace off-limits to the public now?

Chinese: 封、封禁？
English: Closed?

Chinese: 天虽然是黑了，但现在也没有很晚啊，还不到宵禁的时候吧？
English: Even though it's late, it's not curfew time yet, right?

Chinese: 嗫，听说是丞相大人，前段时间突然决定的……
English: I heard the Chancellor made a sudden closure call recently...

Chinese: 我抬头看向道路尽头的皇宫，高墙的另一端几乎没有投射出一丝的光亮，与灯火同名的万枝城街巷形成了鲜明的对比。
English: Gazing up at the palace at the road's end, I'm struck by the high walls, dark and silent, forming a stark contrast with the brightly lit streets and alleys of Multilitchi.

Chinese: ……是不是有什么事情发生呢？
English: Has something happened?
Ugh...

Chinese: 咕！咕咕！
English: Grrr! Grr... Grr!

Chinese: 波斯菊的肚子突然咕咕叫起来。
English: Calliopsis' stomach growls, breaking the tension.

Chinese: 诶，是谁肚子空空的叫声？
English: Hey, who's got the rumbling tummy?

Chinese: ……饲主先生……
English: Master...

Chinese: 丘吉尔，别捉弄波斯菊了。
English: Churchill, lay off Calliopsis.

Chinese: 噗~~~你们虽然是主仆的关系，却好像一家人一样嗫。
English: Phew! Although you have a master-servant thing, you are like a family.

Chinese: 家、家、家人？！讨厌啦，飞玉怎么可以说这么害臊的话呢，
English: F-F-Family?! Oh, stop it, Jady! You're making me blush.

Chinese: 人家还没做好和饲主先生组建家庭的准备呢，虽、虽然，也不是没这样想过啦……
English: I'm not ready to start a family with Master, although, although... it's not like it hasn't crossed my mind...

Chinese: 也不知道波斯菊究竟把飞玉的话理解成了什么意思，突然就深陷进了自我陶醉的状态。
English: I don't know how Calliopsis misconstrues Jady's words, which makes her abruptly get self-conscious.

Chinese: 嗫？我是不是说错话了？
English: Hmm? Did I say something wrong?

Chinese: ……那我先带各位去吃个便饭吧。
English: Anyway, let's grab a meal first.

Chinese: 好耶！
English: Hooray!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 与充满市井气的万枝城不同，红簌宫内尽显庄严。
English: Unlike the lively atmosphere of Multilitchi, the Crimson Kingdom Palace exudes a solemn grandeur.

Chinese: 除了通向圣麟殿的主道两侧稍有一些照明的设施外，其余的小路都需要提着灯笼才能前行，大多的建筑内都没有灯光，完全是一片死寂。
English: The main road leading to the Kirin Palace is flanked by some lighting fixtures, but lanterns are necessary to navigate the rest of the palace, which remains cloaked in darkness and silence.

Chinese: 所幸，作为皇帝会见群臣的场所，圣麟殿中倒是灯火通明，金碧辉煌的四壁，典雅华贵的布置，将红簌国的强盛与富足表现得淋漓尽致。
English: Fortunately, the Kirin Palace, where the empress meets her ministers, is well-illuminated. Its splendid walls and luxurious decor showcase the Crimson Kingdom's wealth and power.

Chinese: 卯兔圣卫波斯菊，前来向丞相大人复命。
English: Calliopsis, Bunnic Sentinel, hereby to report to the Chancellor.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 啊，卯兔卿，情况如何？
English: Ah, Bunnic Lord, how is the situation?

Chinese: 距离我们不远处的书堆里，忽然站起了一个人。
English: A figure popped up from behind a mountain of books.

Chinese: 呜哇……好突然……（小声）
English: Wow... This is kind of sudden... *whispers*

Chinese: 报告丞相大人，灾兽已被全数消灭，但灾兽出现的原因仍需排查。
English: Chancellor, the Disastrous Beasts have all been eliminated, but the reason for their appearance still needs to be investigated.

Chinese: 这人推了推眼镜，嘉许地点了点头，随后看向我们。
English: The woman pushes up her glasses, and gave a nod of approval, then looked towards us.

Chinese: 这些都是何人？
English: Who are these?

Chinese: 回丞相大人，在下影猫卫飞玉，有事禀报。
English: Chancellor, I'm Jady, the Shadow Panther. I have something urgent to report.

Chinese: 呵呵，不必那么拘束，慢慢讲吧。
English: Hehe, there is no need to be so formal. Speak freely.

Chinese: 飞玉上前，简明扼要地说明了我们的来历。
English: Jady stepped forward and briefly explained our origins.

Chinese: 呵呵，原来如此……不曾想太一与那名为“米伦”的世界，竟是如此容易互通？
English: Interesting... I didn't expect Taeuno and this "Mirren" world to be linked so closely.

Chinese: 对了，那卯兔卿可曾认识他们？
English: By the way, Bunnic Lord, you know these people?

Chinese: 回丞相大人，这位、她是……
English: Chancellor, she is...

Chinese: 她……其实是我的妹妹，菊斯波！
English: She... is actually my sister, Sispocali!

Chinese: 其余这两位，是……是我在原来世界的……的……两名……家仆！
English: The other two are... my... two... servants from the world I came from!

Chinese: 至于，他们为何也会来到太一……目前还不知其中缘由，还望丞、丞相大人解答一二！
English: I don't know why they came to Taeuno yet. I was hoping the Ch-Chancellor might be able to shed some light on the matter!

Chinese: 这位太一的波斯菊竟然咬到了舌头……
English: The Calliopsis of Taeuno actually bit her tongue...

Chinese: 当然，当然，既是卯兔卿的故旧，那便是我国的贵客。若我能解答贵客的疑问，那自是再好不过了。
English: Of course, old friends of the Bunnic Lord are always welcome here. It would be great if I could answer your guests' questions.

Chinese: 只是最近国事繁忙，恐怕我暂时无力处理……涉及时空的问题。
English: But I'm swamped with state stuff lately, so I'm afraid I'm temporarily unable to handle... issues involving time and space.

Chinese: 那我可将他们留在卯兔宫中吗？等丞相大人有时间了，我们再来。
English: Then may I have them stay in the Bunnic Palace? We can return when you have more time, Chancellor.

Chinese: 呵呵，自然没有问题，卯兔卿自行安排便可。
English: Hehe, sure thing. You can make arrangements yourself.

Chinese: 谢丞相大人！
English: Thank you, Chancellor!

Chinese: 丞相大人，飞玉此次入宫，还有一事要报。
English: Your Excellency, I have another urgency to report.

Chinese: 但说无妨。
English: Please, speak freely.

Chinese: 是！南部群山中的秋丰村近日出现了疫病……臣恳请丞相大人调配侍医，予以救灾。
English: Yes! A plague has broken out recently in Goldvale Village in the southern mountains... I sincerely request you dispatch imperial physicians for disaster relief.

Chinese: ……何等惨事，令人耳不忍闻。
English: What a tragedy, I'm sorry to hear that.
Ugh...

Chinese: 然如今局势如燃眉之火，要调侍医前往，路上也着实波折……
English: However, the current situation is dire. To dispatch imperial physicians now... the journey would be fraught with difficulty...

Chinese: 可是，秋丰村的村民……
English: But, the villagers of Goldvale...

Chinese: 唉，若在平时，都城定能派出人手……我实在是无能，愧对先帝。
English: Alas, in ordinary times, the capital would certainly be able to send aid... Sorry, I can't do more. I have failed the previous Emperor.

Chinese: 抱歉……
English: My apologies...

Chinese: 那下官，告退。
English: If that's the case, I will take my leave.

Chinese: 飞玉魂不守舍地退下。
English: Jady heads out in despair.

Chinese: 我们也没有多作停留，跟随太一的波斯菊退出了圣麟殿……
English: We did not linger either, following the Calliopsis of Taeuno out of the Kirin Palace...

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 波斯菊
English: Calliopsis

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊
English: Outlander Calli

Chinese: 丘吉尔
English: Churchill

Chinese: 飞玉
English: Jady

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊&波斯菊
English: Outlander Calli & Calliopsis

Chinese: 波斯菊&丘吉尔
English: Calliopsis & Churchill

Chinese: 第六节 闺中话
English: EP 6: Whispered Secrets

Chinese: 一行人跟随大波斯菊来到了卯兔宫，就大小波斯菊的诡异情况进行了一番讨论，但却得到了诸多的疑点……
English: In the Bunnic Palace, the younger and the older Calliopsis confront their strange connection. The more they discuss, the deeper the mystery becomes...

Chinese: 卯兔圣卫的栖身之所，被直白地以“卯兔宫”来命名，其他十一名圣卫的行宫也是如此。
English: The "Bunnic Palace" is the fitting name for the residence of the Bunnic Sentinel, much like the palaces of the other eleven Sentinels.

Chinese: 虽远不如圣麟殿华丽，但作为圣卫的居所，已经足够气派。
English: While it may not be as lavish as the Kirin Palace, it still stands out as the abode of the Sentinel.

Chinese: 行宫中的布置，甚至有几份眼熟，若将家具全部换成神谕司的风格，和波斯菊的房间几乎如出一辙。
English: The arrangement is strangely reminiscent. If one were to swap out all the furnishings for those in the style of the Oracle Division, it would be just like Calliopsis' room.

Chinese: 光是随处可见的胡萝卜，就已经“很波斯菊”了。
English: Especially the ubiquitous carrots.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 呼……刚才的气氛真让人窒息，但好在，碧桂大人同意了让你们留下来的请求。
English: Huh... that place was suffocating, but luckily, Lord Emerina agreed to let you stay.

Chinese: 我连话都不敢说……
English: I didn't dare speak up...

Chinese: 虽然我很想吐槽你把我和侍主大人说成是家仆。
English: I really wanted to complain about you referring to me and the Lord Oracle as your domestic servants.

Chinese: 抱歉，请原谅我当时只能想到这个……
English: Sorry, please forgive me. That's the only thing that popped into my mind at the time...

Chinese: 倒、倒也不用道歉的啦……
English: Well, there's no need to apologize...

Chinese: 总之，多有打扰了。
English: Anyway, I'm sorry to put you out.

Chinese: 不会，你们来了还能热闹些，这么大的行宫就我和几个下人们住，其实挺冷清的。
English: Not at all. Your arrival livens the place up. This palace, as grand as it is, feels kinda deserted.

Chinese: 冷清？冷清好嗫，我现在只想静静……
English: Deserted? Being deserted can be nice. Just a chance to breathe easy...

Chinese: 我也没想到碧桂大人会拒绝得那么决绝。
English: I also didn't expect Lord Emerina to refuse so... resolutely.

Chinese: 而且，决绝得让人很难不产生怀疑，这真的是心系国家的丞相应该说出来的话吗？
English: And so resolutely that it was suspicious. Were those really the words of a Chancellor who cares about the country?

Chinese: 嗫……长途跋涉从边境赶到红簌宫，却吃了大大的一碗闭门羹。
English: Alas... I trekked all the way from the border to the Crimson Kingdom Palace, only to get the cold shoulder.

Chinese: 唯一的贡献，大概就是让你们两位兔裔碰上面了吧？
English: The best part of this journey is probably that you two Bunnicians met each other, right?

Chinese: 看着面面相觑、却都欲言又止的两个波斯菊，也的确是时候聊聊这件事了，不过在那之前，还得先解决另一个不大不小的问题。
English: The two identical Bunnicians look at each other but seem hesitant to speak. It's time to address this matter, but before that, there is another issue to resolve.

Chinese: 在具体搞清楚一些疑问之前，有件困扰了我好一会儿的事，有必要先处理一下。
English: But hold up, there's this one thing bugging me, gotta clear it up first.

Chinese: 饲主先生说的是什么事呀？
English: Master, what's on your mind?

Chinese: 为了不再出现当我喊出“波斯菊”时你们两个同时回应我的情况，必须给你们重新定一个称呼，你们应该也不想用自己的名字来称呼对方吧。
English: To prevent both of you from answering when I call out "Calliopsis," we must decide on new ways to address you. I assume neither of you wants to call the other by your own name.

Chinese: 唔…饲主先生说的，好像有点道理。
English: Well... Master's right.

Chinese: 的确有这个必要。
English: It is indeed necessary.

Chinese: 我先来，叫大波斯菊和小波斯菊怎么样？
English: I'll go first! How about Big Calliopsis and Little Calliopsis?

Chinese: 驳回！太粗暴了，而且难听！
English: No! That's too blunt, and it sounds horrible!

Chinese: 呃……光速淘汰？
English: Er... Okay...

Chinese: 波斯菊一号？波斯菊二号？
English: Calliopsis One? Calliopsis Two?

Chinese: 驳回！
English: No!

Chinese: 波斯菊姐姐？波斯菊妹妹？
English: Big Sis Calliopsis? Little Sis Calliopsis?

Chinese: ……飞玉，你还是别凑热闹了？
English: Jady, please give us a break.

Chinese: 嗫……！！好打击人！
English: Ugh!! So demoralizing!

Chinese: 我一点头绪都没有，要不，就用刚才那个“菊斯波”来叫我？
English: I don't have any ideas... How about you just call me "Sispocali"?

Chinese: 那只是我随口说的啦，这样吧，你们叫我“秋英”好了。
English: That's just off the top of my head. So, just call me "Autumn Glory."

Chinese: 秋英？
English: Autumn Glory?

Chinese: 我刚到红簌国时，先皇灵穹曾赐予我此名，称这是“波斯菊”在红簌国的叫法，但因为我不是很喜欢，便没有用过……
English: When I first arrived in the Crimson Kingdom, the former Emperor, Ling Qiong, bestowed this name upon me, saying it was the local name for "Calliopsis." But I wasn't very fond of it, so I never used it...

Chinese: 但为了大家方便，我可以重新用起来。
English: But hey, if it makes things easier, I'm willing to dust it off.

Chinese: 如果你没有意见的话，暂时就这么决定吧。
English: If there are no objections, then let's go with that for now.

Chinese: 区分完了名字，我们便谈起了关于两人身世的正题，但进展得并不是很顺利，以至于飞玉已经在一旁的长凳上睡着了。
English: After clarifying their names, we discuss the life experiences of the two individuals. However, the conversation hits a snag as Jady dozes off on the bench.

Chinese: 所以，秋英和波斯菊，是同一个人，都经历了圣龙战争，是这样吧？
English: So, Autumn Glory and Calliopsis are one and the same, and they both experienced the Sacred Dragon War, right?

Chinese: 是的。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 在“风暴之殇”发生之后，波斯菊留在了米伦，但秋英穿越到了太一，在此之前，你们享有同样的记忆，没错吧？
English: After the "Storm of Sorrow," Calliopsis stayed in Mirren while Autumn Glory ended up in Taeuno. Before that, they shared the same memories.

Chinese: 应该是这样。
English: That should be the case.

Chinese: 到这里为止，我们可以得出一个假设，在遭受风暴之殇的那次冲击时，波斯菊的魂魄被那个巨大的能量撕裂成了两份……
English: So, it was possible that Calliopsis' soul must've been split into two parts during the "Storm of Sorrow"...

Chinese: ……一份留在了米伦，作为波斯菊继续着自己的人生，另一份来到了太一，成为了这里的秋英？
English: One part stayed in Mirren, the other came to Taeuno and became Autumn Glory.

Chinese: 饲主先生，这种假设能成立吗？
English: Master, is such a hypothesis plausible?

Chinese: 应该可以，其实学者们很早就提出了“风暴之殇的能量冲击不止是来自于地心”的假说，或许还连通了别的世界。
English: Most likely. Scholars have proposed that the energy blast of the "Storm of Sorrow" not only comes from the earth's core but also connects to other worlds.

Chinese: 我已经…听得云里雾里了。
English: I've gotten into the weeds.

Chinese: 直到这里，逻辑还算是能说得通，问题是接下来的部分。
English: Up to this point, the logic makes sense. Let's move on to the next question.

Chinese: 秋英，能再展现一下你刚才战斗时使用的力量吗？
English: Autumn Glory, can you show me the power you used in battle?

Chinese: 咦？为、为什么？
English: Huh? Wh—Why?

Chinese: 你不介意的话，照做就是了。
English: If you don't mind, please.

Chinese: 好、好吧。
English: O-Okay.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 轻吸了一口气后，秋英举起右手，伴随着光点的汇聚，一把弩便出现在了她的手中，与波斯菊所使用的武器如出一辙。
English: Autumn Glory takes a breath and raises her right hand. Light gathers, forming a crossbow identical to Calliopsis' weapon.
Huh!?

Chinese: 波斯菊和丘吉尔应该也看出来了吧？
English: Calliopsis, Churchill, I assume you both see it as well?

Chinese: 是、是星痕之力……
English: Yes, it's the Power of Aster...

Chinese: 如假包换！
English: This is the real deal!

Chinese: 星痕……之力…？
English: Power of... Aster?

Chinese: 那是有点特别的力量，只有星痕或魔女能使用，而且应该只存在于米伦。
English: That is a special power that can only be used by Asters or Novas. And it should only exist in Mirren.

Chinese: 咦…那我为什么可以……
English: Hey... then why can I...

Chinese: 我就直截了当地说了吧，你应该和波斯菊、丘吉尔一样，是一名星痕！
English: Let me be blunt. You, like Calliopsis and Churchill, must be an Aster.

Chinese: 星痕……？我？
English: An Aster? Me?

Chinese: 难怪刚才在战场上，我感受到了远不止两人的星痕气息，可是星痕不可能脱离魔女或者我去独自战斗，是什么在给秋英提供力量？
English: No wonder I sensed more than two Aster auras on the battlefield. But Asters can't leave the Nova or me to fight alone. So, who was backing Autumn Glory?

Chinese: 不，更大的问题是，她为什么会作为星痕存在于这个世界？看她的样子还是无主的状态，应该可以排除太一有能够召唤星痕之人的可能。
English: No, the bigger question is, why does she exist in this world as an Aster? She still appears to be masterless, which should rule out the possibility of someone in Taeuno being able to summon Asters.

Chinese: 秋英，你是什么时候醒来的？
English: Autumn Glory, when did you wake up?

Chinese: 一百多年前，咦，先生不是已经问过了吗？
English: Over a hundred years ago. Huh? Didn't you already ask that, sir?

Chinese: 那时，有什么奇怪的事情发生吗？
English: Did anything unusual happen then?

Chinese: 非要说，是有一件事吧，其实我醒来时，就已经是现在这个样子了……
English: If anything, when I woke up, I was already like this...

Chinese: 就变成大波斯菊了？
English: You mean you became Big Calliopsis?

Chinese: 是这样……但可以的话，请叫我秋英。
English: That's right... But please, call me Autumn Glory if you would.

Chinese: 之后，还有类似的变化吗？
English: Have there been any similar changes since then?

Chinese: 没有啊，一旦成为生肖圣卫，便可享有长生，青春永驻的。
English: No. Once one becomes a Sentinel, one is granted immortality and eternal youth.

Chinese: 大致梳理一下疑点，对我们来说，圣龙战争发生在1853年前，但秋英却是100多年前来到太一的。
English: Let's piece this together. The Sacred Dragon War happened 1,853 years ago, and you came to Taeuno over a century ago.

Chinese: 米伦的1853年对应太一的100多年？这巨大的时间差……
English: So, 1853 years in Mirren is like about a century in Taeuno? Exactly, it's a huge time difference...

Chinese: 还有一件奇怪的事情，来到米伦的秋英为什么会以长大后的姿态苏醒。
English: There's another strange thing. Why did you wake up as an adult when you arrived in Taeuno?

Chinese: 算上“是谁召唤了秋英”的疑问，问题越积越多，但仅靠现有的信息，是无力再向下推敲了。
English: The questions are piling up, like "Who summoned Autumn Glory?" It's hard to move forward without answers.

Chinese: 抱歉，突然和你说了这么多。
English: Sorry for overwhelming you with all this.

Chinese: 不、不会的，我其实也很想多知道一些，只是那些问题，压得我有些喘不过气。
English: N-Not at all. I actually want to know more too, it's just that these questions are a bit... suffocating.

Chinese: （大声）嗫~啊~啊~睡了一觉，舒服多了，就是板凳有点硬……
English: (Loudly) Ugh... ah... ah, I just had a solid snooze, feeling pretty good, but why the bench is so hard...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 你打哈欠的就不能小点声吗？
English: Could you maybe not yawn like you're summoning a storm?

Chinese: 嗫？很响吗？抱歉抱歉，看样子，你们好像是聊完了，我错过了什么？
English: Hmm? Oops, was I that loud? My bad, my bad. Looks like you're done talking. What'd I miss.

Chinese: 四舍五入，大概是全部吧……
English: Well, pretty much everything...

Chinese: 嗫——！这不是亏惨了？！
English: Nya! You mean I missed out completely?!

Chinese: 各位，天色已经不早了，我刚才吩咐过下人准备浴桶，此刻应该已经能够沐浴了。
English: Everyone, it's getting late. I've had the servants set up a bath for you.

Chinese: 今天的战斗弄得大家都灰头土脸的，都去洗一洗，早些歇息吧。
English: After today's scuffle, we all look like we've been dragged through a hedge. Time to scrub up and hit the hay.

Chinese: 嗫…我们猫裔不是很喜欢洗澡的来着……
English: Ugh... we catkin aren't exactly fans of water...

Chinese: 至于先生的浴桶，已经提前准备在客房之中，会有下人带您过去的。
English: As for your tub, sir, it has already been prepared in the guest room. A servant will guide you there.

Chinese: 有劳了。
English: Thanks.

English: The exhaustion from the long journey pulled my body downwards, yet the sharp pain from my cracking skin continuously dragged me back to wakefulness. I try to sort through the day's chaos to find some peace.

Chinese: 这个世界充满了谜团。不说别的，光是波斯菊的情况，就让人难以判断。
English: This world is like a puzzle. Just Calliopsis' situation alone is a head-scratcher, never mind the rest.

Chinese: 越是考虑这些事，脑子就越是清醒……等我意识到的时候，我已经一丝睡意也不剩了。
English: The more I piece things together, the more my brain kicks into gear... By the time I realized it, not a trace of sleepiness remained.

Chinese: （还是起来看看吧。）
English: (I might as well get up and take a look.)

Chinese: none

Chinese: 我摸黑来到了卯兔宫的院子中，本想吹吹夜间的凉风，却听见了一个低低的声音。
English: I wander out to the courtyard of Bunnic Palace under the cloak of night, craving a gulp of that crisp night air, but then I catch a whisper.

Chinese: 卯兔之魂……究竟要怎么样觉醒呢？
English: The Bunnic Soul... how do I wake it up?

Chinese: 要是有谁能来帮帮我的话……不，这样的事，在哪里都不会有吧……呜……
English: If only someone can lend a hand... Nah, that's wishful thinking... ugh...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 循着声音，我轻手轻脚走向假山之后。
English: Drawn by the voice, I tiptoe toward the rockery, quiet as a shadow.

Chinese: 秋英正坐在圆凳上。她低着头，沉浸在自己的思绪之中，看起来完全没有发现我的到来……
English: Autumn Glory is sitting on a round stool. She bows her head, lost in thought, not noticing my arrival at all...

Chinese: 秋英？
English: Autumn Glory?

Chinese: 咦，先生？您怎么……
English: Huh, sir? How did you...

Chinese: 睡得不太习惯，干脆起来吹吹风了。
English: I couldn't sleep, so I come out for some fresh air.

Chinese: 先生一定是觉得床铺太硬了吧，我刚来红簌国时，也适应了好长时间。
English: The bed must've been too hard. I had the same trouble when I first arrived in the Crimson Kingdom.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我坐到了秋英旁边的圆凳上，她下意识地别过了脸庞，但借着月光，我依然隐约看见了她侧脸上的泪痕。
English: I sit down on the round stool next to Autumn Glory. She instinctively turns her face away, but under the moonlight, I can still make out faint tear streaks on her cheek.

Chinese: 还是当作没看见吧……
English: I should pretend I didn't see anything...

Chinese: 波斯菊她们都睡了吗？
English: Are the others asleep?

Chinese: 嗯，睡得很熟，特别是飞玉，已经睡得转了个向了。
English: Yes, sound asleep. Especially Jady—she's already twisted herself in her sleep.

Chinese: 不是才睡过吗？真不愧是猫。
English: Another round of sleeping? Typical cat behavior.

Chinese: 她一早要赶去秋丰村调查，所以逼着自己喝了一碗安睡汤，很苦很苦的那种。
English: She has to get up early to investigate Goldvale, so she forced herself to drink a bowl of Sleep Tea—the really bitter kind.

Chinese: 被丞相大人拒绝后，她明明那么失落，却能马上振作起来，只想着怎么去把事情解决。
English: Even though she was so down after being rejected by the Chancellor, she quickly pulled herself together and focused on finding a solution.

Chinese: 感觉……好羡慕这样强大的心。
English: I really admire that kind of inner strength.

Chinese: 你没有吗？
English: You can't do that?

Chinese: 换成是我，会一个人躲起来。然后找一个随便什么东西，把烦恼、担忧、抱怨什么的，全都说给它听……
English: If it were me, I'd probably hide somewhere alone. And then find something—anything—to pour all my worries, fears, and complaints into...

Chinese: 嗯，我知道。
English: Yes, I know.

Chinese: 咦？！先生怎么会知道这种事？
English: Huh?! How do you know that, sir?

Chinese: 那是因为……
English: Because...

Chinese: 于是，我将我和波斯菊通过抽屉误入太一的始末全都告诉了秋英。
English: I then told Autumn Glory everything about how Calliopsis and I accidentally stumbled into Taeuno through a drawer.

Chinese: 秋英的脸在叙述之中一点点地变红，当她听完，不禁捂住了自己的脸。
English: As I spoke, Autumn Glory's face gradually turned red. By the time I finished, she was covering her face with her hands.

Chinese: 唔…那些害臊的话，居然全都被你们听见了……
English: Ugh... you heard all those embarrassing things I said...

Chinese: 声音断断续续，其实也没听出什么大概。
English: The sound cut in and out, so we didn't catch much of the details.

Chinese: 还、还是会很尴尬……
English: I-It's still very embarrassing...

Chinese: 可是，连接两个世界的通道，竟然是个抽屉……
English: But, a drawer connecting two worlds...

Chinese: 而且，还害得你们也被留在这里了。
English: And because of that, you're stuck here too.

Chinese: 我想出题人往往也是解题人。你们两个本质是同一个灵魂，会互相吸引很正常。
English: I believe that the one who creates the problem is often the one who solves it. Since you are essentially the same soul, it's only natural you'd be drawn to each other.

Chinese: 如果能帮你解决掉麻烦，回去的路可能就会出现。
English: If we help you resolve this issue, the way back might just reveal itself.

Chinese: “解铃还须系铃人”吗？
English: "Only the one who ties the knot can untie it," right?

Chinese: 就是那样的说法吧。
English: That's about the gist of it.

Chinese: 真不可思议……跟您说话，不知不觉就会变得很安心。
English: It's strange... Talking to you makes me feel at ease without realizing it.

Chinese: 告诉我吧，你的麻烦是什么？
English: Tell me, what's troubling you?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: ……先生想必还不知道红簌国最大的敌人是谁吧？
English: You probably don't know who the Crimson Kingdom's greatest enemy is, do you?

Chinese: 你这么问，答案肯定不会只是灾兽那么简单了，是周边的国家？
English: Since you're asking, it must be more than just the Disastrous Beasts, right? Is it one of the neighboring nations?

Chinese: 周边的小国大多需要仰赖红簌国的保护才能生存，不会随便造次。
English: Most of the smaller neighboring countries rely on the Crimson Kingdom for protection, they wouldn't dare stir trouble.

Chinese: 那是这之外的威胁……动乱？
English: So, it's a greater threat... Internal strife?

Chinese: 先生开头其实说对了一半。灾兽的确是很大的威胁，但在它们之上，还有一个更高位的存在。
English: You were partly right earlier. The Disastrous Beasts are indeed a major threat, but above them, there's an even more powerful being.

Chinese: 它才是红簌国，不，应该说是我们十二圣卫最大的敌人。
English: It's the greatest enemy of the Crimson Kingdom, or of the Twelve Sentinels.

Chinese: 它，就是年兽。
English: It's... the Nian Beast.

Chinese: 年兽……它也是灾兽吗？
English: The Nian Beast... Is it another type of Disastrous Beast?

Chinese: 不，它是和太一同源的事物。是它创造了灾兽……
English: No, it comes from the same source as Taeuno. It created the Disastrous Beasts...

Chinese: 太一孕育了大地和这里的人们，年兽带来了祸乱与灾兽，它代表了憎恨与陨灭，是代表着爱与生命的太一的另一面。
English: Taeuno gave life to the land and its people, while the Nian Beast brought chaos and Disastrous Beasts. It represents hatred and destruction—the opposite of Taeuno, which stands for love and life.

Chinese: ……难怪我感受到的是同一个气息在不断叠加，原来那些气息都出自同一个本源。
English: No wonder I keep sensing a familiar energy stacking upon itself. It all originated from the same source.

Chinese: 一个和这个世界同时诞生的对手，真的有办法战胜它吗？
English: A foe that was born with this world... Is it even possible to defeat it?

Chinese: 有，而且并不是没有战胜过……
English: Yes, we've beaten it before...

Chinese: 是在什么时候？
English: When was that?

Chinese: 去年，以及，过去的每一年……
English: Last year. And every year before that...

Chinese: 每一年……是十二圣卫的功劳吗？
English: Every year... So it's the Twelve Sentinels' doing?

Chinese: 诶？……嗯，是的。
English: Eh? Yes, that's right.

Chinese: 年兽平时都在沉睡，只有在每年年关的时候才会苏醒，十二圣卫最大的职责，就是在那时迎战年兽，它虽然强大，但十二圣卫总能获得胜利。
English: The Nian Beast only awakens at the end of each year. The primary duty of the Twelve Sentinels is to face it during that time. Strong as it is, we always manage to defeat it.

Chinese: 每年如此吗？这样听起来，年兽似乎也没有很厉害嘛。
English: Every year? Sounds like the Nian Beast isn't all that powerful after all.

Chinese: 不，它真的很强大，但十二圣卫的“生肖之魂”可以抑制它的力量。
English: No, it really is dreadful, but the Twelve Sentinels' Zodiac Souls can suppress its power.

Chinese: 又是一个新的名词。
English: Another new term.

Chinese: 我、我也只能解释到这一步，因为、因为我……
English: I—I can only explain it so far because, because I...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 秋英的表情变得窘迫。我挪开视线，看着她脚边的石砖。
English: Autumn Glory's expression grows awkward. I shift my gaze down, staring at the stone tiles near her feet.

Chinese: 不再与我对视，秋英明显放松了一些。我看着石砖上的影子，那对柔软的兔耳轻轻摇摆着。
English: As she avoided my gaze, she visibly relaxed. I watch the shadows on the tiles—her soft bunny ears are swaying gently.

Chinese: 我……还没有领悟我的“卯兔之魂”。
English: I... haven't yet awakened my Bunnic Soul.

Chinese: 所以，这才是你的“麻烦”？
English: So that's your real trouble?
Hmm...

Chinese: 那其他的圣卫呢？不能交给他们吗？
English: What about the other Sentinels? Can't they handle it?

Chinese: 不、不可能的，其他的圣卫都还在沉睡。除了辰龙卫，只有当年当班的圣卫会出现在红簌国。
English: N—No, that's impossible. The other Sentinels are still in slumber. Aside from Drago, only the one on duty for the year appears in the Crimson Kingdom.

Chinese: 这算什么规矩？
English: What kind of rule is that?

Chinese: 据说在很久以前，十二圣卫是没有轮班这一说的，也不知道是从什么时候开始变成了现在这样……
English: Long ago, the Twelve Sentinels didn't have this rotation system. No one knows when or why it started...

Chinese: 就没有别的办法了吗？
English: Is there no other way?

Chinese: 本来，身为圣卫之首的辰龙卫每年都会在年关前苏醒，与当年当班的圣卫一同对抗年兽，但今年她却迟迟没有回来……
English: Normally, Drago, as our leader, would awaken before the Nian Beast each year to fight alongside us. But this year, she hasn't returned yet...

Chinese: 先生，我该怎么办？
English: Sir, what should I do?

Chinese: 秋英握着自己的衣角，声音里浸透了苦涩。
English: Autumn Glory grips her clothes tightly, her voice full of anguish.

Chinese: 还没领悟卯兔之魂的我，根本不是年兽的对手。
English: Without awakening my Bunnic Soul, I can't possibly face the Nian Beast.

Chinese: 那个生肖之魂，究竟是什么样的力量？
English: What exactly is this Zodiac Soul power?

Chinese: 每一名圣卫的生肖之魂都不一样，辰龙卫是业火，巳蛇卫是恩泽，丑牛卫是胆魄，子鼠卫是谋略……
English: Every Sentinel's Zodiac Soul is different. Drago's is Blaze , Serpens' is Blessing, Taurin's is Courage, and Mousar's is Strategy...

Chinese: 但我……我不知道我的生肖之魂究竟是什么。
English: But I... I don't know what my Zodiac Soul is.

Chinese: 业火和恩泽，是外放的力量，胆魄和谋略，则是内在的特质，秋英的生肖之魂，无非也是其中的一种……
English: Blaze and Blessing are external powers, while Courage and Strategy are internal traits. Autumn Glory's Zodiac Soul must be one of these...

Chinese: 你得先确定自己的特质是什么。
English: You need to first understand what your own special trait is.

Chinese: 诶？特质……？
English: Huh? Trait?

Chinese: 对，以波斯菊来举例，善良、责任感、运气，这些都算。
English: Yes. For example, in Calliopsis' case, it could be kindness, responsibility, or luck.

Chinese: 或者，你也可以问问你的心，作为卯兔圣卫，你最想做到的是什么事？
English: Or, you can ask yourself—what do you, as the Bunnic Sentinel, want to accomplish the most?

Chinese: 打倒年兽！
English: Defeating the Nian Beast!

Chinese: 如果这个是正确答案，卯兔之魂大约已经觉醒了。
English: If that were the correct answer, your Bunnic Soul would likely have awakened already.

Chinese: 咦，先生为什么这么说？
English: Huh? Why do you say that, sir?

Chinese: 你不缺作战的决心，不是吗？
English: Because you've never lacked the resolve to fight.

Chinese: ……您这么说出来，让人好羞耻。
English: Saying it like that makes me feel so embarrassed.

Chinese: 那就专心想想其他答案吧。
English: Then try to find another answer.

Chinese: 唔……大概是，帮助正在受苦的人们？
English: Hmm... Maybe... helping those who are suffering?

Chinese: 比如秋丰村的村民？
English: Like the villagers of Goldvale?

Chinese: ……嗯，其实，我也很想和飞玉一起去调查，但碧桂大人不允许我离开红簌宫。
English: Yes, actually, I really wanted to go with Jady to investigate, but Lord Emerina wouldn't allow me to leave the Crimson Palace.

Chinese: 圣卫的职责难道不是守护红簌国吗？这可不是呆在宫殿里就能做到的。
English: Isn't the duty of the Twelve Sentinels to protect the Crimson Kingdom? That's not something you can do just by staying in the palace.

Chinese: 而且，我不觉得生肖之魂是一个光凭苦思冥想便能获得的力量，既然遇到了瓶颈，最好的办法绝不是继续往前挤，而是走出来，试试换一条路走。
English: Also, I don't believe the Zodiac Soul is something you can attain by racking your brains. When you hit a roadblock, the best solution isn't to push through, but to take a different path.

Chinese: 先生的意思是……
English: What are you suggesting?

Chinese: 一起去吧，秋丰村！
English: Let's go together, to Goldvale!
Emm?

Chinese: 你有这个念头，就应该拿出行动，帮助弱者可不是光有一份心意就可以的。
English: Actions speak louder than words. Helping the weak isn't something you can accomplish just by having good intentions.

Chinese: 可是，我是圣卫……没有调令，是不能随便离开皇宫的。
English: But I'm a Sentinel... Without orders, I can't leave the palace on a whim.

Chinese: 我们偷偷出去。
English: We'll sneak out.

Chinese: 潜在的力量是需要外力去激发的，此行不够的话，我可以陪你去更多的地方，直到你领悟生肖之魂为止。
English: Hidden power often needs to be awakened by an external force. If this trip isn't enough, I'll go with you to even more places until you grasp your Bunnic Soul.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 秋英抬起头，我也跟着看向她。月光照进她的眼中，映得眼睛亮极了。
English: Autumn Glory lifts her head, and I look into her eyes. The moonlight reflect in them, making them shine brightly.

Chinese: 明明才刚认识……您对我未免太好了。这让我有点……于心不安。
English: We've only just met... but you're so kind to me. It makes me feel... a bit uneasy.

Chinese: 严格来说，并不能算是刚认识吧。
English: Strictly speaking, we haven't just met.

Chinese: 好像也是……
English: Hmm, you're right...

Chinese: 她咯咯地笑起来。
English: She giggles softly.

English: None

Chinese: 与繁华的夜市不同，万枝城的早市主打的是各式各样的早点，几乎每个铺位前都能排上十几号人，同样是熙熙攘攘，但更有生活气息。
English: Unlike the bustling night market, the morning market of Multilitchi is all about breakfast. There are lines of people at every stall, and though it's crowded, it feels full of vitality.

Chinese: 热气腾腾的包子、浓香四溢的豆浆、比脸还大的油饼、清新可口的粥羹……
English: Steamed buns, fragrant soy milk, pancakes as big as one's face, and fresh porridge...

Chinese: 看起来都很好吃的样子，比起宫中那些华而不实、味如嚼蜡的早膳，可谓强上太多。
English: Everything looks delicious, far better than the fancy but tasteless palace meals.

Chinese: （流口水）呲溜……看起来都好好吃呀，要是在米伦也能吃到就好了。
English: (Salivating) Slurp... Everything looks so good! I wish we could have food like this back in Mirren.

Chinese: 这不难，回去之前，去问他们要个食谱就好了。
English: That's easy—just ask for the recipe before we leave.

Chinese: 不如直接绑两个店家回去吧，更简单有效！
English: Why not just abduct a couple of shopkeepers and bring them back? Much simpler and more effective!

Chinese: 请收起你那危险的想法。
English: Please put away your dangerous ideas.

Chinese: 嗫，我再确认一下，侍主先生真的打算同我一起去秋丰村调查吗？
English: Um, just to confirm... You really intend to accompany me to Goldvale, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 当然啦，都快走到城门口了，你怎么还问起这个？
English: Obviously! We're almost at the city gates, and now you ask?

Chinese: 万、万一侍主先生只是想为我送行嗫？怕被我拒绝，只好编出这么一个理由……
English: What if Lord Oracle just wanted to see me off? And he made up such an excuse so I wouldn't refuse?

Chinese: ……你的小剧场里，戏有点多。
English: You have quite the active imagination...

Chinese: 而且，没想到连卯兔圣卫大人也一起来了，您不留在宫中，丞相大人不会怪罪吗？
English: Also, I didn't expect Bunnic Sentinel to come too. Won't the Chancellor be upset if you don't stay in the palace?

Chinese: 应该免不掉被一顿臭骂吧，可我不能顶着“圣卫”的称号却什么都不做……
English: I'll surely get scolded, but as one of the Twelve Sentinels, I must do something...

Chinese: 先生的话很有道理，想要帮助到更多的人，就应该走出去看看。
English: Lord Oracle inspired me. To help more people, I need to step outside and see the world.

Chinese: 嗫……？果然不是我的错觉，您和侍主先生之间，一定发生了什么。
English: Hmm? So it wasn't my imagination. Something definitely happened between you and Lord Oracle.
Huh?!

Chinese: 昨晚明明那么早就睡了，您和侍主先生却一副无精打采的样子，你们俩…该不会是趁我们睡着了以后，偷偷干了什么吧？
English: We all went to bed so early last night, yet you and Lord Oracle look so tired. Don't tell me you two did something while we were asleep?
How... How rude!

Chinese: 我、我太懂这个反应了，这不就是在默认吗？
English: I-I know that reaction all too well! That's basically admitting it!

Chinese: 唔呼~~已经将触手伸向太一了吗？不愧是侍主大人！
English: Oho, have you already set your sights on Taeuno? Good, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: ……这就是猫的直觉吗？在那之后，我和秋英的确还聊了许多……
English: Is this what they call a cat's intuition? Autumn Glory and I did end up talking about a lot of things last night...

Chinese: 从米伦的种种聊到了神谕司，又从十二圣卫聊到了红簌国的美食，我能认出那么多早点的品种，便是昨晚的学习成果。
English: From life in Mirren to the Oracle Division, from the Twelve Sentinels to the delicious food of the Crimson Kingdom. The fact that I could identify so many breakfast dishes was thanks to last night's lesson.

Chinese: 你很好奇吗？那今晚，就换你来和我“干些什么”吧。
English: Are you that curious? Then tonight, it can be your turn to "do something" with me.

Chinese: 嗫……我、我不敢！
English: Eep... I—I don't dare!

Chinese: 那就好好带路，那些过剩的精力，还是留给一路上的灾兽吧。
English: Good, then focus on leading the way. You'll need that extra energy for the Disastrous Beasts ahead.

Chinese: 灾兽？
English: Disastrous Beasts?

Chinese: 第八节 秋丰田
English: EP 8: Autumn Harvest

Chinese: 侍主一行抵达南部群山中的秋丰村，得出中毒的源头或是农作物，为此，一行人来到了秋丰梯田，发现田地中疑似被人下了毒……
English: The group arrives at Goldvale in the southern mountains. Suspecting the crops to be source of poison, they inspect the terraced fields and find traces of deliberate sabotage...

Chinese: 我们……到了，前、前面就是秋丰村了。
English: We... we're here. Just ahead is Goldvale.

Chinese: 终、终于到了吗……
English: F—Finally, we made it...

Chinese: 累死我了，怎么这么远呀！
English: I'm dead tired! Why is it so far?

Chinese: 先生，这附近的路有点难走，你可还安好？
English: Sir, the road's a bit rough here. Are you doing alright?

Chinese: 还能说话，还能行走，一时半会应该不会四分五裂。
English: I can still talk and walk. I don't think I'll be falling apart any time soon.

Chinese: 我开了个玩笑。
English: I was trying to make a joke.

Chinese: 嗫……那就好，那就好。
English: Phew... that's good to hear.

Chinese: 各位——那个，我——很抱歉连累了各位，只是我……我的家就在秋丰村。
English: Everyone—I... I'm really sorry for dragging you all into this, but... my home is here, in Goldvale.

Chinese: 一会儿，各位不能在村子里久留，不，甚至最好都不要进村。
English: When we get there, you all shouldn't stay long in the village. No, in fact, it would be best not to enter the village at all.

Chinese: 为什么这么说？
English: What do you mean?

Chinese: 因为——那可是瘟疫啊。
English: Because... there's a plague.

Chinese: 你说得确有道理，可这样，我们又该怎么帮助村子呢？
English: You've got a point, but in that case, how can we help the village?

Chinese: ——此次能伴你们同行，我很荣幸！
English: It has been an honor to travel with you all!

Chinese: 飞玉？
English: Jady?

Chinese: 我、我真的很钦佩你们。
English: I... I truly admire all of you.

Chinese: 我好像搞明白了一件事……
English: I think I've figured something out...

Chinese: 飞玉，你是回来送死的，是吗？
English: Jady, you come back here to die, don't you?
Hmm...
What?!

Chinese: 嗫……也没有那么悲观，只是自己的事情不能拖别人下水，大概是这个道理。
English: Nya... It's not that pessimistic. I just can't put others into danger with my own problems. It's as simple as that.

Chinese: 我知道了。
English: I see.

Chinese: 一般来说，瘟疫总有源头，飞玉，能拜托你去村子里调查一下吗？
English: Usually, a plague has a source. Jady, could you go into the village and track it down?
Ugh?

Chinese: 丘吉尔，你陪飞玉一起去，是时候发挥一下你那包打听的隐藏属性了。
English: Churchill, go with her. Time to put that nosy nature of yours to good use.

Chinese: 对了，瘟疫有传染性，记得做点保护措施，丘吉尔，你有这方面的能力对吧？
English: Oh, and remember, the plague is contagious. Make sure to take precautions. Churchill, you've got the means for that, right?

Chinese: 毕竟人家是天使嘛。
English: Naturally. I am an angel, after all.

Chinese: 给飞玉也套一个，然后，速战速决！
English: Protect Jady as well. Then, make it quick!

Chinese: 好嘞~小事一桩。
English: No problem! Easy-peasy.

Chinese: 飞玉，我们几个会留在这里。你去村里调查的时候，带上丘吉尔，她能抵御瘟疫。
English: Jady, the rest of us will stay here. You'll go into the village with Churchill. She can protect you from the plague.

Chinese: 然后，把答案或者问题带回来，我们一起想办法吧。
English: Bring back whatever information you find, and we'll figure this out together.

Chinese: 嗫……侍主先生！
English: Fine... Lord Oracle!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 飞玉抱着我不撒手。过了一两分钟，她才抹了把脸，和丘吉尔一起往远处的村子里走去。
English: Jady hugged me tightly and didn't let go. It took a minute or two before she finally wiped her face and set off towards the village with Churchill.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 没多久，飞玉和丘吉尔便带着"消息"与我们会合。
English: It wasn't long before they returned with "news."

Chinese: ……已经有一些外来的医士来到了秋丰村，带头的医士是村长的远房表妹！
English: Some outside healers have already come to Goldvale. Leading them is the village chief's distant cousin!

Chinese: ……显然是只有丘吉尔才会打听到的事情，包打听，名副其实。
English: Of course, only Churchill could dig up something like that. Her nosy reputation is well deserved.

Chinese: 村长的远方表妹说，现在还好，情况暂时维持住了。
English: The cousin said that for now, things are under control, but just barely.

Chinese: 瘟疫的源头呢？调查到了没有？
English: And the source of the plague? Did you find that out?

Chinese: 村长的远房表妹说，村民们的腹中有毒物……？
English: And she mentioned that the villagers had some kind of toxin in their stomachs...

Chinese: 丘吉尔，你怎么看？
English: Churchill, what's your take?

Chinese: 侍主大人，其实，我觉得村子碰到的问题，并不是瘟疫……
English: Lord Oracle, I don't think this is a plague at all...

Chinese: 是觉得，还是确定？
English: Are you thinking or are you sure?

Chinese: 我以前在天界的时候，虽然自己没参与，但看过别的天使给人间降灾，耳濡目染知道一些……
English: Back when I was in the Heavenly Realm, I didn't participate myself, but I saw other angels spreading disasters. I picked up a few things...

Chinese: 这不是瘟疫，因为它根本没在传染嘛。只是接连有人倒下。
English: This isn't a plague. It's not spreading from person to person. People are just collapsing one after another.

Chinese: 所以怀疑源头可能和吃的有关。
English: So the source is related to something they ate.

Chinese: 那，救治的难度不就变小了吗？太好了。
English: Does that mean it's easier to cure? Great.

Chinese: 嗫……就是不知道什么毒。
English: We just don't know what the poison is...

Chinese: 而且秋丰村是自给自足，粮食蔬果全都靠村民们自己种植，也不知道毒素是哪里来的。
English: And Goldvale is self-sufficient. The villagers grow all their own crops. No clue where the toxin could've come from.

Chinese: 能带我们去田地里看看吗？
English: Can you show us the fields?

Chinese: 嗫……好的。
English: Uh... sure.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我们向西走了一会儿，可以用“壮阔”来形容的一大片梯田出现在了我们的眼前。
English: We walk west for a bit until we reach a vast stretch of terraced fields. The view is nothing short of spectacular.

Chinese: 呜哇，好厉害，这么多的农作物，够村民们吃上一整年了吧！
English: Wow, this is amazing! There's enough crops here to feed the whole village for a year!

Chinese: ……你是不是没考虑过菜放久了会烂掉这件事？
English: You do realize vegetables rot if you keep them too long, huh?

Chinese: 啊！有胡萝卜！！
English: Ahhh! Look, carrots!

Chinese: 咦？在哪里在哪里？
English: Huh? Where, where?

Chinese: 真的耶，虽然全被埋在泥土下了，但那些叶子可不会骗人！
English: Oh, you're right! Even though they're buried, those leaves don't lie!

Chinese: 不过…那些叶子的样子，好像有点怪？
English: But... don't those leaves look a little weird?

Chinese: 嗯，不是很有精神……
English: Mmm, they don't look very lively...

Chinese: 虽然秋英的描述多少有点抽象，但确实提到了点子上。
English: Autumn Glory's description was vague, but she was onto something.

Chinese: 我们行走在田地间，无论是蔬菜还是粮食，看起来都不是很新鲜、结实的样子。
English: As we walk through the fields, none of the vegetables or grains look fresh or robust.

Chinese: 走了一圈后，我们回到了原点，波斯菊没有克制住对胡萝卜的冲动，随手拔了一根出来。
English: After circling back, Calliopsis can't resist her carrot craving and pulls one out.

Chinese: 诶，胡萝卜像被抽走了营养一样，瘪了—整圈。
English: Whoa, the carrot is all shriveled up, as if all its nutrients have been drained.

Chinese: ……是土地，还是水源被污染了吗？
English: Is the soil contaminated? Or maybe the water?

Chinese: 村民们刚才倒是提过，今年的蔬果大都不太像样，但以前有过水质变差导致收成不好的先例，就没太当回事……
English: The villagers did mention earlier that most of this year's fruits and vegetables don't look right, but there's been precedent for poor water quality leading to a bad harvest, so they didn't think much of it...

Chinese: 飞玉，水源在哪里？
English: Jady, where's the water source?

Chinese: 田里的水都是村民们从别的地方挑过来的，离这最近的水源地，应该是前面那座山的溪流。
English: The water for the fields is carried in from elsewhere. The nearest source is a stream on that mountain.

Chinese: 那个水源，只有秋丰村在用吗？
English: Only Goldvale is using that water?

Chinese: 不是的，附近两个村子也在用，但没听说那里出事。
English: No, two other villages also use it, but I haven't heard of any problems from them.

Chinese: 那就不是水源的问题……
English: Then it's probably not the water...

Chinese: 可土地里的污染源该怎么找呢？把田地都挖开吗？
English: But how do we find what's contaminating the soil? Are we supposed to dig up the whole field?
Ugh...

Chinese: 看来要再调查一阵子了。
English: Looks like we'll need to investigate more.

Chinese: 不过在那之前，丘吉尔，你的箭好像是有净化效果的吧？如果对这田里射上一箭，能净化毒素吗？
English: But before that... Churchill, your arrows have a purifying effect, right? Could you shoot one into the field and see if it cleanses the toxins?

Chinese: 是可以的……但侍主大人，如果我用多了力量，那个……您可能会裂开。
English: I can do that... but, Lord Oracle, if I use too much power, you might... well, crack open.

Chinese: 做吧。
English: Do it.

Chinese: 飞玉，侍主为了你可是——
English: Jady, Lord Oracle's doing this for you—

Chinese: 别说了。
English: Enough.

Chinese: ……嗫，我、我会负起责任的！
English: I—I'll take responsibility!

Chinese: 不用了，你帮了我们不少忙，这是回礼。
English: No need. You've already helped us a lot. Consider this a thank you.
Hmm.

Chinese: 那我先用这块田试一试。
English: Let me test it on this patch first.

Chinese: 对了，先说好哟，我不是净化的天使，而且那种箭是有副作用的，万一发生什么意外，我可不负责！
English: Oh, just so you know, I'm not a purification angel, and these arrows have side effects. If anything unexpected happens, don't blame me!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 丘吉尔向着田里射出了箭矢，伴随着一些似有似无的粉色泡泡，水质变得清澈透明了起来，农作物不仅恢复了活力，似乎还长得更大了。
English: Churchill shoots an arrow into the field. A few faint pink bubbles float up as the water turns crystal clear. The crops not only recover but seem to grow even bigger.

Chinese: 居、居然真的有效？！
English: It... it actually worked?!

Chinese: 真的嗫，水好像更清澈了，不过这些庄稼，是不是有点生长过盛了？
English: It really did! The water looks clearer now, but the crops... don't they seem a little too big?

Chinese: ……它们和污染相爱了，好像是这样？为了让彼此能在一起，就克服了一些阻碍？
English: Looks like they and the pollution had a little romance. They overcame some obstacles to be together, maybe?

Chinese: 啊，好梦幻的恋爱呀，真没想到，泥土中也是有些浪漫的。
English: Ah, what a dreamy love story. Who knew even the soil could be so romantic?

Chinese: 嗫？真的吗？
English: Hmm? Really?
Romantic...

Chinese: 既然有效，丘吉尔，给这山间的梯田全都来上一箭。
English: Since it worked, Churchill, give every terrace a shot of that arrow.

Chinese: 侍主大人……你是认真的吗？
English: Lord Oracle... are you serious?

Chinese: 这种爱情之后会产生什么问题，我可不负责啊！
English: I'm not responsible for any problems that might arise from this "romance".

Chinese: 而且这可是整整几座山的梯田，全都来上一箭？
English: And you're asking me to shoot arrows into all of these terraces? Across multiple mountains?!

Chinese: 召唤你的时候，我曾附加过一个条件，“希望到来的星痕能在此行中帮助到我”。
English: When I summoned you, I made one request: "I hope the Aster who arrives will aid me on this journey."

Chinese: 所以你的出现一定是有意义的，说不定，就是为了这一刻，别磨蹭了，射吧！
English: Your presence must have a purpose—maybe this is that moment. Stop stalling and shoot!

Chinese: 既然侍主大人这么说，赴汤蹈火我也得去了。
English: Well, if you put it that way, I'll do it anyway!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 不知道过了多久，丘吉尔终于完成了净化整片梯田的伟业，累得直接倒在了一边，而我……已经麻木到感受不到身上的疼痛，即便它确实存在。
English: I'm not sure it took how long for Churchill to complete the monumental task of purifying all the terraced fields. She collapsed to the side in exhaustion, and as for me... I have grown so numb that I can't even feel the pain coursing through my body, though I know it is there.

Chinese: 过程中，我思考过一个问题，能净化污秽的星痕还有很多，效率大多远高于丘吉尔，为什么偏偏是她……之后，便因为身体太疼，放弃了思考。
English: During the process, I pondered why it had to be Churchill. There are plenty of other Asters who could purify with much greater efficiency... but eventually, the pain in my body was too much, and I gave up thinking.

Chinese: 丘吉尔，你好棒呀，真的做到了！
English: Churchill, you were amazing! You really did it!

Chinese: 别夸了，我都快不行了，让我躺会儿……
English: No more compliments, please. I'm about to pass out... just let me lie here...
Rhaaar! Rhaaaaar!
H—Help! Ahhh!!

Chinese: 视线所不能及的远处，突然传来了灾兽的吼声和谁的呼救，真是片刻不得安宁。
English: In the distance, beyond our sight, a Beast's roar and someone's desperate cries for help suddenly shatter the brief moment of peace.

Chinese: 灾、灾兽？
English: Disastrous Beast?

Chinese: 好像有人被袭击了，我们得过去看看。
English: It sounds like someone's being attacked. We need to go check it out!

Chinese: 诶？又要动起来了吗？
English: Huh? We have to move again?

Chinese: 走吧，不管是谁，人命要紧！
English: Let's go! No matter who it is, a life is at stake!

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 波斯菊
English: Calliopsis

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊
English: Outlander Calli

Chinese: 丘吉尔
English: Churchill

Chinese: 飞玉
English: Jady

Chinese: 飞玉 & 异邦波斯菊
English: Jady & Outlander Calli

Chinese: 第九节 丞相令
English: EP 9: Chancellor's Mandate

Chinese: 击退了袭人的灾兽后，发现死者是宫里的人，且带着一块丞相的令牌，秋丰村的事件告一段落，侍主一行告别了飞玉，启程回宫。
English: After driving off the beasts, they find the corpse of a palace servant with Chancellor's token. With Goldvale's matter settled, the group begins their return to the palace.

Chinese: 所幸灾兽的数量并不多，飞玉和秋英没有费太多的功夫便解决了战斗，
English: There weren't too many Beasts. Jady and Autumn Glory quickly finished the fight.

Chinese: 只是在这个过程当中，遭到袭击的人已经咽下了最后的一口气……
English: Unfortunately, the person who had been attacked drew his last breath during the battle...

Chinese: 先生，这个人的情况怎么样？
English: Sir, how's he doing?

Chinese: 很遗憾，救不回来了。
English: I'm sorry, but we couldn't save him.

Chinese: 太惨了，被啃掉了一只手臂……
English: It's awful... his arm's been completely torn off...

Chinese: 一定是因为我的气息引来了灾兽，才害得他遭到了袭击。
English: My fault... the Beast must have been drawn by my presence. That's why he got attacked.

Chinese: 是、是我们害了他吗……
English: Are... are we responsible for his death?

Chinese: 事情已经发生了，再怎么追究原因也于事无补。
English: What's done is done. Looking for someone to blame won't change anything now.

Chinese: 我更在意的是，他是谁，以及，他为什么会出现在这里。
English: What I'm more concerned about is who he was and why he was here.

Chinese: 嗫…？他衣服上的纹饰，好像是宫里才会用的吧？
English: Nya...? The emblem on these clothes... aren't those used only in the palace?

Chinese: 让我看看。
English: Let me take a look.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 的确有些眼熟，好像最近才在哪里见过……
English: Yes, they look familiar. I feel like I've seen this somewhere recently...

Chinese: 啊！你们看，他的口袋里好像掉出来了什么东西。
English: Ahhh! Look, something has fallen out of his pocket!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 顺着波斯菊所指的方向，果然有一块东西从死者的腰兜中滑落了出来。
English: Following Calliopsis' gesture, we see something has indeed slipped from the man's waist pouch.

Chinese: 令牌？！
English: A token?!

Chinese: 与飞玉的银质令不同，被我拾起的这一块令牌由暗红色的玉石打造而成，一面雕刻着一只被蛇缠身的巨龟，另一面则是一个红簌文字。
English: Unlike Jady's silver token, this one is made from a dark red jade. One side is engraved with a giant turtle entwined with a snake, and the other bears a single character.

Chinese: 玄武、和一个“相”字……这是丞相大人的令牌？！
English: The Black Tortoise, and the character "C"... this is the Chancellor's Mandate?!

Chinese: ……是的。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 哇，我还从来没见过丞相令呢，居然这么好看。
English: Wow, I've never seen the Chancellor's Mandate before... It's so beautiful!

Chinese: 一个疑问已经解答了，他是丞相派来的人，问题是，他为什么来？
English: Well, one mystery is solved. He was sent by the Chancellor. But the question remains—why?

Chinese: 会不会是来调查瘟疫的嗫？
English: To investigate the plague?

Chinese: 可是丞相大人在大殿之上，明明说了那样的话……
English: But in the royal court, the Chancellor said those things...

Chinese: 一边已经无力再管小村子的事，一边吩咐人前来调查，什么嘛，丞相大人果然是个好人嘛~
English: She was already overwhelmed with works, and yet she still sent someone here to investigate? What a kind woman she is!

Chinese: 她好像已经完全认定了是这样耶……
English: She's already convinced herself that's the reason...

Chinese: 太好了呢。既然都城肯管，那这里的人也有新鲜的胡萝卜吃了！
English: That's great news. If the capital is helping, the villagers will have fresh carrots to eat again!

Chinese: 就是可惜了这个人，好不容易跑来这里，却被灾兽给咔嚓了。
English: It's a shame for this guy, though. He came all this way, only to be taken down by a Beast.

Chinese: 虽然飞玉的猜想不是全然没有道理，但看秋英的表情，事情似乎并没那么简单？
English: While Jady's guess wasn't entirely off the mark, Autumn Glory's expression suggested things weren't that simple.

Chinese: 不管怎么说，田地救回来了，都城那边也派人来了。我们这就回村子里把好消息告诉村民们吧。
English: Well, either way, the fields are restored, and the capital sent help. Let's head back to the village and share the good news with everyone!

Chinese: 我……还是不去了吧。
English: I... think I'll pass.

Chinese: 嗫？这样好吗？我刚才可是跟他们说了哟，卯兔圣卫大人大驾光临什么的。
English: Hmm? Are you sure? I told them you'd be there.

Chinese: 这里不是出现了灾兽嘛……
English: But Disastrous Beasts appeared...

Chinese: 我想…这大概是因为我。
English: I think the problem might be me.
Ugh?

Chinese: 为什么这么说？
English: What do you mean?

Chinese: 灾兽是年兽的造物，清除十二圣卫，是它们的本能。
English: The Disastrous Beasts are creations of the Nian Beast. It's their instinct to hunt down the Twelve Sentinels.

Chinese: 能分辨出十二圣卫的气息，似乎是它们与生俱来的能力，只要闻到了我的味道，不管它们身在何处，都会跑来攻击我。
English: They can sense our presence. It seems to be their innate ability. No matter where they are, they'll come to attack once they catch my scent.

Chinese: 灾兽的力量源自年兽，年兽的意识，便是灾兽的意识，这一点不难理解。
English: The Nian Beast gives power to the Disastrous Beasts. Their will drives them, which makes sense.

Chinese: 我很抱歉连累了这个人，只是我……真的很想帮助这里的村民。
English: I'm sorry this person got caught up in it... I just... I really wanted to help the villagers.

Chinese: 她的决定是对的，万一还有灾兽跑来就不好办了。
English: She's right. It'll be worse if the Disastrous Beasts turn up.

Chinese: 嗫……都是灾兽的错！
English: It's all the Disastrous Beasts' fault!

Chinese: 就你自己去吧。
English: You should go alone.

Chinese: 我们在这里等你就好。
English: We'll wait for you here.

Chinese: 不用了嗫，村子里还有很多事情要忙，我一回去再出来，可能很晚了。
English: No need. There's still plenty to take care of in the village. When I come out again, it'll be late.

Chinese: 这就要说再见了吗？
English: Time to say goodbye?

Chinese: 这把能让小卯兔的力量变得完整的“钥匙”，这一次，出现了。
English: This "key" that can complete her power has now appeared.

Chinese: 所谓“钥匙”，是指我吧？
English: And the "key" is me, right?

Chinese: 没错没错，就是你，来自异邦的侍主。
English: Exactly. It's you, Lord of the foreign land.

Chinese: 小卯兔不是肉体凡胎，而是星痕，体内本就有一股被你称为“星痕之力”的力量。
English: The bunny girl isn't bound by a mortal body, she's an Aster, already harboring a power you call "Power of Aster."

Chinese: 星痕之力、卯兔之魂，两股力量互相牵制，哪一个都唱不了主角。
English: The Power of Aster and the Bunnic Soul have been suppressing each other, with neither taking the lead.

Chinese: 但现在就不同了，异邦的侍主，你立了大功哟。
English: But now that's changed. Lord of the foreign land, you've played a crucial role!

Chinese: 因为签订了契约，星痕之力变成可控，卯兔之魂不再受牵制，是这样吧？
English: Because I formed a contract with her, the Power of Aster is now under control, and the Bunnic Soul is no longer suppressed. Am I right?

Chinese: 完全正确！
English: Absolutely!

Chinese: 小卯兔，距离你领悟卯兔之魂，应该不远了哟。
English: Bunny girl, you're close to comprehending the Bunnic Soul now.

Chinese: 太、太好了……
English: That's wonderful...

Chinese: 各位先灵，能不能顺便告诉我，卯兔之魂是什么样子的呀？
English: Bunnic Spirits, can you tell me what the Bunnic Soul looks like?

Chinese: 卯兔之魂是吧……嘻嘻，不告诉你！
English: Hehe, nope! We won't tell you!
What?!

Chinese: 留点悬念呗，不然就没有惊喜了~
English: Got to leave some surprises! Otherwise, where's the fun?

Chinese: 哎呀，一不小心，现身的时间好像有点长了。
English: Oops, seems we've been here too long.

Chinese: 回去之前，再说最后一件事吧。
English: Before we go, one last thing.

Chinese: 小卯兔，请你别怨恨碧桂。
English: Bunny girl, don't hold any hatred for Emerina.

Chinese: 咦……？您也认识她吗？
English: Huh? You know her too?

Chinese: 当然，她还小的时候，我甚至还抱过她呢，明明因为害怕陌生人，有点想哭的样子，但一直忍着……
English: Of course! When she was little, I even held her in my arms. Scared of strangers, she was about to cry, but she held it in...

Chinese: 对对对，那小娃，也并非什么冷漠无情之人，只是责任心太重了。
English: Exactly! She's not a heartless person, just burdened by too much responsibility.

Chinese: 她本来就是那种什么事情都想自己扛的性格，现在位居一人之下万人之上，面对的又是年关这种关乎天下之事……
English: She's always been the type to take on everything herself. Now she holds a position second only to the Queen, with the weight of the world on her shoulders...

Chinese: 要是不变成现在这样，那就不是我认识的那个碧桂咧！
English: If she didn't change, she wouldn't be the Emerina I knew!

Chinese: 就是啊，本来要应对年关，若有辰龙，那倒也并非什么不可能之事，只是……直到此刻，就连我们也无法感应到她。
English: That's right. Normally, to deal with the Nian Beast, if the Dragon Sentinel were here, it would not be an impossible task. It's just... even now, we cannot sense her.

Chinese: 小卯兔没有觉醒力量，小龙女又不知道为什么不回来……对付年兽的老方法，已然不可取了！
English: Bunny girl hasn't awakened her power, and the dragon girl is missing... The old ways of dealing with the Nian Beast are no longer an option!

Chinese: 咕……要、要是我能更有用一点……
English: Guh... If only I could be more useful...

Chinese: 万事有缘，不可强求……不过碧桂那小娃的性子……
English: Everything happens for a reason, it cannot be forced... but Emerina won't resign herself to fate...

Chinese: 将溺死之人不会分辨所抓之物……我猜，她是从哪本皇室的古籍中看到了吧……圣兽祭。
English: A drowning person will grab onto anything... I guess she must've found it in some ancient royal text... the Divine Beast Sacrifice.

Chinese: ……圣兽祭？
English: The Divine Beast Sacrifice?

Chinese: 顾名思义，圣兽祭，乃献祭之仪式，但其阵法规模太大，囊括了整个红簌国，反而让世人无法察觉。
English: As the name suggests, it is a ritual of offering, but the scale of its formation is so vast, encompassing the entire Crimson Kingdom, that people can't even detect it.

Chinese: 不管以什么样的方式，只要人死得够多，让大量的生命之力和灵魂，流入阵法之中，麒麟先灵便能降世，封印年兽！
English: As long as enough people die, and a large amount of life essence and souls flow into the formation, the Kirin Spirit can descend and seal the Nian Beast!

Chinese: 难道传说中的麒麟显圣是……！？
English: So this is the truth of the legendary appearance of the Kirin...

Chinese: 没错，这就是——当十二圣卫不足以保护国家，年兽猖獗，灾兽横行之时，麒麟先灵就会降世，拨乱反正——的传说的来源。
English: That's right. This is the origin of the legend that when the Twelve Sentinels are unable to protect the kingdom from the Nian Beast, the Kirin Spirit will descend to restore order.

Chinese: 所以她才盯上秋丰村的村民……
English: So that's why she targeted the villagers of Goldvale...

Chinese: 打断一下……我听下来，圣兽祭似乎并不需要谁来推动的样子。
English: Hold on a second... From what I've heard, it seems like the Divine Beast Sacrifice doesn't need anyone to actively make it happen.

Chinese: 以功利的角度来看，这个国家的执政者只要清楚“要死多少人”和“什么时候让它发生”，然后在对应的时间，不作为不就行了？
English: From a practical point of view, as long as the rulers know "how many people need to die" and "when it is going to happen," they could wait for it to naturally occur.

Chinese: 灾难当前，只要执政者不作为，或者劳而无功，自然会有很多人死去。
English: In the face of disaster, if the rulers simply do nothing or fail in their efforts, a large number of people will inevitably die.

Chinese: 但不作为，和在年关之前，自己想办法去杀够人，这完全是两码事。碧桂似乎另有目的。
English: But doing nothing and actively killing enough people before the year's end are two different things. Emerina must have some other goal.

Chinese: 没错哟，异邦的侍主。
English: Exactly, Lord of the foreign land.

Chinese: ……在你的面前，好像可以谈一些复杂的话题了。
English: It seems we can discuss more complex matters in front of you now.

Chinese: 红簌国国祚悠久，根基日趋腐朽……不好，好像时间到了。
English: The Crimson Kingdom has a long history, but its foundation has been rotting for some time now... Oh no, our time is up.

Chinese: 最后再问一句，对于这个方法，波斯菊你怎么想？
English: One last question before we leave—Calliopsis, what do you think of this method?

Chinese: 这……太过分了！这样应对年关的方法，我无法接受！
English: It is awful! I can't accept such a method to deal with the disaster!

Chinese: 说得好！虽是外来，也不愧为我兔裔！
English: Well said! Though you're an outsider, you're still good Bunnician!

Chinese: ……那我们……就回去了……
English: Now we... must return...

Chinese: 请等一下，我还有最后一个疑问——
English: Wait, I have one last question—

Chinese: 5400年前，秋英来到太一，这个数字，各位没有弄错吗？
English: Autumn Glory came to Taeuno 5,400 years ago. Are you certain about that number?

English: However, I never got the chance to hear the answer. The spirits disappear without leaving a trace, as if they have never been here.

Chinese: 一切重归平静，甚至，有些许冷清，秋英站在池水中，面带分别的苦涩，伸手想要抓住什么……

Chinese: 那些乱糟糟的事情……接下来，我们去弄明白就好了。
English: As for all these tangled-up issues... We'll just figure them out as we go.

Chinese: 嗯。

Chinese: 不过，这个5400年前，也不能完全当它不存在。

Chinese: 等回到米伦之后，得找牧好好研究一下……
English: When I get back to Mirren, I'll have to study this with Muu...

Chinese: 嗫……灾兽从皇宫里跑出来，看样子是出了大事嗫！
English: Well... Judging by the Disastrous Beasts, something serious must have happened!

Chinese: 的确发生了不少事情，我会慢慢告诉你的，先对付这些灾兽吧，然后去救波斯菊。
English: Yes, a lot of things. I'll tell you later. Now, let's fight the beasts and save Calliopsis.

Chinese: 小兔兔？她在哪里？我可以去救她。
English: The bunny? Where is she? I can save her.

Chinese: 你一个人能行吗？万一那里有灾兽呢。
English: Alone? What if there are Disastrous Beasts?

Chinese: 嗫……猫裔的轻功可好了。
English: Phew... Cats are stealthy.

Chinese: 那照你这么说，我还能飞呢！
English: Whatever. I can fly!

Chinese: 有道理，丘吉尔，你和飞玉一起去。救波斯菊的事，就拜托你们两个了。
English: Good point. Churchill, you go with Jady. Please rescue Calliopsis.

Chinese: 诶？我们俩都去了，那你们怎么办？
English: Huh? What do you do without us?

Chinese: 这里有秋英就够了。
English: I have Autumn Glory.

Chinese: 嗫……你们还没告诉我波斯菊在哪……
English: Nya... But where is Calliopsis...

Chinese: 在皇宫的东北角。
English: Northeast of the palace.

Chinese: 这不等于没说吗？
English: How informative!

Chinese: 我想起来了，东北角，不算大的建筑，是年久失修的旧藏书楼！
English: I remember now! The northeast corner, the building that isn't very large... It should be the dilapidated library!

Chinese: 这就清楚多了，包在我们身上了！
English: That's better. We'll handle it!

Chinese: 侍主大人，我们一会儿在哪里汇合？
English: Lord Oracle, where should we meet later?

Chinese: 圣麟殿。
English: The Kirin Palace.

Chinese: 理论上来说，红簌国的小皇帝应该就在那里吧，最坏的情况，我们也得确保她的安全才行——
English: Theoretically, the young Empress of the Crimson Kingdom should be there. At the very least, we should secure her...

Chinese: 侍主先生说的没错，如果圣上出了什么事，不等年兽来，就会天下大乱的。
English: Lord Oracle is right. The nation will get chaotic by itself if anything happens to her.

Chinese: 好，那就圣麟殿见。
English: Alright, we'll see you at the Kirin Palace, then.

Chinese: 我真是劳碌命！
English: Working overtime is my fate!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 丘吉尔和飞玉灵活地跃上了城门，随即消失在了我们的视线中。
English: Churchill and Jady leap to the gate and soon disappear.

Chinese: 飞玉小姐能来实在是太好了，真是意想不到的援军呢。
English: It's great that Jady can make it. What an unexpected reinforcement.

Chinese: 我们也不能掉链子，走吧！
English: We should still try our best. Let's go!

English: Reunited with Jady, Churchill, and the freed Calliopsis, the group confronts Emerina and defeats her. Yet she remains tight-lipped about her actions—and then, something far stranger unfolds...

Chinese: 我们在圣麟殿前汇合。
English: We meet in front of the Kirin Palace.

Chinese: 侍主先生！
English: Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 嗫……嘿嘿，顺利完成任务。
English: Phew... Mission accomplished.

Chinese: 侍主大人，我可累惨了！
English: Lord Oracle, I'm exhausted!

Chinese: 这家伙还睡得很香，这一路上我蹦啊跳啊地，她都没有醒！
English: The bunny sleeps so tight. She didn't even wake up as I ran and jumped!

Chinese: 我看着被丘吉尔背在身后的波斯菊，睡得非常安详，看起来没有受过严刑拷打的样子，便也安心了。
English: I look at Calliopsis, who is sleeping tight on Churchill's back. I'm relieved as she doesn't seem tortured.

Chinese: 先让她在一边接着睡吧，别太近了，安全一些。
English: Let her sleep. Keep a little distance to ensure her safety.

Chinese: 好嗫。
English: Okay, nya.

Chinese: 然后，我们往殿内走去。
English: Then, we walk into the palace.

Chinese: 碧桂站在王座的高台前，似是在迎接我们一般。
English: Emerina, standing before the throne, seems to be waiting for us.

Chinese: 好像已经没有灾兽了的样子……
English: Looks like there isn't any Disastrous Beast...

Chinese: 不要放松警惕，也许只是在埋伏着。
English: Stay alert. Perhaps they're waiting in ambush.

Chinese: 丞相大人，请停手吧，不要再错下去了。
English: Lady Emerina, please stop going down this mistaken path.

Chinese: 呵呵。
English: Hehe.

Chinese: 还冲到这里来……卯兔卿，你纠集这一干人等杀入圣麟殿，是欲对圣上不利？
English: You make it here... Bunnic, are you and your people trying to hurt Her Majesty?

Chinese: ……我们是来救圣上的。
English: We're here to save her.

Chinese: 异乡人——敬酒和罚酒，我都给你们尝过了，为什么还是要管这件事呢？
English: Outlanders, I've asked and warned you. Why do you have to put your nose in it?

Chinese: 也许是不想看这天下大乱吧。
English: Perhaps I just hate to see a nation in chaos.

Chinese: 不会有什么大乱——
English: There won't be chaos.

Chinese: 碧桂突然闭嘴了。
English: Emerina suddenly shuts up.

Chinese: 你失言了。
English: You spilled the beans.

Chinese: 是皇帝要你这么做的吗？
English: Did Her Majesty ask you to do it?

Chinese: 临近年关，辰龙还是没消息，卯兔还是没觉醒，刚即位的小皇帝坐不住了吧？
English: With the year's end approaching, there is still no news from the Dragon Sentinel, and the Bunnic Sentinel has not yet awakened. The newly enthroned young Empress is getting restless, isn't she?

Chinese: 放肆！你敢妄议圣上！
English: Stop! How dare you judge Her Majesty?!

Chinese: 侍主先生，你是说？
English: Lord Oracle, what do you mean?

Chinese: 看起来，这位碧桂仍是一位忠心耿耿的臣子。
English: Looks like Emerina is still loyal to Her Majesty.

Chinese: 喂，她怎么——都小心！
English: Hey, why is she... Watch out!

Chinese: 一股强烈的灾兽气息慢慢地从碧桂的身上涌出，她的身体也悄然发生着变化。
English: A strong aura of the Disastrous Beast comes out of Emerina. Her body also changes fast.

Chinese: 呜哇，看着真有点……！
English: Oh, that's a little bit...

Chinese: 变成灾兽了……
English: She's turning into a Disastrous Beast...

Chinese: 从飞玉和丘吉尔的反应便可以看出，这个变化的过程有多么难以描述，好端端的人类身体，此刻，已然变成一头灾兽……
English: From Jady's and Churchill's reactions, we can tell how weird the process is. A human body has transformed into a Disastrous Beast...

Chinese: 看来得换我问你了，做到这种地步，你又是为哪般？
English: Now, it's my turn to ask questions. Why do you have to do this?

Chinese: 为了……力量，还有权力！
English: For... power! And authority!

Chinese: 比起那个……我……才应该是皇帝！
English: More than that... I... I should be the Empress!

Chinese: 去死吧！
English: Die!

English: After a painful roar, Emerina resumes her human form and collapses before us.

Chinese: 呼……打、打赢了？
English: Phew... W-We win?

Chinese: 嗫，应该是吧……
English: Emm, I guess so...

Chinese: ……丞相大人……
English: Lady Emerina...

Chinese: 我拖着开裂的身体，走到了碧桂的身前。
English: I drag my broken body before Emerina.

Chinese: 现在，能心平气和聊一聊了么？
English: Can we talk calmly now?

Chinese: 就当你是同意了。
English: I'll take that as a yes.

Chinese: 你做的这一切，是不是小皇帝的旨意？
English: Everything you have done... was it by the young Empress's decree?

Chinese: 呵呵，我谁的命令也没听，我才应该是皇帝。
English: Heh, I listened to no one's orders. I should be the Empress.

Chinese: 你要装也不是不行。
English: You can keep telling the lies.

Chinese: 到目前为止，大致的脉络我已经理清了，虽然还差一个疑问——那个就先不管，你就先听听我的推论，再告诉我对或者不对。
English: But I've sorted out most of the story, though I do have one question. That can wait. Listen to my theory and tell me if I am right.

Chinese: ……成王败寇，杀了我。
English: You win. Kill me.

Chinese: 那可不行，秋英看住她，不要让她自尽。
English: No way. Autumn Glory, don't let her kill herself.

Chinese: 自尽……！我知道了。
English: Ugh! I know.

Chinese: 就像我之前说的，临近年关，辰龙还是没消息，卯兔还是没觉醒，眼看着就要年兽作乱，民不聊生了。
English: Like I said about the Drago and the Bunnic, the Nian Beast will soon be a threat to the civilians considering the time.

Chinese: 即便有麒麟先灵救世，可小皇帝刚刚即位就发生这样的祸事。
English: Even if the Kirin Spirit saves the world, for such a disaster to occur just after the young Empress ascended the throne...

Chinese: 可以预见的，百姓对她不会有什么好的看法，地方的势力借机也不会再尊奉中央。
English: Her people will question her capabilities, while all regional forces will rise against the central authority..

Chinese: 她会失去统治天下的权威。
English: She will soon lose power.

Chinese: 碧桂突然开始挣扎起来，又被秋英摁倒。
English: Emerina suddenly starts struggling. Autumn Glory takes her down again.

Chinese: 卯兔先灵告诉我，红簌国国祚悠久，根基日趋腐朽……而你，似乎是一个很想改变现状的人。
English: The Bunnic Spirits told me that the long-reigning Crimson Kingdom's foundations are gradually decaying... And you want to change the situation.

Chinese: 你很想清理掉吧，中央的蠢臣和蛀虫，阳奉阴违中央的地方势力，空有家名的贵族……
English: You want to wipe out the incompetent, the corrupt, and those who are against the government...

Chinese: 如果这些人，都成为圣兽祭的祭品就好了，你有这么想过吧？
English: "If only all these people could become offerings for the Divine Beast Sacrifice." Is that what you think?

Chinese: ……妖言惑众……
English: Nonsense...

Chinese: 然后就到了最关键的地方，我不知道你用了什么办法——让曾经手无缚鸡之力的你掌握了可以命令灾兽的力量。
English: Now is the key part of the story. You, once so defenseless, somehow found a way to control the Disastrous Beasts.

Chinese: 但是，这真是方便的力量啊。如果是灾兽下手，谁还会怀疑皇帝？……谁都知道，灾兽只听年兽的命令。
English: How convenient! Who would doubt Her Majesty if it's the Disastrous Beasts? Everyone knows only the Nian Beast can control them.

Chinese: 假如你再占据了皇宫，召唤灾兽，清理天下，完成了圣兽祭，然后死于降世的麒麟先灵之手呢？
English: What if you take the palace, summon the Disastrous Beasts, kill the unwanted, finish the sacrifice, and get killed by the Kirin Spirit?

Chinese: ……不要再说，求求你，让我死吧……
English: Please stop. Please, let me die...

Chinese: 侍主先生是说……丞相大人打算借年兽之力，降下灾祸，完成圣兽祭，最后把账全推给年兽。
English: Lord Oracle, so... the Chancellor planned to complete the Divine Beast Sacrifice and blame it on the Nian Beast?

Chinese: 是啊，如果计算好，起码在这都城里，她完全可以把想杀的人都带走，再之后，只要尽可能地削弱地方的势力，稳固中央。
English: Exactly. She can manage to get whoever she wants to kill in the capital and then spend time weakening the regional forces.

Chinese: 时机合适时，能让小皇帝讨伐掉自己是再好不过，就算没有那种机会，只要与年兽一起在年关之际被麒麟先灵杀死。
English: It would be perfect if the young empress could kill her in person. If not, she would let Kirin Spirit kill her and the Nian Beast on New Year's Eve.

Chinese: 有了碧桂这个犯上作乱的奸相吸引仇恨，活下来的人又是皇帝派的人占多数。
English: Emerina would be the only source of hatred and most survivors would be in favor of the empress.

Chinese: 民间的舆论自然可以往碧桂身上引，皇帝的权威依然可以保障，等到她长大，该是她的自然还是她的。
English: The public opinion would be around Emerina. The empress secures her authority and gets whatever is hers when she grows up.

Chinese: 原来是这样。
English: I see.

Chinese: 拜托了……你杀了我吧。
English: Please... Kill me.

Chinese: 我对那些不是特别懂……但丞相大人是为了皇帝，也是为了红簌国，才出此下策的吧。
English: I don't quite understand it... But Chancellor, you resorted to this plan for the sake of the Empress, and for the Crimson Kingdom, didn't you?

Chinese: 不要寻死了，和侍主先生好好聊聊吧，凭你和侍主先生的智慧，我也在，还有丘吉尔，一定能找出别的办法来。
English: Calm down and talk to Lord Oracle, please. We can find another way out together.

Chinese: 告诉我，你是怎么取得号令灾兽的力量的？
English: Tell me how you control the Disastrous Beasts.

Chinese: 是年兽吗？
English: Through the Nian Beast?

Chinese: 不过几秒，一股饱含邪念的气息便弥漫到了大殿的每一个角落，而究其源头，似乎正是我面前的碧桂……
English: Just in a few seconds, another evil aura spreads across the hall. The source of it seems to be Emerina...
Ugh!!
Chancellor...?!

Chinese: 秋英两只手用力，继续摁着碧桂，一脸慌张的样子。
English: Looking panic, Autumn Glory tries hard to control Emerina with both hands.

Chinese: 笨蛋，快放开她，她又要变了——？！
English: Let go of her. She's changing again...

English: The Nian Beast possesses Emerina's body and the shrouded secrets of Crimson Kingdom are finally unveiled. Amid the battle, the Bunnic Sentinel undergoes a mysterious transformation...

Chinese: （轻声）唔……走……

Chinese: <size=45>快走！！！它、它要出来了！</size>

Who is it?!

Chinese: 碧桂没有回话，似是气竭一般地低下了头去。

Chinese: 与此同时，整座大殿的邪恶气息突然以碧桂的身体为终点，如洪水般涌动起来。
English: Meanwhile, all the evil aura suddenly floods Emerina.

Chinese: 我、我怎么感觉头晕目眩的？
English: W-Why do I feel dizzy?

Chinese: 侍主先生，这是怎么回事……
English: Lord Oracle, what's going on...

Chinese: ……是年兽吗？
English: Is it the Nian Beast?

Chinese: 呵，真是个没用的女人。……下决心要做坏人的时候，却被人阻止了。
English: Humph, what a useless woman... Allowing people to stop you when you try to do something.

Chinese: 秋英，它是年兽吗……？
English: Autumn Glory, is that the Nian Beast?

Chinese: 是的，它是年兽？！
English: Yes, it is!

Chinese: 年兽，你怎么会提前醒来！？
English: Nian Beast, why do you wake up early?!

Chinese: 我和她做了一场交易。
English: I made a deal with her.

Chinese: 果然。
English: I knew it.

Chinese: ……怎么办……我还没觉醒卯兔之魂……
English: What now... I haven't awakened my Bunnic Soul...

Chinese: 冷静一点，秋英。仔细看，它用的还是碧桂的身体。
English: Calm down, Autumn Glory. Look, it uses Emerina's body.

Chinese: ……呵呵。
English: Haha.

Chinese: 对，侍主先生说的没错。你……你还没出来！
English: Lord Oracle is right. You... you haven't come out!

Chinese: 漂亮。
English: Impressive.

Chinese: 如果不是你，这女人说不定真能做成什么事情。
English: This woman might have accomplished something if it were not for you.

Chinese: 也只是如果，碧桂是怎么和你交易的？她骗了你？
English: But she didn't. What deal did you make? Did she lie to you?

Chinese: 谁知道，我不关心这些事情。
English: Who knows? I don't care.

Chinese: 她是假意臣服，想要借我之手完成圣兽祭，还是真的想要做皇帝，我都不关心。
English: I don't care if she uses me to finish the sacrifice or really wants to be the empress.

Chinese: 我只知道我要大开杀戒……如此一个清除圣兽后裔，并且能有机会进入皇宫亲手斩除麒麟后裔的好机会，我又怎么可能错过。
English: I just want to kill... How would I say no to a great opportunity to kill the Divine Beast offspring and Kirin offspring myself?

Chinese: 你一直在骗丞相……！可是你是怎么做到的？
English: You were deceiving her all along...! But how did you do it?

Chinese: 你们不知道吗？这女人是个书呆子。书呆子最大的问题，便是会轻易地相信古籍。
English: Don't you know? She's a scholar. Scholars trust ancient books easily.

Chinese: 相信这世上存在一个，只要肯豁出命来，便能在一段时间内使用我的力量，而不完全受我控制。
English: She believes that she can use some method to control me for a while without being controlled.

Chinese: 不过，她不是第一个蠢材……真是的，不管过去多少年，永远学不会教训。
English: But she's not the first idiot... Idiots will never learn their lesson.

Chinese: 那么，我也适应这具身体了。异乡人，你们也缓过气了吧？
English: Well, I'm getting used to this body. Outlanders, have you had enough rest?

Chinese: 何不让我们大开杀戒呢？
English: Shall we start killing each other?

Chinese: 丘吉尔，秋英……动手！
English: Churchill, Autumn Glory... Come on!

Chinese: 呵呵呵……
English: Hahaha...

Chinese: 年兽似乎连动都没动一下，举起武器的秋英她们便像是被什么看不见的力量给牵制住了一般，完全动弹不得。
English: The girls, with their weapons held high, seem to be restricted by an invisible force even though the Nian Beast hasn't moved.

Chinese: 唔……身、身体动不了……
English: Ugh... M-My body freezes...
I... Huh!!

Chinese: 该死！
English: Damn it!

Chinese: 对不起，异乡人哟，我跟你们开玩笑的。
English: Excuse me, Outlanders. Just a little joke.

Chinese: 从你们没有生肖之魂，还敢踏足我的面前开始，你们就注定了败亡的命运！
English: You're doomed the moment you try to get near me without the Bunnic Soul.

Chinese: 你做了什么！？
English: What did you do!?

Chinese: 我没有看到年兽做了什么，反应过来的时候，秋英她们便不能行动了。
English: I fail to see through Nian Beast's trick. The moment I realize it, the girls are already stunned.

Chinese: 只有生肖圣卫，或是麒麟先灵能打败年兽，这可是常识。
English: Only the Twelve Sentinels or the Kirin Spirt can defeat the Nian Beast. It's common sense.
I... Move, move!!

Chinese: 我接下来的行程还挺赶的，圣卫们的后裔、麒麟小皇帝，要杀的人可不少。
English: I have a very tight schedule. The offspring of the sentinels, the young Kirin empress... A very long list.

Chinese: 嘛，所谓的一见钟情……虽然是靠外力，不过就是这么一回事吧？
English: Well, love at first sight... though with a bit of help. But, yes.

Chinese: 这时，秋英和飞玉也来到了我身边。
English: Now, Autumn Glory and Jady approach me.

Chinese: ……丘吉尔，你这一箭，后劲好像有点太大了吧…？
English: Churchill, your arrow is perhaps too effective...

Chinese: 一般来说，效果应该没那么惊人的，嘛，反正也不是到永远，再过一段时间就会自己解除的。
English: It doesn't have such a strong effect normally. Well, it will be gone in a while.

Chinese: 罢了，至少现在，事情暂时平息了……？！
English: Whatever. Now, I guess there will be peace for some time...

Chinese: 我话音未落，秋英忽然扑了过来，用力地抱住了被扑倒在地的我。
English: Just then, Autumn Glory springs upon me and hugs me hard as I fall.

Chinese: 太好了，侍主先生……
English: Thank goodness, Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 谢谢你，谢谢你愿意期待我，谢谢你！
English: Thank you for having faith in me! Thank you!

Chinese: 虽然不知道她为什么突然用上这个词，我仍然环抱住她，轻轻地拍抚她的背脊。
English: I don't know why she says so, but I hug her back and pat her back.

Chinese: 因为你是你，所以，我一直都期待着你。
English: Because you are who you are. That is why I have always believed in you.

Chinese: 就这样，这场混乱暂且落下了帷幕。
English: Just like this, the chaos ends for now.

Chinese: （鼓励她）
English: (Encourage her)

Chinese: 我相信你。
English: I believe in you.

Chinese: ……明明才刚认识……不，已经不算了，对吧？
English: But we've only just met... No, that's not it anymore, is it?

Chinese: 哪来的陈年旧词呀。
English: Oh, clichés.
