Chinese: 第十八节 波斯菊
English: EP 18: Calliopsis

Chinese: 风波终于平息，连接米伦的通道再次打开，在好好游玩了一次万枝城后，侍主三人决定踏上归乡之路，秋英也做出了自己的选择……
English: Peace returns at last. The path back to Mirren reopens. After one final journey through Multilitchi, the trio sets out for home and Autumn Glory makes a decision of her own.

Chinese: 清晨的阳光透过窗户打在了被褥上，温暖和煦，让人很不想起床。
English: The morning sunshine casts streams through the window to the bed. The warmth makes me reluctant to get up.

Chinese: 足足睡了十多个小时之后，身体似乎变得轻松了许多，御膳房的那些药膳，还真是有点功效，要是能引入一些去米伦那就太好了。
English: After sleeping for over a dozen hours, I feel light. The herb cuisines of the imperial kitchen work magic. I should introduce it to Mirren.

Chinese: 隐约间，我好像闻到了一股熟悉的味道，一边的被褥好像也有一些轻微的起伏，我突然有了种不太好的预感，机械般地转过头看去……
English: Vaguely, I thought I smelled a familiar scent. There also seemed to be a slight stirring in the bedding beside me. I suddenly had a bad feeling and turned my head to look...

Chinese: 果然，秋英正面朝着我，静静地侧卧在床的另一边，小嘴张开了一个小口，胸腹伴随着匀速的呼吸微微起伏。
English: Just as I expected. Autumn Glory was lying quietly on her side on the other half of the bed, facing me. Her mouth was slightly agape, her chest rising and falling gently with the rhythm of her breathing.

Chinese: 一头漂亮的长发，散发着让人欲罢不能的清香。
English: Her beautiful long hair is giving out an attractive fragrance.

Chinese: 似是感觉到了我的目光，她，缓缓地睁开了眼睛。
English: As if sensing my gaze, she slowly opened her eyes.

Chinese: 呀~侍主先生，您醒啦~~
English: Aw, Lord Oracle. You're awake.

Chinese: 秋英，你怎么会在、在我的床上？
English: Autumn Glory, what are you doing on my bed?

Chinese: 当、当然是因为，胡萝卜……！
English: F-For carrots!

Chinese: 胡萝卜？
English: Carrots?

Chinese: ……对，胡萝卜！
English: Yes, carrots!

Chinese: 我大概需要重新认得一下“胡萝卜”这三个字的含义。
English: Let's redefine the word "carrot".

Chinese: 饲主先生，你起来了吗？我到处都找不到秋……
English: Lord Oracle, are you awake? I can't find Autumn...

Chinese: 诶——！！！秋英？！侍主先生，你、你怎么可以…？！
English: Huh!!! Autumn Glory?! Lord Oracle, how could you...

Chinese: 世上总是会碰上许多巧合，比如波斯菊偏偏会在这个时候冲进了屋子，而这样的巧合，大多都会比较尴尬。
English: You always run into coincidences in this world. For instance, Calliopsis bursting into the room at this exact moment. And such coincidences are, for the most part, rather awkward.

Chinese: 不、不对，在饲主先生身上发生这样的事好像也没什么不正常……
English: N-Never mind. It's nothing unusual if it's Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 可是……嗯！我们不一样，就算被看光光，看的也不是我，对，就是这样！
English: But... Emm! We're different. It's not me who is seen naked. Yep, that's it!

Chinese: 你究竟在那里碎碎念些什么呀……？
English: What are you mumbling about?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 一场误会之后，我们谢绝了宫里的早点，按先前所约定的那样来到了万枝城的街道上，在回米伦之前，必须好好地逛一逛这里的集市。
English: After the misunderstanding, we reject breakfast in the palace and go to the market in Multilitchi as planned to have a little tour before going back to Mirren.

Chinese: 哇，真是太好吃了！秋英秋英，这是什么呀？
English: Wow, this is delicious! What's this, Autumn Glory?

Chinese: 海棠糕，万枝城最有人气的糕点之一……啊！侍主先生，小心烫！
English: Begonia cake, one of the most popular pastries in Multilitchi... Ah! Careful, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 好烫！！
English: It burns!!

Chinese: 唔，还是说晚了一步……
English: Ugh, still too late...

Chinese: （咀嚼）嗯，不过很好吃！
English: *Chews* Yep, but it's tasty!

Chinese: 真的耶，我要买它几百个带回米伦！
English: It really is. I'll buy hundreds of them and carry them to Mirren!

Chinese: 咦？你有钱吗？
English: Huh? Do you have the money?

Chinese: 不是还有秋英在吗？
English: I have Autumn Glory.

Chinese: 唔，你、你到底是天使还是魔鬼……
English: Huh, are you an angel or a devil...

Chinese: 饲主先生、丘吉尔，你们怎么这么慢呀，快过来一起玩嘛~
English: Lord Oracle, Churchill, you're slow. Come over here.

Chinese: 好吃的可不等人哟~
English: Food waits for no one.

Chinese: 是你们两个跑得太快了吧……
English: You run too fast...

Chinese: 丘吉尔，你怎么也走那么慢？
English: Churchill, why are you walking so slowly?

Chinese: 好像吃得太急了，肚子有点痛痛……虽然有点不甘心，但还是让她们先去玩吧。
English: I ate too fast and have an upset stomach... Though reluctant, I'd just leave them to themselves.

Chinese: 而且，她们俩走在一起的画面，侍主大人，您不觉得很美吗？
English: And don't you think they make a beautiful scene walking together?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 怎么样？上次没吃成的糖葫芦，好吃吗？
English: How does it look? I wonder if the sugarcoated haws taste good.

Chinese: 好吃！酸酸甜甜的，就是不知道有没有糖胡萝卜。
English: Delicious! They're sweet and sour. I wonder if there are sugarcoated carrots.

Chinese: 对耶，好主意，一定会很受欢迎！
English: Yes, good idea. They'll be popular!

Chinese: 咦？这是什么呀，像果冻一样，但黑乎乎的……
English: Huh? What's this? It's like jelly but it's black...

Chinese: 是龟苓膏啦，味道有些偏苦，但如果加上一些蜂蜜就会好吃很多。
English: It's herbal jelly. It tastes bitter but you'll love it with some honey.

Chinese: 老板，请给我来一份！谢谢~~
English: Sir, one serving of this please! Thank you~

Chinese: 唔！好吃！
English: Hmm! Delicious!

Chinese: 哎呀，蜂蜜加得太多了啦……
English: Aw, you added way too much honey...

Chinese: 那栋“龙凤楼”是干什么的呀，看起来好气派，但好像没开门？
English: What's that "Phoenix Hall"? The decoration is impressive. But is it closed?

Chinese: 呃……那是、是一家只有晚上才开的店，唔…总之你还是不要知道比较好。
English: Emm... T-That's something open for business only during the night. You'd better not ask more.

Chinese: 神神秘秘的……
English: So secretive...

Chinese: 诶？那边围了好多人，他们在干什么呀？
English: Huh? What are those people over there doing?

Chinese: 应该是捏面人的手艺人来了，要不要过去看看？
English: I guess the dough figurine man is there. Shall we have a look?

Chinese: 捏面人？
English: Dough figurine?

Chinese: 红簌国的传统手艺，可以用面团捏成任何的造型，只是快要失传了……
English: It's a traditional art craft of the Crimson Kingdom. They make dough into anything. But it's almost lost...

Chinese: 什么都能捏吗？那我要让他捏个饲主先生。
English: Literally anything? I'd have a Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 这个主意不错，走！
English: Good idea. Let's go!

Chinese: 好耶！！
English: Yeah!!

Chinese: 的确，眼前的两位波斯菊，在红叶纷飞的万枝城街头，是任谁都会忍不住多看一眼的两抹异色，或许，应该说是“一抹”吧……
English: The two of them make a beautiful scene in Multilitchi where red autumn leaves fall. Anyone would want to watch more...

Chinese: 丘吉尔是对的，如此美好的气氛，谁能忍心去打破呢？
English: Churchill is right. Who would break such a wonderful atmosphere?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 正午时分，我和秋英坐在街边的长凳上，看着波斯菊和丘吉尔在不远处的摊位前玩射气球的游戏。
English: At noon, Autumn Glory and I sit on a bench down the street and watch Calliopsis and Churchill play at a shooting booth.

Chinese: 她们玩得很愉快，但摊位的老板可能不这么想。
English: They are having great fun. But the booth owner is not.

Chinese: 嘿嘿，又是全中呢，好厉害。
English: Hehe, a perfect score again. How impressive.

Chinese: 这不是必然的结果吗？我都有点心疼那个老板了。
English: Isn't that a sure thing? I start to feel pity for the booth owner.

Chinese: 明天他可能就会换一个游戏的吧……
English: Perhaps he'll change his game tomorrow...

Chinese: 有点好奇，不过，明天的这时候，我们大概也已经不在这里了吧？
English: I'm curious. But we probably won't be here tomorrow.

Chinese: …………侍主先生……
English: Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 我知道你想说什么，关于这件事，我不会给你任何压力。
English: I know what you're going to say. I won't give you pressure.

Chinese: 其、其实，我已经和陛下说了，说“我想去和您一起去米伦”……
English: In fact... I've told Her Majesty that I want to go to Mirren with you...

Chinese: 你是红簌国的卯兔圣卫，肩负着对抗年兽的责任，她应该不会答应吧。
English: You're the Bunnic Sentinel of the Crimson Kingdom. I guess she won't let you go.

Chinese: 不，陛下她…恩准了。
English: In fact, she approved it.
...Huh?

Chinese: 似乎是碧桂大人对陛下说过些什么，陛下决定不再依赖圣卫的力量，给予禁军更多的信任，还说如果有必要的话，她自己也会参战。
English: Lady Emerina talked to Her Majesty and somehow Her Majesty decided not to rely too much on the Twelve Sentinels. She planned to trust the imperial guards and join battles herself if it's necessary.

Chinese: 皇帝亲征？那的确会大大激发将士们的战意，是个了不起的小皇帝呢。
English: Fighting in person? That will definitely boost the morale. What a great young empress.

Chinese: 不过，她不是体弱多病吗？真的上了战场，能行吗？
English: But isn't she a feeble girl? Can she really make it to the battlefield?

Chinese: 侍主先生有所不知，其实麒麟裔的力量，是不亚于十二圣卫的。
English: You should know that the power of Kirin offspring is no less than that of the Twelve Sentinels.

Chinese: 只是因为麒麟裔数量极其稀少，先帝驾崩之后，全国上下也就最后3个麒麟裔了——圣上、太上皇和公主。
English: It's just that the Kirin-kin are exceptionally rare. After the previous Emperor passed away, there are only three of them left, including Her Majesty, her mother, and the princess.

Chinese: 是吗……那一般来说是不能冒险的吧。
English: Really... Then I guess you won't let her take any risk.

Chinese: 嗯，朝臣们也是一样的想法，不想让陛下亲征……
English: Yes, that's what the officials think. They won't let her fight...

Chinese: 对了——
English: Speaking of which...

Chinese: 嗫！侍主先生，圣卫大人，总算找到你们了！
English: Hey! Lord Oracle, Lord Sentinel, you're here!

Chinese: 飞玉的突然出现，打断了我的说话，不过看她兴冲冲的样子，我拜托她的那件事，应该是有了进展。
English: Jady suddenly appears and interrupts us. Judging by her expression, she has made progress.

Chinese: 飞玉，希望你带来了好消息。
English: Jady, do you have good news for me?

Chinese: 嗯！出现了！侍主先生提过的那个“门”，真的出现了！！
English: OK! It's here! The portal you mentioned. It appears!!

Chinese: 还是抽屉吗？
English: In a drawer?

Chinese: 不，是衣柜！
English: No, the closet!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我们回到了正在修缮中的卯兔宫，秋英的卧房内，打开着的衣柜里，似曾相识的空间替代了里面本来的模样。
English: We go back to the Bunnic Palace which is still under repair. The open closet in Autumn Glory's room shows the familiar portal.

Chinese: 明明只过了不到一个礼拜，但感觉上次看到这幅场面，已经是很久前的事了……
English: It's only been less than a week, but it feels like a long time since we saw it last time...

Chinese: 毕竟，这几天，我们经历了很多事。
English: After all, we've been through a lot these days.

Chinese: 就要和这里说再见了呢，唔，还没吃够。
English: I should say goodbye. Oh, I still want to eat more.

Chinese: 啊，我忘了买100个海棠糕了！
English: Argh, I forgot to buy 100 begonia cakes!

Chinese: 诶！原来你是认真的吗？
English: Huh! Are you serious?

Chinese: 凡事总有分别之时，留点遗憾也未必不是一种美好，我们走吧。
English: All good things come to an end. It's romantic to leave a regret. Let's go.

Chinese: 对了，还没告诉过你们，秋英也会跟我们一起走。
English: By the way, Autumn Glory will be going with us.

Chinese: 呜哇！真的吗？
English: Waah! Really?

Chinese: 那么惊讶干什么呀，这不是理所当然的事吗？
English: Easy, girl. It's something natural.

Chinese: 以后，就请两位多多关照啦。
English: Looking forward to my new life with you!

Chinese: 偷偷告诉你，回去之后，你就会知道什么叫做“修罗场”了。
English: You know what? You'll see the real war of jealousy.

Chinese: 咦？修罗场？
English: Huh? A war of jealousy?

Chinese: 丘吉尔，你少说几句也是没有关系的！
English: Churchill, you talk too much!

Chinese: 然后，飞玉，这应该是第二次和你道别了。
English: Jady, it's my second time to say goodbye to you.

Chinese: 嗫嘿嘿，是呢，不过我一点都不会伤感，我相信我们还会再见面的！
English: Hehe, yes. But I don't feel sad. I believe we will meet again!

Chinese: 明明上一次还一脸的感伤。
English: You were sad as hell last time.

Chinese: 上次之所以叫上次，就因为它是上次嗫。
English: The last time is called so because it's the past.

Chinese: 好像听懂了，但又好像什么都没懂……
English: Makes sense, though I don't really get your point...

Chinese: 谢谢你，飞玉，昨天能得到你的援助，真是太好了。
English: Thank you, Jady, for your assistance yesterday.

Chinese: 哪儿的话嗫？
English: Oh, come on.

Chinese: 侍主大人，侍主大人，你看……
English: Lord Oracle! Lord Oracle, look...

Chinese: 丘吉尔捂着嘴笑着，示意我看向卯兔宫大门的方向。
English: Churchill giggles as she covers her mouth with a hand, signaling me to look at the hall gate.

Chinese: 唔！
English: Hmm!

Chinese: 当我看向大门时，一个身影像受了惊似的，立刻缩回阴影之中。
English: As soon as I turn to look, a figure shrinks back to the shadow in panic.

Chinese: 此情无计可消除~才下眉头~又上心头~~
English: Love cannot be killed. It thrives in eyes, in hearts fulfilled.

Chinese: 你从哪儿学的这种乱七八糟的句子？
English: Where did you learn those words?

Chinese: 红簌国的诗呀，这不是很好听吗？
English: It's a poem of the Crimson Kingdom. Isn't it romantic?

Chinese: 还有一句哦，“唯将终夜长开眼，报答平生未展眉——”
English: Here's another one. "Sleepless nights are all you gain, from unrequited love's deep pain."

Chinese: 什么意思？
English: What do you mean?

Chinese: 您惹太多桃花债，睡觉就要两只眼睛轮流站岗的意思。
English: That means you have to sleep with your eyes open for all the hearts you broke.

Chinese: ……飞玉，道别就到这里为止吧，虽然的确还有很多想说的话。
English: Jady, I think that's it, though I do have a lot to tell you.

Chinese: 没关系，侍主先生可以留到下次再说。
English: It's OK. We can wait till we meet again.

Chinese: 那我先！
English: I'll be the first!

Chinese: 诶，等等我——
English: Ugh, wait...

Chinese: 丘吉尔和波斯菊先后跳进了衣柜，秋英准备跟上的时候，我突然想起了那句被飞玉打断的话，撑着衣柜边缘停下。
English: Churchill and Calliopsis jump into the closet one after another. Autumn Glory is about to follow them when I think of my words cut short by Jady and stop.

Chinese: 对了，秋英，欢……
English: Autumn Glory, well...

Chinese: 啊啊啊侍主先生怎么突然停下了！
English: Ahhhh, why do you pause?!

Chinese: 呃！
English: Ugh!

Chinese: 秋英结结实实地撞在我的背上，把我砸进了衣柜里。
English: Autumn Glory falls on my back and knocks me into the closet.

Chinese: 没想到，红簌国的旅程，最终竟结束得如此……但转念一想，一切的开头，似乎也是这般……
English: I didn't know this trip would end like this... But thinking twice, the beginning of it is nothing different...

Chinese: 总之，再见了，红簌国。
English: Anyway, goodbye, Crimson Kingdom.

English: Jady

English: Epilogue: Love Verse

Chinese: 回到米伦的侍主在与牧的交谈中发现了惊人的事实——太一这个世界，似乎正被某种异样所笼罩；同时，辰龙卫苏醒，回到了红簌宫……
English: Back in Mirren, Lord Oracle talks to Muu and finds the world of Taeuno may be under a creeping shadow. And far away, the Drago Sentinel awakens and returns to the Crimson Kingdom Palace...

Chinese: 睡了几天硬邦邦的木床，还是神谕司的床更加舒服一些。
English: The bed at the Oracle Division feels much better than the hard one I slept these days.

Chinese: 虽然在红簌国度过了整整六天的时间，但回来后却发现，太一的六天，却仅仅是米伦的两天，时间流动这个东西，实在太难琢磨。
English: After six whole days in the Crimson Kingdom of Taeuno, I find it has only been two days in Mirren. Time is complicated.

Chinese: 饲主，您醒了呀~
English: Master, you're awake!

Chinese: 是牧呀？醒是醒了，但总感觉身体还没有恢复到最佳的状态。
English: Muu, it's you. I am, but I do need time to recover.

Chinese: 饲主如果打算睡回笼觉，要我陪你也不是不可以哦。
English: I can do it with you if you want more sleep.

Chinese: 别闹！
English: Don't be ridiculous.

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊适应得怎么样了？
English: How's Outlander Calli?

Chinese: 除了抱怨床有点太软了，其他好像也没什么。
English: She's good, except for complaining about the soft bed.

Chinese: 好多星痕都围着她问东问西呢，毕竟一个神谕司里有两个波斯菊，不管怎么想都还是蛮奇妙的。
English: Asters are asking her questions. After all, two Calliopsises at the Oracle Division is something absurd.

Chinese: 等新鲜劲过了，应该就会好些了。
English: They'll get used to it.

Chinese: 不过，“异邦波斯菊”这个名字，饲主真的不再考虑一下？挺拗口的。
English: But are you going to continue with the name "Outlander Calli"? It's a real tongue-twister.

Chinese: 我也想过继续叫她秋英，但她说那是红簌国的名字，不想带到米伦来……
English: I wanted to call her Autumn Glory but she wouldn't bring that name to Mirren...

Chinese: 在想到更合适的名字之前，就先这么叫着吧。
English: Let's just call her that before we think of a better name.

Chinese: 反正，星痕们大多都管她叫“波波”，饲主可以借鉴一下？
English: Asters call her "Calli". How about that?

Chinese: 感觉好奇怪，但也不是不行……
English: Sounds strange, but maybe...

Chinese: 对了，拜托你的事，怎么样了？
English: Aw, how about the thing I asked you?

Chinese: 嘻嘻，牧就是为这个来的，饲主拜托的，我已经查过了。
English: Hehe, that's why I'm here. I've done my homework.

Chinese: 那个丞相提到的大司命，在东方的语境里，指的很可能是掌管命运的人。
English: The Grand Arbiter of Fate might be someone in charge of destiny in the Eastern world.

Chinese: 命运星灵……伊茉拉？
English: Like Imora... the Wraith of Destiny?

Chinese: 如果真是她的话，异邦的波斯菊之所以会诞生，就很好解释了。
English: If it's her, the existence of Outlander Calli can be explained.

Chinese: 伊茉拉尊重命运，莉莉娅召唤波斯菊，在她看来，就是波斯菊的命数，也是被吸入太一的那个波斯菊的命数，所以，她才顺应召唤，诞生了。
English: Imora respected fate and Lillia summoned Calliopsis. In her eyes, it's destiny for Calliopsis and the Calliopsis in Taeuno. So, that's how she came to the world.

Chinese: 有道理，应该解释得通。
English: Makes sense.

Chinese: 饲主交代的另一件事，我也查到了，波斯菊是莉莉娅在1800年前召唤的。
English: For another, I found that Calliopsis was summoned by Lillia 1,800 years ago.

Chinese: 1800年吗？也就是太一的5400年了，看来卯兔先灵们说得没错……
English: 1,800 years ago? That's 5,400 years in Taeuno. Looks like the Bunnic Spirits are right...

Chinese: 看饲主的脸色，还像是有什么问题？
English: The look on your face says something is wrong.

Chinese: 明明应该过去了5400，怎么在异邦波斯菊这里，却变成132年？
English: It should be 5,400 years but why did Outlander Calli say it's 132 years?

Chinese: 足足5268年的缺口，这是怎么一回事？
English: Why is there such a large gap?

Chinese: 会不会是那些先灵记错了呢？
English: Did the spirits remember it wrong?

Chinese: 不像，在我看来，她们可比异邦波斯菊靠谱许多，但异邦波斯菊毕竟是活在当下的星痕，自己过了多少年，显然也不会弄错。
English: I don't think so. They are more reliable than the bunny. But Outlander Calli is a living Aster, she can't be wrong about her age.

Chinese: 那我就不明白了，如果两边都没错，那这5268年去哪了呢？
English: I don't get it. If both of them are right. Where is the 5,268 years?

Chinese: 大概只有一种假设可以解释，但希望是我猜错了，不然，太一可能正陷在一个不得了的问题里。
English: I have a theory but I hope it's wrong. Or else Taeuno is in huge trouble.

Chinese: 饲主就别卖关子了，快说嘛。
English: Come on, just tell me.

Chinese: 太一的时间，可能正在以某个数字为节点，循环往复着……
English: The time in Taeuno is running in a loop...

Chinese: 饲主的意思是……轮回？！
English: Do you mean.. a cycle?!

Chinese: 看来，太一的故事，还远远没有结束……
English: Looks like the story of Taeuno isn't over...

Chinese: none
English: None
Bang!!!

Chinese: 嗫？怎么回事，地震了吗？
English: Hmm? What's going on? An earthquake?

Chinese: 天被染成了红色？
English: Why is the sky red?

Chinese: 嗫……是什么凶兆？
English: Ugh... What does it mean?

Chinese: 那个方向是？
English: That direction...

Chinese: 是辰龙宫？嗫！莫非刚才的声响……
English: The Drago Palace? Hey! Is that sound...

Chinese: 君为何故入梦来，此去无期长相别。
English: Why do you come into my dream, when our farewell knows no end, it seems?

Chinese: 心月涟涟雨难歇，可有来日系红结。
English: My heart ripples like the moon in rain. Will fate reunite us once again?

Chinese: 清醒梦
English: Lucid Dream

Chinese: 追忆者
English: Recollector

Chinese: 水塘花
English: Pond Flower

Chinese: 夜柳
English: Night Willow

Chinese: 烛泪
English: Candle Tears

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 办公室
English: Office

Chinese: 魔女
English: Nova

Chinese: 昔莱
English: Shillae

Chinese: 马恩
English: Mann

Chinese: 律
English: Ritsu

Chinese: 克萝萝
English: Kuroro

Chinese: 牧
English: Muu

Chinese: 清醒梦
English: Lucid Dream

Chinese: 昔菈？昔莱？反正是位强大的恶魔……
English: Shila? Or Shillae? Whatever, she is a powerful Demon...

Chinese: 阿嚏！
English: A-choo!

Chinese: 我打了个喷嚏。前些天刚刚下过了雨。天晴之后，屋内多了几丝寒意。
English: I sneeze. It rained a few days ago. Now, the sky's cleared, as a chill lingers.

Chinese: 请您披上吧。
English: Please, take this.

Chinese: 我盖上毯子，接过马恩递过来的手炉和热茶。
English: I drape the blanket over myself, accepting the hand warmer and hot tea from Mann.

Chinese: 被丢到桌子上的笔滚了滚，在碰到那一叠文件时停下了。
English: A pen rolls across the desk, coming to rest against a stack of papers.

Chinese: 这是昨天的文件，只要在律来之前批阅完就好——这是从律那里得到的一点儿“好处”。
English: These came yesterday. I just need to review them before Ritsu arrives—a small perk I get from her.

Chinese: （不过，批阅文件啊。）
English: (Still, document review, huh.)

Chinese: 工作是永远做不完的——在诸如拯救世界、捍卫正义等激情消退之后，总会清醒地感受到这一点。我叹了口气，看向窗外。
English: Work never ends—this realization hits hard once the thrill of saving the world or defending justice fades. I sigh, gazing out the window.

Chinese: 咦？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 那个绿色的身影正向神谕司走过来。
English: Someone in green approaches the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 她抱着一摞高过头顶的文件，文件有时会晃动着，但她只要稍微调整一下姿势，那摞文件便奇异地恢复了平衡。
English: A towering stack of files wobble occasionally on her head, but with a slight adjustment, she miraculously rebalances them.

Chinese: 咦，你披上毯子了……
English: Oh, you've got a blanket...

Chinese: 你抱着的是今天的文件吗？拿过来吧。我早点改完，也能早点休息。
English: Are those new documents for the day? Bring them here. If I finish early, I can rest sooner.

Chinese: 什么今天的，这些只是上午的……
English: Today? These are just from this morning...

Chinese: 看你抱着毯子的样子……上午的活儿，就交给我吧。
English: Look at you, bundled up like that... I'll handle this morning's work.

Chinese: 啊，这真的好吗？
English: Ah, are you sure that's okay?

Chinese: 我毫不掩饰嘴角的笑意。律撇撇嘴，过来摸了一下我的额头。
English: I don't hide my smile. Ritsu smirks, coming over to touch my forehead.

Chinese: 也没发烧嘛……
English: Luckily you don't have a fever...

Chinese: 我先说好，文件可以我做，最后你过一遍就行了——今天的日程有召唤星痕，这件事没你可不行！
English: I can handle the documents for you to give a final check. Yet as the Aster summoning part, we can't do that without you!

Chinese: 这么快就又要召唤星痕了？
English: We're summoning Aster again so soon?

Chinese: 想起上次塞蕾丝蒂娜和瑞比娅搞出的大动静，我捂住了脸。
English: Recalling the chaos Celestina and Reybia caused, I bury my face in my hands.

Chinese: 有没有那种乖乖的星痕？很安静，很善良，很善解人意，很贴心——
English: Are there any well-behaved Aster? Quiet, kind, understanding, and considerate—

Chinese: <size=40>哼！</size>
English: <size=40>Hmph!</size>

Chinese: 啊，你知道的，那些星痕总让我头疼……每次面对新的星痕都要带着点儿勇气……
English: You know, those Asters always give me a headache... Summoning a new one requires a bit of courage...

Chinese: 那你弄完了叫我，我去躺一会儿。
English: Call me when you're done. I need to lie down for a bit.

Chinese: 我抱着手炉站起来，到旁边的沙发上躺下了。
English: I get up with the hand warmer and flop onto a nearby couch.

Chinese: 大懒虫……算了算了，睡你的吧。
English: You lazybones... Fine, go ahead and sleep.

Chinese: 律总是能恰到好处的满足我的一些小任性。我舒服地绷直了身体，然后瘫软下来。
English: Ritsu always knows how to indulge my little whims. I stretch out comfortably, then relax into the couch.

Chinese: 一股自然的疲惫从后颈散开。书页翻动着，笔尖划过纸张，窗帘偶尔被吹起——我就这样睡着了。
English: A wave of exhaustion spreads from my neck. With the sound of turning pages, scratching pens, and fluttering curtains, I drift off to sleep.

Chinese: 别睡啦——
English: Wake up—

Chinese: 都下午啦！
English: It's already afternoon!

Chinese: （可是……好困。）
English: (But... I'm still sleepy.)

Chinese: 我揉着眼睛，依稀看清了面前的人。
English: I rub my eyes as I make out the figure before me.

Chinese: 啊，律……
English: Oh, it's Ritsu...

Chinese: 走啦走啦，召唤室那边都在问了！要是她们休息了，我又得去找审判长解释……
English: Come on! They're looking for you in the summoning room! If they take a break, I'll have to explain to Lord Inquisitor again...
Oh...

Chinese: 你这家伙！算了……
English: You... Fine…

Chinese: 她拉起我的手，我闭着眼，任她牵引着我，向外走去。
English: She grabs my hand. Eyes closed, I let her guide me out.

Chinese: 睁开眼
English: Open eyes.

Chinese: 清醒一点！
English: Wake up!

Chinese: 她好像在揉我的脸。手凉丝丝的，但脸上传来的感觉又让人想继续睡下去。
English: She seems to be rubbing my face. Her hands are cool, but the sensation makes me want to keep sleeping.

Chinese: 我抓住她的双手，敷在眼睛上。那股凉意瞬间透过眼睛，让人打了个激灵。
English: I press her hands against my eyes. The coolness pierces through, jolting me awake.

Chinese: 我睁开眼，已经是在召唤室里了。值班的魔女愣愣地看着我和律。或许是被盯得不自在，律抽回了手。
English: I open my eyes to find myself in the summoning room. The Nova on duty stares at Ritsu and me, dumbfounded. Ritsu yanks her hand back, likely feeling uncomfortable under the stare.

Chinese: 干什么呀……还有人呢！
English: Stop it... it's embarrassing!

Chinese: 她接过那位魔女手中的托盘，递了过来。盘中的绸缎上摆放着小堆的星痕结晶。
English: She takes the tray from the Nova and hands it to me. A small pile of Aster Crystals sits on the satin.

Chinese: 喏，准备好了没？
English: Well, are you ready?

Chinese: 希望快点儿结束……可能是真的感冒了，怎么睡都睡不够。
English: I hope this ends quickly... I might really catch a cold, always so sleepy.

Chinese: 怎么快嘛……星痕总得先和我建立契约吧？
English: How can it be quick? The Aster needs to form a contract first, right?

Chinese: 你之前不是说，想让星痕能自由活动，所以和我建立契约之后还要解除召唤，你再重新召唤一遍……
English: Didn't you say you wanted the Aster to have freedom? So after they contract with me, you need to release and re-summon them...

Chinese: 为了星痕们的幸福，我只好牺牲一下了。
English: For the Asters' happiness, I'll just have to make a sacrifice.

Chinese: 那……我替她们谢谢你？
English: So... should I thank you on their behalf?

Chinese: 律一脸无语地看着我。
English: Ritsu stares at me.

Chinese: 快洗脸，洗完脸就上！
English: Hurry up, let's get started!

Chinese: 她掏出手绢，用水魔法打湿，使劲搓着我的脸。
English: She pulls out a handkerchief, wets it with water magic, and scrubs my face vigorously.

Chinese: 我……我早上洗了！
English: I... I washed this morning!

Chinese: 早上的不管用！审判长的《天之扉实录》里可是说了，主神有召唤前洁面的习惯！
English: That doesn't count now! Lord Inquisitor's Facts of the Gate of Heaven says Lord God always washes face before summoning!

Chinese: 是召唤前哦，早上的肯定不行。
English: It's right BEFORE summoning.

Chinese: ……这能管用吗？
English: Will this really work?

Chinese: 肯定有用的！
English: It'll definitely work!

Chinese: 她又仔细帮我擦干净双手。虽然不觉得会有什么用，但是水分挥发的凉感倒让我清醒了许多。
English: She meticulously cleans my hands. The cool sensation of evaporating water doesn't seem useful, but it certainly wakes me up.

Chinese: 加油呀，[var=Actor]！争取一次就成功！
English: You've got this, [var=Actor]! Nail it on the first try!

Chinese: 我耸了耸肩，拿起了星魂结晶。
English: I shrug and pick up a Mana Crystal.

Chinese: 诶？这股气息……是新的星痕吗？
English: Huh? This aura... is it a new Aster?

Chinese: 好强大……
English: So powerful...

Chinese: 光芒中，陌生的星痕出现了。她像是被光芒刺痛了眼睛，用手掌遮着阳光，皱着眉，背后的骨翼也蜷缩着。
English: A strange Aster materializes in the glow. She squints, shielding her eyes with her hand. Her brow furrows, and her skeletal wings curl up.

Chinese: 哇，穿得这么清凉……
English: Wow, she's barely dressed...

Chinese: 律缩在我身后，小声念叨着。她的双手搭着我的肩膀，打量着这位星痕。
English: Ritsu whispers behind me. Her hands rest on my shoulders as she sizes up the Aster.

Chinese: 你好，这位小姐。我是[var=Actor]，神谕司的司主。这位是律，神谕司的魔女。
English: Hello, miss. I'm [var=Actor], head of the Oracle Division. This is Ritsu, a Nova of the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 你好呀！
English: Hi there!

Chinese: 律探出头打了个招呼，又缩回我身后了。
English: Ritsu peeks out to greet her, then ducks back behind me.

Chinese: 你……你们好……
English: G-greetings... you two...

Chinese: 不好意思，不知道为什么，我有点头疼……
English: Sorry, I don't know why, but my head's aching...

Chinese: 什么东西……星痕？我是星痕？嘶……
English: What's an... Aster? Am I an Aster? Hiss...

Chinese: 啊，我死啦？
English: Am I... dead?

Chinese: 还能想起自己的名字吗？
English: Can you recall your name?
Hmm...

Chinese: ……你先休息。律，拿《米伦通史》来。
English: You should rest for now. Ritsu, fetch The History of Mirren for me.

Chinese: 噢，好！
English: Right away!

Chinese: 律从一旁的置物架上取下一本又重又厚的书，递了过来。
English: Ritsu grabs a hefty tome from a nearby shelf and hands it over.

Chinese: 来吧，我们换个地方说。
English: Let's continue this chat elsewhere.

Chinese: 我笑着做了一个请的手势，那位星痕迟疑了一下，然后点了点头。
English: I gesture invitingly. The Aster hesitates before nodding.

Chinese: 这个……不像。
English: This one... doesn't look like her.

Chinese: 这个……也不是。
English: This one... isn't her either.

Chinese: 诶，这个……？
English: Wait, could it be this one...?

Chinese: 《米伦通史》里的每个人物都用简笔画描绘了大致的形体特征和容貌，律正一边翻阅，一边比对着。
English: The History of Mirren contains simple sketches of each great figure, showing their features. Ritsu flips through, comparing each one.

Chinese: 卫尔斯特，四翼天使……昔菈？
English: Werth Angel, four wings... Shillae?

Chinese: 好像是？不过……似乎很久没人这么叫我了……
English: It seems to be me. But... it feels like ages since anyone's called me that...

Chinese: 我看看人物生平……“禁忌之轮事件后消失，推测与霍洛韦尔家族缔造者昔莱有密切的关联……”
English: "...vanished after the Taboo and Betrayal, suspected to have close ties with Shillae, founder of the Holowells..."

Chinese: 往后翻，昔莱在《上古之战》那一卷的前篇。
English: Flip further back. Shillae is in the earlier part of the Ancient War volume.

Chinese: 哦……哎！对上了对上了！昔莱——霍洛韦尔家族的领袖，最强大的恶魔……哇，你可真是位大人物！
English: Hey! I found her! Shillae, leader of the Holowells, the most powerful demon... Wow, you're quite the big shot!

Chinese: 昔……莱？
English: Shi...llae?
Ah!

Chinese: 她掰了掰头上的角，又拍了拍脑袋，头很痛的样子。
English: She clutches her horns and rubs her head, wincing in pain.

Chinese: 好像想起来了一些，就是有点儿乱……
English: I think I remember some things, but it's all jumbled...

Chinese: 我应该是在深渊才对……这里是哪？
English: I should be in the Abyss... Where am I?

Chinese: 这里是希瑞安大陆的中心，米德加尔城。
English: This is Midgard City, the heart of Ciaran.

Chinese: 我接过律手中的《米伦通史》，一边浏览昔莱的档案，一边向她解释。
English: I take the book from Ritsu, scanning Shillae's file as I explain.

Chinese: 从你……从你消失的那个时代开始算，已经过去了差不多八九万年了。这中间发生了很多事，一时半会儿怕是讲不清楚。
English: From when you vanished... it's been about eighty to ninety thousand years. A lot's happened. We can't sum up soon.

Chinese: 多少？<size=45>八九万年？！</size>
English: How long? <size=45>Eighty to ninety thousand years?!</size>

Chinese: 她挠了挠头上最长的那根角，瞪大眼睛看着我。
English: She scratches her longest horn, eyes wide with disbelief.

Chinese: 以第四纪元的时间来计算的话，确实是这样。
English: That's correct, in the time of Era of Eternal Flame.
Hiss...

Chinese: 都过去这么久了，这下可麻烦了……
English: So long... This is a trouble...

Chinese: 我必须，我必须得……
English: I need to... I have to...

Chinese: 有什么能帮到你的吗？
English: Is there anything I can do to help?

Chinese: 啊，可以吗？
English: Oh, can you?

Chinese: 当然，只要我做得到。
English: Of course, if it's within my power.

Chinese: 刚召唤出的星痕基本都不会讨厌我。在这种时候给予一些帮助，往往能够收获更多好感。
English: Newly summoned Asters rarely dislike me. Offering help now often builds goodwill.

Chinese: 那……有吃的吗？
English: Well... Do you have any food?
Huh?

Chinese: 诶，没有吗？什么吃的都可以……
English: Oh, you don't? Anything will do...

Chinese: 她的眼睛转来转去，盯上了我桌上的星魂结晶。
English: Her eyes dart around, landing on the Mana Crystals on my desk.

Chinese: 这个……是糖果吗？可以吃吗？
English: Is this... candy? Can I eat it?

Chinese: 这个不行……马恩——
English: That's not... Mann—

Chinese: 在。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 去弄点儿吃的。
English: Get some food.

Chinese: 好，您有忌口吗？
English: Sure. Any dietary restrictions?

Chinese: 忌口？那是什么？
English: Dietary restrictions? What's that?

Chinese: ……就是不喜欢吃的东西。
English: It's food you don't like or can't eat.

Chinese: 我想想……我好像没什么不吃的东西呀？
English: I see... I don't think there's anything I won't eat.

Chinese: 什么都可以！拜托你啦！
English: Anything will do! Please and thank you!

Chinese: 她兴奋地晃动着脚，笑嘻嘻地打量着房间。只是……我总觉得她在偷瞄那堆星魂结晶。
English: Shillae swings her legs excitedly, grinning as she surveys the room. I can't shake the feeling she's peeking the Mana Crystals.

Chinese: 那个，昔莱……
English: Um, Shillae...

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 所以，你说的麻烦事，就是饿了？
English: So, the trouble you mentioned... it's just about hunger?

Chinese: 啊对~
English: Yeah.

Chinese: 都这么久没吃东西了……我要饿死了<size=40>啊</size><size=44>啊</size><size=48>啊</size><size=48>——</size>
English: It's been so long since I last ate... I'm famished. <size=40>I</size> <size=44>miss</size> <size=48>foood</size><size=48>—</size>

Chinese: 昔莱向后躺直，喉咙动了两下，好像是在咽口水。
English: Shillae leans back, swallowing hard, clearly salivating.

Chinese: 律看上去像是吃了一枚星魂结晶，脸拧在一起。她凑到我耳边，悄悄说——
English: Ritsu looks as if she swallowed a Mana Crystal, her face all scrunched up. She leans in and whispers to me.

Chinese: 米娅就来自她的家族？霍洛韦尔家族缔造者？
English: Does Mia come from her family? She was the founder of the Holowells?

Chinese: 我总觉得……她和米娅会很合拍……
English: I have a feeling... she and Mia would hit it off...

Chinese: 律震惊地看着我，然后点了点头，又摇了摇头。
English: Ritsu looks at me in astonishment, nodding then shaking her head.

Chinese: 可……领袖不应该是那种很威严的吗？
English: But... shouldn't a leader be more... imposing?

Chinese: 而且——大恶魔诶！不应该很威风吗？
English: And—she's a great demon! Shouldn't she be intimidating?

Chinese: 你觉得圣城最强的审判长应该威风吗？
English: Do you think the greatest Lord Inquisitor should be intimidating?

Chinese: 嗯，我一会儿一定要去偷吃克萝萝的小蛋糕！
English: Hmm, Kuroro won't mind if I have her cupcakes!

Chinese: 啊，被发现了。算了，反正我也已经吃完了。
English: Ah, you get me! Whatever, I've finished them anyway.

Chinese: 坏狗狗！！呜……我要告诉哥哥……
English: Bad dog!! Waaah... Lord Oracle will know about it...

Chinese: 你告诉谁都没有用的~这么好吃的蛋糕，是谁吃不着呢？
English: It's no use! Guess I'm the only one who have enjoyed such a delicious cake.

Chinese: <size=45>哇哈哈哈哈！！！</size>
English: <size=45>Hahahaha!!!</size>

Chinese: 律悻悻地回过头，使劲翻动着昔莱的档案，试图找到一些更有力的论据。
English: Finishing her recalling, Ritsu turns back to Shillae's file, frantically searching for stronger arguments.

Chinese: 小心。
English: Watch out.

Chinese: 马恩推着餐车走了进来。小厨房里一天到晚都有准备好的食物，不会出现我饿了却没东西吃的情况。
English: Mann comes in pushing a food cart. The kitchen is always stocked, so I'm never left hungry.

Chinese: 呀呀呀，这都是什么？唔……好香啊！
English: Ooh, what's all this? Mmm... Smells divine!

Chinese: 咕咾肉，炙风肉串，烤乳猪。请您慢用。
English: Sweet and sour pork, meat skewers, and roasted piglet. Bon appetite.

Chinese: 我尝尝……
English: Let me try...

Chinese: 昔莱用指尖捏起一粒咕咾肉，扔进了嘴里。
English: Shillae pinches a piece of sweet and sour pork.

Chinese: 酸酸的，甜甜的！真奇怪……好吃，好吃！
English: Sour and sweet! How odd... but delicious!

Chinese: 她端起盘子，径直向口中倒去，也不嫌烫。嘴巴鼓鼓的，像两个颊囊。
English: She lifts the plate and gulps the food down, unbothered by the heat. Her cheeks puff out like a hamster's.

Chinese: ……不烫吗？
English: Isn't it hot?

Chinese: 唔汪！吼吼吃……
English: Nomot! Goonom...

Chinese: 你听得懂吗？
English: Can you understand her?

Chinese: 呃，不烫，好好吃？
English: Uh, "not hot", and "good"?

Chinese: 我耸耸肩，帮昔莱倒上茶水。她很快就把那盘肉咽了下去，也不知道有没有嚼碎。
English: I shrug, pouring Shillae a cup of tea. She quickly swallows the meat, barely chewing.

Chinese: 喝点水，别噎着了……
English: Have some tea...

Chinese: 没事没事~太好吃啦！多谢你！
English: I'm fine. It's too good! Thank you so much!

Chinese: 她嘴上道着谢，眼睛却盯上了烤乳猪。她扯下一只猪腿，另一只手拿着三根肉串，大快朵颐起来。
English: She's thanking me, but her eyes are locked on the roasted piglet. Tearing off a piglet leg and grabbing three skewers, she starts feasting.
Wow...

Chinese: 她是饿死的吗？
English: Did she starve to death?

Chinese: 瞎说什么呢，多不礼貌……
English: Don't be so rude...

Chinese: 律吐了吐舌头。看着看着，竟然也咽了下口水。
English: Ritsu sticks out her tongue. As we watch, we can't help but swallow.

Chinese: 好饿……怎么回事？我刚吃过午饭啊……
English: Why is this sudden hunger? I just had lunch...
Grumble...

Chinese: 我也饿了……等等，你吃饭怎么不叫我？
English: I feel hungry too... Wait, why didn't you have lunch with me?

Chinese: 你生病了，肠胃不好，要空一空肚子！
English: You were sick. You needed to fast!

Chinese: 我病已经好了！
English: I'm getting better!

Chinese: 哪有这么快……你是不是又装病骗我！
English: No way you recovered that fast... Are you faking it again?

Chinese: 咳咳。
English: Hack hack.

Chinese: 马恩轻咳了两声。我回过头，原来昔莱已经吃完了，正打量着我和律。
English: Mann clears his throat softly. I then find Shillae has finished eating and is now eyeing Ritsu and me.

Chinese: 吃得还满意吗？不够的话我再安排。
English: Did you enjoy your meal? I can arrange more.

Chinese: 满意满意！不用麻烦啦！嘿嘿~
English: I can't be more satisfied! No need for more! Heh heh.

Chinese: 那，我先说明一下情况吧。
English: Well, let me explain the situation.

Chinese: 我不喜欢勉强别人。我会给星痕们舒适的生活空间，尽可能满足星痕们的愿望。当我需要帮助的时候，希望你能够帮我一把。
English: I don't like forcing people. I provide Asters with comfortable living spaces and try to fulfill their wishes. In return, when I need help, I hope you can lend a hand.

Chinese: 怎么样，你愿意加入我们吗？
English: So, what do you say? Would you like to join us?

Chinese: 你是坏人吗？
English: Are you a bad person?

Chinese: ……不算坏吧。不过也谈不上好。
English: Not exactly bad, I suppose. But I'm not exactly good either.

Chinese: 我可以想去哪儿就去哪儿吗？
English: Can I go wherever I want?

Chinese: 受到召唤魔法的限制，你没办法离开律的身边。不过我们已经找到了解决方式。
English: The magic constraints bind you with Ritsu. However, we've found a solution.

Chinese: 由我重新召唤的话，你在圣城内活动应该没问题。只不过——你的实力会大打折扣。
English: If I re-summon you, you should be able to move freely within the sacred city. But—your power will be greatly reduced.

Chinese: 实力……会有人想杀死我吗？
English: Power... Would anyone want to kill me?

Chinese: 哎，不对，我已经死了吧……
English: Ah, wait, I'm already dead, aren't I...

Chinese: 对了！这么说，你可以复活别人吗？呃，也不是复活，就是说，你可以把死去的人变成我这样子吗？
English: That's it! Is that mean you resurrect others? Uh, not exactly resurrection. I mean, can you turn the dead into something like me?

Chinese: 她眼里闪着光，扑到我身上来。我吓了一跳，举着双手，身体拼命向后仰。
English: Her eyes sparkle as she lunges at me. I flinch, raising my hands and leaning back as far as I can.

Chinese: 昔莱小姐，注意一下影响……！
English: Miss Shillae, please mind your posture!

Chinese: 嗯？什么影响？我没使用力量呀？
English: Hmm? What posture? I didn't show any hostility, did I?

Chinese: 昔莱小姐，唔，麻烦你先起来……
English: Um, could you please get up from me...
Oh...

Chinese: 你刚刚的问题……我并没有办法想召唤谁就召唤谁。甚至我也不知道今天会召唤出你。
English: About your question... I can't just summon whoever I want. I didn't even know I'd summon you today.

Chinese: 因为一些意外，我忘记了一些事情。如果我有一天想起来了，说不定就能准确地召唤了。
English: Due to some mishaps, I've lost certain memories. If I remember someday, maybe I could summon more accurately.

Chinese: 啊……我也有好多事儿想不起来了……
English: Ah... There's a lot I can't remember either...

Chinese: 她拍了拍头，好像很懊恼。
English: She taps her head, frustrated.

Chinese: 说起来，我们之前是不是见过？
English: Come to think of it, have we met before?

Chinese: 应该不会……吧？
English: Probably not... right?

Chinese: 诶，奇怪……我怎么想不起来我的生日了……
English: Huh, weird... I can't remember my birthday...

Chinese: 她的脸上满是懊恼，空落落地向沙发上栽去。
English: Her face crumples with regret as she flops onto the couch.

Chinese: 如果我又碰巧召唤到了你，你就能想起来了。这点我可以向你保证。
English: If I happen to summon you again, you might remember. I can guarantee that much.

Chinese: 算了算了，不想那些有的没的了。
English: Forget it. No need to dwell on that.

Chinese: 她甩了甩头，重新振作起来。
English: She shakes her head to perk up.

Chinese: 留在这里，每天都能有好吃的吗？
English: If I stay here, will there be tasty food every day?

Chinese: 当然。
English: Of course.

Chinese: 那……有水果吗？其实我更喜欢吃水果……
English: And... are there fruits? I actually prefer fruits...

Chinese: 绝大多数水果都能及时供应。不过，鉴于客人您生活的年代较为久远，您偏爱的某些水果可能无法提供。
English: We can supply most types of fruit promptly. However, given that you lived quite a while ago, some fruits you like might not be available.

Chinese: 没关系！什么水果我都爱吃！
English: I can accept that! I love all kinds of fruits!

Chinese: 深渊里的水果可比肉稀罕多啦！
English: Fruits were way rarer than meat in the Abyss!

Chinese: 还有什么疑问吗？
English: Any other questions?

Chinese: 我笑了笑。她顿了一下，笑着答应了我。
English: I smile. She pauses briefly, then agrees with a smile.

Chinese: 没有疑问啦！就听你的吧。
English: Nope, no more questions! I'll go with what you said.

Chinese: 我需要做什么吗？比如……签订什么契约，或者响应召唤？
English: Do I need to do anything? Sign a contract, or respond to the summon?

Chinese: 放松就好。律会代表秩序之海承载、认可、接纳你，你只需要接受秩序之海的规则即可。
English: Just relax. Ritsu will support, acknowledge, and accept you on behalf of the Sea of Order. All you need to do is to accept its rules.

Chinese: 律走上前，轻声吟唱着魔法。
English: Ritsu steps forward, softly chanting a spell.

Chinese: 零星的光点从周围浮现，逐渐融入昔莱的身体。
English: Scattered light dots emerge, gradually merging into Shillae's body.

Chinese: 完成啦！
English: Done!

Chinese: 这就好了？
English: That's it?

Chinese: 唔，还没完。你需要回秩序之海一趟。
English: Um, not quite. You need to make a quick trip to the Sea of Order.

Chinese: 一会儿我会喊你，你只需要回应我的呼唤就好。
English: I'll call you soon. Just respond to my summon.

Chinese: 诶，怎么回……那叫什么来着，秩序大海？
English: Huh? How do I get to... what was it again, the Ocean of Order?

Chinese: 第一次回秩序之海的话需要我解除召唤。记住那种感觉就好啦！
English: For your first return to the Sea of Order, I'll need to dispel the summon. Just remember how it feels!

Chinese: 之后想要回去的话，回想那种感觉就可以~
English: Later, when you want to go back, just recall that sensation~

Chinese: 律挥了挥手，昔莱化作一片光点，消失在空气中。
English: Ritsu waves her hand, and Shillae dissolves into particles of light.

Chinese: 我从桌上的碟子里捏起两颗星魂结晶，注入魔力，在心底轻松呼唤着昔莱的名字。
English: I pick up two Mana Crystals from the plate, silently calling Shillae's name while infusing magic.

Chinese: 她双眼无神，嘴也忘了合上，像是还停留在某种状态中。
English: She appears with vacant eyes and an open mouth, as if stuck in a trance.

Chinese: 昔莱？
English: Shillae?

Chinese: 昔莱？
English: Shillae?

Chinese: 啊？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 她突然回过神，呆滞地看着我。
English: She snaps back to reality, staring at me blankly.

Chinese: 秩序之海……之前是什么地方？
English: Sea of Order... what was it before?

Chinese: 唔……我想想……
English: Um... Well...

Chinese: 风暴之殇后，地底涌出的岩浆就涌上了深渊。
English: After the Storm of Sorrow, magma from the earth's core flooded the Abyss.

Chinese: 大概是八百多年前吧，真理圣殿建立的时候，莉莉娅把那里改造成了秩序之海。哦，莉莉娅就是主神。
English: About eight hundred years ago, when the Sanctuary of Truth was established, Lillia transformed the Abyss into the Sea of Order. By the way, Lillia is Lord God.

Chinese: 深渊……岩浆？
English: Abyss... magma?

Chinese: 改……造？
English: Trans... formed?

Chinese: 她惊惶地退了两步，转过身，向外奔去。
English: She steps back in alarm, turns around, and bolts out the door.

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 昔莱
English: Shillae

Chinese: 司书
English: Librarian

Chinese: 纳菲
English: Naphee

Chinese: 小闪
English: Flashette

Chinese: 安洁
English: Angie

Chinese: 居民
English: Resident

Chinese: 路人
English: Passersby

Chinese: 追忆者
English: Recollector

Chinese: 守护者遗失了珍宝。
English: The guardian has lost her treasure.

Chinese: ……你要待到什么时候？
English: How long will you stay?

Chinese: 我、我才刚来了一分钟！
English: I-I just got here a minute ago!

Chinese: ……任何人待在我的房间里都会让我生理不适……哪怕一秒钟。啊，[var=Actor]除外。
English: Anyone in my room makes me uncomfortable... even for a second. Ah, except for [var=Actor].

Chinese: 算了……你想待着就待着吧。别乱动我东西，别打扰我休息。
English: Anyway... stay if you want. Don't touch anything. Don't bother me.

Chinese: 喂，我可是来跟你同步情报的！
English: Hey, I'm here to share intel!

Chinese: 你在装睡对吧？！
English: You're faking sleep, aren't you?!

Chinese: 小闪面无表情地跳下床，走出卧室，打开门。
English: Flashette hops off the bed expressionlessly, walks out of the bedroom, and opens the door.

Chinese: 你好，请问你是小闪吗？
English: Hello, are you Flashette?

Chinese: 艾克斯？不对……
English: An Achlys? No...

Chinese: 是昂萨斯恶魔？
English: An Ansus Demon, huh?

Chinese: 啊，我也分不太清……
English: I'm not really sure...

Chinese: 请进。
English: Come in.

Chinese: 噢，好。
English: Oh, OK.

Chinese: 咳咳！何时来的恶魔？没有感受到永恒魔王的气息吗？
English: Cough! When did the demon arrive? Didn't you sense the Eternal Overlord's presence?

Chinese: 啊……嗨？
English: Ah... hi?

Chinese: 骨、骨翼昂萨斯？！
English: A-a bone-winged Ansus?!

Chinese: “她的羽肉销磨在空中，她的手足发黑，在杰西斯的怒火中焦熔。”
English: "Her wing-flesh erodes in the air, her limbs blacken, melting in Jancis' fury. "

Chinese: 崇高之翼——昔莱。她就是你要说的情报吗，纳菲？
English: Shillae, the Noble Wings. Is she the intel, Naphee?

Chinese: 昔、昔莱？霍洛韦尔缔造者？？？
English: Shi-Shillae? The founder of the Holowells???

Chinese: 我我我我我我我先走了——
English: I-I-I'm outta here—

Chinese: 你要是晚点儿来，她也许能给你准备点儿惊喜。
English: If you'd come later, she might've prepared a surprise for you.

Chinese: 有什么事找我？
English: What do you need from me?

Chinese: 啊……我，我听说你是厉害的恶魔，所以就来找你了……
English: I heard you're a powerful demon, so I came...

Chinese: 我刚刚被召唤出来，想了解一些深渊的历史……
English: I've just been summoned and want to learn about the Abyss' history...

Chinese: 这……不应该是侍主来讲吗？
English: Shouldn't... the Lord Oracle explain this?

Chinese: 昔莱吐了吐舌头，没好意思回答。
English: Shillae sticks out her tongue, too embarrassed to answer.

Chinese: 小闪的双手不自然地绞在了一起。她宁愿给侍主端一整天盘子，也不想亲口讲述自己身上发生的事。
English: Flashette's hands fidget. She'd rather serve the Lord Oracle all day than talk about her experiences.

Chinese: 要不……你去图书馆看看？借一本《米伦通史》，或者《深渊纪元》就行。
English: Why don't you... check out the library? The History of Mirren or The Era of the Abyss, either one will do.

Chinese: 哦，好……
English: Oh, alright...

Chinese: 多谢你！
English: Thank you so much!

Chinese: 呃，不会，我也没帮到你什么……
English: I didn't really help much...

Chinese: 事情就是这样。
English: That's all I know.

Chinese: 帮大忙了。我正想着去哪找她才好。
English: You've been a huge help. I was wondering where to find her.

Chinese: 小闪并没有走，冲我眨了眨眼睛。
English: Flashette lingers, giving me a wink.

Chinese: 等找到昔莱之后，我带你去个好地方，怎么样？
English: How about I take you somewhere nice after we find Shillae?

Chinese: ……不好。
English: No.
Oh...

Chinese: 是热闹的地方吗？
English: Somewhere lively?

Chinese: 也没那么热闹……
English: Not really lively...

Chinese: 算了，随你吧。
English: Forget it, do what you want.

Chinese: 你好忙……想见你都见不到。
English: You have been busy... I barely get to see you.

Chinese: 我走了。
English: I'm out.

Chinese: 小闪摆了摆手，用传送魔法离开了办公室。
English: Flashette waves and vanishes using magic.

Chinese: 你笑什么？
English: What's so funny?

Chinese: 听闻历史上某些国度的君主可以拥有很多妻子。每到夜晚，侍臣便会捧来匣子，摆放着每位妻子的名签。
English: I heard that in history, some kings had many wives. Every night, a servant would bring a box with name tags for each wife.

Chinese: 打住……这是哪本小说里写的吧？《异界奇想》还是《天界大陆》？
English: Hold up... That's from a novel, isn't it? Otherworld Fantasy or Heavenly Land?

Chinese: 现实里哪有这种君主，没听说过。
English: There's no such king in real life.

Chinese: 哦，是吗？
English: Oh, really?

Chinese: 她眯着眼，故作惊讶。
English: She squints, feigning surprise.

Chinese: 我还以为是真的呢。看来，书籍也和人一样，会骗人呐。
English: I thought it was true. Seems books can lie just like people.

Chinese: ……继续讲吧。
English: Go on.

Chinese: 根据贝卡丝的描述，第一纪元末的某些天使、人类以及精灵，被杰西斯放逐至深渊。他们形成了最初的恶魔。
English: According to Beccas, at the end of Era of Firstlight, Jancis banished certain angels, humans, and elves to the Abyss. These became the first demons.

Chinese: 天使们变成了昂萨斯和艾克斯恶魔，源精灵变成了艾卡希恶魔，艾雅人则变成了达拉尔恶魔。
English: Angels transformed into Ansus and Achlys Demons, primal elves into Akashic Demons, and Aiyans into Dalal Demons.

Chinese: 其中，昂萨斯和艾克斯恶魔的领袖便是这位昔莱，被称为“崇高之翼”。
English: Shillae, known as the Noble Wings, became the leader of the Ansus and Achlys Demons.

Chinese: 贝卡丝并不属于被放逐的那批源精灵。
English: Beccas wasn't among the banished primal elves.

Chinese: 目前所召唤的星痕中，“禁忌之轮”时代的星痕非常少，我们掌握的信息也较为有限，很难还原真相。
English: We've summoned few Asters from the era of Taboo and Betrayal. Our limited info makes uncovering the truth difficult.

Chinese: 大致内容就是这些。圣殿也需要昔莱的记忆补足相关历史。
English: That's the gist of it. The Sanctuary needs Shillae's memories to complete this history.

Chinese: 应该没问题。小闪刚刚也说了，她要想知道真相，得去图书馆。
English: That should not be a problem. As Flashette said, she'll need to hit the library for the truth.

Chinese: 我记得早期恶魔是不懂通用语的吧？昔莱这种天使转化的恶魔，应该只懂艾雅语才对。
English: Early demons do not understand Lingua Communis, do they? An angel-turned-demon like Shillae should only know the Aiyan language.

Chinese: 图书馆中有收录艾雅语的恶魔书籍吗？我只在贝卡丝那里看到过几本有关精灵的艾雅语书籍。
English: Are there any demon-related books in the Aiyan language at the library? I've only seen a few of those about elves among Beccas' collection.

Chinese: 关于恶魔的书籍基本都是通用语著作。早期恶魔的生存环境非常恶劣，加之上位恶魔往往生命悠久，并不会刻意记载什么事情。
English: Most books about demons are in Lingua Communis. Conditions for early demons were too harsh to have records, and the long-lived species rarely recorded events.

Chinese: 这也是现有史料中严重缺乏恶魔资料的原因之一。
English: This explains the lack of demon info in existing historical records.

English: Good. She's probably at the library. I'll go find her.

Chinese: 她和我一起站起身，向我点头告别。
English: She stands with me and nods goodbye.

Chinese: 对了。
English: By the way.

Chinese: 如果我要实现君主一夫多妻制的话，肯定不会放过你。
English: If I were to start a polygamy, I'd definitely include you.

Chinese: 那、那还真是荣幸呢。
English: Th-that would be quite an honor.

English: Ha, you didn't take that seriously, did you?

English: She laughs stiffly without answering. I wave and walk out the door.

Chinese: 啧。
English: Tsk.

Chinese: 爱骗人的家伙……
English: Such a liar...

Chinese: 报复心还真是重呢。
English: Never let go of a chance for revenge.

Chinese: 你好，请问你知道深渊的事吗？
English: Hello, do you know anything about the Abyss?

Chinese: 奇怪，怎么不理我……
English: Strange, they're ignoring me...

Chinese: 你好？
English: Hello?

Chinese: 昔莱伸出手，在路人的眼前挥了挥。那人才像刚看到她一样，停了下来。
English: Shillae waves her hand in front of a passerby. The person stops, as if suddenly noticing her.

Chinese: 啊哟！有人。
English: Oh! Where'd you come from?

Chinese: 你好，请问你知道深渊的事吗？
English: Hello, do you know anything about the Abyss?

Chinese: 深渊？不知道。
English: The Abyss? No idea.

Chinese: 回答完问题，路人往前走了一会儿后，突然又回过头。
English: The passerby takes a few steps before suddenly turning back.

Chinese: 诶，刚才有人问我问题吗？怎么回事？
English: Huh, did someone just ask me something? What's going on?

Chinese: 她疑惑了一会儿，接着向前走了。
English: She looks puzzled, then continues on her way.
What?

Chinese: 昔莱皱着眉，在原地打着转。
English: Shillae frowns, spinning in place.

Chinese: 没人来过吗？奇怪……
English: No one has come? Strange...

Chinese: 需要我帮您留意下吗？
English: Need me to keep an eye out for you?

Chinese: 不必了，正常履行你的工作就好。
English: Don't bother.

Chinese: 那，也祝您能完成今天的工作。
English: Well then. Wish you a smooth day.

Chinese: 哦，对了，《异界奇想》有收录吗？
English: By the way, do you have Otherworld Fantasy?

Chinese: 有的，二楼，第三纪元通俗小说，莎法利尔那几排。我帮您取来？
English: Yes. It's on the second floor, in the Era of Frost Veil popular fiction section, in the Safaril rows. Shall I get it for you?

Chinese: 不用了，我自己去就好。
English: No, thanks. I'll fetch it myself.

Chinese: 我找到那本小说，挑了个能俯瞰一楼的位置，坐了下来。
English: I find the novel and sit at a spot overlooking the first floor.

Chinese: 请止步！
English: Stop right there!

Chinese: 你好！请问这里是图书馆吗？
English: Hello! Is this a library?
(The Aiyan language?)

Chinese: 请告诉我你的名字，我需要查阅名册之后才能让你进去。
English: State your name. I need to check the registry.

Chinese: 我叫昔莱！所以，这里是图书馆吗？
English: My name is Shillae! So, is this a library?

Chinese: 当然。咦……
English: Of course. Huh...

Chinese: 那这里有没有讲恶魔历史的书呀？
English: Do you have any books on demon history here?

Chinese: 先等一下，昔莱小姐。
English: Just a moment, Miss Shillae.

Chinese: 星痕名册上没有你的名字——我不能让你进去。
English: Your name isn't on the Aster registry. I can't let you in.

Chinese: 可是、可是[var=Actor]说我是星痕呀！我真的是呀！
English: But, but [var=Actor] said I'm an Aster! I really am!

Chinese: 你是什么时候被召唤出来的？
English: When were you summoned?

Chinese: 大概……今天下午？
English: About... this afternoon?

Chinese: 她抬起头看向我。我冲她“嘘”了一下，摇了摇头，示意她别喊我。她虽然疑惑，但还是照做了。
English: She looks up at me. I shake my head, signaling her not to call out to me. Though confused, she follows my lead.

Chinese: 按照神谕司条例，召唤当日会为你登记身份，明天才会把身份信息同步到这里。
English: According to the Oracle Division's rules, your identity is registered on the day of summoning, but it won't be updated here until tomorrow.

Chinese: 请明天再来吧。
English: Please come back tomorrow.

Chinese: （……她是不是会错意了？）
English: (Did she misunderstand?)

Chinese: 是《米伦通史》和《深渊纪元》！
English: It's The History of Mirren and The Era of the Abyss!

Chinese: 司书抿着嘴，无奈地纠正着。
English: The librarian corrects her.

Chinese: 啊对，就是这两个！
English: Ah right, those two!

Chinese: 拜托拜托，可以让我进去看看吗？这对我真的很重要！
English: Please, can you let me in? It's really important to me!

Chinese: 司书又抬起头看向我。我赶紧点了点头。
English: The librarian glances up at me again. I nod.

Chinese: 那……好吧。
English: Well... alright then.

Chinese: 我去给你拿。
English: I'll get them for you.

Chinese: 多谢你！你真是个好人！
English: Thank you so much! You're so kind!

Chinese: 司书取了书，递给了昔莱。她接过书，迫不及待地翻阅起来。
English: The librarian retrieves the books and hands them to Shillae. She flips through the pages eagerly.

Chinese: 她越翻越急，竟然哭了出来——
English: Her movements become more frantic, and tears well up in her eyes—

Chinese: 这，这……
English: What... this...

Chinese: 这都是什么字……我不认识……
English: What are these characters... I can't read them...

Chinese: ……你不识字？
English: You can't read?

Chinese: 我……我只会艾雅语……
English: I... I only know the Aiyan language...

Chinese: 你想知道什么？我来帮你找。
English: What do you want to know? I can help you.

Chinese: 真的吗？！太感谢你了！
English: Really?! Thank you so much!

Chinese: 昔莱用手背擦了擦脸上的眼泪，认真地看着司书小姐。
English: Shillae wipes her tears and cast a intent look at the librarian.

Chinese: 我听说，恶魔们生活的深渊被岩浆占据了，后来又被改造成秩序之海……
English: I've heard that the Abyss was once filled with magma and later transformed into the Sea of Order...

Chinese: 我想知道恐怖心潮事件之后，恶魔们都经历了什么事……
English: I want to know what happened to the demons after the Terror Tumult...

Chinese: 司书小姐用平静的语气讲述着恶魔的历史。从恶魔和人类不休止的战争，到小闪与欧尔佳的牺牲，再到黑暗议会时代的血腥……
English: The librarian calmly recounts the history of the demons. From the endless wars between demons and humans, the sacrifices of Flashette and Orelga, to the bloody ruling of the Dark Parliament...

Chinese: 昔莱的手指紧紧攥着，嘴唇也几乎咬出血来。
English: Shillae's fingers clench tightly, her lips nearly bleeding from biting.

Chinese: “风暴之殇后，炽热的岩浆冲出地层，恶魔们——”
English: "After the Storm of Sorrow, scorching magma erupted, leaving the demons..."

Chinese: ……请问，您怎么了？
English: Excuse me, are you alright?

Chinese: 昔莱摇着头，终于忍不住伏在桌子上，大声哭泣起来。
English: Shaking her head, Shillae buries her face in her arms and breaking into loud sobs.

Chinese: 我站起身，走到昔莱身后，轻轻拍着昔莱的后背。
English: I walk behind Shillae, gently patting her back.

Chinese: 侍主大人。
English: Master.

Chinese: 司书小姐站起身向我致意。我点点头，示意她先下去。
English: The librarian stands and acknowledges me. I nod, signaling her to step away.

Chinese: 过了好一会儿，哭声渐渐弱了下来，变成了小声抽噎。时不时还会打一个嗝。
English: After a while, Shillae's crying subsides into soft sobs. She hiccups occasionally.

Chinese: 她缓缓抬起头，好像刚刚发现我坐在这里。
English: As she slowly raises her head, finally noticing I'm here.

Chinese: 你怎么在这里……
English: Why are you here...

Chinese: 刚刚答应我留下来的星痕突然跑掉了，当然要找到她咯。
English: The Aster who just promised to stay ran off. Of course I had to find her.

Chinese: 对不起……给你添麻烦了。
English: Sorry to cause you trouble.

Chinese: 她低着头，闷闷地说。
English: She says, head bowed, voice muffled.

Chinese: 没关系。
English: It's OK.

Chinese: 如果你愿意，什么事都可以跟我说，我很乐意听。
English: If you ever need to talk, I'm here to listen.

Chinese: 噢。
English: Of course.

Chinese: 我们回去吧？
English: Shall we head back?

Chinese: 嗯。
English: Yeah.

Chinese: 我叹了口气，拉着她的手，站起身。
English: I sigh, taking her hand as I stand up.

Chinese: 她的指尖像是尖利的石头，握起来有些硌手。她的手沉着，我小心捏着柔软的指根。
English: Her fingertips feel like sharp stones. Her hand is heavy. I gently squeeze the soft base of her fingers.

Chinese: 她突然紧紧握住了我的手。我忍着那种刺痛，没有松开。
English: That is when she suddenly grips my hand tightly. Sharp pain pierces through, but I don't let go.

English: Shillae, I might not be able to leave the city.

Chinese: 可是……

Chinese: （这三个人怎么聚在一起？先把另外两个人支开吧。）

English: Well... I heard Angie found some ranking in a book, something like... "The Ten Most Influential Demons in History"?

Chinese: 哦？本魔王排第几？

Chinese: 啊，我忘记问了。你要自己找她问问吗？

Chinese: 咳咳，其实我对这个也不是非常特别感兴趣啦！

Chinese: 呀，我的使魔在喊我了。退下吧，仆人！

Chinese: 纳菲提着裙子兴冲冲地跑掉了。

Pffff...

Chinese: 那这里交给我？

Chinese: 嗯，我只是被纳菲拉来的而已。

Chinese: 她嘟囔了一句，用大拇指轻轻顺着我的眉毛，揉了揉我的眼角。
English: She mutters, then gently traces my eyebrows with her thumb, rubbing the corner of my eye.

Chinese: 诶，怎么……都走了呢？

Chinese: 咳，昔莱。我想了想，还是决定跟你去一趟城外。
English: Ahem, Shillae. I've decided to accompany you outside the city.
Wow!!!

Chinese: 晕，晕！放我下来——

Chinese: 啊啊，我很高兴，所以……

Chinese: 你力气可真大……

Chinese: 嘿嘿！

Chinese: 她吐了吐舌头，挠了挠头上比较长的那根角，有些不好意思。
English: She sticks out her tongue, scratching her longer horn.

Chinese: 我刚刚还没说完……跟我一起出去可以，但是明天必须回来。

Chinese: 没问题！吃的东西就交给我来准备吧！

Chinese: 诶，为什么？

Chinese: ……你答不答应吧！

Chinese: 噢，好！

Chinese: 她只疑惑了一瞬，转眼就又雀跃起来。

Chinese: 好耶！城外探险咯！

Chinese: 那，两个小时之后来找我？

Chinese: 嗯嗯！

Chinese: 啊，对了……你等我一下。

Chinese: 她突然想起了什么，跑出了房间。

Chinese: 这么大的行囊？？
