Chinese: 你和耶坦尼娅到底怎么啦，都好反常哦。
English: What's going on with you and Yetannia? You're both acting weird.

Chinese: 聪明的人看起来不够聪明了，冷静的人看起来也不太冷静……真的不用倾诉一下吗？
English: The smart one's not so smart, and the calm one's not so calm... Sure you don't want to talk about it?

Chinese: 我说不定还可以再帮上一点忙！
English: I might be able to help some more!

Chinese: 聪明的不再聪明，冷静的不再冷静，这种情况下，我和她才会吵起来吧。
English: When the smart one loses their smarts and the calm one loses their cool, that's when we'd argue, right?

English: I was wrong too. Letting her handle things alone while I watched afar—that's what led to this mess.

Chinese: 律，你已经帮我很多了，剩下的就交给我吧。
English: Ritsu, you've been a great help. I'll take it from here.

Chinese: 等事情完全解决了，请你去吃城里最好吃的那家蛋糕。

Chinese: 虽然我想说，和好就好啦。但是有蛋糕，怎么能不去吃呢！
English: Though I want to say it's great you've made up... But if there's cake, how can I resist!

English: It's a deal. Sort things out today, and I want that cake tomorrow.

Chinese: 你就对我这么有信心？

Chinese: 好，明天就让你吃上那家的蛋糕。
English: Alright, you'll have that cake tomorrow.

Chinese: 拉钩！

Chinese: 今天刚醒来的时候我就有点奇怪，怎么会有这么巧的事。
English: Something felt off when I woke up today. It seemed too coincidental.

Chinese: 拿到卷轴才确定了，这个魔法波动，还真的是你啊——普琳普顿，你怎么帮他不帮我呀！
English: And this magical signature from the scroll—it's really you, Princeton! You helped him instead of me!

Chinese: 盼着谁揭开棺材，把我拉到阳光下，告诉我从前是从前以后是以后，我再也不用过那样的生活了？可能吗？谁不是在棺材里躺着呢？
English: What's the point of thinking about being pulled into the sunlight, told that the past is gone, and that I'll never have to live such a life again? It's impossible. Isn't everyone in their own coffin in some way?

Chinese: 就只能幻想吧。蜡烛也得有根烛芯吧？烛芯烧没了，这根蜡烛也就差不多了吧。
English: My only comfort is in daydreams. Candles require a wick to burn, correct? Once the wick is burnt out, the candle nears its end.

Chinese: 可是……突然有那么一天，连蜡烛都做不了了。
English: But then, unexpectedly, I could no longer be like candles.

Chinese: 就只是做了个梦，就变成使徒了。牺牲呢？奉献呢？荣誉呢？家族呢？我只是睡了一觉啊……就连这些都不属于我了？
English: I had a dream, and upon waking, I found myself transformed into an Apostle. What about sacrifice? Dedication? Honor? Family? Merely by taking a nap, have I forfeited these as well?

Chinese: 那就让真理去死吧！要是哪天我被发现了，我就要这么骂她们。去死！呸！虚伪！恶心！
English: If so, let the truth perish! Should I ever be uncovered, I will denounce them thusly: "To hell with it! My foot! Hypocrisy! Repugnance!"

Chinese: 这挺好的。如果没被发现，我大概是不敢当面骂出来的。被发现了就能出口气，没被发现就继续做我的蜡烛。这挺好的。
English: A rant is liberating. I won't have the courage to confront directly if I'm not busted. Being busted allows me to release my anger. Otherwise, I'd just be humble as a candle. That's good.

Chinese: 直到……那一天。直到我看见了您。
English: Until that day, we met.

Chinese: 原来……世上真的有这样的宝物吗？赞美主神！我原谅祂一天吧。
English: I discovered that such treasures do exist in the world. I give thanks to Lord God! I grant forgiveness for one day.

Chinese: 我不要做蜡烛了，也不要做泥土了。我能做一朵花吗？在我绽放的时候，您会投来视线吗？您会垂怜、同我说两句话吗？
English: I no longer wish to be a candle, nor do I wish to be clay. May I transform into a flower? Will you notice me when I blossom? Will you show compassion and speak to me?

Chinese: 您可以带我走吗？您可以娶我吗？您可以爱我吗？
English: Will you whisk me away? Will you make me your spouse? Will you hold me dear?

Chinese: 我以为我会知足的。我以为只要说两句话就能高兴一整天、一周、一个月的。我原来是个贪心的家伙啊……
English: I believed I would be satisfied. I thought uttering just a few words would bring me joy for an entire day, perhaps even a week or a month. How come I expect this much?

Chinese: 算了吧。我只想要一个拥抱。那个雨天我抱了您，我满足了。
English: Forget it. All I desire is an embrace. That hug on that rainy day left me contented.

Chinese: ……于是我又贪心了。我多想每天每夜每时每刻都抱着您啊……
English: Yet, here I am, longing once more. Oh, how I yearn to embrace you every single day, every night...

Chinese: 她嗫嚅着、哭泣着。我看向她背后那座虚抬着双臂的石雕。
English: She whispered tearfully. I gaze at the stone sculpture behind her, its arms uplifted.

Chinese: 拥抱安娜。
English: I want to embrace Anna,

English: I extend my arms and hold her tightly.

Chinese: ……您愿意拥抱这样的我吗？
English: Are you willing to embrace me like this?

Chinese: 她抬起头，轻颤着指尖，抚摸着我的嘴唇。
English: She lifts her head and trembles as she touches my lips.

Chinese: 您……比石头柔软。也比石头温暖。
English: You're softer than the stone. And warmer.

English: You made a mistake, but the punishment you endured was way out of proportion. I believe the punishment was too harsh and the cost too great.

Chinese: 过去已经偿清了。不，偿还的太多了。罪是他们定的，我不认同。
English: The past has been settled, overcompensated even. I never agreed with their sentence.

Chinese: 况且，谁告诉你，我只爱无罪的人？
English: Moreover, who said I only love the innocent?

Chinese: 现在，我要问你——
English: Now, I have a question for you—

Chinese: 我爱你的全部。我爱你的一切。哪怕你现在流着眼泪自怨自艾，我也愿意吻你。
English: I love everything about you. My love for you is all-encompassing. Even when you're in tears and down on yourself, I'm here, eager to kiss you.

Chinese: 我低下头，轻轻吻过她的嘴唇。

Chinese: 我爱的是完整的安娜的一切。哪怕你是使徒，哪怕认为你有罪——我依然爱你。
English: It's the entirety of you, Anna, that I cherish. My love remains unwavering whether you're an Apostle or even if I deem you guilty.

Chinese: 你呢？
English: And you?

Chinese: 只是抱着石头就满足了吗？
English: Are you content just hugging that stone?

Chinese: 她吻住了我，喉咙里发出低哑的哭声。泪水咸涩，星光闪烁着向她飞去，安娜又变成了我曾在梦中见过的模样。
English: She kisses me, and a low cry escapes her throat. Her tears taste salty, and as the stars twinkle and soar toward her, Anna transforms into the vision I beheld in my dreams.

Chinese: 她咬着我的嘴唇，将我扑到在床上。欲望渐起，飞过峰峦和山谷，汇成江河。
English: She nips at my lip and casts me onto the bed. Desire rises, flies over mountains and valleys, and flows into rivers.

Chinese: 夜很长，也很短。到天明时，终于沉沉睡去了。
English: The night lingers, stretching moments into eternity. By dawn, she finally falls asleep.

Chinese: 白天也一样短，一样漫长。但那朵只在幽暗中盛开一瞬的昙花，终于能在白天绽放。
English: The day is just as short as it is long. Once a nocturnal bloom, the epiphyllum finds the courage to unfurl its petals to the daylight.

Chinese: 七城的汇报信息全部处理结束了，有三个议题要拟定方案。

Chinese: 明白，相关的会议今晚就会提上日程。

Chinese: 关于海上风暴的处理，目前还缺少线索……

Chinese: 它的信息太少，等待更多信息送到才能判断是否需要中庭的魔女小队。
English: The information is too scarce, we must await further details to assess whether the Midgard's Nova squad is needed.

Chinese: 关于冬雪节相关政策和法条阐释公布出去了吗？
English: Have the policies and legal clarifications for the Winter Solstice Festival been disseminated?

Chinese: 已经公布，目前神谕司方面也在配合运转。
English: Already disseminated, and currently, the Oracle Division is also in sync with the operation.

Chinese: 就在我以为她们会这么快速通过的时候，牧却毫无预兆地停在我的面前。

Chinese: 饲主大人早啊，怎么突然过来了？
English: Good morning, Master. What brings you here so suddenly?

Chinese: 是有什么事吗？还是说想我了，想来抱抱我？
English: Is there something wrong? Or perhaps you've missed me and crave a hug?

Chinese: 想你了。
English: I've missed you.

Chinese: 嘿嘿，我也想饲主大人了，这就是所谓的心有灵犀吧？
English: Haha, I've missed you too, Master. This must be what they call a psychic connection, right?

Chinese: 啊，差点忘了我要去开会，饲主大人之后见！
English: Ah, almost forgot, I'm off to a meeting. See you later, Master!

Chinese: 她用力地抱了抱我，简直像是饿了几天那样在我怀里深呼吸，随后带着她身边的魔女离开了。
English: She embraces me tightly, inhaling deeply as if famished for days in my arms, then departs with Novas in her company.

Chinese: 您看……还是老样子呢。
English: You see... it's the same old tune.

Chinese: 是啊，已经有一周左右了吧。
English: Indeed, it's been about a week now.

Chinese: 这非常异常。
English: This is highly unusual.

Chinese: 等会议结束之后再问她吧。
English: Let's inquire after the meeting.

Chinese: ……安洁，你什么时候站在这里的？
English: Angie, when did you arrive here?

Chinese: 从我跟着审判长大人出来，但您的目光完全落在审判长身上的那时候开始。
English: Since I followed Lord Inquisitor out, but your focus was entirely on her.

Chinese: 请放心，这样的忽略完全不会产生任何负面结果。
English: Rest easy, such oversights shall yield no adverse effects.

Chinese: 如果是你突然转性，一天到晚不看书而是跑出去和孩子们玩抛接球的话，我也会很担心的。
English: Should you take it into your head to forsake your books for a day, opting instead to frolic with the children in a game of catch, I would be concerned as well.

Chinese: 您在指责审判长大人平时游手好闲吗？请放心，我不会说出去的。
English: Are you implying Lord Inquisitor is wont to loaf about idly? Fear not, your secret is safe with me.

Chinese: 你明显就是在记仇吧。
English: You're clearly nursing a grievance.

Chinese: 完全没有。我是您的魔女，深知尊卑有别，
English: Absolutely not. As your Nova, I understand the boundaries of our relationship,

Chinese: 绝不会因为您对我视而不见就记仇到今晚晚餐时间，更不会用我们共同的爱好吊着您，强求您给我一个下次不会的保证。
English: I'd never allow your inattention to me to fester into a grudge lasting until the evening, nor would I ask a promise out of our shared interest.

Chinese: 这不是完全在记仇吗？不过，我好像得到了一点启发。
English: This is entirely nursing a grudge, is it not? Nevertheless, it appears I've gleaned a spark of inspiration.

Chinese: 能帮上您的忙是我的荣幸。那么，在晚餐之前，我就先失陪了。
English: It's my honor to assist you. Thus, I shall make myself scarce until dinner.

Chinese: 安洁行了一个完美的告别礼，在我说出任何一句话之前，转身离去了。
English: With a flawless parting gesture, Angie takes her leave before I can utter a single word.

Chinese: ……您也不容易呢，侍主大人。
English: You too have your burdens, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 不知为何，我好像在这位魔女脸上读到了一丝同情。
English: Strangely, I could have sworn I saw a flicker of compassion on the Nova's face.

Chinese: 没什么。我先走了。
English: Nothing. I'll take my leave.

Chinese: 闭目的魔女向我躬身，无言地送别。
English: The Nova, with eyes closed, bows to me in silence, offering a wordless farewell.

Chinese: 工作的时间一晃即过。等我再从办公桌前抬起头时，照入窗户的，已经是橙红色的暮光。
English: The workday speeds by in the blink of an eye. When next I raise my gaze from my desk, the light streaming through the window is the orange-red of the setting sun.

Chinese: 我回来啦！
English: I'm home!

Chinese: 这么快就回来了？

Chinese: 真奇怪，最近明明快到冬雪节了，为什么神谕司的工作反而少了呢？

Chinese: 因为我们的审判长突然干劲全开了吧。

English: Ritsu clamps a hand over her mouth and scurries out of the office.

Chinese: 早晨还见你在忙。

Chinese: 毕竟饲主大人都这么担心了——总不能一直这样工作下去吧？

Chinese: 我可是最会体谅饲主大人的好狗狗。

Chinese: 牧向我露出了与平时一般无二的笑容。

Chinese: 所以，今晚没事了？

Chinese: 嗯……硬要说的话还有一点事没处理完。

Chinese: 我本来想带你去河边独处一段时间的。

Chinese: 那些事忽然都给自己上了个爆破魔法并施加延时的风魔法以保证自己消失时不留痕迹了。
English: Those tasks, it seems, have cast an explosive spell on themselves and a delayed wind charm to ensure they vanish without a trace.

Chinese: 面对失笑的我，牧双手背在身后，向我露出了完美无瑕的可爱笑容。
English: Seeing my amused reaction, Muu places her hands behind his back, presenting an impeccable, endearing grin.

Chinese: 急什么，刚才散步的时候不是还优哉游哉的吗？

Chinese: 刚才是在心理博弈，现在饲主大人都亮出手牌了，我当然也要坦诚相见啦。

Chinese: 我是饲主大人最乖最可爱的狗狗，让我看看吧！

Chinese: 牧扒在我的手臂上仰头看我，一脸期盼的可怜表情。
English: Muu clings to my arm, gazing up at me with an expectant, pleading look.

Chinese: 看她这么期待，我忽然又觉得有些愧疚了。

Chinese: 其实以前送过你一个，只是又准备了一个。

English: Muu takes the transparent sphere from my hand, rubbing its surface with her thumb.

English: Suddenly, a tiny firework ignites within the ball, silently burning at its center.

Chinese: 啊……亮起来了，还有点暖和。
English: Ah... it's lit up. And it's a bit warm.

Chinese: 你不喜欢爆竹的声音，就用这个来代替吧。把恰当的下班时间当做节日好了，节日快乐。
English: You don't like the sound of firecrackers, so use this as a substitute. Let's treat the end of a good workday as a festival. Happy holidays.

Chinese: 这次不用我提醒，她接过透明的球，用拇指搓亮了它。
English: Without any prompt, she takes the transparent orb and ignites it with a rub of her thumb.

Chinese: 嘿嘿，上次的能量耗尽之后，我一直都放在房间里，这次饲主大人又送我一个新的。
English: Haha, after the energy depleted last time, I've kept it in my room, and now Master has gifted me a new one.

Chinese: 在温暖的光线里，她有些紧绷的表情也放松了下来。
English: Bathed in its warm glow, her previously tense expression softens.

Chinese: 看她似乎心态有所转变，我忍不住摸了摸她的头。
English: Noticing a shift in her demeanor, I couldn't resist ruffling her hair.

Chinese: 想再用它玩一次抛接球吗？
English: Feel like playing a game of catch with it again?

Chinese: 想！
English: I do!

Chinese: 但是我拒绝。
English: But I must decline.
Eh?

Chinese: 听到了意料之外的答案，牧震惊地看着我。
English: Muu's eyes widen at my unexpected response.

Chinese: 先告诉我，你最近到底是为什么这么反常？
English: First, tell me, why have you been acting so out of character lately?

Chinese: 啊这个……年末了嘛总要努力工作一下，这也不奇怪吧？
English: Ah, well... it's the end of the year, so naturally, I have to put in some extra effort, right? It's not unusual, is it?

Chinese: 我最近压力超大的，奖励奖励我嘛——
English: I've been under a tremendous amount of stress, so how about a reward—

Chinese: 非常奇怪。虽然你平时也会干活……
English: It's very unusual. Although you do work...

Chinese: “平时也会干活”这种说法也太伤狗狗的心了！我好歹也有在认真履行主人留下的责任——
English: Saying "do work" like that is quite heart-wrenching for a loyal companion! I've been dutifully fulfilling the responsibilities left by my master—

Chinese: 但忙到没空来找我可是头一次。
English: But being too busy to visit me is a first.
Huh?

Chinese: 牧露出坏笑，歪了歪脑袋。
English: With a sly grin, Muu tilts her head.

Chinese: 饲主大人寂寞了吗？是我照顾您太少了，所以在撒娇吗？
English: Is Master feeling lonely? Am I being neglected, and that's why you're acting out?

Chinese: 是啊。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 呜哇，超级坦率。
English: Wow, that's quite candid.

Chinese: 所以，到底是为什么？忙到心情这么差，报仇雪恨一样地沉迷工作？
English: So, what's the real reason? So engrossed in work out of spite, as if seeking retribution through your labor?

Chinese: 而且，你这几天其实在躲我吧。
English: And you've been dodging me these past few days, haven't you?

Chinese: 每说一句，牧的耳朵就肉眼可见地往下塌一点。终于，她的耳朵彻底耷拉下去了。
English: With each statement, Muu's ears visibly droop a bit more. Eventually, her ears hang completely limp.

Chinese: 好吧好吧，也确实是有点啦……
English: Fine, fine, there is some truth to that...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 完全投降的牧没有再负隅顽抗，我们坐在河边、抱着烟花球，静静地听她解释起一切的起因。
English: Having surrendered, Muu ceases resistance, and we sit by the river, cradling the firework orb, quietly listening to her story.

Chinese: 也就是说，你想给我做个叫玲珑骰的东西。
English: So, you wanted to craft something called an "Intricate Dice" for me.

Chinese: 毕竟是饲主大人在圣城度过的第一个冬雪节，就想弄得隆重一点嘛。
English: It's, after all, the first Winter Solstice Festival you're celebrating in the sacred city, and I wanted to make it significant.

Chinese: 玲珑骰，光听名字是个需要考验手工活的东西。
English: Intricate Dice, just the name suggests it's a task that tests one's manual skills.

Chinese: 手工也可以用魔法代替啦，虽然只能代替一部分，但赶赶工还是可以的。
English: Magic can substitute for some of the craftsmanship, and while it can only cover part of the process, it's still feasible to expedite the work.

Chinese: 真正难办的是它的原料，象牙珊瑚。
English: The real challenge is its material, ivory coral.

English: Ivory coral? The Oracle Division's documents made mention of it as well. Due to the ongoing storms at sea in the east, blocking the maritime routes, there's been a shortage this year.

Chinese: 我记得圣殿会用它制作一些法杖的装饰部分吧。
English: I recall the Sanctuary uses it for decorative elements on some of the staffs, right.

Chinese: 是啊——它能传过来就是因为主人的喜好嘛。
English: Indeed—it's being passed down because of the master's fondness for it.

Chinese: 本来是想给饲主大人弄一份惊喜礼物才想绕过神谕司的，结果工作反而越绕越多了……
English: I intended to craft a surprise gift for Master, which is why I tried to circumvent the Oracle Division, but it only led to an increasing workload...

Chinese: 要把路上堆积的所有工作都解决掉，才能看似自然地接触到解决风暴的问题。
English: I must address all the tasks before I can naturally tackle the issue of the storm.

Chinese: 好不容易终于在今天结束了所有重要性比风暴高的任务，但后天就是冬雪节了！
English: After I finish the tasks superior to the storm, the festival is the day after tomorrow!

Chinese: 怎么看都来不及了，是这个意思吧。
English: No matter how you look at it, it's too late, isn't it?

Chinese: 这么一说更让狗伤心了！呜汪——
English: This makes me even more heartbroken! Woof—

Chinese: 说到东方，神谕司现在倒是有一位认识东方神明……
English: Well, the Oracle Division does have someone acquainted with the Eastern deities...

Chinese: 啊，饲主大人是说——
English: Ah, Master is referring to—

Chinese: none
English: None

English: Although it was at your behest, I have also been unable to reach Gemma recently.

Chinese: ……怎么会有这种事？
English: How could this be?

Chinese: 妾身与承玉的联系，乃是依着您与她未来的姻缘才搭上，若彼此无事，才入梦闲话一二，并无契约或固定的通讯。
English: My connection with Gemma is based on the potential future bond between you and her, we only exchange pleasantries in dreams if all is well. No contract or regular communication.

Chinese: 若是承玉此时忙于响应愿望，或是其他事务，妾身便唤她不得了。
English: If Gemma is currently occupied with fulfilling wishes or other affairs, I cannot summon her.

Chinese: 这种情况持续多久了？
English: How long has this been the case?

Chinese: 妾身不曾细算，想来也有一两月了。
English: I have not kept track precisely, but it must be a month or two.

Chinese: 若是侍主大人有需要，妾身也可尝试在梦中呼唤，只是成效如何，便难说了。
English: If it serves your purpose, I could try to reach out in dreams, yet it may not work.

Chinese: 那就先这么做吧。谢谢你，桃。
English: We'll give that a try for now. Thank you, Momo.

Chinese: 桃浅笑着摇摇头。
English: Momo shakes her head with a gentle smile.

Chinese: 为主上做事，乃是妾身所愿。
English: It is my honor to carry out tasks for my master.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 结束了和桃的对谈，我回到牧身边。
English: After finishing the talk with Momo, I rejoined Muu.

Chinese: 怎么样怎么样？能联系上吗？
English: How did it go, how did it go? Is there a way to contact her?

Chinese: 桃说联系不上，有一两个月了。
English: Momo said she hasn't been able to reach out for a couple of months.

Chinese: 听起来有蹊跷，但现在信也送不过去。
English: That sounds fishy, and we can't even send a message now.

Chinese: 看来这条线也断了啊……
English: It appears this path is also blocked...

Chinese: 虽然往年也有暴风雨，但持续的风暴很少见的。
English: Although there have been storms in the past, sustained ones are quite uncommon.

Chinese: 唉……我还是另给饲主大人准备礼物吧。但明明是第一个冬雪节……
English: Fine... Perhaps I should prepare another gift for Master. But it's supposed to be the first Winter Solstice Festival...

Chinese: 牧叹着气摇头。
English: Muu sighs and shakes her head.

Chinese: 也到晚饭时间了，先去吃个晚饭吧。
English: It's about time for dinner, let's go eat.

Chinese: 我没什么胃口，陪饲主大人去……
English: I'm not very hungry, but I'll accompany Master...

Chinese: （摸摸牧的头）
English: (Pat Muu on the head)

Chinese: 也许还有另一个解法。
English: There might be an alternative solution.

Chinese: 饲主大人是怎么想的？
English: What does Master think?

Chinese: 牧抬起头，眼睛忽闪忽闪。
English: Muu looks up, her eyes sparkling.

Chinese: 你会用远距离的传送魔法吗？
English: Are you capable of long-distance teleportation magic?

Chinese: 如果只传送我们两个人的话，没什么问题啦。
English: If it's just the two of us, it should be manageable.

Chinese: 但来不及做完吧……
English: But there's not enough time to complete it, right...

Chinese: 冬雪节是要大家一起过的，但我们可以一起过冬雪节的前夜。只有我们两个人。
English: The Winter Solstice Festival is a time for communal celebration, but we can share the eve between us. Just the two of us.

Chinese: 一起寻找原料，一起制作，这也会是很美好的回忆。
English: Together we'll seek out the ingredients and craft something together, that will surely become a cherished memory.

Chinese: 真拿饲主大人没办法！这个主意超好的！
English: You've got me there, Master! What a splendid idea!

Chinese: 牧一下子精神起来，用力点了点头。
English: Muu's spirits instantly lift, and she nods energetically.

Chinese: 那就约好了哦！冬雪节前的晚上，我们一起去东方群岛！
English: It's a promise, then! The eve of the Winter Solstice Festival, we'll head to the Eastern Islands together!

Chinese: ……回答得这么快，你是不是早就想好了？
English: You agreed so swiftly, have you been planning this all along?

Chinese: 诶嘿嘿，怎么会呢？
English: Haha, whatever do you mean?

Chinese: 狗狗哪儿有那么多坏心思呀。
English: A loyal pup like me doesn't have many tricks up their sleeve.

Chinese: 狗狗坏心思可多着呢。
English: Oh, but a pup can be quite mischievous.

Chinese: 哈哈，饲主大人肚子饿了吧？我们一起去吃晚餐吧！
English: Haha, are you feeling peckish? Let's dine together!

Chinese: 不等我回答，她挽起我的手，拉着我向餐厅跑去。
English: Without waiting for my reply, she linked her arm with mine and led me toward the dining area.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 时间来到第二天的夜晚。
English: The following evening arrived.

Chinese: 今夜不需要我值守吗？
English: Aren't you required to stand watch tonight?

Chinese: 嗯，回去和家人一起过节吧。
English: No, go and spend the festival with your loved ones.

Chinese: 虽然还有一段时间，但是，冬雪节快乐，马恩。
English: Though it's still a while away, Happy Winter Solstice, Mann.

Chinese: 马恩愣了一下，露出微笑。
English: Mann pauses, then a smile graces his features.

Chinese: 是的，明天是冬雪节。
English: Indeed, tomorrow marks the Winter Solstice Festival.

Chinese: 这是送给您的礼物，请您收下。
English: This is a gift for you, please accept it with my regards.

Chinese: 马恩将一个手掌大小的槲寄生花环递过来。
English: Mann presents a holly wreath, palm-sized, as a gift.

Chinese: 谢谢你，马恩。
English: Thank you, Mann.

Chinese: 马恩沉默了一下，向我鞠躬后离开了。
English: After a brief silence, Mann bows and takes his leave.

Chinese: 收好这个小小的槲寄生环摆件，我看向窗外。
English: Tucking away the small holly ornament, I gaze out the window.

Chinese: 时间也差不多了……
English: The time is nigh...

Chinese: 正是这样！
English: Exactly!

Chinese: ……你又是从哪里冒出来的？
English: Where did you pop up from?

Chinese: 我被吓了一跳，无奈地摸了摸她的脑袋。
English: You startled me. I wearily stroked her head.

Chinese: 嗯？这套衣服是……
English: Hmm? This outfit is...

Chinese: 我专门为今天准备的新衣服哦，很不错吧？
English: A new set I specifically prepared for today, isn't it wonderful?

Chinese: 确实很不错。
English: Indeed, it is.

Chinese: 饲主大人一点也不惊喜呢。
English: My master doesn't seem very surprised.

Chinese: 这是我定做的，让人挂在橱窗里，等你去拿。
English: I had it made to order, arranged for it to be displayed in the shop window, waiting for you to collect it.

Chinese: 我就知道！难怪那位工匠没收钱。
English: I knew it! No wonder the craftsmen didn't charge a fee.

Chinese: 饲主大人算计我。
English: You're playing tricks on me.

Chinese: 牧鼓起脸颊。见她这样，我忍不住怜爱地捏了捏她的脸。
English: Muu puffs out her cheeks in a huff. Seeing her like this, I couldn't help but affectionately pinch her cheeks.

Chinese: 我知道你穿这件一定好看。走吧，时间很紧。
English: I knew this would look stunning on you. Let's go, we're pressed for time.

Chinese: 确实呢！走吧！
English: Indeed, we are! Let's go!

Chinese: 魔法阵在我的房间里展开，牧向我伸出手。
English: The magical circle expands in my chamber, and Muu extends her hand toward me.

Chinese: 上一次丘吉尔搞的传送魔法太突然了，我都没能抓住饲主大人的手。
English: The last teleportation spell Churchill conjured was too abrupt, I missed the chance to hold your hand.

Chinese: 这次我会紧紧抓住的。你也一定要抓紧我哦，饲主大人！
English: This time, I'll make sure to hold on tight. You must hold on to me as well, Master!

Chinese: 当然，我会抓紧你的。
English: Absolutely, I will keep a firm grip on you.

Chinese: 嘿嘿，一言为定！
English: Haha, deal.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 海浪轻轻地拍打着我的脸，将我从晦暗的梦中唤醒。
English: The ocean waves lap gently at my face, rousing me from a murky slumber.

Chinese: （浑身上下都酸痛……发生什么事了？）
English: (I'm sore all over... What's happened?)

Chinese: （尝试起身）
English: (Attempt to rise)

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我尝试坐起来。在手臂和腿一起用力的时候，我感觉到自己的手被紧紧地握着。
English: I attempt to sit up. As I exert force with my arms and legs, I realize my hand is firmly grasped.

Chinese: 循着力量的来源看去，湿透的一大团黑白毛发出现在视野里……
English: Following the source of the grip, a drenched clump of black and white fur comes into view...
Muu?

Chinese: 牧，醒醒。
English: Muu, wake up.

Chinese: 我想起来了。在我们传送的途中，被某种强大的魔力干扰了。
English: It hit me. Midway through our teleportation, we were disrupted by some potent magical interference.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 所以，那种象牙珊瑚是从哪里来的东西？
English: So, where does that kind of ivory coral originate from?

Chinese: 珊瑚当然是从海里来的啦。海岛上的渔民会潜水去采集深水的珍珠，象牙珊瑚是副产物。
English: Coral, of course, comes from the sea. Fishermen on the islands dive to gather deep-sea pearls, and ivory coral is an incidental catch.

Chinese: 后来，主人更喜欢象牙珊瑚的质感，圣城开始大量进口珊瑚，珍珠反而没那么重——yao？楽——
English: Later, as you favored the texture of ivory coral, the sacred city began to import large quantities of it, making pearls less significant? Ahhhh—

Chinese: 牧的声音与形象在传送中扭曲拉长，变得十分诡异。
English: Muu's voice and visage warp and elongate during the teleportation, taking on a bizarre appearance.

Chinese: 怎么回事，传送出了问题吗？
English: What's happening, is there an issue with the teleportation?

Chinese: 事FenG包？我%￥……
English: Is the situation out of control? I, I...

Chinese: 认知似乎也被扭曲了。混乱的魔力将我们扯开，而牧坚决地抓着我的手，不愿松开。
English: My cognition seemes to warp as well. Chaotic magic rips us apart, but Muu clutches my hand with unwavering resolve.

Chinese: 她的手臂在风暴中拉长、爆开伤口，鲜血侵蚀了裂缝。
English: Her arm elongates and bursts with wounds amidst the tempest, blood seeping into the rifts.

Chinese: Wo决对bu……要！
English: I absolutely won't... let go!

Chinese: 黑红相间的魔力从她的伤口和手中迸发，极端不稳的裂缝被撕开一条口子。
English: A torrent of black and crimson magic erupts from her injuries and hands, tearing an unstable rift wider.

Chinese: 我们被无形的巨力抛飞出去。最后感觉到的，是咸腥的海风，以及……那只仍然紧握着的手。
English: An invisible force hurls us outward. The last sensation is the briny sea breeze, and... that hand still firmly clasping mine.

Chinese: （目前来看是落在海岛了，情况应该没有到最差的地步。得先搞清楚我们在哪里才行。）
English: (We've seemingly crash-landed on an isle, the situation isn't as dire as it could be. First, we must discern our whereabouts.)

Chinese: 牧，牧，你还好吗？
English: Muu, Muu, are you alright?

Chinese: 牧的手仍然没有松开，但也没有回应我。
English: Her grip remains steadfast, yet she offers no response.

Chinese: （难道说是重伤昏迷了吗……）
English: (Has she succumbed to her injuries and fallen into a deep slumber...?)

Chinese: 我撑起身体，看向牧。
English: I hoist myself up and gaze upon Muu.

Chinese: 嘿嘿……饲主大人陪我一个月哦……不，两个月！要坐在桌边一直看着我的英姿……
English: Haha... You must keep me company for a month... no, two months! You must sit by the desk, ever watching my valiant form...

Chinese: ……居然是睡着了。

English: My heart eases a bit. Yet, the distant sounds that ring out immediately set my heart aflutter.

Chinese: 这边！我听见这边有声音！
English: Over here! I hear voices coming from this direction!

Chinese: 小响？是不是小响？
English: Hibiki? Is that Hibiki?

Chinese: 牧，快点醒过来……
English: Muu, snap out of it...

Chinese: 不行，这个不能让给你……
English: No way, I can't let you have this...

Chinese: 小响！听得见的话就应一声！

Chinese: （毕竟已经是无罪的时代了。）

Chinese: 我们是遭遇风暴的人，落到岛上了，请救救我们！
English: We're storm survivors, stranded on this island, please lend us a hand!

Chinese: 我怀抱着牧，大声呼救。
English: I cradle Muu in my arms, shouting for assistance.

Chinese: 妈，不是小响，有人说是落难了！
English: Mom, it's not Hibiki, someone's in distress!

Chinese: 怎么有人这个天气还敢出来，快去看看。
English: Who would dare to venture out in this weather? Hurry up and check.

Chinese: 青年男子半是戒备，半是好奇地看着我们。
English: The young man eyes us with a blend of wariness and curiosity.

Chinese: 我们是旅行者，路过这里时遭遇了事故。请问这是哪里？
English: We're wanderers who met with an accident while passing through. Could you tell us where we are?

English: From your getup, you folks are city dwellers, right?

Chinese: 至于你身边这位小姐，是魔女？
English: And the lady with you, is she a Nova?

English: (He's somewhat informed, but not very. It seems we're quite away from the city.)

Chinese: 是的。我们的目的地是在海边，但这里却是丛林。
English: Yes. Our intended destination was the seaside, but here we are, surrounded by jungle.

Chinese: 我们在乘屿岛。
English: We've found ourselves on Lagoon Island.

Chinese: 乘屿……没听过的岛，但有些耳熟。
English: Lagoon... a name unfamiliar to me, yet it rings a distant bell.

English: Judging by the Nova's condition, she must've passed out from her injuries, right?

English: (I can't just say she's so deeply asleep she can't be roused...)

Chinese: 唉，要是风暴前，我们还能收留二位，但现在恐怕是力不从心了。
English: Alas, we could've offered you both shelter before the storm, but now our resources are strained.

Chinese: 发生什么事了？
English: What happened?

Chinese: 我们这里遇到了大风暴，持续有一两个月了。消息送不出去，物资也少了很多……
English: A fierce tempest has been raging here for a month or two. Communications are cut off, and our supplies have been severely depleted...

Chinese: 竟然有两个月了……
English: It's been two months already...

Chinese: 妈，这种事就没必要和外人说了。
English: Mom, there's no need to share such details with strangers.

Chinese: 你们见过一个小女孩吗？大概到我腰这么高，名字叫小响。
English: Have you come across a little girl? About as tall as my waist, her name is Hibiki.

Chinese: 没有，我也刚从昏迷里醒过来。
English: No, I've only just regained consciousness myself.

Chinese: 啊！绝对不行！！
English: Ahhh! Absolutely not!!

Chinese: 牧一声大叫，从我怀里跳了起来。
English: Muu's sudden outcry startles me as she leaps from my embrace.

Chinese: 诶？现在是什么情况？
English: Huh? What's the current situation?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 了解过情况后，我和牧穿梭在灌木丛之间。
English: After getting the lay of the land, Muu and I navigate through the shrubbery.

Chinese: 没想到我们误打误撞跑到了离目标不远的地方。
English: We've inadvertently ended up close to our intended destination.

Chinese: 不过，都穷困成这个样子了，父女之间起矛盾，孩子还会离家出走啊……
English: Yet, despite their destitution, family conflicts arise, and children still run away...

Chinese: 在现在的时代，听起来很不可思议。
English: In this day and age, it sounds quite unbelievable.

Chinese: 说不定是情绪病，这点等帮忙找到之后可以看看。
English: It might be a mood disorder, we can consider that once we've helped locate her.

Chinese: 都出来了，还要谈工作上的事吗？
English: Out here and still discussing work matters?

Chinese: 我都给主人和饲主大人打了这么多年的工了，工作早就融入生活啦。
English: I've been in service to you for so many years, work has become a part of my everyday life.

Chinese: 不然这样吧，要是我再提工作，饲主大人就摸摸我的头，这样我就不会再想工作了。
English: So, how about this? If I bring up work again, you could give me a pat on the head, which distracts me from thinking about work.

Chinese: 你的算盘珠子都要打到我脸上了。
English: Your scheming is about to hit me right in the face.

Chinese: 我提出我自己的交易打算，饲主大人也可以还价嘛……
English: I'll propose my own terms, and Master can negotiate as well...

Chinese: 啊，这里地面上有割断藤条的痕迹。
English: Ah, there are signs of cut vines on the ground here.

Chinese: 切口参差不齐，手劲不大，体力应该也不强。往前走走看吧。
English: The cuts are jagged, not very forceful, so the person isn't physically strong. Let's keep going and see what we find.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我们一边闲聊，一边跟着断藤的痕迹深入丛林。
English: As we chat, we follow the trail of severed vines deeper into the jungle.

Chinese: 不知从何时开始，细碎的虫鸣消失了，留下的只有悠长的风声。
English: At some point, the faint insect chirps fade away, leaving only the lingering wind.

Chinese: 呜哇，饲主大人是不是可以去当侦探啊？
English: Wow, could you consider a career as a detective?

Chinese: 现在的时代不需要那种东西吧。
English: This age doesn't really need that, does it?

Chinese: 而且这个方向不是你引我来的吗？
English: And didn't you guide me in this direction?

Chinese: 这其实也不算我的功劳啦……不完全算。
English: It's not entirely my doing... not all of it.

Chinese: 刚才我做了一个梦，梦见有人拉着我往这边跑，速度可快了。
English: I just had a dream, where I was pulled to run this way, at a breakneck speed.

Chinese: 我想着饲主大人还在这里，拼命地想回去。
English: I was thinking about Master still being here and desperately wanted to return.

Chinese: 然后呢？
English: And then?

Chinese: 然后我就回来了啊。我才不会把饲主大人丢在这里呢！
English: And then I came back. I would never leave Master behind!

Chinese: 牧说得这样理所当然，我也忍不住又摸了摸她的头。
English: Muu speaks with such conviction, I couldn't resist ruffling her hair again.

Chinese: 被魔法蒸干的头发和平时一样好摸。
English: Her hair, parched by magic, is as soft and inviting as ever.

Chinese: 谢谢你。
English: Thank you.

Chinese: 以及，这个应该就是终点了吧。
English: And, this must be the end of our journey, right?

Chinese: 呜喔，有点壮观诶！
English: Whoa, this is quite the sight!

Chinese: 出现在我们面前的，是一棵在树林里显得格外高大的古树。
English: Before us stands a Heartwood, towering majestically above the rest of the forest.

Chinese: 无论是散落在地面的落叶，还是在枝头摇曳的嫩芽，都如同碧玉一般晶莹润泽。
English: The fallen leaves on the forest floor and the swaying buds on the branches glisten with an emerald luster.

Chinese: 树根那边有个树洞诶，饲主大人。
English: There's a hollow in the roots, Master.

Chinese: 有一种被人引过来的感觉。
English: It feels like we were meant to find this place.

Chinese: 那要进去吗？
English: Should we venture inside?

Chinese: 当然。都请我们到这里了，不进去看看岂不可惜。
English: Of course. We've been led here, so it would be a shame not to explore.

Chinese: 真不愧是饲主大人，我也是这么想诶！
English: Master, as ever, you have a keen sense of adventure, and I share your sentiment!

Chinese: 能威胁到我们的人，不说只有一位吧，至少也是现在根本没有。
English: Individuals who could pose a threat to us, there's not just one, but at least none are present now.

Chinese: 牧护在我身边，和我一起走向树根阴影中的洞穴。
English: Muu stays close, guarding me as we approach the cave hidden in the shadows of the tree roots.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: ……哇哦。
English: Wow.

Chinese: 与我们原本设想的安谧景色不同，树洞的内部说是被风暴扫过也不奇怪。
English: The interior of the tree hollow is a stark contrast to the serene scene we had envisioned, it looks as though a tempest has torn through it.

Chinese: 可以见到的环境里四处是翻开的碎木头，地面也像是被猛兽刨过似的，深深浅浅布满了抓痕。
English: The surroundings are littered with splintered wood, and the ground is clawed and gouged, as if a wild beast had been digging furiously.

Chinese: 在满地的残骸中，躺在树叶里熟睡的孩子简直像是一个奇迹。
English: Amid the wreckage, the child slumbering peacefully amid the foliage is nothing short of miraculous.

Chinese: 小响？
English: Hibiki?

Chinese: 饲主大人往后站点，我来看看。
English: Master, step back a bit, let me handle this.

Chinese: 牧说得谨慎，行动却堪称大胆。她几步走近了孩子身边，蹲下身把孩子翻了过来。
English: Muu's words are measured, but her actions are daring. She strides closer to the child, kneels down, and gently flips the child over.

Chinese: 没问题，只是饿昏了，我给她一点魔力，暂时撑起来。
English: She's fine, just fainted from hunger. I'll infuse her with a bit of mana to keep her going for now.

Chinese: 我看着孩子在她手里几乎是飞到半空又转了个圈落在叶子里，心也跟着提起来又掉下去。
English: I watch as the child nearly levitates and spins in the air before settling back onto the leaves, my heart following the same trajectory.

Chinese: ……不错的杂耍。
English: Quite the acrobatics.

Chinese: 嗯，没有死也没有攻击性哦，饲主大人！
English: Yes, she's neither deceased nor aggressive, Master!

Chinese: 这么做是为了避免她攻击你？
English: Was that to prevent her from attacking you?

Chinese: 虽然我是很强，但也不想突然吃几下小猫小狗的挠嘛。
English: Though I am formidable, I'd prefer not to be unexpectedly clawed by a kitten or puppy.

Chinese: 在我们交谈间，小孩也慢慢苏醒。
English: As we converse, the child gradually regains consciousness.

Chinese: 唔……土地神大人……是土地神大人吗？
English: Um... Earth Deity... Is that the Earth Deity?

Chinese: 土地神大人？
English: Earth Deity?

Chinese: 这个小女孩看清了周围，似乎有些失望。
English: The little girl, taking in her surroundings, seems somewhat disheartened.

Chinese: 但随即她的注意力就被我们吸引，圆溜溜的眼睛好奇地打量着我们。
English: But soon, her gaze is captured by us, her eyes wide with curiosity as she examines us.

Chinese: 你们是什么人？土地神大人的同伴吗？
English: Who are you? Companions of the Earth Deity?

Chinese: 不，我们是被你爸爸和奶奶拜托来找你的。
English: No, we were sent by your father and grandmother to find you.

Chinese: 爸爸和奶奶……啊……
English: Father and grandmother... Ah...

Chinese: 孩子的表情一下子就变得心虚起来，她抓着松软的叶子，视线游移。
English: The child's expression shifts to one of guilt, clutching at the soft leaves, her eyes darting about.

Chinese: 你就是小响吗？
English: Are you Hibiki?

Chinese: 我是小响。……我不是离家出走，我是来找土地神大人的。
English: I'm Hibiki. I didn't run away from home. I came to seek the Earth Deity.

Chinese: 在我和小响对话时，牧在周围走了一圈，回来蹲在我身边。
English: While I converse with Hibiki, Muu circles the area and returns, squatting beside me.

Chinese: 随着她放低身体，毛茸茸的头发落在我的背上，热量很快蓄积起来，一片温暖。
English: As she lowers her body, her fluffy hair cascades onto my back, quickly gathering warmth, a patch of comfort.

Chinese: 那你找到土地神大人了吗？
English: Did you manage to find the Earth Deity?

Chinese: 没、没有……土地神大人，最近都不出现了……以前明明是会来的……
English: No, not yet... The Earth Deity, they haven't made an appearance lately... They used to come around...

Chinese: 你找土地神大人做什么？
English: What brings you to seek the Earth Deity?

Chinese: 超大的风雨持续了好久，我想找土地神大人帮帮忙……
English: The immense storm has been relentless for so long, I hoped to ask the Earth Deity for assistance...

Chinese: 但从风暴开始，土地神大人就没有再来过了。
English: But since the storm began, the Earth Deity has ceased to visit.

Chinese: 这时，我心中一动，想起了出发前的事。
English: At that moment, a thought struck me, recalling the events prior to our departure.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 虽是主上的拜托，可妾身近日也联络不上承玉了。
English: Although it was at your behest, I have also been unable to reach Gemma recently.

Chinese: ……怎么会有这种事？
English: How could this be?

Chinese: 妾身与承玉的联系，乃是依着您与她未来的姻缘才搭上，若彼此无事，才入梦闲话一二，并无契约或固定的通讯。
English: My connection with Gemma is based on the potential future bond between you and her, we only exchange pleasantries in dreams if all is well. No contract or regular communication.

Chinese: 若是承玉此时忙于响应愿望，或是其他事务，妾身便唤她不得了。
English: If Gemma is currently occupied with fulfilling wishes or other affairs, I cannot summon her.

Chinese: 这种情况持续多久了？
English: How long has this been the case?

Chinese: 妾身不曾细算，想来也有一两月了。
English: I have not kept track precisely, but it must be a month or two.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我们这里遇到了大风暴，持续有一两个月了。消息送不出去，物资也少了很多……
English: A fierce tempest has been raging here for a month or two. Communications are cut off, and our supplies have been severely depleted...

Chinese: 竟然有两个月了……
English: It's been two months already...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 东方的神明，风暴开始之后就不再出现……翠绿的大树，“承玉”的名号。这一切似乎隐约牵成了一条线。
English: The eastern deities, they vanished after the storm started... The verdant tree, known by the name "Gemma." It all seems to connect in a faint, discernible line.

Chinese: 土地神大人叫什么名字？
English: What might the Earth Deity be called?

Chinese: 唔……土地神大人就是土地神大人。她说我要是知道她的名字，会变得命短，所以这样称呼她就好了。
English: Um... The Earth Deity is just the Earth Deity. She said that knowing her true name would shorten my life, so it's better to refer to her in this way.

Chinese: 那你亲眼见过她吗？
English: Have you ever seen her with your own eyes?

Chinese: 也没有……不，应该有的，但我记不清了。好像做梦一样。
English: Not really... Yes, I think I have, but it's all hazy. It's like a dream.

Chinese: 牧，你怎么看？
English: Muu, what's your take on this?

Chinese: 在我询问孩子时，牧已经昏昏欲睡，脑袋在我肩上一点一点。
English: While I question the child, Muu is already on the verge of sleep, her head bobbing on my shoulder.

Chinese: 嗯，情况是这么个情况，具体的情况还要看情况……
English: Well, the situation is what it is, but the details will reveal themselves...

Chinese: 认真一点。
English: Let's focus.

Chinese: 不管具体是怎么回事，我们都得先把这个幼崽带回父母身边。
English: Regardless of the specifics, our priority is to return this little one to her parents.

Chinese: 我离开饲主大人一会儿都会焦虑呢，也让幼崽和家人团聚之后再做打算比较好！
English: I'd be anxious if I were away from you, so it's best to reunite the child with her family before making further plans!

Chinese: 也是。不过，果然今晚是回不去了。
English: True. However, it's clear we won't be heading back tonight.

Chinese: 希望小克蕾尔别追过来说我们才是……唉，干审判长真不容易啊。
English: I hope little Claire doesn't come after us, thinking we're the ones... sigh, the life of Lord Inquisitor is tough.

Chinese: 我还想再等等……
English: I'd like to wait a bit longer...

Chinese: 我们会帮你找到土地神的。
English: We will help you find the Earth Deity.

Chinese: 真的吗？
English: Really?

Chinese: 真的。我身边的这位，超厉害的！
English: I promise. The one by my side here is incredibly formidable!

Chinese: 要不是他，我们谁都找不到你哦。
English: Without him, we wouldn't have been able to find you at all.

Chinese: （不至于到这种程度吧。）
English: (That might be an exaggeration.)

Chinese: （哄一下这个幼崽嘛，不然他继续夹缠不清，好麻烦的。）
English: (Just appease the child, or if he keeps on, it'll be quite bothersome.)

Chinese: 那……那我们回去吧。
English: Then... let's head back.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我们回到村庄。见我们带回小响，大人们立刻围了上来。
English: We return to the village. Upon seeing us bring back Hibiki, the villagers quickly surrounded us.

Chinese: 太感谢了，太感谢了……我们真以为小响跑到风暴里去了。
English: We're so grateful, more than words can express... We were afraid Hibiki had run right into the storm.

Chinese: 啊啊，小响！你个野仔，怎么敢在这时候出去乱跑！
English: Ah, Hibiki! You little scamp, how could you dare to wander off at a time like this!

Chinese: 老人抱着失而复得的孙女，哽咽着责骂。她的父亲站在一边，脸色不虞，但也没有责骂，明显放松了许多。
English: The elderly man, clutching his found-again granddaughter, chokes out his reprimand. Her father stands by, his expression stern, yet he refrains from scolding, visibly more at ease.

Chinese: 我……我想去找土地神大人……
English: I... I want to seek out the Earth Deity...

Chinese: 衰仔，土地神大人能做什么！外头的怪物，那是土地神能打的吗？
English: Fool, what can the Earth Deity do! The monsters outside, are they a match for the Earth Deity to combat?

Chinese: 外面的怪物？
English: Monsters outside?

Chinese: 啊，魔女小姐，其实，我们也有一个不情之请……
English: Ah, lady Nova, in truth, we have a favor to ask of you...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 小响似乎想说什么，但被父亲拉着手带走了。老人引着我们走向村子里看起来最大的房子。
English: Hibiki seems to want to say something more, but her father leads her away by the hand. The elder guides us toward the most substantial house in the village.

Chinese: 也就是说，风暴实际上是魔物引起的，而这个魔物现在就在风暴中央。
English: So, the storm is actually caused by a monster, and this monster is currently at the eye of the storm.

Chinese: 是，是。我们这儿还算是富庶的岛，现在也被风暴困得吃不饱饭，不知道其他岛上的村子怎样了……
English: Yes, yes. Our island, once prosperous, is now struggling for food due to the storm, and I dread to think about the state of villages on other islands...

Chinese: 想向城市求救，可是风暴把我们送信的渠道都切断了，信送不出去，也不知道外头的大人有没有来。
English: We sought to call for help from the city, but the storm has severed our means of communication, we're uncertain if anyone from the outside has come to our aid.

Chinese: 圣城已经知道这件事了，你们没有收到物资吗？
English: The sacred city has been apprised of this situation, haven't you received any supplies?

Chinese: 这是我们这几个月来第一次见到外人。
English: This is the first encounter with outsiders we've had in months.

Chinese: 我想起了来时遇到的魔力干扰。
English: The magical interference we experienced on our approach comes to mind.

Chinese: 我听说魔女们拥有神奇的力量，要是能解决这件事，我们感激不尽……
English: I've heard that Novas possess extraordinary powers, if you could address this predicament, our gratitude would be boundless...

Chinese: 牧没有回答，她看向我，眼睛忽闪忽闪。
English: Muu remains silent, her gaze flicking toward me, her eyes sparkling.

Chinese: 老人也看向我，见我沉吟，她又继续说。
English: The elder also turned to me, and noticing my thoughtful expression, she pressed on.

Chinese: 二位应当是来找什么东西的吧？我们岛上的土产不少，风暴消失还能去别的地方换。
English: You both must be in search of something, am I right? Our island boasts a wealth of local goods, and once the storm subsides, we can trade them elsewhere.

Chinese: 要是您有什么需要，我们一定给您弄来。
English: Should you require anything, we are at your service.

Chinese: ……（并不是想要报酬的意思。）
English: (It's not that we seek a reward.)

Chinese: （不过，要是能趁这个机会直接拿到象牙珊瑚的话，倒也不错。）
English: (However, if we could seize this chance to directly acquire the ivory coral, that would be quite beneficial.)

Chinese: 这里有象牙珊瑚吗？
English: Is there ivory coral to be found here?

Chinese: 这您可问对人了。我们这里是象牙珊瑚的产地，但是大块的珊瑚都在海里，用时才会开采。
English: You've inquired to the right person. This place is renowned for its ivory coral, though the larger formations reside beneath the sea, harvested only as needed.

Chinese: 您如果需要，风暴结束，我们立刻就去采给您。
English: If it's what you need, as soon as the storm abates, we'll retrieve it for you without delay.

Chinese: 我知道了，这个我们接了。
English: I see, we'll take on this task.

Chinese: 好！那今晚就去——
English: Sure! Then let's head out tonight—

Chinese: 明天再去。
English: We'll set out tomorrow.

Chinese: 早点结束不好吗？今晚就能搞定的。
English: Won't it be better to finish this sooner rather than later? We could get it done tonight.

Chinese: 修整一下，搞清楚具体情况再去比较好。
English: It's wise to rest and gather more information before we proceed.

Chinese: 这位大人说得对。贸然前往恐怕会遭遇更多的危险，还请小姐冷静冷静。
English: This noble speaks wisely. Hastily venturing forth could lead to greater perils, I advise the young lady to exercise caution.

Chinese: 嗯……既然饲主大人都这么说了，那我就勉为其难地等一晚吧！
English: Well... if you insist, then I suppose I can endure waiting for one more night.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 当晚，我们来到村长为我们准备的房间里。
English: That evening, we are shown to the room the village head has prepared for us.

Chinese: 虽然知道这个村里的物资已经很少了，但没想到能少到这个地步……
English: I'm aware resources in this village are scarce, but the extent of it is surprising...

Chinese: 我拎起床铺上的被子抖了抖，棉絮少得可怜。
English: I lift the quilt on the bed and give it a shake, revealing meager filling.

Chinese: 这边海岛不产棉花，也不怎么遇到下雪天，现在的气候很反常的。
English: This island lacks cotton production, and we seldom experience snowy weather, the climate has been quite erratic lately.

Chinese: 牧眼珠一转，向我张开双臂。
English: Muu's eyes twinkle as she spreads her arms wide.

Chinese: 饲主大人觉得冷吗？
English: Are you feeling the chill?

Chinese: 感觉这么睡一晚上会生病。
English: It seems sleeping like this might lead to illness.

Chinese: 那饲主大人就抱着我睡吧？我毛茸茸的，很暖和哦。
English: Why not share my warmth, then? I'm fluffy, very warm.

Chinese: 只是为了暖和吗？
English: Just for warmth?

Chinese: 我点点牧的鼻尖，把她抱起来放在床上。
English: I tap the tip of Muu's nose and lift her onto the bed.

Chinese: 当然也是想跟您睡一起啦！睡觉能取暖，旅行能保安，饲主大人翻遍整个中庭也找不到比我更好的狗狗啦！
English: Of course, I also relish the thought of sleeping by your side! Sleeping keeps us warm, and traveling keeps us safe, you won't find a more loyal companion than me, even if you search every corner of Midgard!

Chinese: 看着她自得又满足的样子，我点了点她鼻尖，正想说些什么，就听到了敲门声。
English: Observing her smug and contented look, I tapped her nose, about to speak, when a knock came at the door.

Chinese: 谁？
English: Who's there?

Chinese: 大哥哥，大姐姐，你们睡了吗？我有事想跟你们说……
English: Mister, Miss, have you retired for the night? I have something I'd like to discuss with you...

Chinese: 我和牧互相看了一眼。牧钻进被窝暖床，我去给她开了一条门缝。
English: Muu and I share a look. Muu burrows under the covers to warm the bed, and I open the door just a crack.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 站在外面的果然就是小响。她抱着一床大被子，期期艾艾地看我。
English: It is indeed Hibiki standing there. She clutches a large quilt, gazing at me with uncertainty.

Chinese: 你是来送被子的吗？我们已经有被子了。
English: Did you come to bring us an extra quilt? We already have one, thank you.

Chinese: 这是奶奶让我抱来给你们的。里面都是松软的棉丝草，和棉花一样暖和。
English: This is from my grandmother, for you. It's filled with soft cotton silk grass, just as warm as cotton.

Chinese: 小响抱着被子，表情踌躇。我看了她片刻，没有接她的被子。
English: Hibiki holds the quilt, her expression wavering. I regard her for a moment, not yet taking the quilt.

Chinese: 你想拜托我们做什么吗？
English: Is there something you need from us?

Chinese: 你、你怎么知道？
English: How did you figure it out?

Chinese: 房间里传来牧憋笑的声音。
English: Muffled laughter from Muu echoes within the room.

Chinese: 因为你都写在脸上了。
English: It's clear as day on your face.

Chinese: 唔……那个……我希望……
English: Um... well... I was hoping...

Chinese: 她结结巴巴地说着，抱紧了被子，好像这床被子能给她勇气似的。
English: She speaks haltingly, clutching the quilt as if it could lend her strength.

Chinese: 能请你们别杀风暴里的魔兽吗……
English: Could you possibly spare the magical beast within the storm...

Chinese: 出人意料的回答。
English: An unexpected plea.

Chinese: 为什么？魔兽掀起了风暴，击败它，海路就能通畅，天气也会恢复正常。
English: Why? The beast is the cause of the storm, by defeating it, the sea lanes would clear, and the weather should return to normal.

Chinese: 那个魔兽……应该是土地神大人。
English: The beast in question... is likely the Earth Deity herself.

Chinese: ……什么？
English: What?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 很小的时候，我和小面、小铃去林子里玩，迷路了，是土地神大人救了我们。
English: When I was just a child, Luke, Lynn, and I were playing in the forest and lost our way, it was the Earth Deity who came to our rescue.

Chinese: 她住在林子里最大的树上，有时候我钻进树洞休息，她也会保护我，有时候还会给我变戏法。
English: She resides in the grandest tree within the woods, and on occasion, when I'd rest within the tree's hollow, she would keep me safe, and at times, she would even perform tricks for me.

Chinese: 但是一两个月前，土地神大人开始变得不对劲了……
English: But a month or two ago, the Earth Deity began to change...

Chinese: 变得不对劲了？
English: Began to change?

Chinese: 林子里开始刮起狂风，她的脾气也变差了，还会在树洞里发怒，把干净的树皮抓得乱乱的……
English: The forest started to be lashed by fierce winds, and her temperament turned foul, she'd become enraged within the tree hollow, clawing at the pristine bark...

Chinese: 但那不是她愿意的，她叫我跑远一点，不要被她伤害。但我有点担心，就还是常来……最后，她肯定是跑到海上去了。
English: Yet, it wasn't out of her own accord, she urged me to stay away to avoid being hurt. But, concerned, I continued to visit... Eventually, she must have fled to the sea.

Chinese: 除了这些，她还有其他的异常吗？比如说，你会不会感觉到她身边有什么奇怪的地方……
English: Aside from this, were there any other peculiarities about her? For instance, did you sense anything odd in her vicinity...

Chinese: 嗯……她的戏法，变成黑红色的了。
English: Well... her tricks, they transformed into hues of black and red.

Chinese: 混乱能量。
English: Havoc Energy.

Chinese: 几个月前，莉莉娅失踪、我醒来回到米德加尔。从那时起，混乱能量也开始增加。
English: Several months ago, Lillia vanished, and I found myself awakening in Midgard. Since that time, the presence of Havoc Energy has been on the rise.

Chinese: 之前在梦中见到承玉时，她还没有异常，而那之后不久，桃联系不上承玉……时间也对得上。
English: Before, in a dream, when I encountered Gemma, there was no sign of anything amiss, and shortly thereafter, Momo lost contact with Gemma... The timing aligns.

Chinese: 我知道了。我们会救下她的，不会杀掉她。
English: I know. We'll rescue her, not harm her.

Chinese: ……真的吗？真的可以吗？
English: Really? Is it really possible?

Chinese: 当然可以，我跟你约定。
English: Absolutely, you have my word.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 送走小响之后，我抱着她送来的被子回到房间内。
English: After bidding Hibiki farewell, I return to the room with the quilt she has brought.

Chinese: 牧背对着门，呼吸均匀，似乎已经睡熟了。
English: Muu has her back to the door, her breathing steady, seemingly already asleep.

Chinese: （躺在她身边）
English: (Lie down beside her)

Chinese: 我把小响带来的被子展开盖在床上，随即钻进被子，躺在她的身旁。
English: I spread out the quilt that Hibiki had brought, covering the bed, and then slip under the covers, lying down next to her.

Chinese: 牧像说梦话那样轻轻地嘀咕着什么。我凑过去，聚精会神地倾听。
English: Muu mumbles something softly, as if in a dream. I lean in, straining to hear.

Chinese: 饲主大人……你……为什么不抱抱我呢……再不抱……真的要睡过去了哦……
English: Master... why... don't you hold me... if you don't... I'm really going to drift off...

Chinese: 不装睡了？
English: Not feigning sleep anymore?

Chinese: 这不是看饲主大人这么郑重，所以不想打扰你的思考嘛。
English: I didn't want to interrupt your deep thoughts, seeing how solemn you were.

Chinese: 你明明就是等我来找你。
English: You were clearly waiting for me to come to you.

Chinese: 牧眨眨眼睛，凑过来亲亲我的脸，我顺势和她躺在一起。
English: Muu blinks, leans in to plant a kiss on my cheek, and I settle in beside her.

Chinese: 她抱着我的手臂，脑袋钻在我的颈窝里，很快被窝就变得热烘烘的。
English: Her arms around mine, her head resting on my neck, we cocooned in warmth.

Chinese: 饲主大人，如果那个魔物真的是被混乱能量影响的土地神，你想救她吗？
English: Master, if that creature is indeed the Earth Deity influenced by Havoc Energy, do you wish to save her?

Chinese: 你有别的想法吗？
English: Do you have an alternative in mind?

Chinese: 神意司的情况饲主大人也见过了嘛，一般我们都是物理消灭的。
English: You've witnessed the Kismet Division's approach, Master. Typically, we opt for physical elimination.

Chinese: 她很可能是桃的朋友，即使不是，她也是海岛孩子们的守护者。真的不能救下她吗？
English: She might be a friend of Momo's, and even if not, she's the guardian of the island's children. Is it truly impossible to save her?

Chinese: 那倒也不是不能……哎呀，饲主大人，别用这种很期待的眼神看着我啊！我承受不住的！
English: It's not that it's impossible... Oh, Master, don't gaze at me with such anticipation! I can't bear it!

Chinese: 我看你挺能承受住的，能连续高强度工作不来见我。
English: I believe you can handle it just fine, managing to work intensively without coming to see me.

Chinese: 我捏住牧的脸蛋，把她的小脸揉圆搓扁。
English: I tweak Muu's cheeks, playfully distorting her features.

Chinese: 牧故意做出苦兮兮的脸，呜噜呜噜地跟我求饶。
English: Muu puts on a deliberately woeful expression, murmuring for clemency.

Chinese: 我错了嘛，下次再也不敢啦——
English: My bad. I promise not to dare again—

Chinese: 我满意地放开牧的脸，她连忙自己搓了搓脸蛋，乖乖靠回我怀里。
English: Contentedly, I release Muu's face, and she rubs her cheeks and cuddles back into my arms.

Chinese: 但是，要是救不了呢？如果土地神只能净化的话，饲主大人要怎么办？
English: But... what if we fail to save her? If the Earth Deity can only be purified, what will you do, Master?

Chinese: 你怎么不问我如果我们打不过她要怎么办？
English: Why don't you inquire what we should do if we can't overcome her?

Chinese: 因为十个她都不够我一只手打啊。
English: Because she wouldn't stand a chance against even a single one of my hands.

Chinese: 牧回答得理所当然，我忍不住笑出了声。
English: Muu responds with a matter-of-fact tone, and I can't help but chuckle.

Chinese: 好，你最强了。
English: Very well, you are the mightiest.

Chinese: 回到刚才的问题，如果救不下，要怎么办？
English: Back to the question at hand, if we can't save her, what then?

Chinese: 我只是不想看到孩子露出失望的表情。
English: I simply don't wish to witness the children's faces filled with disappointment.

Chinese: 如果真的救不下，我们就告诉小响，土地神去修行了吧。
English: If we fail, we'll tell Hibiki the Earth Deity has embarked on a journey of cultivation.

Chinese: 真是温柔又残忍的话，但是我认同这个处理办法。
English: It sounds both tender and harsh, yet I concur with this option.

Chinese: 我轻轻地拍了拍她的肩膀。
English: I gently tap her shoulder.

Chinese: 小好奇鬼，没有别的问题就早点睡吧。
English: Inquisitive one, if you have no further inquiries, seek slumber early.

Chinese: 啊，其实还有一个问题的。侍主大人为什么要在这里住一晚？
English: Ah, there is actually another question. Why did Lord Oracle choose to spend the night here?

Chinese: 你今天受过伤，我希望你休息一下。
English: You sustained an injury today, I wanted you to have some rest.

Chinese: 空间旅行那点小伤压根不算什么啦。
English: That minor wound from spatial travel is of no consequence.

Chinese: 今天在海滩上的时候，你昏睡了很久。
English: On the beach today, you were in a deep sleep for quite a while.

Chinese: 啊，那个。
English: Ah, that.

Chinese: 那个？
English: That?

Chinese: 那个是因为我连续三天晚上加班没有睡觉……所以碰到沙滩就忍不住睡着了……
English: That was because I'd been working overtime for three nights straight without rest... so when I encountered the sand, I couldn't resist dozing off...

Chinese: 睡觉吧你。
English: Sleep now.

Chinese: 我把她的脑袋往怀里一按。牧吃吃笑着不再说话了，毫不客气地深吸一口气，慢慢调节呼吸。
English: I pressed her head to my chest. Muu giggles and fell silent, takes a deep breath and steadies her breathing.

Chinese: 我们彼此依靠着，任由睡意慢慢把我们往梦境拖去。
English: We lean on each other, surrendering to the drowsiness.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 次日，我们被村民送出村庄，来到了海边。
English: The next day, we're escorted out of the village and make our way to the seaside.

Chinese: 村长远远地待在林子和海滩相接的地方，见证这场即将开始的战斗。
English: The village chief stands at a distance, ready to witness the impending battle.

Chinese: 嗯——手脚都活动好了，饲主大人就看着我去风暴里收拾那家伙吧。
English: Ah! I'm all warmed up, Master, just watch as I deal with that creature in the storm.

Chinese: 等等，我和你一起去。
English: Wait. I'll go with you.

Chinese: 诶？要一起去吗，虽然也不是不行……
English: Huh? With me? It's not out of the question...

Chinese: 十个她都不够你一只手打的，那就让我们并肩去做这件事，不好吗？
English: You said ten of her wouldn't be a match for one of your hands, so why not face this together?

Chinese: 牧注视着我，慢慢露出了非常幸福的笑容。
English: Muu gazes at me, her expression gradually softening into a blissful smile.

Chinese: 当然好啦！
English: Absolutely, that sounds wonderful!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 铺天盖地般的黑影升腾起来，笼罩住牧娇小的身影。
English: A towering black shadow rises, enveloping Muu's petite figure.

Chinese: 我难得看见她用这种形态出场，聚精会神地看着那巨大的兽类。
English: I rarely see her take on this form, and I watch with rapt attention as the colossal beastly figure.

Chinese: 饲主大人？
English: Master?

Chinese: 我准备好了。
English: I'm ready.

Chinese: 漆黑的兽类垂下爪子，将我捞进她的手掌。我的背碰到软弹的一块——是牧的肉球。
English: The pitch-black creature lowers its claws, lifting me into its palm. My back meets a soft, springy surface—it is Muu's padded paw.

Chinese: 好，出发！
English: Let's go!

Chinese: 我们飞上天空，离那冰冷的风暴越来越近。
English: We ascend into the sky, drawing ever nearer to the frigid storm.

Chinese: 如刀刃般锋利的气流擦在牧的皮毛上，甚至没能磨损她的皮肤，更不能伤到我丝毫。
English: The wind, sharp as blades, grazes Muu's fur, failing to fray even a single hair, let alone harm me in any way.
Roar!!

Chinese: 风暴中传来某种生物狂怒的嚎叫声，我们径直向风暴眼飞去。
English: The storm roars with the ferocious howls of a creature, and we head straight for the storm's eye.

Chinese: 穿过飓风、穿过暴雨，我们看见无数扭曲的枝条在风暴眼里挥舞着。
English: Through the gales and the torrential rain, we see twisted branches thrashing about within the storm.

Chinese: 就是它了，真是疯狂的土地神啊……
English: This is it, the truly frenzied Earth Deity...

Chinese: 我从牧爪子的缝隙往下看，猩红的能量掩盖着核心，除了枝条什么都看不清楚。
English: Peering through the gaps in Muu's claws, I see a core shrouded in crimson energy, with no details discernible beyond the branches.

Chinese: 尽可能不要伤到她太多。
English: Try not to harm her too much.

Chinese: 知道啦、知道啦……
English: OK, OK...

Chinese: 漆黑的树枝向着天空延伸，漆黑的巨兽俯冲向大地。
English: The pitch-black branches reach for the heavens, and the Behemoth plunges toward the earth.

Chinese: 一道闪电将天空劈裂，二者终于交汇——
English: A bolt of lightning cleaves the sky, and the two finally clash.

Chinese: 我得以见证牧真正战斗的样子，即使只有一瞬。
English: I bear witness to Muu's true combat form, albeit for but a fleeting moment.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 当当！解决啦！
English: Ta-da! Done!

Chinese: ……这么快？
English: So fast?

Chinese: 我才不想让其他人占据我和饲主大人的时间呢。
English: I've no desire to let others encroach on my time with you.

Chinese: 风暴渐渐停止，那些狂乱的枝叶以极快的速度枯萎，露出中间紧闭着眼睛的人形。
English: The storm subsides, and the branches wither rapidly, revealing the figure with eyes shut.

Chinese: ……果然是你，承玉。
English: It is indeed you, Gemma.

Chinese: 呃……怎么回事……我、呃啊啊啊啊——
English: Uh... What's happening... I, uhhhh.

Chinese: 她受混乱能量的影响很深，一时半会儿可能没法恢复……随时都有再次疯狂的可能。
English: She's deeply ensnared by Havoc Energy, and may not recover soon... She may go mad again.

Chinese: 饲主大人，怎么办？
English: Master, what's our next move?

Chinese: 我知道一个魔法，你试着对她用一下。这是卷轴。
English: I'm aware of a spell you could attempt on her. Here's the scroll.

Chinese: 咦，这是什么，好新奇的东西！
English: Oh, what's this? Such a novel item!

Chinese: 神谕司一位博学魔女的试作品，可以遏制混乱能量的污染。试试看吧。
English: An experimental scroll crafted by a Nova from the Oracle Division to suppress Havoc Energy. Give it a try.

Chinese: 这魔法还不足以拯救一个使徒化的无辜女子，但对只是被污染的土地神，不该不起效果。
English: This spell may not redeem an apostolized innocent, but suffice for the Earth Deity afflicted by corruption.

Chinese: 尽管那个人已经成为星痕，但是……至少未来，我希望这样的悲剧尽可能不要发生。
English: Even if she's become an Aster... I wish to prevent such tragedies from occurring.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 赶在风暴完全消散前，我和牧将承玉带回了那棵古树的树洞里。
English: Before the storm fully abates, Muu and I bring Gemma back to the hollow of the Heartwood.

Chinese: 这个魔法有效，虽然不能完全净化，但凭着承玉自己的力量，这种程度应该可以自行净化掉了。
English: The spell works, though it can't achieve complete purification, with Gemma's own strength, she should be able to manage the rest.

Chinese: 那就好。
English: Good.

Chinese: 在我们交谈时，躺在草叶上的承玉也睁开了眼睛。
English: As we converse, Gemma, reclining on the grass leaves, also opens her eyes.

Chinese: 没想到……竟是侍主大人与这位……救了……小神。
English: I never expect... I could be rescued by Lord Oracle and this esteemed companion...

Chinese: 你现在感觉怎么样？
English: How are you feeling at the moment?

Chinese: 姑且能保持住理智，要想福泽岛民们，怕是还不能。
English: I can cling to my sanity for now, yet I cannot shield the island's people.

Chinese: 先休养吧。真没想到，混乱能量的影响居然对神也有效……
English: Rest is the first order. Even a deity could be affected by Havoc Energy. How astonishing...

Chinese: 小神……护着这方土地，将混乱能量……都吸进了小神的本体中。
English: I... safeguard this land, drawing the Havoc Energy... into my own essence.

Chinese: 看来，小神是有些自不量力了。甚至连求救都没来得及，便被吞没了神智……
English: It appears I've bitten off more than I can chew. I was overwhelmed before I could even cry out for aid...

Chinese: 这件事之后有人会来处理，你不用太担心。
English: We'll take it from here, so you needn't be worried.

Chinese: 承玉点了点头，又躺倒回去。
English: Gemma nods and reclines once more.

Chinese: 此次是小神承了您的人情。待到稍微好些……小神会想办法报答二位的。
English: I'm in your debt this time. Once I recover... I shall seek a way to express my gratitude to both of you.

Chinese: 这之后不要再逞强了，如果察觉什么麻烦，通过桃的梦境联系我们就好。
English: Do not overexert yourself. Should any difficulties arise, reach out to us through Momo's dreams.

Chinese: 我们还要回村里一趟，下次见，承玉。
English: We must return to the village for now. Until we meet again, Gemma.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 告别承玉后，我和牧回到村子。
English: After bidding farewell, we return to the village.

Chinese: 还没进村，我们就听见了村民的欢呼声。
English: As we approach, villagers' cheers reach our ears.

Chinese: 太好了！风暴结束了！可以出海打鱼了！
English: That's great! The storm's over! We can fish again!

Chinese: 哈哈，我的生意也能继续做了！
English: I can finally get back to business!

Chinese: 村长远远看见了我们，连忙走上来迎接。
English: The chief hurries to greet us.

Chinese: 二位来了！这次风暴平息多亏了二位，我们真是不知该怎么感谢才好……
English: You're here! We can't thank you enough for calming the storm...

Chinese: 才这么一点时间，村里已经多了一些不熟悉的人，似乎是其他海岛的。
English: In such a short time, unfamiliar faces have appeared, likely from other islands.

Chinese: 这点事而已，不算什么，村子可以正常运作了就好。
English: It's nothing special. We're just glad the village is back to normal.

Chinese: 对其他人的夸赞，牧似乎并不感冒，平淡地给予回应。
English: Muu responds coolly, seemingly unimpressed by the praise.

Chinese: 所以，我们的……
English: So, our...

Chinese: 魔女大人！请收下我的感谢！
English: Miss Nova! Please accept my gratitude!

Chinese: 斜刺里冲出一个女人，抱着布袋冲到了牧的面前。
English: A woman suddenly rushes to Muu, clutching a cloth bag.

Chinese: ……诶？什么？
English: Eh? What?

Chinese: 多亏了您，我和我女儿才能团聚……请您收下这份薄礼！
English: Thanks to you, my daughter is back to me... Please accept this small token!

Chinese: 啊，这位先生，请收下我的谢礼！
English: Sir, please take my gift!

Chinese: 这位小姐……
English: And miss...

Chinese: 小哥你……
English: Young man...

Chinese: 眨眼间，我们被前来感谢的人围了个水泄不通，各种礼物在我们身边堆积起来。
English: In an instant, we're surrounded by grateful villagers, gifts piling up around us.

Chinese: 啊、拜托大家让一让！谢谢啦！让一让——
English: Please, everyone, give us some space! Many thanks! Excuse—

Chinese: 在我们快要被礼物埋掉的时候，小响挤开人群，跑到我们身边。
English: Just as we're about to be buried under the gifts, Hibiki pushes through the crowd.

Chinese: 大哥哥，你救下她了吗？
English: Sir, did you save her?

Chinese: 她仰着脸看我，表情是遮掩不住的心焦。
English: She looks up at me, obliviously anxious.

Chinese: 小响，你说什么胡话呢？快过来，别冲撞了我们的贵客。
English: Hibiki, what nonsense are you talking about? Come here, don't bother our esteemed guests.

Chinese: 小响的父亲上前来拉她，想把她扯走，我向这位父亲摇了摇头。
English: Hibiki's father attempts to pull her away, but I shake my head at him.

Chinese: 大哥哥，我……
我蹲下来，和她视线平行，望着她的眼睛，一字一句地。
English: I crouch down to her eye level and look directly at her.

Chinese: 我们做到了，我们救下了她。
English: We did it, Hibiki. We saved her.

Chinese: ……太好了……太好了！谢谢大哥哥，你简直就是……简直就是……
English: That's great... so awesome! Thank you! You're just... you're just...

Chinese: 小响绞尽脑汁，试图给我想一个形容词。
English: Hibiki racks her brain, trying to find the right words.

Chinese: 冬雪哥哥！
English: Mr. Winter Solstice!

Chinese: ……那是什么？
English: What's that?

Chinese: 对这个孩子临时想出来的词，我有些哭笑不得。
English: I can't help but chuckle at the term she just made up.

Chinese: 大哥哥是冬雪节出现的奇迹，所以是，冬雪哥哥！
English: You are a miracle of the Winter Solstice Festival, so you're Mr. Winter Solstice!

Chinese: 诶诶，那我是什么？
English: Hey, what about me?

Chinese: 牧也弯下腰来凑热闹。
English: Muu bends down to join the conversation.

Chinese: 大姐姐是冬雪姐姐。
English: You are Miss. Winter Solstice.

Chinese: 这听起来跟我完全没关系嘛。
English: That doesn't seem describe our relationship.

Chinese: 我是冬雪哥哥，你是冬雪哥哥的雪橇犬，怎么样？
English: I'm Mr. Winter Solstice, and you're Mr. Winter Solstice's sled dog. How's that?

Chinese: 好呀！这听起来很棒，就这样了！
English: Sure! That sounds awesome. Let's go with that!

Chinese: 小响看看我，看看牧，很是困惑。
English: Hibiki looks between us, clearly confused.

Chinese: 那，冬雪哥哥，雪橇犬姐姐，这是我的谢礼。
English: Mr. Winter Solstice!, Miss Sled Dog, this is my thank you gift.

Chinese: 谢谢你们救下土地神大人。
English: Thank you for saving the Earth Deity.

Chinese: 她把一个小木盒举起来，递到我们手里。
English: She hands a small wooden box to us.

Chinese: 谢谢你，小响。
English: Thank you, Hibiki.

Chinese: 我打算收起来，小响却拉住我的袖子。
English: As I'm about to put it away, Hibiki grabs my sleeve.

Chinese: 拆开看看吧！我听奶奶说了你们来这里的目标，这个对你们肯定有用！
English: Open it up! I heard from Grandma what you're after. This will be useful!

Chinese: 我心里一动。难道说，这是……？
English: My heart skips a beat. Could this be...?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我打开木盒，里面躺着一枚洁白的骰子。
English: I open the box to find a pristine white die inside.

Chinese: 外壳如象牙般莹润，红色的圆球在镂空的方块内滚动，端的是精致灵动。
English: Its shell is as lustrous as ivory, with a red ball rolling within the hollow square.

Chinese: 啊！是相思骰！
English: Ahhh! It's a Lovesick Die!

Chinese: 我们此行的目标，居然是一个孩子送给我们的。
English: I never expected that our target would be got from a child.

Chinese: 我有些惊讶地看着小响，小响却也是一脸惊讶。
English: I look at Hibiki in surprise, and she mirrors my expression.

Chinese: 听着我们的话，一直在旁边等着带小响走的青年也咦了一声。
English: Overhearing us, the young man waiting to take Hibiki home speaks up.

Chinese: 相思骰，爸走的时候不就已经失传了吗？小响，是爷爷教你的？
English: The Lovesick Die? Didn't that vanish when dad left? Hibiki, did grandpa teach you about this?

Chinese: 这不是我的！我拿的明明是象牙珊瑚，怎么会变成这个呢？
English: This isn't mine! Hibiki exclaims. I picked up ivory coral. How did it turn into this?

Chinese: 谁拿错了我的盒子？
English: Who switched my box?

Chinese: 未必是这样。
English: That might not be the case.

Chinese: 可是，我真的只是拿了一枝很粗的象牙珊瑚……
English: But I really did only take a large piece of ivory coral...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 小神会想办法报答二位的。
English: I will find a way to repay you.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 也许是神奖励的奇迹吧。
English: Perhaps it's a miraculous reward from the gods.

Chinese: 现在看来，也只能这么相信了。
English: I guess we have to believe that now.

Chinese: 不然实在是没法解释已经失传的制作技术，怎么会突然蹦出来……
English: Otherwise, there's no explaining how a long-lost crafting technique suddenly reappeared...

Chinese: 圣城倒是还留着这个的制作方法，我来教你们吧。
English: The sacred city still has the method for making these. I can teach you.

Chinese: 真的吗？魔女小姐，那可真是太感谢了！
English: Really? Miss Nova, that's incredibly kind of you!

Chinese: 那，这个绳结的做法，这个布……
English: This is how to make this knot, this fabric...

Chinese: 这个我也知道。看来不少圣城还存着的东西，外面都失传了啊。
English: I know these too. Seems like a lot of things the sacred city still has are lost to the outside world.

Chinese: 那你就教教他们吧，不要浪费太久才好。
English: Go ahead and teach them, but try to make it quick.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 即使我这么说了，我们还是在村子里一直留到了晚上。
English: Despite my words, we end up staying in the village until evening.

Chinese: 风暴消失后，海岛也迎来了暖风，村民们和其他岛上的住民交换物资，办了一场盛大的感谢宴会。
English: After the storm passes, warm breezes sweep the island. The villagers and island residents throw a grand feast of gratitude.

Chinese: 我们离开后，关于冬雪哥哥和雪橇犬姐姐的传说开始在孩子们间流传。
English: After we leave, legends of Mr. Winter Solstice and Miss Sled Dog begin to spread among children.

Chinese: 随着这批孩子长大变老，冬雪哥哥也成为了大家口中的“冬雪爷爷”，而雪橇犬姐姐也只剩下了雪橇犬三个字。
English: As they grow old, "Mr. Winter Solstice" becomes "Winter Grandpa" in their stories, Miss Sled Dog becomes simply a sled dog.

Chinese: 而承玉告诉我东方群岛形成了在冬雪节这天扮成冬雪爷爷和雪橇犬的习俗，这更是很久很久之后的事了……
English: Gemma tells me that, in the later future, people in the Eastern Islands become used to dress up as Winter Grandpa and his sled dog during the festival...

Chinese: 不过，这些终究是遥远的未来。
English: However, that's all distant future.

Chinese: 生活在当下的我们，正要回归到自己的生活中去。
English: We, living in the present, are about to return to our own lives.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 当我们结束传送时，一点冰凉的东西落在我的脸上，融化成湿润的一片。
English: As we finish teleporting, something cold lands on my face, soon melting.

Chinese: 在眨眼的空隙间，三片，四片……深蓝的夜空之下，雪片簌簌扑向大地，拥抱立于地面的一切。
English: More flakes fall, three, four... Under the deep blue night sky, snowflakes flutter down, embracing everything on the ground.

Chinese: 下雪了。
English: It's snowing.

Chinese: 冬雪节嘛，这一天一定会下雪的。
English: Winter Solstice Festival always snow.

Chinese: 饲主大人，低低头。
English: Master, please lower your head.

Chinese: 我低下头，牧踮起脚，把我脸上的水迹擦净。
English: I do, and Muu rises on her toes to wipe the moisture from my face.

Chinese: 好在今天是假期。去逛街吗？
English: Luckily, it's a holiday. Want to go shopping?

Chinese: 好呀！和饲主大人一起去逛街，看看今年有没有好玩的新东西。
English: Sure! Let's check if there are any fun new things.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 冬雪节特供暖手玩偶！百分百手工制作，历代传承手艺人！
English: Winter Solstice Festival Specials! Hand warmer dolls! Perfectly handmade!

Chinese: 妈妈，暖手玩偶……
English: Mommy, I want a doll...

Chinese: 好，请给我一只暖手玩偶。
English: One hand warmer doll, please.

Chinese: 商人把毛茸茸的魔法道具递给孩子。然而，孩子手一抖，玩偶摔落在地。
English: The child gets a fluffy magical item. Accidentally, the doll falls to the ground.

Chinese: 哇！暖手玩偶跑掉了——
English: Wow! The doll runs away—

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 嘿，看我的！
English: Watch this!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 牧一把抄起玩偶。
English: Muu snatches up the doll.

Chinese: 是这只吗？
English: Is this the one?

Chinese: 哇！谢谢你帮我抓回它！
English: Wow! Thank you for bringing it back!

Chinese: 要抓牢，不然玩偶就会这样张牙舞爪，还会咬你的手。
English: Hold on tight, or the doll might claw and bite you.

Chinese: 大姐姐骗人，玩偶是好玩偶，不会咬人的。
English: That's a lie. It's a good doll. It won't bite!

Chinese: 玩偶是我的毛狗狗，狗狗都是好狗狗。
English: It's my fluffy doggie. Doggies are good.

Chinese: 是的，狗狗都是好狗狗。系上这个项圈，玩偶就不会跑走了。
English: That's right. Doggies are good. Put this collar on to prevent it from running away.

Chinese: 哇！冬雪节快乐，大姐姐和大哥哥！
English: Wow! Happy Winter Solstice Festival!

Chinese: 谢谢二位，冬雪节快乐。
English: Thank you. Happy Winter Solstice Festival.

Chinese: 二位好心人！雪太大了，请撑上伞吧！我们的伞物美价廉！
English: You are so kind! The snow's getting heavy! Please, take an umbrella! We have the best price!

Chinese: 好，要一把伞。
English: Alright, I'll take one.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 孩子带着玩偶和糖果蹦蹦跳跳地离开了，商店前只留下撑着伞的我，和伞下站着的牧。
English: The child bounces away with the doll and candies, leaving Muu and I under the same umbrella.

Chinese: 结果节日已经过去一大半了……虽然旅程很充实，但错过了圣城冬雪节的白天，还是有点可惜。
English: It's nearly night... Our journey was great, but it's a pity we missed the daytime.

Chinese: 白天的时候有什么特别节目吗？
English: Any special events during the day?

Chinese: 也不算是什么特殊节目啦，就是有个习俗。
English: Nothing too special, just a tradition.

Chinese: 钟声响起的时候，大家会在槲寄生环下拥抱，感谢主人赐予的安宁。
English: When the bells chime, people gather under the mistletoe to embrace and thank for the peace.

Chinese: 现在也能做吧？
English: We can still do that, can't we?

Chinese: 我也想啦——但天黑之后，卖槲寄生的商贩就收摊了。
English: I thought so too, but after dark, the mistletoe vendors pack up.

Chinese: 做槲寄生环的都是老人，休息得很早。
English: The elders who make the mistletoe wreaths rest early.

Chinese: 这样。
English: Got it.

Chinese: 我摸了摸口袋，拿出马恩送的槲寄生环，把它吊在伞骨上。
English: I pull out the mistletoe wreath Mann gave me, and hang it on the umbrella frame.

Chinese: ……不是吧。
English: No way...

Chinese: 虽然小了点，但这也是一种槲寄生环。
English: It's small, but it's still a mistletoe wreath.

Chinese: 真是输给饲主大人了！
English: You never cease to amaze me!

Chinese: 在漫天的大雪里，牧扑进我的怀里。
English: Amidst the swirling snow, Muu throws herself into my arms.

Chinese: 冰花融化在头发上、皮肤上，空气如流动的冰水。
English: Snowflakes melt in our hair and on our skin, with the air like flowing ice water.

Chinese: 而双臂圈定的小天地温暖如春。
English: Yet the small world within our embrace is as warm as spring.

Chinese: （挠她痒痒）
English: (Tickle her)

Chinese: 我把小响带来的被子展开盖在床上，双手钻进被子里，开始挠她痒痒。
English: I spread out the quilt that Hibiki had brought, covering the bed, and then slip under the covers.

Chinese: 牧忍了一会儿，翻过身来哈哈大笑。
English: Muu doesn't holds it for long before letting out hearty laughs.

Chinese: 哈哈……哈哈哈！我投降、我投降！
English: Haha...hahaha! I surrender!

Chinese: 总有一种不祥的预感……
English: I have a bad feeling...

Chinese: 有我在，就算出问题也不会很大的。
English: I'm here. Everything will be fine.

Chinese: 我紧紧握住牧的手，和她一起迈入传送阵。
English: Holding Muu's hand tight, I step into the teleportation array with her.

Chinese: 你最近太忙了，我很担心你。
English: I'm really worried seeing you pushing yourself.

Chinese: 没什么啦，接近冬雪节，怎么说都会忙一段时间的。
English: Rest assure. There are always busy days nearing the Winter Solstice Festival.

Chinese: 是的。
English: Yes.

Chinese: 唉，审判长大人还是那样，忙得不得了。
English: Lord Inquisitor always has so much to do.

Chinese: 【选项】
English: [Options]

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 纳菲
English: Naphee

Chinese: 魔王的温泉请帖
English: Overlord's Spa Invitation

Chinese: 林中有个惊喜正在等着纳菲，但愿她会喜欢。
English: There's a surprise waiting for Naphee in the woods. Hope she'll like it.

Chinese: 唔嗯……
English: Hmm...

Chinese: 这就是仆人你说的，会令我欣喜之地吗？
English: Is this the place you said would delight me?

Chinese: 唔……总感觉很普通啊，你是不是记错地方了？
English: Hmm... It seems quite ordinary. Is this really the right place?

Chinese: 就是这里没错。
English: This is definitely the right place.

Chinese: 但这里只有这一池子滚烫的热水……
English: But there's only a pool of scalding water here...

Chinese: 我最亲近的仆人哟，你侍奉我那么久了，莫非觉得这种东西就能让我欣喜？
English: My dearest servant, you've served me for so long. Do you think I would take delight in something like this?

Chinese: 我需要的是最为邪恶的魔力，就连最古老的恶魔感受到也会浑身发抖的那种！
English: I need the evilest magic, the kind that even the oldest demons would tremble upon sensing!

Chinese: 我需要的是最为疯狂的祭祀，直到我喊停之前膜拜与献祭不许停止！
English: I need the craziest rituals, with worship and sacrifices that won't stop until I give the command!

Chinese: 我需要的是最为狂热的征服，直到整个世界的幸存者都只能瑟瑟发抖的对我俯首称臣！
English: I need the most fervent conquest, until all the survivors of this world tremble and bow to me!

Chinese: 热水？热水是什么意思？
English: Hot water? What do you mean by hot water?

Chinese: 无聊！我要看到血流成河！
English: How uninspired! I want to see rivers of blood!

Chinese: 呃，那些东西等下次吧……
English: Uh, let's save those things for next time...

Chinese: 啊，我明白了。仆人你是这个意思吧——
English: Ah, I understand. So this is what you mean, servant...

Chinese: “嘿嘿嘿~三千世界最为强大而伟岸的魔王大人啊！卑微的仆人在此精心为您献上的是……地狱之汤！”
English: "Hehehe. Oh great and mighty Overlord of the three thousand worlds! Your humble servant has meticulously prepared for you... the Hell's Brew!" "

Chinese: （忍住别说话）
English: (Refrain from speaking)

Chinese: “此汤看似平平无奇，一池热水，其实能将所有得罪您之人折磨到生不如死！”
English: "This brew may seem ordinary. It appears to simply be a pool of hot water. However, it can torment anyone who offends you to the point that they wish they were dead! "

Chinese: “一口饮下，首先全身会感到像被火山灼烧一般的热，随后会感到像是冰封雪原一样的冷！”
English: "With just one sip, they will first feel as if they're being burned by a volcano, then as if they're freezing in an icy tundra! "

Chinese: “再将人全身按进汤中，不用三分钟，整个人就会皮肉融化，化为一摊黑水，最后升腾为一团黑雾，雾中裹挟的灵魂将永远受到您的折磨！！”
English: "Submerge them entirely, and in less than three minutes, their flesh will melt away, turning into a pool of black liquid that will rise as a cloud of black mist. Their souls will remain wrapped in the mist to be tormented by you forever!!"

Chinese: 好哇！真不错！这可真是最为上等的刑场！我收下了！
English: Great! Not bad at all! This is truly the finest execution ground! I will take it!

Chinese: 没那么神奇……
English: It's nothing magical...

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 其实就是一池温泉。
English: It's just a hot spring.

Chinese: ……真的就只是温泉啊……
English: Nothing more, nothing less...
Hmm...

Chinese: 对了，昨天买的那本《吞噬诸神的黑暗之主》还没看完，我先回去啦！
English: You know, yesterday, I bought a book, The Dark Lord Who Devours the Gods, and I haven't finished reading it yet. I'm going to head back now to finish it.

Chinese: 等一下，先别急着走。
English: Wait, don't rush off.

Chinese: 好不容易建起来的，你不试试吗？
English: Building this was no easy feat. Don't you want to try it?
Huh?

Chinese: 我可是很忙的~
English: I'm very busy!

Chinese: 读小说跟忙不沾边吧……
English: Reading a novel is not the same as being busy...
Hmm...

Chinese: 但感觉泡温泉也没什么意思啊，无非就是把身体弄得热乎乎湿漉漉的。
English: But soaking in a hot spring doesn't seem that interesting. It's just getting warm and wet.

Chinese: 除了这里是露天，那跟在浴室里泡澡有什么区别嘛。
English: Other than being outdoors, how is it different from taking a bath in the bathroom?

Chinese: 当然有区别。
English: Of course there's a difference.

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 放松全身，置身在流动的温暖之中，面向天寒地冻的荒芜郊野……
English: Relaxing your entire body, immersing yourself in the flowing warmth, facing the cold and desolate wilderness...

Chinese: 那种感觉……或者说那种无以伦比的意境……
English: That feeling... or rather, that unparalleled atmosphere...

Chinese: 是只有富有智慧的大人才能体会到的。
English: It's something only a wise adult can appreciate.

Chinese: 哼~雕虫小技。
English: Hmph! What a trivial trick.

Chinese: 愚蠢的仆人哟，我本来就是成熟的大人，是不会中这种激将法的。
English: Foolish servant, I am already a mature adult. I won't fall for such provocations.

Chinese: 还是说，堂堂魔王居然怕水？
English: Or perhaps you are saying that the mighty Overlord is afraid of water?
Ha?

Chinese: 哼，看来不偶尔展现一下魔王的威严，下仆也会变得不敬啊！
English: Hmph, it seems if I don't occasionally demonstrate my majesty, the servants will become disrespectful!

Chinese: 嘿咻~！
English: Phew!

Chinese: 喂，等一下，虽然让你泡温泉是我推荐的，但脱衣服去更衣室脱啊。
English: Oh, wait a moment. While I advised that you enjoy the hot spring, you should still undress in the changing room.

Chinese: 怎么？反正这里就只有仆人你在，有什么必要专门去更衣室——
English: What? You're the only one here. Why bother going to the changing room...

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 哦~原来如此——
English: Oh! I see...

Chinese: 是我这副强大而伟岸的身材对仆人来说过于刺激了吧~
English: It's because my strong and magnificent body is too stimulating for you!

Chinese: 更衣室可以收纳衣服还有毛巾——这种事情说晚了，就不好再开口了。
English: The changing room has storage for clothes and towels, But it's too late to explain this.

Chinese: 哼哼~没办法呀，身为魔王，当然拥有匹配的上“王”之名的身材。
English: Heh. There's no helping it, as the Overlord, of course I have a body befitting the title of "Lord."

Chinese: 嘿呀~是我考虑不周，忘记了自己的强大也包括无上的美貌，没想到自己随意的举手投足会给仆人造成那么大动摇……
English: Oh my... It was inconsiderate of me to forget that my strength is coupled with outrageous good looks. I didn't realize my casual gestures would cause such terror for my servants...

Chinese: 不过你也不必自责，无法抵御我的魅力是理所当然的，倒不如说……
English: But there's no need to blame yourself. It's natural to be unable to resist my charm. It would be better to say...

Chinese: 你能够按捺自己膨胀的欲望，没有在此地直接化身为野兽，这才是我的仆人应有的忍耐力，嗯！
English: Being able to restrain your growing desires and not turn into a beast right here is the true mark of my servant's endurance!

Chinese: 既然来都来了，那就让我先享受一下。

Ah!

Chinese: 桃，你在这里吗？

English: Right here. What brings you to me today, my lord? If it's for battle, you should summon me directly...

Chinese: 还是说，主上今日来是另有邀约呢？
English: Or have you come for another purpose today?

Chinese: 你猜对了。
English: You guessed right.

Chinese: 有一个有趣的地方建好了，我想邀你一起去。
English: A fascinating place has been built, and I'd like to invite you to go with me.

Chinese: 呼呼，主上都说有趣了，妾身难免要好奇一下，那是什么样的去处？
English: Haha. Since you say it's fascinating, I'm curious to know what kind of place it is.

Chinese: 在到达之前，我想先保密。
English: I want to keep it a secret until we get there.

Chinese: 保密吗？若说等待答案所用的时间，自然是不足挂齿的。
English: A secret? The time spent waiting for an answer is nothing to worry about.

Chinese: 但若是将与主上相处的时间用于猜测，就有些难熬了。
English: But if the time spent with you is used for guessing, it could become a bit unbearable.

Chinese: 还是说，这就是主上想要带给妾身的滋味？
English: Or is this the feeling you're trying to achieve?

Chinese: 怀抱期待也是惊喜的一环，我想你会喜欢的。
English: Anticipation is part of the surprise. You'll enjoy it.

Chinese: 怀抱期待，就会忐忑不安，像是走在空中，所依靠的，只有一根柔如发丝的期望。
English: Anticipation brings anxiety. It's like walking in the air, relying only on a hair-thin hope.

Chinese: 何等不安，又是何等地……令妾身期待、渴求啊。
English: Such anxiety, and yet... it does make me feel eager and filled with longing.

Chinese: 这样的妾身，能够让主上感到愉悦吗？
English: Does this make you feel pleased, my lord?

Chinese: 是的，我感到愉悦。
English: Yes, it pleases me.

Chinese: 这一根细丝，看起来脆弱无比，一阵风就足以将它吹断，但……若给予它的人是主上，那便不会断裂。
English: This thin thread looks incredibly fragile, a gust of wind could break it, but... if it's given by you, it will hold fast.

Chinese: 依靠着主上，吞咽着苦涩与焦灼，等待最后赏赐的快乐。
English: I'm leaning on you, my lord, swallowing the bitterness and anxiety and waiting for the final reward.

Chinese: 还望主上不要令妾身等待太久才好。
English: I hope you won't make me wait too long.

Chinese: 不，我只是想和你多走一段时间。
English: No, I just want to spend more time walking with you.

Chinese: 拉长漫步的时间吗？这让妾身想起还在那个梦中的时候……
English: Prolonging our walk? This reminds me of when I was still in that dream...

Chinese: 我们也是在这样的夕阳之下，并肩漫步，聊起等待着未来的那个“我”。
English: We were also walking side by side under such a sunset, talking about the future "me" we were waiting for.

Chinese: 那时，妾身等了太久，甚至不敢确定主上究竟是真实存在的，还是梦里造出的，足以欺骗妾身自己的错觉。
English: At that time, I waited so long. I couldn't be sure if you really existed or if you were just a dream that could deceive me.

Chinese: 不会让你等得太久，再转两个弯就到了。
English: I won't make you wait too long. It's just two more turns and then we'll be there.

Chinese: ……有水滴下来了？
English: Did I feel a drop of water?

Chinese: 哎呀……下雨了。
English: Oh... it's raining.

Chinese: 看来，上天也在催促我们呢，主上。还请再靠妾身近些……
English: It seems even the heavens are urging us on, my lord. Please come a bit closer...

Chinese: 路边刚好有这样的大叶子，妾身便借来当伞一用。
English: There's a big leaf by the roadside, I'll use it as an umbrella.

Chinese: 这树上的叶子原本没有这么大，你用了自己的神力？
English: The leaves on this tree weren't this big before, did you use your magic?

Chinese: 一点小小的，为主上而生的奇迹……就当做是您为妾身带来期待的回礼吧。
English: A small miracle for you, my lord... consider it a gift in return for the anticipation you brought me.

Chinese: 不会等太久的，那里离这儿不远。
English: You don't need to wait long. It's not far from here.

Chinese: 妾身知晓了。
English: I understand.

Chinese: 主上，妾身的发饰似乎打湿了。请您再靠过来一些，帮妾身略微打理打理。
English: My lord, it seems my hair ornament is wet. Please come a bit closer and help me adjust it.

Chinese: 好，是这里吗？
English: Alright, is it here?

Chinese: 啾。

Chinese: 完成了这枚柔软的偷袭，她若无其事地挪开了一些。
English: Having completed this gentle ambush, she moved away as if nothing had happened.

Chinese: 我们快些去吧，主上……再不到达，妾身要等不及了哟。
English: Let's hurry, my lord... if we don't get there soon, I won't be able to wait.

Chinese: 妾身还说您为何忽然递来邀约，原来是造了这样一个好去处。

Chinese: 在这样湿冷的下雨天里，能有这样一汪温泉，那是再好不过。

Chinese: 不过，只是这样的天气、有一汪温泉，可不足以让妾身满意啊……

Chinese: 你还想要什么呢，桃？

Chinese: 呵呵……

Chinese: 我感觉到有一根尾巴圈到我的腰上了。这是邀请吗？

Chinese: 自然。您要一起入浴，才能抵得上这份期待啊。

Chinese: 妾身来为主上宽衣……如何？

Chinese: 外衣已经被褪下一半，她的呼吸，温暖地抚摸过我的后颈。
