Chinese: 那就劳烦你了，桃。
English: That would be fine, Momo.

Chinese: 您身上还是沾了寒气呢……湿漉漉的，肩膀和袖口也都是。

Chinese: 来，请您抬手。

Chinese: 不过，就在这里吗？

Chinese: 总不能弄脏温泉吧……呵呵，这可是主上的心意呢。

Chinese: 你啊……
English: You...

Chinese: 您不也迫不及待了吗？妾身可不会像您一样，坏心眼地让人焦灼呢……
English: Aren't you eager too? I won't be as mean as you, making others anxious...

Chinese: 侍主大人~要不要我帮你再加一点水温吱？

Chinese: 你捉弄人的时候性子倒是比平时和缓了，但还是太急。

English: Alright, let me have a moment alone with Momo.

Chinese: 啊，主上，小心。

English: The tray with the bamboo sake is right by your leg. Be careful not to tip it.

Chinese: 原来是竹酿。你带来的？

Chinese: 既是约会，当然不能少了助兴之物。

Chinese: 但只有瓶子，没有杯子吗？
English: So, just the bottle and no cups?

Chinese: 在我这里叽。侍主大人，等我喝完这一杯……

Chinese: ……哎呀。孩子们太淘气了，不然……
English: Oh my. The girls sure are having their fun. Now...

Chinese: 妾身来喂主上，如何？
English: Shall I give you a taste myself, Lord Oracle?

English: I often dream of moments like these, but you're always surrounded by so many lovely ladies, and the occasions are usually far too formal for me to just have my way.

Chinese: 酒先不急着喝，你已经洗完了吗，桃？
English: The wine tasting can wait. Now, have you finished your bath?

English: My hand found her ankle as I hoisted her leg up. My sudden move caught her off guard, and her tails as well, sending them a shiver down her spine.

Chinese: ……您可真是坏心呢。
English: Oh, Lord Oracle... you are quite the devil.

Chinese: 是你先开始的，不是吗？
English: Hey, you're the one who started it.

Chinese: 我懂了，是灭世再创世的关键阶段了对吧！就让我暗之尾来见证！
English: Oh, now it's the crucial phase of the Eruption and Creation, right? Then let me, Shadow Tail, bear witness!

Chinese: 你就少说几句吧吱！
English: Would you just quiet down!

Chinese: 刚刚冒出来的暗之尾又被按回了水中。我暂时放开桃的脚腕，走到她身边坐下。
English: Shadow Tail, who had just popped up, was pushed back into the water. I let go of Momo's ankle and moved to sit beside her.

Chinese: 那柔软的大尾巴又一次拐过来，裹住了我。
English: And again, her soft, fluffy tail wrapped itself around me.

Chinese: 从刚刚开始，你就在掸头发，怎么了？
English: You've been fussing with your hair for a while now, is something wrong?

Chinese: 妾身的头发湿了，还沾着水呢。唉，下水的时候没有注意，泡进水里了，有些沉重。
English: My hair got soaked when I got in. It feels kind of heavy now. Ah, well, should've been more careful.

Chinese: 没注意？你难得有说这句话的时候。转过去，我帮你打理一下。
English: More careful? Well, that's an unusual thing to hear. Turn around, let me help you with that.

Chinese: 万物都在变化之中，主上亦然，妾身亦然；就连这些孩子，说话也变得顺畅了许多。
English: Everything in this world is changing, Lord Oracle, you and I included, even these girls are speaking much more fluently now.

Chinese: 在主上身边，妾身紧绷的神经也会变得松懈……妾身也只能在您的身边如此放松。
English: When I'm with you, Lord Oracle, I can let my guard down... You're the only one I can really relax with.

Chinese: 那么，主上呢？
English: What about you, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 一抹白色在水中翘起，她涂着淡紫色指甲的脚尖勾着水中的月影。
English: A piece of jade rises from the water as her pearly toes with pale purple nail polish, ripple the moon's reflection in the pool.

Chinese: 我也一样。就像你所说的，一切都在变化。
English: I feel the same way. Just like you said, everything's changing.

Chinese: 呵呵……下一次，下下一次……乃至于千百年后，我们也一起来享受温泉吧。
English: Hehe... next time, and the time after that... even centuries from now, let's always enjoy the spa together.

Chinese: 岁岁年年，与君常相见。
English: Year after year, may we always meet like this.

Chinese: 虽然过去了几百年，但是这里几乎没有变化……
English: Hundreds of years have passed, and it looks practically the same...

Chinese: 因为是休渔期，没有人会来这里，我想，作为一日度假的区域，应该能让您尽情游玩。
English: And since it's not fishing season, no one's likely to show up. I thought it would be a nice one-day getaway for you.

Chinese: 那么，塞蕾丝蒂娜，你带泳衣了吗？
English: So, Celestina, did you bring a swimsuit?

Chinese: ……您之前说的妥当的装束，不是指“能够在水边行动的衣饰”吗？毫无疑问，我目前的衣装是达标的。
English: Didn't you say "proper attire"? Like, clothes you can wear by the water? Pretty sure this outfit fits the bill.

Chinese: 虽然做出了邀请的举动，但果然不能指望她完全开窍。
English: Although she accepted the invitation, she was not one to be easily reasoned with.

Chinese: 我将自己携带的袋子向她递过去。
English: I hand her the bag I'm carrying.

Chinese: 试试这个吧。
English: Try this.

Chinese: 啊……是我误会了什么吗？
English: Whoa... Did we miss something here?

Chinese: 来海边总要穿泳装。既然没有准备，那就试试看这件吧。
English: Look, beaches call for swimsuits. You weren't prepared, so here's one. Try it on.

Chinese: 如果试了觉得不习惯，也可以换掉。
English: If you don't like it, you can just change back.

Chinese: 实在抱歉，身为您的星痕，居然多次要您为我费心到这种地步……
English: Ugh, I'm so sorry, Lord Oracle. You shouldn't have to deal with my incompetence as an Aster all the time...

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜羞愧地低下头，双手接过我递过去的袋子，退到一棵较粗壮的树后去更衣了。
English: Celestina lowers her head in shame, takes the bag I handed over with both hands, and retreats behind a wide tree to change clothes.

English: None

Chinese: 我一边换衣服，一边等待着她更衣完毕。然而刚脱下一件衣服，我就听见了她的惊呼声——
English: As I adjust my attire, I patiently await Celestina's completion of her own preparations. But the second I take off a piece of clothing, I hear a high-pitched squeak...

Chinese: ……怎么会！？
English: Why!?

Chinese: 侍侍侍侍侍主大人……您……您真的……真的没有……
English: Lord, Lord, Lord Oracle... you... you really... really don't...

Chinese: 意料之中的疑问。我回过头，塞蕾丝蒂娜藏身在粗壮的树干后，只露出一张红通通的脸。
English: I'm not shocked by her reaction. I turn around to see Celestina peeking from behind the tree, her face as red as a sunset.

Chinese: 怎么了，塞蕾丝蒂娜？
English: What's up, Celestina?

Chinese: 我……您……这衣装究竟……
English: I... you... what exactly are these clothes...

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜磕磕绊绊半天，也没能说出一句完整的话来。
English: Celestina stammers, unable to complete a sentence.

Chinese: 要换一件吗？
English: Do you want a different one?

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜露出了犹豫的神色。她咬着自己的下唇，什么也没有说，就这么退回了树后。
English: Celestina looks hesitant. She bites her lower lip, says nothing, and retreats further behind the tree.

Chinese: 见她没说什么，我也继续更换自己的衣服。
English: Seeing that she don't say anything, I continue changing my clothes.

Chinese: 要问为什么我们会出现在这里，她又是为什么会发出这样的疑问，那就得从三天前说起……
English: To grasp the context of our current situation and Celestina's bewilderment, let us turn back the pages of time to three days earlier...

English: None

Chinese: 三天前。
English: Three days ago.

Chinese: 上午十点的阳光已经开始变得炽烈，厚实的绿叶在门边的花坛里轻轻摇摆。
English: Under the scorching sun of a ten o'clock morning, the verdant foliage rustled softly beside the doorway.

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜将办公室的窗帘轻轻拉上，挡住天光后，悄然走出了办公室。
English: Celestina, with a delicate touch, drew the office curtains to shield the room from the glaring light before making her silent exit.

English: None

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 里面情况怎么样？
English: How's it going inside?

Chinese: 已经把瑞比娅和贝卡丝都赶出去了，目前侍主一个人在里面休息。
English: Kicked out Reybia and Beccas. Lord Oracle's enjoying some alone time.

Chinese: 瑞比娅是从哪里进去和出来的？在下竟然毫无所觉。
English: Reybia snuck in and out? Totally missed that.

Chinese: 她从窗户进来的，我把她从窗户丢出去了。
English: Yeah, she slipped through the window. I chucked her out the same way.

Chinese: 在下了解了。
English: I see now.

Chinese: 近期神谕司闲下来一些，许多星痕就更不老实了。身为侍主保护协会，我等任重而道远。
English: Seems like the Oracle Division's have too much time on their hands these days. The Asters are upping their prank game. Looks like we've still got our work cut out for us with the Lord Oracle Protection Association.

Chinese: 我不理解。神谕司闲下来一些，不是正应该好好休息吗？
English: I don't see why. With some free time on their hands, they should be kicking back, right?

Chinese: 在下也不明白。为了一己私欲损害主公的休息时间，在下实在难以将其称之为爱。
English: Beats me. Doesn't feel like love if you're messing with someone's downtime for your own kicks.

Chinese: 在两人交谈间，奈奥米收起长枪，走到雷雷和塞蕾丝蒂娜的身边。
English: As they chatted, Naomi stowed her spear and sauntered over to ReiRei and Celestina.

Chinese: 会长，我这边也已经结束了。
English: Everything's sorted out at this end too, my lord.

Chinese: 作为侍主保护协会的新人，奈奥米小姐，你有非常优秀的才能。
English: Naomi, you're killing it as the newbie in the Master Protective Association. You've got some exceptional talent.

Chinese: 谬赞了，这只是女仆的基本素养而已。
English: Aw, shucks. It's nothing, just maid 101.

Chinese: 奈奥米带着无懈可击的微笑躬了躬身。
English: Naomi replied with a bow and a flawless smile.

Chinese: 另外，关于二位刚才的话题，我倒是知晓一些情报。
English: Hey, I caught wind of something about what you guys were just talking about.

Chinese: 奈奥米小姐，你探知到了什么？请你告诉我们。
English: Naomi. What's the scoop? Spill it.

Chinese: 雷雷也将目光投向奈奥米。面对二人的目光，奈奥米竖起一根食指。
English: ReiRei leaned in, eager to hear more. Naomi lifted an index finger, commanding their attention.

Chinese: 众所周知，按目前的工作流程，主人可以享有一整天的假期。
English: Well, as far as I know, with how things are run, Lord Oracle, you should have a whole day to just be.

Chinese: ……我现在刚刚知道。
English: That's news to me.

Chinese: 无需为此困扰，塞蕾丝蒂娜小姐，并不是每个人都能对文书工作了如指掌。
English: Don't sweat it, Celestina. Not everyone's a whiz with the paperwork.

Chinese: ——回归正题。尽管星痕们无法对侍主使用强制手段，但规则内的“争取”是可以的。
English: Let's stay on point. Even though the Asters can't strong-arm Lord Oracle, they're all about "actively soliciting" within the rules.

Chinese: 因此，许多星痕正在试图占有侍主的假日。
English: So, they're all trying to hog his day off.

Chinese: 试图占有……为何要这么做？我等的时间应由侍主大人决定如何使用。
English: Why bother doing that? We should be at Lord Oracle's beck and call.

Chinese: 尽管侍主大人给了我们相当程度的自由，但要反过来占有他的闲暇时间，大家不会感到愧疚吗？
English: Lord Oracle has been quite lenient in giving us freedom, but wouldn't you feel guilty for taking up his time off

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜说完，发现奈奥米和雷雷都用奇怪的眼神看着她。
English: Finishing her thought, Celestina caught Naomi and ReiRei giving her the side-eye.

Chinese: ……为什么用这种眼神看着我？我有哪里说的不对吗？
English: What's with the looks? Did I say something wrong?

Chinese: 不。你不常和其他星痕交际，知道的也只有基础规则，会这么说不奇怪。
English: No. You do not exactly mingle with the other Asters much. All you've got is the basic do's and don'ts. No wonder you're out of the loop.

Chinese: 但众所周知，侍主平时对大多数星痕都是随缘相处，能让他主动提出邀约的只有审判长牧。
English: But you know, Lord Oracle's pretty laid back with most Asters, except for Lord Inquisitor Muu. She's the only one who can get Lord Oracle to send out an invite.

Chinese: 其他时候，都是星痕主动去争取主人的精力。也是因此，才会有种种乱象……
English: Otherwise, it's on the Asters to actively solicit his time. That's why everything's turned into a hot mess...

Chinese: 也就是说，侍主大人每天的约会，其实并非出自自己的意愿，而是碰上谁，就答应谁的邀请吗？
English: So, you're saying Lord Oracle's daily hangouts aren't really his pick, but he just goes with whoever pops the request?

Chinese: 正因如此，星痕们大多都经过精心的计算，来使得自己与主人的相遇充满浪漫和情趣。
English: Exactly. That's why the Asters are going all out to make their run-ins with Lord Oracle seem all dreamy and exciting.

Chinese: 当然，也有靠运气碰到主人，提出邀约而被垂爱的人……
English: And sure, some get lucky, shoot their shot, and hit it off...

Chinese: 奈奥米轻轻撩了一下鬓边的碎发。
English: Naomi paused to tuck a loose strand of hair behind her ear.

Chinese: 但幸运可是会用完的。
English: But hey, luck's not always on your side.

Chinese: 在听到这句话时，塞蕾丝蒂娜的心跳漏了一拍。
English: When she heard these words, Celestina's heart skipped a beat.

Chinese: 原来是这样。我明白了，谢谢你们的解释。
English: I see. Thanks for your explanation.

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜不记得自己是怎么和雷雷与奈奥米告别的，也不记得自己究竟是怎样离开神谕司，走到花园里去的。
English: Celestina stepped into the garden, though the memory of her parting with ReiRei and Naomi, or her departure from the Oracle Division, eluded her.

Chinese: （我明明从未想过能和侍主大人发展那种过于亲密的关系，为什么会被奈奥米的话动摇呢。）
English: (I never intend to develop the bond I seem to feel toward Lord Oracle. But why was I swayed by Naomi's words?)

Chinese: （只是想要陪在他身边，只是想成为他最亲近和信任的剑。）
English: (I just wanted to remain by his side as his most faithful and trusted blade.)

Chinese: （为他奉献出这条虚假的性命，为侍主大人的胜利献上关键的一击，无论何时都紧紧追随着他。这就是我全部的希望。）
English: (To devote my borrowed existence to his cause, to strike a decisive blow for Lord Oracle's triumph, and to shadow him without falter. These are what I believed to be my calling.)

English: None

Chinese: （只是想成为他亲近与信任的剑。只要仍然做肃清之爪，就足够了。）
English: (I just wanted to be his close and trusted sword. I thought my role as the Talon of Purge would satisfy me.)

Chinese: （我原本是这么想的。因为我的天职……我的命运，只能做到这一步。）
English: (That's what I originally thought. Because this is the best I can do due to my calling... and destiny.)

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜轻轻按着自己柔软的胸口，蹙着眉头，像是要阻止心跳那样，用力地按压下去。
English: With a furrowed brow, Celestina pressed against her tender chest, as if to quell the rebellious beating of her heart,

Chinese: （塞蕾丝蒂娜，你不可以逾越。）

Chinese: （幸运是会被用完的，即使一时被侍主大人注视，那也不代表全部……）
English: (Luck's not always on your side. A fleeting favor from Lord Oracle doesn't mean you get all his time...)

Chinese: （但，为什么……）
English: (But why...)

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜注视着面前伸着懒腰的猫咪，试图转移注意力。
English: She tried to distract herself by watching a cat stretch.

Chinese: （看着猫，塞蕾丝蒂娜。你能重新存在于此，是侍主大人的恩赐，你与被允许活在此处的猫咪没有不同。）
English: (Celestina, look at that cat. Makes you think, huh? Being here, it's all thanks to Lord Oracle. Kinda like that cat, just living its best life.)

Chinese: （即使侍主大人带你出行数次……即使你曾和侍主大人共同制作了纸灯……即使侍主大人原谅了你在噩梦未醒时的应激反应……）
English: (Yeah, Lord Oracle's taken you on trips... you've made paper lanterns together... he's even got over you losing it from nightmares...)

Chinese: （即使侍主大人还学了猫叫……侍主大人实在十分可爱。如果没有侍主大人，你以为你现在又在哪里？）
English: (And him meowing? That's just him being adorable... But let's be real, you owe it all to him.)

Chinese: （……转移注意力没有用，我又开始想侍主大人了。）
English: (No point trying to look away. You're missing Lord Oracle again, aren't you?)

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜转身，大步向广场走去。
English: With a turn of her heel, Celestina advanced toward the square.

Chinese: 在心乱如麻的此刻，她习惯性地想要通过温习武术而祛除自己的不安。
English: Amidst her bewilderment, she tried to find comfort in the discipline of martial arts.

Chinese: 然而就在这时，像是要与她纷乱的心绪作对似的，她瞧见了那个熟悉的身影。
English: However, at that moment, as if to challenge her inner disarray, she saw the familiar silhouette.

Chinese: 一瞬间，所有的杂念都被澄净。她毫不犹豫地向着那个人走去。
English: With the scattering of all distractions, she approached him with unwavering resolve.

Chinese: 难得没有人打扰地睡了一个午觉，醒来的时候，阳光已经带上了些许夕暮的橙红色。
English: It's rare to have an undisturbed nap, and when I woke up, the sunlight had already taken on a hint of the evening's orange-red hue.

Chinese: 我用力活动了发酸的肩颈。随着我直起身，肩膀上的毛毯自然地滑落下去，堆在椅子上。

Chinese: ……竟然一整天都没有新的工作，真不敢相信，我居然也能有这么闲的时候。
English: Nothing to do all day. I never thought I'd have such a relaxing time.

Chinese: 那是因为今天的工作全都是日常，已经被处理完毕了。
English: Well, today's tasks were all routine, and you've already completed them.

Chinese: 安洁，你是什么时候来的？
English: Angie, when did you get here?

English: I felt startled when she spoke suddenly. I turned around and saw the serene Nova sitting in the corner of the office.

Chinese: 一个预先设计好的隐匿魔法而已，只要不出声，就没有人会发现。
English: Just a pre-designed concealment spell. No noise, no notice.

Chinese: 所以，工作是你帮忙处理完的吗？
English: You helped me with my work?

Chinese: 不止我一个帮了忙，所以早早就结束了。
English: I wasn't the only one helping, so the work went quickly.

Chinese: 谢谢你。
English: Thank you.

Chinese: 你在这里守着我午睡吗？
English: Are you here to watch over me as I nap?

Chinese: 不完全是。
English: Not entirely.

Chinese: 被塞蕾丝蒂娜和雷雷清理过的办公室很安静，比图书馆还要适合看书，所以我在这里。仅此而已。
English: Celestina and ReiRei made the office a quieter, and more favorable reading room than the library. So I am here.

Chinese: 难怪今天的午觉睡得很好，原来是塞蕾丝蒂娜和雷雷来过了。
English: Had Celestina and ReiRei been here? No wonder I had a sound nap.

Chinese: 是啊，多亏了她们清理得够干净和坚决，这间办公室才能变得这么安静。
English: Uh-huh, they were so thorough and decisive with their cleaning, it's so quiet.

Chinese: 听说她们建立了侍主保护协会，奈奥米也参与其中。这就是近期星痕闹腾的次数变少的原因吧。
English: I heard they established a Lord Oracle Protection Association, and Naomi is involved too. That's probably why the number of incidents caused by the Asters has decreased recently.

Chinese: 那是什么？我第一次听到。
English: What's that? That's news to me.

Chinese: “侍主保护协会”。
English: Lord Oracle Protection Association.

Chinese: 安洁重复了一遍。
English: Angie repeated.

Chinese: 有想要千方百计偷跑的人，当然也就会有想要守护您不受打扰的人。
English: Some will go to great lengths to sneak away, and naturally, some are willing to protect you from being disturbed.

Chinese: 我看着她，心里有个模糊的猜测浮上水面。
English: I looked at her, and a vague guess surfaced in my mind.

Chinese: 她们是什么时候离开的？
English: When did they leave?

Chinese: 中午。
English: At noon.

Chinese: 所以，那之后，你接替了她们？
English: So, after that, you took over?

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜小姐拜托了我。再者，做这件事也不影响我温书。
English: Miss Celestina asked me to. And this doesn't interfere with my reading.

Chinese: 安洁合上书本，站起身。
English: Angie closed her book and stood up.

Chinese: 你会答应星痕的拜托，这也很少见。
English: It's rare for you to agree to a request from an Aster.

Chinese: 是吗？或许是因为她看起来很矛盾吧。
English: Really? Maybe because she looked quite conflicted.

Chinese: 很矛盾？
English: Conflicted?

Chinese: 我们英明神武的侍主大人，如果您真的关心那些星痕，那么就亲自去看。
English: Lord Oracle the Wise and Brave, if you really care about them, then go see them yourself.

Chinese: 安洁啪地一声合上书。
English: Angie snapped her book shut.

Chinese: ……（惹得她不高兴了。）
English: (It seems that I've upset her.)

Chinese: 我关心她们，也关心你。要一起去度假吗？
English: I care about both you and them. Do you want to go on a vacation together?

Chinese: 感谢您的关照。不过，就算是我，也不想和挂心另一个女人的男人一起度假呢。
English: Thanks for your invitation. But even I wouldn't want a vacation with a man who's worried about another woman.

Chinese: 等您解决了自己挂心的事，再来邀请我吧。
English: Settle your concerns first.

Chinese: 说完，她离开了这个房间。
English: With that, she left the room.

Chinese: 安洁说的没错。在她说出那句话后，我确实更挂念塞蕾丝蒂娜的状态。
English: Angie was right. I was concerned about Celestina after hearing what she said.

Chinese: 这位女战士不善言辞，行事也有些笨拙。
English: This female warrior is not good with words and is a bit clumsy in her actions.

Chinese: 相比于许多灵巧懂事的星痕，她显得更让人担心。
English: Compared to many clever and sensible Asters, she seems more worrisome.

Chinese: （去找找她吧。她现在的位置应该在……）
English: (Go find her. She should be at...)

Chinese: （如果是有什么事想不通的话，她应该是在——花园的撸猫角。）
English: (If she's troubled by something, she should be... at the cat corner in the garden.)

Chinese: 神谕司算是三司中最不严肃的地方，从雷雷带来忍猫后，有一些馋猫而不得的星痕偷偷在花园里养了猫。
English: The Oracle Division is considered the most flexible in management among the three divisions. After ReiRei brought the ninja cat, some cat-loving Asters secretly started raising a cat in the garden.

Chinese: 这猫的主人是谁，没有定论，因此它活得更像野猫，时常在花园里太阳最好的地方伸懒腰。

Chinese: 在我走近的时候，塞蕾丝蒂娜主动向我走过来，表情一如既往地认真，怎么也看不出有矛盾的地方。

Chinese: 啊，就是午睡睡得好不好的意思。
English: Ah, I just want to be sure you had a good nap.

Chinese: ……啊，因为太紧张，不小心用了奇怪的说法，十分抱歉。
English: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just too nervous and said something weird.

Chinese: 这没什么。都相处这么久了，怎么反而紧张起来了？
English: No big deal. We've been together for so long, why are you getting nervous now?

Chinese: 我在想……
English: I was thinking...

Chinese: （我在想您。）
English: (I was thinking about you.)

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜不明白自己为什么想这么说。她咽下最后一个字，感到咽喉冰冷生痛，像吞咽了一块钻石。
English: Celestina didn't understand why she had this thought. She swallowed the last word, feeling a cold pain in her throat, like swallowing a diamond.

Chinese: 我在想，最近做的纸灯，终于有些样子了。
English: I was thinking that the lanterns I've been making recently are finally taking shape.

Chinese: 也许下一次灯会，我也能参与制作……
English: Maybe I could use them in the next lantern festival...

Chinese: 不是也许，而是该去了。
English: Be confident. You can definitely do it.

Chinese: 我还不能确定……您已经看到未来了吗？
English: I'm not sure yet... have you seen the future?

Chinese: 你练了这么久，我都看在眼里。按这个进步的速度，只要目标不是做猫纸灯，都能做得很精妙吧。
English: I've seen how hard you've been practicing all this time. With the rate of progress, as long as you don't make a cat lantern, everything else will be exquisite.

Chinese: 啊……猫的话，确实是……完全没有办法去做。
English: Ah... indeed... I have no way of making one.

Chinese: 但也渐渐地，开始习惯了。
English: But somehow, I'm getting used to it.

Chinese: 习惯了没有猫的生活？
English: Getting used to life without cats?

Chinese: ……倒也没有。只是，习惯了……能去陪伴特别的人，那么猫也……不是很重要了。
English: Not exactly. It's just that getting used to being with someone special makes cats less important.

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜的手捏着短短的衣服边缘，轻轻细细地捻着。
English: Celestina's hand pinched the hem of her short clothes, gently twiddling it.

Chinese: 侍主大人，我有一件事，想问问您的看法。
English: Lord Oracle, I'd like to ask you something.

Chinese: 你说。
English: Sure.

Chinese: 如果有一个人，长久地注视着您，没有错过您的任何信息……
English: If there was someone who watched you for a long time, never missing even the slightest detail about you...

Chinese: 听起来不像是人，像是神明。
English: That sounds less like a person and more like a deity.

Chinese: 也许就是一位神明。嗯……但您不能确定，这位神明对您是什么样的想法。
English: Maybe it is a deity. Hmm... but you can't be sure what this deity thinks of you.

Chinese: 您会怎么做呢？
English: What would you do?

Chinese: 那要看我对她是否有兴趣。
English: That depends on whether I'm interested in her.

Chinese: 如果……有的话，您会怎么做？
English: If... you were, what would you do?

Chinese: 我会试试接近她，如果可以，约她同行，来仔细观察她的态度。
English: I would try to approach her, and if possible, invite her to go for a walk and carefully observe how she reacts.

Chinese: 这样……我斗胆设想过您的回答，也……差不多就是这样。
English: I see... I was already guessing what you would reply, and... it's pretty much the same.

Chinese: 因为您就是这样的人。
English: Because that's who you are.

Chinese: 她望着我，眼睛里闪着光，期待的，柔软的，似乎下定了某种决心。
English: She looked at me, her eyes softly shining with expectation as if she had made some kind of decision.

Chinese: 夕阳垂落在我们的身上，赶在最后的温暖消失之前，她低声开了口。
English: The setting sun fell on us, and she spoke softly with the last moment of warmth.

Chinese: 我听说您最近不太忙了。不知道能不能请您……去度假呢？
English: I heard you're not very busy lately. I wonder if I could invite you... on a vacation.

Chinese: 我知道一个好地方，距离圣城不太远，是一片……很安静的海域。
English: I know a good place, not far from the sacred city, a very... quiet seaside.

Chinese: 那个，也许您已经去过类似的地方，但这里不会有其他人，非常安静。
English: You might have been to similar places, but there is no one else there, it's very peaceful.

Chinese: 那里的天很蓝，云也很白，就像是……就像是……
English: The sky there is just so blue, and the fluffy clouds are so white. It's like... like...

Chinese: 看着她绞尽脑汁试图说服我去的样子，实在是惹人怜爱。在她卡壳的时候，我接上了她的话头。
English: Watching her try so hard to convince me was really adorable. When she got stuck, I finished her sentence.

Chinese: 好啊。
English: Sure.

Chinese: 而且……而且抱歉，您刚才说了什么？
English: And... and sorry, what did you just say?

Chinese: 好啊。明天交接完工作，我们可以出去走走。
English: Sure. We can go on a vacation after I hand over my work tomorrow.

Chinese: 大概要几天？
English: How long will we be away for?

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜？你在听吗？
English: Celestina? Are you listening?

Chinese: 抱歉，我……我知道了。
English: Sorry, I... I got it.

Chinese: 没想到您真的会答应……非常感谢，我一定会保证您的……安全。
English: I didn't expect you'd really agree. Thank you very much, I'll make sure of your safety.

Chinese: 在安全之外，我也希望我们都能快乐。
English: Well, I also hope we can both be happy there.

Chinese: 我……不确定怎样才能算是快乐，如果您有指令的话，我会尽力的。
English: I... am not sure what happiness is, but if you have instructions, I'll do my best.

Chinese: 要说的话，就是享受假期应有的气氛。
English: Well, just enjoy the vacation.

Chinese: 穿着合适的衣服去做合适的事，比如冲浪、潜泳之类吧。
English: Get appropriate equipment and do things that are appropriate for the occasion, like surfing or diving.

Chinese: ……我会慎重地考虑的。
English: I'll think about it carefully.

Chinese: 她严肃地点了点头。
English: She nodded seriously.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 次日。炽烈的阳光打在宽敞的桌面上，一片眩目的反光将室内照得通明。
English: The next day. The blazing sunlight hit the spacious desk, the dazzling reflection lighting up the room.

Chinese: 面对着已经没有文书、变得干干净净的桌面，个头娇小的瑞比娅做出了总结。
English: Seeing the paper-free, clean desk, petite Reybia made her guess.

Chinese: 所以，您又要把这些工作都堆在我头上，自己跑去玩了对吧？
English: So, you're going to dump all this work on me and go off to have fun, right?

Chinese: 真没想到，塞蕾丝蒂娜竟然也变成了这么卑鄙的女人……
English: I never thought Celestina would turn out to be that crafty...

Chinese: 听说是很好的地方。这几天也不会有什么重大的工作，如果有什么急事，你派信隼来找我就好。
English: I heard it's a very nice place. The next few days should be pretty quiet. If there's an emergency, just send a carrier falcon to find me.

Chinese: 好吧！既然您都这么信任小瑞比娅了，小瑞比娅还能怎么办呢？
English: Fine! Since you trust me so much, what else can I say?

Chinese: 至少要告诉我，是去什么地方吧。
English: But at least tell me where you're going.

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜说是海边，距离圣城最近的一片安静的海域。
English: Celestina said it's by the sea, a quiet area closest to the sacred city.

Chinese: 哦！这个地方，我也知道。
English: Oh! I know that place, too.

Chinese: 你也知道？
English: You do?

Chinese: 您还记得在圣别之塔时，我们进入的那片幻境吗？
English: Do you remember the illusion we entered at the Tower of Sanctity?

Chinese: 你还好意思提。
English: You have the nerve to bring that up.

Chinese: 诶嘿嘿，您也没有怪我嘛！
English: Hehe, but you didn't blame me!

Chinese: 瑞比娅调皮地吐吐舌头，又转个身踮起脚亲一下我的脸颊。
English: Reybia playfully stuck out her tongue, then turned around and stood on her tiptoes to kiss my cheek.

Chinese: 那片幻境里的湖还在现实中存在的时候，最后就会汇入那片海域呢。
English: When the lake in the illusion still existed, it would eventually flow into that sea.

Chinese: 你怎么知道？
English: How do you know about that?

Chinese: 那时候的圣别之塔上能看见湖，湖远去的地方，就是海。
English: Back then, you could see the lake from the Tower of Sanctity, and where the lake flowed far away, there was the sea.

Chinese: 所以，在我离开圣别之塔后做的第一件事，就是沿着湖的去向，去亲眼看了那片海。
English: So, the first thing I did after leaving the Tower of Sanctity was to follow the lake's direction and lay eyes on the sea myself.

Chinese: 那时候感觉怎么样？
English: How did it feel back then?

Chinese: 自由。我得到了自由，但是还不够。
English: It felt like freedom. I felt free, but it wasn't enough.

Chinese: 我恨死这些人了。就算到了现在……啊啊，气死了！我要狠狠地报复！
English: I hated those people! Even now... ugh, they get me so worked up! I will make them pay!

Chinese: 注意到我在看她，她立刻挥舞着小拳头，很生气似的大呼小叫。
English: Noticing me looking at her, she immediately waved her little fists and shouted angrily.

Chinese: 是是，你想怎么报复？
English: Alright, how's your plan?

Chinese: 配合着她用力的表演，我点点头。
English: I nodded, matching her vigorous performance.

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜那种木头，光是把她杀了，一点用都没有。
English: Just killing someone as dull as Celestina is pointless.

Chinese: 要报复她，就要给她顶级的折磨，让她爱别离，求不得，狠狠地受辱，面红耳赤羞愤欲死也无法反抗！
English: To get back at her, you need to give her the ultimate torment, make her suffer from unfulfilled desires, and humiliate her so deeply that she blushes with shame and is unable to resist!

Chinese: 瑞比娅幼稚的脸上露出了阴险的笑容。
English: An insidious smile stretch out on Reybia's childish face.

Chinese: 所以，这件事需要侍主大人的帮忙！
English: So, I need your help with this, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 不帮。
English: Not a chance.

Chinese: 好干脆……别这么急着拒绝小瑞比娅嘛！
English: So straightforward... Why are you so hurried to refuse me?

Chinese: 至少听一听嘛，看在小瑞比娅这么可爱的份上……也许我能给您一个不那么忍心拒绝的条件呢？
English: Just for my cuteness, at least hear me out. Maybe I can make you an offer you can't refuse.

Chinese: 瑞比娅可怜巴巴地眨着眼睛，双手扶着我的衣襟，左右摇晃着。
English: Reybia blinked pitifully, holding onto my lapel and swaying from side to side.

Chinese: 好吧，看在你可爱的份上，可以说说看。
English: Alright, go ahead.

Chinese: 小瑞比娅当然也不会想着杀死塞蕾丝蒂娜啦，现在我们都是侍主大人的星痕了嘛。
English: Of course, I'm thinking about killing Celestina. After all, we're all your Asters now.

Chinese: 既要让侍主大人尝到鲜，又能报复到塞蕾丝蒂娜，小瑞比娅可是花费了很——长——时间！才定下这个方案的！
English: I wanted to get back to her while you two have a happy vacation together. I spent a very—long—time planning it.

Chinese: 你听到这个消息也才几分钟的时间吧。
English: You've only known about this for a few minutes.

Chinese: 这是分秒必争的时候，晚一点儿也不行，我可是晚了好几分钟呢。
English: It's a race against time, and I'm already several minutes late!

Chinese: 这可是您和塞蕾丝蒂娜的第一次约会，怎么能不带礼物去见女孩子呢，那她多可怜啊。
English: This is your first date with Celestina. How could you not bring a gift? She would feel down in the dumps if you did that!

Chinese: 你是想……
English: You mean...

Chinese: 但是您不用担心！您贴心的辅佐官小瑞比娅，帮您准备了一份礼物给塞蕾丝蒂娜~
English: But don't worry! I, your considerate assistant, have prepared you one.

Chinese: 稍等，我现在就去给您拿来……唔，还是请您跟我去一趟吧？
English: Wait a moment, I'll get it for you now... hmm, could you come with me?

Chinese: 到底是什么东西，这么神神秘秘的？
English: Suspicious... What exactly is it?

Chinese: 您跟我来就知道了嘛。
English: Just come with me, and you'll see it yourself.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 你说的礼物，就是这个？
English: This is the gift you were talking about?

Chinese: 怎么样，很不错的礼物吧？
English: Isn't it great?

Chinese: 她不会喜欢的，我也不想强迫她。
English: She won't like it. I don't want to force her to accept this.

Chinese: 您都没有送出去过，怎么知道她喜不喜欢呢？
English: How do you know she won't like it? You haven't given it to her yet.

Chinese: 她要是真的完全没兴趣，您放弃就好了嘛！
English: If she's really not interested, then you can just take it back.

Chinese: 那我就试试吧。
English: Alright, I guess I'll give it a try.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 那之后，我就和塞蕾丝蒂娜一起来了海滩。
English: After that, I went to the seaside with Celestina.

Chinese: （会不会对她刺激太大了一些？虽然她的作战装束这么清凉，但其实意外地是个保守的女性。）
English: (Would this be too much of a shock for her? Even though her combat outfit is quite revealing, she's actually rather conservative.)

Chinese: （再过一会儿，如果还是克服不了这一关，就“命令”她不要换了吧。）
English: (I'll wait a little while and if she doesn't accept it, I'll "order" her not to change.)

Chinese: 穿好我自己的泳装，我正要向她所藏身的那棵树后说点什么，就看见树的影子——准确来说，是树后的影子动了。
English: After putting on my swimsuit, I'm about to say something to her as she hides behind a tree. Then the shadow of the tree starts to move—well, more accurately, the shadow behind the tree is moving.

Chinese: 倚靠着那棵树的、修长又柔软的影子靠着树反弓起腰，手臂探到背后，摸索着什么。
English: Her slender and supple shadow leans against the tree as her back arched. The shadowy arms reach behind, groping for something.

Chinese: 片刻后，那窈窕的影子又弓起身，抬起腿，将一片柔软的影子从身上扯下。
English: Moments later, the graceful shadow arches again, lifting a leg and tugging a soft-looking shadow down the length of its body.

Chinese: 今天的海浪似乎有些太喧嚣了。以至于我本想发出的声音被浪卷走。我静默地观看着那一片阴影的形变。
English: Today's waves seem especially loud. Even my voice is swept away by the waves. I silently watch as the shadow changes.

Chinese: 那窈窕的身影或许是觉得冷，短暂地用手抱住了双肩。随后，她很快放开了手，蹲下身去。
English: That graceful figure, perhaps feeling cold, briefly hugs her shoulders. Then she quickly lets go, crouching down.

Chinese: 海蓝色的长发迤逦在地，从树影里舒展开来。在长发间，有一片像是错觉般耀眼的白皙肌肤，在光影间摇曳着。
English: Her long, sea-blue hair trails on the ground, spreading out from the shadow of the tree. Amidst the long hair, a bit of dazzling fair skin peeks through the shifting light and shadow.

Chinese: 影子再动，她的腰部靠上树干，这次曲起腿是为了让一片轻薄的影子贴上身体。
English: The shadow moves again, her waist against the tree trunk, this time raising a leg to pull a sliver of shadow upward along her body.

Chinese: 它似乎比之前脱离的影子更难贴合，她摇晃了两三下，闪着白光的龙尾卷上树干，尾尖在我的视野里垂下。
English: It seems harder to put on than the bit of shadow she just removed. She seems to lose her balance for a moment, and the glowing white dragon tail curls around the tree trunk, its tip resting just within my view.

Chinese: 能够诛杀怪物与叛军的手，却像是对这片镂空的布料毫无办法似的。
English: The hands that could slay monsters and rebels seem helpless against this piece of delicate fabric.

Chinese: 好在不过一会儿，她便舒展开来。
English: Fortunately, after a moment, she manages to get it on.

Chinese: 十分抱歉，侍主大人，我耗费了太多的时间……
English: Sorry, for taking so long Lord Oracle...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 她从树后走出。在这一刻，我忽然意识到，她矫健的身躯——原来在另一种意义上，也很有杀伤力。
English: She steps out from behind the tree. At that moment, I suddenly realize that her athletic figure has a different kind of lethal power.

Chinese: ……侍主大人，我穿这个……
English: Lord Oracle, how do I...

Chinese: 见我一时没有说话，她咬了咬自己的下唇，像要遮挡自己的身体似的，用左手抱住了右臂。
English: Noticing my silence, she bites her lower lip and hugs her right arm with her left hand, as if to cover her body.

Chinese: 如果是平时，这样的姿态不会有什么问题，但在布料稀少的当下，软绵的山丘立刻被挤压耸起，堆在她的手腕边。
English: Normally, such a posture won't be an issue, but with so little fabric, the soft swell on her chest is immediately lifted up, piling up at her wrist.

Chinese: ……那个……看来……还可以……吗？
English: Well, what do you think?

Chinese: 她觑着我的表情，试探着询问。
English: She glances at my expression as she tentatively asks her question.

Chinese: 感觉还不错。
English: It looks good on you.

Chinese: 得到了我肯定的回答，那双原本打定主意要遮掩的手臂，也略微放下了一些。
English: Receiving my affirmative answer, those arms that are initially set on covering up relaxed a bit.

Chinese: 太好了。我本来还在担心，这件衣服会不会让我显得太过……不知羞耻。
English: Great. I'm worried that this outfit may make me look too... shameless.

Chinese: 说来……您为什么会选择这样的泳衣呢？
English: I'm wondering... why did you choose this swimsuit?

Chinese: 这样的衣服，简直就像是……
English: This sort of outfit is just like...

Chinese: 像是？
English: Like what?

Chinese: 像是瑞比娅和珀莉会选的那种……存在就像是叛逆本身的泳装。
English: Like the kind Reybia and Peri would choose... a swimsuit that embodies rebellion.

Chinese: 其实就是瑞比娅选的。
English: Actually, Reybia picked it.

Chinese: ……那女人想看我的笑话，所以才向您献上了这样的诡计，是吗？
English: I see... That woman wanted me to make a fool of myself. That's it, isn't it?

Chinese: 她的表情变得冷硬。
English: Her expression turns cold.

Chinese: 等到回去之后，我会让她知道耍弄阴谋者的下场。
English: When we get back, I'll make her understand the consequences of scheming.

Chinese: 但也是我同意的。
English: But I also agreed with the selection.

Chinese: 听到我这么说，塞蕾丝蒂娜愣了愣，随即低下头去，几乎要把脑袋埋进自己高耸的胸脯里去。
English: Hearing this, Celestina freezes for a moment, then lowers her head, nearly burying her face in her ample chest.

Chinese: 也是……如果不是您首肯，她怎么能让您送出泳衣呢？
English: It makes sense... if you hadn't agreed, how could she make you give me the swimsuit?

Chinese: 即使您总是英明坚定的，但也请您务必小心……不要被她所迷惑。
English: You are always wise and resolute, but please be careful... don't be deceived by her.

Chinese: 在短暂的无措后，她很快找到了说服自己的理由。
English: After a brief moment of hesitation, she's able to persuade herself.

Chinese: 但她一反常态羞涩并紧的双腿，还是猫一般甩动不停的尾巴，都显示着她的身体还没有听从理智的摆布。
English: However, her legs remain clenched together and her tail flicks back and forth like that of a cat. Her tense posture reveals that her body wasn't yet obeyed her rational mind.

Chinese: 既然解决了泳装的问题，是不是该做正事了？
English: Now that the swimsuit issue is resolved, shouldn't we get down to business?

Chinese: 您说的正事……
English: The business you mentioned...

Chinese: 还没等我说什么，她点了点头，向我走过来，张开双臂……
English: Before I can say anything, she nods, walks toward me, and opens her arms...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 将我打横抱起。
English: She picks me up and lies me across her arms.

Chinese: 你在做什么，塞蕾丝蒂娜？
English: What are you doing, Celestina?

Chinese: 我的双臂顶着白皙的峰峦，但我的心中充满了疑问。
English: My arms press against the fair swell of her chest, but my mind is full of questions.

Chinese: 如果要开始游泳的话，得从适应水开始。
English: If you want to swim, you need to get used to the water.

Chinese: 我会先教您习惯被水浸泡。
English: First, I'll help you get used to being immersed in water.

Chinese: 那双形状优美的手臂因用力而绷紧，柔软的皮肉下撑出清晰的肌肉线条。
English: Her beautifully shaped arms flexes under my weight, the delicate lines of her muscles clear beneath the soft skin.

Chinese: ……不愧是曾经最擅长近身战斗的魔女，即使变成星痕，也丝毫不损这份气势。
English: As expected of the Nova who once excelled in close combat, even as an Aster, her vigor remains undiminished.

Chinese: 我其实会水。
English: Actually, I can swim.

Chinese: 啊，是这样吗？抱歉，我这就放您下来。
English: Ah, is that so? Sorry, I'll put you down at once.

Chinese: 虽然这么说，但她也没有立刻放手，而是抱着我走进海里，水淹到她的腰腹时才松开我。
English: However, she doesn't immediately release me. Instead, she carries me into the sea, letting me go only when the water reached her waist.

Chinese: 海浪推挤着我和塞蕾丝蒂娜，我们的行动化作波纹，推挤着彼此的身体。
English: The waves pushes against the two of us, our movement creating ripples that nudge our bodies together.

Chinese: 我向她伸出手，她会意地握住。
English: I reaches out to her, and she knowingly grasps my hand.

Chinese: 为什么你会认为我不会水？
English: Why do you think I can't swim?

Chinese: 因为之前在圣别之塔时，您似乎对水没有什么了解……
English: At the Tower of Sanctity, you seemed unfamiliar with water...

Chinese: 那次是因为太突然了。
English: That's because it was too sudden.

Chinese: 尽管考虑到了瑞比娅可能会做出大胆的事，但是完全没有想到坠落的幻境里会有湖。
English: While I considered that Reybia might do something bold, I didn't anticipate a lake being included in the falling illusion.

Chinese: 即使是杰西斯那样强大的主神，也会有无法考虑周全的事。
English: Even a powerful Lord God like Jancis can't consider everything thoroughly.

Chinese: 我见过太多人类的阴谋诡计……尽管您可能嫌我啰嗦，但我还是希望您能小心。
English: I've seen too many human schemes... although you might find me verbose, I still hope you can be careful.

Chinese: 当然，我会的。谢谢你的担心，塞蕾丝蒂娜。
English: Of course, I will. Thank you for your concern, Celestina.

Chinese: 不，这完全没有什么值得感谢的地方……这只是我的本职工作。
English: There's nothing to thank me for... it is simply my duty.

Chinese: 我以为她会继续说下去。然而，她停了停，露出不安的表情。
English: I think she will continue speaking. Instead, she pauses with an uneasy expression on her face.

Chinese: 抱歉，明明在休假中，我又在说这些了。
English: Sorry, I forget that we're on vacation.

Chinese: 没关系，这就是你的习惯吧？
English: It's OK. I'm getting used to your habits.

Chinese: 不……请不要习惯这种事。
English: No... please don't get used to this.

Chinese: 您好不容易出来度假，我希望您能过得开心……请您享受这个假期。
English: You rarely have the opportunity to take a vacation. I hope you can be happy and enjoy it.

Chinese: 说着，她牵着我的手，再次一起潜入海浪之中。
English: As she speaks these words, she grabs my hand and we dive into the waves once more.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我在海水中睁开眼睛。映入眼帘的，是塞蕾丝蒂娜矫健的身影。
English: I open my eyes under the water. The sight before me is Celestina's athletic figure.

Chinese: 无论我游得快还是慢，她始终都在我的附近，维持着与我相近的速度陪伴着我。
English: No matter how fast or slow I swim, she's always nearby, adjusting her speed to stay with me.

Chinese: 阳光穿过海水，在她窈窕的身躯上投下粼粼光斑，此刻的她不像是强壮的龙女，倒像是本就来自海底的人鱼。
English: The sunlight pierces the water, casting shimmering spots on her graceful body. At this moment, she looks less like a mighty dragon girl and more like a mermaid from the depths of the sea.

Chinese: 我向着她游去。她轻踩海底，在烟尘中后退，长发像张合的海葵，柔软地摆动着包住了她一瞬。
English: I swim toward her. She steps lightly on the seabed, retreating into the cloud of sand. Her long hair sways like an anemone, momentarily enveloping her.

Chinese: 我继续向前游，她似乎明白了我的意思，脚在岩石上一踩，在骤然开放的蓝色花朵中，白皙的花蕊向我迎来。
English: I continue swimming forward, and she seems to understand my intent. She pushes off a rock, her fair form emerging from the sudden bloom of blue water toward me.

Chinese: 她翠绿的眼中映着我的影子。那一刻，我什么也没有想，只是顺应着本能合拢双臂，捕获了向我而来的女性。
English: Her emerald eyes reflects my silhouette. At that moment, I think of nothing, simply following my instincts. I close my arms around the approaching woman.

Chinese: 丰盈的身躯来不及刹住，在升腾起来的气泡之中，她撞入我的怀里。
English: Her ample body carries too much momentum. Unable to stop, she collides into my embrace amid the rising bubbles.

Chinese: 那双嘴唇仍然惊愕地张开着，我低下头，用自己的嘴唇堵住了想要逃逸的气泡。
English: Her lips remain open in surprise. I lower my head, sealing her escaping bubbles with my lips.

Chinese: 如果是地面上，也许我们就会一起摔倒，但这是水中。我们拥抱着，短暂地下沉了一下，便被水流托了起来。
English: If we were on land, we might have fallen together. However, we are in the water. We embrace, briefly sinking before the water lifts us up.

Chinese: 两双唇瓣自然地分开。她拥抱着我，两人一起向海面浮去。水流搅碎了太阳，在我们的头顶洒下一片星星。
English: Our lips naturally part. She holds me as we both float to the surface. The water scatters the sun's rays, casting a shower of stars above us.

Chinese: 恰似那个繁星璀璨的夜晚。
English: Just like that starry night.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 在浮上海面之前，她调整了我们两人的位置，好让我们能以接近站立的姿势浮上来。
English: Before surfacing, she adjusts our positions so we can rise in a nearly upright stance.

Chinese: 呼……侍主大人，我们这一次潜游，游得很远。
English: Whew... My lord, we swam quite far this time.

Chinese: 是啊。因为开心，所以会沉浸进去，不知不觉就游得这么远了。
English: Yes. That's because I was happy. I was so immersed that I didn't realize how far we swam.

Chinese: 从这里看去，沙滩已经变成了一条模糊的黄色装饰带。
English: From here, the beach looks like a faint yellow ribbon.

Chinese: 感觉还能再往远处游一些。要去吗？
English: It feels like we could swim even farther. Do you want to go?

Chinese: 如果您愿意的话，当然，我会跟着您一起。
English: If you want to, of course, I'll go with you.

Chinese: 只是，如果往那边游的话，应该不是去往海里，而是会一路游到陆地上……
English: But if we swim that way, we won't be heading into the sea. We'll end up on land...

Chinese: 我抬起头，看向她所示意的方向。
English: I raised my head to look in the direction she indicated.

Chinese: 那边什么都没有。
English: There is nothing there.

Chinese: 如果您再游近一些，就会发现，那只是因为魔法的影响。
English: If you swim a little closer, you'll see it's just an illusion created by magic.

Chinese: 实际上，那边是圣别之塔的方向。
English: Actually, that's the direction of the Tower of Sanctity.

Chinese: 听着塞蕾丝蒂娜的话语，我想起瑞比娅在来时所说的话。
English: As Celestina speaks, I recall what Reybia said earlier.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 那片幻境里的湖还在现实中存在的时候，最后就会汇入那片海域呢。
English: When the lake in the illusion still existed, it would eventually flow into that sea.

Chinese: 你怎么知道？
English: How do you know about that?

Chinese: 那时候的圣别之塔上能看见湖，湖远去的地方，就是海。
English: Back then, you could see the lake from the Tower of Sanctity, and where the lake flowed far away, there was the sea.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 那片湖，我记得已经消失了吧。
English: That lake, I remember it disappeared, right?

Chinese: 是的，在曾经的一场战役里，因为山裂开了缝隙，湖也变成了暗流。
English: Yes, during a past battle, the mountain cracked and the lake turned into an underground stream.

Chinese: 虽然湖不在了，但水始终都会在，它无时无刻不向着海奔来……
English: Although the lake is gone, the water remains, constantly flowing toward the sea...

Chinese: 难得会听你说这么诗意的话。
English: It's rare to hear you speak so poetically.

Chinese: 我笑着打趣她。她不好意思地低了低头，又潜入水里。
English: I tease her with a smile. She lowers her head bashfully and dives back into the water.

Chinese: 这次我不打算这么轻易地放过她，于是和她一起潜下去。
English: This time, I don't intend to let her go so easily, so I dive down with her.

Chinese: 太阳走向海的另一端，在沉落的光线里，我追着她游向更远处。
English: The sun is setting over the far side of the sea, and in its fading light, I swim after her to greater distances.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 再次浮起来时，我们仍然在海上。除了海面，这里便只有天空，碧蓝无垠的天空。
English: When we surface again, we are still in the sea. Other than the surrounding water, there is only the boundless blue sky.

Chinese: 想从这里游到圣山之下，恐怕需要很久。
English: It may take a long time to swim from here to the foot of the Sacred Mountain.

Chinese: 您想去吗？如果您想，我可以带着您冲过去。
English: Do you want to go? If you would like, I can take you there quickly.

Chinese: 我知道你的速度。不过，我只是在享受和你一起游泳的过程而已。
English: I know how fast you can go. But I'm enjoying just swimming with you.

Chinese: 享受和我一起游泳的过程吗……和我相处的时光，令您觉得享受吗？
English: Enjoying swimming with me... You mean you enjoy spending time with me?

Chinese: 一直都是。不然，我也不会总是带着你出去了。
English: Always. Otherwise, I wouldn't take you out so often.

Chinese: ……是吗……是这样啊。
English: Is that so... I see.

Chinese: 她专注地凝视着我，似乎下定了某种决心。
English: She gazes at me intently, as if finally making a decision.

Chinese: 侍主大人，我有一个问题，希望……如果可以的话，您能够回答我。
English: My lord, I have a question. I hope... if it's possible, that you could answer it.

Chinese: 她向我游得更近了一些，翠绿的视线静静地笼罩着我。
English: She swims closer, her emerald gaze quietly enveloping me.

Chinese: 你问吧。
English: Please ask.

Chinese: 您刚刚，在水下的那个亲吻……是什么意义呢？
English: Your kiss under the water... what did it mean?

Chinese: 这个答案，对你来说重要吗？
English: Is this answer important to you?

Chinese: 您本可以不用注视着我。但您注视了我，予我恩赐，予我……许多不该给予兵器之物。
English: You didn't have to pay attention to me. But you did, granting me favors, giving me... many weapons that shouldn't have been given.

Chinese: 如果我误解了您的恩慈，那接下来的行为，便与亵渎无异了。
English: If I misunderstood your kindness, my next actions would be akin to blasphemy.

Chinese: 您的答案，非常重要。
English: Your answer means a lot to me.

Chinese: 你可以自己来品尝这个答案。
English: You can taste the answer yourself.

Chinese: 说着，我踏着水向她游去，距离一瞬缩短为零。
English: Saying this, I swim toward her, closing our distance to nothing in an instant.

Chinese: 我们再次相拥着沉入海中。她比海水蓝得更纯粹的长发，这一次包裹了我们两个人。
English: We embrace again, sinking into the sea. Her hair, bluer than the sea, wraps around both of us this time.

Chinese: 出乎我意料的，这次的亲吻是她更主动。
English: To my surprise, she is more assertive in this kiss.

Chinese: 就像是要补回之前所有的犹豫和退缩那样，她以一往无前的气势打开城门，孤军深入，直挑大营。
English: As if to make up for all her previous hesitation and retreat, she advances with unwavering determination, breaching the gates and diving straight to the heart.

Chinese: 面对她的攻势，我也毫不客气地回应。攻守之势不断易位，洋流似乎也在这时变得混乱。
English: Facing her offensive, I responds without hesitation. The roles of attack and defense constantly switches, and the ocean currents seem to become chaotic.

Chinese: 亲吻之外的拥抱逐渐变成了另一个战场，在她的柔软之处被攻陷时，这个吻终于走到尽头。
English: The embraces beyond the kisses gradually turn into another battlefield. When her softness is breached, the kiss finally comes to an end.

Chinese: 呼啊、咕……
English: Hah, gulp...

Chinese: 相似的亲吻，相似的沉沦。呛水的人变成了她。
English: Similar kisses, and similar sinking. Then she's the one choking on water.

Chinese: 我拥着她再次浮上水面。
English: I hold her as we resurface.

Chinese: 咳、咳咳！非常抱……
English: Cough, cough! I'm so sor...

Chinese: 别为情趣道歉，塞蕾丝蒂娜。
English: Don't apologize for the moment, Celestina.

Chinese: 风停，海面一片宁静。短暂的沉默后，她拉起我的手，放在她的胸口。
English: The wind stops, and the sea is calm. After a brief silence, she takes my hand and places it on her chest.

Chinese: 如果这是您的希望……那么，请您拿走我的一切。
English: If this is what you wish for... then please, take everything from me.

Chinese: 这时候还要这么说吗？
English: Do you still have to be that implicit?

Chinese: ……是的，我不该这么说。
English: Well, I should be more direct.

Chinese: 她按着我的手，有些为难地沉默片刻，沉重地吐字。
English: She presses my hand and pauses with embarrassment. Then she speaks in all seriousness.

Chinese: 我爱您。
English: I love you.

Chinese: 你用什么样的角色爱着我？
English: In what kind of role do you love me?

Chinese: 她的脸变得苍白了一些。这份剖白，似乎连着她的脏腑一起剖开了似的，露出了像是痛苦，又像是安心的表情。
English: Her face turns a bit pale. This confession seems to cut through her innards, revealing a look of both pain and relief.

Chinese: 我曾在向神职人员告解的人们脸上看到这样的神情，也曾在被爱火炙烤的某个人脸上，看见过这样的表情。
English: I've seen such expressions on the faces of people confessing to clergy as well as on those burning with the flames of love.

Chinese: 在这片只有我们的海中，二者在她的身上融合在一起。
English: In this sea that bears only the two of us, both merge within her.

Chinese: 又或者，从许久之前，就已经是一体的存在了。
English: Or perhaps, they've been one for a long time.

Chinese: 侍主大人，请原谅我。
English: Lord Oracle, please forgive me.

Chinese: ……我既作为您的剑，爱着您执掌我的手，也作为一个女人，爱着您。
English: I love you both as a sword wielded by your hand and as a woman.

Chinese: 所以，我才选择带您来到这里。
English: That's why I brought you here.

Chinese: 哪怕您毫无所觉，我也想要占有您……一天的时间，只有我一个人，跟随着您的时间。
English: Even if you have not yet realized it, I want to have you for myself... for one day, just you and me.

Chinese: 我不会原谅你。
English: I will not forgive you.

Chinese: ……如果您真的这么想，那么这也是我的愿……
English: If that is truly what you think, then it is also my wish...

Chinese: 我从来没有怪过你。塞蕾丝蒂娜，这正是我希望的。
English: I have never blamed you. Celestina, this is exactly what I want.

Chinese: 她张了张嘴，泪水先一步流下。
English: She opens her mouth to speak, but the tears begin flowing first.

Chinese: 然而她却笑了。痛苦的，惶恐的，也是带着喜悦的泪水。
English: But there is a smile. They are tears of pain, fear, and joy.

Chinese: ……是的，这是我的愿望……
English: Yes, this is my wish...

Chinese: 我爱您。所以，请您拿走我的全部。
English: I love you. So, please take all of me.

Chinese: 请您……允许我亵渎您。
English: Please... allow me to desecrate you.

Chinese: 我允许你，塞蕾丝蒂娜·卡尔佩恩。我接受你的一切。
English: I allow you to do so, Celestina Calpine. I accept all of you.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 在这片海域之中，我们浮浮沉沉。
English: In this sea, we rise and fall.

Chinese: 一片从未被踏足的湖面迎来了第一位访客，她奔向大海，为大海敞开了自身。
English: An untouched lake welcomes its first visitor. She rushes to the ocean, opening herself to it.

Chinese: 海中的两股水流融为一体，沙与水流染上了浅淡的白。
English: The two currents in the sea merge, sand and water stained with a light white.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 太阳西斜时，我们终于游回岸边。
English: As the sun set, we finally swim back to shore.

Chinese: 踏上沙滩时，塞蕾丝蒂娜的身体一晃，我立刻扶住了她。
English: When we step onto the beach, Celestina's body begins to sway. I quickly reaches out to support her.

Chinese: ……竟然这样失态，回去后一定要好好锻炼才行。
English: I must train harder when we return.

Chinese: 还想锻炼成什么样子？
English: How much more do you want to train?

Chinese: 我总归是您的星痕，若是每次都腿软，像什么样子。
English: I am your Aster, after all. If my legs always go weak, how can I protect you?

Chinese: 虽然我也想说谢谢夸奖，但你的腿软，也许还另有一个原因。
English: Although I would like to thank you for the compliment, there might be another reason for your weak legs.

Chinese: 我指了指她的小腿。她低头看去，那里不知何时，吸上了一枚海星。
English: I point to her calf. She looks down and sees a starfish clinging there.

Chinese: 是毒吗？我竟然毫无所觉，实在是太松懈了。
English: Is it venomous? I didn't notice it at all. I've been too careless.

Chinese: 如果你能在那时候分神，我会惩罚你的。
English: I would have punished you if you had been distracted earlier.

Chinese: 她露出了为难的表情。
English: Her expression becomes troubled.

Chinese: 只有这点……还希望您能通融……
English: Just this once... I hope you'll make an exception...

Chinese: 这么快就开始撒娇了？
English: Are you already starting to act spoiled?

Chinese: 不是的，我是说，这……
English: No, I mean, this...

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜的脸颊泛起娇美的红色，就像刚才在海中时一样。
English: Celestina's cheeks turn a delicate red, just like when we were in the sea.

Chinese: ……如果说，这就是撒娇的话，我希望您能……允许。
English: If this is acting spoiled, then I hope you can... allow me...

Chinese: 允许我向您表达心意，允许我……能够在某些时候贪心，既作为您的武器，也作为女人被您所欣赏。
English: Allow me to express my feelings to you, allow me... to be greedy at times, both as your weapon and as a woman to be admired by you.

Chinese: 其实一直都是这样。
English: That's the way it has always been.

Chinese: 她惊讶地望着我。随后，那惊讶崩塌，变成了苦笑。
English: She looks at me in surprise. Then, the surprise collapses into a bitter smile.

Chinese: 主神在上……塞蕾丝蒂娜·卡尔佩恩，究竟是一个多么愚蠢的女人啊。
English: By Lord God... Celestina Calpine, what a foolish woman you are!

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜·卡尔佩恩！你这个卑鄙的女人！
English: Celestina Calpine! You despicable woman!

Chinese: 突如其来的骂声，让我和塞蕾丝蒂娜的视线都投向了来者。
English: The sudden shout causes Celestina and me to turn attention to the newcomers.

Chinese: 娇小的瑞比娅气势汹汹地冲在前面，然而，她并不是一个人来的。
English: The petite Reybia charges forward aggressively, but she isn't alone.

Chinese: 她的身后，还有伊卡洛斯、阿波菲斯、桃……甚至连安洁都在。
English: Behind her are Icaruth, Apoffis, Momo... even Angie is there.

Chinese: 大家怎么都来了？
English: Why is everyone here?

Chinese: 您还敢说呢！说是没什么工作，结果今天就忙得要命，小瑞比娅都快被累病了呢！
English: You dare to ask! You said there would be nothing urgent, but I'm nearly sick from exhaustion!

Chinese: 她娇俏地抱怨着扑进水里，众多星痕和魔女们也一起下水，挤开了我和塞蕾丝蒂娜。
English: She cutely complains as she splashes into the water. Then all of the Asters and the Nova join her, pushing the two of us aside.

Chinese: 小瑞比娅实在没办法，只好找大家帮忙，就算这样，也刚刚才腾出手呢！
English: I had no choice but to ask them for help. Even so, we've just finished all the work.

Chinese: 而这个号称是您忠诚护卫的女人，居然监守自盗！在这里和您享受两人假期！
English: And this woman, who claims to be your loyal guard, is actually stealing time with you for herself! She's out here enjoying a vacation with you!

Chinese: 你还敢狡辩吗？人赃俱获！
English: Do you still dare to argue? You've been caught red-handed!

Chinese: 瑞比娅向着塞蕾丝蒂娜红痕嫣然的胸口飞起一脚。塞蕾丝蒂娜面色如常地躲过，让她摔进水里。
English: Reybia kicks toward Celestina's red-stained chest. Celestina calmly dodges the kick, letting her fall into the water.

Chinese: 我不会狡辩，这是事实。
English: I won't argue, because it's the truth.

Chinese: 侍主！您看她！！
English: Lord Oracle! See what she did?!

Chinese: 瑞比娅似真似假地抱怨着。而我看向了星痕之间唯一的一位魔女。
English: Reybia complains, half serious, half joking. And I look at the only Nova among the Asters.

Chinese: 我记得你拒绝了我的邀请。
English: I seem to recall that you declined my invitation.

Chinese: 我的确说过我不想和挂心另一个女人的男人一起度假。
English: I did say I didn't want a vacation with a man who's concerned about another woman.

Chinese: 她解开看似庄重的外衣，露出里面的……连体泳衣。
English: She unfastens her seemingly solemn outer garment, revealing a... one-piece swimsuit underneath.

Chinese: 所以我为您留出了解决顾虑的时间。还是说，您到现在，还没有解决完下属的苦恼呢？
English: So I gave you some time to resolve your concerns. Or perhaps you still haven't resolved your subordinate's troubles?

Chinese: 当然已经解决了。不过，你倒是带来了更大的苦恼啊。
English: Of course, it's already resolved. But you've brought about even more trouble.

Chinese: 您应得的。
English: You deserve it.

Chinese: 好吧，我应得的。你也没说错。
English: Alright. I deserve it. You're not wrong.

Chinese: 既然大家都来了，那今晚就在海滩边上办一场晚会吧。
English: Since everyone is here, let's have a party by the beach tonight.

Chinese: 我的提议迅速取得了绝大多数人的同意，欢呼声在海上传得很远。
English: My suggestion is quickly agreed to by the majority, and cheers ring out far across the sea.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 几天后，神谕司。
English: A few days later at the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 闲着的时间总是过得很快……真希望假期赶紧再次到来啊。
English: Vacations are always over before you know it... I really hope we can have more time off again soon.

Chinese: 会的，侍主大人。
English: Of course, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 在那之后，塞蕾丝蒂娜确实变得主动了一些。
English: After that, Celestina becomes more proactive.

Chinese: 她会更积极地向我搭话，也会做出种种热情的举动。
English: She'll engage with me more intentionally and express her enthusiasm.

Chinese: 我为她逐步放开而高兴。
English: I'm pleased to see her gradually opening up.

Chinese: 侍主大人，这是我准备参加灯会的作品。
English: Lord Oracle, this is my work for the Lantern Festival.

Chinese: 她将一盏纸灯放在我的面前。这是盏玫瑰形的纸灯，花瓣层层叠叠，做得已经算是精巧。
English: She places a lantern in front of me. It's an intricate rose-shaped paper lantern with layered petals.

Chinese: 已经决定是这个了吗？我想在灯会前的几天，你应该还会有进步才对。
English: Have you already decided on this one? You could probably make further improvements before the Lantern Festival.

Chinese: 这是送给您的灯。短时间之内，我应该不会有能胜过它的作品了。
English: This lantern is for you. I doubt I could make anything better given the short amount of time.

Chinese: 这么肯定吗？
English: Are you sure?

Chinese: 如果您认为我还能进步，那我应该还能进一步才对。我会勤加练习的。
English: If you believe I can improve, then I should be able to make more progress. I will practice harder.

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜说着，撑着桌子向我俯身。
English: As she replies, Celestina leans over the table toward me.

Chinese: 侍主大人。
English: Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 在练习之外的时间，我能否……在您的夜间日程上，占据一席之地呢？
English: Outside of practicing, could I... have a place in your nightly schedule?

Chinese: 塞蕾丝蒂娜的眼睛是一双龙的眼睛。
English: Celestina's eyes are the eyes of a dragon.

Chinese: 从那天我们把话说开后，我意识到了这点。
English: I realized this after our intimate conversation that day.

Chinese: 以护卫的身份吗？
English: As a guard?

Chinese: ……不全是。
English: Not entirely.

Chinese: 这可是监守自盗啊。
English: This is like a guard stealing.

Chinese: 所以我希望能走正规的流程……我的心正为您而跃动，即使您拒绝，我也想将此刻的心意……传达给您。
English: So I hope to follow the proper procedures... My heart throbs for you. Even if you refuse, I want to convey my feelings to you.

Chinese: ……您是希望我之后这么邀请您吗？
English: Do you want me to invite you like this from now on?

Chinese: 这次演练不错，还可以再放开一些。
English: This rehearsal wasn't bad, but you can be even more open.

Chinese: ……抱歉！果然还是会觉得太羞耻了！日程还是交给您来安排吧，只要我能听到您的声音，就已经很满足了……
English: Sorry! It still feels so embarrassing! I'll let you decide the schedule. Just hearing your voice is enough for me...

Chinese: 慢慢来吧，时间还有很多。
English: Take it slow. We have plenty of time.

Chinese: 好的……
English: Alright...

Chinese: 唉，先把脸从我的肩上抬起来吧？
English: Sigh, can you lift your face off my shoulder first?

Chinese: 明白！
English: Understood!

Chinese: 她立刻执行了我的命令，站得如同钢枪一般笔直。
English: She immediately obeys my command, standing as straight as a spear.

Chinese: 身为兵器，和身为女人，这两种状态的切换，她还是容易用力过猛。
English: She still tends to overdo it when switching between being a weapon and being a woman.

Chinese: 但我不再那么担心她了。她也一样，不会那么担心我对她的看法了。
English: But I'm no longer as worried about her. She's the same. She is becoming less concerned about my opinion of her.

Chinese: 下次假期想去哪里？
English: Where do you want to go on vacation next time?

Chinese: 我占有一次假期已经满足，下一次，还是让给其他渴望亲近您的星痕吧。
English: Getting to go on vacation with you just once is enough for me. You should go with one of the other Asters who yearn to be close to you.

Chinese: 这么舍得？
English: Are you willing to give up so much?

Chinese: 我已经……得到我能得到的，最珍贵的东西了。
English: I've already... received the most precious thing I could possibly get.

Chinese: 我也是。
English: So have I.

Chinese: 爱与坦诚是一剂良药，能够唤醒一颗龙冰封的心。
English: Love and honesty are a potent medicine. They are capable of awakening the frozen heart of a dragon.

Chinese: 那颗心正在我的身边鲜活地跃动着——这便是我这个假期里最珍贵的收获了。
English: That heart is now beating strongly by my side—this is the most precious thing attained during my vacation.

Chinese: 谢谢。
English: Thank you.

Chinese: 能帮上您的忙是我的荣幸。
English: It's my honor to assist you.

Chinese: 很快，我和她都开始踩水。
English: Soon, she and I start treading water.

Chinese: 因为这是我的兴趣。
English: Because this is my interest.

Chinese: 原来您的兴趣是这样的……
English: So this is what you're interested in...

Chinese: 她有一瞬间露出了呆滞的表情。
English: For a moment, she has a dazed expression.

Chinese: 感到无法接受吗？
English: Do you find it unacceptable?

Chinese: 并不，我只担心我无法满足您的兴趣。
English: Not at all. I'm just worried I won't be able to hold your attention.

Chinese: 其实这是神谕司派发的制式泳装。
English: To tell you the truth, this is the standard swimsuit issued by the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 您就不要用这种玩笑捉弄我了……
English: Please don't tease me with such jokes...

Chinese: 在成为星痕之前，我也曾是圣殿的一员。对圣殿的作风，我还是清楚的。
English: Before becoming an Aster, I was also a member of the Sanctuary. I'm still familiar with the ways of the Sanctuary.

Chinese: 总之，我明白了……
English: Anyway, as I understand it...

Chinese: 这件泳装的存在，本身就是您意志的体现。
English: The existence of this swimsuit is a manifestation of your will.

Chinese: 既然如此，我只需要遵从即可。
English: This means I just need to comply.

Chinese: 很漂亮。
English: Gorgeous.

Chinese: 您原来喜欢这样的装束吗？也是，在瑞比娅变身时，您会看着她。
English: Do you like this kind of outfit? Indeed. No wonder you can't tear your eyes away when Reybia transforms.

Chinese: 还可以再坦诚一些。
English: You can be more open.

Chinese: 再坦诚一些？您是说，姿态上吗？
English: More open? You mean my posture?

Chinese: 她放下紧绷的双臂，完全向我展开。阳光在她身上似乎变得格外眩目。
English: She lowers her tense arms and opens them to me. The light of the sun seems to radiate off of her.

English: Vernal Drago Maid
