English: Drago Reunion

Chinese: 一场两个人的婚礼，催出四个人的心思。
English: A wedding for two, stirring the hearts of four.

Chinese: 从打开的窗户里，一枚花瓣飘进窗口，轻飘飘地落在桌上。
English: A wayward petal, carried on a sigh of wind, drifted through the window and settled softly on the table's surface.

Chinese: 桃花都开进神谕司了，不知不觉已经要春天了啊。
English: Wow, even the Oracle Division has peach blossoms! Guess spring snuck up on us.

Chinese: “都”。主公用这个字，是因为神谕司很难有桃花开放吗？
English: Even? Do you mean peach blossoms popping up in the Oracle Division is a pretty rare sight?

Chinese: 神谕司的位置算是比较高的，如果连这里的桃花都开了的话，城外的桃林想必已经开遍了。
English: Yeah, with the high altitude, the Oracle Division would be the last place where they bloom. If they're out here, the groves outside must be a pink paradise!

Chinese: 这样。我已有许多年没有看过桃林煌煌开放的样子，想必会是不错的景色。
English: Got it. It's been ages since I saw the peach trees in full swing. Bet it's a knockout view.

Chinese: 你已经开始习惯在米伦的生活了吗？
English: How are you settling into Mirren?

Chinese: 虽然无法在睡梦中再次入眠，多少会有些精神上的疲惫，但习惯当前的状态后，倒也不会觉得太难。
English: Tossing and turning at night's a drag, but once I get the hang of it, it's smooth sailing.

Chinese: 至今为止，我都难以想象。在我之前，竟然没有“耀星”星痕吗？
English: I'm still wrapping my head around it. There was no Polaris Aster before me?

Chinese: 不一定。也许还有，只是我没有记起来。
English: Don't know. Maybe there was, and it's just slipped my mind.

Chinese: 我想也是。来米伦国的这几日，您究竟有多少缘分，我已都充分地见识过了。
English: I think so. Since you landed in Mirren, I've been watching your fate unfold.

Chinese: 尽管桃花难以开放，但若说主公的“桃花”，看来是常开的。
English: Yeah, peach blossoms don't bloom easily around here, but your love life? It's like a never-ending springtime, always in full bloom!

Chinese: 她的语气严肃平静，看起来并不是调笑，而是认真地在思考着什么。
English: Her tone was flat and serious, as if she was lost in thought.

Chinese: 桃花啊……算是吧。
English: Peach blossoms, huh? You kinda have a point.

Chinese: 你在想什么，极焰？
English: What's eating you, Yan?

Chinese: 太一那边传来了消息。不知主公是否有时间，前往红簌国，完成之前约定之事。
English: Got a message from Taeuno. Got a sec to swing by the Crimson Kingdom? We've got some old business to wrap up.

Chinese: 什么事？
English: What business?

Chinese: 极焰的目光垂在桌子上，像是要从这些繁杂的米伦文字中看出什么奥秘似的。
English: Yan stared at the table, like she was trying to crack some code written within the Mirrenese.

Chinese: 是说我与主公在红簌国的婚事。
English: We're talking about tying the knot in the Crimson Kingdom.

Chinese: 咳……这消息来得太快，直到此时，才体会到太一与米伦的时间流速确有不同。
English: Ahem... That's... out of the blue. Now I finally understand Mirren's clock ticks at a different tempo from Taeuno's.

Chinese: 还请主公拨冗前往。
English: Hope you can pencil it in your packed planner.

Chinese: 我知道了，就尽快前往吧。
English: Got it, I'll head over when I can.

Chinese: ……谢谢主公。
English: Thank you, my lord.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 神谕司的星痕休息室，此刻正挂着使用中的牌子。
English: A "Do Not Disturb" sign was hung at the Aster Lounge in the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 突然从中爆发出的尖叫声，震得木牌晃了晃。
English: A scream suddenly erupted, causing the wooden sign to shake.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 什什什什什么婚礼——？！
English: What?! What... what wedding?!

Chinese: 秋英，声音轻些。
English: Hush, Autumn Glory!

Chinese: 抱、抱歉……
English: Sorry...

Chinese: 当时饲主先生不是拒绝了吗，为什么现在突然说什么都准备好了？！
English: Hold up! Didn't Master turn down that marriage thing before? Why the sudden wedding chatter?

Chinese: 我、我实在是没法接受……太突然了……
English: I... I can't wrap my head around this. This is coming out of nowhere.

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊双手捂着脸，焦虑地原地打着转。
English: Outlander Calli covered her face with her hands and anxiously paced in circles.

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚仍然稳稳地坐在椅子上，看着她不断地转来转去。
English: Giratia remained seated, watching her going round in circles.

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚小姐你说句话呀！
English: Miss Giratia, say something!

Chinese: 你难道不觉得这件事太过突然了吗？明明极焰和饲主先生也没有认识多久的，怎么，怎么就走到谈婚论嫁了呢？
English: Isn't this rushing things? Yan and Master haven't known each other long. Why the rush to tie the knot?

Chinese: 我想可能有政治联姻的因素在。
English: I think there may be political factors at play.

Chinese: 红簌国的皇帝有意结交侍主先生，使我们成为红簌国的外援。
English: The Empress of the Crimson Kingdom wants Lord Oracle on her side.

Chinese: 一个仅在红簌国生效的婚约，是合理的。
English: A marriage contract that works in their realm makes sense.

Chinese: 就算这么说……那、那我也可以呀！
English: If that's the case, why not pick me?

Chinese: 我作为卯兔圣卫，也是饲主先生的星痕，而且也有担当起政治联姻的觉悟……！
English: I'm the Bunnic Sentinel, Master's Aster! I'm all in for a political union!

Chinese: 你是夹在太一和米伦两个世界之间的存在，立场比较复杂。
English: Your position straddles Taeuno and Mirren.

Chinese: 相比之下，极焰的出身跟红簌国更紧密，而侍主大人和极焰，显然也有……
English: Yan's roots are closer to the Crimson Kingdom, and she and Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 也有……
English: Well,

Chinese: 也有一定的感情基础在。
English: they've got a real connection.

Chinese: 啊啊啊啊啊……？！他们、他们不是只是互相欣赏吗，怎么会发展得这么快？！
English: What... what? Weren't they just admiring each other? How'd they go from zero to wedding bells so fast?

Chinese: 明明我已经尽可能地占用饲主先生的时间了……他们到底是什么时候发展起来的啊！
English: I've been hanging out with Master nonstop... When did this happen?

Chinese: 不管怎么说……我们应该劝阻饲主先生吧？
English: Anyway... we should talk some sense into my Master.

Chinese: 他俩才认识多久，不该这么快结婚的……吉拉蒂亚，你怎么了？心口疼吗？
English: They're practically strangers! Giratia, you OK? Giratia, you OK?

Chinese: ……只是有一点胸闷的感觉，也许是身体回忆起了魔力晶化的感受……不用在意。
English: Just a tight chest, maybe a flashback to crystallizing magic power. Don't worry.

Chinese: 侍主大人有自己的想法，我身为星痕，尽可能不要多言为好。
English: Lord Oracle's got plans. As an Aster, I'll keep my mouth shut.

Chinese: 好吧，说多了万一饲主先生烦我就不好了。
English: OK, I don't wanna blabber too much and get on Master's nerves.

Chinese: 但饲主先生问我要不要回红簌去看一看，我觉得……好矛盾。
English: But he did ask if I wanted to visit the Crimson Kingdom. I'm... torn.

Chinese: 那边也算你的第二个家，不想回去看看吗？
English: It's your second home. Don't you want to visit?

Chinese: 想是想的，可是……我不想看饲主先生和极焰结婚。
English: Sure, but... seeing Master and Yan hitched?

Chinese: 极焰每年都帮我，我很感谢她。可是……要是她和饲主先生结婚的话……
English: Yan's been awesome helping me out every year, but if she marries my Master...

Chinese: ……我感觉自己变成一个卑鄙的女人了。
English: Feels like I'm playing the mean girl.

Chinese: 在这个时候，我能想到的，只有逃避。
English: This whole thing is a big NOPE for me.

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊挫败地蹲坐在吉拉蒂亚的脚边，把脸颊埋进双膝间。
English: Outlander Calli squats down at Giratia's feet, burying her face in her knees in frustration.

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚看着她垂落的长耳朵，静静地听她倾诉着。
English: Giratia looked at her long drooping ears and listened quietly to her confiding.

Chinese: 逃跑不可耻。如果不知道该怎么做，那就暂时避开。
English: No shame in saying no. If you're unsure, just decline for now.

Chinese: 侍主大人不会因为你的拒绝而生气的。
English: Lord Oracle won't hold it against you.

Chinese: 但我又不想错过饲主先生重要的时刻，而且，极焰也是我的朋友……
English: But I don't want to miss Master's big moment. And Yan's my friend...

Chinese: 哪怕新娘不是我……想到这里我会觉得很难受，去也不是，不去，好像也不是……
English: Even if I'm not the bride, it feels weird. Staying or going, it's all off-kilter.

Chinese: 你和极焰算是朋友吗？
English: Are you and Yan pals?

Chinese: 她没什么朋友，我想，我应该算是朋友……嗯。
English: She doesn't have many friends. I guess I'm one?

Chinese: 如果我不去的话，她应该是要找陌生人做伴娘了。
English: If I bail, she'll find a random bridesmaid.

Chinese: 那很不好吗？
English: Is that so bad?

Chinese: ……换作是我结婚，我也会希望陪在身边的是熟面孔的。
English: Look, if it were me getting hitched, I'd want familiar faces around.

Chinese: 看到熟悉的人，会更有安全感吧。
English: Spotting a familiar face can be a real comfort.

Chinese: ……我明白了。
English: I see...

Chinese: 胸口闷闷的，上不来气，好难过……吉拉蒂亚，你明白了什么？
English: My chest's tight, I can't breathe, and I'm just... upset. Giratia, what's your take?

Chinese: 我应该答应侍主大人的邀请。
English: I'll accept Lord Oracle's invitation.

Chinese: ……什么？饲主先生邀请你去做什么？
English: What? What's he inviting you to do?

Chinese: 他邀请我做他的随侍，在红簌国来说，就是“伴郎”的位置吧。
English: To be his attendant. I believe it's called "best man" in Crimson Kingdom terms.

Chinese: 伴郎……怎么让女孩子做这个事情啊！
English: Best man? Why'd he pick a girl for that?

Chinese: 我起初也很困惑。侍主大人没有男性朋友，也该找一个男性来站在这里才对。
English: I was scratching my head about that too. Lord Oracle might not have male friends, but shouldn't he at least get some random guy for that?

Chinese: 为什么……会是我呢。
English: Why... me?

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚的声音低下去，她看着异邦波斯菊脚边的地面。
English: Giratia's voice lowered, looking at the ground at the feet of Outlander Calli.

Chinese: 现在我明白了。我想，侍主大人，也许也只是想在婚礼上看到他熟悉的人站在身边吧。
English: Now I see. I think Lord Oracle may just want a familiar face standing by his side during the wedding.

Chinese: 既然是这样，那我，可以做这个人。
English: If that is the case, then I can be his best man.

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊抬起头，看向吉拉蒂亚。
English: Outlander Calli looked up at Giratia.

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚，其实你……也喜欢饲主先生吧？
English: Wait, Giratia, you actually like Master too, don't you?
Hmm.

Chinese: 你这个样子……他不会明白的哦。
English: If you keep this to yourself, he'll never know.

Chinese: 我知道。
English: I know.

Chinese: 什么我知道……所以，你就准备答应他，去看喜欢的男人结婚吗？
English: You know nothing... So, are you really willing to watch your crush get married to someone else?

Chinese: 我已经答应了。
English: I've accepted it.

Chinese: 只是直到刚才为止，都在想他为什么要邀请我，而不是别人……而已。
English: I was just puzzled about his invitation until now. Why would he choose me and not someone else... That's all.

Chinese: 饲主先生，搞不好比我想象得还要坏心……
English: Perhaps Master's more complex than I give him credit for.

Chinese: 也许吧。只是这样，我也很满足了。
English: Perhaps. I'm OK with how things are.

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚，你的表情看起来很难过哦……
English: So then why the long face, Giratia?

Chinese: ……我先出发了，如果你想通了，可以自行前往，或者就留在这边。
English: I'm setting off now. You figure it out for yourself—either stay or go.

Chinese: 诶，不是一起去吗？
English: Hey, aren't we going together?

Chinese: 侍主大人和极焰已经先一步动身前去了。
English: Lord Oracle and Yan have already headed out.
What?

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 太一，红簌国，辰龙行宫。
English: In the Vernal Drago Palace, Crimson Kingdom, Taeuno.

Chinese: 此时的辰龙行宫一扫平时的冷清肃穆，身着红衣的宫女们来来往往，在宫殿里张灯结彩，好不热闹。
English: The usually quiet Vernal Drago Palace is now bustling. Crimson-clad servants hurry about, and the halls are adorned with lanterns and finery, creating a festive, grand atmosphere.

Chinese: 看来这次的入口刚好开在辰龙宫。
English: It seems the gateway opened straight onto the Vernal Drago Palace.

Chinese: 我向身边的人搭话，然而却没有人回答我。
English: I address my attendants, yet receive no reply.

Chinese: 我转头一看，发现身边空无一人。
English: A glance over my shoulder confirm it. I'm alone with no one around.
(Where is Yan?)

Chinese: 在我张望的时候，一位装束飒爽的红衣女子停在我身边。
English: While I'm looking around, a woman clad in elegant red attire approaches.

Chinese: 您就是[var=Actor]大人吧。请问您有什么需要？
English: You are Lord [var=Actor], right? May I be of any assistance?

Chinese: 你是辰龙行宫新来的侍女吗？
English: You new around here?

Chinese: 我等是世代侍奉辰龙圣卫的辰龙侍女。本代圣卫大人不喜身边有人，因此我们通常都在龙之须侍奉先灵。
English: I'm one of the Vernal Drago Maids who have been serving the Drago Sentinels for generations. The current Sentinels prefers solitude, so we usually serve the ancestors at Dragon's Beard.

Chinese: 近日是圣卫与您大喜的日子，我们自龙之须回归，为圣卫大人的婚事效劳。
English: Today, however, is your joyous wedding day with the Twelve Sentinel. So we're back from Dragon's Beard to assist.

Chinese: （龙之须……对了，极焰是用灵魂体前往米伦，回归太一时，应该是回归她沉睡的身体里去了。）
English: (Dragon's Beard... Got it. Yan must've soul-traveled to Mirren. She probably slipped back into her sleeping body when she returned to Taeuno.)

Chinese: 我知道了。龙之须在哪里？我想去见见她。
English: I know. Where's this Dragon's Beard? I have to see her.

Chinese: 明白了，请随我来。
English: Of course. Follow me.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 在还算宽阔的山路上，我仰头望着山顶，眯起眼睛。
English: While traversing the wide mountain trail, I pause to cast my gaze toward the peak, shielding my eyes from the glaring sun.

Chinese: 您还好吗？是否需要休憩片刻？
English: Are you holding up alright? Do you need to take a breather?

Chinese: 不用，这点路不算什么。
English: No, this little uphill walk is nothing.

Chinese: 真不愧是圣卫大人选中的夫婿，倒是我低估您了。就在前面。
English: Impressive. You're every bit the husband the Twelve Sentinel picked. I underestimated you. We are almost there.

Chinese: 就在山腰上吗？
English: It's here on the mountainside?

Chinese: 呵呵，山顶虽能一览众山，但总有几个月日光强烈，于沉眠不利。
English: Haha, Yeah, the top may have the best views, but you don't want to sleep up there. Too much sun is not helping for a sound slumber.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 说着，她将我引到一处海棠掩映的林边。
English: While continuing her explanation, she guides me to the entrance to a grove, sheltered by crabapple trees.

Chinese: 此时正值海棠花的花期，白的红的花朵肆意盛放，在暖风中摇曳着身姿。
English: It's the season of begonia blossoms, and the white and red flowers flourish, dancing in the gentle breeze.

Chinese: 我走进林中，便看见了在树影掩映间睡着的女子。
English: Venturing into the woods, I behold a woman asleep in the cool shade.

Chinese: 这么想来，这还是我第一次看到极焰睡着的样子。
English: It's my first time seeing Yan in sleep.

Chinese: （睡得很熟啊。）
English: (She sleeps soundly.)

Chinese: （观察她的睡颜）
English: (Take a moment to observe her tranquil visage)

Chinese: 或许是因为梦中在米伦活动的缘故，她的睡姿不大老实，斜倚在榻上，海棠花瓣落了满头满身。
English: Her rest seems influenced by her travels in Mirren, and her clothes are slightly disheveled. She lies on a divan, with fallen begonia petals scattered over her.

Chinese: 长长的红发散落在榻边，也被落花盖满了。
English: Her auburn tresses spill over the side, mingling with the fallen blooms.

Chinese: （亲吻她的脸颊）
English: (Bestow a gentle kiss upon her cheek)

Chinese: 阳光落在极焰的脸上，将她的脸烤得比平时还要温暖。
English: The sunlight bathes her face, lending it additional warmth.

Chinese: 亲上去时，她的热度也感染到我的嘴唇。
English: As I press my lips to her skin, the heat transfers to mine.

Chinese: 花影摇曳，心跳如鼓。
English: Amidst the dancing flower's shadows, my heart beats with a fervent rhythm.

Chinese: 该醒来了。
English: Time to wake up.

Chinese: 在这时候，极焰睁开了眼睛。
English: At that moment, Yan opens her eyes.

Chinese: 主公……？啊！
English: My lord? Ahhh!

Chinese: 她立刻坐起身来，我配合着退后一步，转开视线等她把衣物整理好。
English: She immediately sits up, and I step back, averting my gaze to allow her some privacy as she adjusts her clothing.

Chinese: 感谢主公留给我空间，现在可以看了。
English: Thank you for giving me a moment to compose myself. I am ready now.

Chinese: 我转回视线，果然，极焰已经恢复了平时利落的模样。
English: I turn my gaze back, seeing Yan returns to her usual neat appearance.

Chinese: 刚才松散的样子也没关系，我不介意。
English: I never find anything wrong with your appearance.

Chinese: 这是万万不可的。
English: That's why I prefer to always be sharply dressed.

Chinese: 大约是感到窘迫，她抿紧了嘴，摆出了严肃的表情。
English: She purses her lips and puts on a serious expression, likely out of embarrassment.

Chinese: 主公来找我，是有什么急事吗？
English: You called on me for an urgent matter, my lord?

Chinese: 因为回到红簌，她也换回了在红簌时使用的称呼，语气更加正式。
English: Returning to the Crimson Kingdom, she reverts to a more formal tone and addresses me by title.

Chinese: 在来到太一的时候，你忽然从我身边消失了，我有些担心，所以来见见你。
English: You vanished when I arrived at Taeuno. That got me worried, so here I am.

Chinese: 原来是这样。感谢主公的关心，我一切正常。
English: I see. I appreciate the concern. All is well, my lord.

Chinese: 极焰有些生硬地回答了我，随即低声补充。
English: Yan answers stiffly, then adds in a low voice.

Chinese: ……红簌的习俗，结婚前新郎新娘不可相见，否则婚事将生波折。还请快些回去吧。
English: But hey, Crimson Kingdom rules say no seeing each other before the wedding. Bad luck, you know? Better head out.

Chinese: （吻别）
English: (Kiss goodbye)

Chinese: 极焰，靠过来些。
English: Yan, come closer.

Chinese: 我们已经很熟悉了。听我这样招呼她，她露出了有些苦恼的表情，却没有拒绝。
English: We know each other well enough. Upon hearing my request, she looks somewhat concerned but doesn't refuse.

Chinese: 她向我走来，抬起头迎上我的亲吻。
English: She approaches me and raises her head to meet my kiss.

Chinese: 海棠花的影子轻轻摇曳，映照着地上的一双身影。片刻后，极焰推开了我。
English: The shadows of the begonia flowers sways gently, and our figures are reflected on the ground. After a while, Yan gently pushes me away.

Chinese: 该走了。坏了规矩，到底不好。
English: You should leave now. Can't be breaking traditions.

Chinese: 她退回摇曳的花荫之下，我与她分别。
English: Yan distances herself, retreating into the shade of the swaying flowers. This is where we part.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 跟着在山下等候的辰龙侍女回到行宫时，我远远地就看见了吉拉蒂亚的身影。
English: As I return to the palace with the Drago Maid who is waiting at the foot of the mountain, I see Giratia in the distance.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 侍主大人。
English: Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 她手中拿着一叠红纸，走到我的身边靠后位置站定。
English: She approaches holding a stack of red paper and stands at my side.

Chinese: 你来了。拿着什么？
English: You are here. What's all that?

Chinese: ……方才辰龙侍女们送来的，红簌的结婚流程。我大致看了一遍。
English: I just received the description of the Crimson Kingdom wedding style. I took a quick look.

Chinese: 感想怎么样？
English: And? What's your opinion?

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚似乎心事更重了。
English: Giratia seems worried.

Chinese: 这些日子以来，她一直都有些心不在焉，又问不出理由。
English: Giratia's been out of sorts lately.

Chinese: （本来想带她来红簌散散心的，感觉还是在走神。）
English: (I thought a trip to the Crimson Kingdom might cheer her up, but so far, no improvement.)

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚？
English: Giratia?

Chinese: 被我叫了名字，吉拉蒂亚回过神，垂着眼睛回答。
English: When I call her name, Giratia snaps back to reality, her eyes lowered.

Chinese: 相比于龙族的婚礼要繁杂许多。
English: A Dragon's wedding would be simpler.

Chinese: 龙族的婚礼是什么样的？
English: What is a dragon's wedding like?

Chinese: 龙族的婚礼需要祭司代龙神见证，随后两条龙就可以结合。
English: A dragon's wedding is witnessed by the priest on behalf of the Divine Dragon before the two dragons are married.

Chinese: 这么简单吗？
English: That's it?

Chinese: 这么简单。龙族的婚礼不需要多么繁杂的仪式。
English: Yep. A dragon's wedding is the complete opposite of a complicated ceremony.

Chinese: 爱的仪式，只需一个誓言，两个灵魂。
English: Love's ceremony is just one oath, two souls.

Chinese: 这么说的时候，那双玫红色的眼睛静静地注视着我。
English: Her rose-red eyes holds my gaze.

Chinese: 那之中似乎酝酿着异常的涌动，但细细看去，又什么都没有。
English: They are silent wells that threaten to overflow with unspoken emotion. Yet, when I peer deeper, their surfaces remain placid.

Chinese: 这很好。
English: Good to know.

Chinese: 说回婚礼吧，流程大致分为六步。
English: Well, this wedding basically has six steps.

Chinese: 婚前夜，新郎须寻人安床。
English: On the night before the wedding, the groom must find someone to prepare the bridal bed.

Chinese: 婚礼当日，新郎方款待宾客，请花轿前往新娘方。
English: On the day of the wedding, the groom entertains the guests and orders a sedan chair to go to the home of the bride's family.

Chinese: 因为是武家婚姻，新娘上轿子后，男方的伴郎出面，假装抢走新娘，由新郎与之决斗，抢回新娘。
English: Because the bride is from a warrior's family, there's this special tradition where the groom's best man pretends to steal the bride after she gets in the sedan chair.

Chinese: 抢亲环节结束，新郎接轿子至家门前，新娘出轿，新郎与新娘对拜。
English: After the kidnapping ceremony concludes, the groom brings the bride in the sedan chair to his place. Then, they bow to each other.

Chinese: 随后入洞房揭盖头，新郎出去，待新娘换妆后一同敬酒。
English: After they enter the bridal chamber, the groom gets a peek under the veil before stepping aside. The bride takes a moment to refresh her bridal makeup, and then they share a toast.

Chinese: 敬酒完毕，正式……入洞房。
English: Once the toast is finished, it is time to make it official... in the bedroom.

Chinese: 她说到入洞房时，声音像是被梗了一下，稍有滞涩，在我看她时又恢复如常。
English: When she mentions entering the bedroom, her voice wavers slightly. When I look at her, it returns to normal.

Chinese: 这就是婚礼的流程了。
English: So, there you have it, the entire wedding.

Chinese: 听着没什么。整个婚礼都在宫里办？
English: That doesn't sound too complicated. This all takes place in the palace?

Chinese: 不。秋英刚刚来接极焰，她们以卯兔行宫为新娘的娘家。
English: No. Yeah. Autumn Glory's fetching Yan from the Vernal Bunnic Palace, which will serve as her maiden home.

Chinese: 明天接亲，新娘子从卯兔行宫出发，轿子出宫走一圈，回到行宫时为礼成。
English: To receive the bride tomorrow, the bride will begin the procession from the Vernal Bunnic Palace. They'll do a lap around the palace to complete that part of the ceremony.

Chinese: 我知道了。伴郎这方面，灵昭有准备吗？
English: I know. Who's the best man?

Chinese: 我来担任伴郎。
English: That's me.

Chinese: 你做伴郎？
English: Why?

Chinese: 我是侍主大人的护卫，没什么不可以的。
English: I'm Lord Oracle's bodyguard, so it should be me.

Chinese: 请允许我这么做……感谢您。
English: I can do you this service... and I thank you for the honor.

Chinese: 见她坚持，我也点了点头。
English: She's dead set on it, so I agree.

Chinese: 这点改动流程的权利，我还是有的。
English: It can be arranged.

Chinese: 不过，为什么你要坚持做伴郎？
English: Why are you so set on this?

Chinese: 因为……
English: Because...

Chinese: （因为我无论如何，都想要在您身边最近的位置，见证您的一切。）
English: (Because I want to remain by your side, no matter what.)

Chinese: 因为我是您的护卫，身负重要的职责。
English: I'm your guard. It's my duty.

Chinese: （这明显不是真话。）
English: (Something's off.)

Chinese: （她在隐瞒什么？）
English: (She's hiding something.)

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚，你……
English: Giratia, you...

Chinese: 我还没有问出那个问题，就听见一连串的跑动声。
English: Before I can finish, footsteps come our way.

Chinese: [var=Actor]哥哥！
English: Dear [var=Actor]!

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 灵昭将宫女们远远地甩在身后，快步跑到我身边，一个纵跃扑进我的怀里。
English: Ling leaves the palace maids behind in the dust, sprinting to my side and leaping into my arms.

Chinese: 好几天不见了，我好想你呀！
English: I haven't seen you for days! I've missed you so much!

Chinese: 好久不见，阿昭。
English: Long time no see, Ling.

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚退后几步，将空间让给我和灵昭。
English: Giratia takes a subtle step aside, giving Ling and me some space.

Chinese: ……看来现在不是问话的好时候。
English: Seems like it isn't the moment for questions.

Chinese: 我抱起灵昭转了一圈，和她问好。
English: I scoop up Ling, twirling her around, and we share a warm greeting.

Chinese: [var=Actor]哥哥不在的这段时间，阿昭可是精心准备了呢！
English: [var=Actor], while you were away, I took care of everything!

Chinese: 在预算里精彩地排布了整场婚礼哦，不浪费，又很隆重。
English: The wedding's perfectly planned and well within budget, grand but not wasteful.

Chinese: 我看到了，辰龙宫里很热闹。你来这边找我？
English: I saw it. The Drago Palace is all abuzz about it. Did you come here to find me?

Chinese: 当然啦，这可是极焰姐姐出嫁前重要的时间，朕来替她看看新郎官。
English: Of course. Yan's wedding is a big deal. I'm checking in on the groom for her.

Chinese: 她挺起胸膛，做出皇帝威严的样子。我被她逗笑了，捏了捏她的鼻尖。
English: Ling puffs out her chest, suddenly looking like an imposing empress. I'm amused by her display and pinches the tip of her nose.

Chinese: 陛下意下如何？
English: What do you think, Your Majesty?
Hmm...

Chinese: 她坐在我的臂弯里，煞有介事地俯视着打量我。
English: Ling, perched within my embrace, gazes solemnly downward.

Chinese: 我耐心地等着她的回答。
English: I wait patiently for her answer.

Chinese: 过了几秒，她点点头，一副满意的样子。
English: Moments later, she nods with a satisfied look.

Chinese: 英姿神武，风流倜傥，好一个出色的新郎。朕准了这门婚事啦！
English: You are the epitome of handsomeness, a vision of charm and an exemplary groom. This marriage has my blessing!

Chinese: 是是，谢陛下隆恩。
English: Thanks for your gracious blessing, Your Majesty.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 看着笑成一团的灵昭和侍主，吉拉蒂亚的眼神黯淡下去。
English: Ling and I burst into laughter, the sound light and carefree. But as we share our moment of joy, I can't help but notice Giratia. Her eyes seem a little... dim.

Chinese: 即使已经有所觉悟，看着这一幕，她仍然感到胸中一阵阵的沉闷，像是在心里下起了一场雨。
English: Despite the jovial scene before her, she feels a tightness in her chest, as if a downpour is about to drench her soul.

Chinese: 她控制不住地想起了异邦波斯菊的话语。
English: Memories of Outlander Calli's words echo within her.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 你这个样子……他不会明白的哦。
English: If you keep this to yourself, he'll never know.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: （他记得我。但是，他身边的人也越来越多了。）
English: (He still holds me dear in his thoughts. Yet, the crowd following him thickens.)

Chinese: （会有那么一天，他忘记我吗？）
English: (I wonder if a time will come when I fade into oblivion.)

Chinese: （丹妮，你说的那个可能性，似乎离我越来越远了。）
English: (Danni, the future you spoke of drifts further from my grasp.)

Chinese: （我究竟该怎么办？）
English: (What should I do?)

Chinese: 吉拉蒂亚一边淋着心中的那场雨，一边静静地站在原地，看着在晴空之下玩闹的两人。
English: Despite the tempest raging inside, Giratia remains a silent sentinel, her presence steadfast as she witnesses the playful exchange under the clear skies.

Chinese: 她始终静静地守望着，没有走开一步。
English: Her vigil is unwavering, her feet rooted to the spot.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 时光飞逝，很快，婚礼的当日便到来了。
English: Time passes swiftly, and the long-awaited wedding day arrives.

Chinese: 卯兔行宫内，异邦波斯菊正坐在极焰身前，面色凝重地望着她。
English: Inside the Bunnic Palace, Outlander Calli sits across from Yan, her expression solemn.

Chinese: 还是不行吗？我觉得这套已经差不多可以了。
English: This one's not going to work either, huh? I think this one is suitable.

Chinese: 看着异邦波斯菊的表情，极焰有些无奈。
English: Yan feels a bit lost under Outlander Calli's intense scrutiny.

Chinese: 不行……这可是女孩子一生最重要的仪式，不可以马虎对待的。
English: And yet... it's a once-a-lifetime ceremony and can't be taken lightly.

Chinese: 陛下送来这么多套喜服，就是希望你好好挑选，度过一个尽可能完美的婚礼呀。
English: The Empress sent a whole wardrobe hoping you'd find the perfect garment to make you shine.

Chinese: （明明进来时还看起来萎靡不振的样子，说到衣服就立刻精神起来了……）
English: (Her mood becomes astonishingly perky the moment they start talking dresses...)

Chinese: 这套也不行吗？
English: And what about this one?

Chinese: 嗯，有点拖沓，让极焰显得有点没精神。
English: Messy. Makes you look dull.

Chinese: 但……这几套不都差不多吗？
English: But... don't they all look rather... similar?

Chinese: 听到极焰的话，异邦波斯菊的脸色一变。
English: That gets Calliopsis frowning.

Chinese: ……（糟糕，失言了。）
English: (Oops, I misspoke...)

Chinese: 秋英，我的意思是……
English: Autumn Glory, I mean...

Chinese: 怎么可以这么说呢！
English: How can you say that!

Chinese: 异邦波斯菊一反刚才的弱气，气鼓鼓地打断了极焰的话语。
English: Outlander Calli's interruption is fierce, a stark departure from her previous timidity.

Chinese: 从三套之前开始，每一套都是有问题的！
English: Starting with just the last three bridal sets, each one has serious flaws!

Chinese: 这一套是太修身，裙摆却太长，显得有些拖拉。
English: This one clings too tightly, that one's skirt drags on the floor.

Chinese: 这一套呢，太宽大，流苏也太多了。
English: The other is too voluminous and weighed down by excessive tassels.

Chinese: 而这套是太简洁了，衬托不出极焰的气质。

English: You should ask Anna. All the clothing we sell is designed by her.

English: You can request a refund. But if you want to order again, you'll have to get back in line.

Chinese: 哈哈，醉话，当不得真……
English: Haha, just drunken talk. Forget it...

Chinese: 还没到时候。
English: You'll know soon.

Chinese: 先来泡温泉吧，旅者，在温泉里等待更好。
English: For now, let's just soak in the spa and wait, Traveler.

Chinese: （一个惊喜？来自卡萝琳……或者瑞比娅？！）
English: (A surprise? From Caroline or Reybia?!)

Chinese: 少女低着头，好像在刻意躲避我的目光。
English: She lowers her head, avoiding eye contact.

Chinese: 好。
English: Sure.

Chinese: 她将湿透的衣服一件件揭下来，叠在温泉边，随后沉入温泉里。
English: She takes off her soaked clothes and folds them neatly before sinking into the spa.

Chinese: 看她这样坦荡，我也就地脱了衣服，和她一同入池泡澡。
English: Seeing how naturally she does it, I undress as well and join her in the bath.

Chinese: 热气蒸去了夜风中的寒意，卡萝琳和我保持着一点距离，嘟起嘴去吹水面，看着波纹层层荡开。
English: The steam drives away the night's chill. Caroline keeps some distance from me, puffing at the water's surface, watching the ripples spread.

Chinese: 细微的白气模糊了猎人凛冽的眉眼，她看起来像是在笑一样。
English: The faint mist softens her sharp features. She almost looks like she's smiling.

Chinese: 和旅者这样待在一起，有一种很安心的感觉。
English: It feels reassuring to be with you like this.

Chinese: 安心吗？对我来说可是很新奇的事。
English: Reassuring? That's rare for me.

Chinese: 为什么？
English: Why?

Chinese: 因为你……你……
English: Is it because...

Chinese: 因为你和其他人这样泡过澡就会滚到床上去吗？
English: Because you usually end up in bed with others when you soak in the spa with them?

Chinese: 原来你听说过这件事啊，我还以为你在这方面的信息不算灵通。
English: So you've heard about that? I thought you weren't very informed about these matters.

Chinese: 上次去听安洁讲课的时候，她告诉我的。
English: I heard it last time when I attended Angie's lecture.

Chinese: 她说你不在办公室，多半就是和一些星痕鬼混去了。
English: She said if you're not in the office, you're probably off fooling around with some Asters.

Chinese: 不是所有时候都适用，但也算是大多数情况。
English: Not always, but... often enough.

Chinese: 你会因为这件事讨厌我吗，卡萝琳？
English: Would that make you dislike me, Caroline?

Chinese: ……不会。
English: No.

Chinese: 旅者对我很诚实。
English: You're honest with me.

Chinese: 她从水中伸出手，去接从天上落下来的雪花。
English: She lifts her hand from the water to catch the snowflakes falling.

Chinese: ……雪花？
English: Snow?

Chinese: 今天是晴天，怎么会有雪？
English: Why is there snow on such a clear day?

Chinese: 一片接一片的雪落下，还未到达温泉就被融化，变成淅淅沥沥的细雨。
English: The snowflakes fall and melt before reaching the spa, turning into a fine drizzle.

Chinese: 温泉上的白气更盛，彼此的面容在雾气之下变得模糊不清。
English: The mist over the spa thickens, blurring our faces.

Chinese: 这就是你刚刚累到睡着的原因？
English: Is this why you were so exhausted earlier?

Chinese: 瑞比娅说，下雪天泡温泉会有特别的气氛。
English: Reybia said a snowy spa feels special.

Chinese: 她说得没错。这样，还算值得。
English: She was right. It's worth it.

Chinese: 白雾短暂地被卡萝琳拨开，藕节似的手指一闪，又被隐去了。
English: Caroline briefly parts the white mist with her slender fingers.

Chinese: 你感觉到了吗，旅者？
English: Do you feel it, Traveler?

Chinese: 当然。很美妙的感受。
English: Of course. A wonderful feeling.

Chinese: 谢谢你，卡萝琳。
English: Thank you, Caroline.

Chinese: 不客气。
English: You're welcome.

Chinese: 不过，只是这样是不够的。
English: But this isn't enough.

Chinese: 旅者，你忘了捏一捏我的脸。
English: Traveler, you forgot to pinch my cheek.

Chinese: 嗯？我记得最开始你还会打开我的手呢。
English: Hmm? I remember you used to slap my hand away.

Chinese: ……我们的关系变得不同，彼此可以有的行动也不同了。
English: As our relationship changes, the things we can do are different.

Chinese: 她向我靠过来一些，睫毛挑起温软的雾气，露出冷澈的眼瞳。
English: She leans in slightly, her eyes sparkled in the mist.

Chinese: 天空暗蓝，温泉摇荡，我们共浴一场温暖的雾雪。
English: Under the dark blue sky and in the rippling spa, we share this bath of snow and mist.

Chinese: 捏吗。
English: Pinch?

Chinese: 捏。
English: Pinch.

Chinese: 我向她伸出手。然而，在那一瞬，我们的目光都变了。
English: I reach out my hand to her. The next second, we both look alert.

Chinese: 我搂住她的腰、她抓住我的手腕，两人一起跳出温泉。
English: I grab her waist, she grabs my wrist, and together, we leap out of the spa.

Chinese: 嘭！一块巨大的冰从天而降，砸进温泉池里，水花四溅，泼了我们一身。
English: Boom! A huge ice chunk slams into the pool, splashing water everywhere and drenching us.

Chinese: ……你是不是用力过头了？
English: Looks like you've overdone it.

Chinese: 失败并不少见，至少不危及性命。
English: Failures happen. At least we're both alive.

Chinese: 她理直气壮地回答我。
English: She defends herself.

Chinese: 唉……算了。这温泉一时半会儿泡不好了，我们去换衣服吧。
English: Alas... forget it. The spa's ruined. Let's go change.

Chinese: 都湿透了。
English: The clothes are soaked through.

Chinese: 我看了看脚边。就像她说的，刚才放在泉池边的衣服，现在都已经被溅出的温泉水泡透了。
English: I glance down. Just as she said, the clothes we left by the pool are now drenched in water.

Chinese: 旅者，你去换衣服，这里我来处理。
English: Traveler, go get changed. I'll handle things here.

Chinese: 拜托你了。
English: OK.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 当我再走出来时，卡萝琳正坐在廊下，整理着鬓边的发饰。
English: When I step back out, Caroline is sitting under the eaves, adjusting her hair ornament.

Chinese: 都收拾好了，旅者。
English: All cleaned up, Traveler.

Chinese: 裹着她身体的薄款浴巾浸满了水，贴紧了那具玲珑的躯体。我有些意外地打量着她。
English: The thin towel she's wearing is drenched, clinging tightly to her slender frame. I size her up in surprise.

Chinese: 你的表情很意外。怎么了？房间里有魔物？
English: You look surprised. What's on your mind? Something strange?

Chinese: ……你很成熟。
English: You've matured.

Chinese: 危机能让猎人成长，仅此而已。
English: Yeah, crisis makes a hunter grow.

Chinese: 我想我们说的不是一件事……算了，别太在意。
English: I don't think we're talking about the same thing... Never mind.

Chinese: 我在她身边坐下，与她一起看向温泉。
English: I sit beside her, and we both look at the spa.

Chinese: 刚才砸落的冰块已经完全化了，温泉上的雾气短暂地散去了一些。
English: The ice chunk has already melted, and the mist over the water has briefly thinned.

Chinese: 特别的气氛完全消失了。
English: The special atmosphere is all gone.

Chinese: 还会有下一次的。
English: We'll do this again another time.

Chinese: 不过，卡萝琳，下次出来不要穿成这个样子了。
English: But next time, Caroline, don't go out dressed like this.

Chinese: 不行吗？其他星痕和你在一起的时候，也有不穿的人。
English: Why not? There are some other Asters who dress like this when they're with you.

Chinese: ……你想和我缔结更深层的关系吗？
English: Do you want to take our relationship to the next level?

Chinese: 我不知道。
English: I don't know.

Chinese: 如果是和你一起做那种事，我不讨厌。
English: If it's with you, I don't mind doing that thing.

Chinese: 看着她坦诚的表情，我轻轻地叹了口气。
English: Her innocent look makes me sigh softly.

Chinese: 你不高兴吗，旅者？
English: Did I upset you, Traveler?

Chinese: 没有的事。不过，我还是希望你能明白这句话的意义之后，我们再继续往下。
English: Not at all. I just think we should wait until you truly understand its meaning before we take the next step.

Chinese: 至于现在……还是先看夜空吧。
English: As for now... let's just watch the night sky.

Chinese: 我抱你回房间好吗？
English: Shall I carry you back to the room?

Chinese: 婚礼之后，我便一直想挤出一些时间，多陪陪吉拉蒂亚。时至今日，终于把积冗的工作清扫一空了。
English: Since the wedding, I have been trying to make more time to spend with Giratia. Today, I have finally cleared my backlog.

Chinese: 推开门，走廊外空荡荡的——
English: I push open the door—the corridor outside is empty.
(That's odd...)

Chinese: （平时一个个都来假装偶遇，今天怎么？）
English: (Normally, they'd pretend to "accidentally" run into me. But today?)

Chinese: 走廊对面的门那头，昏暗的天光下，缀着一个孤零零的影子。
English: Across the dimly lit corridor, under the fading evening glow, a solitary figure sits there.

Chinese: 怎么一个人在这里坐着？
English: Why are you sitting out here alone?

Chinese: 她跳了起来，回过头，脸上却满是泪痕。
English: She jumps up. As she turns around, her face is streaked with tears.

Chinese: 哎，怎么——
English: Hey, what—

Chinese: 像一只纯白的归鸟，伏在了我的怀里。
English: Like a pure white bird returning to its nest, she collapses into my arms.

Chinese: 我轻轻拍着她的后背，抱着她，顺势坐了下来。
English: I gently pat her on the back, holding her close as I sit down.

Chinese: 不管是因为什么，总之，现在她更需要这个。
English: Whatever has happened, this is what she needs right now.

Chinese: 好一会儿——天黑得能看见星星了，她才慢慢停止了抽噎。
English: She stays like that for a while, and by the time her sobs subside, the sky has darkened and the stars have come out.

Chinese: （……好像是不敢抬头。）
English: (She still won't look up at me.)

Chinese: 我一边用手指帮她拢着鬓角纷乱的发丝，一边悄悄把她的脸拨向我这边。
English: I gently tuck the loose strands of hair near her temples, quietly turning her face toward me.

Chinese: 眼睛周围红红的，也不敢睁眼，有点不知道怎么面对现实的感觉。
English: Her eyes are red and puffy, reluctant to open, like she isn't ready to face the reality.

Chinese: 沿着龙角的根，我的手慢慢往上滑着。它白的像初冬的雪，是她身上诸多美丽的事物之一。
English: My hand moves up along the base of her horn. White as early winter snow, it's one of the many striking parts of her beauty.
Hmm...

Chinese: 她不由得睁了眼，看着我，眼神又躲开。
English: She instinctively opens her eyes at me, but quickly averts them.

Chinese: （看来还不想说话。）
English: (Still not ready to talk.)

Chinese: 手掌回到龙角的根，捧着她的头，我浅浅地吻了她的眉心。
English: I rest my hand at the base of her horn, gently cradling her head before pressing a light kiss to her forehead.
Hmm...

Chinese: 她下意识揽住我的脖子，我就势环过她的腿弯，把她抱了起来。
English: She wraps her arms around my neck, and I take the chance to slip an arm under her legs, lifting her into my arms.

Chinese: 就这么把她抱回了办公室，坐到沙发上——她仍然在我怀里。
English: I carry her back into the office, settling onto the couch with her curled up against me.

Chinese: 是不是因为我冷落你了？
English: Are you upset because I haven’t been paying you enough attention?

Chinese: 她用脑袋蹭了蹭我的胸口——是在摇头。
English: She shakes her head, rubbing her forehead against my chest.

Chinese: 那，谁欺负你了？
English: Then... did someone bully you?

Chinese: 她又蹭了蹭我。
English: Another shake of the head.

Chinese: （唔……那是因为什么？）
English: (Hmm... then what is the reason?)

Chinese: 我用拇指挠了挠她的下巴，她受用地眯着眼，慢慢抬起头。
English: I lightly scratch her chin, and she tilts her head up, eyes closing in contentment.

Chinese: 停下了手上的动作，她自然而然地睁开了眼。
English: When I stop, her eyes slowly open again.

Chinese: 可以告诉我原因吗？
English: Can you tell me why?

Chinese: 为什么哭了。
English: Why are you crying?

Chinese: 她眨巴眨巴眼睛，再一次摇了摇头。
English: She blinks a few times and shakes her head again.

Chinese: 呐，你要是告诉我，我就给你一个惊喜。
English: Come on, if you tell me, I'll give you a surprise.

Chinese: 她的眼睛跳动了一下，思索片刻，还是摇了摇头。
English: Her eyes flicker. Thinking for a moment, she still shakes her head.

Chinese: 见我思索，她伸出手指，抚了抚我的眉心。
English: Seeing me ponder, she reaches out and lightly brushes my forehead.

Chinese: 我……不想让你为难。
English: I... I don't want to trouble you.

Chinese: ……你不说我会更为难。
English: Your silence troubles me even more.

Chinese: 好不容易对上的视线又挪开了。但好在，她终于肯张口了。
English: She avoids my gaze again. But at least, she is finally speaking.

Chinese: 你不让我做侍卫官了……我……我很难过。
English: You don't want me to be the guard anymore. I... I feel really sad.

Chinese: 但、但不是想要怪你的意思……
English: But—but I don't mean to blame you...

Chinese: 你想起我的时候来找我就好了，我会一直在家里等你的。
English: If you ever need me, just come find me. I'll always be waiting at home.

Chinese: 一瞬间，我就明白了她话里藏着的意思——
English: In an instant, I understand what she really means.

Chinese: “你如果不喜欢我了，也没关系——”
English: "Even if you don't love me anymore, it's OK."

Chinese: “我会等你的。”
English: "I'll still wait for you. "

Chinese: 说是换掉，其实是换个名头，继续让她待在我身边而已。
English: I never meant to replace her. It's only a new title.

Chinese: 护卫、秘书、侍从、顾问，这种头衔要多少有多少。原本是女孩子们玩笑一般的借口，唯独这个傻家伙当了真。
English: Guard, secretary, attendant, advisor—whatever the title, it's all the same. The other girls treated it as a joke, but this silly girl took it seriously.

Chinese: 我把桌子上安娜送来的东西取了过来，递给了吉拉蒂亚。
English: I pick up the thing Anna has left on my desk and hand it to Giratia.

Chinese: 看看这个？
English: Look at this.

Chinese: 这是……我和安娜做的衣服……
English: This is... the outfit Anna and I made...

Chinese: 怎么在你这里……
English: Why do you have it?

Chinese: 本来就是我找安娜订的，送给你的。
English: Because I commissioned it from her. It's a gift for you.

Chinese: 秘书官的位置本来就是你的。不信的话，穿上试试尺码？
English: The secretary position was always meant for you. If you don't believe me, try it on and see if it fits.
But...

Chinese: 你、背过身去……
English: You turn around first...

Chinese: 我笑了笑，站起身，关上了办公室的灯。
English: I chuckle, stand up, and turn off the office lights.

Chinese: 背后传来阵阵衣物的窸窣声。过了一会儿，低到几乎听不见的声音响了起来——
English: I hear the faint rustling of fabric from behind. Then, in the softest voice—

Chinese: 好了……
English: I'm ready...

Chinese: 我打开灯转过头，一个俏生生的秘书官就这么出现在我面前。
English: I switch the lights back on and turn around—there she stands, a neatly dressed secretary.

Chinese: 还合身吗？我应该没记错尺码。
English: Does it fit? I got the size right, didn't I?
Hmm...

Chinese: 尺码合适，也就是说——我的话是真的。秘书官的位置本来就是她的。
English: It fits, that means my words were true. The secretary position was always hers.

Chinese: 她显然也意识到了这一点，脸红得不知道往哪里放。
English: She realizes it too—her face flushes red.

Chinese: 哎……都想哪去了。
English: Hey... what are you even thinking?

Chinese: 她显然有话想说，又羞于启齿。
English: She clearly wants to say something but is too shy.

Chinese: 她低着头冲了过来，把灯熄了，隔着昏暗的星光，对着我。
English: She darts forward and turns off the lights, standing in the dim starlight with her head low.

Chinese: 我真的值得你对我这么好吗……
English: Do I really deserve this?

Chinese: 值得？
English: Deserve?

Chinese: 她在黑夜中抬起头，暗红色的眼睛再一次对上了我。
English: In the dark, she raises her head, her dark red eyes locking onto mine once again.

Chinese: 不是交易，也没有所谓值得与不值得。
English: It's not a trade, so don't think about whether you deserve it or not.

Chinese: 不是择优而取，不是待价而沽。
English: I'm not going to judge or put a tag on you.

Chinese: 而是——从坎特维尔到吉利亚斯，甚至放眼整个星海……吉拉蒂亚也只有一个。
English: Because—from Cantwell to Hiliyath, and even across the entire Celestial Sea, you're one of a kind.

Chinese: 谁也代替不了。我就要这个。
English: No one can take your place. You’re the only one I want.

Chinese: 可是……我不明白……
English: But... I don't understand...

Chinese: 这本来也不是需要被理解的事情。
English: This isn't something that needs to be understood.

Chinese: 一个誓言，两个灵魂。米伦的诸神为我们见证过。
English: One oath, two souls. The gods of Mirren have borne witness.

Chinese: 何况——那是我的诺言。
English: Not to mention, that is my promise.

Chinese: 不是说过吗？难道你忘了——
English: Didn't I tell you? Have you forgotten?

Chinese: 我没忘……
English: I haven't forgotten...

Chinese: 那就回答我——
English: Then answer me.

Chinese: 即使你什么都搞砸了——
English: Even if you mess everything up—

Chinese: 即使我什么也没有做，你也愿意。
English: Even if I've done nothing, you're still willing.

Chinese: 她说着便扑了过来，抱着我，撞在桌子上，翅膀扫得周围七零八落。
English: She speaks and lunges at me. When she hugs me, she crashes into the table, her wings scattering things around.

Chinese: 我……我真傻。
English: I... I was so foolish.

Chinese: 我以为你不要我了……
English: I thought you didn't want me anymore...

Chinese: 她又伏在我胸口，埋着头抽噎起来。
English: She buries her head in my chest and begins to sob again.

Chinese: 我扣着那一对角，用下巴靠着她的头，想让她的情绪慢慢稳定下来。
English: I hold her horns gently, resting my chin on her head, trying to calm her down.

Chinese: 她那头几乎要垂到地上的头发实在是漂亮。搭配上刚换好得秘书官制服，我恰好能从长发间摸到她滑嫩的后背。
English: Her hair, almost touching the ground, is stunning. The secretary uniform allows me to reach her smooth back through her long hair.

Chinese: 怀中的她颤了颤，带着那柔软的触感也跳了跳。
English: She trembles in my arms, and I feel something soft quiver as well.

Chinese: 她察觉到了什么，抬起头。视线的温度骤然攀升，瞬间就明白了彼此的心意。
English: She senses something and raises her head. Through her burning gaze, we understand each other's feelings in an instant.

Chinese: 一夜无话。
English: No more talking for the rest of the night.

Ah...

Chinese: 唔……好了……

Chinese: 我也穿好了衣服。这里暂时是不能待了。况且，我也没有休息够。

Chinese: 晨风让我们清醒了一点。我侧过头，看见吉拉蒂亚嘴角的笑意。
English: The morning breeze wakes us a little. I turn my head and glimpse the smile at the corner of Giratia's mouth.

Chinese: 水流没有问题……温度也很好地保存住了。

Chinese: 克尔苏娜的脸红透了。

Chinese: 真对不起。
English: I'm really sorry.

Chinese: 不要再说对不起了，这算不上什么。
English: There's no need to apologize.

Chinese: 你刚刚说它碰到你的脚了，碰到哪里？受伤了吗？

Chinese: 应该没有，不疼的。
English: No, I don't think so.

Chinese: 说着，她调整了姿势，让我看她的脚踝。

Chinese: 克尔苏娜似乎没有意识到，她的动作会导致浴巾散开。
English: Kelsuna doesn't realize that her movement would cause her towel to slip.

Chinese: 我的动作停顿了一下，克尔苏娜立刻发现了问题。
English: I freeze for a moment, and Kelsuna immediately notices the problem.

Chinese: 呜……！不是，我不是这个意思……
English: Ugh! Wait, no, I didn't mean—

Chinese: 克尔苏娜惊慌地裹紧了浴巾。
English: Flustered, Kelsuna clutches the towel tightly around herself.

Chinese: ……然而，这没能让局面变好哪怕一点儿。
English: However, that doesn't improve the situation in the slightest.

Chinese: 单薄的浴巾被浸湿了，紧贴着她的身躯，清晰地勾勒出精灵那稚嫩的曲线。
English: The thin fabric is already soaked, clinging to her frame and tracing the curves of her elven figure.

Chinese: 别慌，我不看。我知道你不是故意的。
English: Relax. I won't look. I know you wouldn't do it on purpose...

Chinese: 我挪开视线，看向温泉池里她摇曳的倒影。
English: I turn my gaze to her wavering reflection in the water.

Chinese: 呜、谢谢侍主大人……
English: Ugh... thank you, Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 克尔苏娜看起来惊魂未定。
English: Kelsuna still looks shaken.

Chinese: 水面上映出的她慢慢靠近水面，把自己整个人都埋了进去。
English: Her reflection moves as she slowly submerges herself in the water.

Chinese: 好了吗？
English: Is it done?

Chinese: 嗯，已经好了……您可以转过来啦。
English: Mm, I'm in place... You can turn around.

Chinese: 她肩膀以下都沉在水里，裹着身体的浴巾在水下散开一个角。
English: She's submerged up to her shoulders, with the towel floating loose beneath the water.

Chinese: 这样的方式似乎让她觉得好过了一些，她靠近了我，抬起头打量我的肩膀。
English: This seems to make her feel a little better. She inches closer, examining my shoulder.

Chinese: 您的衣服都湿透了……都是因为我一惊一乍的。
English: Your clothes are soaked... all because I panicked.

Chinese: 还是要快一点换掉吧？
English: You should change.

Chinese: 我在这里陪你一下就去。
English: I'll stay with you a little longer, then I'll go.

Chinese: 诶？我没关系的。
English: Huh? I'm fine, really.

Chinese: 你发抖只是因为刚才冷吗？
English: You're shivering. Still feeling cold?

Chinese: 其实不是的。我还有点儿怕。
English: Not exactly. I'm still a little scared.

Chinese: 可是，要是您是为了我在这儿受凉，我是不能接受的。
English: But I wouldn't want you to end up catching a cold because of me.

English: What if there are more crabs in the pool?

English: You're scaring me again... There shouldn't be any, right? I filtered the water very carefully. I don't know how I made a slip and let a crab in.

Chinese: 待会儿我再检查一遍，不能让其他人受这种惊吓。
English: I'll check again later. I can't let it scare anyone else.

Chinese: 我猜很多人想的只有吃螃蟹羹。
English: I bet most people are only thinking about crab soup.

Chinese: 好了，你背过身去吧，我就在这里换。
English: Alright, turn around. I'll change here.

Chinese: 好的，我帮您拿浴巾。
English: OK, I'll get your towel.

Chinese: 听到我要在这里换衣服，克尔苏娜的呼吸明显乱了，耳朵也变得有些红。

Chinese: 她逃似的转过身去，指挥信隼从房间里叼来我的浴巾。
English: She quickly turns away, almost like she is escaping, and then instructs the carrier falcon to fetch my towel.

Chinese: 想要和您一直在一起，并且独占您，我不会想那么僭越的事情……

Chinese: 没有谁比我们这一代的精灵更清楚您的心归属于谁。

English: The answer, of course, is no. And yet, Sarah feels it.

Chinese: 那是对转瞬即逝的东西所萌生的“遗憾”与“不舍”。
English: It is a sense of regret and reluctance toward something fleeting.

Chinese: （这种感情……似曾相识。）
English: (This feeling... it's familiar.)

Chinese: 那又是什么时候的事呢？
English: When was the last time she felt this way?

Chinese: 天使的记忆永远是明澈清晰的。萨拉不费吹灰之力，就回忆起了那一场壮美的流星雨。
English: An angel's memory is always clear and unclouded. Without effort, Sarah recalls that magnificent meteor shower.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 我希望我和你今天的相处是特别的，是不会重复、无比珍贵的一刻。
English: I hope that my time with you today is special, an irreplaceable and precious moment.

Chinese: 我希望在久远的时间后，我仍然能回忆起今日的快乐，而不是把它当成寻常的某一天。
English: I hope that in the distant future, I will still remember today's joy, rather than mix it up with any other ordinary day.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 萨拉感到困惑。
English: Sara is puzzled.

Chinese: 对天使而言，与这位大人的相处也同样会是永恒之事。
English: To an angel, time spent with her lord is eternal.

Chinese: 为何永恒的双方，要去执着“一刻”的概念呢？
English: Why, then, would two eternal beings concern themselves with the notion of a single fleeting moment?

Chinese: 但在感到困惑的同时，她也意识到了——自己正在为某种事遗憾。
English: Yet, as confusion fills her, she also realizes—she is experiencing a strange kind of regret.

Chinese: 值得铭记的“一刻”正在增加。她为着这些“一刻”不能成为永恒而感到遗憾。
English: The number of moments worth remembering is increasing. And she feels regret that these moments can't last forever.

Chinese: 到这一刻为止，天使还不知道这遗憾究竟有什么作用；因此，她将遗憾轻飘飘地抛在脑后。
English: At this point, the angel still doesn't understand the significance of such regret. So, she just casts it aside.

Chinese: （现在有更重要的事要做。）
English: (There are more important matters at hand.)

Chinese: 在风又一次将花茎上的攀爬者摇下时，萨拉向城中的裁缝送去了信隼。
English: As the wind once again shakes the climber off the flower stem, Sarah sends a carrier falcon to the city's tailor.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 舞会的风波过去，尽管有许多星痕为此不满，日子姑且也平静地过着。
English: The ball's commotion fades. Despite many Asters' displeasure, life goes on peacefully.

Chinese: 直到数天后的一个夜晚——我收到了一封邀请函。
English: Until, one night, I receives an invitation.

Chinese:
致侍主大人：
我已为您准备好您所需要的事物，请您激发信件上的魔法阵获取它。
萨拉
English:
To Lord Oracle:
I have prepared what you need. Please activate the magic circle on this letter to receive it.
Sarah

Chinese: （我所需要的事物？）
English: (What I need?)

Chinese: （萨拉这么神秘，到底准备了什么……）
English: (Sara's being secretive... What could she have prepared?)

Chinese: 尽管感到疑惑，我仍然触发了魔法阵。
English: Despite my confusion, I activates the magic circle.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 在传送阵的魔法波动后，景色骤然变换——眼前是一处陌生的豪华大厅。
English: A surge of magic shifts the scenery, and I find myself in a grand ballroom.

Chinese: 人们觥筹交错，各自交谈着——以与米德加尔不同的语调。
English: People clink glasses and converse in a dialect distinct from Midgard's.

Chinese: （这里离米德加尔很远。）
English: (This place is far from Midgard.)

Chinese: （萨拉把我传送过来……是为什么？）
English: (Why has Sarah sent me here?)

Chinese: 敬天之扉。敬宁静的、秩序的时代。敬我们的使命！
English: To the Gate of Heaven. To an era of peace and order! To our grand mission!

Chinese: 先生们， 女士们！用你们的舞蹈庆贺吧，庆贺这一日的结束！
English: Ladies and gentlemen! Celebrate with your dances—the night has begun!

Chinese: （一场舞会。）
English: (A ball.)

Chinese: （难道说，萨拉是为了前些天我的那句话……）
English: (Could it be... because of what I said the other day?)

Chinese: 高跟鞋敲打地面的声音靠近了。我转头看去，收敛了羽翼与光环的萨拉正款款地靠近我。
English: The sound of heels clicking against the floor draws closer. I turn and see Sarah approaching gracefully, her wings and halo concealed.

Chinese: 我主，夜安。
English: Good evening, my lord.

Chinese: 我打量着她。
English: I study her.

Chinese: 这身礼服的剪裁不可谓不大胆，但穿在萨拉身上，却只是衬得她愈发高雅美丽。
English: The cut of the dress is bold, but on her, it only enhances her elegance and beauty.

Chinese: 像是夜空的女神静静伫立在我面前，那凛然的美貌，此刻展现出了更加柔和的一面。
English: Like a night sky goddess, she stands before me, her usual dignified beauty softening slightly.

Chinese: 这是你定做的礼服？
English: This is your custom made dress?

Chinese: 是的。若要在一场符合人类标准的舞会上跳舞，礼服必不可少。
English: Yes. If one is to dance at a human ball, a proper dress is essential.

Chinese: 萨拉提裙向我行礼，随后向我伸出手。
English: Sarah lifts her skirt and curtsies before extending a hand to me.

Chinese: 这里没有您所认识的人，您是一位体面的先生，仅此而已。
English: No one here knows you. To them, you are simply a gentleman of good standing.

Chinese: 而您的舞伴……就在这里。
English: And your dance partner... is right here.

Chinese: （握住她的手）
English: (Take her hand)

Chinese: 女士，很高兴和你共度今夜。
English: Lady, I am honored to share this evening with you.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 跳舞的地方是城里最大的议会厅，在水晶灯的照耀下，年轻的男男女女寻找着彼此的舞伴。
English: The grandest hall in the city is filled with young men and women seeking their partners.

Chinese: 随着大提琴的声音宣告舞会开场，人们纷纷滑入舞池。
English: As the cello signals the start of the ball, the crowd gracefully step onto the dance floor.

Chinese: 萨拉扶着我的肩膀旋转，每一步都精确优雅。
English: Sarah places her hand on my shoulder, moving with flawless precision and grace.

Chinese: 天界也有舞会吗？
English: Are there balls in the Heavenly Realm?

Chinese: 人类的娱乐活动对天使来说不是必需品，我们会将更多时间花在保持自身的纯粹之上。
English: Entertainment is not a necessity for angels. We devote our time to maintaining our purity.

Chinese: 你的舞跳得很好。
English: You dance beautifully.

Chinese: 感谢您的肯定，我主。
English: Thank you for your kind words, my lord.

Chinese: 只是为了跟上我主的步伐所必须的素质罢了，请珍惜您的夸赞。
English: It is simply a skill necessary to match your steps. Please use your praise sparingly.

Chinese: 随着舞曲的节奏，我们沿着美妙的弧形踏步，向着核心圈靠近。
English: As the music guides us through elegant arcs, we drift toward the center of the floor.

Chinese: 不想被我夸赞吗？
English: Do you not wish for my praise?

Chinese: 如果可以，我希望被您一直夸赞。
English: If I could, I would wish for your praise endlessly.

Chinese: 她坦荡地说。
English: She speaks without hesitation.

Chinese: 您的夸赞十分珍贵，即使对我来说，亦是如此。
English: Your praise is precious—even to me.

Chinese: 所以你希望这份“奖赏”被保留在最耀眼的时刻。
English: So you wish for it to be saved for the most radiant moments.

Chinese: 是的，还请我主赐予我这样的特殊。
English: Yes. Please grant me such a special gift.

Chinese: ——这不也是一种“刹那”吗？
English: Is that not, too, a fleeting moment?

Chinese: 天使似乎被这句话所击中了。
English: The angel seems struck by my words.

Chinese: 她惊讶地睁大了眼睛——
English: She widens her eyes in surprise—

Chinese: 准备好。
English: Get ready.

Chinese: 我们不知不觉来到舞池中央，舞曲来到高潮。
English: We have somehow reached the center of the dance floor. The music swells to its climax.

Chinese: 小提琴高昂地鸣奏，辉煌的灯光垂落下来，笼罩着我们两人。
English: The violin sings in soaring notes, and the golden light cascades down, enveloping the two of us.

Chinese: 我举起她的手，引导她在我的手下旋转，裙摆随之飞散。
English: I lift her hand, guiding her into a graceful spin beneath mine, her skirt fanning out in the motion.

Chinese: 深蓝色的夜幕剪开了白昼似的光芒，像水晶摔碎在夜空里，在人群的中心转开星轨似的耀眼线条。
English: The deep blue sky splits with dazzling light, like shattered crystal arcing above the crowd.

Chinese: 那两位是……
English: Who are those two?

Chinese: 不认识啊，跳得真好……
English: No idea, but they dance so well...

Chinese: 萨拉仰起头，像是第一次认识世界那样注视着我。
English: Sara tilts her head up, gazing at me as if seeing the world for the first time.

Chinese: 灯光落进她金色的瞳孔，那眼神一瞬涣散如融金，又很快凝聚起来。
English: The lights reflect in her golden eyes, briefly softening into molten gold before clearing.

Chinese: ……不可思议。
English: Unbelievable.

Chinese: 我竟然会和人类一样……对这一刻产生留恋，希望这一刻也能永恒地持续下去。
English: I never thought I could be like a human... to cherish this moment and wish for it to last forever.

Chinese: 但这一刻正因为短暂，才会珍贵。
English: But it is precisely because this moment is fleeting that it becomes precious.

Chinese: 一直跳下去，舞会也就失去了意义。
English: If we danced forever, the ball itself would lose its meaning.

Chinese: 在您看来，刹那是珍贵的。那么，永恒是无意义的吗？
English: To you, the fleeting moment is precious. Then, does eternity have no meaning?

Chinese: 不，并不是这样的。
English: No, that's not it.

Chinese: 舞曲缓缓停止，只留下漫长的余音。
English: The music gradually fades, leaving only a lingering echo.

Chinese: 我与她相对而立，互相行礼。
English: We stand facing each other and exchange bows.

Chinese: 永恒的含义不是不变，而是在变化中的延续。
English: Eternity does not mean stagnation—it is the continuation of change.

Chinese: 无数个珍贵的刹那堆叠起来，从过去延续到现在、随后抵达未来。
English: Countless precious moments stack upon one another, stretching from the past to the present and onward into the future.

Chinese: 这样形成的漫长时间，被称之为永恒。
English: That long passage of time is what we call eternity.

Chinese: 因为有你和我的参与，它变得闪闪发亮，每一个刹那都让人期望它变得更长。
English: And because you and I are part of it, it shines. Each fleeting moment makes us long for more.

Chinese: 这就是刹那和永恒的意义。
English: That is the meaning of the transient and the eternal.

Chinese: 萨拉眼中的迷茫消散、或者说，停止了。
English: The confusion in Sarah's eyes fades—or perhaps, it simply ceases.

Chinese: 我想，我似乎明白了一部分。
English: I think... I understand, at least a little.

Chinese: 永恒本身是一种价值……但对于永恒之外的事物产生遗憾和不舍，同样会成为某种力量。
English: Eternity itself has value... but the regret and longing for what lies outside of it also hold power.

Chinese: 可以这么说。
English: That's right.

Chinese: 那么……我主，您对今夜的舞会满意吗？
English: Then... my lord, are you satisfied with tonight's ball?

Chinese: 我很满意。谢谢你，萨拉。
English: I am. Thank you, Sarah.

Chinese: 在结束之前，再陪我一会儿吧。
English: Before the night ends, stay with me a little longer.

Chinese: 荣幸之至。
English: My pleasure.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 在一支又一支的舞曲之后，舞会宣告落幕。
English: Dance after dance, the ball eventually draws to a close.

Chinese: 萨拉把我送回卧室门前时，月亮静静地悬在高天之上，播洒着静谧的光芒。
English: As Sarah walks me to my chamber, the moon hangs silently, casting its glow.

Chinese: 那么，请您好好休息。
English: Have a good rest then.

Chinese: 晚安，萨拉。
English: Goodnight, Sarah.

Chinese: 虽然这么说了，我们却没有松开相牵的手，或者说，萨拉没有松开。
English: Though we've said goodnight, we don't let go of each other's hands—or rather, Sarah does not let go.

Chinese: 你看起来还在想之前的事。
English: You're still thinking about what we talked about, aren't you?

Chinese: 我仍在思考刹那的意义。
English: I am still pondering the meaning of a fleeting moment.

Chinese: 您与我一同观看过流星雨，又一同经历舞会，如您所说，这都是珍贵的刹那。
English: We watched the meteor shower and danced at the ball—just as you said, these were precious moments.

Chinese: 天使望着她所侍奉的主人，再次回忆起了那个无数流星坠落的夜晚。
English: The angel gazes at her master, recalling the night countless meteors fell.

Chinese: 我相信人们来到这个世界上并不仅仅只是追求永恒。
English: I believe people don't come into this world solely to pursue eternity.

Chinese: 永恒没有什么不对，只是有些时候回忆比永恒更有价值。永远同时也意味着价值的消弭。
English: There's nothing wrong with eternity itself, it's just that sometimes memories are more valuable than eternity. Eternity also means the negation of all values.

Chinese: 任何事情在无尽的时间中都会丧失自身的意义，我不希望如此。
English: Given time enough, even the most profoundly meaningful of experiences will inevitably see its significance eroded, a fate I would fain avoid.

Chinese: 我希望我和你今天的相处是特别的，是不会重复、无比珍贵的一刻。
English: I hope that my time with you today is special, an irreplaceable and precious moment.

Chinese: 我希望在久远的时间后，我仍然能回忆起今日的快乐，而不是把它当成寻常的某一天。
English: I hope that in the distant future, I will still remember today's joy, rather than mix it up with any other ordinary day.

Chinese: 虽然舞会刚刚结束，可我竟然已经开始怀念。
English: Though the ball has only just ended, I already find myself missing it.

Chinese: 也许之后您还会和许多人跳舞，其中也仍然会包括我。
English: You will dance with many others in the future, and I will still be among them.

Chinese: 但都和这一夜不同，它于我而言，有了特别的意义。
English: But tonight will be different—it has become something special to me.

Chinese: 但，有一点似乎与您讲的不同，我主。
English: However... there is one thing that seems to differ from what you said, my lord.

Chinese: 你说。
English: I'm listening.

Chinese: 您说过，“任何事情在无尽的时间中都会丧失自身的意义”。
English: You said, "Given time enough, even the most profoundly meaningful of experiences will inevitably see its significance eroded."

Chinese: 天使是接近永恒的存在。
English: Angels are beings close to eternity.

Chinese: 只要我的意识仍存在于历史之中，仍能被您翻阅和续写，那么，我们共处的时间就不会丧失意义。
English: As long as I exist and my story endures, our time together will never lose meaning.

Chinese: 我会成为意义的锚点，守望着永恒与刹那。
English: I will be the anchor of that meaning, watching over both the eternal and the transient.

Chinese: 就像你守望光明与黑暗那样？
English: Just as you watch over light and darkness?

Chinese: 萨拉点了点头。
English: Sarah nods.

Chinese: 正如我守望您所在的昼夜。
English: Just as I watch over the days and nights that you reside in.

Chinese: 您在看我。您仍然感到我是顽固的吗？
English: You're looking at me. Do you still think I'm stubborn?

Chinese: 你正在变化。
English: You are changing.

Chinese: 我很高兴看到你的变化，也很高兴你仍有不变的地方。
English: And I'm glad to see your change, just as I'm glad to see the parts of you that remain the same.

Chinese: 我想，我对你的心意也变化了。
English: I think... my feelings for you have changed as well.

Chinese: ……是吗。
English: Is that so?

Chinese: 天使显得有些紧张。
English: The angel seems a little nervous.

Chinese: 现在的您对我是怎么想的？
English: How do you see me now?

Chinese: 我更中意你了，萨拉。
English: I am growing fonder of you, Sarah.

Chinese: 变化与不变同样珍贵。
English: Change and constancy are both precious.

Chinese: 她微微低头，思考着我的话语。就在这时，一处细细的闪光吸引了我的视线。
English: She lowers her head slightly, pondering my words. Just then, a small glimmer of light catches my eye.

Chinese: 这套饰品搭配得很好。
English: That jewels suit you well.

Chinese: 啊，这些？是丘吉尔给我的“制胜法宝”。
English: Ah, these? Churchill called them my "secret weapon."

Chinese: 在舞会时灯太亮了，我没有注意到你还戴着这些。
English: The ballroom lights were so bright that I didn't notice you were wearing them.

Chinese: 它们很适合这套礼服。
English: They match the dress well.

Chinese: 萨拉拨弄着耳坠，星星在她颊边一闪一闪。
English: Sara idly plays with her earrings, the tiny stars glinting beside her cheeks.

Chinese: 星点的反光落在脸颊上，像是某种无言的提示。
English: Their reflections dance on her skin, like an unspoken message.

Chinese: 您能觉得它们很美，它们就已经尽到了应尽的责任。
English: If you find them beautiful, then they have fulfilled their purpose.

Chinese: 丘吉尔说这是制胜法宝？
English: Churchill called them a secret weapon?

Chinese: 是的。您有什么疑问吗？
English: Yes. Do you doubt that?

Chinese: 丘吉尔为你我留下了一个提醒。
English: Churchill left us with a reminder.

Chinese: 您是说……
English: You mean...

Chinese: 舞会之后，应当吻别舞伴。
English: After the ball, one should bid their dance partner farewell with a kiss.

Chinese: （亲吻萨拉）
English: (Kiss Sarah)

Chinese: 我亲吻了她的脸颊。
English: I kiss her on the cheek.

Chinese: 在渐冷的晚上，她的热度从皮肤相亲的地方传过来，沾上我的嘴唇。
English: In the cooling night air, her warmth lingers where our skin meets, brushing against my lips.

Chinese: 这是答谢。
English: This is my thanks.

Chinese: 那么，我主，也请允许我做出答谢。
English: Then, my lord, please allow me to return the favor.

Chinese: 当然，我允许你。
English: Of course, I allow it.

Chinese: 她望着我片刻，靠近了我。
English: She gazes at me for a moment before drawing closer.

Chinese: 那双涂着淡色唇彩的柔软嘴唇贴上了我的嘴唇，裹着丝质手套的手指穿过我的指间扣紧。
English: Her soft lips, painted with a pale gloss, press against mine, her silk-gloved fingers threading between my own.

Chinese: 这个吻并不止于此，不知谁先打开了牙齿，另一人默契地跟上，像一曲只在唇舌间展开的舞，纠缠着深入。
English: The kiss doesn't end—neither of us knows who parts our lips first, but the other follows. It's a dance of lips and tongues.

Chinese: 当我们分开时，萨拉露出了柔和的微笑。
English: When we finally pull apart, Sarah smiles softly.

Chinese: 感谢我主，赐予我这个“刹那”。
English: Thank you, my lord, for granting me this fleeting moment.

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 次日，神谕司休息室的窗外。
English: The next day, outside the Lounge of Oracle Division.

Chinese: 丘吉尔正蹲在花丛边，窸窸窣窣地行动。
English: Churchill is crouching among the flowerbeds, rustling about.

Chinese: 在找什么？
English: What are you looking for?

Chinese: 呜哇！
English: Waah!

Chinese: 萨拉大人，你吓死我啦！
English: Lady Sarah, you nearly scared me to death!

Chinese: 我是正常地走近，你们没有听到声音而已。
English: I walked up normally. You just didn't hear me.

Chinese: 是什么让你这么专心致志？
English: What's got you so focused?

Chinese: 我在找一条虫子。
English: I'm looking for a bug.

Chinese: 我在神谕司闲逛，寻找激发爱意的契机时，看到一条虫子一直在爬一朵花。
English: While wandering the Oracle Division for romantic inspiration, I saw a bug climbing a flower.

Chinese: 昨天风很大，它老是被从花上摇下去，但是完全没有放弃，一直在爬！
English: The strong wind kept blowing it off yesterday, but it never gave up, always climbing back up.

Chinese: 就像在追求那朵花一样。
English: Like it was pursuing that flower.

Chinese: 多么坚持不懈的爱情！我当然要帮帮它了。
English: Such persistent love! Of course, I had to help it.

Chinese: ——你要找的是不是它？
English: Is this what you were looking for?

Chinese: 哇，不愧是萨拉大人，这么快就……这不是虫子啊！
English: Wow, you found it so fast... Wait, this isn't a bug!

Chinese: 跟着萨拉的手指，炽爱也看了过去。
English: Following Sarah's finger, Dia also looks over.

Chinese: 在一朵花的枝叶下方，一只蛹静静地悬挂着。
English: Beneath the leaves of a flower, a cocoon hangs silently.

Chinese: 这也是虫子，只是按照规律，迈入了下一个发育阶段。
English: It is a bug—it's just moving on to its next stage of growth.

Chinese: 啊！我明白了！它爬了那么久，是为了找到合适的地方成蛹。

Chinese: 裱花表演也是服务的一部分，您有什么特殊要求吗？
English: Decorating is part of the service too! Do you have any special requests?

Chinese: 花纹都能选什么？
English: What kind of designs do you offer?

Chinese: 很遗憾，只有一个“黑音超恨你”花纹可选哦。
English: Unfortunately, there's only one option—"Dark Tone Super Hates You".

Chinese: 那就选这个吧。
English: I'll take that one.

Chinese: 她灵巧地转动着手腕，做出了一个裱花蛋糕，又将草莓从冰盒里取出，装点在蛋糕顶上。
English: She swirls the icing, decorating the cake, then adds fresh strawberries from the icebox.

Chinese: 我拿起餐叉，吃了一口蛋糕。
English: I pick up the fork and take a bite of the cake.

Chinese: 这手艺还算熟练，就是太甜了。究竟往里面放了多少糖？
English: Her technique is decent, but the cake is way too sweet. Just how much sugar did she put in this?

Chinese: 你不问我感想？
English: Aren't you curious about my thoughts?

Chinese: 黑音露出了“就等着你这句话呢”的表情，将奶油抹在我的嘴唇上。
English: Dark Tone gives me a look that says, "I was waiting for you to say that," and smears cream on my lips.

Chinese: 太好了……
English: That's great...

Chinese: ……努力学了那么久，都是值得的……
English: All that effort is worth it...

Chinese: 你想听我说这个吗？
English: Is that what you wanted to hear?

Chinese: 还是说，你想要自己来说，说好吃，明明放了这么多的糖？
English: Or do you want to say it yourself—that it's delicious, even though I put in so much sugar?

Chinese: 我吃完吧，你也吃一半。
English: I'll finish it. You eat half too.

Chinese: 你不吃就白夜吃。
English: If you don't, White Night will.

Chinese: 卑鄙。
English: Despicable.

Chinese: 不过黑音却笑了。
English: But Dark Tone laughs.

Chinese: 要我吃——
English: You asked me to eat—

Chinese: 旋即，她凑近我，将唇瓣印在我唇上。
English: Then, she leans in and presses her lips against mine.

Chinese: 在这里……唔！
English: Right here... Mmph!

Chinese: 奶油在甜蜜的亲吻间化开。
English: The cream melts in the sweetness of our kiss.

Chinese: 等这个漫长的吻结束时，黑音有些站不稳，她拉着自己的围裙靠在桌边，脸颊泛着可爱的红。
English: After the long kiss, Dark Tone sways, clutching her apron, cheeks flushed.

Chinese: 卑鄙无耻！
English: Shameless!

Chinese: 黑音在我身边坐下来，我们一起一口一口把这个甜得过头的蛋糕吃完。
English: Dark Tone sits beside me, and together, we slowly finish the overly sweet cake.

Chinese: 将蛋糕吃了大半，才显露出了黑音的“阴谋（存疑）”。
English: Only after we have eaten most of it does Dark Tone's questionable plot finally reveal itself.

Chinese: 吃完的蛋糕盘上露出了一行字——
English: At the bottom of the empty cake plate, a message is written—

Chinese: “吃光这个蛋糕的人要原谅黑音”。
English: "Whoever finishes this cake must forgive Dark Tone."

Chinese: 侍主大人已经把蛋糕都吃完了，所以……
English: You've finished the cake, my lord, so...

Chinese: ……可以吧？
English: You will, right?

Chinese: 原谅……
English: Forgive...

Chinese: ……是指什么？
English: Forgive what, exactly?

Chinese: 事情已经结束了，根本没必要原谅什么。
English: Everything is already over. There's nothing that needs forgiving.

Chinese: 事情已经结束了，根本没必要原谅什么呢。
English: Everything is already over. There's nothing that needs forgiving.

Chinese: 这是废话，但是你已经知道我的计划是什么了吧？
English: This is pointless, but you already know what my plan was, don't you?

Chinese: 用一句话来回答，就只是想和我一起吃，你自己手制的蛋糕而已。
English: To put it simply, you just wanted to share a cake you made with me.

Chinese: 而已……你啊，就算到了这个地步。这就是历史的胜利者的胸怀吗？
English: Just... Even now, that's how you put it. Is that the magnanimity of the victor of history?

Chinese: 是器量不同吧。
English: It's a matter of perspective.

Chinese: 我比较小气，还是得加上多余的说明。
English: I'm petty, so I feel the need to add extra explanations.

Chinese: 她的语气与其说是同情，更像是讥讽。
English: Her tone isn't sympathetic—it is mocking.

Chinese: 要加上说明就是这样的吧，这是你深信给其他星痕建议，这是一种对我的报复行为，而蛋糕和衣服则是为此准备的赔罪礼物。
English: If I have to explain, it'd be like this: You thought advising the other Asters was revenge on me, and the cake and outfit were your way of making amends.

Chinese: 话是这么说，你也不打算乖乖赔罪，所以蛋糕是加了致死量的糖，服务是不被教训，就绝不打算好好服务。
English: Yet, you didn't plan to apologize properly, so you made the cake overly sweet, and your "service" wouldn't be genuine unless you got punished by me.

Chinese: 黑音竖起一根手指，抵在我嘴唇上，止住了剩下的话。
English: Dark Tone presses a finger against my lips, cutting off the rest of my words.

Chinese: 是啊，你在担心我说出对自己很过分的话；命令我也是，不想让我太过别扭，好好享受。
English: Exactly. You were worried I'd say something too cruel to myself. By ordering me around, you didn't want me to be too stubborn but enjoy myself.

Chinese: 她的手被阳光晒得很暖，带着奶油的甜味。
English: Her hand, warmed by the sunlight, carries the sweet scent of cream.

Chinese: 但是[var=Actor]，这种有点不太正常的事情，可不是甜点哦。
English: But, [var=Actor], this slightly strange situation... It's not as sweet as dessert.

Chinese: 黑音直视着我的眼睛。
English: Dark Tone gazes straight into my eyes.

Chinese: 在短暂的一瞬间，她的眼神似乎带着一丝悲伤，却又沉着得感受不到情绪。
English: For a fleeting moment, her gaze carries a trace of sadness, yet it is so steady that it betrays no emotion.

Chinese: 然后她好像在笑，然而慢慢移开视线的她所露出的笑容却是冷冷的。应该说，是和那天一样，好像有些寂寞，又有些疲惫。
English: Then she seems to smile, but as she slowly looks away, her expression is cold. Or rather, just like that day—tinged with loneliness, and a little exhaustion.

Chinese: 我们总是聚少离多，但不管怎么说，这一次作为星痕与您相见，也是一次新的人生，我本来就希望你能多陪陪我。
English: We're always coming and going, but regardless, this time, as a Aster, I got to meet you again. It's a new life. I've always wanted you to spend more time with me.

Chinese: 也奉陪我的仇恨。
English: And to share in my hatred.

Chinese: 好了，我要回到正常的样子了。
English: Alright, I'll go back to being normal now.

Chinese: 1、2、3……这次是我手滑了，下次你吃到的会更完美的！
English: One, two, three... I slipped up this time, and next time, the cake will be even better!

Chinese: 另外看你吃蛋糕时候的样子就知道了！蛋糕太腻了吧，我这去给你准备黑咖啡。
English: I could tell by looking at you while you were eating— The cake was too rich, wasn't it? I'll get you some black coffee.

Chinese: 太阳越来越烈，我也跟着她进了店里。
English: As the sun grows hotter, I follow her inside.

Chinese: 这么急吗？

Chinese: 呀，我自己避暑的事被你发现啦！

Chinese: 但不是夕阳吗？

Chinese: 是是，我是进来抓你的。
English: Sure, sure. I'm here to catch you.

Chinese: 黑咖啡的味道倒是正常的。

Chinese: ——就像这杯黑咖啡的味道一样。
English: Just like this cup of black coffee—

Chinese: 黑音……
English: Dark Tone...

Chinese: 然而，那双总是跟着我的金色眼睛不知何时已经闭上了。
English: But at some point, those golden eyes, always fixed on me, have closed.

Chinese: 黑音趴在吧台上，呼吸均匀、神态安然。

Chinese: 醒醒，黑音。我们该回去了。

Chinese: 我推了推她，她却完全没有醒过来的样子，推了推我的手，发现推不开，就枕着手掌继续睡了。

Chinese: 别闹我……我这几天……都没有睡……

Chinese: 她睡不好的原因，我当然也清楚。

Chinese: ……阳光不错，风也舒服。就这样……陪她一会儿吧……

Chinese: 两人的影子，在夕阳下拉得长长的，又显得那样安静。
English: The shadows of the two, bathed in tranquility, stretch long in the sunset.
