Chinese: 还是别往前走了，要是打搅了里面正在休息的人就不好了，您的情况的话我会想办法的。
English: It's better not to go any further, you might disturb someone resting. I'll figure something out for you.

Chinese: 诶！小姐您倒是听一下我说的啊，里面已经有人住了！
English: Huh! Miss, please work with me here, the room is already occupied!

Chinese: 哎呀，您这样让我很难做呀。
English: Oh dear, you're really puttin' me in a pickle here!

Chinese: 门外的这番动静引起了我的兴趣，我起身去开门，想看看外面发生了什么。
English: This commotion outside the door arouse my interest. I get up to open the door to see what is happening outside.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: ……安洁？
English: Angie?

Chinese: 你为什么会在这里？
English: What are you doing here?

Chinese: ……我是有一些私事要处理才过来的。不过，我也想说为什么您在这里？
English: I had some personal matters to attend to. Funny, I could ask you the same thing.

Chinese: 回过神来的我把情况和安洁说明，而后我们不约而同地转头看向了店员。
English: After explaining the situation to Angie, we both turn to the clerk.

Chinese: 我...我真的不是故意的，主要是城里的单子还没送过来，所以就...
English: I... I didn't mean to, the reservations from the city haven't arrived yet, so...

Chinese: 好了，我们认识，理清楚是怎么回事就行了。
English: Alright, we know each other, so it's fine as long as we understand what happened.

Chinese: 可这样的话你是不是得给我找个能住的地方？
English: But doesn't that mean you owe me a room for the night?

Chinese: 您说得是…只是这会也只有一间卧房能用了。但是因为不是给客人住的，床和房间都比较简陋和狭小，住起来可能不会太舒服...
English: Fair point... But the thing is, the only chamber I got left is pretty bare-bones. It's not exactly guest-ready, so the bed and the decor are rather small and simple. Comfort might be an issue...

Chinese: 不过这个大床房的床其实本来也是给两个人睡的，既然二位认识的话，倒也不是不能接受，对吧...
English: But this room does have a bed meant for two. Since you two know each other, it should work out, right?

Chinese: 我们不由得彼此看了一眼
English: Angie and I exchange a loaded look.

Chinese: 眼下再怎么要求他能做的估计也只有这些。
English: There's not much else he can do at this point.

Chinese: 现在这种情况，也只能……
English: Given the circumstances, we have no other choice but to...

Chinese: 和安洁分开睡
English: Bunking solo

Chinese: 我们还是分开睡吧。
English: Looks like we're bunking solo tonight.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 腿也伸不直，店员说的真是一点夸张的成分都没有。
English: No legroom? The clerk wasn't kidding around!

Chinese: 安洁来这里是做什么呢？
English: So, what's Angie's deal? Why's she in town?

Chinese: 以我对她的了解，如果没有什么特别重要的事她自己是不会跑这么远的。
English: Knowing her, she wouldn't come all this way without a good reason.

Chinese: 对于她私下的生活中别的部分我基本谈不上有什么了解，虽然我原本也不是那种对八卦有兴趣的人。
English: I don't know much about her private life, and I'm not one for gossip.

Chinese: 但这般巧合所带来的机会，我难免还是会有一些忍不住的好奇心。
English: But this coincidence piqued my curiosity.

Chinese: 既然来都来了，还是看看安洁到底要做什么，无论如何都不能让这一趟白来。
English: Since I'm already here, I might as well find out what Angie is up to.

Chinese: 就在我这样想的时候，门外传来了安洁的声音。
English: Just as I'm thinking this, I hear Angie's voice outside.

Chinese: 侍主大人，您在这里吗？
English: Lord Oracle, are you in your room?

Chinese: 你怎么找过来了？
English: What brings you here at this hour?

Chinese: 现在方便进来吗？
English: Is it alright if I come in?

Chinese: 方便，你进来吧。
English: Sure, come in.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 随后安洁走进了房间里看了一圈，她的眉头稍微皱了起来。
English: Angie strolls in, gives the place a look around, and furrows her brow.

Chinese: 完全是一团糟，必须得收拾下……
English: Yeesh, what a mess. We gotta do something about this...

Chinese: 我大致猜到安洁接下来要做什么，往后退了两步。
English: I roughly guess what Angie is going to do next and take two steps back.

Chinese: 在安洁的魔法中，房间开始发生转变。
English: Under Angie's magic, the room begins to transform.

Chinese: 在微光照耀的地方，污垢褪去，一切杂乱摆放的物品都回到了原位，连一些墙上的破损也修复得和崭新的一样。
English: Wherever the soft glow touches, grime vanishes, clutter sorts itself out, and even the banged-up walls look good as new.

Chinese: 谢谢了。
English: Thanks a bunch.

Chinese: 处理这些事对魔女来说是顺手之举罢了。
English: No problem. It's just a little Nova service.

Chinese: 嗯……那我就先去洗漱，不打扰侍主大人休息了。
English: Hmm... I'll take my leave now, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 安洁说完便离开了，我看着她的背影消失在了走廊的转角处。
English: Angie excuses herself, leaving me to watch her retreating figure fade into the hallway shadows.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 因为安洁整理过的缘故，躺在床上的我很快就有了睡意。
English: Angie's little spring cleaning does the trick. The moment my head hits the pillow, I can feel the sandman coming.

Chinese: 除开床的大小依旧让我不太舒服外，这一晚我休息得还行。
English: Despite the small bed, I have a decent rest.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 晨光穿透窗帘落在眼皮上时，我听到了一阵敲门声。
English: The crack of dawn peeks through the curtains, tickling my eyelids. Then comes a rapping at my door.

Chinese: 那声音带有节奏，不紧不慢，像是在刻意等待我回应一样。
English: The knocking is rhythmic, deliberate, like it is patiently waiting for me to answer.

Chinese: 稍等。
English: Wait.

Chinese: 我闭着眼睛抓起衣服穿上，打开门后发现安洁正站在门口。
English: With eyes half-closed, I grab my clothes and open the door to find Angie standing there.

Chinese: 你这么早就来了啊...
English: Angie! What's got you up so early?

Chinese: 嗯...我是特地来叫侍主大人您的。
English: It's... your wake-up service, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 安洁直直地盯着我，像是找我有什么事。
English: Angie is drilling holes through me with her stare. Seems like she has something to get off her chest.

Chinese: 怎么了？
English: Is that a problem?

Chinese: ……我来找您确实是有一些事，毕竟侍主大人也想知道我来这干嘛，不是吗？
English: I do have something to discuss with you, Lord Oracle. And I reckon you wanna know what I'm up to, right?

Chinese: 安洁说这句话的时候，还刻意凑近了一些。
English: Angie leans in real close when she drops that little truth bomb.

Chinese: 是什么事？说说看。
English: What is it? Explain.

Chinese: ……是一件“私事”。
English: It's a... personal matter.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在安洁的带领下，我们绕开了村庄中繁华的区域，沿着蜿蜒的道路向着一侧走去。
English: Following Angie, we avoid the bustling part of the village and walk along a winding path.

Chinese: 我是第一次到这里来，之前光是找旅店都花了不少时间。可安洁看起来完全不需要人指引，她有着明确的目的地。
English: I'm new to these parts, and it took me quite a while just to find the inn. But Angie seems to know exactly where she is going.

Chinese: 或者换句话说，她对这里很熟悉…
English: Or rather, she is very familiar with this place...

Chinese: 侍主知道这个地方的名字吗？
English: Do you know the name of this place, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 是叫托卢卡村吧。
English: Toruca Village, isn't it?

Chinese: 准确来说的话，侍主大人您说对了一半。
English: Well, you're half right.

Chinese: 实际上它还有个原本的地名——牧羊人溪谷。
English: In fact, it used to go by another name, Shepherd's Glen.

Chinese: 当时圣殿为了统筹管理各大区内零散的居民地，让周围的居民进行过一次搬迁，将其集中在了圣紫音湖的东岸，也就是在那个时候改的名。
English: Back in the day, the Sanctuary wanted to get all these little villages in the district organized. So they moved everyone to the east shore of Lake Seraphis. That's when they changed the name.

Chinese: 原来如此。
English: I see it now.

Chinese: 这里和你有关联？
English: You got some history with this place?

Chinese: 嗯，这是我长大的地方。而去圣殿后这么多年第一次回来，也是我想要搞清楚一些在困扰我的问题。
English: Yeah, this is where I grew up. And this is my first homecoming since I joined the Sanctuary all those years ago. There's some stuff that's been eating at me, and I'm here to get some answers.

Chinese: 安洁一边说着，一边低头叹息，我从没见到她这样过。
English: Angie lets out a sigh, her head hanging low. I've never seen her like this.

Chinese: 既然是一起来解决它的话，其实你可以告诉我那是什么样的问题，也不必一路上都憋着。
English: Hey, if we're in this together, you can tell me what's buggin' you. No need to keep it all bottled up.

Chinese: 安洁的头再次抬起头看向前方，她目光中流露出的是一丝迷惘。
English: Angie lifts her chin, staring straight ahead. I can see the confusion swirling in her eyes.

Chinese: 过去的记忆对我来说只是一些碎片。
English: My memories of the past, they're just bits and pieces.

Chinese: 我曾经以为总会好起来的，但这么多年，我始终无法拼凑出一个结果。
English: I kept thinking things would clear up, but all these years later, I still can't put the puzzle together.

Chinese: 一开始我觉得那并不重要，但那种不完整、那种空缺的感觉让我无法不去在意。
English: At first, I didn't think much of it. But that nagging feeling that something's missing, that void... I just can't shake it.

Chinese: 在零碎的画面之后，我是如何来到这里，曾经又是怎样的，我必须给自己一个答案。
English: Beyond those hazy snapshots, how did I end up here? What was life like before? I gotta find those answers for myself.

Chinese: 这些事圣殿的档案册应该都会有记录的吧，你去找过吗？
English: The Sanctuary's gotta have records on this stuff. Have you looked?

Chinese: 那上面并没有相关的内容，不然我也不会来这里了。
English: There's nothing relevant there, which is why I'm here.

Chinese: 这确实是一件蹊跷的事。按理来说魔女的档案某种意义上来说也是她们身份证明的一种，任何相关的信息都会被记录在上面。
English: That is indeed odd. In theory, a Nova's archives are, in a sense, a form of identification. Any relevant information should be recorded on it.

Chinese: 像是出身和血脉之类的更是重要的部分，有些甚至可以追溯到其千年前的祖先身上。
English: Some can even be traced back to their ancestors a thousand years ago, especially important parts such as origin and bloodline.

Chinese: 这种情况我还是第一次听说，哪怕是当时把你分配过来的时候也没人跟我提起过。
English: This is the first time I've heard of this situation. Even when you were assigned to me, no one mentioned it to me.

Chinese: 所以这次我才从圣城跑过来调查。
English: That's why I came here from the sacred city to investigate.

Chinese: 嗯…这种没有归属的未知感，我并不喜欢…
English: Hmm... I don't really like this feeling of not belonging...

Chinese: 想必这次会有一个好结果。
English: Hopefully, we'll get some answers this time.

Chinese: 嗯……到了。
English: We're here.

Chinese: 谈话间，安洁和我在一座教堂前停下了脚步。
English: As we aree jawing, Angie and I find ourselves in front of a church.

Chinese: 有些锈蚀的铁门旁，一位老妇人正在那里认真地清扫着落叶，这景象显得有些落寞。
English: By the slightly rusted iron gate, an old lady is diligently sweeping away the fallen leaves.

Chinese: 可房子里不时响起的孩子们的笑声又打破了它。
English: The scene is somber, but the laughter of children inside breaks the stillness.

Chinese: 似乎是终于下定了什么决心，我看着安洁吸了一口气，然后一步步走了上去。
English: I can tell Angie has made up her mind about something. She takes a deep breath, squares her shoulders, and marches right up those steps.

Chinese: 久疏问候，海伦院长。
English: Long time no see, Matron Helen.

Chinese: ……你是……安洁吗？
English: Is that you, Angie?

Chinese: 你还好吗？我听说圣城里最近发生了一些不好的事……
English: Are you alright? I heard some unsettling news from the sacred city...

Chinese: 承蒙主神的庇护，作祟的混乱已被圣殿清除。
English: Praise be, the Sanctuary rooted out that chaos, by the grace of the Lord God.

Chinese: 承蒙主神庇护，承蒙主神庇护……
English: The Lord God's blessings, the Lord God's blessings upon us...

Chinese: 噢，还有这位与安洁同来的先生，方才未能与您问候，还请勿怪罪。
English: Oh, and who might this gentleman be, Angie? Please forgive my earlier lack of manners.

Chinese: 没关系。毕竟，您非常高兴。
English: It's OK. That's alright, given how overjoyed you are.

Chinese: 是的，因为她太久没有回来了。
English: Yes, it's been too long since she last visited.

Chinese: 啊对了，安洁你们难得回来一趟，打算留多久？
English: Speaking of which, Angie, how long are you staying?

Chinese: 院长您是知道魔女的工作的，不出意外的话，我们应该今天就要离开。
English: As you know, Matron, we Nova have work to do, so we'll probably leave today.

Chinese: ……这样啊。那，要不吃顿饭吧，刚好今天我打算给孩子们做顿好的。
English: I see. How about a meal then? I was planning to cook something nice for the children today.

Chinese: 我们也正好想要拜访您的福利院……侍主大人，您看可以吗？
English: Perfect. We were just thinking of visiting your orphanage...Lord Oracle, what do you think?

Chinese: 久违的相聚我是没有任何理由拒绝的，同时这也是个能更多地了解安洁的机会。
English: A reunion like this is hard to refuse, and it's also a chance to learn more about Angie.

Chinese: 那就承蒙您照顾了。
English: We'd be honored.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 福利院远离村镇，孤自矗立于山坡之上俯瞰着那若即若离的繁华。
English: The orphanage stands apart from the hustle and bustle of town, perched solo on a hillside. From up here, the busy streets seem a world away, even though they're just down the hill.

Chinese: 从这里往下看，依稀可见城镇的繁华景象。
English: The view from up here is quite something. You can just make out the lively little town down below.

Chinese: 这里可真是个好地方。
English: What a lovely spot!

Chinese: 因为这处是由原本的旧神教教堂改建而来，除了庭院未动分毫，其余都进行了大幅的修整，变为更适合孩童居住的场所。
English: See, they took the old Church of the Ancient Faith and gave it a total makeover, turned it into a cozy place for the children. Except for the courtyard - left that bit alone.

Chinese: 说起来…，侍主大人。趁海伦院长做饭的这段时间，正好去将要事办了吧。
English: By the way... Lord Oracle. While Matron Helen is cooking, we should take care of our business.

Chinese: 不先去和海伦院长叙叙旧吗？
English: Don't you catch up with her first?

Chinese: 叙旧的话，一会在饭桌上来说也不迟。
English: We got plenty of time over dinner.

Chinese: 在有限的时间里，还是先完成此行的目的吧。
English: Clock's tickin', we should get crackin' on what we came here for.

Chinese: 是否有重聚的喜悦、是否有对事实的期待，这些我都不得而知。
English: Whether she feels the joy of reunion or anticipation for the truth, I have no idea.

Chinese: 越是坚定的语气，安洁的面容就越是不会为之所动。
English: The firmer her voice gets, the tighter she locks down that poker face.

Chinese: 她的内心真的也如冰霜般冷漠，还是说在承受着多种复杂的感情交织在一起，那种毫无方向的拉扯呢？
English: So is she really a stone-cold Frosty, or is she juggling a jumble of feelings yanking her every which way?

Chinese: 哥哥姐姐，快来陪我们一起玩。
English: Hey mister, miss! Come play with us!

Chinese: 这时有一些孩子围了过来，热情地邀请我们加入他们的游戏。
English: Some children come over, inviting us to join their games.

Chinese: 我们听见你跟院长奶奶的话了！你是从圣殿回来的魔女，肯定特别厉害对不对？
English: We heard what you said to Granny Helen! You're a Nova from the Sanctuary, right? You must be really powerful!

Chinese: 听说魔女可以徒手放出超级厉害的魔法！我想看我想看！
English: I heard Nova can shoot out super powerful magic with their bare hands! C'mon, show us, show us!

Chinese: 哈哈，没想到安洁你还挺受欢迎的。
English: Well, well! Look who came back as Miss Popularity!

Chinese: 果然会发生这种事呢…
English: I had a feeling this would happen...

Chinese: 侍主大人，您在这稍微等我一下，我去把其他孩子也叫过来。
English: Lord Oracle, please wait here while I go round up the rest of them.

Chinese: 嗯，那我在这里等你好了。
English: Sure thing. I'll be right here waiting.

Chinese: 不一会，我的身边全是笑脸盈盈的孩子们。
English: Before I knew it, I'm swarmed by a pack of grinning youngsters.

Chinese: 我们做着各种各样的游戏，而他们的笑声让我倍感满足。
English: We horse around playing all sorts of games, and their giggles are like music to my ears.

Chinese: 玩累了后，再用魔法给孩子们变一些戏法。虽然这对我来说十分简单，可孩子们却看得如痴如醉。
English: Once they've tuckered themselves out, I bust out some magic tricks to wow the crowd. It is a walk in the park for me, but the children are mesmerized.

Chinese: 等等，好像有哪里不太对。
English: Wait, something doesn't seem right.

Chinese: 安洁人呢！
English: Where's Angie?!

Chinese: 这时我才反应过来，安洁一直没有回来，而我则成了这些孩子们的保姆。
English: That's when I realize Angie hasn't returned, and I'm left to babysit.

Chinese: 真不愧是安洁，说的让我帮忙，恐怕就是指这个了，让我帮她拖住这帮缠人的孩子。
English: Gotta hand it to Angie. When she said she needed my help, this must've been her game all along—keeping these clingy kids occupied.

Chinese: 内心的好奇又忍不住冒了出来，安洁此时到底在做什么呢？
English: That itch of curiosity comes clawing back. Just what the heck is she up to?

Chinese: 继续和孩子们呆在一起
English: Keep hanging with the children

Chinese: 虽然我有所好奇，可毕竟答应了安洁要帮她忙，我相信她这样做是有理由的。
English: Though curious, I promised Angie I'd help, and I trust she has her reasons.

Chinese: 好了孩子们，看这边，新的戏法！
English: Alright kids, look here, a new trick!

Chinese: 好耶！
English: Hooray!

Chinese: 原来他们都在您，看来您也很喜欢孩子啊。
English: So they were all with you. You must be fond of children.

Chinese: 因为这些孩子们很活泼也很讨人爱，毕竟我平时也不太能接触到他们呢。
English: Well, they're just endearing and full of beans. I don't usually get many chances to interact with them.

Chinese: 孩子们，我有些事找这位先生，你们先去饭桌上乖乖坐好，一会完了咱们就开饭。
English: Kids, I have some matters to discuss with this gentleman. Go sit nicely at the dining table first, and we'll eat once we're done.

Chinese: 海伦奶奶，快一点哟，我都有些玩饿啦。
English: Granny, be quick ok? All that playin' around made me hungry.

Chinese: 海伦奶奶你放心和这位先生谈好了，我们都会好好等着的，不要着急。
English: Granny, don't worry, take your time talking with this mister. We'll all wait patiently.

Chinese: 海伦院长突然叫走了孩子们，而应该看住孩子们的我却有些焦虑。
English: Helen suddenly calls the children away, leaving me, who is supposed to be babysitting them, a bit anxious.

Chinese: 可要是现在贸然举动，也会引起不必要的注意吧。
English: But making a rash move now would only draw unnecessary attention.

Chinese: 看起来安洁好像不在啊，她没和您一起吗？
English: Where's Angie? She's not with you?

Chinese: 装糊涂
English: Play dumb

Chinese: 她刚才还在一边坐着，也许是我和孩子们玩得太入神了，没注意到她什么时候不见了的。
English: She was over there just a minute ago. Maybe I got too caught up horsing around with the children and didn't notice her.

Chinese: 看起来您真是一位十分善良的人，连说谎的技巧都这么拙劣。
English: You seem too kind-hearted to be good at lying.

Chinese: 海伦院长锐利的目光让我知道恐怕她没这么好应付。
English: Helen's sharp gaze makes me realize she isn't easy to fool.

Chinese: 如果不出意料的话，安洁现在应该在福利院的档案室里，毕竟这里的孩子们会告诉我一切。
English: If I'm not mistaken, Angie is probably in the orphanage's archive room. The kids tell me everything.

Chinese: 安洁是我一手照顾大的，她想要什么我也能猜个大概。
English: I practically raised that girl myself, so I have a pretty good idea of what she wants.

Chinese: 您也不用感到不好意思，我知道迟早会有这一天，我只是担心她对这些事过分地纠结。
English: You don't need to feel embarrassed. I knew this day would come. I'm just worried that she's getting too caught up in all this.

Chinese: 眼看已经瞒不住了，我也只得点头承认。
English: Cat is out of the bag. So I just nod, figure I'd best come clean.

Chinese: 可以的话，方便告诉我您和她的关系吗？
English: If you don't mind me asking, what's the story with you and her?

Chinese: 我是她在圣殿的顶头上司
English: I'm her direct superior at the Sanctuary

Chinese: 请再次原谅我的有失远迎。
English: Please forgive my lack of proper welcome once again.

Chinese: 看来当年的那些人还没有放弃调查啊…
English: Looks like they still haven't given up investigating after all these years...

Chinese: 那些人是？
English: "They"?

Chinese: 和您一样来自于圣殿，想要揭开安洁过去之事的调查者。
English: The same as you, investigators from the Sanctuary who want to uncover Angie's past.

Chinese: 这么久过去，我想这些事说出来也好。
English: It's about time these things are brought to light.

Chinese: 听起来会有些复杂啊...
English: It sounds complicated...

Chinese: 如果只是复杂倒也还好…
English: Complicated would be an understatement...

Chinese: 实际上，安洁对我来说也像是一个谜。
English: Angie is somewhat of a mystery even to me.

Chinese: 这话怎么说？
English: What do you mean?

Chinese: 一般福利院都是收纳邻近的孩童，就算是从外地送过来的，也会有相关的出身证明，这点您应该清楚吧。
English: Orphanages usually take in local children. Even those from far away have proper documentation. I'm sure you know about this, right?

Chinese: 是的，否则一般情况下审判所是不会下发接收证明的。
English: Yes, otherwise the Court of Judgment wouldn't issue a reception certificate.

Chinese: 可…安洁是属于特殊情况。
English: But.... Angie was a special case.

Chinese: 当年我们既没有发现任何和她亲人有关的信息，她的血脉也与圣城的各个家族都不匹配。
English: We found no information about her relatives, and her bloodline didn't match any family in the sacred city.

Chinese: 那这么说她是游民？
English: So she was a vagabond?

Chinese: 不，审判所给她的断定是外域之城，当年他们把安洁交到我手上的时候特意嘱咐我不要声张此事。
English: No, the Court's verdict was that she came from the Outer Cities. When they handed Angie over to me back then, they specifically told me to keep this quiet.

Chinese: 而更让我感到不安的是，在安洁都来前，我出现了类似于预感一类的东西。
English: What worried me more was that I had a premonition before she arrived.

Chinese: 您是说和预知相关的魔法，或者占卜？
English: You mean a prophecy or divination magic?

Chinese: 不，是一个梦。
English: No, it was a dream.

Chinese: 在安洁到来的前几日，我梦到一个浑身支离破碎的灵体从湖底走出，来到了我的门口。
English: A few days before Angie arrived, I dreamt of a spirit, broken and shattered, walking out of the lake bottom and coming to my door.

Chinese: 它用沙哑的声音在门外告诉我会有一名叫安洁的女婴来到我这里，它嘱咐我一定要将其顺利地抚养成人，否则将会有严重的后果。
English: It told me in a hoarse voice outside the door that a baby girl named Angie would come to me. It urged me to raise her to adulthood, or there would be serious consequences.

Chinese: 那个梦真实到让我分不出虚实，但我知道的是，它提到的安洁的确来到了我这里。
English: That dream was so real that I couldn't tell if it was real or not. But what I do know is that the Angie it mentioned did come to me.

Chinese: 这些事，难道都和审判所有关？
English: Could all of this have something to do with the Court of Judgment?

Chinese: 我可不敢妄言。
English: I dare not speculate.

Chinese: 只是在这之后，我越发确定了安洁是特殊的存在。
English: It's just that after that, I became more certain that Angie is special.

Chinese: 在其他孩子才开始记事的时候，她就已经表现出了出于自主而非兴趣的学习能力。
English: When other children were just starting to form their first memories, she already showed the ability to learn independently, not out of interest but of her own will.

Chinese: 对于家庭、对错、善恶和我们信仰中的那些概念，她都可以没有多少困难地去理解。
English: She could understand the concepts of family, right and wrong, good and evil, and the things we believe in without much difficulty.

Chinese: 甚至是那些孩童该有的顽皮、无知，在她身上我完全看不到。
English: I never saw the typical childish mischief or ignorance in her.

Chinese: 这绝对不是所谓的懂事或是天才能够轻易解释的。
English: This definitely can't be simply explained as being mature or gifted.

Chinese: 可审判所和圣殿方面对于这种情况一定是会处理的，至少会查清她的由来。
English: The Court of Judgment and the Sanctuary should have investigated this, at least to trace her origins.

Chinese: 但他们并没有，或者说是和我一样无从查起。
English: But they didn't, or they couldn't find anything either.

Chinese: 连这些人都没有办法，这其中的牵扯很难想象...
English: If these people had no way, it's hard to imagine the implications involved...

Chinese: 她现在还会出现失忆的表现吗？
English: She's still having those memory lapses now?

Chinese: 我想应该没有，至少我知道的情况下是没有过。
English: I don't think so, not that I'm aware of.

Chinese: 那就好，我少了一件需要担心的事。
English: That's a relief, one less thing to worry about.

Chinese: 可您说的失忆是？
English: But what do you mean by memory lapses?

Chinese: 以前的她时常会进入一种失神的状态，就像是她人去了别的地方，只剩身体还在这。
English: She used to enter a trance-like state, as if her body was here but her mind was elsewhere.

Chinese: 每当我想要去唤醒她的时候，我都感觉那似乎不是她。
English: When I tried to wake her, it felt like she wasn't even there.

Chinese: 一个小孩子绝不会有这样的气质，我甚至会在她面前感到恐惧。
English: No child should have that kind of presence. It was enough to make me feel scared.

Chinese: 每次这样后，安洁都会虚弱好几天，而期间的记忆十分模糊。
English: After each episode, she would be weak for days, with very vague memories of the event.

Chinese: 我曾求助过圣殿的主教，可她却告诉我这是安洁年龄尚小且灵魂不稳固的原因。
English: I sought help from the High Priestess, who said it was due to her young age and unstable soul.

Chinese: 可我一直在问自己，真的是这样吗？
English: But I kept asking myself, is that really the case?

Chinese: 所以您能理解为什么我一直没有告诉她了吧，因为这已经超出了我的能力范围。
English: So you can understand why I never told her; it's beyond my ability to explain.

Chinese: 可我知道这始终困扰着她，她一定会回来，这只是时间的问题而已。
English: But I know it's always troubled her, and she would come back one day; it was just a matter of time.

Chinese: 她会在档案室里找到我曾经不想让她看的东西，可刚才说的那些内容，我确实还无法确定是否应该由我来说。
English: She will find things in the archive room that I didn't want her to see, but I'm still unsure if I should be the one to tell her everything.

Chinese: 可我想您是最合适的吧。
English: But I think you're the one who should do it.

Chinese: 并不，我察觉到安洁已经变了，不再是我了解的那个孩子。
English: I'm not. I feel Angie has changed; she's no longer the child I knew.

Chinese: 也可能，是我从来就没了解过她…
English: Or maybe, I never really knew her...

Chinese: 但现在让她身边亲近的人知道这件事，我想是我唯一能做的了。
English: But now, letting those close to her know the truth is the only thing I can do.

Chinese: 亲近…吗…
English: Close, huh...?

Chinese: 这就是我这个老婆子一直以来的秘密了，现在它已经交到了您的手上，是否要告诉她，也全看您了。
English: I've carried this secret for years, and now I'm entrusting it to you. The choice of whether to share it with her lies with you.

Chinese: 希望您不要责怪我没有这番勇气。
English: Please understand, I never had the courage to tell her myself.

Chinese: 您已经做得很好了，在您的能力里这已经无可厚非了。
English: Hey, you did everything you could. No one could ask for more, given the circumstances.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在海伦院长离去后，我在原地伫立了许久，我没想到我会了解到安洁的这些，这是她自己都不曾了解的部分。
English: I'm rooted to the spot long after Helen walked away. Never in my wildest dreams did I think I'd uncover chunks of Angie's past that even she was clueless about.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 简单的午饭过后，我和安洁告别了海伦院长和福利院的孩子们。
English: After a simple lunch, Angie and I bid farewell to Helen and the children at the orphanage.

Chinese: 我的脑海中全是之前海伦院长所说的那些，再加上我能看出她在饭桌上的强装镇定，这都让我感到无所适从。
English: Helen's words linger in my mind, and I can see she was trying to stay calm at the dining table, which makes me feel uneasy.

Chinese: 侍主大人您看起有些心不在焉，是发生什么了吗？
English: Lord Oracle, you seem distracted. Did something happen?

Chinese: 嗯…倒没有什么。
English: Hmm... Not really.

Chinese: 不过，安洁找到了自己想要的答案了吗？
English: Did you find the answers you were looking for?

Chinese: 只有一份简单的收养证明而已。
English: Just found a simple adoption certificate.

Chinese: 应该是触及到了一些不太好的内容，我感觉安洁有意在回避它。
English: She must have stumbled upon some unpleasant truths. I feel she is avoiding them.

Chinese: 困扰了你这么久的问题如果就这样轻易被解开，想必也会让人感到失落。
English: It would be disappointing if the problem that has been bothering you for so long was solved so easily, right?

Chinese: 可能会吧，我并不确定…
English: Maybe, I'm not sure...

Chinese: 但如果知道有些东西，其实也可以说出来，就像您一直想告诉我的可以把自己内心的想法说出来。
English: But if there's something you know, you should say it. You've always encouraged me to be open about my thoughts.

Chinese: 低着头的安洁突然抬起头，略带有一丝质问的口气这样说着。
English: Angie, who has been looking down, suddenly lifts her head, a questioning note in her voice.

Chinese: 虽然是否告诉我的决定权在您，但这毕竟是与我相关的事，我不想留有什么遗憾。
English: It's your decision whether to tell me, but this concerns me, and I don't want to live with regrets.

Chinese: 看着安洁，我知道这是她的一个诉求，她眼神中的真挚让我有些动摇。
English: Seeing the earnest look in Angie's eyes, I feel my resolve weakening.

Chinese: 告诉她
English: Tell her

Chinese: 这是她的过去，我还是认为无法以我自己的意愿去干涉她的知情权。
English: It's her past. I don't think I have the right to decide what she should know.

Chinese: 海伦院长的确有和我提过一些关于你的事，但这对你也许会有些沉重。
English: Helen did tell me a few things about you, but they might be a bit difficult to hear.

Chinese: 在我做出这个决定的时候，我也做好了相应的准备，侍主大人不必担心。
English: I knew what I was signing up for when I chose to go down this road. You don't need to worry, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 现在的我站在这里，但我不会让过去动摇我已经选择了的道路。
English: I'm here now, and I refuse to let the past change the course I've set for myself.

Chinese: 安洁的语气没有任何的改变，冷静，坚定，却又让人不安。
English: Angie's tone remains unchanged—calm, firm, yet unsettling.

Chinese: 我将之前海伦院长告诉我的内容一五一十转述给了安洁，她全程认真地听着，脸上也没有一丝的变化。
English: I recount everything Matron Helen has told me, and Angie listens intently without a change in her expression.

Chinese: 涉及到审判所的话，看来以我的能力，对这件事的答案追寻得等一等呢。
English: If the Court of Judgment is involved, it seems that finding the answers for myself will take time.

Chinese: 我想过安洁或是惊讶、或是对这个问题的偏执，可她的回应出乎我的意料。
English: I expected Angie to be surprised or fixated, but her response is unexpected.

Chinese: 这件事就像是被她轻轻放下了一样，没有丝毫的犹豫。
English: Looks like she just set the whole thing aside, without any hesitation.

Chinese: 这些真的是你想要的吗？结果也好，选择也好。
English: Is this really what you want? Doesn't matter what I what.

Chinese: 至少在这里，我已经得到了我目前能知晓的一切。
English: For now, I've gathered all the information I can.

Chinese: 怎么，侍主大人是在担心我吗？
English: Are you worried about me, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 这就看你怎么想了。
English: That depends on how you see it.

Chinese: 我没有否认，也没有确认，只是注视着她。
English: I neither confirm nor deny, just looking at her.

Chinese: 侍主大人您应该清楚，魔女们并没有那么多的时间，因此把它们花在去纠结暂时无能为力的事上在我看来是不值得的。
English: Lord Oracle, as you know, our time as Nova is limited. Wasting it on matters beyond our control right now is, in my view, not worthwhile.

Chinese: 抱歉，是我忘了这也是侍主大人您的假期，说得有些太沉重了。
English: Sorry, I forgot this is your vacation too. I might have gotten a bit too heavy there.

Chinese: 没关系，这次能和你在这里相遇，又了解到了你的过去，也算是不可多得的经历。
English: It's OK. Being able to meet you here and learn about your past is a rare experience in itself.

Chinese: 我想这个话题还是就到这里吧，就像安洁所说的，我们暂时无能为力。
English: I think we should leave this topic here for now, just like you said. It's beyond our control right now.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我和安洁从福利院往村庄的中心走去，那是圣紫音湖的方向。
English: Angie and I walk from the orphanage toward the village center, heading toward Lake Seraphis.

Chinese: 因为考虑到时间的问题，我打算今天就先回圣城了。
English: Given the hour, I decide to return to the sacred city today.

Chinese: 由于地面已经没有昨天那样糟糕，回去的马车已经又开放了。
English: Since the roads are no longer muddy, and the return carriages are available again.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 那我就送侍主大人您到这里了。
English: I'll see you off here, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 你不和我一起回去吗？
English: You're not coming back with me?

Chinese: 这是侍主大人的假期安排，可不是我的呢。
English: This is not my vacation, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 那你是还有别的事要做吗？
English: So you still have other things to take care of?

Chinese: 算不上吧，只是想再多看看这里。
English: Not really, just want to look around here a bit more.

Chinese: 我想，我以后可能再也不会回到这里了。
English: Something tells me this might be the last time I ever see this place.

Chinese: 那海伦院长呢？
English: What about Matron Helen?

Chinese: 会有人代替我的。
English: She'll have someone else looking out for her.

Chinese: 安洁并不是在和我商量，只是单纯在告知我而已，这不是我能改变的。
English: Angie isn't asking for my opinion. She is just letting me know, which isn't something I can change.

Chinese: 好吧，那你自己多注意一些，我就先回去了。
English: Alright then, take care. I'll be heading back.

Chinese: 嗯…
English: Mm-hmm...

Chinese: 马车沿着道路缓缓地往前驶去，我探出头看着安洁的身影越来越远。
English: The carriage moves slowly along the road, and I watch Angie's figure grow distant.

Chinese: 她去往了湖畔，那是与我截然相反的方向...
English: She heads for the lakeside, in the completely opposite direction from me...

Chinese: 先隐瞒
English: Hide the truth

Chinese: 就像海伦院长说的，我也认为安洁还没到去接触这件事的时候。
English: Helen was right. I don't think she's ready to face this yet.

Chinese: 我只是在想之前海伦院长和我提的一些关于你小时候的事。
English: I was just thinking about what Matron Helen told me about your childhood.

Chinese: 那她有说过我以前是什么样的吗？
English: Did she say what I was like before?

Chinese: 天真活泼
English: Cute as a button.

Chinese: 安洁是个讨人喜欢的孩子，海伦院长可是跟我说了许多你的趣事。
English: You were just the sweetest little thing. She told me many stories about you,

Chinese: 像是和其他孩子们一起打趣，帮她处理家务，还有…
English: like how you used to joke around with other kids and help with chores.

Chinese: 完全没有印象呢…
English: I have no memory of that at all...

Chinese: 海伦院长真的只说了这些吗？
English: Is that really all she said?

Chinese: 你不相信我吗？
English: Don't you believe me?

Chinese: 这倒是没有的事…
English: I do, but...

Chinese: 其实有很多人都在关心你和爱护你，远比你想的也要多。
English: You know, there's a whole lot of people who care about and love you, far more than you think.

Chinese: 侍主大人也有这份心情吗？
English: That includes you too, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 就像你之前说的，这是属于正常范畴里的。
English: Just like you said before, it's a normal feeling.

Chinese: 以这种关系来会意的话，侍主大人不会觉得可惜吗？
English: Wouldn't you find it a pity to imply it that way?

Chinese: 好了好了，这种事以后再说了。
English: Alright, let's talk about this another time.

Chinese: 说话间，我们朝着山下走去。
English: Our chatter keeps us company as we make our way down the mountainside.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 因为考虑到时间的问题，我们打算今天就先回圣城。
English: Given the hour, we decide to return to the sacred city today.

Chinese: 我和安洁登上了其中一辆，踏上了归途。
English: We board one of the carriages and set off on our way back.

Chinese: 真没想到这次出来还能以这样的方式遇见你。
English: I never thought I would meet you like this on this trip.

Chinese: 看起您很高兴呢。
English: You seem happy.

Chinese: 那当然，毕竟这样的机会很少啊。
English: Of course, it's not every day you get a chance like this.

Chinese: 噢？侍主大人以后还想再插手我的私事吗？
English: Oh? Do you intend to meddle in my personal matters again, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 你这说得我很不讲道理一样…
English: It sounds like you're saying I'm being unreasonable...

Chinese: 如果您这么想那我也不反对。
English: Well, you said it, not me.

Chinese: 但这次的您多少帮了我一些，之后的话我倒是可以答应帮您做一件事。
English: But you did help me this time, so I can promise to help you with one thing in return.

Chinese: 那我可得好好想想。
English: Then I'll have to think about it.

Chinese: 不过得是经过我同意的才行，侍主那些歪脑筋可是不被允许的。
English: But it has to be something I'm OK with, OK? None of your funny ideas, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 果然我们在互相的眼中都是一个奇怪的人啊…
English: Guess we're just two peas in a weird pod, huh?

Chinese: 十分独特
English: One of a kind

Chinese: 她说你小时候就很聪明，比其他孩子懂得更多，在她眼里十分独特。
English: She told me you were a bright kid, wise beyond your years. A real standout, in her book.

Chinese: 可你的性格也有些与普通孩子不太一样，就和现在的你一样。
English: Even as a child, your personality was quite unique, just like it is now.

Chinese: 所以我想海伦院长一直都有在担心你吧。
English: That's why I think Helen has always been concerned about you.

Chinese: 她说你小时候就很聪明，可性格也早就和你现在一样了，她一直都很担心你。
English: She mentioned you were bright, but your personality set you apart from other kids. That's why she's always been concerned.

Chinese: 我和她是关系不错的朋友
English: A good friend of mine

Chinese: 能和这孩子成为朋友，您也不一般啊…
English: For someone to be friends with this child, you must be quite extraordinary...

Chinese: 像您这样的人的话，倒是可以信任。
English: Someone I can trust.

Chinese: 打掩护
English: Cover for her

Chinese: 她刚去卫生间，应该一会就会回来了。
English: She just went to the restroom. She should be back soon.

Chinese: 我想事实恐怕不是这样呢。
English: That's not true, is it?

Chinese: 去寻找安洁
English: Find Angie

Chinese: 都到这一步了，要是不知道安洁想知道的答案是什么，岂不是白费力气了。
English: We can't come this far just to leave empty-handed. Angie deserves those answers.

Chinese: 我打发走了孩子们后，开始在福利院里寻找安洁的身影。
English: After sending the kids away, I begin searching for Angie around the orphanage.

Chinese: 缺失的档案的话，也只能去这里的档案室了。
English: If the missing files are anywhere, they must be in the archives.

Chinese: 经过一番搜寻，我在福利院三楼的角落里找到了这个房间。
English: After some searching, I find a room tucked in the corner of the third floor.

Chinese: 可门不知道是怎么了，不管我怎么拧把手都毫无反应，就像是和这里的空间嵌为了一体。
English: But the door won't budge, no matter how much I turn the handle. It feels like it is fused with the wall.

Chinese: 奇怪，难道她没来这里吗？
English: Strange, did she not come here?

Chinese: 等等，这个是，魔法的痕迹？
English: Wait, is this... a trace of magic?

Chinese: 我暗暗一笑，知道了是怎么回事。
English: I crack a smile, realizing what is going on.

Chinese: 安洁，开门吧，是我，只有我一个人。
English: Angie, open the door. It's me, just me.

Chinese: 还真是瞒不过您呢…
English: Well, nothing can escape you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 无言的幽邃，失语的妖精，所隐藏之物已然改变，跨过虚实的境界线，去白夜的尽头再次静候。
English: In soundless deeps, the wordless sprite, cloaked mysteries change in night; cross the divide from truth to lie, where the night shines ever so bright.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 随着咏唱的结束，刚才还紧锁的门发出了被打开的声音。
English: As the chanting ends, the locked door creaks open.

Chinese: 怎么，有发现什么吗？
English: So, did you find anything?

Chinese: 我翻阅了从第四纪元1605年福利院建立起到我记事的1736年的所有档案，可是毫无线索。
English: I've looked through all the records from 1605 in the Era of Eternal Flame, when the orphanage was established, up to 1736, as far back as I can remember. But there's no clue.

Chinese: 安洁周围漂浮着大量的纸张，她是用魔法来阅读的，所以不存在有漏掉的可能。
English: Angie has papers swirling around her, using magic to read every single one, leaving no detail unchecked.

Chinese: 会不会你想找的东西一开始就不在这里？
English: Maybe what you're searching for was never here to begin with?

Chinese: 说的也是，换做是我应该也不会把它放在这样容易找到的地方。
English: You might be right. If it were me, I wouldn't leave something important in such an obvious place.

Chinese: 那你有什么头绪吗？
English: So, do you have any leads?

Chinese: 也许在海伦院长的房间里…
English: Hmm... What about Helen's quarters?

Chinese: 不过还是先离开吧，我们在这里呆太久了。
English: But let's get out of here first. We've been here too long.

Chinese: 我和安洁把翻阅过的文档重新整理好，然后按照原样锁上了门悄悄离开。
English: Angie and I carefully restore the documents, lock the door behind us, and quietly slip away.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 片刻后，房间的门被打开，一个人站在门前，幽幽地叹息。
English: Moments later, the door creaks open, and a figure stands in the doorway, a soft sigh escaping their lips.

Chinese: 还是到这一天了吗…
English: So this day has finally come...

Chinese: 没想到会比我想的要来得快呢…
English: Didn't expect it to come so soon...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 都是一些小菜，比不得圣城的那些美味，还请您见谅。
English: Apologies for the humble fare, nothing as grand as the sacred city's delicacies.

Chinese: 没关系，侍主先生是不会介意的。
English: It's alright. His lordship wouldn't mind.

Chinese: 那些东西吃多了后，换换口味也是挺好的。
English: After eating those delicacies for a while, it's nice to have a change.

Chinese: 在安排了孩子们去吃饭后，我们在一侧的房间中享用着简单且朴素的午餐。
English: After arranging for the kids to have their meal, we enjoy a simple and modest lunch in a side room.

Chinese: 我与院长侃侃而谈，安洁却基本是一言不发的状态，或是夹一口菜慢慢放到嘴里，或是就这样看着我们。
English: I converse with Matron Helen, while Angie sits quietly, occasionally taking a bite or just watching us, her eyes shifting between us.

Chinese: 安洁小时候就可聪明了，你看，我还有她画的那些画。
English: Angie was incredibly smart as a child. Look, I still have the drawings she made.

Chinese: 这些风景画和那些小孩子的涂鸦完全不在一个档次，她的天分显露很早啊。
English: These landscapes are nothing like ordinary children's doodles. You could tell she's clearly gifted.

Chinese: 还有这个，她做的手工艺品，虽然有点旧了，不过还是很精美。
English: And here's a handicraft she made. It's a bit aged, but still intricately crafted.

Chinese: 编得很好啊，比起城里那些打着匠人旗号的小商贩做的好多了。
English: The weaving is excellent, far superior to what those city peddlers who claim to be craftsmen can make.

Chinese: 看得我也很想要一个。
English: Well, color me interested.

Chinese: 我并不记得自己有做过这些东西。
English: I don't remember making these.

Chinese: 不记得？
English: No?

Chinese: 还是和以前一样，只有模糊的印象，对吗？
English: Only vague impressions, just like before?

Chinese: 但这些的确就是属于你的东西，它们曾是你的一部分。
English: But they do belong to you. They were once a part of you.

Chinese: 海伦院长把那些东西交到了安洁的手里，我不知道她是否能感受到那其中所带有的份量。
English: Matron Helen hands them to Angie. I wonder if she feels the weight of it all.

Chinese: 这些都不是什么值得一提的东西。
English: They're nothing fancy, really.

Chinese: 安洁这孩子，还是和以前一样谦虚。
English: Angie, she's still got that same humility.

Chinese: 而且做事也是如此，只会做自己明确有目标的事。
English: And she approaches everything the same way, only tackling tasks with a clear objective.

Chinese: 安洁，你这次回来想做的事完成了吗？
English: Angie, did you manage to accomplish what you came back for this time?

Chinese: 海伦院长的话锋一转，很明显她已经觉察到了什么，而安洁并没有说话，只是转头看向了我。
English: Helen's tone takes a turn, clearly sensing something, while Angie simply turns her gaze to me.

Chinese: 善意的谎言
English: A white lie

Chinese: 当然，安洁和我回来本就是来探望您，看到您依旧健在自然是再好不过了。
English: Well, that's what Angie and I are here for, to visit you. And it's wonderful to find you in good health.

Chinese: 您善良的心意我已经领了，不过也不用这么安慰我这个老婆子了。
English: I appreciate your kind words, but there's really no need to worry about this old biddy.

Chinese: 毕竟，真正需要坦白的反而是我啊…
English: Truth is, if anyone needs to come clean... it's me.

Chinese: 你们应该去档案室找过了吧。
English: You must have looked through the archives, correct?

Chinese: 是的…
English: Yes...

Chinese: 海伦院长叹了一口气，从自己的衣服中掏出了一个盒子。
English: With a heavy sigh, Helen reaches into her robes, producing a small box.

Chinese: 安洁，我希望你明白一直以来这个问题不是我不愿意给你答案，而是我自己也不清楚。
English: Angie, my girl, I need you to understand. It's not that I've been withholding answers all this time. It's just... I'm as much in the dark as you are.

Chinese: 或者说，那不是我这种人应该知道的答案。
English: Or rather, it's not an answer that someone like me should know.

Chinese: 在郑重地接过海伦院长手中的盒子后，一种莫名的沉重感从手掌传来。
English: As I take the box from Matron Helen with a solemn air, a strange weight settles in my hand.

Chinese: 将其打开后，里面只有一张褶皱地泛黄的羊皮纸。
English: Inside, there is only a crumpled, yellowed piece of parchment.

Chinese:
接收证明：
婴儿姓名：安洁
性别：女
发现地：圣紫音湖畔
发现人：希瑟·葛蕾丝碧
伴随物品：写有“安洁”二字的纸条，判断其为婴儿姓名。
English:
Certificate of Receipt:
Infant's Name: Angie
Sex: Female
Place of Discovery: By Lake Seraphis
Discovered by: Heather Graceby
Accompanying Items: A note with the name "Angie", presumed to be the infant's name.

Chinese:
审判所的批注：
出身未知，经由审判所鉴定，其血脉与圣城内诸多世袭家族无法适配。
其体内仅存留纯净的秩序能量，因此亦无游民可能。
猜测其双亲为他城之民，然经数日，未收到任何寻亲讯息。
经由审判长判断，现将其送往海岩家属地，由鸣沙福利院院长海伦·赫尔蒙代为抚养。
English:
Annotations from the Court of Judgment:
Origin unknown. Examination by the Court of Judgment shows no connection to any hereditary families within the sacred city.
Only pure Order Energy is present in her body, ruling out the possibility of being a vagabond.
It is speculated that her parents are from another city. Yet no inquiries have been received after several days.
As determined by the Lord Inquisitor, she is to be sent to the Saltrock territory, to be raised by Matron Helen Helmont of Echoing Sands Home.

Chinese:
愿，雏子的未来健康平安，病痛永不缠身；
愿，雏子的未来天高海阔，前路鲜花遍地；
愿，雏子的未来踏向自由，识遍途中风景。
English:
May the girl's future be healthy and safe, free from illness.
May the girl's future be vast and boundless, with flowers along the path.
May the girl's future be free, exploring all she encounters.

Chinese:
海伦的批注：
本院于1733年12月25日确实接收该名幼子，并按本院传统，将该日定为幼子诞辰。登记入案。
海伦·赫尔蒙在此宣誓。我将忠实遵守《收养法》，将幼子抚养成人，帮助幼子学礼，学品，并将她待如亲生子女，予以爱与关怀。
English:
Helen's Annotation:
On December 25, 1733, this orphan was officially received by this institution, and as per tradition, this date is designated as the child's birthday. Registered and filed.
I, Helen Helmont, do solemnly swear: I will faithfully follow The Adoption Act, nurturing the child as if she were my own, instilling in her manners and virtues, and providing her with love and care.

Chinese: 这份收养证明严格意义上算不得是解答，虽然这些内容让我们对安洁的过往有了一些了解，可随之而来的却是更多的疑问。
English: This adoption certificate doesn't exactly provide answers. While it gives us some insight into Angie's past, it also raises more questions.

Chinese: 所以你们现在能理解我的顾虑了吗？
English: So, do you understand my concerns now?

Chinese: 在我所知的魔女中，的确找不出像安洁这样的例子啊…
English: Among the Nova I know, there's no one quite like Angie...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在我一旁的安洁却站了起来，对着海伦院长深深鞠了一躬。
English: Beside me, Angie stands up and bows deeply to Matron Helen.

Chinese: 感谢您一直以来的照顾让我有了今天，也感谢您对这些秘密一直以来的保守。
English: Thank you for your years of care and for guarding these secrets.

Chinese: 随后安洁便一个人转身离去。
English: Without another word, Angie turns and leaves on her own.

Chinese: 她的举动太过突然，而我只得尴尬地看向海伦院长。
English: Her sudden exit leaves me standing awkwardly before Matron Helen.

Chinese: 抱歉，海伦院长……
English: I'm sorry, Matron Helen, please forgive her...

Chinese: 没关系，去吧，我想她现在是需要你的。
English: It's alright. Go. I think she needs you right now.

Chinese: 实在是失礼了，我先告辞。
English: I'm really sorry about this. I'll go find her now.

Chinese: 简单的告别后，我沿着安洁离去的方向追了出去。
English: After a quick goodbye, I hurry in the direction Angie had gone.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 安洁，你怎么了？
English: Angie, what's going on?

Chinese: 我在外面院子的偏僻处找到了安洁，而她只是望着下方远处的圣紫音湖沉默不语。
English: I find Angie in a quiet corner of the courtyard, silently staring at Lake Seraphis far off.

Chinese: 责怪她
English: Confront her

Chinese: 我能理解你的情绪，但是这样说，对海伦院长不太公平。
English: I get that you're upset, but it's unfair to put all the blame on Matron Helen.

Chinese: 侍主大人觉得我做错了吗？
English: Are you saying I crossed a line?

Chinese: 至少我觉得不应该这样。
English: I just think there was a better way to handle it.

Chinese: 也许吧，我并不打算反驳您...
English: Perhaps, but I'm not going to argue with you...

Chinese: 但也是因为我明白她的好，我才打算这样。
English: Knowing how she is, I had no choice but to end things with her.

Chinese: 您应该也能看出来，我存在一些特殊之处，与他们并不一样。
English: Surely, you can see that there is something special about me, different from them.

Chinese: 我想这个告别我许多年前就应该说出口。
English: And for me, I should have said that goodbye to her years ago.

Chinese: 我不求侍主大人一定要理解我的想法，只要不用您的身份去强行要求我就好。
English: I don't expect you to understand my situation, but please don't use your authority to impose your will on me.

Chinese: 安洁的这些自白让我一下子不知道该说些什么好，我们就这样静静地看着对方。
English: Angie's confessions leave me at a loss for words for a moment, and we just look at each other quietly like this.

Chinese: 可我知道我必须要做出一些回应。
English: But I know I have to make some response.

Chinese: 安洁觉得这一切最重要的是什么？
English: Angie, what do you think is the most important thing about all this?

Chinese: 我现在没有明确的头绪，还望侍主大人明说…
English: I'm not sure. Please, Lord Oracle, tell me what you think...

Chinese: 对于你的过去，目前我们确实无能为力。
English: Regarding your past, it's indeed beyond our control right now.

Chinese: 但至于自己是什么样的人，我想并不用一定去纠结事实是如何。
English: The truths may set you free, but they don't necessarily define you so.

Chinese: 重点不在于你是什么，而是你想成为什么。
English: The point is not about who you were, but what you want to become.

Chinese: 我握住她的手，直视她的眼睛。
English: I clasp her hand and hold her gaze.

Chinese: 我们每个人都有着有限的时间，如果不能为了这件事去努力，一味耽溺于过去，才是真正的悲哀。
English: Nothing lasts forever. The real tragedy is being trapped in the past without striving for more.

Chinese: 嗯…算是稍微明白了一些…
English: I think... I'm starting to get it now.

Chinese: 而且你看，你对这一切，也不是像你说的那样毫无反应嘛…
English: And I daresay your heart's not quite so indifferent to all this as you pretend to be...

Chinese: 意识到自己的越界举动，我立刻松开手，并找了一个台阶顺着说下去。
English: Realizing my overstep, I release her hand and try to smooth things over.

Chinese: 倒不如说，侍主大人是特殊的。
English: If anything, it is you, my Lord, who is the extraordinary one.

Chinese: 这是什么意思？
English: What does that mean?

Chinese: 那这就看你自己怎么去思考了。
English: That's for you to think about.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 安洁再次回到了一贯的表情，但我清楚刚才的苦闷已经消失了，至少暂时是。
English: Angie goes back to her usual look, but I know the gloom is gone, at least for the moment.

Chinese: 离开了福利院后，我开始思考接下来应该去干嘛。
English: After leaving the orphanage, I begin to ponder my next steps.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 侍主大人要回去了吗？
English: Are you heading back, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 是啊，毕竟剩下的时间也完不成我原来的计划了。
English: Yeah, since there's not enough time to finish what I started.

Chinese: 同时最近天气阴晴不定，我怕又遇到昨天的情况，万一到时候回不去就麻烦了。
English: Plus, with this unpredictable weather, I don't want to get stuck here again like yesterday.

Chinese: 不过侍主大人难得休息，这样多少有些可惜呢。
English: But you rarely get a vacation like this, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 还好吧，反正不是还有一天嘛，回去在圣殿里躺着也挺不错。
English: It's alright. I still have a day left. Resting at the Sanctuary sounds good for me.

Chinese: 那听起来，侍主大人明天是没什么安排。
English: So, you're free tomorrow?

Chinese: 这，有哪里不对吗？
English: Why? Is there a problem?

Chinese: 这倒没有。
English: No, not at all.

Chinese: 只是正好明天我也没什么特别的事要做，比较有时间，可以陪侍主大人出去走走，毕竟这次您也帮了我一些忙。
English: It's just that I happen to be free tomorrow as well. I could join you for a walk since you've helped me a lot.

Chinese: 安洁的虽然没有明说，但意思却已经很直白了。
English: Though she doesn't spell it out, her intention is clear.

Chinese: 好啊，那就一言为定。
English: Alright then, it's a deal.

Chinese: 是不是还少了点什么，让女生和您一起出行，有些礼节还是必要的呢。
English: Aren't you forgetting something? It's customary to invite a lady properly.

Chinese: 对于主动权她真是喜欢牢牢把控在自己手里，还是她平时的脸色更好对付一些啊...
English: She certainly likes to be in control. Her usual demeanor is easier to handle...

Chinese: 不过既然安洁想要这样，那我就顺便推一把好了。
English: But if that's the way she wants it, perhaps a gentle nudge is in order.

Chinese: 那就，明天的话，要是你愿意，我想要邀请你一起去…
English: So, if you're up for it, I'd like to invite you to...

Chinese: 去什么呢？
English: To what?

Chinese: 那个词怎么说来着，是叫约会对吧，是吧，安洁。
English: What's the word again? A... date? Right, Angie?

Chinese: 说得这么直接，您是故意的吧。
English: Oh Lord Oracle, aren't you the brazen one?

Chinese: 这就看你怎么想咯。
English: Well, I agree to disagree.

Chinese: 那就…像侍主大人您所说的，明天…约会吧…
English: In that case... As you so boldly propose, my Lord, on the morrow... let's have a date...

Chinese: 安慰她
English: Comfort her

Chinese: 你看起来不太好，没有得到自己的答案果然还是会觉得难过吧。
English: You don't look well. Not getting your answers must be hard.

Chinese: 要是有什么想说的，其实不用这样憋在心里。
English: If there's anything you want to say, I'm here for you.

Chinese: 谢谢侍主大人的关心，但其实并不是因为这个…
English: Thank you for your concern, Lord Oracle, but that's not it...

Chinese: 再次回到这里没有让我有什么怀念的感觉，与海伦院长多年后的相见也并没有让我有多少喜悦…
English: Returning here didn't feel like a homecoming, nor did seeing Matron Helen after all these years bring me joy...

Chinese: 哪怕是没能得到想要结果的失望、在打算告别这一切而决断时的不舍，我都没有那些强烈的感觉…
English: Even the disappointment of not getting the answers I wanted, or the reluctance to leave, or the reluctance to say goodbye, didn't hit me hard.

Chinese: 如此平淡…常人不应该是这样的…
English: A curious detachment... Not the norm for mortal sentiment, I should think...

Chinese: 而想到这一点后，我却反而感到了一丝悲哀，可我不理解这到底是为何…
English: This realization brings a tinge of sadness, but I can't quite grasp why...

Chinese: 如实坦白
English: Tell the truth

Chinese: 我可以和海伦院长直说吗？
English: Can I be honest with her?

Chinese: 嗯…我想也没有解释的必要了。
English: Hmm... I guess there's no need to hide it from her anymore.

Chinese: 如您所说，我们确实是为了一些事才来的，为了困扰着她的过往。
English: Your suspicion was correct. We came here for a reason, to uncover her troubled past.

Chinese: 的确和我想的一样呢…
English: Just as I thought...

Chinese: 骗我去带孩子，真坏啊。
English: Tricking me into babysitting, that's mean.

Chinese: 我的确去把其他孩子都叫过来了，到底是哪里骗您了呢？
English: But I did bring the other kids over. How is that a trick?

Chinese: 而且侍主大人不是答应了我要帮忙的吗？
English: And you did promise to help me, didn't you?

Chinese: 让我知道要帮什么忙、立即开始行动，和隐瞒着我让我猜测要帮什么忙再付出行动，效率是不一样的。
English: There's a difference between keeping me in the loop and leaving me in the dark, before running errands for you.

Chinese: 我让侍主大人您看住那群孩子也是因为他们算是海伦院长的眼睛，有什么人和什么事如果被他们看见了，那海伦院长很快就会知道。
English: I asked you to keep an eye on the kids because they're Helen's eyes and ears. If they see something, she'll know it too.

Chinese: 只是，现在真正的问题是我还没找到想要的东西。
English: But the real problem is that I haven't found what I'm looking for.

Chinese: 这种事去问海伦院长会好些吧。
English: Why not just ask her instead?

Chinese: 就是因为从海伦院长那里得不到答案，我才要这么做的。
English: I can't get the answers I need from her. That's why I'm doing this.

Chinese: 原来是这样吗…那应该就是有一些不方便告诉你的原因吧。
English: I see... She probably had her reasons.

Chinese: 无论如何，我都必须要知道它。
English: Regardless, I have to find out for myself.

Chinese: 请问您和安洁的关系是？
English: What is your relationship with here, may I ask?

Chinese: ……她是抚养我长大的福利院院长。
English: She is the matron who raised me.

Chinese: 和安洁一个房间
English: Bunk with Angie

Chinese: 要不就一起？
English: How about we share a room?

Chinese: 嗯。
English: Yeah.

Chinese: ……你不用勉强说这种话。现在是旅途之中，你我不需要遵守那些上下尊卑。
English: You don't have to be embarrassed about it. Out here on the open road, you and I don't need to follow those hierarchical formalities.

Chinese: 我没有勉强。毕竟侍主大人来之前也不知道这些。
English: I'm not. Besides, you didn't know about this before coming here.

Chinese: 如果这样还要委屈侍主大人您的话，那我作为神谕司的魔女也未免有些失格。
English: If this would embarrass you, I should hardly be worthy of my title as a Nova in your service.

Chinese: 谢谢。
English: Thank you.

Chinese: 那个，之后就请二位随意了，我就先不打扰二位了。
English: Well then, I'll leave you two alone.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 由于时间已经很晚了，而且也没有什么可做的，再加上白天路途上的劳累，之后我们便打算先休息。
English: As it is late and we are tired from the road, and there is nothing else to do, we decide to call it a day.

Chinese: 在洗漱完回房间的路上，我的脑海中一片混乱。
English: On the way back to the room after washing up, my thoughts are a tangled mess.

Chinese: 与安洁同床共枕，我可还从来没想过这种事...
English: Never thought I'd be sharing a bed with Angie...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 安洁，这会方便吗？
English: Angie, is now a good time?

Chinese: 我轻轻敲了敲门，等候她的回应，这也是为了避免在发生比较尴尬的情况。
English: I knock lightly, waiting for her response to avoid any awkward situations.

Chinese: 请进来吧，床我也已经整理好了。
English: Come in, the bed is made ready.

Chinese: 房间里的灯点着，安洁坐在床上，手里捧着一本与高阶术式有关的书，和她平时的状态没什么区别。
English: The room is lit, and Angie is sitting on the bed, reading a book about advanced spells, just like usual.

Chinese: 我躺在床上闭上眼，等待睡意的降临，以及安洁躺在床铺另一边的重量变化。
English: Stretched out on the bed, I let my eyelids drift closed, anticipating the sweet pull of slumber and the shifting weight of Angie claiming her spot beside me.

Chinese: 然而几分钟过去了，我发现安洁似乎没有改变过姿势。
English: But as the minutes tick by, Angie remains still as a statue, not a rustle to be heard.

Chinese: 还不睡吗？
English: Burning the midnight oil, are we?

Chinese: 嗯...我的话...稍微再等会吧。
English: Mmm... You know me... Just a few more pages.

Chinese: 安洁还真是热衷于学习。
English: Seems like you've really got a knack for learning.

Chinese: 作为优秀的魔女这是应该的...
English: Well, that's what good Novas do...

Chinese: 不过应该有些影响侍主大人的休息了，那就还是先到这里吧...
English: Not that I want to keep you up, Lord Oracle. But maybe I should call it a night now...

Chinese: 安洁合上了书，把一旁的灯熄灭，背对着我缓缓躺了下来。
English: Angie shuts her book, switches off the light, and settles down with her back to me.

Chinese: 也许是我的错觉，我总觉得她的动作很僵硬...
English: Maybe it's just me, but the way she moves seems hesitating...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我其实一直在思索安洁所说的私事到底是什么，要是能有答案就好了。
English: I keep wondering about what her personal matters could be. If only I had an answer.

Chinese: 鼻尖感受到的是安洁头发所散发的像是紫丁香般的芳香，而在这个想法中我渐渐进入了梦乡。
English: As slumber slowly claims me, my senses are awash in the sweet perfume of lilacs, an aroma that can only be Angie's silken hair.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 窗外不时响起的鸟鸣声和照在脸上的阳光让我醒了过来。
English: Mingling with the melodic chirping of birds beyond the windowpane, the morning sunlight on my face gently pulls me from my slumber.

Chinese: 这一觉，睡得真舒服…
English: That was truly refreshing...

Chinese: 满足地伸了一个懒腰后，我发现一旁空空如也，安洁似乎已经离开了。
English: After a satisfying stretch, I notice the empty space beside me. Angie has already gone.

Chinese: 在我穿上衣服收拾东西的时候，安洁回到了房间。
English: While I'm getting dressed and packing, Angie walks back into the room.

Chinese: 侍主大人希望我走吗？
English: Does Lord Oracle wish me gone?

Chinese: 这倒是没有。
English: Not at all.

Chinese: 喏，给你带了早点上来。
English: Here, I brought breakfast for you.

Chinese: 谢谢。
English: Thank you.

Chinese: 应当的。
English: It's my pleasure.

Chinese: 我以为你去办自己的事去了。
English: I thought you were off handling your personal matters.

Chinese: 事是要去办的，不过昨晚我想了想，我一个人处理起来会有些麻烦，如果侍主大人能和我一起的话倒是比较好的选择。
English: I was going to, after some thought last night, I realized it might be a bit challenging for me to handle alone. It'd be great if you could join me, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 那么，侍主大人您的意见如何呢？
English: So, what do you think, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 捉弄她
English: Mess with her

Chinese: 我本来也是这个意思，安洁这么说正好省去了我还要想办法去插手她的事。
English: I was going to suggest the same. And she just made it easier for me to get involved.

Chinese: 但或许是因为无聊，我突然打算想捉弄一下安洁。
English: But feeling a bit mischievous, I thought I'd mess with Angie a little.

Chinese: 我是过来度假的，今天有别的安排，帮不了你呢。
English: I'm here on vacation and have other plans for today. I can't help you.

Chinese: 这样吗？那我也不好勉强。
English: Oh, bummer! But I suppose I can't insist.
Hmm...

Chinese: 她这样说，倒让我不太忍心了。
English: Her reaction tugs at my conscience.

Chinese: 到时候我晚回去了，就和律还有黑神说说这一路上的事，遇到侍主、和侍主在一起住了一晚，当然也不能隐瞒……
English: I guess I'll just tell Ritsu and Kurokami about the trip when I get back to the sacred city, including our chance meeting and our night together. And of course, sharing a room with you...

Chinese: 好好好...我去，我去！
English: Alright, alright... I'll come along!

Chinese: 没想到居然被安洁反将了一手……
English: Didn't expect to get blackmailed by little Angie...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 答应她
English: Accept her request

Chinese: 正好我原本的度假计划也被搞砸了，那就先帮你把你的事处理了吧。
English: Since my vacation plans are already spoiled, let's take care of your business first.

Chinese: 嗯...谢谢侍主大人了。
English: Well, thank you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 不过，具体需要我做什么呢？
English: But what exactly do you need from me?

Chinese: 侍主大人不用着急，之后您会知道的。
English: Don't worry, Lord Oracle. You'll find out soon enough.

Chinese: 我在旁边让你感到不适应吗？
English: Am I making you uncomfortable sleeping next to you?

Chinese: 怎么会...
English: Of course not...

Chinese: 总之我也要睡了，明天还有事要做...
English: Anyway, I should sleep too. Busy day tomorrow...

Chinese: 难道是我说中了？安洁马上放下书关掉了灯，然后钻进了被子里。
English: Oh my... Did I strike a nerve? Quick as a flash, Angie snaps her book shut, kills the lights, and burrows beneath the blankets.

Chinese: 我不知晓这对她是否产生了些许的愉快，或许，一切在她眼中都不过是消遣……
English: I do not know if this brought her any pleasure, or perhaps, everything in her eyes is merely a pastime...

Chinese: 广场，我在熙来攘往的人群中轻而易举地找到了那抹蓝色身影。
English: At the plaza, I effortlessly spot that blue figure amid the bustling crowd.

Chinese: 她站在路旁，专心翻看着手中巴掌大小的手册，仿佛周遭的嘈杂无法对她产生影响。
English: Standing at the roadside, she's focused on reading a small handbook, seemingly immune to the chaos around her.

Chinese: （明明是邀请她出来放松的，但总觉得她还是一脸严肃……）
English: (I invited her out to relax, but she still looks so serious...)

Chinese: 抱歉，我来晚了。
English: Sorry I'm late.

Chinese: 听到声音，她先是抬头望了一眼，随后才将书册合拢收好。
English: Upon hearing my voice, she glances up before closing her booklet and tucking it away.

Chinese: 您来了。
English: You've arrived.

Chinese: ……是有事耽搁？
English: Did something hold you up?
Eh—

Chinese: （但我明明已经比约定的时间早到了10分钟，这位魔女还真是……）
English: (But I actually arrived 10 minutes before our agreed time. She's really something...)

Chinese: 安洁是什么时候到的？
English: What time did you arrive, Angie?

Chinese: 一刻钟前，我比较习惯提前一些。
English: A quarter hour ago. I prefer to arrive early.

Chinese: 安洁抽出几份纸张递到我面前。
English: Angie pulls out several pieces of paper and hands them to me.

Chinese: 这是……
English: What's this?

Chinese: ……很多张传单。
English: A collection of flyers.

Chinese: 看起来像一种宣传手段。用带有文字与图案的纸张让行人对商店产生兴趣，以达到招揽顾客的目的……只是我未曾在圣城中见过这种形式。
English: They seem to be some sort of promotional material. Papers with words and illustrations to generate interest among passersby and attract potential customers... a strategy I haven't previously observed in the sacred city.

Chinese: 圣城以南的游牧部族，他们热情爽朗，会以高声吆喝与发放传单的形式推销商品……这是那边的习俗传统。
English: The nomadic tribes to the south of the sacred city are warm and direct. They advertise their merchandise through shouting and handing out flyers, a tradition of their culture.

Chinese: 你能猜出我在想什么？
English: Can you guess what I'm thinking?

Chinese: 还有另一种人也以传单作为宣传手段……虽然很少见，但您应该能猜到。
English: Another type of individual also uses flyers for advertising... While uncommon, you probably know who I'm referring to.

Chinese: 另一种人？
English: Another type of individual?

Chinese: 我顺着安洁给予的思路向下思考。
English: I follow Angie's line of thought.

Chinese: 侍主理应知道的，圣城中罕有却非不存在，让安洁能特地提及的……
English: You should know about this, something rare but not non-existent in the sacred city, something I would specifically mention...

Chinese: 你是说——游民？
English: You mean—vagabonds?

Chinese: 那些以传播混乱为毕生使命的可悲的家伙，圣殿的敌人。
English: Those pitiful individuals dedicated to spreading chaos, enemies of the Sanctuary.

Chinese: 你是从游民手里拿到的这些？
English: Did you get these from vagabonds?

Chinese: 安洁既不肯定也不否定的态度让我感到一阵不安。
English: Angie's neither affirmative nor negative attitude fills me with unease.

Chinese: 我仔细看了看传单上的文字。
English: I carefully examin the text on the flyers.

Chinese: “……诗牌屋盛大开业，供应茶水点心，欢迎新老顾客光临？”
English: "Grand opening at Poetry House, tea and snacks available, new and returning customers welcome? "

Chinese: ……和游民完全没有关系。
English: This has absolutely nothing to do with vagabonds.

Chinese: （害我紧张了一下，难道她是在故意吓唬我？但是感觉和她平日里的风格不一样。）
English: (She made me nervous for nothing. Was she deliberately trying to mess with me? But that doesn't seem like her usual style.)

Chinese: 你不会是故意这样说的吧？
English: You weren't saying that on purpose, were you?

Chinese: 您多虑了，我只是说出所有可能。
English: You're reading too much into it. I was simply stating all possibilities.

Chinese: （表情毫无变化……）
English: (Her face shows no reaction...)

Chinese: 哎……总之先去商业街吧，那里出现了个占卜屋，我在意好久了。
English: Well... let's head to the shopping street first. There's a Divination Parlor there that's been intriguing me for a while.

Chinese: 如您所愿。
English: As you wish.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我们站到队列的末端，而后又有人跟着站到我们身后，队伍如长虫般向前挪行。
English: We join the end of the queue, and others line up behind us as the line inches forward like a caterpillar.

Chinese: 队列通向的是一辆马车，车厢呈宽敞的树干状，设有门窗，可供人在里边正常居住。
English: The line leads to a carriage with a spacious trunk-like cabin that has doors and windows, suitable for normal habitation.

Chinese: 圣城很少见到如此奇特的东西，所以那大约是来自更南方的事物。
English: Such peculiar things are rarely seen in the sacred city, so it likely originates from somewhere further south.

Chinese: 马车旁的帐篷……被称为“占卜屋”的地方，这就是我们的目标？
English: The tent beside the carriage... the place called the "Divination Parlor," this is our destination?

Chinese: 没必要这么正式……还记得我们出来的目的吗？
English: You don't need to be so stiff about it... Remember why we're out today?

Chinese: 我同样看向队伍的远方。
English: I glance toward the front of the long queue.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 只记得您邀了我外出。
English: I only recall that you invited me to go out.

Chinese: 准确来说是“外出放松”。
English: Technically, it was to "go out and relax."

Chinese: （话说刚刚好像看见个奇怪的谁……）
English: (I think I just spotted someone strange...)
(Staring...)

Chinese: 好吧，其实是我想放松……现在你也看到那个占卜屋了，三天前出现的。
English: Fine, it's actually me who wanted to relax... Now you've seen the Divination Parlor that appeared three days ago.

Chinese: 我想去试试，但我不懂占卜学。
English: I want to try it out, but I don't understand divination.

Chinese: 尝试占卜，并不需要学问。
English: Trying divination doesn't require scholarly knowledge.

Chinese: 安洁罕见地皱了一下眉。
English: Angie frowns slightly, which is unusual for her.

Chinese: （好冷的目光……这家伙今天是不是吃错药了？）
English: (That's a chilly look... Is something wrong with her today?)

Chinese: 我的意思是，你是我认识的魔女中对占卜最熟悉的，所以才想请你参与进来——
English: What I meant was, you're the Nova I know who's most familiar with divination, so I thought you could help me—

Chinese: <size=25>看到那个女孩了吗？蓝色头发的……</size>
English: <size=25>Do you see that girl? The one with blue hair...</size>

Chinese: <size=25>那好像是魔女大人，侍奉主神的，我在圣殿旁边见过！</size>
English: <size=25>That looks like Miss Nova, who serves Lord God. I've seen her near the Sanctuary!</size>

Chinese: <size=25>魔女大人为什么会出现在这里？</size>
English: <size=25>What's Miss Nova doing in a place like this?</size>

Chinese: <size=25>不好说，可能是在执行什么秘密任务吧。</size>
English: <size=25>Who knows? Maybe she's on some secret mission.</size>

Chinese: <size=25>那我们在这里议论是不是不太好，万一影响了魔女大人的秘密任务就糟了。</size>
English: <size=25>We probably shouldn't gossip about this. What if we end up compromising Miss Nova's secret mission?</size>

Chinese: <size=25>刚刚是谁起的头？不过你说的有道理，这事大家得保密，不能外泄啊！</size>
English: <size=25>Says the one who brought this up in the first place. But you're right, this information needs to stay between us!</size>

Chinese: <size=25>那是，那是，绝对不外露！</size>
English: <size=25>Of course, absolutely—we'll keep it quiet!</size>

Chinese: （啧……这就是流言的起源吗……）
English: (Tsk... so this is how rumors start...)

Chinese: 我大概知道安洁烦躁的理由了。
English: I think I understand why Angie is irritated now.

Chinese: （虽然在我眼中魔女并非罕见，但她们其实是只有少数人才能接触到的存在。）
English: (Though Novas are common to me, they're actually beings that very few people get to interact with.)

Chinese: （看来安洁并不喜欢这种情况，即便对方都并非坏心。而且安洁应该遇见过更多这种情况，毕竟她的很多任务地点都在城区……）
English: (It seems isn't comfortable with this, even though no one means any harm. And Angie must have experienced this more often, given that many of her assignments are in urban areas...)

Chinese: ……您怎么了？队伍可是往前走好一段了。
English: What's the matter? The line has moved quite a bit.

Chinese: 欸？啊，这个是……
English: Huh? Oh, well...

Chinese: …………您不用在意其他人的看法。
English: Don't worry about what others think.

Chinese: （我心思都写在了脸上么？她怎么什么都知道……）
English: (Can she read my thoughts that easily? How does she always seem to know what I'm thinking...)

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 漫长的排队后，我们总算见到了那位占卜师。
English: After an extended wait in line, we finally met the diviner.

Chinese: 她跪坐着，身前的红木矮桌上放置着水晶球、塔罗牌等各异的占卜道具。
English: She is kneeling with a low red wooden table in front of her, arranged with various divination tools like a crystal ball and tarot cards.

Chinese: 二位请坐。
English: Please take a seat.

Chinese: 我们依言坐到对方面前。
English: We sit down in front of her as instructed.

Chinese: 我想先问一下，你能为我们占卜什么？
English: First, I'd like to know what kind of divination you can provide for us?

Chinese: 取决于您想知道什么。
English: That depends on what you wish to know.

Chinese: 我能提供的有很多。例如运势，宜忌，幸运色……不过更多人来这里只是因为好奇，因为他们从未接触过占卜，属于一种新鲜的事物。
English: I can provide many different services. For example: fortunes, lucky and unlucky actions, lucky colors... But most people come here simply out of curiosity, as they've never experienced divination before and find it novel.

Chinese: （居然还有占卜师说别人纯粹是因为好奇？）
English: (A diviner actually admitting people come just out of curiosity?)

Chinese: （好吧……我也差不多，也算是说中了。）
English: (Well... that's basically why I'm here too. She's right on the mark.)

Chinese: 安洁觉得我该占卜什么？
English: What do you think I should divine for, Angie?

Chinese: 既然是第一次尝试，就得问问专家的意见。
English: Since it's my first attempt, I should ask an expert's opinion.

Chinese: ……关于这个，您其实更应该向主神大人祈祷。
English: In this case, you would find more value in directing your prayers to Lord God.

Chinese: 而且，我有一件事想要弄清楚。
English: Besides, there's something I'd like to clarify.

Chinese: 安洁看向那位占卜师。
English: Angie turns her attention to the diviner.

Chinese: 就常理而言，“与‘命运’和‘预言’相关”才是普通人占卜的理解。
English: Generally speaking, common understanding of divination involves concepts of "fate" and "prophecy."

Chinese: 但您刚才却似乎主动避开了这方面，更用“新鲜事物”加以引导……
English: Yet you seemed to deliberately avoid those aspects, instead emphasizing divination as "something novel"...

Chinese: 我很好奇，您究竟是不是一位真正的占卜师呢？
English: I wonder, are you actually an authentic diviner?
Huh—?

Chinese: 你的意思是……假的？
English: Are you saying she's a... fake?

Chinese: 不不不。我可以证明我的能力。只需要您给我一根头发，我便能大致猜出您的来历。
English: Of course I am. And I can prove my abilities. Just give me a strand of your hair, and I can roughly determine your origins.

Chinese: 哦？
English: Oh?

Chinese: （能知道连我自己都弄不明白的来历……但只是一根头发的话……）
English: (To know about my origins that even I don't fully understand... but if it's just one strand of hair...)

Chinese: （给她）
English: (Give it to her)

Chinese: 您还是不要相信为好。部分占卜确实会用到受卜者的毛发，但另一方面，毛发同样可以用在“诅咒”之上。
English: You'd be better off not trusting her. Some divination practices do use the querent's hair, but the same material can also be used to cast "curses."

Chinese: 尤其是受到“给予的认可”之后，诅咒的指向性便会高上许多。
English: Especially after receiving "granted approval," the curse becomes much more precisely targeted.

Chinese: 在我犹豫的时候，安洁忽然拦在我的面前。
English: While I hesitated, Angie suddenly stepped in front of me.

Chinese: 诅咒——
English: Curses—

Chinese: 本以为安洁又是在吓唬我，但这次她的脸上没有任何揶揄之色。
English: I thought Angie was trying to mess with me again, but this time there's no trace of teasing in her expression.

Chinese: 魔女冷冷地看向面前的占卜师。
English: The Nova gazes coldly at the diviner before her.

Chinese: “占卜者理应在阐述注意事项后，方可索要随身之物。”若你身为真正的“占卜者”，理应知道这条规矩。
English: "A proper diviner should explain precautions before requesting personal items." If you were an authentic "diviner," you would know this rule.

Chinese: ……现在，你有两个选择。
English: Now, you have two options.

Chinese: 第一，向我们阐述事实，说明你真正的来历。
English: First, tell us the truth about yourself and explain your real background.

Chinese: 第二，由我们向禀报圣殿，让他们接手调查你的真相。
English: Second, we report you to the Sanctuary and let them investigate your true identity.
What—?!

Chinese: ……大概就是这个样子。
English: That's basically how it'll be.

Chinese: （没想到事情会发展成这样……）
English: (I didn't think it would come to this...)

Chinese: 占卜师老实地讲述了自己的来历。
English: The diviner truthfully discloses her background.

Chinese: 例如她来自南方，家族是采卖香料的工种。这是她第一次代替父亲随队伍前往圣城，目的则是运送圣城商人的沙棘。
English: She explains that she comes from the south, from a family in the spice trade. This is her first time accompanying her father to the sacred city, tasked with transporting sea buckthorn for local merchants.

English: A magical being who can make any wish come true.

English: I appreciate the flattery.
