Chinese: 圣城博物院计划修缮部分展馆，安洁受托作为顾问提供修缮意见，趁此机会，安洁邀我同行，一同浏览闭馆期间的博物院。
English: The Sacred City Museum is renovating several exhibition halls and has hired Angie as a consultant. During the closure, she invited me to join her for a private tour.

Chinese: 交涉完了？
English: Finished your discussions?

Chinese: 抱歉，侍主大人，没能实现我事先安排好的单独游览。
English: I'm sorry, Lord Oracle. I couldn't deliver on the private tour I had arranged beforehand.

Chinese: 没关系，我原本也不是很在意是否有其他顾问在。
English: Don't worry about it. I wasn't particularly bothered about sharing the tour with other consultants anyway.

Chinese: 感谢您的体贴，但这件事毕竟是圣城博物院违约在先，而且在计划变更后也没及时与我沟通，所以我要求了一些合理的补偿措施。
English: I appreciate your understanding, but the museum broke our agreement first. And after changing plans, they failed to communicate with me promptly, so I demanded reasonable compensation.

Chinese: 哦？还有补偿措施？是什么？
English: Oh? There's compensation involved too? What is it?

Chinese: 安洁十分自然的拿出了一卷文件，拎起卷轴的一端顺势展开。
English: Angie effortlessly produces a scroll and unrolls it with a casual gesture.

Chinese: 卷轴的另一端滚落地面，一直延伸到楼梯下方才停止，上面密密麻麻的写满了详细的条文。
English: The other end of the scroll rolls across the floor, extending all the way down the stairs. Every inch is covered with intricate legal text.

Chinese: 第一大章第一小节第一款，圣城博物院在本次修缮计划中需要优先考虑顾问安洁所提出的各方面建议，包括但不限于——
English: Chapter 1, Section 1, Clause 1: In this renovation, the Sacred City Museum must give priority to all recommendations from consultant Angie, including but not limited to—

Chinese: 等，等一下！
English: Hold on, wait a sec!

Chinese: 嗯，侍主大人请说。
English: Yes, Lord Oracle?
Well...

Chinese: 安洁神色如常的看着我，但我莫名觉得她今天的“攻击性”比平时高了好多。
English: Angie maintains her typical expression, but I cannot help feeling she is being much more "aggressive" than usual today.

Chinese: 罢了，也算给圣城博物院上了一课，那我们现在开始参观如何？
English: Let it go. This will teach the Sacred City Museum a lesson. Shall we start our tour now?

Chinese: 安洁微微点头，手上亮起魔法光辉，将卷轴回收。
English: Angie nods subtly while magical light shimmers around her hands as she rolls up the scroll.

Chinese: 我们先去“黄金时代”展馆吧，虽然出了些小插曲，但我还是希望能尽量按照计划进行。
English: Let's begin with the "Golden Age" exhibition hall. Despite this little setback, I'd still like to follow our schedule as planned.

Chinese: 居然第一站就是黄金时代的展馆，还不错嘛。
English: The Golden Age exhibit as our first destination? Impressive choice.

Chinese: 黄金时代，在史学界中通常是特指第三纪元10938年至17250年间的历史时期。
English: Among historians, the Golden Age specifically refers to the historical period from year 10938 to 17250 of the Era of Frost Veil.

Chinese: 在这六千三百余年间，米伦文明得到了空前的发展，诸多对后世影响深远的文明成果接连涌现。
English: Throughout more than 6300 years, Mirren civilization flourished like never before, producing countless cultural achievements that would deeply impact future generations.

Chinese: 其中最能令人们心生向往的，便是如今已经难以复现的各种“符文科技”。
English: What captivates people most are the various "Rune Tech" innovations that have become almost impossible to recreate in our time.

Chinese: 这是一块保存相对完好的琳文石，出土自加文山脉附近的修格斯矮人聚落遗迹。
English: This is a remarkably well-preserved rune stone discovered in the ruins of a Sugeth Dwarves settlement near the Gavin Mountains.

Chinese: 据说它原本被安置在一台损坏的机关中，作为动力源使用，刚出土之时还能被激活。
English: They say it was originally installed in a damaged device as its power source. When first unearthed, it was still functional.

Chinese: 居然埋了这么久还没失效？矮人的文明确实有些可惜了，这可都赖丝特芬妮。
English: It remained functional after being buried for all that time? What a pity about the dwarven civilization. Entirely Stephanie's fault, if you ask me.

Chinese: 侍主大人不应该站在历史学家的角度去评论当时的人。
English: You shouldn't judge people of the past through a historian's lens.

Chinese: 果然，安洁今天的攻击性高了很多。是因为前天去野炊没有叫她么？
English: Indeed, Angie is definitely more aggressive today. Is she upset because I didn't invite her to the picnic the other day?

Chinese: 侍主大人，你知道我对食物并没有特别的诉求。
English: Lord Oracle, you know I don't have any particular interest in food.

Chinese: 额……还是一如既往的能看偷我的心思。
English: Uh... she can see right through me, as usual.

Chinese: 咦？安洁，话说那台损毁的机关是做什么的？
English: Huh? Angie, what was that damaged mechanism used for?

Chinese: 似乎是载具，发现者将它命名为“飞梭”，因为它在激活时带飞了两位考古学者，后来他们在六千多里外的亚尔夫着陆，万幸没造成人员伤亡。
English: It appeared to be a vehicle, dubbed the "Sky Shuttle" after it launched two archaeologists over six thousand miles to Yarve. Fortunately, both were unharmed.

Chinese: 啊？这么一小块东西带着两个人横跨了整个迷雾海？
English: Huh? This little thing transported two people across the entire Misty Sea?

Chinese: “飞梭事件”的详细记录已经归档至圣殿考古学会，真实性是有保障的。
English: The "Sky Shuttle Incident" has been thoroughly documented and archived at the Sanctuary Archeological Society. The records' authenticity is beyond question.

Chinese: 我对符文科技的了解不深，但依据那些流传下来的技术文献来推断，这种事是可以轻松做到的。
English: My understanding of Rune Tech is limited, but based on surviving technical literature, this kind of feat was well within its capabilities.

Chinese: 虽然我也对符文科技了解不深，但对黄金时代的历史还是略知一二的。
English: Although I'm not well-versed in Rune Tech, I am somewhat familiar with the history of the Golden Age.

Chinese: 即便以当时的发展水平来看，这种能跨越海洋的小型载具不说是不可思议，至少也称得上是难得一见吧？
English: Even by the development standards of that time, wouldn't a small vehicle capable of crossing oceans be considered, if not extraordinary, at least quite uncommon?

Chinese: 不，侍主大人误会了，我的意思不是说黄金时代已经普及了这种水平的私人载具。
English: No, Lord Oracle, that's not what I meant. I'm not saying these personal vehicles were widespread during the Golden Age.

Chinese: 而是单纯从理论角度来分析，它并不特别，核心原理很明晰，技术层面也不复杂。
English: I'm simply looking at it from a theoretical perspective. It's not especially impressive—the fundamental principles are straightforward and the technology isn't complex.

Chinese: 所以我想说明的是，它的展出方式理应进行调整，将更有价值的展品——
English: What I'm proposing is that its display arrangement should be adjusted to showcase more valuable artifacts—

Chinese: 呵呵，小姑娘的观点很新颖嘛。
English: Well, well, the young lady has quite fresh perspectives.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我和安洁循声望去，一位老先生正昂首阔步地走向我们，在他身边还跟着一名展馆内的工作人员。
English: Angie and I turn toward the voice. An elderly gentleman is approaching us with confident strides, accompanied by a museum staff member.

Chinese: 我刚刚听到了你们的谈话，这位小姑娘似乎对符文科技有十分独特的见解，能与我交流分享一下吗？
English: I overheard your discussion. This young lady seems to have quite distinctive insights about Rune Tech. Would you care to share them with me?

Chinese: 我看了看安洁，而她的沉默却让气氛一时间显得有些难堪。
English: I glance at Angie, whose silence creates a momentarily awkward atmosphere.

Chinese: 请问您是？
English: And you are?

Chinese: 是有着真理圣殿所认证的“大贤者”头衔，同时也身为符文科技学会的首席顾问的唐纳德爵士。
English: This is Sir Donald, holder of the "Grand Sage" title certified by the Sanctuary of Truth and chief advisor to the Rune Tech Society.

Chinese: 虚名，都是虚名而已。
English: Just titles, nothing but hollow titles.

Chinese: 嗨呀，您真是太谦虚了，要知道我们博物院方面可是将您的到来视为莫大的荣幸，至于考察和评估的方面也更是需要指导。
English: Oh my, you're too humble, Sir. You must know that our museum considers your visit a great honor, especially regarding the inspection and evaluation.

Chinese: 所以，您看我们还是继续…
English: So, perhaps we should continue...

Chinese: 这件事我们可以稍后再说。
English: We can address this matter later.

Chinese: 可时间上的安排…
English: But regarding the timing...

Chinese: 聪明人之间的交流不会花太多的功夫，你明白吗？
English: Conversations between intelligent people don't take much time. Do you understand?

Chinese: 这…好吧，那我就在前面的侧厅等候，还望之后的工作您多多照顾。
English: I... understand. I'll wait in the side hall ahead. I hope you'll be supportive of our work later.

Chinese: 在唐纳德爵士把话几乎挑明的情况下，那名负责人夹着尾巴离开了。
English: After Sir Donald made his intentions so clear, the manager scurries away with his tail between his legs.

Chinese: 尽管这个过程中我没有和他有任何接触，但这种奉承也足够让我十分地不舒服。
English: Though I haven't interacted with him at all, this kind of sycophantic behavior is enough to make me deeply uncomfortable.

Chinese: 哼，这种人简直就是在浪费我的时间。
English: Hmph, such people are just a waste of my time.

Chinese: 对了，关于刚才我的提议，这位小姐意向如何？
English: Now, regarding my earlier suggestion, what are your thoughts, young lady?

Chinese: 哦，我当然很乐意与大名鼎鼎的唐纳德爵士探讨一番，毕竟您的声名在学术圈里无人不知无人不晓。
English: Oh, I would absolutely love to engage in discussion with the illustrious Sir Donald, as your fame is unmatched in academic circles.

Chinese: 都说了是虚名，不必这么在意——
English: As I mentioned, these are just titles, no need to focus on them—

Chinese: 嗯哼~尤其是您在飞梭事件中跳海的英姿更是令人津津乐道。
English: Hmm! Particularly your heroic leap into the ocean during the Sky Shuttle Incident is still the talk of many conversations.

Chinese: 咳…那是必要的举措。而且您看起来也不像是个外行人，这点自然是能懂的吧。
English: Ahem... That was a necessary leap. You obviously aren't an amateur yourself, so you surely understand this, correct?

Chinese: 是这样吗？或许您那位在飞梭上坚持到着陆的同僚会有不同的看法。
English: Is that so? Perhaps your colleague who stayed aboard the Sky Shuttle until landing would have a different perspective.

Chinese: 你有所不知，我可是为了测定实时数据才舍身跳海的，要知道——
English: What you don't know is that I jumped into the sea to gather real-time data. You see—

Chinese: 数据？之后的文刊中可完全没提到，是又出了什么别的问题么？
English: Data? That wasn't mentioned in any of the later publications. Were there other complications?

Chinese: （笑出声）
English: (Burst into laughter)

Chinese: ……这位先生，为什么突然发笑？
English: Sir, what prompted your sudden laughter?

Chinese: 神国能有您这样杰出的贤者工作在第一线，让我感到十分的，呃，喜不自胜。
English: I'm simply thrilled that the Divine Kingdom has such exceptional sages working on the front lines. I'm uh... overjoyed.

Chinese: 不好意思打断了两位的学术交流，不要在意我，两位请继续。
English: Pardon my interruption of your academic exchange. Please ignore me and continue.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 不知我们刚刚的对话中有哪里吸引了唐纳德爵士的注意呢？
English: I wonder what aspect of our discussion piqued Sir Donald's interest?

Chinese: 眼前的老贤者似乎被我们连番的打岔扰乱了思路，沉吟了片刻才回话。
English: The elderly sage seemed thrown off by our continuous interruptions and only replied after gathering his thoughts.

Chinese: 怎么说呢，从刚刚的发言来看，小姑娘你似乎对飞梭的技术水平评价颇低啊。
English: From what I gathered, young lady, you appear to have a rather dismissive view of the Sky Shuttle's technical sophistication.

Chinese: 事实如此。
English: That is indeed the case.

Chinese: 啧，你可知加文山脉遗迹的造物都是出自谁的手笔吗？
English: Tsk, do you have any clue who created the artifacts found in the Gavin Mountains ruins?

Chinese: 应该是后伊德时期的符文锻造者布罗克。
English: They should be the creations of the post-Eude rune forger Brok.

Chinese: 谅你也不知—— 哎？
English: I doubt you'd even— Huh?

Chinese: 从琳文石上Ω型的铭文回路来看，这是布罗克锻造生涯晚期的造物。
English: From the omega-shaped inscription on the rune stone, this is clearly from Brok's later forging period.

Chinese: 是布洛克大师！后伊德时代最伟大的锻造大师！
English: You should call him Master Brok! The greatest master forger of the post-Eude era!

Chinese: 你居然知道布洛克大师，既然如此，为何还会胆敢评价说飞梭的技术水平低下？小娃娃可得懂得尊重前辈。
English: Given that you know about Master Brok, how dare you judge the Sky Shuttle's technical merit as subpar? Young ones should learn to respect their elders.

Chinese: 大师造物和水平高超之间没有必然联系，飞梭结构简单，原理单一，唯一值得称道的只是储能效率而已。
English: Master craftsmanship doesn't guarantee technical sophistication. The Sky Shuttle has a simple structure and rudimentary principles. Only its energy efficiency is worthy of note.

Chinese: 荒唐！三重推进机关和精妙的深度铭刻技术！这些哪一个不是伟大的发明？
English: Outrageous! The triple propulsion engine and the exquisite deep etching technique! Aren't these both remarkable innovations?

Chinese: 三重推进机关在前伊德时期就已经应用的相当成熟，这并非布罗克首创。而所谓深度铭刻技术只不过是抄袭的产物罢了。
English: The triple propulsion engine was already mature technology in the pre-Eude period. It wasn't Brok's invention. And the so-called deep etching technique is just stolen innovation.

Chinese: 你想用这些尚未考证的传闻来佐证你的观点吗？
English: Are you trying to use uncorroborated rumors to support your position?

Chinese: 事实是否需要考证您心里应该比我更清楚。
English: You know better than I do whether these facts require verification.

Chinese: 哼，那抛开这些不论，那飞梭未解明的动力技术你如何解释？目前真理学院还有数位学者在研——
English: Hmph, leaving those points aside, how do you explain the Sky Shuttle's power technology that remains undeciphered? Currently, multiple scholars at the Academy of Truth are still studying—

Chinese: 未解明的动力技术？这甚至称不上是一项独立的技术。
English: Undeciphered power technology? That barely qualifies as a distinct technology.

Chinese: 什么？！
English: What?!

Chinese: 请看。
English: Watch this.

Chinese: 安洁微微抬手，灌注了魔力的水流在半空中汇聚出繁复的回路，散发出柔和的光芒。
English: Angie lifts her hand slightly, and magically charged water forms elaborate circuits in midair, emitting a soft luminescence.

Chinese: 而后安洁变换手势，繁复的纹路翻转交叠，形成了新的立体回路，光芒大盛。
English: Angie then alters her gesture, causing the complex patterns to flip and intertwine, creating a new three-dimensional circuit that blazed with light.

Chinese: 想必您已经明白了这个浅显的原理。
English: I presume you now comprehend this basic principle.

Chinese: 所以它充其量不过是布罗克大师一时兴起的试验之作，论技术水平比不上留影机，论历史意义比不上光炬。
English: So it's merely an experimental piece that Master Brok created on impulse. In terms of technical sophistication, it's inferior to the kinescope, and in historical significance, it's overshadowed by the light torch.

Chinese: 即便是只考虑展出的噱头，它也比不上同一批出土的特朗巨炮。
English: Even for exhibition appeal, it doesn't compare to the Trang Cannon found in the same excavation.

Chinese: 所以我认为它不适合作为展示黄金时代辉煌技术的头号展品。
English: So I believe it shouldn't be the flagship exhibit representing the Golden Age's technological brilliance.
What the...? This!

Chinese: ……请问您的名讳是？
English: May I know your name?

Chinese: 神谕司魔女安洁向您问好。
English: Nova Angie, from the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 原来是魔女大人！请恕我冒犯。主神也因您的侍奉而更显光辉。
English: So you're a Nova! I beg your pardon for my rudeness. The Lord God's radiance is enhanced by your service.

Chinese: 天之扉。
English: Gate of Heaven.

Chinese: 天之扉。
English: Gate of Heaven.

Chinese: 天之扉。
English: Gate of Heaven.

Chinese: 您言重了，唐纳德爵士。
English: You flatter me, Sir Donald.

Chinese: 魔女大人，老头子厚着脸皮，有个不情之请，希望您能考虑一下。
English: Miss Nova, this old man has a presumptuous request that I hope you might consider.

Chinese: 我能否邀请您来担任真理学院符文科技学会的首席顾问，当然只是虚职，我以贤者身份保证，这不会以任何形式影响您的魔女本职工作。
English: Could I invite you to become the chief advisor to the Rune Tech Society at the Academy of Truth? It would be only a nominal position. As a Sage, I assure you it won't impact your primary responsibilities as a Nova.

Chinese: 只需要有您闲暇时的指导，我们学科的发展将步入新的阶段，假以时日重现黄金时代的科技盛况也不是没有可能！
English: With merely your occasional guidance during your leisure time, our discipline would advance to a new level. In time, we might even revive the technological splendor of the Golden Age!

Chinese: 眼前这位德高望重的老贤者越说越兴奋，渐渐开始胡言乱语起来。
English: The distinguished old sage became more enthusiastic as he continued, gradually veering into outlandish claims.

Chinese: 怎么样！怎么样！安洁小姐！您意下如何？
English: What do you say? What do you say? Miss Angie! Would you like to register for one?

Chinese: 感谢爵士的好意，但魔女乃侍奉主神，维护真理者，即便是这样的虚职我们也不能私自答应，除非……
English: Thank you for your kindness, Sir. However, as Novas serve Lord God and safeguard truth, I cannot accept even a nominal position without approval, unless...

Chinese: 安洁非常刻意的看了我一眼，唐纳德爵士的注意力也被她的目光引导了过来。
English: Angie gives me a very pointed look, directing Sir Donald's attention toward me.

Chinese: 从我与安洁相处的经验来看，这是她有意拒绝的表现。
English: From my history with Angie, I recognize this as her signal that she wants to refuse.

Chinese: 该以什么方式婉拒这位有贤者身份的爵士阁下呢。
English: What's the best way to gracefully decline this sage's request?

Chinese: 咳，抱歉，失礼了，还未请教这位与安洁小姐同行的先生是？
English: Ahem... Forgive my discourtesy, but I haven't asked about this gentleman accompanying Miss Angie?

Chinese: （拉米雷斯）
English: (Ramirez)

Chinese: 我叫拉米雷斯，是一名历史学者。作为一个历史学家我给出的建议是……
English: I'm Ramirez, a historian. As a historian, I'd suggest...

Chinese: 拒绝！！
English: REFUSE IT!

Chinese: 从唐纳德爵士的反应来看，我这个回答有些过于离谱了，但事已至此，也不得不硬着头皮接下去。
English: Based on Sir Donald's reaction, my response is rather extreme, but having committed, I have to follow through.

Chinese: 咳，安洁小姐的这个顾虑呢，在历史上倒也不是没有先例，那是第四纪元807年，真理圣殿创立之初……
English: Ahem... Regarding Angie's reservation, historical precedent exists. In year 807 of the Era of Eternal Flame, during the early days of the Sanctuary of Truth...

Chinese: 总之，菈雯女士是获得了主神的授意，才依旧从事着世俗工作，所以安洁小姐恐怕很难答应您的请求。
English: Essentially, Lady Lavin only maintained her worldly occupation with Lord God's direct authorization. Thus, Miss Angie would struggle to accept your invitation.

Chinese: 眼前的老贤者神情涣散，显然是被我的话术绕晕了。
English: The old sage looks bewildered, obviously lost in my deliberately convoluted explanation.

Chinese: 唐纳德爵士？
English: Sir Donald?

Chinese: 啊，原来是这样，我完全理解了，很抱歉提出了这么唐突的请求。
English: Ah, I see. I understand completely. Please forgive me for such an unexpected proposition.

Chinese: 今天很高兴认识二位，时候也不早了，我就先行告辞了。
English: I'm delighted to have met you both. It's getting quite late, so I must excuse myself now.

Chinese: 正午的阳光透过彩绘悬窗投在大理石地面上，年迈的贤者逃也似的离开了展厅，脚步声急促而清脆。
English: Midday sunlight filters through the stained-glass windows onto the marble floor as the aged sage hastily departs the hall, his footsteps rapid and distinct.

Chinese: 侍主大人，这就是您……独特的幽默。
English: Lord Oracle, that was your... peculiar sense of humor.

Chinese: 唉，可怜的老爵士。
English: Oh, poor old Sire.

Chinese: 不过，安洁，我总觉得你今天的情绪有些反常。
English: Still, Angie, your demeanor seems different today.

Chinese: 不，我自认为没什么特别之处，或许是您的错觉。
English: No, I don't think I'm acting any differently. It's likely your imagination.

Chinese: 我们已经在第一个展馆耽误了太长时间，还有很多值得浏览的展馆等我们光顾，侍主大人我们继续吧。
English: We've already lingered too long in the first exhibition hall. Many interesting exhibits await our attention. Shall we continue, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我们行程的第二站是座艺术类展馆，主题是雕塑艺术的发展。
English: Our second stop is an art gallery showcasing the development of sculptural art.

Chinese: 展馆主体在室外，另设有大型法阵避免风吹雨淋对展品的影响。
English: The main exhibition area is outdoors, equipped with a large magical array to protect the exhibits from the elements.

Chinese: 如此大费周章的设计是为了兼顾一座特殊的巨型雕塑。
English: This extensive setup was designed specifically for an extraordinary massive sculpture.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 《奈比·诺克》——米伦历史上无可争议的第一雕塑巨作。
English: Nebi Nok, indisputably the greatest early sculptural masterpiece in Mirren history.

Chinese: 原型建成于第一纪元2573年，那时人类文明还处于较为原始的聚落时期。
English: The original was created in year 2573 of the Era of Firstlight, when human civilization existed only in primitive settlements.

Chinese: 它的建成奠定了后世艺术文化的发展基础，同时也是文明早期变革的缩影之一。
English: Its creation established the foundation for future artistic and cultural development, while also embodying the transformation of early civilization.

Chinese: 当然，我们面前的这座雕像并不是由拉娜·福斯亲自创作的，这个是第三纪元中期圣加尔特帝国皇家艺术学院的仿品。
English: Of course, this statue isn't Lana Voss's original work. It's a replica created by the Sanctgard Imperial Academy of Arts during the mid-Era of Frost Veil.

Chinese: 我对雕塑艺术了解不深，但据说当今艺术界对这件作品的评价两极分化严重。
English: I'm no expert in sculptural art, but I've heard that modern critics are deeply divided over this piece.

Chinese: 有人认为仿品是对伟大作品的不尊重，且不具备传承价值。
English: Some believe that replicas dishonor the original masterworks and possess no cultural value.

Chinese: 还有人认为本作品精妙绝伦，留有古韵的同时还完美融入了第三纪元独特的造型风格，可谓匠心独运，艺术价值颇高。
English: Others find this piece magnificent, perfectly integrating ancient elements with the unique style of the Era of Frost Veil—a stroke of genius with considerable artistic merit.

Chinese: 侍主大人觉得呢？
English: What's your view, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 嗯，我的观点偏向后者吧，我对雕塑艺术的了解也不深，作为一名单纯的欣赏者，我是能感受到万余年前创作者们的——
English: Hmm, I side with the latter view. I'm no expert in sculpture either. As a simple admirer, I can feel the creative passion from thousands of years past—

Chinese: 哎！诺大个圣城博物院难道就找不出一个真正懂艺术的人了吗？这个展厅的设计处处透露着一股萎靡妥协的味道！
English: Hey! Is there not a single person in this vast Sacred City Museum who genuinely understands art? Every aspect of this exhibition hall's design reflects a spirit of timid compromise!

Chinese: 远处传来的高声锐评打断了我和安洁的对话。
English: A strident critique from across the hall interrupts my conversation with Angie.

Chinese: 而且听这喋喋不休的架势，一时半会是停不下来了。本来好好的和安洁独处的机会，净是被人打断，我也有点生气了。
English: And from the sound of that persistent tirade, it won't be stopping anytime soon. What was meant to be a quiet time alone with Angie keeps getting interrupted. I'm beginning to feel annoyed myself.

Chinese: 我和安洁交换了一下眼神，向声音传来的方向望去。
English: Angie and I share a glance, and then turn toward where the voice is coming from.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 又一个近现代的仿品，摆在如此显眼的位置，还号称是第三纪元表现主义的集大成之作？
English: Yet another modern replica placed in such a prominent location, and they claim it represents the pinnacle of Era of Frost Veil Expressionism?

Chinese: （打招呼）
English: (Say hello)

Chinese: 你好，这位女士，我们是——
English: Hello, ma'am. We're—

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 眼前的女士沉浸在自己的世界里，并未注意到我们的存在，继续对着眼前的雕塑品头论足。
English: The lady is lost in her own world and hasn't noticed us. She continues to evaluate the sculpture critically.

Chinese: 你好？
English: Hello?

Chinese: 未等我尝试再次与这位不知名的女士沟通，安洁迈出一步，走到我身前，踮起脚尖施放了一道炫目的照明魔法。
English: Before I can try again to speak with the unknown lady, Angie moves in front of me, stands on her tiptoes, and casts a blinding illumination spell.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 啊！发生什么事了！
English: Ahhh! What happened!

Chinese: 呀！你们是谁？博物院不是说闭馆期间只有我一个人在吗？
English: Ah! Who are you? Didn't the museum tell me I'd be the only one here during closure?

Chinese: 你好，这位不知名的女士，我们是受博物院邀请的顾问。
English: Hello there. We're consultants invited by the museum.

Chinese: 现在是为了提醒你馆内还有其他人在，希望你能在浏览的过程中保持一定程度的安静，否则会影响到其他人。
English: I wanted to inform you that others are present in the museum. Please maintain an appropriate volume during your visit to avoid disturbing others.

Chinese: 那位女士沉默片刻，便以审视的目光上下打量了我们一番。
English: The woman is silent briefly, and then examines us with a critical eye.

Chinese: 抱歉，我不知道展馆内还有其他人在，感谢你们的提醒，我是一名艺术家，和你们一样也是受邀而来，你们可以叫我布朗妮夫人。
English: I apologize. I didn't realize others were in the gallery. Thank you for your reminder. I'm an artist, also here by invitation. You may call me Madam Brownie.

Chinese: 嗯，感谢你的配合，布朗妮夫人，既然我们已经达成了共识，那么就不再继续打扰你了，再见。
English: Thank you for your cooperation, Madam Brownie. Since we've come to an understanding, we'll leave you in peace. Goodbye.

Chinese: 等等，二位请留步。
English: One moment, please.

Chinese: 还有什么问题吗？布朗妮夫人。
English: Is there something else? Madam Brownie.

Chinese: 我刚刚仔细观察了两位的气质和着装，能断定你们是拥有高雅品味之人。
English: I've been studying your appearance and manner, and I can tell you both possess sophisticated taste.

Chinese: 可否邀请二位一同浏览？我们之间相互讨论彼此对展品的看法，应该能更有效的完成圣城博物院征求修缮建议的委托。
English: Would you mind if I joined you on your tour? By discussing our views on the exhibits together, we might more effectively fulfill the Sacred City Museum's request for renovation advice.

Chinese: 这次不同，安洁甚至没给我犹豫的时间，直接出言拒绝。
English: Unlike before, Angie doesn't even give me time to hesitate and directly refuses.

Chinese: 不了，感谢你的邀请，我认为那反而会影响博物院的委托。
English: No, thank you for your invitation, but I think that would actually undermine the museum's commission.

Chinese: 啊？您为何会这样想？
English: Huh? What makes you think so?

Chinese: 好吧，既然进一步的对话不可避免，那么出于礼貌和沟通需要——我是魔女安洁。
English: Fine, since further conversation is inevitable, for the sake of courtesy and clear communication... I am Nova Angie.

Chinese: 原来是魔女大人！主神也因您的侍奉而更添光辉。
English: So you're a Nova! Lord God shines even brighter through your service.

Chinese: 天之扉。
English: Gate of Heaven.

Chinese: 天之扉。
English: Gate of Heaven.

Chinese: 那这位先生是？
English: And who might this gentleman be?

Chinese: 我们的对话很快就会结束，这位大人应该不会与你产生沟通，就不必介绍了。
English: This conversation will be brief. This gentleman won't be interacting with you, so no introduction is needed.

Chinese: 什么？！
English: What?!

Chinese: 下面我阐述一遍我的观点，请你听好。
English: Let me clearly state my view. Listen carefully.

Chinese: 从你刚刚评论的语气来看，你表达的观点是认真的，基于这一点，我认为你并不具备提出合理建议的能力。
English: Based on your earlier comments, I can see your criticisms are sincere. Given that, I don't believe you can offer constructive suggestions.

Chinese: 你盲目的尊古卑今，无法从全面客观的角度来评估作品的价值。
English: You blindly venerate the old while dismissing the new, unable to assess works from a balanced, objective standpoint.

Chinese: 在此基础上，你还仅仅关注作品的价值，而没有考虑展馆整体的设计。
English: Additionally, you fixate only on individual pieces' value without considering the exhibition's overall design.

Chinese: 就拿眼前这个《空鸟》来说，虽然它跟其他同类作品相比在美学角度有所欠缺，但胜在凝练，灵动，张力等抽象概念的表现上。
English: Consider this Skybird here. Though aesthetically inferior to comparable works, it excels at conveying abstract qualities like conciseness, dynamism, and tension.

Chinese: 作为表现主义的代表作之一，它能让普通参观者第一时间分辨出不同展区的特色，放置在这个位置无疑是合理的设计。
English: As an exemplar of Expressionism, it helps ordinary visitors immediately identify different exhibition zones. Its placement here is absolutely appropriate.

Chinese: 即便抛开水平不谈，从我们交流开始，你就多次表现出偏执和盲信等有碍沟通效率的特质，可以预见你并不能作为一个好的交流对象。
English: Even ignoring questions of expertise, you've repeatedly displayed traits like obsessiveness and blind faith that hinder effective communication. I can already tell you wouldn't make a productive conversation partner.

Chinese: 结合以上三点，我认为与你结伴同行对完成博物院的委托没有任何帮助。
English: Given these three points, I don't think accompanying each other would help us complete the museum's request.

Chinese: 虽然您是魔女大人，但也不可能理解真正的艺术家！
English: You may be a Nova, but you could never comprehend what makes a true artist!

Chinese: 真正的艺术家吗？那冒昧问一句，布朗妮夫人可否有哪尊作品被圣城博物院收录？
English: A true artist? May I ask if any of Madam Brownie's works have been acquired by the Sacred City Museum?

Chinese: 我没有又能说明什么？整个圣城博物馆又有几件现代作品？这难道不能说明问题么？
English: What difference does it make if they haven't? Just how many contemporary works does this entire Sacred City Museum have? Isn't that telling enough?

Chinese: 布朗妮夫人话音未落，安洁就露出了一个令我深感熟悉和无奈的表情。
English: Before Madam Brownie can finish her thought, Angie displays an expression I recognize all too well—one that fills me with resignation.

Chinese: 看来这位落入陷阱的牺牲品要被狠狠的打击一番了。
English: It appears this poor soul who has stumbled into a trap is about to face a crushing rebuke.

Chinese: 惭愧，虽然微不足道，但我还是以某种形式在博物院内留有作品。
English: I'm afraid I must admit that I do have work exhibited here, modest though it may be.

Chinese: 请向后看，在你左手侧十三步左右的位置。
English: Look behind you, about thirteen paces to your left.

Chinese: 什么？！
English: What?!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 这块名为《恩典》的浮雕，是前年艺术行会毕业生的集体作品，我有幸作为魔法指导参与其中，最后成品的铭牌上留下了我的名字。
English: This bas-relief titled Grace was created by Artificer's Guild graduates two years ago. I had the honor of providing magical guidance, and my name appears on the final plaque.

Chinese: 那群学生当时还未获得世袭工种的资格认证，但他们的创作热忱却给我留下了深刻的印象。
English: The students hadn't yet received their hereditary profession qualification, but their creative passion deeply impressed me.

Chinese: 布朗妮夫人盯着面前的浮雕怔怔出神，似乎是深受打击。
English: Madam Brownie stares at the relief, visibly shaken by this revelation.

Chinese: 如果你仍以创作者自居，就请不要将问题全都归咎于环境和时代。
English: If you still identify as a creator, stop blaming everything on circumstances and historical period.

Chinese: 让创作回归其本身，正如你面前这座技艺不精，形式俗套的作品一样，即便不够优秀，也能让观众感受到创作者所投入的独特心意。
English: Return to the essence of creation itself. Like this piece before you—technically imperfect and conventionally styled—it still manages to convey the creators' unique sentiments to viewers, despite its shortcomings.

Chinese: 趁她沉浸在自己的世界里，我和安洁离开了展厅。
English: As she remains lost in contemplation, Angie and I quietly leave the hall.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 第三章是自然类展馆，主题是海洋奇珍。
English: The third section features a natural history hall showcasing oceanic wonders.

Chinese: 展馆的设计称得上是匠心独运，蔚蓝色的主色调和各种精妙的装饰物给参观者们营造出了一种漫步海底遗迹的奇妙感觉。
English: The exhibition's design is genuinely masterful. The blue color palette and intricate decorations give visitors the extraordinary feeling of exploring underwater ruins.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 小到奇异海螺，大到远洋独角鲸，名录上的大多数海洋生物都能在展馆中找到。
English: From tiny unusual seashells to massive pelagic narwhals, nearly every marine creature in the catalog can be found in this exhibition.

Chinese: 这座展馆的水平非常高，尽管我对海洋生物的——
English: The quality of this exhibition hall is truly exceptional. Although my knowledge of marine creatures is...

Chinese: 了解不深？
English: Limited?

Chinese: 嗯，保守的说，我对此只是略懂皮毛罢了。
English: Yes, to put it conservatively, I only have a cursory knowledge of the subject.

Chinese: ……好吧，我对你的判断标准又有了新的认识。
English: I see. My understanding of your evaluation criteria has just evolved.

Chinese: 不得不说离正常人的认知真是越来越远了。
English: It's becoming further and further removed from common perception.

Chinese: 侍主大人，选取合适的比较对象，才能做出相对客观的评价。
English: Lord Oracle, choosing the right comparison points is crucial for making objective evaluations.

Chinese: 就拿我们刚刚参观过的雕塑艺术展馆来说，虽然它展品丰富，设计巧妙，单独来看不失为一座优秀的展馆。
English: Take the sculpture hall we just toured. Though rich in exhibits and cleverly designed—a fine exhibition in isolation.

Chinese: 但实际上大多数珍贵的雕塑作品都被分配到其他历史类展馆中了，横向对比之下，那个展馆的“含金量”严重不足，甚至比不上米娅家的地下室。
English: In truth, most valuable sculptures have been assigned to other historical exhibitions. Comparatively, that hall's "substance" is seriously deficient—even Mia's basement surpasses it.

Chinese: 安洁这番论述的信息量好大，我一时间竟不知该如何接话。
English: Angie's statement contains so much information that I'm temporarily lost for words.

Chinese: 所以从结果来看，刚刚布朗妮夫人的批判也不是全无道理，但她显然不具备横向对比的意识，只是在主观的发泄不满。
English: So in the end, Madam Brownie's critique wasn't entirely wrong, but she clearly lacked comparative perspective, simply expressing her subjective discontent.

Chinese: 论述有些发散，不过我相信侍主大人应该理解了我想强调的重点。
English: I might've gone off track a bit, but I'm sure you caught the gist of what I meant, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 明白了，你的横向对比，目标是资深海洋学者？所以才做出了“略懂皮毛”的判断？
English: I did. Were you making a lateral comparison with a senior oceanographer in mind? Is that why you judged the knowledge as merely "surface-level"?

Chinese: 正是如此，与侍主大人的交流总是如此轻松，能与思考习惯契合的人相处真是件愉悦的事。
English: Exactly. Engaging with you is always effortless, Lord Oracle. It's truly a rare pleasure to converse with someone whose thinking aligns so well with mine.

Chinese: 哈哈哈哈，没错没错，正如找到一名能喝到一起去的酒友一般，是非常难得的体验。
English: Hahaha, I couldn't agree more. It's like finding a drinking companion who matches your pace perfectly—an experience as rare as it is delightful.

Chinese: 声音早于主人先出现的情景今天好像已经经历了数次。
English: It seems today has been full of moments where voices arrive before their owners.

Chinese: 但眼下这次我能通过至少四种方式提前确定来的人是谁。
English: But this time I can identify who's coming in at least four different ways before they even appear.

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯？你怎么会出现在这？我记得对你的禁足令还没解除吧？
English: Icaruth? What are you doing here? If I recall correctly, your ban hasn't been lifted yet.

Chinese: 哈哈，侍主大人别这么严格嘛，先听我解释嘛。
English: Ahaha, don't be so strict, Lord Oracle. Please hear me out first.

Chinese: 有什么好解释的，无非还是圣城博物院的委托吧？
English: What's there to explain? It's just another commission from the Sacred City Museum, isn't it?

Chinese: 唉，当时就应该一口回绝。
English: Sigh... I should've just turned it down from the very beginning.

Chinese: 哈哈哈，不愧是侍主大人！
English: Hahaha, you are truly amazing, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 因为博物院的工作人员表现的很坚持。
English: The museum staff were quite persistent.

Chinese: 那是当然，他们很清楚我的分量，就拿眼前这个展馆来说，至少有半数的展品跟我有直接或间接的关系。
English: Naturally—they're well aware of my value. Just take a look around this exhibit hall. At least half the displays are directly or indirectly tied to me.

Chinese: 怎么样？就让我带你们开开眼？
English: How does it look? May I have the honor of showing you around?

Chinese: 我回头与安洁交换了一下眼神，她点头回应。
English: I exchange a glance with Angie, and she nods in response.

Chinese: 那就请伟大的“暴风之女”伊卡洛斯小姐为我们展示探险家眼中的海洋吧。
English: Then please, Miss Icaruth, the legendary "Storm Lady", show us the ocean through the eyes of an explorer.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 唉~嘿嘿~安洁大人居然也知道我这个外号呀~哈哈。
English: Oh, Lady Angie knows that nickname too? Haha!

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯毕竟是称号最多的女人。
English: After all, Icaruth holds more titles than any other woman.

Chinese: 其实《海务志》的记载多有纰漏。
English: To be honest, The Maritime Chronicles contains quite a few errors.

Chinese: 就比如说这种鲸类活跃于风暴洋而不是迷雾海，我的航海日志中有明确的记录。
English: For example, this whale species is active in the Stormy Sea, not the Misty Sea. My logbook clearly records that.

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯不愧是有史以来最著名的海洋探险家，她掌握的大量“第一手”知识让我大开眼界。
English: Icaruth truly lives up to her name as the greatest ocean explorer in history. The wealth of firsthand knowledge she holds is eye-opening.

Chinese: 而安洁在知识方面，还是颇有些较真和好胜心的，二人的话题很快就攀升到了一个我插不上嘴的高度。
English: As for Angie, she's meticulous and fiercely competitive when it comes to knowledge. Their conversation quickly reaches such a level that I find myself unable to interject.

Chinese: 这个问题还真是刁钻，估计除了我，就没有人知道了吧。
English: This question is quite tricky. Aside from me, I doubt anyone else knows the answer.

Chinese: 这个猜想部分正确，远洋地区的洋流运动不遵循正常规律，应该是有什么未知的要素在起作用。
English: That hypothesis is partially correct. The ocean currents in the open sea don't follow normal patterns; there must be some unknown factors at work.

Chinese: 部分生活在远洋的大型生物有能力预知洋流变化，我正是利用这点才完成了一些“不可能”的航行。
English: Some large ocean creatures can anticipate current changes. Using this, I've completed some seemingly impossible voyages.

Chinese: 原理？安洁小姐，这世界可没你眼中那么简单有序，很多事情就是说不清的，仅靠原理来行动的话我在第一次出航时就葬身海底了。
English: The principle? Miss Angie, the world isn't as simple and orderly as you might think. Many things can't be explained clearly. If I'd relied solely on principles, I would have perished at sea on my very first voyage.

Chinese: 嗨！不谈这些无聊的事了，我带你们去看看我发现命名的螺吧，对对对，就叫伊卡螺，很有品位吧？
English: Hi! Enough of these boring details. Let me show you the shell I discovered. I called the Icarus Shell. Quite elegant, don't you think?

Chinese: 与安洁相比，伊卡洛斯更不是什么省油的灯，在察觉到安洁的想法后，伊卡洛斯就频频做出挑衅般的回应。
English: Compared to Angie, Icaruth is certainly no pushover. After catching on to Angie's thoughts, Icaruth begins responding with a series of provocative remarks.

Chinese: 呼，怎么样？安洁？还有什么想向我请教的吗？
English: So, what do you think, Angie? Anything else you want to ask me?

Chinese: 不，没什么了，我想我们已经进行了足够充分的交流，不得不说这令我受益匪浅。
English: No, nothing else. I believe we've had a thorough discussion, and I must say, it's been extremely enlightening.

Chinese: 听了安洁的回答，伊卡洛斯仿佛宣告胜利一般，掏出随身的酒壶得意的灌了一大口。
English: Hearing Angie's reply, Icaruth pulls out her flask and takes a hearty swig, as if claiming victory.

Chinese: 然而遗憾的是，伊卡洛斯小姐的这份宝贵的知识却很难让圣城博物院也受益其中。
English: Unfortunately, Miss Icaruth's valuable knowledge is unlikely to benefit the Sacred City Museum.

Chinese: 哦？为什么？
English: Oh? Why?

Chinese: 一名连深蓝鳐都不认识的顾问所给出的建议肯定会有某方面的欠缺。
English: Advice from a consultant who can't even recognize a deep blue ray is inevitably flawed in some respects.

Chinese: 我感到震惊和疑惑，伊卡洛斯的反应很奇怪，以她刚刚表现出的博学程度不应该不认得这种连我都熟悉的常见鱼类。
English: I'm both shocked and puzzled. Given the depth of knowledge she's shown earlier, there's no reason Icaruth shouldn't recognize such a common fish, one even I'm familiar with.

Chinese: 随后，安洁又提了几个“常识性”的问题，伊卡洛斯还是不明所以。
English: After that, Angie asks a few more "basic" questions, but Icaruth remains clueless.

Chinese: 我似乎有些理解了，安洁说的这些，都是第四纪元才出现的知识。
English: Now I get it—everything Angie brought up came about in the Era of Eternal Flame.

Chinese: 这些事，伊卡洛斯生前自然无从知晓，但是——
English: Naturally, Icaruth has no way of knowing these things during her lifetime, but—

Chinese: 切~我大概明白你什么意思了。
English: Tch, I think I get what you mean.

Chinese: 你那些广博的知识，大多源自探险生涯的亲身经历，而这些知识也往往会直接应用于探险中，助你渡过一个个难关。
English: Most of your vast knowledge comes from firsthand experiences during your explorations, and you've used it time and again to get through tough situations.

Chinese: 知识对你来说，只是趁手的工具，当你不再需要工具时，自然也不会去多做关注了。
English: Knowledge, for you, is just a handy tool. When you no longer need the tool, you naturally stop paying much attention to it.

Chinese: 这同时也导致了另一个缺陷，你的知识不成体系，只知道“如何”，而不知道“为何”。
English: This also reveals another flaw: your knowledge lacks structure. You know how to do things, but not why they work.

Chinese: 这到也没错，毕竟我真正感兴趣的东西可不是这些海里游的小家伙。
English: That's not exactly wrong. After all, those little swimmers in the sea were never really where my interests lay.

Chinese: 我的新酒友在这方面一定和你聊的来，她一天天最喜欢研究这些个“为什么”了，下次约你们俩一起喝一杯。
English: My new drinking companion would probably get along great with you. She's always chasing after the "whys" of everything. Next time, I'll have to invite both of you for a drink.

Chinese: 喝一杯的事就算了，但还是要问一句，伊卡洛斯小姐的新酒友是哪位？
English: I'll pass on the drinking, but I do have to ask—who is this new drinking companion of yours, Miss Icaruth?

Chinese: 当然是普琳普顿那家伙……
English: It's Princeton of course...

Chinese: 哈哈~侍主大人原来还在这里~
English: Haha, you're still here, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 你这家伙，再这么放肆，我就让人把你关到秩序之海了。
English: Keep acting out like this, and I'll have you thrown into the Sea of Order.

Chinese: 别嘛~别生气嘛~侍主大人，我这就走，这就不打扰您约会了~
English: Don't be mad, Lord Oracle! I'm leaving now. I won't get in the way of your date any longer.

Chinese: 好了，侍主大人，看来数理学会最近状况频出的流言已经有线索了——
English: Lord Oracle, it seems we may have finally found the source behind the recent rumors destabilizing the Mathematical Society.

Chinese: 今天博物院之行的最后一站，名为真理展馆。
English: Today's final stop at the museum was the Hall of Truth.

Chinese: 展馆的主题是主神终结战乱，建立无罪神国的功绩。
English: The exhibit focused on Lord God's triumph in ending the wars and founding the sinless Divine Kingdom.

Chinese: 我和安洁在展馆中无言漫步，任由静默在庄严肃穆的展厅中流淌。
English: Angie and I walk the hall, wrapped in the solemn reverence that fills the space.

English: none

Chinese: 真理展馆虽大，但我们还是很快便浏览完毕了。
English: Though the Hall of Truth is large, we tour around it quickly.

Chinese: 毕竟在主神相关的事务上，神谕司有着最权威的发言权。
English: After all, when it comes to Lord God, the Oracle Division holds the highest authority on such matters.

Chinese: 也因此，我能够轻易察觉到，展馆在叙事上有着明确的偏向性。
English: That's why I can easily sense a distinct narrative bias in the exhibit.

Chinese: 它弱化了战争的残酷，更侧重描绘主神博爱仁慈的一面，某些重要的历史事件被一笔带过，而另一些事迹则被大书特书。
English: The brutality of war is downplayed, with greater emphasis on Lord God's compassion. Some major events are glossed over, while others are highlighted in detail.

Chinese: 安洁，你觉得这个展馆的设计如何？
English: What do you think of the exhibit's design, Angie?

Chinese: 完善，全面，得体，是相当成功的设计。
English: Comprehensive, balanced, dignified—it's quite a successful presentation.

Chinese: 好吧，你是这样考虑的啊。
English: I see your point.

Chinese: 侍主大人，我作为神谕司的一员，自然能理解您的不满，主神的功绩是不需要任何形式的加工和粉饰的。
English: Lord Oracle, as a member of the Oracle Division, I fully understand your dissatisfaction. The Lord God's deeds require no embellishment.

Chinese: 但此处毕竟只是面向大众的普通展馆，需要做出一定程度的妥协。
English: But this is, after all, a public-facing exhibit. Some degree of compromise is inevitable.

Chinese: ……妥协吗？
English: Compromise, huh?

Chinese: 我缓缓抬头，望着展馆上方的真理二字，金属的镀层在夕阳下熠熠生辉。
English: I slowly lift my head to look at the word "Truth" etched above the hall. Its metallic surface shimmers in the sunset.

Chinese: 安洁走到我身旁，同样抬起头，沉默了片刻。
English: Angie steps beside me, lifts her gaze, and falls silent for a moment.

Chinese: 侍主大人，您认为“真理”是可以达到的吗？
English: Lord Oracle, do you believe "truth" is something that can truly be attained?

Chinese: 你这问题有点太跳跃了吧……
English: Where's that question coming from?

Chinese: 侍主大人不必考虑的太复杂，就当是对既往行程的回顾好了。
English: No need to overthink it, Lord Oracle. Just see it as a reflection on the journey thus far.

Chinese: 嗯？什么意思？
English: Hmm? What do you mean?

Chinese: 安洁将目光从远方收回，转过身笑盈盈的看着我。
English: Angie withdraws her gaze from the distance, turns, and looks at me with a soft smile.

Chinese: 黄金时代是公认的米伦文明发展巅峰，当时的人们甚至已经将目光放眼星海，这样辉煌的文明成果却在后世迅速衰落，如今已经难复荣光。
English: The Golden Age is seen as the height of Mirren civilization. People then had already set their sights on the Celestial Sea. Yet, that brilliance faded quickly in the generations that followed, and its glory is now all but lost.

Chinese: 在侍主大人看来，什么才应当是文明追求的目的呢？
English: In your view, Lord Oracle, what should be the true goal of a civilization?

Chinese: 存续
English: Continuity.

Chinese: 艺术品有别于自然物品和其他智慧造物，它们的意义就建立在智慧生命的感受上。
English: Unlike natural or utilitarian objects, the meaning of art lies in the perception of sentient beings.

Chinese: 在侍主大人看来，对艺术的评价存在“客观”的角度吗？
English: Lord Oracle, do you believe art can be judged objectively?

Chinese: 存在
English: Yes.

Chinese: 伊卡洛斯小姐对知识背后的原理既不了解也不感兴趣，却还是成了那个时代海洋生物学发展最有力的推动者之一。
English: Miss Icaruth neither understands nor cares about the principles of knowledge, yet she is still one of the greatest forces driving the development of marine biology in her time.

Chinese: 在侍主大人看来，究竟哪个方向更能推动事物的发展呢？
English: Lord Oracle, in your opinion, which approach better advances progress?

Chinese: 形而下
English: The empirical.

Chinese: 捐献馆中陈列着许多家族的光辉过往，虽然他们的家系已经凋零，但他们的故事却也因此被更多人所知，将更广的传唱下去。
English: The Donation Hall preserves the glorious histories of many once-great families. Though they have faded, their stories endure—shared now more widely than ever.

Chinese: 在侍主大人看来，真正的传承，是基于什么的呢？
English: So then, Lord Oracle, what do you believe true legacy is built upon?

Chinese: 现实
English: Reality.

Chinese: 对这些问题的讨论，对体现我对真理的看法没有帮助。
English: Yet none of these questions seem to help clarify my view of truth.

Chinese: 安洁似乎对我的回应并不意外，安静的等待我继续陈述观点。
English: Angie doesn't seem surprised by my response. She waits quietly for me to go on.

Chinese: 在我看来，真理是个超脱的概念，不存在于现实之中。
English: In my eyes, truth is a transcendent concept—it doesn't exist within reality.

Chinese: 人们在现实中追寻的真理不过是受限的真理，是妥协的真理，谈论它是否可以达到意义不大。
English: What people pursue in this world under the name of "truth" is always limited, always compromised. Debating whether it can be attained is meaningless.

Chinese: 就像是捧起水面易碎的倒影，并不意味着得到了月亮。
English: It's like trying to hold the moon by cupping its fragile reflection on the water.

Chinese: 那您是否有想过，脱离大地，去手握真正的月亮呢？
English: Then have you ever thought of leaving this land behind... to hold the real moon in your hands?

Chinese: ……或许吧。
English: Fair enough.

Chinese: 希望您终将如愿。
English: May your wish one day be fulfilled.

Chinese: 言以至此，我们默契的中止了话题，相伴步入了夜色。
English: We let the conversation end, walking together into the deepening night.

Chinese: 没想到今天还真不虚此行了。
English: I hadn't expected today's visit to be quite so rewarding.

Chinese: 其实我对真理的看法其实也就是讨论的事差不多，并不纯粹。
English: My thoughts on truth, in the end, are not far from what we discussed—it is neither pure nor absolute.

Chinese: 在我看来，真理是无法达到的，盲目追寻真理也没有什么意义。
English: To me, truth lies forever just out of reach. Chasing it blindly serves little purpose.

Chinese: 但我仍然认为追寻真理的过程本身却拥有意义，它赋予了人格的高贵。
English: And yet, I still believe the pursuit itself holds meaning—it lends dignity to one's character.

Chinese: 旧日的世界，以及如今的神国，都可以被看做追寻真理过程的副产物。
English: The old world and the present Divine Kingdom—perhaps both are merely byproducts of that very pursuit.

Chinese: ……您的观点倒是让我我耳目一新。
English: That's a perspective I hadn't considered.

Chinese: 在您看来，如今的神国比起旧日的世界是否是更接近真理呢？
English: Then tell me, in your eyes, does the Divine Kingdom come closer to truth than the old world?

Chinese: ……正是如此，我们离真理已经很近了。
English: It does. I believe we are already near to truth.

Chinese: 今日的旅途迎来尾声，我和安洁立在展馆门口的长阶上，远望着仍未落下的夕阳。
English: As our journey draws to a close, Angie and I stand atop the long steps outside the exhibition hall, gazing into the sun that lingers in the sky.

Chinese: 那温暖的余晖似乎永远不会变化。
English: That warm afterglow feels as if it will last forever.

Chinese: 十分有效的回顾，这几个展馆各具特色，我们提交的修缮建议一定会非常全面且富有建设性。
English: A productive visit. Every hall has its own unique charm—our renovation proposal will certainly be comprehensive and insightful.

Chinese: 那，天色也不早了，我们再交换一下关于修缮细节方面的意见——
English: It's getting late. Let's go over the renovation details again—

Chinese: 等一下，侍主大人，您对今天的行程表示满意让我很高兴，但——
English: Just a moment, Lord Oracle. I'm really glad you enjoyed today's visit, but—

Chinese: 您是不是有意跳过了刚刚的那个话题？
English: Are you intentionally avoiding that last question?

Chinese: 好吧，我以为可以就这样糊弄过去呢。
English: I have hoped I can get away with that.

Chinese: 说实话，我并不是十分在意那些无法得出确切结论的问题。
English: To be honest, I don't particularly concern myself with questions that have no definitive answers.

Chinese: 在我看来那些看似意义重大的论调都太过虚无缥缈，不切实际。
English: In my view, those grand-sounding arguments often feel too vague—too detached from reality.

Chinese: 与其耗费精力去思考所谓的“真理”能否达成，不如行动起来，从能去改变的地方入手。
English: Rather than wasting energy pondering whether so-called "truth" can be attained, I prefer to act—starting with what can be changed.

Chinese: 就比如我会向圣城博物院提交真理展馆的具体整改建议。
English: For instance, I intend to submit concrete renovation suggestions for the Hall of Truth at the Sacred City Museum:

Chinese: 提高“风暴之殇”和“卡里安希兰大火”等重要历史事件的叙述比例，并通协调卡尔佩恩家族和亚尔夫群岛提供相关的文献或实物来充实展馆。
English: increasing the coverage of key historical events like "The Storm of Sorrow" and "The Fire of Karianthillae", and working with the Calpines family and the Yarve Archipelago to provide relevant documents or artifacts to enrich the exhibition.

Chinese: 修缮完成后，我会去请圣城的民众们，历史学家们，魔女们来真理展馆参观。
English: Once renovations are complete, I'll invite the citizens of the Sacred City, historians, and Novas to come visit the new Hall of Truth.

Chinese: 如果在庆祝新馆开展的晚宴上，我仍然在意这个问题，我想那时我会很乐意再跟你来讨论所谓的真理能否达成的。
English: And if, at the banquet celebrating its reopening, I still find myself wondering whether 'truth' can ever truly be attained... then I would be more than glad to continue the discussion with you once more.

Chinese: 受教了，您的这番言论令我我由衷的感到震撼和欣喜，不愧是您，侍主大人。
English: I'm truly enlightened. Your words have left me both awed and delighted. Thank you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 那么就如您所愿，趁天色未晚，我们尽快交流一下关于修缮细节方面的建议吧。
English: Well then, while there's still daylight, let's go over our renovation plan in detail.

Chinese: 我和安洁坐在石阶上，在谈笑中结束了这充实美好的一天。
English: Angie and I sat on the steps, ending a perfect day with laughter and conversation.

English: Greetings, Sir. Like Angie, I also serve at the Sanctuary of Truth. I am currently the head of the Oracle Division, primarily responsible for summoning Asters and overseeing sacrificial rites.

English: Please forgive my earlier discourtesy—I hope your impression of me won't affect your judgment of the museum.

Chinese: 爵士阁下，您多虑了，您率真的心性和专业的学术水平令值得尊敬。
English: You need not worry, Sir. Your candid nature and scholarly professionalism are both admirable.

Chinese: 但授权安洁出任学术顾问一事恐怕我不能答应。
English: However, I'm afraid I cannot approve Angie's appointment as academic advisor.

Chinese: 安洁是个非常认真的人，以我对她的了解，即便是所谓的虚职，她也会尝试做到最好，并为此投入大量时间和精力。
English: She is a deeply earnest person. From what I know, even if the position is merely symbolic, she would still dedicate most of her time and energy to doing her very best.

Chinese: 于公于私，我都不希望安洁本就不多的私人时间被消耗殆尽。
English: Both professionally and personally, I would prefer that the little personal time she has remaining not be completely consumed.

Chinese: 另外，安洁虽然有些智慧，但她毕竟不是专业的学者，您向她寻求的不应该是对研究的深度介入，而是偶然乍现的灵感。
English: Moreover, although Angie is insightful, she is not a professional scholar. What you should seek from her is not deep research involvement, but occasional flashes of inspiration.

Chinese: 如果爵士阁下依然想与安洁进行学术交流，可以向神谕司寄送私人信件，届时我们会妥善回应。
English: If you still wish to engage in academic dialogue with her, you are welcome to send a private letter to the Oracle Division. We will ensure it receives proper attention.

Chinese: 您正有如神谕本身，所思所想果然非我等所能企及。
English: You truly speak like an oracle, and your thoughts are clearly beyond our grasp.

Chinese: 很高兴今天能与二位大人相遇，令我获益匪浅，近些年冥思不得的难题也因此有了突破的契机。
English: It has been a true privilege to meet both of you today. I have gained invaluable insight, and the problem that has long confounded me now seems to have a clear path forward.

Chinese: 我准备现在就去验证它们，就在此拜别了。
English: I plan to begin testing them immediately. With that, I shall take my leave.

Chinese: 唐纳德爵士迈着沉稳的步伐离开了，与之前昂首阔步的姿态有很大不同。
English: Sir Donald departs with steady steps—quite a contrast to his earlier, head-held-high strut.

Chinese: 您总能带给我新的惊喜，您刚刚的回应无可挑剔，着实精彩。
English: You never fail to surprise me. Your reply just now was flawless—truly brilliant.

Chinese: 没什么值得称赞的，真实想法罢了。
English: There's nothing to praise. It was simply my honest opinion.

Chinese: 咳，那个，我们已经在这个展馆停留过久了，要按原计划浏览的话，可得尽快动身了。
English: Ahem, we've lingered in this hall for quite some time. If we're to continue our visit as originally planned, we'll need to set off at once.

Chinese: 我们转向目隐街，那边居民的世袭工种特殊，还可以避开阿塔利家族的宅邸，他们最近与黑神家来往密切——
English: Let's go to Kagehide Street. The locals have unique trades, and we'll avoid the Atali estate—they've been meeting with the Kurokami family lately.

Chinese: 黑神真是一如既往的认真可靠，虽然我期待的反应不是这样的。
English: She's as diligent and dependable as ever. Though... that's not quite the reaction I was hoping for.

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 没什么，我们走吧。
English: Nothing. Let's go.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 黑神的判断是正确的，改变路线后，虽然路上的行人没有减少，但搭话的情况却再没发生过。
English: Indeed, Kurokami's judgment is spot on. After we changed routes, while the number of pedestrians doesn't decrease, no one approaches us again.

Chinese: 我身上的奇异能量也消退了不少，症状发作的频次已经显著降低。
English: The strange energy on me also begins to fade, and the frequency of my symptoms has clearly dropped.

Chinese: 情况稳中向好之际，那个充满意外性的家伙突然出现在我们面前，顿时让我陷入危机。
English: Just as things are starting to stabilize, that unpredictable individual suddenly appears in front of us, throwing me right back into danger.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 啊！大笨，咳！侍主大人还有黑神前辈！
English: Ahhh! Ah, fools! Both of you, Lord Oracle and Kurokami!

Chinese: （大力抛洒甘露）
English: (Generously scatter nectar)

Chinese: 诶？你们在做什么？
English: Huh? What are you two doing?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 下午好，律，如你所见，我和侍主大人正在进行祈福巡游，是种古老而经典的敬神方式。
English: Good afternoon, Ritsu. As you can see, Lord Oracle and I are conducting a prayer parade, an ancient and traditional form of divine worship.

Chinese: 嗯？祈福巡游？
English: Hmm? Prayer parade?

Chinese: 起源于第四纪元初期，是根除原罪后人们对主神表达信仰之意的一种形式。
English: It originated in the early Era of Eternal Flame, a ritual developed after the eradication of original sin to express faith in Lord God.

Chinese: 啊——！嗯，对！祈愿巡游嘛，我知道的，身为神谕司的一员这种事情我还是了解的！刚刚只是一时没想起来而已。
English: Ah—! Right! A prayer parade! Of course I know that! As a member of the Oracle Division, I'm totally familiar with such things! I just... suddenly forgot.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: （怎么回事！这笨蛋是在故意引人指出她的错误吗？！）
English: (What's going on?! Is this idiot deliberately baiting others to point out her mistake?)

Chinese: （冥想——控制——收束思绪！）
English: (Meditate—control—rein in your thoughts!)

Chinese: 侍主大人这是怎么了？从刚刚开始脸色就怪怪的，也不说话……
English: What's wrong with Lord Oracle? He's looked a bit off since earlier, and hasn't said a word...

Chinese: 侍主大人他……
English: Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 他推崇原意教旨，力求还原祈福巡游的本来面貌，在巡游完成前都不能开口的。
English: He advocates the Originalist Doctrine, striving to recreate the prayer parade in its purest form. He won't speak until the parade is complete.

Chinese: （精彩的解释！黑神！）
English: (Brilliant explanation, Kurokami!)

Chinese: 是这样的吗？总觉得有哪里不太对……
English: Is that so? Somehow it still feels a little off...

Chinese: 没什么不对，侍主大人他身为神谕司之主对主神相关事宜有独特要求是十分合理的。
English: There's nothing off. It's entirely reasonable for the Lord of the Oracle Division to uphold unique standards in matters concerning Lord God.

Chinese: 说起来，律你今天不是去执行外勤任务了吗？怎么会来目隐街？
English: By the way, Ritsu, weren't you out on a field mission today? What brings you to Kagehide Street?

Chinese: 那个，跟踪途中暴露了，没办法只能战斗，最后没能找到她们的据点，所以……
English: Well... I was tailing someone, but got discovered. I had to fight, and in the end... I couldn't locate their hideout. So...

Chinese: 安全回来就好，我记得你这次任务的目标是一个影巫女，异端的邪术诡异难防，偶有失手也可以理解。
English: It's good that you're back safe. I remember the target of your mission was a Shadow Witch. Heretical sorcery is strange and hard to counter, so an occasional stumble is understandable.

Chinese: 是，是啊，况且跟踪什么的不是我擅长的领域。
English: Y-Yes, exactly. Besides, tracking isn't really my area of expertise.

Chinese: 黑神前辈你今天好温柔啊，希望过会审判长大人也能像这样理解我的难处。
English: Kurokami, you're so gentle today. I hope Lord Inquisitor will be just as understanding of my struggles.

Chinese: 律，你还没回圣殿复命吗？
English: Ritsu, haven't you returned to the Sanctuary to report back yet?

Chinese: 目隐街这边有珍稀食材的限时售卖，所以……
English: There's a limited-time sale of rare ingredients in Kagehide Street, so...

Chinese: 律羞愧的低下头，同时却又献宝似的晃了晃提袋里的黑松露。
English: Ritsu lowers her head in shame, yet at the same time proudly shakes the bag in her hand, revealing the black truffles inside.

Chinese: 律的连番耍宝终于将症状发作的我逼到了极限。
English: Her repeated antics finally pushes me, in the midst of my symptoms, to the brink.
(Twang—)

Chinese: ΦΥΘΞΞΨ！
English: ΦΥΘΞΞΨ!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 不幸中的万幸，我凭借残存的最后一丝理智将脱口而出的心声转换成了古老的艾雅语。
English: By sheer luck, I manage to convert the words that almost burst from my lips into ancient Aiyan language.

Chinese: 但从律的神情来看，这不过是无用的挣扎罢了，我的异常已经暴露无疑。
English: But judging from Ritsu's expression, it is a futile effort—my abnormal state has been completely exposed.
Sigh...

Chinese: [var=Actor]，你怎么了？究竟发生了什么？
English: [var=Actor], what's the matter? What exactly happened?

Chinese: 没什么，律，这也是祈福巡游中的一个环节，传说七圣星痕中的——
English: It's nothing, Ritsu. This is just part of the prayer parade. The Sacred Seven Asters—

Chinese: 不，不是这样的，黑神前辈，我承认我的确不清楚祈福巡游的事，但我看的出来[var=Actor]的状态很不对劲。
English: No, that's not it, Kurokami. I admit I don't fully understand the prayer parade, but I can tell that [var=Actor] is not acting normal.

Chinese: 圣城中应该没有任何事物能影响到他才对，一定是发生了什么不得了的大事。
English: There shouldn't be anything in the Sacred City that could affect him like this. Something serious must have happened.

Chinese: 身为起居官，我现在应该履行自己的职责，请告诉我，究竟发生了什么？
English: As his chamberlain, I must fulfill my duty. Please tell me what exactly is going on?

Chinese: 律担忧的看着我，她想尽自己的全力帮助我，动用她能动用的任何手段。
English: Ritsu looks at me with concern, willing to do everything in her power to help me.

Chinese: 我感受到了律的觉悟，于情于理，我都应该和盘托出。
English: I feel her determination, and both morally and emotionally, I should be completely honest with her.

Chinese: 但，这毕竟不是什么正经的大事，而且藏不住心事的律过会还要和牧见面，所以——
English: But this isn't exactly a serious matter, and since Ritsu, who can't keep a secret, is going to meet Muu later—

Chinese: （只是微笑）
English: (Just smile)

Chinese: 冥想，控制，收束思绪。
English: Meditate, control, rein in your thoughts.

Chinese: 我沉默，同时向律露出了应该很难看的笑容。
English: I stayed silent, giving Ritsu a smile that was probably not very pleasant to see.

Chinese: 我相信万能的黑神一定有办法突破眼前的绝境。
English: I trust that the all-capable Kurokami will find a way to break through this predicament.

Chinese: 律，侍主大人现在的确遇到了困境，需要帮助。
English: Ritsu, Lord Oracle is indeed facing a difficult situation right now and needs help.

Chinese: 但透露困境本身就会影响问题的解决，你能明白这意味着什么吗？
English: But revealing the details of the predicament itself could hinder the solution. Do you understand what that means?

Chinese: 我不明白，这不合理。
English: I don't understand. This doesn't make sense.

Chinese: 不明白也不要紧，但有件事希望你能相信。
English: It's okay if you don't understand, but there is one thing I hope you will believe.

Chinese: 什么？
English: What?

Chinese: 我，黑神月咏，承诺会尽全力帮助[var=Actor]摆脱眼下的困境，不让他受到任何形式的伤害。
English: I, Kurokami Tsukuyo, will do everything in my power to help [var=Actor] overcome his current difficulties and protect him from any harm.

Chinese: 律，你愿意在这件事上相信我吗？
English: Ritsu, will you trust me on this?

Chinese: 嗯，我相信黑神前辈！
English: Yes, I trust you, Kurokami!

Chinese: 遏制住高声喝彩的冲动，我以不停鼓掌的形式排解不受控制的高涨情绪。
English: Suppressing my urge to cheer loudly, I express my uncontrolled excitement through continuous applause.

Chinese: 哼，看来你也没什么大事，我得赶回圣殿向审判长大人复命去了。
English: Hmph, looks like you're not in any real trouble after all. I have to rush back to the Sanctuary and report to Lord Inquisitor.

Chinese: 掌声骤停，这冒失的精灵万一顺口说漏嘴，那我岂不是——
English: The applause abruptly stops. If this reckless elf accidentally blurts something out, wouldn't that mean—

Chinese: 你这是什么表情啊！黑神前辈话都说到这份上了，我还会不格外注意吗？也多信任我一些啊！
English: What kind of look is that?! After everything Kurokami said, of course I will be extra cautious! Show me a little more trust, will you?

Chinese: （赞赏的手势）
English: (Make a gesture of approval)

Chinese: 事情解决了就快回来，这黑松露可要趁着新鲜才好吃，黑神前辈也要来哦！
English: Come back as soon as you're done. Black truffles are best when fresh! Kurokami, please come as well!

Chinese: 嗯，我很期待律的手艺。
English: Mm, I'm really looking forward to your cooking.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 律一边挥手，一边迈着欢快的步伐远去了。
English: Ritsu waves as she skips away with cheerful steps.

Chinese: 呼，好险。
English: Phew, that was close.

Chinese: 能让那种状态下的律放下顾虑，恐怕也就只有黑神了。
English: If anyone could ease Ritsu's worries in a state like that, it'd have to be Kurokami.

Chinese: 要知道她在某些事上可是相当执拗的。
English: You know how stubborn she can be about certain things.

Chinese: 我懂，尤其是那些关于你的事。
English: I know—especially when it comes to you.

Chinese: 有这样一位重视你的人在身边陪伴，是非常幸福的事。
English: To have someone who cares about you that much by your side... that's a blessing.

Chinese: 咳，那个黑神，我们加快步伐吧，再遇到几个熟人恐怕就没那么幸运了。
English: Ahem... Kurokami, let's pick up the pace. If we run into a few more familiar faces, we might not be so lucky next time.

Chinese: 好，这边走。
English: Alright. This way.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 夜长梦多，我们加快了行进的速度，奇异能量的消耗速度也随之提升。
English: We quicken our pace, but the strange energy consumption rises as well.

Chinese: 但这也给我的精神和体力带来双重的重担。
English: This puts a strain on both my mind and body.

Chinese: 半小时后，我们行至圣紫音湖畔，心力交瘁的我只得停下来稍作休息。
English: Half an hour later, we arrive at the banks of Lake Seraphise. Completely drained, I have no choice but to stop and rest for a while.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 别直接喝下去，先含一会，效力会发挥的更快。
English: Don't drink it all at once. Hold it in your mouth for a bit. It'll take effect faster that way.

Chinese: （接过水壶）
English: (Take the canteen)

Chinese: 谢谢黑神，没想到你还准备了恢复补剂。
English: Thank you, Kurokami. I didn't expect you to bring a recovery tonic as well.

Chinese: 唔？味道很新奇，好像跟神赦司出产的制式补剂不太一样？
English: Huh? The taste is quite unique. It seems different from the standard tonics made by the Absolving Theocracy.

Chinese: 嗯，这是我自用的，配方做了些许改良。
English: Yes, this one's for my personal use. I've made a few modifications to the formula.

Chinese: 我喜欢这个味道。
English: I like this flavor.

Chinese: 黑神温婉一笑。
English: Kurokami gives a gentle smile.

Chinese: 湖畔的微风拂过她的发丝，带来的暗香使我紧绷的心境放松了下来。
English: The lakeside breeze sweeps through her hair, carrying a subtle fragrance that eases the tension in my heart.

Chinese: 忽然觉得，这仪式副作用带来的也不全是坏事。
English: I suddenly realize that the side effects of the ritual may not be entirely bad.

Chinese: 有时候，能将内心想法如实表达出来，是很畅快的。
English: Sometimes, being able to speak your mind honestly is surprisingly liberating.

Chinese: 侍主大人……
English: Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 咳，黑神前辈不要在意，就当是我症状发作的胡言乱语吧。
English: Ahem... Please don't mind me, Kurokami. The side effects made me speak nonsense.

Chinese: 不，侍主大人，这值得在意。
English: No, Lord Oracle. This is worth minding.

Chinese: 我们共同经历了这件事，你今后可以选择在我面前放下顾虑，说任何你想说的话，表达你任何想表达的观点。
English: We went through this together. From now on, you can set aside your reservations in front of me—say whatever you want to say.

Chinese: 谢谢你，黑神，我也希望自己能够如此，但平常状态下的我可能做不到这种事。
English: Thank you, Kurokami. I hope I can, but... when I'm in my normal state, I might not be able to do that.

Chinese: 那就趁这个难得的闲暇多聊聊吧，我希望能更多的了解侍主大人。
English: Then let's make the most of this rare moment of calm. I'd love to learn more about you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 我稍加思索，顺便又喝了一口补剂。
English: I give it some thought... and take another sip of the tonic.

Chinese: 我不习惯引导话题，黑神想聊些什么呢？
English: I'm not used to leading conversations. What would you like to talk about, Kurokami?

Chinese: 的确是个难题呢，想谈的东西太多，一时也不知该从何开始。
English: That's a tough question. There's so much I'd like to discuss that I don't even know where to begin.

Chinese: 如果说第一反应的话——
English: If I had to go with my first instinct—

Chinese: 黑神？
English: Kurokami?

Chinese: 咳，侍主大人，我有个问题——
English: Ahem, Lord Oracle, may I ask you something—

Chinese: 喔！总算找到你们了，魔女大人！
English: Oh! Oh! There you are at last, Miss Nova!

Chinese: 不认识的声音从身后传来，中断了我们的对话。
English: A voice unfamiliar to us calls out from behind, abruptly interrupting our conversation.

Chinese: 向你们问好，魔女大人，还有这位尊敬的先生。
English: Greetings to you, Miss Nova, and to this esteemed gentleman as well.

Chinese: 我们是附近的居民，听闻有魔女大人在举行古老的祈福巡游。
English: We are local residents, and we heard that a Nova is conducting an ancient prayer parade.

Chinese: 这种古典而传统的敬神行为深深的打动了我们，希望二位能准许我们共同参与。
English: Such a traditional and devout ceremony moved us deeply. We humbly ask to join in the parade.

Chinese: 不需要二位额外做什么，我们跟随在后就好，恳请二位答应我们的请求。
English: You needn't do anything special. We'll simply follow along behind. Please, grant us this small request.

Chinese: 看着眼前这几位真诚的居民，我和黑神前辈交换了一下眼神，做出了回应。
English: Gazing at the sincere faces before us, Kurokami and I exchange a glance before responding.

Chinese: 很乐意答应各位，与你们这样虔诚的信众同行也是我们的荣幸。
English: We'd be delighted. Walking alongside such devout believers is an honor for us as well.

Chinese: 喔！赞美您的善意，尊敬的魔女大人！
English: Oh! Thank you for your kindness, revered Miss Nova!

Chinese: 我们起身，周围的群众们也拿出了自备的甘露，“祈福巡游”再次开始。
English: As we stand, the surrounding townsfolk bring out the nectar they have prepared, and the "prayer parade" resumes once more.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我再次直观的感受到了群体的力量。
English: Once again, I feel the power of the collective—so vividly, so tangibly.

Chinese: 但怎么也无法想到会是以这种形式。
English: But never did I imagine it would take this form.

Chinese: 半小时后，巡游的队伍扩大到了近百人的程度。
English: Half an hour later, the parade has grown to nearly a hundred people.

Chinese: 许多人在观望后就自行加入了其中。
English: Many join voluntarily after merely watching for a while.

Chinese: 看着事态一步步发展，却没有任何能扭转局势的办法，只得顺应它走下去。
English: I can only watch as things unfold step by step, powerless to change the course.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 最终，我们抵达了“巡游”的终点，聚集在此的民众已经多达数百人。
English: Eventually, we reach the endpoint of the "parade." By then, the gathered crowd has swelled to several hundred.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 更令我感到绝望的是，似乎有不少圣殿方面的熟面孔也混在其中。
English: What fills me with deeper despair is that... I spot several familiar faces from the Sanctuary among the crowd.

Chinese: （抛洒最后一次甘露）
English: (Scatter the nectar for the last time)

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 众人也随之一同抛洒甘露，眼前的场面给了我一种莫名的抽离感。
English: Everyone else follows suit, scattering their own nectar. The scene before me gives rise to a strange sense of detachment.

Chinese: 时间慢了下来，我努力的思考如何收场。
English: Time seems to slow, and I rack my mind for a way to bring this to a close.

Chinese: 空灵的圣歌传来，我随着人群的目光转身——
English: Then comes the ethereal sound of a sacred hymn. I turn, following the gaze of the crowd—

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 黑神月咏在轻声颂唱。
English: Kurokami Tsukuyo is softly chanting.

Chinese: 人群也受到感召，渐渐附和起来。
English: The crowd, inspired, gradually joins in.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 歌毕，似乎万物都安静了下来，耳边只剩下细微的风声。
English: When the song ends, it is as if all things have fallen silent. Only the faint rustle of the wind remains.

Chinese: 黑神看着我，等待我的回应。
English: Kurokami looks at me, waiting for my response.

Chinese: 我犹豫了片刻，异样的感觉萦绕心头无法忽视。
English: I hesitate for a moment, an unusual sensation lingering in my heart that I can not ignore.

Chinese: 依照莉莉娅的记载，这种难以言明的事物被称作信仰之力。
English: According to Lillia's writings, this indescribable feeling is known as the Power of Faith.

Chinese: 原本即将彻底消散的奇异能量受到刺激，当即活跃了起来。
English: The strange energy, once on the verge of fading away, is suddenly stirred and began to surge once more.

Chinese: （你是万有的主宰。）
English: (You are the Lord of all things.)

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我步向人群，庄严的诵出祷词。
English: I step toward the crowd and solemnly recite the prayer:

Chinese: 你是万有的主宰。
English: You are the Lord of all things.

Chinese: 诸天诉说你的功绩。
English: The heavens proclaim your glory.

Chinese: 诸天诉说你的功绩。
English: The heavens proclaim your glory.

Chinese: 你拨开永夜的黎明。
English: You part the eternal night with dawn.

Chinese: 你拨开永夜的黎明。
English: You part the eternal night with dawn.

Chinese: 你容纳万恶的源头。
English: You embrace the source of all wickedness.

Chinese: 你容纳万恶的源头。
English: You embrace the source of all wickedness.

Chinese: 天地都敬畏你圣名，你是我们永远的神。
English: Heaven and earth revere your holy name—You are our everlasting God.

Chinese: 天地都敬畏你圣名，你是我们永远的神。
English: Heaven and earth revere your holy name—You are our everlasting God.

Chinese: 天之扉，诚所愿。
English: May the Gate of Heaven open as we desire.

Chinese: 天之扉，诚所愿。
English: May the Gate of Heaven open as we desire.

Chinese: 礼毕，安宁祥和的氛围降临，人群缓缓散去。
English: With the rite complete, a serene atmosphere descends, and the crowd gradually dispers.

Chinese: 一场意外最终化为了一次正式的敬神活动。
English: What began as an unexpected incident has ended as a formal act of devotion.

Chinese: 呼，举行异邦仪式前的我，无论如何都想不到会以这样的方式收场。
English: Phew... Before the foreign rite was held, I could never have imagined things would end this way.

Chinese: 侍主大人，真是精彩的应对。
English: Lord Oracle, you handled the situation brilliantly.

Chinese: 黑神说笑了，若不是黑神及时颂唱圣歌，恐怕我这神谕司之主就要失职了。
English: You're too kind, Kurokami. If not for your timely hymn, I fear I would have failed in my duties as the Lord of the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 侍主大人的状态似乎已经完全恢复了？
English: You seem to have made a full recovery, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 嗯，今天多亏有黑神在。
English: Yes. I owe that entirely to you, Kurokami.

Chinese: 侍主大人，你有在刻意控制语气吗？
English: Lord Oracle, are you deliberately adjusting your tone?

Chinese: 刚恢复，还需要些许时间调整。

Chinese: 呀！

Chinese: 小心！
