English: Nova A

Chinese: 魔女B
English: Nova B

Chinese: 黑神月咏
English: Kurokami Tsukuyo

Chinese: 旁白
English: Voiceover

Chinese: 尤娜
English: Yuna

Chinese: 侍主
English: Lord Oracle

Chinese: 背后的努力
English: Efforts Behind the Scenes

Chinese: 即便是在假期，黑神月咏也依旧在繁忙地处理公务。一个突如其来的任务让我发觉了黑神月咏作为最为强大的魔女，她强大的理由。
English: Even during her vacation, Kurokami Tsukuyo is still busy handling official affairs. But a sudden mission makes me realize why she's known as the most powerful Nova.

Chinese: 等、等一下！慢一点！前面有人！
English: W-Wait! Slow down! There's someone up ahead!

Chinese: 唔啊！
English: Urgh!

Chinese: ……好痛。今天想着黑神难得有假期，早上过来约她出去散散心，却被人迎面撞上。
English: Ouch. I came by this morning hoping to invite Kurokami out for a relaxing walk on one of her rare days off, but someone runs straight into me.

Chinese: 侍主大人？！
English: Lord Oracle?!

Chinese: 对、对不起！您没事吧？
English: We're sorry! Are you alright?

Chinese: 不，我没关系。倒是你们，怎么回事？
English: I'm fine. But what about you two? What's going on?

Chinese: 圣殿出了什么事情吗
English: Did something happen at the Sanctuary?

Chinese: 这个，其实也没什么事，只是在逃离……
English: Well, actually, it's not a big deal... We were just, uh, fleeing—

Chinese: 没什么啦！侍主大人不用担心，我们没在逃！绝对没有！
English: N-No! Nothing like that! You don't need to worry, Lord Oracle! We definitely weren't fleeing! Absolutely not!

Chinese: 我们可是魔女，什么东西能让我们逃跑呢，根本不存在，哈哈哈……
English: We're Novas. What could possibly make us flee? Nothing, hahahaha...

Chinese: 你们这幅样子绝对是在逃跑吧……
English: You two totally look like you're fleeing...

Chinese: （但是话又说回来，真理圣殿是整个神国的核心区域，什么东西能够潜入真理圣殿中，却不被守卫们发现？）
English: (The Sanctuary of Truth is the very heart of the Divine Kingdom. What could possibly infiltrate it without being noticed by the guards?)

Chinese: 我立刻意识到这里面隐藏着巨大危险。身为神谕司司长，我可不能坐视不管！
English: I immediately realize there is a serious threat involved. As the head of the Oracle Division, I couldn't just stand by and do nothing!

Chinese: （不过，这两名魔女极力否认，她们大概是不想让我担心，而决定自己扛下对抗威胁的责任。）
English: (These two Novas are clearly trying to hide the truth. They probably don't want me to worry and have chosen to shoulder the danger themselves.)

Chinese: （她们应该是新晋的魔女。年级轻轻就如此有担当，该说不愧是黑神月咏月咏的后辈。）
English: (They must have been appointed as Novas recently. So young, yet already bearing such responsibility... Just what you'd expect from Kurokami Tsukuyo's followers.)

Chinese: 告诉魔女们自己站在她们一边
English: Tell the Novas that you're on their side

Chinese: 放心吧，无论发生什么事，我都会站在你们一边。毕竟和你们一同战斗，正是我作为神谕司司长的职责。
English: Don't worry. No matter what happens, I'll stand with you. After all, fighting alongside you is part of my duty as the head of the Oracle Division.

Chinese: （一同战斗？侍主是说会照顾我们的想法吗？）
English: (Fight alongside us? Is Lord Oracle saying he'll respect our thoughts and decisions?)

Chinese: （唔，如果是侍主的话，没准可以阻止……）
English: (Hmm... if Lord Oracle helps, maybe we really can stop it...)

Chinese: 嗯？你在小声说什么呢？
English: Hmm? What are you whispering about?

Chinese: 唔，就是，那个，我们面临了很麻烦的状况……
English: Uh, well... it's just that... we're dealing with a really troublesome situation...

Chinese: 魔女支支吾吾，看起来潜进圣殿的危险生物对她们来说相当陌生，以至于描述起来都很吃力。
English: The Novas hesitate. It seems the creature that has infiltrated the Sanctuary is so unfamiliar to them that they struggle to describe it clearly.

Chinese: （让她先冷静下来，然后引导一下她吧。）
English: (I should calm her down first, then guide her along.)

Chinese: 冷静下来
English: Calm her down

Chinese: 不要慌张，你们可是力量强大的魔女。先想一想，在你们眼中，追着你们的，是什么样的存在？
English: Don't panic. You're powerful Novas. Take a moment and think: in your eyes, what kind of being was chasing you?

Chinese: （存在？是说她在我们眼中是什么样的人吗？）
English: (A being? Does he mean how we see her?)

Chinese: 这个，在我们看来，她的热情像太阳一般，光芒四射，平等地照耀每一个人。
English: Well... to us, her passion is like the sun—radiant and dazzling, shining equally on everyone.

Chinese: 但是有时候这种光又会灼烧人……
English: But sometimes, that light can also burn...

Chinese: （难道说入侵生物可以释放高光高热？）
English: (The intruder emits intense heat and light?)

Chinese: 但是如果犯下错误，她就会像冬日的寒风一样冷酷。
English: And when someone makes a mistake, she can be as cold as a winter wind.

Chinese: 我现在就感觉到冷了……
English: I feel cold just thinking about it now...

Chinese: （犯下错误？是指如果应对不当，入侵生物就会释放冰冻魔法吗？）
English: (Did they say "made a mistake"? Do they mean that if we handle it poorly, the intruder will unleash freezing magic?)

Chinese: 有时候像春日的煦风一般温柔……
English: Sometimes, she's as gentle as a spring breeze...

Chinese: 却又像山峰一样让人只能仰望，不敢靠近……
English: But sometimes, she's like a mountain—one can only look up in awe, not dare to approach.

Chinese: 像太阳一样发出光和热，却又能施放冰冻魔法。
English: She radiates light and warmth like the sun, yet can cast freezing spells.

Chinese: 像春风一样具有灵活的身形，皮肤却又像磐石一样坚韧。
English: Her body is as agile as the spring wind, yet her skin is as tough as stone.

Chinese: （只有一种生物拥有以上所有特征——我曾经在书上读到过的一种元素生物。)
English: (Only one creature matches all these traits—an elemental being I once read about in a book.)

Chinese: 所谓元素生物，便是纯粹由魔法元素构成的生物。
English: Elemental beings are creatures made purely from magical elements.

Chinese: 尽管元素生物往往在诞生时由单一元素形成，但在长时间聚集后，它们也会互相影响，形成多种元素构成的新生物。
English: While they are typically formed from a single element at birth, over time, as elements gather and interact, they can evolve into beings composed of multiple elements.

Chinese: （莫洛石魔。一定是它，火、水与土元素形成的怪物。这么危险的怪物竟然进入了圣殿？！）
English: (The Moro Stone Maiden. It must be that—a monster born from fire, water, and earth elements. Such a dangerous monster has entered the Sanctuary?!)

Chinese: 她……她过来了……
English: She... she's coming this way...

Chinese: 怎、怎么办！
English: W-What do we do?!

Chinese: 被抓住就完蛋了！果然还是只能跑啊！
English: If we get caught, we're done! We've got no choice but to run!

Chinese: 等等，你们别慌！
English: Wait, don't panic!

Chinese: 我下定决心，如果莫洛石魔真的出现在我面前，一定要用我的力量阻止它。
English: I make up my mind—if the Moro Stone Maiden really appears before me, I'll use my strength to stop her.

Chinese: 做好战斗准备
English: Prepare for battle

Chinese: 于是我紧张地把视线两名魔女看过去的方向，然后看见一个人影飞速扑过来——
English: Nervously, I follow the gaze of the two Novas and see a figure rushing toward us.

Chinese: 等等，你们先停下来！
English: Wait! You two, stop right there!

Chinese: 啊！侍主大人！您怎么在这里？
English: Ahhh! Lord Oracle! What are you doing here?

Chinese: 等等，黑神！你看见附近有莫洛石魔吗？很危险的！
English: Wait, Kurokami! Have you seen the Moro Stone Maiden nearby? It's dangerous!

Chinese: 莫洛石魔？圣殿里怎么会出现这种东西？
English: Moro Stone Maiden? Why would something like that show up inside the Sanctuary?

Chinese: 说起来，侍主大人，您在附近有见到两名魔女吗？
English: By the way, Lord Oracle, have you seen two Novas around here?

Chinese: 她们应该刚刚跑过这里。
English: They should've just passed by.

Chinese: 唉，她们训练表现不好，才把她们留下。看她们训练的也累了，本来想要晚上请她们吃一顿饭，但没等我接近她们就一溜烟跑掉了……
English: Sigh... They weren't doing well in training, so I kept them behind. They looked exhausted, so I was planning to treat them to a nice dinner tonight. But before I could approach them, they took off like a flash...

Chinese: （……等等。按照黑神的说法，那两名魔女口中的元素生物……）
English: (Wait a second. Based on what Kurokami just said, the elemental creature those two Novas mentioned...)

Chinese: （不对，什么元素生物。她们恐怕在说的是黑神。）
English: (No, that wasn't some elemental creature. They were probably talking about Kurokami.)

Chinese: 顺着黑神月咏的话，然后扯开话题
English: Following Kurokami Tsukuyo's words, I steered the conversation elsewhere.

Chinese: 跑步的魔女吗？我确实见到了她们，大概往那个方向去了。
English: Two running Novas? Yes, I saw them. I think they went that way.

Chinese: 不过你今天不是应该休假吗？为什么还会在圣殿里训练？
English: But... aren't you supposed to be off duty today? Why are you still training in the Sanctuary?

Chinese: 我露出一个尴尬地笑容，赶紧转移了话题。刚刚在想的事情可不能告诉她。
English: I give an awkward smile and quickly change the subject. I can't let her know what I was just thinking about.

Chinese: 是神赦司突然下发的任务。
English: It was a sudden mission issued by the Absolving Theocracy.

Chinese: 最近在城市的郊外发现了一大批正在聚集的元素生物，如果放着不管的话，它们一定会穿过城市，造成严重破坏。
English: A large number of elemental creatures were recently discovered gathering on the outskirts of the city. If left alone, they'll surely invade and wreak havoc.

Chinese: 所以神赦司紧急安排了魔女，尽早驱离这些元素生物。
English: So the Absolving Theocracy urgently dispatched Novas to drive them away as soon as possible.

Chinese: 接过月咏的话
English: Continue with Tsukuyo's topic

Chinese: 但是元素生物很稀有，恐怕大多数魔女根本没有见识过。
English: But elemental creatures are extremely rare, and most Novas have probably never even seen one.

Chinese: 所以我决定放弃休假，帮忙对新晋魔女们进行驱逐元素生物的训练。
English: That's why I gave up my break to help train the newly appointed Novas in elemental expulsion.

Chinese: ……不过，这么短的时间果然还是有些勉强了，大家的训练热情都不怎么高。
English: But with so little time, everything's been rushed, and honestly, morale isn't exactly high.

Chinese: 元素生物的入侵吗。如果处理不当的话，的确会对城市带来很大危险。
English: An elemental creature invasion... If mishandled, it could indeed pose a serious threat to the city.

Chinese: 决定陪同黑神月咏训练
English: Join Kurokami Tsukuyo in training Novas

Chinese: 要不然，我陪你一起去训练吧。我在之前也阅读了一些关于元素生物的著作，应该也帮得上一些忙。
English: How about I join you in training them? I've read some texts on elemental creatures before. Maybe I can be of some help.

Chinese: 侍主大人要陪我一起训练吗？
English: You'll train them with me, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: ……谢谢。您的话，应该能说服那两名魔女归队。
English: Thank you. If you speak to them, I'm sure those two Novas will return to training.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 之后，我找到了那两名魔女，说服她们归队，接着跟月咏一起到了集训场地。
English: After that, I find the two Novas and convince them to return to the team. Then, Tsukuyo and I head to the training grounds together.

Chinese: 黑神的训练十分严格，但遇到魔女们训练出了差错，她也会身体力行做出示范，看得出来，她希望每个魔女都能完成训练任务。
English: Kurokami's training sessions are intense, but whenever someone makes a mistake, she will personally step in to demonstrate the correct form. It is clear she genuinely wants every one of them to succeed.

Chinese: 但是正如黑神自己所说，她定下的目标似乎确实比较高，要求每个魔女都能灵活使用魔法的同时，还要与其他人有高度的配合。
English: Still, just as she has said, her standards are undeniably high. She expects each Nova not only to master their own magic but also to coordinate seamlessly with their teammates.

Chinese: （难怪那两名魔女在收到黑神的邀约后会跑掉。恐怕在她们的认识里，黑神更像是名严师，而非同龄人。）
English: (No wonder those two Novas ran off when Kurokami invited them. To them, she must feel more like a strict instructor than a peer.)

Chinese: （突然被老师叫去吃饭，任谁都会紧张吧，尤其是自己在老师面前的表现不怎么样……）
English: (Being invited to dinner by your instructor out of the blue—especially after a poor performance—would make anyone nervous...)

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 哈……哈……果然还是好难啊。
English: Hah... Hah... It's still so tough.

Chinese: 但是这些训练目标，黑神前辈却那么轻易地就完成了。
English: But Kurokami handled everything so effortlessly.

Chinese: 是啊，黑神前辈无论是人品还是能力都无可挑剔，简直是我们可望不可及的存在。
English: Yeah... She's flawless in both skill and character. Someone we can only ever look up to.

Chinese: 毕竟是那个黑神家族的继承人，黑神紫音的后代。我们这种普通人怎么可能比得上。
English: Well, she is the heir of the Kurokami family—descendant of Kurokami Shion. People like us could never be as good as her.

Chinese: 黑神前辈制定训练计划和目标时，不会也是按照黑神家族的标准吧……
English: I bet when she made this training plan, she used the Kurokami family's standards...

Chinese: 肯定是这样没错。大概黑神家族的严格教育对她来说已经是本能了，所以才感觉不到这些目标对我们来说有多难以达到……
English: That's probably it. She was likely raised with such strict expectations that those goals just feel natural to her... She probably doesn't even realize how hard they are for us...

Chinese: 休息时，我听到了不少魔女的窃窃私语。
English: During the break, I overhear the Novas murmuring among themselves.

Chinese: 果不其然，她们虽然崇敬和崇敬着黑神，但却也正因如此，而和她有不少的距离感。
English: As expected, while they all admire Kurokami deeply, that admiration also creates a sense of distance between them.

Chinese: 这时，我看到黑神的表情有些落寞，大概刚才也是听到了这些魔女的对话。
English: Then, I notice a shadow pass over Kurokami's face. She must have heard them too.

Chinese: 大家不用担心，我制定的训练目标是考虑到了大家能力的。
English: Everyone, don't worry. I set these goals based on your actual capabilities.

Chinese: 只要稍微加把劲，就一定可以完成目标。
English: If you push just a little harder, I'm sure each of you can reach them.

Chinese: 咦啊？！黑神前辈！
English: Eh?! Kurokami!

Chinese: 对、对不起！我一定会加倍努力的！
English: We're sorry! I promise I'll work twice as hard!

Chinese: 那个，我之前说的晚饭，如果你们不介意的话，晚上的话……
English: Um, about that dinner I mentioned earlier... If you don't mind, maybe tonight we could...

Chinese: 我们会加油完成目标的！请不要让我们晚上留下！
English: We'll work hard to meet the training goals! Please don't make us stay late tonight!

Chinese: 不，我只是想请你们吃个饭而已……
English: No, no, I just wanted to invite you to dinner...

Chinese: 你们不想去的话，那就算了。好好加油，凭你们的能力，我相信一定能完成训练目标。
English: If you're not interested, then forget it. Just do your best. Given your abilities, I'm sure you can meet the training goals.

Chinese: 看到黑神失落的样子，我的心里也多少有些不好受。
English: Seeing the disappointment on Kurokami's face makes me feel a little down.

Chinese: 去安慰黑神月咏
English: Comfort Kurokami Tsukuyo

Chinese: 于是我走到黑神身旁，想要安慰安慰她。
English: So I walk over to her, wanting to offer some comfort.

Chinese: 黑神还是没有和她们约上饭吗？
English: They still haven't accepted your dinner invitation?

Chinese: 是啊。
English: That's right.

Chinese: 每次我想邀请她们做什么事情时，大家都会躲开我。
English: Every time I try to invite them to do something, they avoid me...

Chinese: 就和我和她们之间隔了一层不可见的壁障。
English: It feels like there's an invisible wall between us.

Chinese: 这也难免啊，毕竟黑神是她们的前辈，一直以严格的标准训练她们。
English: Well, that's understandable. You've been training them with strict standards.

Chinese: 她们也并没有恶意，只是和自己仰慕的前辈接近，对她们而言压力太大吧。
English: They don't mean any harm. Just being around an instructor they admire can be overwhelming.

Chinese: ……是吗。但是，我并不想单纯成为她们的前辈。我其实……也想和她们做朋友。
English: Is that so? But I don't want to just be their instructor. I... actually want to be their friend too.

Chinese: 我这时才猛然醒悟。
English: That's when I realize this.

Chinese: （没错，从魔女的资历上讲，黑神月咏是她们无可置疑的前辈。）
English: (Surely, when it comes to experience, Kurokami Tsukuyo is undeniably their instructor.)

Chinese: （但从年龄上讲，黑神前辈却是她们的同龄人。）
English: (But in terms of age, she's actually one of their peers.)

Chinese: （一直在同龄人面前扮演一个负责任、有能力、而且相当严格的前辈，但这就意味着难免与自己的同龄人有些疏离。）
English: (She's always trying to act like the responsible, capable, and strict instructor, but doing that around people her own age is bound to create some distance.)

Chinese: （黑神的内心，恐怕也有些孤独……）
English: (Deep down... maybe Kurokami feeks a bit lonely too.)

Chinese: 我相信黑神能和大家成为朋友
English: I believe Kurokami can become friends with them.

Chinese: 没关系，我相信黑神以后一定能够和大家成为朋友。
English: I believe you'll become friends with everyone someday, Kurokami.

Chinese: 侍主大人……
English: Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 没错，无论何时何地，侍主大人都始终陪伴在我身旁。
English: That's right. No matter the time or place, you're always by my side.

Chinese: 只要诚心相待，以后大家一定也会真正把我当作她们的朋友，而不是像现在这样，只把我当作她们的前辈。
English: If I treat everyone sincerely, then eventually, they'll come to see me as a true friend, not just as an instructor.

Chinese: 不过不能因为我的心情这种小事就停止训练。
English: But... I can't let my personal feelings interfere with training.

Chinese: 侍主大人，还请您继续监督我们练习。大家对元素生物的了解都很少，如果不做充足准备的话，大家一定会陷入危险。
English: Lord Oracle, please continue to oversee our practice. Everyone still knows very little about elemental creatures, and if we're not fully prepared, we could be in real danger.

Chinese: 当然，只要黑神有需要，我一定会陪着黑神前辈。
English: Of course. As long as you need me, I'll be right there with you, Kurokami.

Chinese: 就这样，我和黑神一同训练着新晋魔女们，帮助她们分析元素生物的特性，制定详尽的战术计划。
English: And so, I help Kurokami train the newly appointed Novas. Together, we analyze the characteristics of elemental creatures and formulate detailed tactical plans.

Chinese: 时间过得很快。太阳西沉时，大概是觉得已经训练得差不多了，黑神月咏解散了所有人。
English: Time passes quickly. As the sun begins to set, Kurokami Tsukuyo dismisses everyone, perhaps feeling that the day's training has been enough.

Chinese: 我也回到了自宅。
English: I return home.

Chinese: 夜晚，当弯月的冷光照进卧室，我的心里开始按捺不住不安。
English: That night, as the pale crescent moonlight spills into my room, I find myself growing increasingly uneasy.

Chinese: 黑神之前一直在强调元素生物很危险。这固然是因为元素生物本身的强大，但还有另一点。
English: Kurokami has emphasized again and again how dangerous elemental creatures are. Of course, part of that comes from their terrifying power, but there is something else, too.

Chinese: 元素生物已经销声匿迹很久了，魔女们只在书上见到过它们。包括我们所制定、演练的战术，也是完全依据书上的“理想状况”。
English: Elemental creatures have long since vanished from the world. Most Novas have only ever seen them in books. All of our strategies and training have been based on the "ideal scenarios" from texts.

Chinese: 但真到了战斗的时候，理想状况有多大概率会出现？
English: But when it comes to real combat, how often do ideal scenarios actually play out?

Chinese: 圣殿定下的驱逐日期就是明天。我越想越担忧，干脆起身，赶往了档案室。
English: The official expulsion operation is scheduled for tomorrow. The more I think about it, the more worried I become. Finally, I get up and head to the archives.

Chinese: 令我惊讶地是，正值深夜，但当我踏进档案室里，却发现那里竟然还有一个人的影子。
English: To my surprise, when I enter the archives late at night, I find someone inside.

Chinese: 黑神！
English: Kurokami!

Chinese: 侍主大人？
English: Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 你也是过来研究元素生物的吗？
English: Are you here to study materials on elemental creatures too?

Chinese: 虽然我们已经做了不少准备，但毕竟那么长的时间里，我们一直都没有真正接触过元素生物。
English: Even though we've done a lot of preparation, the truth is, we haven't actually encountered elemental creatures for a long time.

Chinese: 所以我想，哪怕只是多一点对元素生物的知识，明天的战斗就可以更轻松一些。
English: So I thought, if we could just learn a little more about them, maybe tomorrow's battle would be a little easier.

Chinese: 哪怕只是多看了一些前人记录的经验，明天后辈们受伤的概率就会减少一些。
English: Even just reading more of the records left by those before us could help reduce the chances of younger Novas getting hurt.

Chinese: 作为她们的前辈，我可不能抱着“这样就可以”的态度敷衍了事。
English: As their instructor, I can't just go through the motions.

Chinese: （是啊，黑神月咏就是这样的人。）
English: (Yes, that's exactly the kind of person Kurokami Tsukuyo is.)

Chinese: （宁愿自己放弃休息的时间，也要努力把事情做到最好。这并不仅仅是出于黑神家族固有的荣誉感，抑或是她自身的责任感。）
English: (She'd rather give up her own rest than cut corners. It's not just because of the honor of the Kurokami family, or her own strong sense of responsibility.)

Chinese: （想要保护后辈，更想要成为后辈们的榜样，让她们能够安全地抵达应该抵达地目标。）
English: (She truly wants to protect the Novas, to be a role model for them—someone they can rely on as they move forward their goals safely.)

Chinese: （这就是黑神月咏作为魔女上的前辈，与后辈们联系的方式。）
English: (That's how Kurokami Tsukuyo, as a senior Nova, connects with the ones following her.)

Chinese: （不过，在休息日一个人在档案室中熬夜，未免太孤独了。）
English: (Still, spending her day off alone in the archives late at night... it's a little too lonely.)

Chinese: 和黑神月咏一起研究
English: Join Kurokami Tsukuyo in the study

Chinese: 这样的话，我也来陪黑神一起研究吧。
English: In that case, I'll join you in the study, Kurokami.

Chinese: 诶？现在都这么晚了，侍主大人你也要跟我一起研究吗？
English: Huh? Huh? It's already so late... You're going to stay and study with me, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 毕竟来都来了。而且作为神谕司司长，我也很担心明天的行动。
English: Well, I'm already here. And as the head of the Oracle Division, I'm concerned about tomorrow's operation too.

Chinese: 况且，一个人的精力毕竟有限，夜晚就这么点时间，黑神如果仅仅是自己阅读的话，效率也不高吧。
English: Besides, no matter how driven someone is, there's only so much one person can do in a night. If you study alone, it won't be very efficient.

Chinese: 加上我，我们互相查漏补缺，速度应该可以快上不少。
English: But if I help, we can catch each other's oversights and cover more ground.

Chinese: ……是吗，我明白了。
English: I see. You're right.

Chinese: 那么请多指教了，侍主大人。
English: Thank you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 摇曳的烛光下，黑神露出温柔的笑容。
English: Under the flickering candlelight, Kurokami puts on a gentle smile.

Chinese: 寂静的夜晚，只有书页翻动的沙沙声在两个人的手上不断涌现。
English: In the silent night, the only sound is the soft rustling of pages turning in our hands.

Chinese: 不知道什么时候，太阳升了起来。一夜就这么过去了。
English: Before we know it, the sun has risen, and the night has passed.

Chinese: 抱歉，侍主大人，让你一晚上都陪着我阅读那些枯燥的元素生物图鉴……
English: I'm sorry, Lord Oracle, for keeping you up all night reading those dull materials on elemental creatures...

Chinese: 我觉得这些元素生物还挺有趣的，而且能帮上你们的忙，我就很满足了。
English: Not at all. I actually found them quite interesting. And if they're of any help to you, then it was time well spent.

Chinese: 提议和黑神月咏一同参加任务
English: Suggest going on the mission with Kurokami Tsukuyo

Chinese: 时候也不早了……不对，其实应该说，时候也挺早了。
English: It's getting late... actually, it's early morning.

Chinese: 既然都到第二天了，我就陪你执行任务吧。
English: Since it's the next day already, I'll go with you on this mission.

Chinese: 侍主也要加入吗？但是这次或许会有什么危险也说不定……
English: You want to come too, Lord Oracle? But this time... it might be dangerous.

Chinese: 在一群魔女面前，能有什么危险可言？黑神你就放心吧，我知道分寸的。
English: What danger could there be in front of a group of Novas? Don't worry, Kurokami, I know what I'm doing.

Chinese: 何况作为神谕司司长，我也有责任了解我们面对的危险。而且经过一晚上的阅读，我也知道该怎么对付元素生物了
English: Besides, as the head of the Oracle Division, it's my duty to understand the threats we're facing. And after a night of reading, I've got a pretty good idea of how to deal with elemental creatures.

Chinese: 既然侍主大人你这么坚持的话，那我也不再说什么。
English: If you're that determined, I won't stop you.

Chinese: 不过，答应我，如果遇到危险，一定要优先考虑自身的安全。
English: But promise me—if we run into danger, make your safety the top priority.

Chinese: 黑神，你就放心吧，我们也一起经历过不少了，这点事我还是明白的。
English: Don't worry, Kurokami. We've been through a lot together. I know how to take care of myself.

Chinese: 我和黑神离开档案室，来到了真理圣殿中的集结地。
English: Kurokami and I leave the archives and head to the rally point in the Sanctuary of Truth.

Chinese: 魔女们已经排好了队列，正待出发。
English: The Novas are already lined up, ready to depart.

Chinese: 黑神前辈！我们所有人已经到位了。
English: Kurokami, everyone is ready!

Chinese: 准备工作还顺利吗？
English: Is the prep work going smoothly?

Chinese: 非常顺利。我们现在就等着去到指定地点，然后把那些元素生物打个落花流水！
English: Very smoothly. We're just waiting to head to the designated location and crush those elemental creatures!

Chinese: 看起来大家都很自信啊。
English: You all look pretty confident.

Chinese: 那是当然，毕竟这几天都那么努力地训练了。
English: Of course! We've been training hard these past few days.

Chinese: 关于元素生物的档案和资料呢？
English: What about the materials on the elemental creatures?

Chinese: 认真阅读完了！挺少的，还以为是什么大部头的砖头书，结果大家只花了一个下午就差不多看完了。
English: We've read them thoroughly! There wasn't much, honestly. We thought it'd be some massive tome, but everyone finished reading it in just one afternoon.

Chinese: 一个下午？
English: One afternoon?

Chinese: 基础资料的话大概确实如此。
English: For the basic info, that's probably enough.

Chinese: 黑神前辈不必担心，元素生物不过是些没有智力的野兽而已。想战胜我们魔女，还早得很！
English: Kurokami, no need to worry. Elemental creatures are just mindless beasts. There is no way they can defeat Novas!

Chinese: 你们这么自信，虽说也不是坏事，但……
English: It's not a bad thing to be confident, but still...

Chinese: 黑神转过头，我们四目相对。望见我坚定的目光，黑神也点了点头，仿佛下了什么决心一般。
English: Kurokami turns her head. Our eyes meet. Seeing the resolve in my gaze, she gives a small nod, as if she's made up her mind about something.

Chinese: 目标是城外森林中聚集的元素生物。放着它们不管的话，城市迟早会被威胁到。
English: Our target is the elemental creatures gathering in the forest outside the city. If we leave them be, it's only a matter of time before they become a threat to the city.

Chinese: 好，出发！
English: Let's go!

Chinese: 就这样，在震耳欲聋的欢呼声中，魔女们在黑神月咏的带领下出发了。
English: Amid thunderous cheers, the Novas set off under the command of Kurokami Tsukuyo.

Chinese: 魔女们战斗力很强，这次出任务应该稳稳当当，不会有什么大波折——
English: The Novas are strong fighters. This mission should go smoothly, without any major trouble.

Chinese: ——一开始我是这样想的，她们毕竟也经过了黑神前辈的训练。
English: I thought so at first. After all, they've been trained by Kurokami herself.

Chinese: ……不幸地是，情况的进展和我预想中的大相径庭。
English: However, what actually happened is far from what I've imagined.

Chinese: 这个应该是火焰元素生物……看我用水魔法！
English: That one looks like a Fire Elemental Creature... I'll use water magic!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 元素生物反而变硬了？！怎么可能？！
English: The elemental creature just... hardened?! How is that possible?!

Chinese: 唔，这个元素生物好像是冰属性的……
English: Ugh, this one seems to be ice-type...

Chinese: 用土元素的魔法应该能行！
English: Earth magic should work!

Chinese: 咦？！元素生物不仅没被击倒，它旁边的地面还变成了泥地？！
English: Wait, what?! Not only did it not go down, but now the ground around it has turned to mud?!

Chinese: 不行，结块的地面变得又硬又滑，小……哎呀！
English: This is bad. The packed earth's become slick and hard—Ah!

Chinese: 一名魔女在固化的地面上滑倒，出于本能，她在彻底倒下之前拽住了另一名魔女的衣服。
English: One of the Novas slips on the hardened ground. Instinctively, she grabs another nearby Nova's sleeve to steady herself before hitting the ground.

Chinese: 当然这并不能阻止她跌倒，却顺带着把另一名魔女也拽到了地面。
English: Of course, it doesn't stop her from falling. She just ends up pulling the other Nova down with her.

Chinese: 被拽的魔女又恰好毗邻另一个人，于是她又撞倒了人……
English: And that second Nova happens to be next to another, who also falls down...

Chinese: ……于是连锁反应开始在战场上出现，魔女们像扑克牌一样顺势倒下。
English: A domino effect ripples across the battlefield, with Novas toppling over like cards.

Chinese: 情况真是惨不忍睹......
English: The whole situation is too miserable to watch.

Chinese: 在这一片混乱中，只有黑神保持着冷静，行云流水地施展魔法，轻松地击倒一个个元素生物。
English: In the midst of all this chaos, only Kurokami remains calm. Her spells flow like water—elegant, precise. She brings down the elemental creatures one by one.

Chinese: 大家冷静下来，保持阵型！这些元素生物因为混乱能量的影响，以及因为聚集产生的元素互渗，每个个体都有一个以上的元素！
English: Everyone, calm down and hold formation! These elemental creatures have been affected by Havoc Energy and elemental blending! Each one carries more than a single element now!

Chinese: 用单一的元素魔法无法击倒它们！按照我们演练的，三人一组行动，用不同的魔法持续打击它们！
English: You can't take them down with just one kind of magic! Stick to our training: work in teams of three and use different types of magic in succession!

Chinese: 侍主大人，能指挥一下侧翼吗？后辈们虽然在训练中掌握了对抗元素生物的基本方法，但她们并不知道元素生物会存在持有多种元素的情况。
English: Lord Oracle, could you lead the flank? While the Novas have trained to fight basic elemental creatures, they weren't prepared for multi-element ones.

Chinese: 毕竟她们只看了基础资料，而基础资料只介绍了元素生物的基本情况，没有介绍元素互渗。
English: After all, they only studied the basics, and those leave out elemental blending entirely.

Chinese: 我记了起来。元素互渗这个现象正是我和黑神昨日在档案室中查看的一本冷门书籍记载的。
English: I remember now. This phenomenon of elemental blending was recorded in an obscure book that Kurokami and I looked through in the archives just yesterday.

Chinese: 这些后辈魔女们没有专门阅读，自然不会知道。
English: These junior Novas haven't read it, so of course they wouldn't know.

Chinese: 侍主大人，现在只有你和我知道这些元素生物的弱点了。请你观察战场，把你看见的元素生物的弱点告知后辈魔女们。
English: Lord Oracle, right now, only you and I are aware of these elemental creatures' weaknesses. Please observe the battlefield and share any weaknesses you identify with the junior Novas.

Chinese: 明白了，交给我吧。
English: Understood. Leave it to me.

Chinese: 迅速前往左翼
English: Quickly move to the left flank

Chinese: 我快速地奔向魔女们的左翼，那里暂时还未受到刚才混乱的影响，魔女们的阵线还没被元素生物冲垮。
English: I rush to the Novas' left flank. That area hasn't yet been affected by the earlier chaos, and their formation is still solid against the elemental creatures.

Chinese: 我努力观察每一个元素生物，确定它们由哪几种元素混合而成，再告知魔女们应对方法。
English: I carefully observe each elemental creature, identify the elements they are composed of, and inform the Novas how to counter them.

Chinese: 终于，在我的努力下，魔女们打倒了不少元素生物。
English: At last, with my efforts, the Novas manage to defeat many of the elemental creatures.

Chinese: 在另一边，黑神也重新组织起魔女，打垮了元素生物。
English: On the other side, Kurokami also regroups the Novas and crushes the foes.

Chinese: 这些危险的生命体也察觉到优势已不在它们那里，开始往森林深处逃去。
English: Sensing the tide has turned against them, these dangerous beings begin retreating into the depths of the forest.
Phew... hah...

Chinese: 我们……胜利了！
English: We... we've won!

Chinese: 不要放松，保持战斗队形，保持侦查。开始清点人数。
English: Stay alert. Maintain formation. Keep scouting. Let's do a headcount.

Chinese: 没人受伤吧？
English: Is anyone injured?

Chinese: 报告黑神前辈，我们没人受伤。只是尤娜……她暂时没过来。
English: No one was injured, Kurokami. It's just Yuna... she hasn't returned yet.

Chinese: 没过来？她是没有遵照我的指令，擅自离开了自己的位置吗？
English: She hasn't returned? Did she disobey my orders and leave her assigned position without permission?

Chinese: 不、不是这样的！因为黑神前辈下令要不放过任何一个大型元素生物，而当时尤娜正好发现了一个，她才追击出去。
English: N-No, that's not it! You ordered us not to let a single large elemental creature escape, and Yuna happened to spot one. She went after it.

Chinese: 但是当时战局太混乱了，她很快消失在了元素生物群中，至今没回来……
English: But the battle was chaotic at the time, and she quickly vanished into the swarm of elemental creatures. We haven't seen her since...

Chinese: 在这种时候，在这种情况下消失……
English: Disappearing in a situation like this...

Chinese: 她一定会遇到危险。
English: She's likely in danger.

Chinese: 但是其他魔女们又不能放着不管……
English: But we can't just leave the other Novas unattended...

Chinese: 跟随黑神月咏寻找后辈
English: Accompany Kurokami Tsukuyo to search for Yuna

Chinese: 黑神，我们一起去寻找尤娜吧。
English: Kurokami, let's go find Yuna together.

Chinese: 诶？可是这样的话，其余的人……
English: Huh? But if we both go, then the Novas...

Chinese: 黑神，你也看到她们的表现了。
English: You've seen how they performed.

Chinese: 她们虽然在战斗的初期犯下了一些错误，但最后不也是成功驱离了元素生物。
English: Yes, they made a few mistakes early in the battle, but they ultimately drove the elemental creatures away.

Chinese: 后辈们值得信赖
English: They have proven themselves reliable.

Chinese: 黑神还是多相信一些你的后辈吧。
English: You should place more trust in them, Kurokami.

Chinese: 没错，黑神前辈，我们早就是能独当一面的魔女了。
English: That's right. Kurokami, we're already capable of standing on our own.

Chinese: 我们没有任何伤亡，就是我们按照黑神前辈的计划，刻苦训练的成果。
English: We suffered no casualties because we trained hard and followed your plans.

Chinese: 所以黑神前辈就放心去找尤娜吧。
English: So please don't worry about us. Go find Yuna.

Chinese: 说得也是，你们已经掌握了对付元素生物的窍门。
English: You're right. You've all grasped the key to defeating elemental creatures.

Chinese: 好，你们继续追击元素生物，彻底把它们赶出森林，确保它们的行进路线不再穿过城市。
English: Alright. Keep pushing the elemental creatures out of the forest and make sure they don't enter the city again.

Chinese: 具体战术就按照我教给你们的执行。
English: Stick to the tactics I taught you.

Chinese: 侍主大人，我们就去寻找尤娜吧。
English: Lord Oracle, let's go find Yuna.

Chinese: 好！
English: Sure!

Chinese: 我和黑神一同离开了大部队，来到附近的森林，寻找失踪的尤娜。
English: Kurokami and I leave the group and enter the nearby forest in search of Yuna.

Chinese: 好在，元素生物的队伍浩浩荡荡，它们留下了不少线索，我们最终找到了一个洞窟入口。
English: Thankfully, the elemental creatures have passed through in great numbers, leaving behind plenty of traces. Eventually, we discover the entrance to a cave.

Chinese: 尤娜……恐怕就是进入了这个洞窟之中。
English: Yuna... she must have gone into this cave.

Chinese: 看样子是。但是洞窟……如果洞窟深入地下的话，恐怕里面也充斥着混乱能量。
English: It seems that way. But if this cave extends underground, it's likely filled with Havoc Energy as well.

Chinese: 没错。这也意味着尤娜现在恐怕正面临很大的危险。
English: Yes. That means Yuna may be in serious danger right now.

Chinese: 我和黑神没有犹豫，径直进入了洞窟。
English: Without hesitation, Kurokami and I step into the cave.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 正如我所料，没走多长时间，我们就明显觉察到了混乱能量，而且越往里走，混乱能量的气息越浓郁。
English: As expected, it isn't long before we can clearly sense the presence of Havoc Energy. And the deeper we go, the denser the energy become.

Chinese: 紧张的气氛在我和黑神中间弥漫。
English: A tense silence spreads around us.

Chinese: 决定和黑神聊聊天
English: Start a conversation with Kurokami

Chinese: 黑神真的很厉害啊，经过你训练的后辈魔女们，在这么短的时间里，就从混乱中恢复过来。
English: Kurokami, you're really amazing. The Novas you trained managed to recover from all that chaos so quickly.

Chinese: 换成普通军队，大概早就溃散了。
English: If it were an ordinary unit, they would've crumbled right from the start.

Chinese: 诶？也不单单是我的功劳，是后辈们自己的努力，才让任务那么顺利的完成。
English: Huh? That's not just because of me. Their hard work contributed to the mission's success.

Chinese: 不过说起来，在昨天训练的时候，魔女们提到黑神正因为是黑神家族的继承人，才如此强大时，黑神似乎有些不高兴。
English: By the way, during yesterday's training, I noticed something. When the Novas said you were strong because you're the heir to the Kurokami family, you didn't seem all that happy.

Chinese: 为什么？黑神据我所知，应该很为自己身为黑神家族一员而自豪啊。
English: Why? As far as I know, you've always been proud of your lineage.

Chinese: 不，也没有不开心。
English: It's not that I was upset.

Chinese: 我为自己黑神家族继任者的身份而骄傲，这一点绝不会改变。
English: I am proud to be the heir of the Kurokami family. That's something that will never change.

Chinese: ……只是，每次后辈们看向我时，我总觉得她们看见的是历史悠久的黑神家族，而不是名为黑神月咏月咏的我。
English: But whenever the younger Novas look at me, I can't help but feel like they're only seeing the long-standing legacy of the Kurokami family, not me, Tsukuyo.

Chinese: 这也不是什么不满，但果然，相比被单纯视作黑神家族的延续，我还是希望她们能更多的关注我这个人。
English: It's not that I resent it, really. But I do wish they'd see me for who I am, not just as a continuation of that legacy.

Chinese: 而且，如果把我视作一直延续的历史本身，恐怕她们也会被这份沉重压得喘不过气，但我不希望她们因此……对我心存隔阂。
English: Besides... if they see me as nothing more than a symbol of tradition, that expectation might become a burden for them as well. I don't want that to make them feel distant from me.

Chinese: （作为黑神家族的继承人，在别人的眼中，她也势必会成为黑神家族的代表。）
English: (As the heir to the Kurokami family, she's inevitably seen as the representative of the her name.)

Chinese: （黑神有这个自觉，也正因为明白自己代表了黑神家族，恐怕她才会如此努力。）
English: (Kurokami is fully aware of this. And perhaps it's precisely because she understands the weight of that responsibility that she works so hard.)

Chinese: （在所有人都以为阅读基础资料就足够的时候，不惜熬夜，去阅读那些艰涩古老的档案。）
English: (While everyone else believed that reading the basic materials was enough, she went as far as staying up late to study those obscure, ancient files.)

Chinese: （可是，这样对黑神而言就够了吗？）
English: (But... was that truly enough for Kurokami?)

Chinese: （对一个少女来说，以这种身份去面对自己的同龄人，果然还是会心生孤独。）
English: (For a young girl, carrying such a heavy legacy among her peers—it's only natural she'd sometimes feel alone.)

Chinese: 侍主大人，小心！
English: Lord Oracle, look out!

Chinese: 跃起躲开攻击
English: Jump up to dodge the attack

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 一束火焰朝我扑来。我浑身一激灵，跳到后面，这才没有被击中。
English: A burst of flame comes rushing toward me. I shiver instinctively and jump back just in time to avoid being hit.

Chinese: 要不是黑神的提醒，我恐怕凶多吉少。
English: If it weren't for Kurokami's warning, I might not have made it.

Chinese: 我往下一看，很多元素生物都在朝我和黑神冲过来。
English: Looking down, I see a swarm of elemental creatures charging toward us.

Chinese: 它们明显受到了混乱能量的影响，变得更加狂躁。
English: It is evident that the Havoc Energy has affected them, driving them into an even greater frenzy.

Chinese: 我和黑神一边战斗，一边小心地继续深入洞窟，最终在一处狭小的空间中，发现了一个熟悉的人。
English: Kurokami and I press forward, carefully battling our way deeper into the cave. In a narrow hollow, we finally came across a familiar face.

Chinese: 尤娜！你怎么了！
English: Yuna! What just happened to you?

Chinese: 不行，不行，我逃不出去的……
English: No... no, I can't escape...

Chinese: 我死定了……谁来救救我……
English: I'm doomed... someone, please save me...

Chinese: 不，不会有人来救我……毕竟我已经失败了……
English: No, no one's coming... I failed...

Chinese: 我是个没用的魔女……没有任何价值……
English: I'm a useless Nova... worthless...

Chinese: 尤娜此时坐在地上，双手抱胸，身子不断颤抖。
English: Yuna is sitting on the ground, hugging herself tightly, her body trembling uncontrollably.

Chinese: （混乱能量可以激发出各种负面情绪，这种地下洞窟里，混乱能量的影响尤为剧烈。）
English: (Havoc Energy can trigger all kinds of negative emotions, and in this underground cave, its effects are especially intense.)

Chinese: （恐怕，尤娜正是受了这种影响，心中的自卑和恐惧一下子爆发了出来。）
English: (Most likely, Yuna ias influenced by it, causing her buried feelings of inferiority and fear to erupt all at once.)

Chinese: 尤娜，快点站起来！只是坐着不动的话，那什么都无法做到！
English: Yuna, get up! If you just sit there, you won't be able to do anything!

Chinese: 这些元素生物可不会等着你恢复，只有战斗才能击倒它们，逃出去！
English: These elemental creatures aren't going to wait for you to recover. Only by fighting can we defeat them and escape!

Chinese: 不行的……我的星痕用光了……
English: I can't... I've run out of Asters...

Chinese: 没有星痕，我一无是处……
English: Without them, I'm worthless...

Chinese: 没有星痕的话，就用自己的魔法和战斗技巧来应对！
English: Then fight with your own magic and combat skills!

Chinese: 开什么玩笑，魔女之所以是魔女，就是因为我们拥有星痕。
English: Don't be ridiculous. A Nova is only a Nova because we possess Asters.

Chinese: 没有了星痕的魔女，那还是魔女吗？只是可怜的普通人而已……
English: Without them, what are we? Just helpless, ordinary people...

Chinese: 黑神，现在的话，恐怕没法这么简单的鼓励她重振旗鼓。
English: Kurokami, I don't think simple encouragement will be enough to lift her spirits right now.

Chinese: 也是，能够让被混乱能量影响的她重新振作的人，也就只有侍主你了。
English: True. The only one who can bring her back from the influence of Havoc Energy... is you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 那么，这些围攻过来的元素生物就由我来处理掉！
English: In that case, I'll handle these aggressive elemental creatures!

Chinese: 尤娜，看好了，即便没有星痕，我们魔女也有战斗的办法！
English: Yuna, watch closely. Even without Asters, we Novas still have ways to fight!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在我们面前，黑神月咏高高跃起，跳过了元素生物，刚一落地，一道白光闪烁，黑神的剑就刺进了元素生物体内。
English: Kurokami Tsukuyo springs into the air, clearing the elemental creatures. As she lands, a flash of white light—her sword strikes true, piercing one of them.

Chinese: 寒冷魔法沿着剑身进入元素生物体内，后者随即像灰色的沙土一样土崩瓦解。
English: Frost magic courses through the blade and into the creature, causing it to crumble into gray sand.

Chinese: 利用武器传导魔法，这极大节省了黑神的体力，但要找准元素生物的弱点可不是件容易事。
English: Channeling magic through her weapon greatly conserves Kurokami's stamina, but finding an elemental creature's weakness is never easy.

Chinese: 这，这怎么可能……
English: Th-this... how is this possible?

Chinese: 黑神前辈竟然能在那些元素生物群中灵活穿梭，击倒元素生物就像击倒那些弱小的混乱生物……
English: Kurokami is actually able to weave through those elemental creatures, taking them down as effortlessly as if they were weak chaotic creatures...

Chinese: 可是，她明明没有使用星痕之力，也没有使用特别强力的魔法……
English: But she clearly isn't using Power of Aster, nor any particularly powerful magic...

Chinese: 没错，黑神仅仅用简单的魔法，加上自己的体能和技术就能完美地对抗这些元素生物。
English: That's right. Kurokami is relying solely on basic spells, combined with her physical prowess and technique, to take down these elemental creatures with ease.

Chinese: 而这些并不需要强大的星痕天赋，所需要的仅仅是勤奋的训练。
English: And none of that requires an exceptional Aster talent—only diligent training.

Chinese: 她能够判断出元素生物的弱点也并不是她真的天赋异禀，而是靠着昨晚在档案室中，熬夜读完了全部的元素生物档案。
English: Her knack for finding the elemental creatures' weak points isn't due to some special talent—it's because she stayed up all night in the archives, reading every file on them.

Chinese: 那些档案里记载着元素生物的特性和弱点，只要用心记住，任谁都能做到黑神月咏的效果。
English: Those files documented the traits and weaknesses of elemental creatures. After thorough study, anyone could do what Kurokami Tsukuyo has done.

Chinese: 黑神前辈……
English: Kurokami...

Chinese: 黑神她，并不仅仅是因为自己的星痕天赋才强大。
English: She isn't strong just because of her Aster talent.

Chinese: 当集训解散的时候，黑神还是会在圣殿中练习；当所有人都回家时，黑神还是会在档案室里奋战。
English: When training was dismissed, she remained in the Sanctuary to continue practicing. When everyone else went home, she stayed in the archives, burning the midnight oil.

Chinese: 黑神也许的确拥有异于常人的天赋，但天赋缺失了努力，也最终会一无是处。
English: Kurokami may indeed possess an extraordinary talent, but without effort, talent means nothing in the end.

Chinese: 而且，黑神正是为了做你们的榜样，才会在背后如此努力。
English: And she works this hard... just to be an example for you.

Chinese: 没错……我也……
English: That's right... I, too...

Chinese: 握住尤娜的手，帮助她驱散混乱能量
English: Take Yuna's hand and help her dispel the Havoc Energy

Chinese: 我握住这名后辈魔女的手，帮助她驱散混乱能量的影响。
English: I hold the young Nova's hand, helping her dispel the effects of the Havoc Energy.

Chinese: 我也一定有能做到的事情！
English: There must be something I can do too!

Chinese: 尤娜站了起来，此时的她全然没有了刚才的怯懦，眼神里充满了坚毅。
English: Yuna stands up. The timidness she has shown moments ago is gone, replaced by a look of steely perseverance.

Chinese: 我想，我想帮上黑神前辈的忙！
English: I want—I want to help Kurokami!

Chinese: 好，我们一起战斗吧！
English: Alright. Let's fight together!

Chinese: 终于，在我和尤娜的帮助下，黑神击退了潮水般涌来的元素生物。
English: At last, with Yuna's and my help, Kurokami manages to drive back the flood of elemental creatures.

Chinese: 我们且战且退，终于来到了洞口附近。
English: We fight while retreating, and finally make it near the cave entrance.

Chinese: 渐渐，元素生物也不再聚集过来，它们恐怕也本能地意识到了我们不是那么好惹。
English: Gradually, the elemental creatures stop swarming. Perhaps, by instinct, they realize we aren't easy prey.

Chinese: 大家再加班劲，我已经能看到光了。我们就快到了！
English: Keep it up, everyone! I can see the light. We're almost there!

Chinese: 我们快马加鞭，一同穿过了洞口。
English: We rush forward together and pass through the cave entrance.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 炽烈的阳光一时间让我感到眼睛刺痛。我按捺不住自己的欣喜，刚想大声呼唤黑神，告诉她我们终于脱离险境——
English: The blazing sunlight stings my eyes for a moment. I can't contain my joy. Just as I open my mouth to call out to Kurokami and tell her we'd finally made it out of danger—

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: ——然后就被浇了一盆冷水。字面意义上的。
English: I'm hit by a sudden chill. Literally.

Chinese: 唔呀？！侍，侍主大人？
English: What?! It's y-you, Lord Oracle?!

Chinese: 都是她出的主意！和我们无关！
English: It was all her idea! We had nothing to do with it!

Chinese: 魔女们站在洞口旁，目瞪口呆地看着被浇成落汤鸡的我，接着便纷纷移开视线，那副样子虽然没开口，但浑身上下都在说“不是我做的”。
English: The Novas are all gathered near the entrance, staring at me in stunned silence. I'm soaked from head to toe. Then, one by one, they look away. No one speaks, but their body language says it all: "It wasn't me."

Chinese: 呆站在原地
English: Stand frozen
Well...

Chinese: 诶？！侍主大人您没事吧？
English: Eh?! Lord Oracle, are you alright?

Chinese: 你们这是？
English: What are you all doing here?

Chinese: 不是让你们去追击元素生物了吗？
English: Weren't you supposed to be chasing down the elemental creatures?

Chinese: 元素生物已经被我们彻底赶走了，之后我们商量了一下，觉得黑神月咏前辈一定能成功救出尤娜，所以在洞口准备了一个惊喜……
English: We have completely driven them off. Then we figured Kurokami Tsukuyo would definitely save Yuna, so we set up a little surprise at the cave entrance...

Chinese: 真的不是我的主意！
English: It wasn't my idea, I swear!

Chinese: 唉，我没什么事，你们不用那么惊慌失措。
English: Sigh... I'm fine. No need to panic like that.

Chinese: 虽然确实挺凉的……
English: Though it is a bit chilly...

Chinese: 那个，是因为我们想要庆祝，但是手边没有烟花。
English: Well, we wanted to celebrate, but we didn't have any fireworks on hand...

Chinese: 我们见到了元素互渗的现象，所以想着是不是能用水元素来降低火元素魔法的效果，制造类似烟花的无害火焰效果……
English: Then we saw the phenomenon of elemental blending and thought maybe we could use water magic to weaken fire magic, and create a harmless firework-like effect...

Chinese: 但好像水元素魔法强过了头……
English: But the water magic might've been a bit too strong...

Chinese: 你们怎么想的，元素生物的现象怎么可能套用到魔法上……
English: Seriously? Just because something happens with elemental creatures doesn't mean you can apply it directly to magic...

Chinese: 也没什么关系，何况她们不也顺利完成任务了。这次可是我们的胜利啊。
English: It's fine. Besides, they completed the mission, didn't they? This is our victory.

Chinese: 你说的没错，侍主大人。不过，你少说了一点。
English: You're right, Lord Oracle. But you forgot one thing.

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 没有你的话，我们这次不会这么顺利。
English: We couldn't have done it without you.

Chinese: 无奈地望天
English: Look helplessly up at the sky

Chinese: 选择离开黑神月咏，带着其他魔女返回城市
English: Leave Kurokami Tsukuyo and return to the city with the other Novas

Chinese: 黑神，你就放心地先去找尤娜吧。
English: Kurokami, you go ahead and find Yuna. Don't worry about us.

Chinese: 我先带着魔女们驱散周围其他的元素生物。
English: I'll lead the Novas to drive off the remaining elemental creatures nearby.

Chinese: 这样没问题吗？
English: Are you sure about this?

Chinese: 我们才要问，黑神前辈一个人去寻找尤娜没关系吗？
English: We should be asking you—are you sure it's fine for you to find Yuna alone?

Chinese: 不用担心，黑神的战斗力足够对付少数元素生物。
English: Don't worry. Kurokami's combat ability is more than enough to handle a few elemental creatures.

Chinese: 何况如果我们全都出发去找尤娜，那些元素生物过不了多久，就会在森林中隐藏起来，不知道什么时候会再度集结。
English: Besides, if all of us head out to search for Yuna, the elemental creatures will just retreat deeper into the forest and regroup. We'll lose our chance to stop them.

Chinese: 这样的话，我们就失去了这次阻止它们的机会。
English: We'll lose our chance to stop them.

Chinese: 没错，所以我和你们分开行动是最好的选择。
English: You're right. That's why splitting up is the best option.

Chinese: 那么侍主大人，魔女们的指挥就交给你了。
English: Then, Lord Oracle, I'll leave the command of the Novas to you.

Chinese: 毕竟从刚才的表现来看，魔女们还是不能没有指挥。
English: From what we've seen just now, it's clear they still need someone to lead them.

Chinese: 接下指挥魔女们的责任
English: Agree to lead the Novas

Chinese: 嗯，我明白的，黑神就放心吧。
English: Got it. Leave it to me, Kurokami.

Chinese: 之后，我带着魔女们去搜寻元素生物。
English: After that, I led the Novas in a search for the elemental creatures.

Chinese: 有了之前的经验，魔女们在我的指挥和帮助下，成功战胜了元素生物群，将它们彻底赶出了森林。
English: With our previous experience, and under my guidance, they successfully defeated the creatures and drove them completely out of the forest.

Chinese: 当我们返回和黑神的分别处时，我看到黑神朝我们走来，背上还背着一个魔女。
English: When we return to the spot where we parted ways with Kurokami, we see her walking toward us, with a Nova carried on her back.

Chinese: 黑神？！
English: Kurokami?!

Chinese: 前去迎接黑神月咏
English: Go over to meet Kurokami Tsukuyo

Chinese: 你背着的是？
English: Who are you carrying?

Chinese: 是尤娜。她进入了一处洞窟中，那里充斥着混乱能量。
English: It's Yuna. She went into a cave filled with Havoc Energy.

Chinese: 我赶过去的时候，她已经深陷负面情绪的漩涡，连站都站不起来。
English: By the time I got there, she was already overwhelmed by negative emotions and couldn't even stand.

Chinese: 没办法，我只好打晕她，然后背着她逃离洞窟。
English: I had no choice but to knock her out and carry her out of the cave.

Chinese: 尤娜不会有什么事吧？
English: Will Yuna be okay?

Chinese: 混乱能量对她的影响只是暂时的，去圣殿里休息一下应该就好了。
English: The effects of the Havoc Energy are only temporary. She should recover after some rest at the Sanctuary.

Chinese: 不过，确实不能低估对她心理的影响。
English: But... we can't underestimate the psychological impact it had on her.

Chinese: 没关系的，黑神，我相信尤娜作为魔女，一定可以跨过这个坎。
English: No need to worry too much, Kurokami. Yuna's a Nova. She'll pull through this.

Chinese: 就像其他的魔女们，虽然一开始的作战并不顺利，最后不也是成功驱逐了那些元素生物。
English: Just like the other Novas—things didn't go smoothly at first either, but in the end, they successfully drove off the elemental creatures.

Chinese: 说得也是。多亏了你，侍主，我们的任务才能够完成。
English: Fair point. Thanks to you, Lord Oracle, we were able to complete the mission.

Chinese: 一边提防一边前往左翼
English: Proceed cautiously toward the left flank

Chinese: 返回自宅
English: Return home

Chinese: 一宿没睡，我感觉到身体说不出来的疲乏。
English: I haven't slept all night, and a deep, indescribable fatigue weighs on my body.

Chinese: 侍主大人，你的脸色很差，果然是太累了吗？
English: Lord Oracle, you don't look well... Are you exhausted?

Chinese: 要不你就先回去吧。任务的事情你就不用担心了，我会处理好的。
English: Maybe you should head back first. Don't worry about the mission. I'll take care of the rest.

Chinese: 好吧。那么黑神，我先走了。
English: Fine. Then I'll leave it to you, Kurokami.

Chinese: 身体实在有点吃不消，这种状态下，恐怕即便去帮忙，也只会帮倒忙。
English: My body really can't take it anymore. In this state, I'll only be a burden even if I try to help.

Chinese: 而且我相信黑神自己便足以处理这些事情。毕竟从资料里来看，元素生物并不特别强大。
English: Besides, I believe Kurokami can handle things on her own. From the information we have, elemental creatures aren't particularly strong.

Chinese: 回到自宅中，我很快便沉睡过去。
English: Back at home, I quickly fall into a deep sleep.

Chinese: 等我醒过来，已经是傍晚了。
English: By the time I wake up, it is already dusk.

Chinese: 最初的迷茫感消散后，我记起黑神应该已经回来了，便赶忙起身，赶到了真理圣殿中。
English: After the haze fades, I remember Kurokami should be back by now. I quickly get up and rush to the Sanctuary of Truth.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 圣殿中已经聚集了不少魔女，看来她们都是完成了任务归来的魔女。我往前凑了凑，很快便看见了黑神月咏。
English: The Sanctuary is already filled with Novas. Seems they are all returning from their missions. I squeeze my way forward and soon spot Kurokami Tsukuyo.

Chinese: 黑神！
English: Kurokami!

Chinese: 跑向黑神月咏
English: Run up to Kurokami Tsukuyo

Chinese: 侍主大人？
English: Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 黑神，这次任务的情况怎么样？
English: Kurokami, how did the mission go?

Chinese: 大体上还算顺利，只是……
English: It went smoothly. Just that...

Chinese: 有个叫尤娜的魔女受到了混乱能量的影响，现在送去休息治疗了。
English: A Nova named Yuna was affected by Havoc Energy. She's currently resting and undergoing treatment.

Chinese: 混乱能量？！元素生物应该没有混乱能量啊……
English: Havoc Energy?! But elemental creatures shouldn't have that!

Chinese: 是尤娜追击元素生物过于深入，不小心进入一个洞窟。
English: Yuna chased the elemental creatures too far and ended up stumbling into a cave.

Chinese: 洞窟里面有很浓重的混乱能量，她这才受到了影响。
English: That cave was filled with dense Havoc Energy and she was affected.

Chinese: 抱歉，黑神，假如我能和你一起去的话……
English: I'm sorry, Kurokami. I should have gone with you...

Chinese: 不，这不是侍主大人的错。
English: No, this isn't your fault, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 打败元素生物，保护城市，本来就是交由我们魔女的任务。
English: Defeating elemental creatures and protecting the city is our duty as Novas.

Chinese: 是我们不成熟的表现才导致了这一切。侍主大人不必介怀。
English: It was our lack of experience that led to this outcome. You don't need to blame yourself.

Chinese: 至少让我去帮一下忙吧。
English: At least let me help out now.

Chinese: 之后，我帮着黑神处理余事。
English: Afterward, I help Kurokami handle the aftermath.

Chinese: 虽然黑神让我不用介怀，但我还是不自禁地想到，假如我跟着黑神过去，事情能够变得顺利些吗？
English: Although she told me not to worry, I can't help but wonder—if I went with her back then, would things have turned out more smoothly?

Chinese: 快步走向黑神月咏
English: Walk briskly toward Kurokami Tsukuyo

Chinese: 我就是黑神的朋友
English: I'm a friend of Kurokami.

Chinese: 况且，现在在你旁边站着的我，不就是你的朋友吗。
English: Besides, I'm here by your side now. Doesn't that make me your friend?

Chinese: 保持沉默，不打断黑神月咏
English: Remain silent and let Kurokami Tsukuyo speak

Chinese: 而大部分魔女以前没有对付过元素生物。
English: Most Novas have never faced elemental creatures before.

Chinese: 挺身面对危险
English: Step forward and confront the danger

Chinese: 告诉魔女们自己会和她们一起战斗
English: Tell the Novas you'll fight by their side

Chinese: 你们怎么这么慌张
English: Why is everyone panicking like this?

Chinese: 选项
English: Options

English: Kuroro

English: Lord of the Lake

English: Female resident

English: Yetannia

Chinese: 受祝福的庆典
English: Blessed Celebration

Chinese: 我带着克萝萝参加雏鸟庆典，据说在这个节日，未成年的孩子将会得到祝福，更快成长。但是当我们问及“祝福”，村里的人却又露出一副十分微妙的表情……对他们来说，那是一段难以忘怀的记忆。
English: I brought Kuroro to the Nestling Festival. It's said that during this celebration, underage children will receive a blessing that helps them grow faster. But when we asked the villagers about this "blessing," they all showed a rather... complicated expression. To them, it seems to be a memory not easily forgotten.

Chinese: ……哥哥，有新的信。
English: Hey my lord, check it out, there's a new letter.

Chinese: 信？
English: A letter?

English: I glance up, spotting an envelope sneaking its way out from the towering stacks of paper on my desk.

English: All logical tweaks. However, whenever the word "blessing" is mentioned, the villagers become shifty and avoided answering.

Chinese: “在庆典的最后，先知会带领子民向神祈祷，神灵就会降下祝福……然后就能长大。”书上是这样写的。
English: "At the end of the celebration, the prophet will lead the people in praying, and the gods will bless them... and they will grow. "That's what it says in the book.

Chinese: 克萝萝适时做出解释。
English: Kuroro fills in the blanks just in time.

Chinese: 先知啊……但要是没有先知，这祝福仪式又会是什么样子？
English: The prophet... but what's this blessing ceremony without the prophet?

English: I doubt it'll make a difference. Yetannia is probably just there for show.

Chinese: 嗯！
English: OK!

English: none

Ah—!

English: How often does this occur? When will it be my turn?

English: You? How long has this Lord of the Lake thing been going on? Does anyone ever win?

English: Kuroro, wait for it to get near the bank, then go for it!

English: Did that fish just... talk?

English: They kept fishing. Some of them caught normal fish, while others were yanked into the water by the elusive Lord of the Lake.

Chinese: 不过……

English: The villagers said it was the Lord of the Lake's curse.

English: That being said, I was rather surprised when it spoke.

English: (Although I've seen stranger things—like flying fish, on land...)

Hey, busy bee, I saw the note you left! Don't you think you've been gone long enough?!
Dragging Kuroro to the festival while leaving me to clean up after you... You're getting too comfortable bossing me around!
Forget it. You've been swamped lately, so you should take some time to relax.
Don't worry. I'll handle the mess. —Ritsu

English: The letter starts off casual and snarky but has a better conclusion.

English: My lord, should we... head back soon?

English: Kuroro's drooping tail says it all.

Chinese: ……让我想想。
English: Give me a moment.

English: Even with my knowledge as Lord Oracle, I still can't determine what this ceremony is about.

Chinese: （比起祝福仪式，更像是打算开始合唱……）
English: (It seems more like they're preparing to sing songs than receive a blessing...)

Chinese: （……藏了这么久的祝福仪式，现在就让我见识一下吧。）

Chinese: 准备——

Chinese: ♪羽翼未丰的雏鸟，愿你能在将来展翅高飞……♪

English: But it is a true blessing, a wish for the children to aim high. The joy and excitement of the festival is centered on these prayers for the children's futures.

Chinese: 也在这一刻，我感受到克萝萝传递过来的微妙愿望。

English: (I had such a bitter-sweet time with Kuroro.)

Chinese: ♪令人怜爱的孩子，我们将送上祝福，愿你能茁壮健康……♪
