Chinese: 你不去和大家一起找吗？
English: Aren't you going to search with the others?

Chinese: 这个嘛....我打算去人少的地方先找一下，这样也许会找到一些容易被漏掉的线索。
English: Well... I was thinking of starting somewhere less crowded. That way, I might spot some clues others missed.

Chinese: 嗯，这样也好。不过要是你有发现，记得先通知我，不要一个人擅自作主张。
English: Sure, that's fine. But if you find anything, make sure to tell me first. Don't act on your own.

Chinese: 嗯，那...那我就先去了。
English: Got it... I'll get going then.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我再次回到克萝萝的身旁，试着唤醒她。
English: I return to Kuroro's side and try to wake her again.

Chinese: 同时我也在想到底谁会做这种事，而且还是在圣殿里，他到底是怎么躲过其他人的眼睛？
English: At the same time, I keep wondering—who could've done something like this? And how did they manage to slip past everyone in the Sanctuary?

Chinese: 突然一道灵光闪过，我想起今天早些时候发生的一件事。
English: Suddenly, a thought strikes me. I remember something that happened earlier today.

Chinese: 那时我结束了巡视，正和牧坐在回城里的马车上。
English: At the time, I had just wrapped up my inspection and was going back to the city in a carriage with Muu.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 你的精力还真是好啊，跑这么多地方也不带累一下的。
English: You've got impressive stamina—running all over the place without getting tired.

Chinese: 协助饲主大人完成工作可是我的荣幸，怎么还会觉得累呢~
English: Assisting you is an honor! How could I possibly feel tired?

Chinese: 说得也是，要是没有你的话，光是把周围这几个城镇走完就够让我头大的，更别提还要去那些零零散散的村庄什么了。
English: True enough. Without you, just visiting the nearby towns would've been a headache. Not to mention all those scattered little villages...

Chinese: 嘿嘿，那饲主大人要不要奖励我一下？
English: Hehe, then shouldn't you give me a reward?

Chinese: 这本来就是你的职责。
English: This is your job, you know.

Chinese: 哎呀，这里又没外人你还和我来这一套，饲主大人一点都不坦诚。
English: Oh, come on, there's no one else around. Why are you so serious? You're really not being sincere at all.

Chinese: 你呀，真的是…
English: Sigh...

Chinese: 要是想和我敞开心扉了，随时来找我就行哟~
English: Whenever you feel ready to talk, I'll be here for you.

Chinese: 你还真是一点都不谦虚啊....
English: You really aren't modest, are you...

Chinese: 在我和牧逗趣的时候，我猛然感到一丝寒意，有什么东西在向我袭来。
English: As I was bantering with Muu, I suddenly felt a chill—something was coming at me.

Chinese: 而牧的脸色也在霎时骤变，还没等我行动就先一步做出了反应。
English: Muu's expression shifted in an instant. Before I could even react, she was already moving.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 她展开防御魔法挡在我身前，我明显感觉到有什么东西被弹开了。
English: She cast a defensive spell and shielded me, and I clearly sensed something get deflected away.

Chinese: 但同时我又感觉自己心中一紧，像是有什么事发生了一样。
English: But at the same time, a strange sense of tightness gripped me, like something had just happened.

Chinese: （看来诅咒没有生效，那就还好。）
English: (Looks like the curse didn't take effect. That's a relief.)

Chinese: 你没事吧！
English: Are you alright?

Chinese: 饲主大人倒不用担心，我已经用屏障把它反射回去了。
English: No need to worry, Master. I've already reflected it with a barrier.

Chinese: 那刚才那个是？
English: What was that?

Chinese: 很明显是朝着饲主大人您所释放的诅咒，只是....
English: It was clearly a curse directed at you, Master. However...

Chinese: 只是？
English: What?

Chinese: 在接触的瞬间我试着感知了一下，和我所了解的诅咒的类型相比，它的构成有点奇怪，但现在我还不好确定具体是如何。
English: When it made contact, I tried to sense its nature. Compared to the curses I know, its structure felt a bit... unusual. I can't say exactly how yet.

Chinese: 不管怎样，以饲主大人为目标就是不可饶恕的。
English: Whatever the case, targeting you is absolutely unforgivable.

Chinese: 请您放心，我一定会把胆敢做出这般忤逆之事的恶贼揪出来交到饲主大人您面前。
English: Rest assured, Master. I'll find the scoundrel who dared to defy you and drag them before you myself.

Chinese: 说实话，牧此刻的眼神让我也感到了一丝畏惧....
English: To be honest, the look in Muu's eyes made me feel a tinge of fear...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 剩下的路程中我和牧都保持着高度的警惕，但所幸我们没有再遇到什么麻烦。
English: For the rest of the journey, both Muu and I stayed on high alert. Fortunately, we didn't run into any more trouble.

Chinese: 等到城门口的时候牧却告诉我她察觉到了施术来源的气息，这让我有些意外。
English: When we reached the city gate, Muu told me she sensed the presence of the spell's source, which caught me off guard.

Chinese: 可这种事还是先不要声张的好。
English: Still, it's better not to make this public just yet.

Chinese: 在跟牧嘱托过后我便让她先暗中试着能不能追查一些线索。
English: After cautioning Muu, I asked her to quietly investigate and see if she could uncover any leads.

Chinese: 而我则在城里绕了两圈确认了没有被可疑人员跟踪后才回到了圣殿。
English: As for me, I circled the city twice to make sure I wasn't being followed before finally returning to the Sanctuary.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 该不会和这件事有关吧....
English: Could it be related to all this?

Chinese: 在我正焦头烂额的时候，律带着安洁走了进来。
English: Just as I'm at my wits' end, Ritsu walks in with Angie.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 事情的大概我在路上听律说了，说实话我也是第一次听说这种事。
English: Ritsu has filled me in on the way here, and honestly, it is the first time I'd ever heard of something like this.

Chinese: 到底怎么办啊，要不还是多找些人来帮忙吧....
English: What should we do... Maybe we should call in more people to help?

Chinese: 人多并不一定有作用，还是先让我检查一下。
English: More people won't necessarily help. Let me examine her first.

Chinese: 安洁一边在克萝萝身边来回地踱步，一边注视着她，但她的表情却逐渐变得凝重。
English: Angie paces back and forth beside Kuroro, her gaze fixed on her. But her expression gradually grows more serious.

Chinese: 一旁的我们甚至也忍不住压低了自己的呼吸，静静等候着。
English: Even we instinctively lower our breathing, waiting quietly.

Chinese: 侍主大人您过来一下。
English: Lord Oracle, could you come here for a moment?

Chinese: 需要我做什么吗？
English: What do you need me to do?

Chinese: 请您试着继续往克萝萝身体里输送力量。
English: Please try continuing to channel your power into Kuroro.

Chinese: 虽然不知道安洁想做什么，但我相信她一定是有所发现才会这样说。
English: Although I don't know what Angie is planning, I trust she must've discovered something.

Chinese: 我按照她所说的继续试图用自己的力量唤醒克萝萝，而安洁则拉着我和克萝萝的手，嘴里开始念着些什么。
English: Following her instructions, I continue trying to awaken Kuroro with my power. Angie holds both my hand and Kuroro's, and begins chanting something.

Chinese: 一些荧光开始环绕在我们身边，而我通过手掌所传输的力量和克萝萝身上的诅咒也开始变得具象化。
English: Faint glows of light begin to swirl around us, and the power I'm channeling through my palm, along with the curse on Kuroro, starts to take shape.

Chinese: 还有这种魔法吗？
English: Is this... some kind of magic?

Chinese: 只不过是我空余时间的一些小研究罢了，还请侍主大人集中精神。
English: Just a little research I did in my spare time. Now please, Lord Oracle, stay focused.

Chinese: [var=Actor]你看，你的力量都直接从那个图案上穿过去了，然后在小克萝萝的身体里一直循环。
English: [var=Actor], look! your power is passing straight through that symbol and circulating inside little Kuroro's body.

Chinese: 怪不得我说明明没感觉到什么阻碍，但就是一点作用都没有。
English: No wonder I didn't feel any resistance, yet it had no effect at all.

Chinese: 嗯....现在我可以确认的是，克萝萝身上的这个东西严格意义上不完全算是魔法，是一个杂糅了封印术而导致了展开错乱的诅咒。
English: Hmm... what I can confirm now is that the thing on Kuroro isn't exactly magic. It's a distorted curse caused by a fusion with sealing spells.

Chinese: 这是什么意思呀？
English: What does that mean?

Chinese: 诅咒虽然总体上归纳在魔法之列，但二者还是有区别的。
English: Although curses are generally classified under magic, there are still differences between the two.

Chinese: 简单来说，诅咒基本上都需要相应的准备仪式和材料，同时需要有一个和施术者不同的接受者。
English: Simply put, curses typically require specific rituals and materials, and they always need a recipient different from the caster.

Chinese: 而且与魔法高度的自由不同的是，想要解除诅咒通常只有两个办法。
English: And unlike magic, which is highly flexible, lifting a curse usually only has two methods:

Chinese: 一是满足其在释放时预设的解除条件，二是在相关记载中找到其具体的种类并进行逆向仪式，这通常又需要搜集一些复杂的材料或则元素。
English: First, fulfilling the conditions preset during its casting. Second, identifying the curse type from relevant records and performing a reverse ritual, which often requires collecting complex materials or elements.

Chinese: 因此这些限制，通常诅咒都会以他人为目标，否则在没有把握的情况下随意对自己释放很可能无法解除，甚至还会造成一些无法预计的后果。
English: Because of these restrictions, curses are usually cast on others. Using them on oneself without certainty can make them nearly impossible to undo, and may even lead to unforeseen consequences.

Chinese: 至于侍主大人无法唤醒克萝萝的这一点。
English: As for why Lord Oracle couldn't awaken Kuroro,

Chinese: 我想大概是这个诅咒将你们本是同源的力量判定为了是同一人，所以就变成了我上面所说的“自己无法解除”的情况。
English: I believe it's because the curse has mistaken your powers—originally from the same source—as belonging to a single entity. This lead to what I mentioned earlier: "a curse one cannot undo themselves."

Chinese: 对了，克萝萝的昏迷我推测应该也是体内能量流的紊乱在诅咒的影响下无法自我调节所造成的。
English: Also, I suspect Kuroro's coma is due to a disruption in her internal energy flow, made impossible to regulate under the curse's influence.

Chinese: 按你这么说的话，岂不是克萝萝自己对自己释放了诅咒？
English: So according to you, doesn't that mean Kuroro cast the curse on herself?

Chinese: 理论上来说应该是的，但这样不太符合逻辑。
English: Theoretically, yes, but that doesn't quite add up.

Chinese: 听到这里，我开始有了一些猜测，但就像安洁说的，这怎么想也不太对。
English: Hearing this, I began to form a few guesses of my own. But as Angie said, it still didn't make much sense.

Chinese: 虽然没太听懂，但是安洁你一定能解决的吧！
English: I don't really get all that, but Angie, I'm sure you'll figure it out!

Chinese: 如果只是预防的话也还好，可已经生效了的话…
English: If it's just a precaution, it's not too bad. But if the curse has already taken effect...

Chinese: 那解除的条件你有头绪吗？
English: Then do you have any leads on how to lift it?

Chinese: 我只能解析出这个诅咒有着和恶魔们气息相似的特征，但它的种类和展开构成我还不清楚。
English: All I can tell is that the curse features a trait similar to demonic energy. But as for its type or structure, I'm still in the dark.

Chinese: 那第二个办法呢，那些材料什么的，你懂得比我多，肯定知道是哪些吧！
English: Then what about the second method? You know more about materials than I do. You must have some idea, right?

Chinese: 我已经说过了，我还不知道它具体的种类…
English: I already said I don't know the exact type...

Chinese: 而且就算我知道需要什么，短时间内也不一定找得到。
English: Even if I did know what we needed, there's no guarantee we could find it quickly.

Chinese: 十天，十个月，十年，都有可能。
English: Ten days, ten months, ten years—it's all possible.

Chinese: 肯定不能等这么久，还是得从解除的条件这条路入手试试…
English: We can't afford to wait that long. Looks like our best bet is to focus on uncovering the conditions for breaking it...

Chinese: 诶，等等，刚才你说恶魔....
English: Hey, wait a second. You just mentioned demons...

Chinese: 我怎么把纳菲忘了，她不是在嘛。而且她刚刚还说这玩意有些熟悉，快把她找来。
English: How could I forget about Naphee? She's also here! And she just said this thing looked familiar. Quick, go get her.

Chinese: 对噢。
English: You're right!

Chinese: 我马上去，[var=Actor]你等等啊。
English: I'll go now. [var=Actor], please wait here.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 过了一会，律和纳菲回来了。
English: Some time later, Ritsu and Naphee returned.
Hmm...

Chinese: 纳菲盯着克萝萝额头上那个桃红色的印记，陷入了一阵苦思。
English: Naphee stares intently at the pink mark on Kuroro's forehead, getting lost in thought.

Chinese: 喔！难怪会觉得这么熟悉，原来是这玩意！
English: Oh! No wonder it feels so familiar. So it is this thing!

Chinese: 虽然改动了一部分，但一定是这个，不会错的！
English: Even though it's been changed a bit, I can tell—this is definitely it!

Chinese: 夸奖
English: Praise her

Chinese: 不愧是纳菲，关键时候还是有作用的嘛。
English: You're amazing, Naphee. We can always count on you when it matters.

Chinese: 哼哼哼，谁叫我是大恶魔纳菲。这点事，完全小问题嘛。
English: Hah! Of course! I'm the Great Demon Naphee! Something like this is a piece of cake for me!

Chinese: 诶不对啊，什么叫关键时候有作用，难道我平时就没用处嘛！
English: Wait, hold on! What do you mean "when it matters"? Are you saying I'm useless the rest of the time?

Chinese: 真正的恶魔之王心胸可不会这么狭隘。
English: The true Demon King wouldn't be so petty.
Ugh...

Chinese: 我记得这个图案对应的是一种叫“塞赫拉之吻”的诅咒，以前在家里秘藏的古书上看到过。
English: I remember this symbol corresponds to a curse called "Sehra's Kiss." I came across it once in an old, secret book back at home.

Chinese: 不过这种禁术应该早就没人用了才对啊….
English: But this kind of forbidden spell should've been long abandoned...

Chinese: 禁术？也就是说它很危险？
English: Forbidden spell? So it's dangerous?

Chinese: 这倒也不是…准确说是因为没有用它的必要…
English: Not exactly... It's just that there hasn't been any need to use it anymore.

Chinese: 那这个到底是用来干嘛的？
English: Then what was it used for?

Chinese: 这…这个嘛…
English: Well... um...

Chinese: 说起来有些羞耻，这其实是早先的恶魔们为了扩大种群而用来魅惑其他生物的…
English: It's a bit embarrassing to say, but... this was actually a spell early demons used to charm other beings in order to expand their population.

Chinese: 被下咒的目标会被施术者的某种魅力所吸引，从而疯狂地迷恋上对方。
English: The cursed target would become irresistibly attracted to the caster, falling madly in love with them.

Chinese: 但后来因为恶魔们发展壮大了起来，它也没了意义，于是方法就被封存起来了...
English: But as the demon race grew stronger, there was no longer any need for such a spell, so the method was sealed away...

Chinese: 要不是因为书上还有记载，我都不知道以前还有这些事。
English: If it hadn't been recorded in that old book, I wouldn't have even known its presence.

Chinese: 居然是这样啊...
English: I can't believe that's what it is...

Chinese: 那你知道怎么解开吗？
English: Do you know how to break it?

Chinese: 正常来说只要做一些指定的亲密行为就能解除掉。
English: Normally, it can be lifted by performing certain... intimate acts.

Chinese: 呃....亲密？那具体是？
English: Uh... intimate acts? Like... what exactly?

Chinese: 咳咳，这个...我不太好说....
English: Ahem... T-That's a bit hard for me to explain...

Chinese: 总之一般这个条件具体是什么也只有施术者才清楚。
English: Anyway, only the caster would know what exactly the condition is.

Chinese: 还是没办法啊....
English: Still no way, huh...

Chinese: 哎呀，你别急嘛。我好歹也是个大恶魔，可以试试看能不能破解掉它。
English: Ah, don't get so worked up. I am a great demon, after all. I can at least try to break it.

Chinese: 因为这个诅咒不带有攻击或者伤害性，所以用外部的力量冲破它的限制并对术式的构成进行覆写其实也是一种不算办法的办法。
English: Since this curse isn't offensive or harmful by nature, it might be possible to override its structure using an external force.

Chinese: 我转头看了看安洁，但安洁也只是摇了摇头，她并不是很赞同这样做。
English: I turn to look at Angie, but she simply shakes her head. She clearly doesn't approve of the idea.

Chinese: 可似乎目前也只有让身为恶魔同时也知道这个诅咒由来的纳菲试试了....
English: Seems like letting Naphee, who's a demon familiar with the origin of the curse, give it a try may be our only option...

Chinese: none
English: none
Ugh... my head...

Chinese: 到底是谁想出来的鬼才主意啊，把魔法和诅咒混在一起，弄得展开的回路全都搅成了一团。
English: Who came up with the idea to mix magic and curses together like this? The circuits are a complete mess now!

Chinese: 果然还是不行吗？
English: So, still no good?

Chinese: 呜....等我再试试。
English: Ngh... Let me give it another shot.

Chinese: 这时候房间外面传来了一阵吵闹的声音。
English: Suddenly, a commotion erupts outside the room.

Chinese: 想好等会怎么解释了吗？
English: Have you figured out what you're going to say?

Chinese: 如果你要是保持沉默的话，没关系，我也有办法。
English: If you're planning to stay silent, that's fine. I've got my own ways.

Chinese: 外面在干嘛啊？
English: What's going on out there?

Chinese: 这个声音....
English: That voice...

Chinese: 还没等我开口，门砰地一下被打开，而我看见牧拖着一个掩着面的少女走了进来。
English: Before I can respond, the door bursts open with a loud bang, and I see Muu dragging in a girl who is covering her face.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 你怎么跑到这来了？
English: Why did you come all the way out here?

Chinese: 我不是说了去查那件事嘛。
English: I told you I was looking into that matter, remember?

Chinese: 所以我才想知道为什么你在这。
English: That's why I want to know what you're doing here.

Chinese: 因为源头就是在这里啊，饲主大人还没反应过来吗？
English: Because the source is right here. Haven't you figured that out yet, Master?

Chinese: 牧的出现坐实了一部分我之前的猜想，但为什么耶坦尼娅会被她抓住，这反而让我更加迷惑了。
English: Muu's appearance confirms part of what I suspected before, but why would Yetannia get caught by her? That's what's really confusing me.

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅，你....
English: Yetannia, you...
Uh... well... I...

Chinese: 放心，你要是不好开口的话，那刚才的事我来帮你说。
English: Relax. If it's hard for you to explain, I'll help you out with what just happened.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在圣殿后院角落的一处空地旁出现了一个行迹可疑的人影。
English: A suspicious figure appeared near an open place in the rear courtyard of the Sanctuary.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 呼，还好，看起来这里还没有被发现。
English: Phew... well, looks like this place hasn't been discovered yet.

Chinese: 这些东西得赶快收拾掉，不然要是引起误会的话…
English: I need to clean all this up quickly. If someone misunderstands...

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅看了看地上画着的法阵和散乱的材料，脸上又露出了十分纠结的表情。
English: Yetannia looked at the magic circle drawn on the ground and the scattered materials, a conflicted expression returning to her face.

Chinese: 唉，也是因为我一时疏忽才搞成这样，不然克萝萝也不会…
English: Sigh... My negligence led to all this. If only I hadn't been so careless, Kuroro wouldn't have...

Chinese: 等之后事情解决了还是找个机会给侍主大人好好道个歉吧。
English: Once this whole thing is over, I should find a chance to apologize to Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 正当耶坦尼娅一边擦掉法阵一边搜集那上面的东西时，一个突然从阴影中闪出来的人紧紧抓住了她的手。
English: Just as Yetannia was wiping away the magic circle and collecting the items from it, a figure suddenly darted out from the shadows and grabbed her wrist tightly.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 什...什么！
English: W-What?!

Chinese: 你在这里做什么？
English: What are you doing here?

Chinese: 我也是听从侍主大人的安排，来这里看能不能找到一些有关克萝萝昏迷的线索。
English: I was... sent by the Lord Oracle to investigate and see if there were any clues about Kuroro's coma.

Chinese: 强压着心中的慌张，耶坦尼娅装作镇定的样子这样说着，她可万万没想到牧居然会在这里出现。
English: Suppressing the panic in her heart, Yetannia forced herself to appear calm as she spoke. She had never expected Muu to show up here.

Chinese: 噢？侍主大人的安排，你在胡说些什么？
English: Oh? Lord Oracle sent you? What nonsense are you talking about?

Chinese: 就是...
English: I... I mean...

Chinese: 比起这个，我想你是来拿走这些证据，对吧？
English: I'd say you're here to take away the evidence, aren't you?

Chinese: 当然，这些东西带回去说不定能对解决问题有所帮助。
English: Of course, taking these things back might help solve the problem.

Chinese: 我不清楚你到底想表达什么，但侍主大人还等着我回去。
English: I don't know what you're trying to imply, but Lord Oracle is waiting for my report.

Chinese: 这样啊，那还是就直接一些好了。
English: I see. In that case, let's be straightforward.

Chinese: 让我们来谈谈你刚才说的那些话是什么意思。
English: Let's discuss what exactly you meant by those words earlier.

Chinese: 还有在圣殿的后院里为什么出现了失传已久的”塞赫拉之吻“的仪式法阵以及为何恰好你又出现在这里。
English: And why a ritual circle for the long-lost "Sehra's Kiss" appeared in the Sanctuary's backyard, and last, why you happened to show up here?

Chinese: 面对着一脸阴沉的牧，耶坦尼娅只感到自己背后止不住地在冒冷汗，就像是在她面前站着的不是那个娇小的女孩，而是一只巨大的可怖怪兽。
English: As Yetannia stared at Muu's sullen expression, cold sweat trickled down her back. It feels as though the petite girl standing before her has transformed into a towering, fearsome beast.

Chinese: 就算自己再有能力，对于已经被牧所洞察到的事也不可能瞒得过去。
English: No matter how capable she was, there is no hiding what Muu had already seen through.

Chinese: （在这里都告诉她的话，她也不一定会相信，而且指不定她会做出什么事，还是回去是侍主大人面前去说更稳妥一些。）
English: (If I tell her everything here, she probably won't believe me anyway, and who knows what she might do. It's safer to explain things directly to Lord Oracle.)

Chinese: 好吧，确实是和我有些关系，但作为受到影响的当事人，侍主大人应该是需要最优先知道的。
English: Alright. It's true this has something to do with me. But as the one most affected, Lord Oracle deserves to know first.

Chinese: 毕竟没人应该，也没有权力可以僭越他。
English: After all, no one else should, or has the right to, overstep him.

Chinese: 您说是吧，审判长。
English: Don't you agree, Lord Inquisitor?

Chinese: 这种时候都还能有这样的判断，真不愧是”伟大的先知“。
English: Even in a moment like this, you can still make such a sound judgment... You're truly the "Great Prophet."

Chinese: 那么，跟我走吧。
English: Very well. Come with me.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 大概就是这样。
English: That's basically what happened.

Chinese: 我沿着气息发现那个法阵的时候就估计犯人应该之前是来不及处理掉，所以肯定会再回来。
English: When I followed the trail and found the magic circle, I realized the culprit hadn't had time to destroy the evidence, which meant they'd have to return.

Chinese: 不过来的人居然是耶坦尼娅小姐，这确实有些出乎我的意料。
English: But... I didn't expect the one to show up would be Lady Yetannia.

Chinese: 在牧的叙述下，现在事情的矛头指向了耶坦尼娅，一股极度压抑的气氛盘踞在房间的上方。
English: With Muu's account laid out, all suspicion now points toward Yetannia, and an oppressive tension spreads heavily over the room.

Chinese: 侍主大人，一定有什么搞错了，这些绝对不可能是她做的！
English: Lord Oracle, this must be some mistake! There's no way she could've done something like that!

Chinese: 况且这些恶魔们用的把戏，她用这些来做什么？
English: Besides, what would she even want with a demonic trick like that?

Chinese: 第一个站出来的人是普林普顿，她绝对不会接受自己的挚友被人这样看待。
English: The first to step forward is Princeton. She can never watch her dearest friend be treated this way.

Chinese: 我并不怀疑牧的判断，但是我也觉得事情肯定还有憋的隐情，你还是先冷静下吧。
English: I don't doubt Muu's judgment, but I also believe there's more than meets the eye. You'd better calm down.

Chinese: 虽然我可以通过星痕的力量来看到你所见到之事从而来得出真相，但现在大家都在等着一个解释。
English: While I could see what you've seen through Asters and piece together the truth... right now, everyone is waiting for an explanation.

Chinese: 而且，你也看到了我们暂时没办法解除掉这个诅咒。
English: Besides, as you've seen, we still can't lift this curse.

Chinese: 怎么会变成这样...连侍主大人都....
English: How did it come to this... Even you...

Chinese: 所以能请你把知道的一切都告诉我们大家吗，耶坦尼娅。
English: So, could you tell us everything you know, Yetannia?

Chinese: 好吧，这些错误我都会承担相应的责任和处罚，不过还希望大家明白我绝对没有任何的恶意。
English: Alright. I'll take full responsibility for everything. But please understand—there was never any malice behind my actions.

Chinese: 这点我们倒是清楚，毕竟诅咒的性质我们已经解析出来了。
English: We get that. After all, we've already analyzed the nature of the curse.

Chinese: 听到安洁的话，耶坦尼娅长舒了一口气，随后开始为我们说明事情的原委。
English: Hearing Angie's words, Yetannia lets out a deep breath and begins explaining what has happened.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 时间回到两天前...
English: Two days earlier...

Chinese: “我们彼此如同孤岛上的灯塔，即使遥遥相望，无法触碰、无法交流，但我们的光芒仍然会照耀着对方。”
English: "We are like lighthouses on the distant islands—no touch, no words—our light still reaches one another. "

Chinese: “但倘若是这样你也会感到迷失的话，那么就记得曾经的约定，让我们在月亮上相见吧。”
English: "But if such distance leaves you lost, then remember our promise—let us meet upon the moon. "

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 多美的句子，再加上这种相爱却彼此无法言语绝美故事。
English: What beautiful lines... paired with a tale of love so deep, yet forever unspoken...

Chinese: 简直是...
English: Wow...

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅抱着书在床上翻来覆去，脑子里全是她所看的小说里的情节，那些暧昧又浪漫的内容让她满脸通红。
English: Yetannia tossed and turned in bed, hugging her book tightly, her mind consumed with the heart-racing story pieces that left her cheeks flushed.

Chinese: 不过这时，一阵敲门声把她从幻想中拉了回来。
English: Just then, a knock on the door pulled her out of her daydream.

Chinese: 打开门后，一个同样捧着一本书的小毛球突然撞到了她的怀里。
English: When she opened it, a small fluffy ball—holding a book of her own—bumped straight into her arms.

Chinese: 克萝萝，你怎么在这？
English: Kuroro? What are you doing here?

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅姐姐，这个！
English: Sister Yetannia, look at this!

Chinese: 诶，稍等我看一看是...
English: Huh? Let me see...

Chinese: 顺着克萝萝手指的地方，耶坦尼娅读起了上面的内容。
English: Following Kuroro's pointing finger, Yetannia began reading.

Chinese: “幽静月夜之下，兰花静谧舒展，两人背靠而坐，讲述旅途，回忆过往，诉说心声。”
English: "In the serene embrace of the moon's gentle glow, the orchid extends its delicate tendrils, while two souls, in silent communion, share tales of their odyssey, weave memories of yesteryears, and bare their innermost reflections. "

Chinese: “彼此的眼中早已只有对方，在点滴的萤火中两个灵魂合为一体，永远不会分离。”
English: "In their eyes, only each other remains. Amid flickering fireflies, their souls entwine as one, forever inseparable. "

Chinese: “他们愿意守候对方的心情是名为爱情之物，而这比世间的任何情感与关系都更加鉴定，更加的不可割舍。”
English: "This bond of devotion is what mortals call love, stronger and more unbreakable than any emotion or relationship known to man. "

Chinese: 这不是《王国骑士》的第三卷嘛，我之前还找律借来看过。
English: Isn't this from volume three of Kingdom Knights? I borrowed it from Ritsu before.

Chinese: （没想到克萝萝居然对言情小说感兴趣...）
English: (What, Kuroro is into romance novels...)

Chinese: 这本小说我挺了解的，那这里是有什么读不懂的地方问我就好啦。
English: I know this book pretty well. If there's anything you don't understand, just ask me.

Chinese: 就是...
English: I... I mean...

Chinese: 克萝萝想知道怎么才能和哥哥有爱情。
English: I wonder how to have romance with Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 之前去问律姐姐的时候她脸红得半天也没反应，最后说这种事我还没必要知道...
English: I asked Sister Ritsu before, but she just blushed and froze up, and in the end said I didn't need to know such things...

Chinese: 于是克萝萝试了试看能不能在脑子里找一些相关的记录，但也完全搞不懂...
English: So I tried to dig through my memory for anything related, but it was all so confusing...

Chinese: 所以就来找同样知道好多好多事的耶坦尼娅姐姐啦！
English: So I came to you, Sister Yetannia, since you know so many, many things!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 克萝萝的回答让耶坦尼娅以为自己是听错了，可看到她一脸期待的表情，这又不像是开玩笑的样子。
English: Yetannia thought she must've misheard, but Kuroro's expectant expression was completely sincere. Definitely not a joke.

Chinese: 或者对于克萝萝来说，就算是开玩笑她也不会选择这种内容。
English: Then again, with Kuroro, this kind of joke wouldn't even occur to her.

Chinese: 克萝萝为什么想知道这个啊...
English: Why do you want to know about this, Kuroro?

Chinese: 书上说爱情是最好最好的关系，可以让两个人一直在一起，所以克萝萝也想要！
English: Since the book said love is the best kind of relationship that keeps two people forever together, I want that too!

Chinese: 虽然大体上不出所料，但克萝萝的理由还是让耶坦尼娅有些哭笑不得。
English: Though not entirely surprising, Kuroro's reason left Yetannia unsure whether to laugh or sigh.

Chinese: 就像律所说的那样，爱情的概念对克萝萝来说还太遥远了。
English: Just like Ritsu had said, the concept of love was still too far off for Kuroro.

Chinese: 现在的她还不需要知道这些，况且自己都没怎么有明白过的东西，又怎么能真正给她简简单单地说清楚。
English: She simply wasn't ready for it. And honestly, Even Yetannia herself didn't fully understand it. So how could she possibly explain it clearly?

Chinese: 不过克萝萝都找到这里来了，耶坦尼娅也知道自己要是不说点什么她是不会轻易放弃的。
English: Still, Kuroro had come all this way. Yetannia knew she had to say something, or Kuroro would never give up.

Chinese: 原来是这样啊~
English: Oh I see.

Chinese: 爱情可是很复杂的，而且也不是随随便便就能有的。
English: Well, love is complicated. It's not something you just get out of nowhere.

Chinese: 诶！那和哥哥岂不是…
English: Huh! Eh?! Does that mean Lord Oracle and I can't...

Chinese: 不用这么担心啦，你有的是机会。
English: Don't worry so much. You still have plenty of time.

Chinese: 嗯…
English: Mm-hmm...

Chinese: 不对！
English: Correction.

Chinese: 哥哥这次又出去了好几天，还不带克萝萝一起！
English: Lord Oracle went off again for days and didn't take me with him!

Chinese: 肯定…肯定是那条坏狗又在缠着哥哥！
English: It's definitely... definitely that bad dog clinging to him again!

Chinese: 一想到牧在[var=Actor]面前那副殷勤的样子，克萝萝就气得跺起了脚。
English: Imagining Muu being all fawning in front of [var=Actor], Kuroro stomped in frustration.

Chinese: 也许你可以试试让侍主大人多注意你一些？
English: Maybe you should try catching Lord Oracle's attention?

Chinese: 这个克萝萝知道，只要没事的时候就一直呆在哥哥的身边。
English: I know! Stay close to Lord Oracle all the time when he's free!

Chinese: 这件事克萝萝早就会啦，那耶坦尼娅姐姐的意思是克萝萝做得还不够多吗？
English: I already does that! So... do you think I'm not doing enough?

Chinese: 倒也不完全如此，我的意思是让侍主大人注意到克萝萝一些不同的地方，比如你可以让自己变得更具魅力一些。
English: Not exactly. I meant maybe you could try showing Lord Oracle something different. Like... make yourself more charming?

Chinese: （我到底在说什么啊，克萝萝哪会懂得魅力什么的...）
English: (What am I even saying? As if Kuroro understands what charm even is...)
Eh...

Chinese: 咳咳...像是可爱，就是个很好的方向嘛...
English: Ahem... Like being cute! That's a great place to start!

Chinese: 那具体该怎么办呀？
English: Then what should I do exactly?

Chinese: 这个就得靠克萝萝自己努力去想啦，毕竟爱情是要靠自己力量才能获得的。
English: You'll have to figure it out on your own. Love is something you need to fight for.

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅顺带着揉了揉克萝萝的脑袋，的确没人能拒绝这样可爱的她。
English: As she spoke, Yetannia gently ruffled Kuroro's head. Truly, who could resist someone as adorable as her?

Chinese: 喔，克萝萝大概明白了，嘿嘿~
English: Oh! I kinda get it now. Heehee.

Chinese: 得到答案的克萝萝露出了笑脸，然后转身就跑掉了。
English: With a big smile, Kuroro dashed off.

Chinese: 诶等等，你的书还没拿走...
English: Wait, you forgot your book...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 你这么一说我就想起来了，那天克萝萝是来问过我这个。
English: Now that you mention it, I do remember Kuroro came to ask me that same question.

Chinese: 之前我还看到她在图书馆里翻来翻去，我都有些好奇她在找什么。
English: I also saw her digging through books at the library, wondering what she was looking for.

Chinese: 不过...你说的这些还不是全部吧...
English: But... that still isn't the whole story, is it?

Chinese: 嗯...之后克萝萝拿着一些她手写的笔记来找我。
English: No... After that, Kuroro brought me some handwritten notes of hers.

Chinese: 说实话那些字写得歪歪扭扭的，有些地方连我也看不懂，但我确定那应该是某种简单的法术，
English: Honestly, the writing was so messy I could barely make some of it out. But I'm certain it was some kind of basic spell.

Chinese: 同时克萝萝也是这么和我说的，是她想拥有魅力的方法...
English: Kuroro told me it was a way for her to become more charming...

Chinese: 不过因为还缺少一些准备的材料，所以她让我帮一帮她。
English: But she was still missing a few ingredients, so she asked for my help.
And so...

Chinese: 于是你就真的按她说的做了？
English: So you actually went along with it?

Chinese: 我...想着这是举手之劳嘛...毕竟也不是什么危险的事。
English: I... I figured it was just a small thing. Nothing dangerous.

Chinese: 但如果真像你说的这样，按照步骤来的话并不该出现这种情况。
English: But if everything was done in order like you said, this shouldn't have happened.

Chinese: 问题就出在这...
English: That's where the problem started...

Chinese: 我按克萝萝说的释放完后，她立刻就像是被什么东西击中了一样昏了过去...
English: Right after I cast the spell as Kuroro instructed, she collapsed like something had struck her.

Chinese: 当时我也不清楚到底发生了什么...原本我还以为能靠自己解决掉这个问题，结果下午侍主大人您就回来了...
English: At the time, I didn't understand what had happened. I thought I could handle it myself. But then... you returned, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 好吧，事情的大概我清楚了。
English: Alright, I've got the general idea now.

Chinese: 那时牧挡下来的诅咒以及她为什么会查到这里来，这样一切就说得通了。
English: It all made sense—the curse Muu took upon herself and how she ended up tracing it back here.

Chinese: 那些事情你也不清楚的话，就先算了。但至于这个解除的方法，你应该清楚吧。
English: If there's more you don't know, we'll leave it for now. But as for lifting the curse, you do know how, don't you?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 这个的话，需要....
English: Well, it requires...

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅凑到了我耳边说起了悄悄话，而下一秒我就知道了为何她要这样做了...
English: Yetannia leaned in and whispered in my ear. Then, I understood why she did that.

Chinese: 嗯…那个…方法我是知道了，不过麻烦其他人先出去一下吧…
English: Um... well... I got the method, but could I ask everyone to step outside?

Chinese: 这这这…难道真的要…
English: W-wait... You're not seriously going to...?

Chinese: 真是精彩~
English: How exciting!

Chinese: 哎呀，就不要在这里给侍主大人添麻烦了。
English: Oh my, let's not trouble Lord Oracle any further.

Chinese: 其他人陆续离开后，房间里只留下了安洁、律、牧还有耶坦尼娅。
English: One by one, everyone left, until only Angie, Ritsu, Muu, and Yetannia remained.

Chinese: 呃...除了耶坦尼娅外，你们几个要不也先出去下？
English: Uh... could the rest of you—except Yetannia—leave too?

Chinese: 饲主大人真的不需要我的帮助嘛....
English: Master, do you really not need my assistance?

Chinese: [var=Actor]我也想帮帮忙，一定有什么是我能做的吧。
English: [var=Actor], I want to help too! There must be something I can do!

Chinese: 对于这种大家都还不完全确定的情况，我认为还是留下来稳妥一些。
English: Considering the uncertainties here, I believe it's best if we stay.

Chinese: （我是不想让她们看到我等会的样子，可万一真有其他情况的话...到底要不要她们留下来？）
English: (I just don't want them to see me what I'm about to be like... But if something really goes wrong... Should I let them stay?)

Chinese: 妥协
English: Compromise

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 思考过后，我觉得这并非没有道理，毕竟我心里也没有底。
English: After a moment of thought, I realize they have a point, since I'm not entirely confident.

Chinese: 好吧，要留下来也行，只是…
English: Alright, you can stay. But...

Chinese: 一会你们看到的东西，一定要忘掉…
English: Whatever you see later on... you must forget it.

Chinese: 听到这句话后，她们三个分别露出了茫然、惊恐和看戏的表情…
English: At that, the three of them respectively show confusion, horror, and anticipation...

Chinese: 算了，快点结束就行…
English: Never mind, let's get this over.

Chinese: 我突然走上前去一把把克萝萝抱了起来。
English: I suddenly step forward and scoop Kuroro up into my arms.

Chinese: 那个，我再确定一下…你是认真的，对吧…
English: Well, just to be clear... You're sure this is the real method?

Chinese: 都这时候了我怎么会骗侍主大人...
English: Would I lie to you at a time like this, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 好吧，说得也是...
English: Fair enough...

Chinese: 我咽了咽唾沫，让自己稍微镇定下来一些...
English: I swallow hard, trying to steady my nerves...

Chinese: 克萝萝，是最乖的！
English: Kuroro, you're the sweetest!

Chinese: 克萝萝，最可爱了！
English: Kuroro, you're the cutest!

Chinese: 克萝萝，哥哥最喜欢了...
English: Kuroro, I like you so much...

Chinese: 克萝萝，是哥哥最爱的人...
English: Kuroro, you're the one I love the most...

Chinese: 我单脚踮着脚尖，一边旋转一边跳跃，还得把克萝萝高高地抛起，同时在接住她的时候要说这些一看就是克萝萝一拍脑袋想出来的话....
English: On tiptoe, I spin and leap, tossing Kuroro into the air and catching her again, repeating lines that are clearly something she'd make up on a whim...

Chinese: 虽然我想要唤醒克萝萝的急切心情是不变的，但这一刻我也巴不得钻到地缝里消失得无影无踪...
English: Desperate as I am to wake Kuroro, I also wish I could just disappear into the ground from sheer embarrassment.

Chinese: 在这种极度尴尬的情景下，我的声音也越来越小...
English: My voice only grew softer and softer...
Pfft... Ahem!

Chinese: 这是在搞什么啊！！
English: What the heck is this even!?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 一番折腾下来后克萝萝毫无反应，我也没什么力气了。
English: After all that, Kuroro still doesn't respond. I am exhausted.

Chinese: 你确定...这样...真的有用？
English: Are you sure... this... is actually going to work?

Chinese: 是侍主大人的说得太小声了....而且还要多带一些感情...
English: It's because you said it too softly... and you need to put more feeling into it...
Just... give me a minute...

Chinese: 不过，你们看到没有啊，克萝萝头上的印记好像在动。
English: But—did anyone else notice? I think the mark on Kuroro's head is moving.

Chinese: 不，它在变得更亮...
English: It's glowing brighter...

Chinese: 要是你们还搞不定的话，就让我来试试吧。
English: If none of you can handle this, I'll give it a try.

Chinese: 毕竟在强大的力量面前，这种小把戏不值一提。
English: Compared to overwhelming power, this little trick is child's play.

Chinese: 不行呀，说不定你会伤到克萝萝。

Chinese: 克萝萝从脑海里搜索了米伦世界中有关使对方对自己着迷，爱上自己的方法，最后这个能立即起效的”塞赫拉之吻“引起了她的注意。
English: Searching her memories of Mirren, Kuroro comes across a spell called "Sehra's Kiss", a charm that could make someone instantly fall for her.

Chinese: 蚯蚓和石头可以在后院里挖，松果在公园能找到...锅灰的话...律姐姐平时好像是用魔法来生火做饭的...
English: Earthworms and stones can be dug up in the backyard... Pinecones can be found at the park... As for soot... Sister Ritsu usually cooks with magic...

Chinese: 可是这个眼泪要去找谁呀...
English: But where can I find the tears?
Hmm...

Chinese: 噢！克萝萝知道了！
English: Oh! Got it!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 当耶坦尼娅再次打开房门的时候，看到的是一身脏兮兮的克萝萝。
English: When Yetannia opens her door again, she is greeted by a filthy, dirt-covered Kuroro.

Chinese: 发生什么事了，你怎么搞成这个样子？
English: What happened to you? Why do you look like that?

Chinese: 快，耶坦尼娅姐姐，克萝萝要一点你的眼泪。
English: Quick! Sister Yetannia, I need your tears!

Chinese: 啊？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 没等耶坦尼娅反应过来，克萝萝就跑进了她的房间。
English: Before Yetannia can react, Kuroro dashes into her room.

Chinese: 她把一些散乱的纸张铺在书桌上，然后拉着耶坦尼娅说起了上面的内容...
English: She spreads out scattered notes on the desk and starts explaining the contents.

Chinese: “对他人...提高注意力...”
English: "Increase... attention from others..."

Chinese: “克萝萝...有魅力...哥哥会有爱情...”
English: "Kuroro... is charming... Lord Oracle will fall in love..."

Chinese: “进行所需的材料...”
English: "Required materials..."

Chinese: （克萝萝这写的都是些什么啊...）
English: (What in the world is Kuroro even writing?)

Chinese: （但这部分...像是某种仪式？）
English: (But this part... it feels like some kind of ritual?)

Chinese: 这个东西到底是用来干嘛的啊，你要不先告诉我。
English: What exactly is this for? Can you explain before we go further?

Chinese: 就是克萝萝用来解决问题的办法啦！
English: It's my way to fix everything!

Chinese: 有了这个东西的祝福，一定会管用的！
English: With this spell's blessing, it's sure to work!

Chinese: 要不你还是先等等，我觉得这有点乱来了。
English: Maybe you should slow down a bit. This all seems a little reckless.

Chinese: 不会啦，耶坦尼娅姐姐只用给我一点眼泪就好了。
English: Don't worry! You just need to give me a tear!

Chinese: 就算我想给你，也给不了呀，我又没办法一下子哭出来…
English: Even if I wanted to... I can't just cry in an instant...

Chinese: 嗯…好像是喔！
English: Oh... that's true...

Chinese: 好啦，你还是再想想吧，要不回头等侍主大人回来了我帮帮你？
English: Come on, think it over again. When Lord Oracle comes back, I'll help you talk to him, alright?

Chinese: 然而克萝萝似乎并没有听耶坦尼娅说的，只是直勾勾地看着她。
English: But Kuroro doesn't seem to hear her. She just stares straight at Yetannia.

Chinese: 那个，有哪里不对吗？
English: Is something wrong?

Chinese: 有办法啦！
English: I know what to do!

Chinese: 诶？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 克萝萝突然跳到了耶坦尼娅的身上，用双手挠起了她的腰。
English: Kuroro suddenly leaps onto Yetannia, tickling her sides.

Chinese: 这是...做什么...
English: Wha—what are you doing?

Chinese: 好...好痒啊...哈哈...克萝萝...快停...停一下...
English: I-it tickles! Haha! Kuroro! Stop—stop it!

Chinese: 哎呀...快松开...要痒死了...哈哈...哈哈...
English: Gah—let go! I'm gonna die of laughter... Haha... haha!

Chinese: 克萝萝就像黏在了她的身上一样，根本甩不掉。
English: Kuroro clings to her like glue, completely unshakable.

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅完全无力反抗，在她笑得最激烈的时候，克萝萝用一旁拿过来的被子接住了眼泪，随后一溜烟地又跑掉了。
English: Yetannia has no strength to fight back, and just when her laughter peaks, Kuroro catches a tear in a nearby blanket and darts away.

Chinese: 过了好一阵，耶坦尼娅才缓过神来。
English: It takes Yetannia a while to catch her breath.

Chinese: 到底是搞什么啊，莫名其妙的....
English: What in the world was that... totally absurd...

Chinese: 小孩子的想法真是难懂，唉，不过只要别闯祸就行了。
English: Kids really are unpredictable... but as long as she's not causing harm, I guess it's fine.

Chinese: 但说起来，做一些祈祷或者祝福的仪式用得上这些材料吗？好像有哪里不太对啊...
English: Still, using these kinds of materials for a blessing or ritual? That seems off...

Chinese: 想到这里，耶坦尼娅开始思索这样的感觉从何而来...
English: The thought unsettles her. She begins to recall a strange feeling...

Chinese: none
English: None

Chinese: 就是这样，所有东西都准备好啦！
English: Everything's ready now!

Chinese: 在后院的空地上，克萝萝用找来的锅灰按照记载的样子画出了施法所需的阵列。
English: In the clearing of the backyard, Kuroro has drawn the required ritual array using soot from a cooking pot.

Chinese: 哼哼~等哥哥回来的时候一定会只想着克萝萝了，以后出门也会都带着克萝萝一起去。
English: Hehe. When Lord Oracle gets back, all he thinks about will be me! And he'll bring me along wherever he goes.

Chinese: 诶，对了，这个要怎么释放来着？
English: Ah, wait, how do I activate this?

Chinese: 喔，差点忘了，还需要再设置一下解除的条件。
English: Oh, I almost forgot—I still need to set the breaking condition.

Chinese: 记得是需要一些亲密的接触才行...
English: It has to involve some kind of intimate contact...

Chinese: 不过克萝萝干嘛要解除这个啊...
English: But why would I even want to break it?

Chinese: 算啦，随便想一个好了，就哥哥需要当着别人的面做….
English: Eh, whatever! I'll just set it to something like... Lord Oracle has to do it in front of someone else...

Chinese: 当克萝萝开始大声咏唱解除的条件时，远处的耶坦尼娅急匆匆地赶了过来...
English: Just as Kuroro begins loudly reciting the breaking conditions, Yetannia comes rushing in from the distance.

Chinese: 那股不安让她去翻阅了一下自己曾经的笔记，再加上过去的一些回忆，她猛然想起克萝萝要做的根本就不是什么祝福仪式，而是诅咒。
English: That uneasy feeling has driven her to flip through her old notes. With the help of some fragmented memories, she suddenly realizes the ritual Kuroro is attempting isn't a blessing but a curse.

Chinese: 克萝萝，这个是诅咒，不能随便乱放的！
English: Kuroro! That's a curse! You can't just cast that!

Chinese: 快停下来！
English: Stop it now!

Chinese: 没等耶坦尼娅走到面前，克萝萝脚下的法阵便开始发光。
English: But before Yetannia can reach her, the array beneath Kuroro's feet begins to glow.

Chinese: 来不及了，希望这招能管用吧...
English: Too late... Hope this works...

Chinese: 神恩之语，万物缄默，以我心为锁，万法皆止！
English: Words of Divine Grace, let all things fall silent. With my heart as the seal—let all magic cease!

Chinese: 紧急时刻耶坦尼娅尝试用自己的封印魔法中止诅咒的发动，可是她忘记了一件事，克萝萝也是她的力量来源之一...
English: In a desperate moment, Yetannia tries to interrupt the curse with her sealing spell. But she has forgotten one crucial fact—Kuroro is one of her own sources of power.

Chinese: 当二者碰撞在一起后，克萝萝下意识地吸收了这股力量，这使得她脚下的法阵也变得更加强大。
English: When the two magics collide, Kuroro instinctively absorbs the energy, unintentionally strengthening the array beneath her.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 最后，一个加强了数倍且混杂了耶坦尼娅魔法的“诅咒”被释放了出去。
English: In the end, the curse—now amplified many times over and laced with Yetannia's magic—is unleashed.

Chinese: 可随着法阵的黯淡，克萝萝却如同断线的木偶一样，突然晕了过去...
English: But as the glowing fades, Kuroro collapses like a puppet with its strings cut.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 耶坦尼娅原来自己还多揽了一部分责任....
English: Yetannia ends up shouldering even more responsibility than she originally intended...

Chinese: 大概就是这些。后面不知道为什么克萝萝睡着了，等醒来的时候哥哥就在了。
English: That's about all I remember. I fell asleep after that, and when I woke up... you are already there.

Chinese: 诶，等等，哥哥身上没有那个法术的气息...
English: Wait a sec—why don't I feel the spell's presence on you?

Chinese: 这是怎么回事...
English: What's going on?

Chinese: 察觉到和自己预想有出入的后，克萝萝表现得有些慌张。
English: Kuroro seems visibly rattled after realizing something isn't right.

Chinese: 而搞清楚了事情的全貌后，我也是该表态的时候了。
English: And now that I fully understand what has happened, it's time I said something.

Chinese: 现在应适当教导
English: Time for a gentle lesson

Chinese: 我把她昏迷时的经过说了出来，而她听到后，耳朵和尾巴都有些蔫了下去。
English: I explain what has happened while she was unconscious. As I speak, her ears and tail droop in guilt.

Chinese: 这次哥哥出去，克萝萝没有乖乖的…
English: I wasn't a good girl while you were away...

Chinese: 这确实很惊险啊，刚才大家也都担心了很久。
English: It really was dangerous. Everyone was so worried.

Chinese: 呜…
English: Ugh...

Chinese: 克萝萝只是想…
English: I just wanted...

Chinese: 应该是知道我实际上并没有真的想责怪她的意思，克萝萝无处安放的尾巴开始在我的手上蹭个不停。
English: She must've realized I'm not really angry, because her restless tail begins brushing against my hand again.

Chinese: 但我认为还是有必要让她对自己做的事有一些清楚的认识，这也是为了她以后能有更正确的判断力。
English: Still, I think it is important to let her know what she has done—not to scold her, but to help her grow.

Chinese: 在做这些事前，克萝萝想过会如何吗？
English: Before you did all this, did you think about the consequences?
Ugh...

Chinese: 也不用那么紧张，就有什么说什么嘛。
English: No need to be nervous. Just tell me honestly.

Chinese: 就...就是想着能和哥哥亲近一些，能像那些有爱情的人一样。
English: I... I just wanted to be closer to you. Like how people in love are.

Chinese: 然后等哥哥回来的时候，就可以一直呆在哥哥旁边哪里也不去了。
English: So when you come back, I could always be by your side.

Chinese: 那，还有别的吗？
English: Was that all?

Chinese: 克萝萝想想...
English: Let me think...

Chinese: 应该没有了...
English: Yep. That's all...

Chinese: 那像这样的意外是没想到的吧。
English: So you didn't expect something like this to happen, right?
Mm...

Chinese: 要是克萝萝能想到的话，就不会这样了...
English: If I had thought it through, it wouldn't have turned out like this...

Chinese: 顺着她摇来摇去的尾巴，我轻轻摸了两下。
English: I gently pat her wagging tail.

Chinese: 诶？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 你看，有很多事也是光靠自己对付不了的，尤其还是像这样贸然做决定的情况下。
English: See? There are things you can't handle alone—especially not when you act without thinking.

Chinese: 但耶坦尼娅姐姐也说过要靠自己的力量...
English: But Sister Yetannia said... I should rely on my own strength...

Chinese: 你再好好想想，你用的方法真的是自己的嘛...
English: Think again. Was what you used really your own strength?
Mm...

Chinese: 这个是恶魔们用的东西，不是克萝萝的。
English: That spell is something demons use. It's not really mine...

Chinese: 所以说嘛，这可不算是你自己的力量喔。
English: Exactly. So it doesn't count as your own strength, does it?

Chinese: 呜...克萝萝怎么连这个也搞错了...
English: Ugh... I can't believe I got even that wrong...

Chinese: 那对克萝萝来说，爱情和被我多摸摸脑袋，以后能一起多待一些时间这两个里更想要哪个呢？
English: So, Kuroro—if you had to choose, would you rather love, or just have me pat your head more and spend more time together?

Chinese: 后面的，后面的那个！
English: The second one! Definitely!

Chinese: 爱情有麻烦，但这个没有。
English: Love sounds like trouble. That one's simple.

Chinese: 倒也不是这样，不过爱情有时候确实会麻烦又复杂。
English: Well... love can be complicated and troublesome at times.

Chinese: 大家都这样说啊...
English: Everyone says that...

Chinese: 这样的话，咱们理一理，克萝萝这次没做对的地方是？
English: Then let's sort this out. What did you do wrong this time?

Chinese: 嗯...做事之前多想想，没有把握的不要随便决定。
English: Umm... I should think more before I act, and not make reckless decisions.

Chinese: 还要在哥哥不在的时候，再多乖乖听话一些...
English: And when you're not around, I should behave well...

Chinese: 我原本并没有想克萝萝刚才说的那句话，当我听到的时候便忍不住露出了欣慰的笑容，用手像是奖励一般摸着她的小脑袋。
English: I haven't expected her to say that last part. I can't help but smile, and give her head a rewarding pat.

Chinese: 她也一扫刚才的不安，立刻活泼了起来。
English: Her gloom instantly vanishes, replaced with bubbly energy.

Chinese: 欸嘿嘿，克萝萝是听话的好孩子，要一直都是。
English: Ehehe! I'm a good girl! And I'll always be!

Chinese: 嗯哼，但是要靠你自己的力量去做到喔。
English: Mhm. But you've got to do that using your own strength.

Chinese: 嗯！
English: OK!

Chinese: 其实因为心灵相通的缘故，这样的交流是一件没有效率的事。
English: Honestly, considering how deeply we're connected, having this kind of conversation is inefficient.

Chinese: 但能通过这样的方式让克萝萝自己有所领会，我想才是意义所在。
English: But I believe helping Kuroro reach understanding on her own is what truly matters.

Chinese: 这时，一阵敲门声又响了起来。
English: At that moment, there is a knock at the door.

Chinese: [var=Actor]，你俩好了没有呀，晚饭已经好了哟。
English: [var=Actor], are you two done yet? Dinner's ready!

Chinese: 马上就来。
English: We're coming!

Chinese: 克萝萝，要吃好多盘！
English: I'm going to eat so much!

Chinese: 这时，她又抬头看了看我。
English: She look up at me again.

Chinese: 对了，然后还要帮律姐姐收拾餐具。
English: Oh! And I'll help Sister Ritsu clean up too!

Chinese: 嗯，到时候我们一起弄吧。
English: Sounds good. Let's do it together.

Chinese: 好！
English: Sure!

Chinese: 这倒是无伤大雅
English: No real harm done

Chinese: 在我看来这次并不存在谁真正有过错一说，而且让刚恢复克萝萝一时间接受太多的话，我想也不是个太好的选择，还是之后再说吧。
English: In my view, no one was really at fault this time. And dumping too much on Kuroro right after she woke up wouldn't help either. It'd be better to talk more later.

Chinese: 那个方法因为你和耶坦尼娅的意外而没有成功喔。
English: The spell didn't work because of the clash between you and Yetannia.

Chinese: 诶，怎么会这样…
English: Eh? Really?

Chinese: 不过话说回来，克萝萝也不用靠那些东西。
English: But honestly, Kuroro, you don't need things like that anyway.

Chinese: 在我眼里克萝萝本来就很可爱了，要是再让我多注意的话我就没办法做其他事了。
English: To me, you're already plenty adorable. If I paid more attention to you, I'd never get anything done.

Chinese: 那克萝萝会影响哥哥的工作吗？
English: Would I get in the way of your work?

Chinese: 没有啦，倒不如说每次劳累过后看到克萝萝可以让我又有精神呢。
English: Not at all. Actually, seeing you after a long day gives me the energy to keep going.

Chinese: 欸嘿~
English: Ehehe.

Chinese: 对了，这个给你。
English: Oh, right—this is for you.

Chinese: 这时我才想起来自己带给克萝萝的小礼物还被扔在一边。
English: It suddenly hits me that I've brought a small gift for Kuroro.

Chinese: 那是一把手工制作的大木梳，因为考虑到克萝萝平时经常用手去搓自己的尾巴而特意买的。
English: A large, handcrafted wooden comb I picked up, knowing how she often messes with her tail.

Chinese: 好大啊，和克萝萝的尾巴一样。
English: It's so big! Just like my tail!

Chinese: 这样才方便嘛。
English: That makes it useful.

Chinese: 哥哥送的，克萝萝喜欢！
English: It's from you—I love it!

Chinese: 以后就不要再用手去弄自己的尾巴了，用这个吧。
English: So don't use your hands on your tail anymore. Use this instead.

Chinese: 嗯！
English: OK!

Chinese: 看起来她已经把之前的那些事抛在了脑后，但这样也好，我和她都不用有太大的负担。
English: She seems to have completely moved on from earlier. And honestly, that is fine—it means neither of us have to carry any lingering weight.

Chinese: 这时，一阵敲门声又响了起来。
English: At that moment, there is a knock at the door.

Chinese: [var=Actor]，你俩好了没有呀，晚饭已经好了哟。
English: [var=Actor], are you two done yet? Dinner's ready!

Chinese: 马上就来。
English: We're coming!

Chinese: 克萝萝，要吃好多盘！
English: I'm going to eat so much!

Chinese: 那就看看谁会赢吧。
English: Let's see who can eat more.

Chinese: 肯定是克萝萝更厉害~
English: I'm definitely going to be the winner!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在之后过了一段时间，我们似乎都忘记了那次事件，直到某天我才忽然想起来。
English: Some time passed, and we all seemed to forget what had happened—until one day, the memory came rushing back to me.

Chinese: 我心里其实有些担心我不在的时候克萝萝又会做出一些让人感到匪夷所思的事，于是我打算再看看她是如何。
English: I have a slight concern that Kuroro might do something bizarre while I'm not around, so I decide to check on her.

Chinese: 当我从书桌旁站起来时，原本趴在一边的克萝萝走到了我的身旁。
English: As I stand up from my desk, Kuroro, who has been curled up nearby, walks over to my side.

Chinese: 克萝萝，一直乖乖的，就算哥哥不在也不会捣乱。
English: I'm being good. Even if you're away, I won't cause any trouble.

Chinese: 嗯，我的克萝萝最乖，最可爱了。
English: Mhm, you're the sweetest and the cutest.

Chinese: 那，摸摸头~
English: Then... head pats!

Chinese: 嗯哼。
English: Mm-hmm.

Chinese: 是啊，相通的心灵下，她又怎么会不知道，只是她在按自己的理解和努力弥补自己的过错。
English: Yes... With a bond like ours, of course she knows. She is trying to make up for her mistakes in her own way.

Chinese: 即使我从来没有责怪她的想法。
English: Even if I never once blamed her for any of it.

Chinese: 回过头来，我才发现克萝萝在我身边也陪伴了这么久了。
English: Looking back, I realize Kuroro has been by my side for so long now.

Chinese: 要是稍不注意，她也是会成长得很快啊....
English: She'll grow up before I even notice...

Chinese: 询问情况
English: Ask how she's feeling

Chinese: 克萝萝还有哪里感觉不对或者说不舒服的地方吗？
English: Kuroro, is there still anywhere that feels off? Or something bothering you?
Mm...

Chinese: 就是脑袋还有些晕乎乎的。
English: My head still feels kinda dizzy.

Chinese: 克萝萝好像睡过头了...
English: I might've overslept a bit...

Chinese: 克萝萝身上的诅咒应该是解除了，至于头晕应该是体内的紊乱造成的，之后再休息一下大概就没什么问题了。
English: The curse on Kuroro should be lifted by now. The dizziness must be due to residual inner instability. A bit more rest and she'll likely be fine.

Chinese: 你抓着耶坦尼娅干嘛？
English: Why were you grabbing Yetannia?

Chinese: 因为我恰好在案发现场抓到了耶坦尼娅小姐哟~
English: Because I happened to catch Miss Yetannia at the scene of the crime!

Chinese: 案发现场，不会是....
English: Scene of the crime? Don't tell me...

Chinese: 就是饲主大人所想的那样。

English: Oh no, Master, you misunderstand. You know I don't want to be here either. But looking at the big picture—it's necessary.

English: Exactly. To push for real change, sometimes you need to play the long game.

Chinese: 下午还请您专注一点，要想争取到足够的改革资本，光“有理”可不够，还得“有据”。
English: This afternoon, you'll need to stay focused. Being "right" isn't enough—we also need "evidence."

English: That's fine. You don't have to understand it yet. It's not important for you right now.

English: Umm, I don't get it... but can I keep helping this afternoon?

English: Of course. Overall, you did a pretty good job this morning.

Chinese: 我还在犹豫怎么跟克萝萝解释，就发现一道绿色的身影在门口探头探脑。
English: I'm thinking how to explain when I notice a flash of green peeking in from the door.

Chinese: 转念一想，还是让她实际体验下比较容易明白。
English: Then I think—maybe it's easier to let her experience it firsthand.

Chinese: 专注甜点的克萝萝还没发现魔镜视野的边缘多了个人，我出言提醒——
English: Kuroro's still focused on her sweets, unaware of the new figure at the edge of the mirror's view. I speak up to alert her.

Chinese: 然而，作为地点的提议者，坐在我对面的魔女此时却一脸愁容。
English: But the Nova who suggested it has a worried look.

Chinese: 菜可都要凉了。
English: The food's getting cold.

Chinese: 你刚才肯定全听到了……
English: You heard everything... right?

Chinese: 你刚才的碎碎念？我是听到你打算带我先来餐厅，你好像已经做好了计划。
English: You mean what you were mumbling about? I heard that you planned to bring me here and had everything figured out.

Chinese: 那当然——呃没有！
English: Of course—eh not!

Chinese: 那、那个，平常你这个时间都刚起，今天怎么这么早？
English: Um, um, you usually wake up around this time. Why are you up so early today?

Chinese: 还想岔开话题，明明是她每天起得太早……这个家伙。
English: She tries to change the subject, but it is clear she got up early every day...

Chinese: 我得逗逗她。
English: I can't resist teasing her.

Chinese: 原来你什么计划不做就喊我出来……
English: So you dragged me out here without any plans...

Chinese: 当然不是！我可辛辛苦苦——
English: Of course not! I work so hard—

Chinese: 辛辛苦苦？
English: Work so hard?

Chinese: ——没有！没有计划！有也不告诉你！快点吃饭啦！
English: —No! No plan! Even if there is one, I won't tell you! Let's eat!

Chinese: 你就告诉我吧？
English: Can you just tell me?

Chinese: 才不~快吃饭！快吃饭！吃完饭再说~
English: No way—Now eat! Just eat! We'll talk after we eat.

Chinese: 现在还是先吃饭。这家店我也是听别人说的，提供的菜品非常多，而且要是想，客人还能借用店里的厨房和食材，自己做饭。
English: Let's eat now. Some people told me about this restaurant. They said it offers a wide variety of dishes and even allows customers to use their kitchen and ingredients to cook their own food.

Chinese: 你再看这几道菜，蜜汁鱼冻、肉末粉丝煲，还有这个千丝烧麦，这些都是店里的精品菜，据说每天都限量呢！
English: Look at these dishes: honey fish jelly, minced meat vermicelli casserole, and shredded steamed pork dumplings. These are the hot dishes, but they're only made in limited amounts each day!

Chinese: 不一定比你做得好。
English: I doubt they could be better than what you make.

Chinese: 胡说些什么呢！这、这菜都上齐了……
English: Don't be ridiculous! All of the dishes have been served...

Chinese: 真想吃？
English: Do you really want me to make something?

Chinese: 那肯定，你做的饭是我吃过最好的美味。黑神她们也这么认为，不信你问问？
English: Of course. Your food is the best I've ever had. Miss Kurokami and the others agree. If you don't believe me, just ask them.

Chinese: 哼……这也是当然的！
English: Hmm... yeah, I guess that's true!

Chinese: 那你等一下，我去借用一下厨房！很快回来！
English: Hold on, I'm going to the kitchen! Be right back!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: ——哇啊！抱、抱歉，差点撞到你了！
English: —Whoa! Sorry for almost running into you!

Chinese: 一大段时间过后。
English: What seems like an eternity later.

Chinese: 等了很久，律才带着极大的阵仗回到了我的视野中。
English: Ritsu finally returns to great fanfare.

Chinese: 她手里托着两盘菜肴，身后还带着一个厨师模样的人物，那人手推着一个大型的铁厨具，上边串着着一块呈焦红色的炙热肉块。
English: Her arms are laden with two plates of culinary delights. Behind her is a figure, who seems like a chef, pushing a cart that bears the weight of a hefty iron rack. Perched atop is a skewer of meat, its surface has been lightly charred by flames.

Chinese: 呃哈哈……让你久等……因为看到了这个铁架子，所以我没忍住借用了一下。
English: Haha... so sorry for keeping you waiting... I saw this iron rack and just had to use it.

Chinese: 还不赖。
English: Not too shabby.

Chinese: 嘿嘿！那你不看看我是谁~
English: Hee hee! Who do you think I am?

Chinese: 律将菜肴连同那巨大肉块，一同放在了餐桌上。
English: Ritsu sets down the dishes and the massive piece of meat on the table.

Chinese: 虽然还想用这种特制厨具做更多的料理，但那花的时间就要更长了，所以现在就只做了这些。
English: I wanted to make more dishes with their special equipment, but that would take forever. So, I just made these for the time being.

Chinese: 还有就是，嗯……虽然兴致很高地做完了，但用这种“野蛮”的方式制作料理……其实我也是第一次。
English: Also, um... even though I was all fired up about cooking, this is actually my first time doing it like this.

Chinese: 所以我希望你……能第一个尝尝。
English: So, I want you to be the first to try it.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 律拿起小碗，将食物分好，端到我的面前。
English: Ritsu scoops up the small bowl, portions out the food, and brings it over to me.

Chinese: 说实话，律这次的烹饪的确出乎我意料。
English: To be honest, I can't believe how incredible Ritsu's cooking is this time.

Chinese: 第一道是粥，使用小火精煮，加入鱼肉与虾仁，再用少量细盐调至咸鲜。
English: The first dish is a slow-cooked porridge with fish and shrimp and just a pinch of salt to keep it fresh.

Chinese: 因为是刚出锅的，还很烫，你要小心！
English: Be careful, it's still steaming hot!

Chinese: 来来，还有这个跟这个！
English: Dig in! Try this one and that one!

Chinese: 又是两道餐品。
English: Two more dishes follow.

Chinese: 一道是炭烤蘑菇，用木炭加热烹炒，加上独特的香辛料点缀，卖相营养双收。
English: One is grilled mushrooms with charcoal and some fancy spices. It looks amazing and is filled with nutrients.

Chinese: 另一道则是从刚才起就夺食客眼球的巨大肉排，它摆在特制的铁板上，炭火的余热让这块肉排发出嗤嗤的诱人肉香。
English: The other is a huge steak that catches everyone's attention. It sits on a special iron plate, still sizzling from the charcoal fire.

Chinese: 律用刀和铁签将肉排做成方便食用的小串……
English: Ritsu slices it into bite-sized pieces with a knife and skewer.

Chinese: 锯齿兽的肋排，我也没想到这家餐厅会有这样的食材，还带了相应的厨具~
English: Sawtooth spareribs. I didn't expect a place like this to have these types of ingredients, let alone the equipment needed to prepare them.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 这种做法是参照过去，猎人们现烤现吃的样子，所以趁热吃更好哦！
English: This is the way hunters used to eat, so we should eat it while it's still hot!

Chinese: （细嚼慢咽）
English: (We took our time chewing.)

Chinese: 架不住律的热情，我将每道菜都享用了一番。
English: Unable to resist Ritsu's enthusiasm, I savor every bite.

Chinese: 虽说我从不对律的厨艺抱以否定，但这三道菜确实独特。
English: I have never doubted Ritsu's cooking skills before, but these three dishes are beyond my imagination.

Chinese: 粥谷香浓郁，蘑菇清爽可口，肉排鲜美多汁。而各异的风味又在口中化开，并恰到好处地融合在一起，犹如黄金。
English: The porridge is full of flavor, the mushrooms are cool and tasty, and the meat is juicy and tender. The flavors blend together in my mouth—pure gold.

Chinese: 能做出这种程度的料理，如律自夸的那样，这么长时间绝不白等。
English: Eating something this good is worth every second of waiting.

Chinese: 怎么样怎么样！（夸我夸我！）
English: What do you think of my skill? (Praise me! Praise me!)

Chinese: （真的好明显……不过现在就纵容一下吧。）
English: (She's practically glowing... but I should let her bask in her own glory for now.)

Chinese: 美味！你怎么做到的？
English: Wow, that's some serious flavor! How'd you manage that?

Chinese: 对吧对吧，我跟你讲哦，蘑菇要去柄，然后肉排处理就更麻烦……
English: Right, right... let me tell you how it's done... You have to remove the mushroom stems, then deal with those messy spareribs...

Chinese: 在律的滔滔不绝中享用了大餐。
English: I savor every dish while Ritsu goes on about her cooking process.

Chinese: 饱了……
English: I'm stuffed...

Chinese: 我也……吃不下了……
English: I can't eat another bite...

Chinese: 虽然有尽力去吃，但这些料理绝不是两个人就能解决的，尤其是那块还剩一半的肉排，让我觉得这甚至有些浪费。
English: Even though I tried to keep up, these dishes were way too much for two people—especially the half-eaten spareribs. It feels like a waste.

Chinese: 呃，剩下的就打包吧，食物不能浪费……
English: Well, let's pack up what's left. Food this good shouldn't go to waste...

Chinese: 不过这个分量得问问……店员？
English: But I have to ask... how much is it?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 两位客人，有什么需要帮助吗？
English: How can I help you?

Chinese: 是这样……（讲述了自己的需求）
English: I mean... (I explained our situation.)

Chinese: ……我了解了，是可以的，我们会为您打包需要的餐点，您也可以选择寄放，待到您事务办妥后取回。
English: Alright, I understand. Don't worry, we'll pack up your food. You can leave everything here and pick it up later when you're done with your errands.

Chinese: （跟律说得一样，一家令人满意的老店。）
English: (Ritsu was right. It truly is a satisfying old-timey restaurant.)

Chinese: 那我先去结账。
English: OK, I'm checking out.

Chinese: 那麻烦将这个跟这个都替我打包，还有肉排需要单独一份。
English: Pack up these two for me, and the spareribs should be packed separately.

Chinese: 我明白——
English: OK—

Chinese: <size=50>呜哇啊啊啊———！！！</size>
English: <size=50>Whoa aah—!!!</size>

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 所以……没带钱？
English: So... you forgot your wallet?

Chinese: 呃哈哈，昨天确实有把钱包放在床头，但出门的时候忘记拿了。
English: Oops, haha, I put it on the nightstand last night and forgot to grab it when I left.

Chinese: 把账单给我看看……
English: Let me see the bill...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 从迷雾森林运回来的兽排，风暴海的鱼肉虾仁……珍贵的食材，原来如此。
English: These steaks are from the Misty Forest, and the fish and shrimp are from the Storm Seas—high-quality ingredients. I see.

Chinese: 得益于圣殿颁布的商业法令，这些稀有的食材虽有，但供应也是相当有限，应该不会低成本地放上餐桌。
English: Thanks to the Sanctuary's business decree, we can get these rare ingredients, but they're not cheap.

Chinese: 不过这不是我该思考的问题。
English: Still, that's not what I'm worried about.

Chinese: 钱的事你不用担心，实际上刚才店主有向我们……主要是向你请求帮助。
English: Don't worry about the cost. The owner actually asked us..., or rather, you... if you could provide some assistance.

Chinese: 求助？
English: Assistance?

Chinese: 也可以理解成委托——他看见了你那块锯齿兽排，从来没有人能把它制作得那么好，希望你能再演示一次。
English: You could think of it as a commission. He saw your sawtooth spareribs. Nobody's ever prepared them quite like that, and he wants you to show off your skills again.

Chinese: ……就这样？
English: Is that all?

Chinese: （但肉排料理起来可麻烦了，从零开始大概要1个小时……不，2个小时。）
English: (But making sawtooth spareribs is no joke. It takes about two hours to get it just right.

Chinese: （不过万一厨房里有处理好的呢？我之前好像瞥见一块，那只要半个小时！）
English: Unless you prepare them ahead of time? I think I've seen that before. If that's the case, it could be ready in half an hour!

Chinese: （但也只是瞥见，没确认过，说不定是我看错了。）
English: But I'm not sure if I saw it right.)

Chinese: 看你的表情好像挺……纠结？
English: You seem a bit conflicted.

Chinese: 不是，还有其他方法吗？
English: No, is there another way?

Chinese: 有，而且更简单。
English: Sure, there's an easier option.

Chinese: 回去拿钱，从这里到圣殿，来回应该一个小时。
English: Just go back and get your wallet. It'll take about an hour to get from here to the Sanctuary.

Chinese: 也要一个小时……
English: An hour...

Chinese: （两个方法都这么花时间啊……本来是做好计划，打算陪[var=Actor]好好玩一整天的，他最近一直都很忙……）
English: (Both options are time-consuming... I had planned to spend the whole day with [var=Actor] since he's been so busy lately...)

Chinese: 当然我还可以和店主说明情况，把账单送去神谕司就好。
English: Of course, I can also talk to the owner and have the bill sent to the Oracle Division.

Chinese: 不行！怎么能这么利用特权——多不名誉啊！
English: No way! That would be abusing our power—it's not right!

Chinese: 这不算特权。
English: This isn't about our power.

Chinese: 唔……拿出神谕司的身份，大家的对待方式都会不一样，可我们只是来吃饭而已。
English: Well... if we tell them we're from the Oracle Division, we'll get special treatment, but we're just here for a meal. No harm done, right?

Chinese: （总要懂得变通……）
English: (Don't be so stubborn...)

Chinese: 虽然想这么说，但律的眼神让我放弃了说这句话。她对此事似乎相当坚决，也不知心底是在怎么想。
English: I wanted to say it, but Ritsu's determined look stopped me. She seems pretty set on this, and I can't figure out what she was thinking.
Um...

Chinese: 还是你选吧！
English: It's your call!

Chinese: 怎么忽然——
English: Why are you so indecisive—

Chinese: 不知道不知道，你选！你可是我们的侍主大人，当然要决策！
English: I don't know what to do, so you decide! You are Lord Oracle, so you should have the final say!

Chinese: ……那我想想。
English: Then let me ponder over it.

Chinese: （第一个方法用时似乎更短，但我不太懂厨房的事，可能也更长？）
English: (The first option might be quicker, but I'm not much of a cook, so maybe it will take longer?

Chinese: （第二个方法胜在固定，只要一个小时就能返回。）
English: The second option is more reliable and can be done in an hour.

Chinese: （看律的模样，她应该是想尽快解决这件事吧？我到底是稳妥起见，还是……）
English: Based on Ritsu's expression, she probably wants to sort this out quickly. Am I being cautious, or...?)

Chinese: 我们留在这里。
English: We'll stay here.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 在餐厅工作了几个小时……
English: After working in the restaurant for a few hours...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 啊啊啊~没想到肉排虽然有处理好，但厨具却忽然坏掉了，修理花了好长时间……是我之前用得太过分吗？
English: Ahhh, the steak cooking went smoothly, but then the kitchen tools my lord broke down and took ages to fix... Did I push them too hard?

Chinese: 实际上在厨具损坏后，店长就说了我们可以先离开。
English: Actually, after the kitchenware broke, the owner said we could leave.

Chinese: 那不行！毕竟我们说好的，就算做不了肉排，也要用别的补偿！
English: No way! We agreed that if we couldn't cook spareribs, we'd make up for it in some other way!

Chinese: 结果没想到花了这么长时间……计划完全泡汤了啦……
English: I didn't expect it to take so long... The plan fell apart...

Chinese: （但刚才明明笑得那么开心，完全是因为你料理上了头……）
English: (But you were grinning from ear to ear just now because you were enjoying the cooking so much...)

Chinese: 往好处想，至少我们对得起自己的良心。
English: At least our consciences are clear.

Chinese: 而且你的料理也大受欢迎。客人对你赞不绝口，连店家都说你不当厨师真是可惜呢！
English: And your cooking is extremely popular. The customers loved it, and even the owner said it was a shame you're not a chef!

Chinese: 那是，也不想想我是谁！
English: Well, of course. Who do they think I am?

Chinese: 不过我可没有当厨师的打算，我的料理可不是随便什么人都能吃的。
English: But being a chef is not one of my goals, and my food isn't for just anyone.

Chinese: 所以说，你每天能吃到这么好吃的料理，应该多多感谢我才对！
English: So, you're indebted to me since you get to enjoy such tasty meals every day!

Chinese: 我一直都很感谢你。
English: I'm always thankful for that.

Chinese: 咦？是、是这样吗……别这么肉麻啦！
English: Huh? Is that really true... Don't be so sentimental!

Chinese: 不过……还是有点可惜。
English: But... it's still a bit of a shame.

Chinese: 她话锋一转。
English: She snaps herself back to the present.

Chinese: 可惜什么？
English: What's a shame?

Chinese: 嗯……在这里花的时间太久了，都没有好好做完计划里的事情。
English: Well... I've spent so much time here and didn't get to do what I planned.

Chinese: 我本来是打算让你好好放松的，结果没想到忘记带钱，还当了半天的厨师。
English: I wanted you to relax, but I left my wallet at home and ended up cooking all day.

Chinese: 我早就知道了。
English: I knew what you were up to the whole time.

Chinese: 咦，你知道我的想法？
English: You knew my plan?

Chinese: 你亲自告诉我的。
English: You pretty much told me yourself.

Chinese: 不是……你没有说出来，但表情暴露了。
English: No... You didn't say it directly, but your look said it all.

Chinese: 而且，还有一件事你想错了。
English: And there's one more thing you missed.

Chinese: 但是，我今天只是在做菜，而你就是坐着……
English: But I was just cooking today, and you were just sitting...

Chinese: 这就是我想要的——跟圣殿无关的日常。况且这还是你为我准备的。
English: This is what I wanted—a day outside the Sanctuary. Plus, you made all of this for me.

Chinese: 以后也抽空出来玩吧？还是两个人，我跟你。
English: Can we spend more time together? Just the two of us?

Chinese: 那，一言为定？
English: Do you agree?

Chinese: 一言为定。
English: It's a deal.
Alright...

Chinese: 那你就好好期待下一次吧！我会做好更完美的计划，会让你好好放松！
English: Then I look forward to next time! I'll make sure it's a perfectly relaxing time!

Chinese: …………我会期待。
English: I can't wait.

Chinese: 看着洋洋自得的律，心底又莫名生出了不安的感觉。
English: As I look at how relaxed Ritsu is, I feeel an inexplicable wave of anxiety.

Chinese: 我不觉得今天有浪费时间，我感到很放松。
English: Today wasn't a waste of time. It was actually quite relaxing.

Chinese: 我们稳妥起见。
English: To be on the safe side,

Chinese: 那就是留一个人在这咯？那你留下吧，我脚程更快，能更早回来！
English: should we have someone stay here? Then you stay. I can walk quicker and get back faster!

Chinese: 不，我去，你都替我准备了大餐，这点小忙就让我帮你吧。
English: No, I'll go. You made a feast for me, so let me return the favor.

Chinese: 你正好休息一下。
English: You can get some rest too.

Chinese: 欸……那，你要早点回来，要记住你今天可是来休息的，别到处乱跑！
English: Eh... just make sure you come back early. Remember, today's your day off. Don't overdo it!

Chinese: （你以为我是你吗……）
English: (I won't push myself like you...)

Chinese: ……我知道。
English: Got it.

Chinese: 那……好吧，一定不要太久哦，我在这等你！
English: Well... alright, don't take too long. I'll be waiting!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 意外地在餐厅外遇见了米娅……
English: I unexpectedly bump into Mia outside the restaurant...

Chinese: ……啊哈哈，所以你才急匆匆往圣殿赶啊。
English: Ha! So that's why you were rushing to the Sanctuary.

Chinese: 不用那么急，不就是出门忘记带钱嘛！我借你，来，拿好！
English: Don't worry about it. You just forgot to bring money with you. Here, I'll lend you some money.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 哎你就收下吧！不过下次记得注意哈，毕竟没钱很不方便的。玩得开心！
English: Just take it. But make sure to remember your wallet next time. It's a hassle to be without money. Enjoy yourself!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 回餐厅把律带了出来……
English: I went back inside and brought Ritsu out...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: ……原来如此，所以你才这么快就回来。
English: Ah, that explains how you got back so quickly.

Chinese: 就当做是运气好吧！等我回圣殿就把钱还她，不过现在我们去下个地方！
English: I was pretty lucky! I'll pay Mia back when we're back at the Sanctuary, but for now, let's head out!

Chinese: 接下来要去哪？
English: Where are we off to?

Chinese: 跟我来吧，保准让你满意！
English: Come with me. You're in for a treat!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 锵锵！想不到吧，你肯定没有来过这里！
English: Clang clang! You never thought you'd end up here, did you?

Chinese: 嗯……确实没来过。
English: Well... this place is new to me.

Chinese: 这是一家开在商业街深巷中的一家书店，远离街道的喧闹，店内的留声机流淌出唱片悠扬的乐曲。
English: We have arrived at a quaint bookstore tucked away in a quiet alley off the shopping street, far from the city's noise. The store plays melodious tunes from old vinyl records.

Chinese: 诊断的结果说这恐怕是千蝶菇和茶叶混合后的成分引起了肠胃的某种反应。虽然谈不上有多危险，可我是免不了一顿折磨了。

Chinese: 别慌，医生已经都告诉我该怎么做了
English: Don't worry. The doctor told me what to do.

Chinese: 总之…我肯定会让你马上好起来的！
English: Anyway, I'll have you back on your feet in no time!

Chinese: 于是，我又被迫在床上休息了两天…
English: And so I end up stuck in bed for two more days...

Chinese: 沉默
English: Silent

Chinese: 关心
English: Show your concern

Chinese: 你没事吧，有伤到哪里吗？
English: Are you alright? Did you hurt yourself?

Chinese: 你让我缓缓，我想想有没有。
English: Give me a second to think.

Chinese: （这是给她撞懵了吗…）
English: (Did that smack rattle her brain?)

Chinese: 拒绝她
English: Refuse her

Chinese: 我隐约觉得要是这样做了很可能会发生不好的事，于是想想还是算了。
English: I get the sense something bad could happen if I accept, so I decide against it.

Chinese: 我在你眼里就这么弱嘛…
English: Do you really think I'm that weak...

Chinese: 哎呀，我不是那个意思…
English: No, that's not what I mean...

Chinese: 就是前面的路还有那么长，就…
English: It's just we still have a long way to go...

Chinese: 我也是开个玩笑而已，不过你也太容易上钩了。
English: I'm just messing with you. But wow, you take the bait way too fast.

Chinese: 哼！那你想拿就自己拿吧！
English: Hmph! Then carry it yourself if you want!

Chinese: 她的脸有些涨红，不过这种路途上一些小打小闹的气氛我还是挺喜欢的。
English: Her cheeks flush, but I enjoy this light-hearted banter on the road.

Chinese: 要是换成除了律之外的人，估计就很难做到了…
English: If it were anyone else, it probably wouldn't be possible...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 剩下的路上我一直留意着四周，好在并没有发生什么糟糕的事。
English: I keep my guard up the rest of the way, and thankfully nothing else happens.

Chinese: 我们倒带目的地的时间和预计相比并没有差多少，我想也许有时候避开自己记忆中的部分应该也是一种降低风险的选择。
English: We arrive pretty much on schedule. Maybe sometimes steering clear of what's in my memory is another way to cut risk.

Chinese: 希望剩下的也是如此吧。
English: I hope the rest goes just as smoothly.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 你看，我这个帐篷搭得怎么样？
English: See? How's my tent?

Chinese: 结实倒是挺结实的，可只有一个也有点…
English: It's sturdy enough, but only bringing one...

Chinese: 我想了想，带两个小的不如带一个大的，这样住一起的话有什么也好照应。
English: I figured one big tent would be better than two small ones. If we stay together, we can look out for each other.

Chinese: 话是这么说，但你不觉得这空间还是太小了么？而且晚上岂不是也很不方便…
English: Still, don't you think the space is too small? Won't it be inconvenient at night...

Chinese: 哪里有不方便的地方嘛，明明就…
English: What's so inconvenient? I mean...

Chinese: 好像是有点…
English: Maybe you're right...

Chinese: 突然想到这点的律挤出了一个生硬的笑容来掩饰尴尬，但脸上的红晕出卖了她。
English: Realizing what they implied, Ritsu forces a stiff smile to hide her blush, but the red in her cheeks gives her away.

Chinese: 反正睡袋带了两个，到时候注意一点就行。
English: We have two sleeping bags, so we'll manage.

Chinese: 好啦好啦我知道的，你不用再强调一次。
English: Alright, alright, I get it. No need to repeat.

Chinese: 对了，这会我打算去准备晚饭，你要不去休息下？
English: I'm going to start dinner. Why don't you rest?

Chinese: 同意
English: Agree

Chinese: 也行，正好我也走得有点累了。
English: Sure, I'm a little tired too.

Chinese: 那我去躺一会，要是有什么就叫我。
English: I'll lie down. Call me if you need anything.

Chinese: 嗯哼，不过我感觉都不用这样，一会我做饭的时候你闻着味就来了。
English: Well. Though I don't think you'll need to, you'll come running when you smell the food.

Chinese: 有这么夸张吗…
English: Am I that predictable?

Chinese: 反正你多期待一下吧。
English: Just look forward to it.

Chinese: 她嘴里哼着歌，把包里的东西一样样拿出来，那些有条理的排列一看就是精心准备过的。
English: She hums a tune as she takes everything out of her bag one by one, laying them out in such neat order that it's clear she planned this all ahead of time.

Chinese: （我能记得的就大概到这个地方了，可之后的怎么办？）
English: (My memory only goes up to here. What happens next?)

Chinese: （不过都已经顺利到这里了，应该也都还好吧。）
English: (But we've made it here, so it should be fine.)

Chinese: 我心中还是有一些不安，躺在帐篷的床铺上一刻不停地在回想这些。
English: Unease still tugs at me. I lay on the cot, replaying everything.

Chinese: 不知不觉间，我逐渐睡了过去…
English: Before long, I drift off...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 律并没有来叫我，等我醒来的时候天色已经暗下去了。
English: Ritsu never comes to fetch me. When I wake, it's already dark.

Chinese: 我走出帐篷，发现还烧着的锅的一旁空空如也。
English: I step out of the tent and see the pot still simmering, but the spot beside it is completely empty.

Chinese: （她去哪了？）
English: (Where did she go?)

Chinese: 满怀疑惑的我在营地附近逛了一圈，依旧没见到她的身影。
English: Puzzled, I take a lap around the camp, but still don't catch even a glimpse of her.

Chinese: （糟了，该不会是出什么意外了吧。）
English: (Darn, did something happen?)

Chinese: 律！
English: Ritsu!

Chinese: 听得到吗？
English: Do you hear me?

Chinese: 哎呀别叫啦，我在这儿。
English: Quit yelling, I'm over here.

Chinese: 额呀！
English: What!

Chinese: 你怎么了，没事吧！
English: What's wrong? Are you alright?

Chinese: 没事没事，就是不小心脑袋撞到了。
English: I'm fine, just banged my head.

Chinese: 伴随着脚步声越来越近，她从帐篷后面的树林中钻了出来。
English: She comes out of the trees behind the tent as her footsteps draw near.

Chinese: 你去哪儿了？
English: Where did you go?

Chinese: 我看这周围有不少好东西，于是就去弄了点。
English: There was so much good stuff around here, so I went to gather some.

Chinese: 就像展示自己的战利品一样，她把手里装着蘑菇、香草叶还有许多我不认识的野果和鸟蛋的篮子在我面前晃了晃。
English: Like showing off loot, she shakes a basket filled with mushrooms, herbs, berries I can't name, and bird eggs.

Chinese: 然而她这样的擅自行动也是之前不少意外发生的原因，我想也许我该提醒她一下。
English: But her solo expeditions have caused plenty of mishaps before. Maybe I should say something.

Chinese: 觉得这还是无所谓
English: Decide it's not worth making an issue.

Chinese: 但毕竟她也不是有意的，就还是算了吧。况且已经发生的事，我感觉现在再去说也没什么用了。
English: She's not doing it to annoy me. Besides, what's done is done.

Chinese: 其实原本你带的那些差不多够我们吃了。
English: What you packed originally was enough.

Chinese: 放心啦，肯定不会浪费的，而且正好你也醒了，再准备下咱们就可以开饭了。
English: Relax, none of it will go to waste. And now that you're up, we can finish prepping and eat.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 这个炖锅、烤串、还有这些小菜，果然还是得你做才行。
English: This stew, those skewers, and all these little sides, yeah, they only taste right when you're the one cooking them.

Chinese: 哼哼，别的我不敢说，但就这方面的话，没人比我更懂你的口味。
English: Well, I won't brag about anything else, but when it comes to your taste no one knows it better than me.

Chinese: 她还伸出双手做了个十分得意的手势…
English: She even strikes a triumphant pose...

Chinese: （这个她说得倒是一点没错。）
English: (Can't argue with that. This is true.)

Chinese: （嗯…要是她把这种能力挪一些到其他的地方就好了。）
English: (Well... If only she'd apply that talent to other things.)

Chinese: 阿嚏！
English: A-choo!

Chinese: 奇怪，难道是有人在说我坏话？
English: Weird, is someone badmouthing me?

Chinese: 啊哈哈..应该是你的错觉吧。
English: Haha... probably just your imagination.

Chinese: （沙沙）
English: (Rustling)

Chinese: （脚步声）
