English: The bushes behind the tent stir, and both of us tense up.

Chinese: 这脚步声很重，听起来这家伙的个头应该不小。
English: The footsteps are heavy, whatever it is, it's big.

Chinese: 它停下来了，是冲我们来的？
English: It stopped. Is it coming for us?

Chinese: 我不好说…
English: I'm not sure...

Chinese: 不过晚上在这种地方要是遇上什么大型动物的话也不是什么值得高兴的事，而且万一它要还不是动物的话…
English: Running into a large animal here at night isn't something to celebrate. And what if it's not an animal...

Chinese: 那要不你在这待着，我上去看看？
English: Maybe you stay put, and I'll take a look?

Chinese: 保持警戒
English: Keep your guard

Chinese: 不知道是什么的情况下还是先不要轻举妄动。
English: It's best not to do anything rash when we don't know what it is.

Chinese: 说得也对，不过你还是往后退一点吧。
English: Agreed. But step back a little.

Chinese: 我和她都摒住了呼吸，只有营火噼啪燃烧的声音、飞过的夜鸦的嘶叫声以及彼此砰砰的心跳声。
English: We both hold our breath. The only sounds are the crackling fire, night ravens screeching overhead, and our pounding hearts.

Chinese: （沙沙）
English: (Rustling)

Chinese: 在没被火光照亮的阴影处，一对犄角慢慢从中探了出来。
English: From the shadows beyond the firelight, a pair of antlers slowly emerge.

Chinese: 什么嘛，原来是一头鹿…
English: Come on, it's just a deer...

Chinese: [var=Actor]你也太敏感了。
English: [var=Actor], you're way too jumpy.

Chinese: 我这不是以防万一嘛…
English: I'm just being cautious...

Chinese: 嘿嘿，快过来~
English: Hehe, come here.

Chinese: 她拿起一根之前切剩下的萝卜，简单的招呼了两下就把那头鹿引了过来。
English: She picks up a leftover carrot and gives a little call, and the deer comes right over.

Chinese: 鹿这种动物挺怕生的，不过看起来它倒是挺喜欢你。
English: Deer are usually skittish, but this one seems to like you.

Chinese: 要不你也试试摸摸它？
English: Want to try petting it?

Chinese: 刚说完，那头鹿就转头看了我一眼，随后流露出一种带有嫌弃的目光。
English: As soon as she finishes, the deer shoots me a look of utter disdain.

Chinese: 我还是算了吧…
English: I'll pass...

Chinese: 要是多点时间让它熟悉下你就好了.
English: If we had more time to let it get used to you.

Chinese: 不如我们把它带回去?
English: Why don't we take it back?

Chinese: 想法是挺好的,就是估计没地方能养，而且它也应该有自己所属的群落，贸然带走它也并不是好事。
English: Good idea, but there's nowhere to keep it, and it must have its own herd. Taking it away isn't right.

Chinese: 说的也对…
English: True...

Chinese: 不过来都来了，你也和我们一起吧。
English: But since you came all this way, join us.

Chinese: 正好，我看刚才还有一些剩下的食材。
English: I see there's still some ingredients left.

Chinese: 哎呀，把人家叫过来，你怎么能让它只吃这些？
English: Hey, if you're inviting someone, you can't just serve scraps!

Chinese: 就这样,这头突然闯入的鹿也加入了我们的饭桌。
English: And with that, the unexpected deer joins our meal.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 果然，[var=Actor]就是[var=Actor]，一点都不喜欢运动，吃了饭就找个地方躺着了。
English: As expected, [var=Actor] is [var=Actor]. Zero interest in exercise, they eat, then immediately find a spot to lie down.

Chinese: 收拾完餐具和垃圾的律走到我身边坐了下来。
English: After clearing the dishes and trash, Ritsu sits down beside me.

Chinese: 毕竟是休息日嘛，也是出来玩的，你还是放过我吧…
English: It's a day off, after all, we're supposed to be relaxing, cut me some slack...

Chinese: 看在你今天的运动量上，我就不计较了~
English: I'll let it slide since you actually moved today.

Chinese: 虽然口头上是这么说，实际上我其实是想找个地方在脑子里再过一过这些。
English: Though that's what I say, what I really want is just a quiet spot to sort through everything in my head.

Chinese: 今天是发生了很多事，不过重点应该还是这最后的流星雨。
English: A lot happened, but the main focus is still the meteor shower.

Chinese: 说起来…
English: By the way...

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 都到这会了，除了和你一起来野营外，别的什么都没做。
English: We've made it this far and done nothing but camp.

Chinese: 不是说要解决问题嘛，但我感觉只是这样好像不太对…
English: Weren't we supposed to fix this? It feels wrong to stop now...

Chinese: [var=Actor]，你是不是有什么在瞒着我？
English: [var=Actor], are you hiding something from me?

Chinese: 坦白
English: Confess

Chinese: 我自己一个人憋着也不会有什么作用，其实想想就算是告诉她也无妨。
English: Keeping it to myself won't help, and telling her might even be okay.

Chinese: 该怎么说呢，就是…
English: How should I put it, well...

Chinese: 我其实并没有什么确定的办法，只是在尝试而已，至于尝试的内容就是看能否把今天糟糕的事都避免掉，顺利地过完这一天。
English: I don't have a solid solution. I'm just seeing if avoiding all of today's disasters and getting through smoothly will change things.

Chinese: 怎么会这样…
English: How'd that happen...

Chinese: 要是这条路也行不通的话，大不了就再重新开始。
English: If this doesn't work, we'll start again.

Chinese: 退一步说，你今天也为我做了不少事，要是没有你的话恐怕我也没那么顺利能走到这里。
English: And you've done so much for me today, without you I wouldn't have made it this far.

Chinese: 还好啦，也不是什么很重要很了不起的。
English: It's nothing big.

Chinese: 不过嘛，有一点我也希望你能够清楚。
English: But there's something I want you to understand.

Chinese: 你说说看？
English: What?

Chinese: 要是没有你的话，我也不会来这里了。
English: If it weren't for you, I'd never have come here.

Chinese: 我用笑容回应了她，而她也是如此。
English: I smile at her, and she smiles back.

Chinese: 天边突然响起了雷声。
English: Thunder rumbles at the edge of the sky.

Chinese: 我注意到有厚重的乌云正冒着雷光往我们这边飘来，同时还裹挟着地面的阵阵寒风。
English: I see thick clouds lit with lightning drifting our way, carrying a chill wind.

Chinese: 这看起来完全就是要下雨的样子啊！
English: That looks like a downpour!

Chinese: 也不一定，说不定它只是光响一声。
English: Not necessarily, maybe just thunder.

Chinese: 我有不太好的预感，要不你还是少说两句？
English: I've got a bad feeling about this... Could you just stop?

Chinese: 不至于…吧…
English: It can't be... right...

Chinese: 还没等她说完，雨滴便落了下来。
English: Before she can finish, the rain begins.

Chinese: 别说了，先把外面的东西收进去！
English: Talk later, get everything inside!

Chinese: 哎，你等等我！
English: Wait for me!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 没一会外面的雨便大了起来，不过好在我们动作够快。
English: Within moments the rain is pounding, but we move fast.

Chinese: 果然还是解决不了啊…
English: So we still can't fix it...

Chinese: 没想到最后的大问题是这个天气。
English: I never thought the final obstacle would be the weather.

Chinese: 按你那样说的话，这个方式从一开始就不可能成功，我想和你一起看的东西也是…
English: If you're right, this method was doomed from the start. And what I wanted us to see...

Chinese: 她说得没错，事已至此，不管是她还是我都已经无法改变这些一开始就注定好的。
English: She's right. At this point, neither of us can change what's been set from the start.

Chinese: 没关系，我们有的是机会。
English: It's fine, we'll have other chances.

Chinese: 好啦，[var=Actor]你也不用再这样安慰我啦，我没你想的那么娇气，我就只是说说而已。
English: Come on, [var=Actor], you don't have to console me. I'm not that fragile, I'm just saying.

Chinese: 对了，要不我们早点休息？之后你应该又要去试别的办法，要是状态差了可不行。
English: By the way, we should get some sleep. You'll be trying other methods. You need to be in good shape.

Chinese: 同意
English: Agree

Chinese: 也好，那就早点休息吧。
English: Alright, let's call it a night.

Chinese: 今天也确实折腾了不少，过得也很累，不好好睡一觉可不行。
English: Today really has worn us out. we've been through a lot, and we won't make it without a good night's sleep.

Chinese: 那个…
English: Um...

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 没什么，睡吧。
English: Nothing else. Sleep.

Chinese: 你确定？我看你一副有什么话要说的样子。
English: You sure? You look like you're about to say something.

Chinese: 肯定是你想多了。
English: You're imagining things.

Chinese: 哎呀，你就是太敏感了，这样可不行。
English: You're too sensitive, that's not good.

Chinese: （她好像不太想说，继续问估计也没什么结果…）
English: (She doesn't want to say. Pushing won't help...)

Chinese: 那你也快睡吧，之后的话我们还有很多事要做。
English: You go to sleep. We still have a lot to do later.

Chinese: 嗯，晚安。
English: Yeah. Good night.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 过了一段时间后。
English: After a while...

Chinese: [var=Actor]，你听到了吗，雨停了呢。
English: [var=Actor], did you hear? The rain stopped.

Chinese: 睡得很死啊…
English: He's out like a log...

Chinese: 也没办法，谁让今天的事这么多。
English: Can't blame him after a day like today.

Chinese: 说起来，要是一开始换点别的计划就好了。
English: Come to think of it, maybe we should've gone with a different plan.

Chinese: [var=Actor]？
English: [var=Actor]?

Chinese: 嗯…还是算了吧。
English: Well... Maybe not.

Chinese: 律一个人悄悄走出了帐篷，在她看来这是为今天自己的付出寻找一种慰藉。
English: Ritsu quietly slips out of the tent alone; to her, it's a way to find comfort for all she did today.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 他怎么这么慢，难道是还在收拾吗？
English: Why's he taking so long? Still packing, maybe?

Chinese: 律穿过圣殿内的走廊，正快步朝着[var=Actor]的房间走去。
English: Ritsu walks through the hallway, heading toward [var=Actor]'s room.

Chinese: 而在房间之中，我正等待着她的到来…
English: Meanwhile, I'm in my room, waiting for her arrival...

Chinese: 拒绝
English: Refuse

Chinese: 还好吧，这个点我还不怎么困。而且有这么多事，要轻轻松松就睡着也不是容易的事…
English: I'm fine. I'm not very sleepy yet. After everything that happened, it's hard to just fall asleep...

Chinese: 那好吧，我先睡了，你别太晚噢。
English: Alright, I'm turning in. Don't stay up too late.

Chinese: 嗯，今天还是辛苦你了，晚安。
English: Yeah, thanks for today. Good night.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 油灯灭掉后，我们各自钻入了自己的睡袋。
English: The oil lamp goes out and we crawl into our sleeping bags.

Chinese: 她那边很安静，而我则还在不停思考今天所经历的每件事当中的细节。
English: It's quiet on her side while I replay every event in my mind.

Chinese: 不知道过了多久后…
English: After some time...

Chinese: [var=Actor]，你睡了吗？
English: [var=Actor], are you asleep?

Chinese: 没有，还醒着。
English: No, I'm still awake.

Chinese: 啊哈哈…我就是随便试试，没想到你还在熬…
English: Haha... I was just testing, didn't think you'd still be up...

Chinese: 怎么，有我在你睡不着吗？
English: Well, can't sleep with me here?

Chinese: 哎呀，这种事，你说呢！
English: Well, what do you think?

Chinese: 睡不着也挺好的，不然你的呼噜声就要被我听到了。
English: Not sleeping means I won't have to hear you snore.

Chinese: 哪有！
English: No way!

Chinese: 好啦好啦，要是你觉得不自在的话，我再挪过去一点？
English: Alright, if you're uncomfortable, I'll scoot over.

Chinese: 不…不用…这样也行…反正又看不到…

Chinese: 而且这里我们也不是很熟，要是一个人乱跑的话没准会遇到什么危险。
English: And we're not that familiar with this area. Going off alone could be dangerous.

Chinese: 她没有像平时那样为自己辩解什么，把头默默低下了去，这让我意识到自己的语气有点重了。
English: She doesn't defend herself like she normally would. She just lowers her head. I realize my tone was harsher than necessary.

Chinese: 其实她也是一片好心，我也用不着非得这样。
English: She meant well, after all. I don't have to say so.

Chinese: 嗯…我可能说得有点不合适，但也没有怪你的意思。
English: Well... Maybe I came off wrong. I'm not blaming you.

Chinese: 你真的不生气吗？
English: You're not mad?

Chinese: 你又没犯错我干嘛生你的气，只是你这样会容易让我担心。
English: You didn't do anything wrong. I'm just worried you'll get into trouble if you go alone.

Chinese: 那这些额外的加餐就当成对你的补偿，可以吗？
English: Then these extra dishes can be your compensation, deal?

Chinese: 嗯，正好我也饿了。
English: Works for me, I'm hungry anyway.

Chinese: 那咱们准备一下就开饭吧。
English: Then let's get ready and eat.

Chinese: 律，那个…
English: Ritsu, that...

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: 没什么，就是感觉有点辛苦你了。
English: Nothing, just feel like you did all the work.

Chinese: 你要是这么想，一会可得多吃点。
English: If you think that, then you'd better eat more.

Chinese: 那当然。
English: Of course.

Chinese: 刚才那一刻我大概有不少话想和她说，因为想到了有她这样一个人总是在我的跟前忙前忙后，而这些从来也都是为了我而已。
English: A moment ago I had so many things I wanted to say, realizing she's always bustling around me, always for my sake.

Chinese: 不知道为何，那些脑子里的话最后只简化成了这短短的一句，我想也许是我以前没有怎么去在意这点吧。
English: Somehow all those thoughts came out as one simple sentence, maybe I've never really appreciated it.

Chinese: 拒绝
English: Refuse

Chinese: 如果是平时的话我自然会接受她的提议，可现在不行。
English: Normally I'd take her offer, but not now.

Chinese: 虽然这短暂的宁静让我有些放松，但现在我又忍不住开始去思考那些麻烦事，因为我原本的记忆就到这个地方。
English: This brief calm relaxes me, but then I'm pulled back to all the problems ahead, this is as far as my memory goes.

Chinese: 也就是说，之后的事我就只有完全靠自己的猜测。
English: In other words, everything that happens next... I can only rely on my own guesses.

Chinese: 不用，我还不是很累。
English: No, I'm not that tired.

Chinese: 听起来感觉有点勉强啊，你真的没问题吗？
English: Sounds like you're forcing it. You sure you're okay?

Chinese: 嗯哼，不用担心。
English: Yeah. Don't worry.

Chinese: 你这副表情…肯定有哪里出问题了。
English: What's that face? Something must be wrong.

Chinese: （有这么明显吗？）
English: (Was it that obvious?)

Chinese: 眼看她已经察觉到了，于是我把自己的担忧告诉了她。
English: Seeing that she has already noticed, I decide to tell her my worries.

Chinese: 这样啊…
English: I see...

Chinese: 没事，只是野营而已，我相信再差也不会差到哪去。
English: It's okay. What's the worst that could happen on a camping trip?

Chinese: 嗯…总之你只要告诉我怎么做就好了。
English: Well... As long as you tell me what I should do.

Chinese: 我打算去营地附近看看有没有什么可能有危险的东西，其他的就先这样吧。
English: First things first, I'll scout the campsite and make sure there's nothing dangerous around.

Chinese: 那我跟你一起。
English: Let me go with you.

Chinese: 还是要有人看着才行，我可不想等我们回来发现是一团糟，哪怕可能性很小。
English: Someone's still gotta keep an eye on things. I don't want to come back to a total mess—even if it's unlikely.

Chinese: 你放心，我顶多半小时就回来。
English: Don't worry. I'll be back within half an hour.

Chinese: 你等等，我让芙洛拉出来帮我们。
English: Wait. I'll ask Flora for help.

Chinese: 你要是带了她的话我就不至于会这么说了。
English: Sure, if only you had brought her with you.

Chinese: 哎，我忘了，今早她出门去找索菲玩了…
English: Alas, I nearly forgot. She went for Sophie this morning...

Chinese: 没办法了，还是用这个吧。
English: Then we have no other choice.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 她伸出手用魔力凝聚出一颗类似于石头的东西交给了我。
English: She reaches out, shapes her mana into something like a stone, and hands it to me.

Chinese: 这个是？
English: What's this?

Chinese: 是我做的占灵球，要是你遇到什么就把它捏碎，这样我就能知道你的位置。
English: I made this spirit orb. If anything happens, just crush it and I'll be able to find you.

Chinese: 原来还有这种东西，很方便嘛。
English: That's incredible. And convenient!

Chinese: 不过只有一颗的话…
English: But there is only one...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 呃…嗯呀…
English: Ugh... Aha!

Chinese: 亮光退去后，她的手上多了一大捧占灵球，少说也有七八十颗。
English: When the light fades, her hands are full of spirit orbs—at least seventy or eighty of them.

Chinese: 这…
English: This...

Chinese: 拿好，一定不要把它们搞丢了！
English: Take them. And don't lose them!

Chinese: 总之我去去就回，你就先留在这。
English: Anyway, I'll be back soon. Wait for me.

Chinese: 哎，一定要安全回来啊…
English: Alas, be sure to take care...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 之后我沿着河流的上游把营地周围的树林排查了一番，不过并没有什么有价值的发现。
English: I follow the river upstream and check the woods around the campsite, finding nothing useful.

Chinese: 反倒是她给我的珠子在我走下山路时不小心从口袋里漏了出来，让我摔了一跤，还差点扭伤了脚。
English: On the way back down the trail, though, the orbs she gave me slip out of my pocket, trip me up, and I nearly twist my ankle.

Chinese: 好在回到营地看到她已经准备好了一桌子晚餐，刚才心中的郁闷便瞬间消散。
English: Luckily, when I get back, she has already set up a full dinner spread, so all my frustration vanishes.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 否认
English: Denial

Chinese: 稍微想了想后，我觉得照顾下律的感受还是有必要的。
English: After a second thought, I believe it is necessary to make Ritsu feel better.

Chinese: 嗯？什么惊喜，你难道还准备了些特别的东西吗？
English: Hmm? What surprise? Did you prepare anything special?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 没有没有，我瞎说的！
English: No, I'm just saying.

Chinese: 直行
English: Go straight ahead

Chinese: 没事，继续走吧。
English: It's alright. Keep going.

Chinese: 你不是说那里很危险吗？
English: Isn't that a dangerous place?

Chinese: 我又不是第一次走了，挡在路上的陷阱位置我都记得，而且我们把它们解除掉，也算是顺便减少了其他人碰到的可能。
English: But I'm experienced. I remember the traps and we can remove them for others' sake.

Chinese: 好吧，不过你还是得多注意安全，别受伤了之类的。
English: Okay, but you must be very careful not to get hurt.

Chinese: （那个，其实每次中招的人…）
English: (Well, the one who always gets hurt is actually...)

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我用树枝往前面的草丛里扒了两下，好像戳到了什么硬的东西。
English: I poke around the bushes ahead with a tree branch and hit something hard.

Chinese: 砰的一声，原本跟我手臂差不多粗的树枝就碎成了两半。
English: With a loud crack, the branch—about as thick as my arm—snaps clean in two.

Chinese: 好了，你过来吧。
English: Clear. Come on.

Chinese: 这要是被一般人踩到的话肯定腿就没了。
English: Anyone who stepped on it would have lost a leg.

Chinese: 所以我才说把它们解除掉是很有必要的。
English: That's why I insisted on removing the traps.

Chinese: 不过你先等下，我记得前面那棵树下面也有一个。
English: Wait, I think there is another one down that tree.

Chinese: 听到我的话后，她下意识把我往后拉了一下。
English: She instinctively pulls me back when she hears what I say.

Chinese: 要不我还是用魔法把这片地都清理一遍，开一条路出来？
English: I can clear a path with magic, if you will.

Chinese: 我们是出来野营的，不是来搞破坏的…
English: We're here to camp, not to wreck the place...

Chinese: 我就是不放心你一个人，至少让我跟你一起吧。
English: I'm just worried. At least let me go with you.

Chinese: 同意
English: Agree

Chinese: 也行，毕竟后面有的陷阱要我们两个人配合才好处理。
English: Fine. I could use a hand for some of the traps.

Chinese: 你只需要告诉我怎么做就好，剩下的都交给我。
English: Just tell me what to do and I'll finish the job.

Chinese: 我都说了是要配合…
English: I prefer teamwork...

Chinese: 之后，我们花了些时间一点点把路上的危险清理掉，同时也得益于我对这些的记忆，中途没有发生什么意外。
English: Then, we spend some time clearing the obstacles along the road. Thanks to my good memory, nothing bad happens.

Chinese: 幸好是我们两个发现了这个忘记了被打扫的狩猎场，否则换成其他人误入的话很难想象是什么后果。
English: Luckily, we, instead of others, found this forgotten hunting ground, or who knows what would happen.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我已经能看到前面的路了，是都已经弄完了吗？
English: I can see the path ahead. Does it mean we're done here?

Chinese: 刚才那个地刺陷阱就是最后一个。
English: Yes, we just finished the last one.

Chinese: 嗯，那就好，和你一起感觉这些麻烦处理起来都变轻松了，你也有这种感觉吧。
English: Great! Things feel a lot easier to deal with when you're around. You feel that too, right?

Chinese: 确实帮了不少忙，应该算有吧。
English: Yeah... I guess I do.

Chinese: 什么嘛！说得好敷衍。
English: Hey! What's that attitude?

Chinese: 哎？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 哼！
English: Hmph!

Chinese: 她一副气鼓鼓的表情，用手捶了几下我的胸口。
English: She says grumpily and gives me a few punches on the chest.

Chinese: 但在我盯着她看了一会后她又装不下去了，忍不住笑了起来。
English: But after I stare at her for a moment, she can't keep a straight face and bursts out laughing.

Chinese: 我就开了个玩笑，你居然上当了。
English: I was kidding. Don't take it seriously.

Chinese: 呃，那我不是白白让你打了几下。
English: But you did punch me on the chest.

Chinese: 听到我这样说，她马上把手插在腰间，挺起胸口摆出像是要经受一番考验的样子。
English: Hearing that, she puts her hands on her hips and puffs out her chest like she is ready to face some big challenge.

Chinese: 噗…你呀…
English: Pffff... Come on...

Chinese: 我就知道你下不去手~
English: I knew you wouldn't do it.

Chinese: 表示她是对的
English: She is right.

Chinese: 算了，毕竟[var=Actor]我也不是什么坏人。
English: Never mind. I, [var=Actor], am not a bad guy.

Chinese: 嘿嘿~
English: Heh heh.

Chinese: 一些小吵闹让我们的旅途的氛围变得比之前活跃了不少，我知道这是律在用她自己的方式想让我放松一下，不必随时都紧绷着。
English: The playful bickering lightens the mood. I know Ritsu is just helping me unwind in her own way.

Chinese: 好啦，快走吧，不然来不及了。
English: Alright, let's roll before it's late.

Chinese: 诶，是不是有什么声音？
English: Ugh, did you hear that?

Chinese: 顺着律所指的方向，离我们不远的地方传来了一些零零散散的脚步声。
English: Following the direction, I hear scattered footsteps not far from us.

Chinese: 多半是路过的动物之类的，听起来不是往我们这个方向来的。
English: Some animals, perhaps. I don't think they're coming for us.

Chinese: 一根拌绳突然弹起。
English: A rope suddenly pops up.

Chinese: 快闪开！
English: Move!

Chinese: 她一把把我推开，巨大的力道让我整个人飞出去数米远。
English: She shoves me hard, sending me flying several meters away.

Chinese: （坏了，应该先把这个告诉她…）
English: (I should have told her...)

Chinese: 诶，怎么回事，只有绳子，机关呢？
English: Huh? There is only a rope.

Chinese: 这个…已经…失效了，所以我…没让你处理…
English: The trap... doesn't work, so I left it so...

Chinese: 噢，这样啊。
English: I get it.

Chinese: 诶！！！！[var=Actor]你！
English: Huh?!! [var=Actor]!

Chinese: 她整个人足足愣了好几秒，而这是因为我踩中了另一个陷阱，正被倒吊在一颗树上左摇右晃。
English: She stands there, stunned, because I step into another trap and end up hanging upside-down on a tree.

Chinese: （这就是书里所说的所谓的“倒悬之危”吗…）
English: (Perfect. "The Hanged Man" in tarot decks...)

Chinese: 我…我马上过来！
English: I... I'll get you!

Chinese: 别急，我这下面有带刺的坑，你得先用什么垫一下才行。
English: Slow down. There is a pit below with spikes. You need to deal with it first.

Chinese: 还有，不要往你的右前方走，那里还有个隐藏起来的绳套。
English: And don't go right, because there's another trap.

Chinese: 我知道了，你…你先撑一下…
English: Got it. P—Please hang on...

English: none

Chinese: 在我的指挥下她把我放了下来，不过可惜的是我原本带着的用于晚饭的调料撒了一地，这无疑给我们的野营又增加了一些困难。
English: She follows my instructions and puts me down. Yet, the spices for dinner are spilled, making another challenge for the camping.

Chinese: 同时因为这一系列的耽误，我们到达目的地的时间比预计晚了不少，因此帐篷也只能手忙脚乱地大概搭了搭。
English: The accident also delays us and leaves us little time to roughly set up the tent.

Chinese: 放在你包里的调料罐都撒了，唉…
English: The spices in your bag are gone, alas...

Chinese: 没有调料就没有调料吧，把你带的那些煮一下应该也还好。
English: That's alright. We can do without them.

Chinese: 没有那么简单。
English: Not that simple.

Chinese: 怎么说？
English: Why?

Chinese: 喏，你闻闻。
English: Here. Smell them.

Chinese: 她捏着鼻子，从她的包里掏出了几个用皮纸包着的东西递到了我面前。
English: She pinches her nose, pulls out a few wax paper packs from her bag, and holds them out to me.

Chinese: 这是什么，太腥了吧，
English: What is the awful smell?

Chinese: 还有这个，怎么跟发霉了一样？
English: And this one looks moldy!

Chinese: 除了土豆和萝卜这些配菜，我带的基本上都是这个季节的特产还有之前在市场上买的进口货。
English: Besides potatoes and carrots, I brought seasonal specialties and imported goods from the market.

Chinese: 像千蝶菇、密鳞鱼、苔原牦牛肉这些必须要用特别的调料处理过后才会有香味，不然就会这样…
English: Ingredients like Butterflishrooms, Dense Scale Fish, and Tundra Yak Meat need to be processed with spices before cooking...

Chinese: 好吧…
English: Yeah...

Chinese: 不过我看这附近的环境还不错，没准能找到一些能用的食材。
English: Look around. We might find something useful.

Chinese: 毕竟都到这来了，没有丰盛的晚餐还是不行啊。
English: We've come all this way. We do need a proper dinner, right?

Chinese: 认同她，选择丰盛的晚餐
English: Agree with her and prepare a proper dinner.

Chinese: 如果只是在附近的话就还好，而且我也没理由拒绝她的这一片好心。
English: It's okay if we just need to search around, and I have no reason to deny her.

Chinese: 那试试吧，看能找到什么。
English: Let's give it a try.

Chinese: 嗯，那你在这等着。
English: Sure. Wait here for me.

Chinese: 我们还是一起去吧，这样也快一些。
English: We should go together. It will be faster.

Chinese: 不过你知道哪些是能吃的，哪些是不能的吗？
English: But do you really know what is edible?

Chinese: 大不了你告诉我就是了。
English: You can tell me.

Chinese: 哼，那必须的。
English: Hmph. Of course.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 东西我放这儿了，你看怎么样？
English: I put them here. What do you think?

Chinese: 红色圆头的，带紫色斑点的那些拿来熬汤很合适，五味草也可以用来调味，至于其他的就还是扔掉吧。
English: The red, round ones with purple spots are good in soup. The flavor grass can be used as a seasoning. And throw away the rest.

Chinese: 这些果子也是？
English: How about the fruits?

Chinese: 那些吃了可是会中毒的。
English: They might poison you.

Chinese: 这样吗…
English: I see...

Chinese: 对了，你先把东西接一下。
English: Oh, take these.

Chinese: 我抬起双手，几个黑乎乎的东西落到了我的掌心里。
English: I reach out and take over several dark objects.

Chinese: 这个是？
English: What's this?

Chinese: 是矮脚鸟的蛋，一般可是买不到的。
English: The eggs of Shorty Birds. You can't buy them with money.

Chinese: 听起来很不错的样子，就是不知道味道好不好。
English: Sounds great. But do they also taste great?

Chinese: 有我在你还怕这个嘛。
English: You have me as your chef.

Chinese: 不过，只有这点的话还是不太行。
English: But I think we need more ingredients.

Chinese: 我倒是感觉应该够了吧…
English: Really?

Chinese: 这些只能做点汤还有煎蛋之类的，主菜可不能就这么随便。
English: We have soup and fried eggs, but nothing for the main dish.

Chinese: 就算你这么说，可现在上哪去…
English: But where can we get...

Chinese: 我注意到她正两眼放光地看着树林外的河。
English: I notice her staring at the river behind the trees.

Chinese: 你想钓鱼？
English: Are we going fishing?

Chinese: 那样太慢了，而且也没有什么保证。
English: Too slow. And it requires luck.

Chinese: 所以嘛，还是用点更快的办法好了。
English: So, we need a faster way.

Chinese: （我有种不太好的预感…）
English: (I don't feel good about this...)

Chinese: 律的周围开始出现魔力的涌动，一个闪亮的法球从她手上聚集而出。
English: A surge of mana gathers around Ritsu, and she quickly makes a shiny magic orb.

Chinese: 别告诉我你是认真的！
English: You can't be serious!

Chinese: 嘿呀！
English: Hiyah!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 随着律魔法的释放，河面下发生了一次剧烈的爆炸。
English: As Ritsu casts her spell, a powerful explosion erupts in the river.

Chinese: 在腾起的水花中，数条鱼被迫“上岸“飞到了我的脚边。其中还有些还不甘心地在地上蹦跳挣扎着，它们散发着诡异的光的眼睛哀怨地注视着我…
English: Several fish are blasted out of the water and land right at my feet with water. Some are struggling unwillingly for their lives, gazing sadly at me...

Chinese: 你看，现在主菜有了~
English: Now we have the main dish.

Chinese: 这次就算了，下次不许再这么搞了。
English: Please don't do it again.

Chinese: 哎呀，我知道啦。
English: Aw, I know.

Chinese: 不过我在想…这些鱼，真的吃得完吗？
English: But... can we really eat all these fish?

Chinese: 有我在，这些就都不是问题。
English: I can solve that.

Chinese: 感觉你很有自信嘛…
English: You sound confident...

Chinese: 不是自信，是事实。
English: I do have the capability.

Chinese: 否决她，选择简陋的晚餐
English: Reject her and prepare a simple dinner.

Chinese: 虽然我知道她是一片好心，但我也有不得不拒绝的理由。
English: I know she does so for me, but I have to reject her.

English: none

Chinese: 怎…怎么会有熊啊！
English: W—Why is there a bear?!

Chinese: [var=Actor]你快闪开！
English: [var=Actor], get out of the way!

Chinese: 我一个滑步赶忙躲到了一旁，然而它的注意力似乎并不在我，而是在面前的锅上。
English: I slide to the side and hide. But the bear seems to care more about my pot than me.

Chinese: 是不是你做的菜的味道把它引过来了…
English: Did the smell of our food attract the bear?

Chinese: 站住，不要乱碰！
English: Stop! Don't touch it!

Chinese: （无视）
English: (Ignore)

Chinese: （嗅嗅）
English: (Sniff)

Chinese: 因为还烧着火的原因，绕了两圈的它没办法揭开滚烫的锅，于是又转头扑向了我。
English: The bear can't touch the pot because of the burning fire, so it turns to me.

Chinese: 别过来！！！
English: Stay away!!!

Wooo...

Chinese: 说起来这妖精没见过啊，[var=Actor]你知道是什么种类吗？

Chinese: 我早该想到的，大意了……
English: I should have known...

Chinese: 诶？

Chinese: 向律说明
English: Explain to Ritsu.

Chinese: 虽然稍微有些区别，不过看起来她应该是一种被叫做“珀尔代“的妖精。
English: She's a bit different, but I think she's one of those goblins called "Pearldeck."

Chinese: 记载中提到她们本身数量稀少，可是却生性顽劣，喜欢潜入他人的住宅里以恶作剧为乐。
English: According to the records, they're rare but super mischievous, love sneaking into people's homes just to cause trouble.

Chinese: 以前只是在书上见到过，没想到今天遇到真家伙了，也不知道该说是我们走运还是倒霉……
English: I've only read about them before, never thought we'd run into a real one. Not sure if we're lucky... or just unlucky.

Chinese: 原来是这样，怪不得她这么能闹腾。
English: That explains it. No wonder she's been such a handful.

Chinese: 我才不是什么“珀尔代“，我可是有名字的，叫海瑟！
English: I'm not Pearldeck! I am Hazel!

English: Hearing our conversation, the goblin who calls herself Hazel starts to struggle again in the jar, grumpily.

Chinese: 你直接用驱逐咒直接弄出去吧，不然我怕她一会又跑回来。
English: Cast a banishing spell, or I'm afraid she'll be back again.

Chinese: 嗯……我明白了。
English: Okay... I'll do it.

Chinese: 不要，我不要！
English: No, don't do it!

Chinese: 明明是你们跑来把先生的家搞得乱糟糟的，又蛮不讲理地污人清白，现在还要把我赶走……
English: First, you ran into the master's house and made it messy. Now, you accuse me of what I didn't do and want to drive me away...

Chinese: 要不是我被关在这里，不然你们……你们……

Wooo...

Chinese: （怎么说着还变成我们的错了……）
English: (Why is it our fault now?)

Chinese: 别愣着，赶紧处理掉这个麻烦。
English: What are you waiting for? Solve the trouble.

Chinese: 好吧，让我准备一下……

Chinese: 微光开始聚集在律的手心，但她的动作与以往相比却显得有些迟钝。
English: A faint glow begins to gather in Ritsu's hand, but her movements are slower than usual.

Chinese: 先生，对不起，是我没把家看好……真的对不起……
English: I'm sorry, sir... I failed to protect the house... I'm really sorry...

Chinese: 罐子中的妖精双手抱着脑袋，一边自言自语地说着一边开始低声抽泣。

Chinese: 反驳她
English: Push back.

English: I'm not so sure. Goblins aren't always as innocent as they look.

English: True, but if she's just the prank-loving type like you said, would she really react like this?

English: Fair enough. Better than letting her keep causing trouble.

English: After I give the go-ahead, a hint of relief flashes across Ritsu's face.

Chinese: （你啊，结果还是心软了嘛。）
English: (Softie. Told you you'd cave.)

English: Ugh... meanies! Go away!

English: You might wanna watch your tone.

English: Hmph! Just wait till the master gets back. He'll have you all arrested!

English: She's clearly not in the mood to talk...

Chinese: 不至于吧……

English: Let me try. Maybe being an elf will make me seem a little more approachable.

Chinese: 我耸了耸肩，无奈地表示同意。
English: I shrug and step back.

English: none

English: Are you willing to talk now, dear?

Chinese: 我都强调过了，我是有名字的！

English: none

Chinese: 你这样子，要是我没猜错的话，应该是“珀尔代“妖精吧。
English: Let me guess. You are a Pearldeck goblin, right?
It's...

English: none

English: Hazel looks it over carefully, but her brows slowly furrow.

English: Anything wrong?

English: No way. If there was something like that, the master would've told me for sure.

Chinese: （怎么感觉她们说的不是一个东西……）
English: (I wonder if there is another misunderstanding...)

English: Do you know about the revamp?

English: Why do you want to revamp the manor?

English: The exhibition is meant to give people a chance to see Sir Shepard's artwork and personal collection before the place gets renovated. He was... kind of a big deal, after all.

English: Hazel suddenly freezes, her expression flickering with shock before darkening completely. Realizing something is wrong, I quickly grab Ritsu's arm, signaling her to stop talking.

Chinese: 骗人的吧，你们居然说施佛德先生他……
English: You're lying... You're saying Sir Shepard is...

English: No... no, that can't be right... He's just been gone a while...

English: He never returned...

Chinese: 当自己竭力想去忽视的现实刺破被捏造出来的愿景，最后剩下的只有难以承受的孤独。

Chinese: 谁……都不能动先生的房子……谁……都不能……

Chinese: 她阴沉着脸，发出颤抖的声音，关着她的罐子也随之抖动起来。
English: Her voice trembles, her face dark with emotion, and the jar begins to shake.

Chinese: 呃，海瑟？
English: Huh, Hazel?

Chinese: 出去……你们都出去！
English: Out... Both of you!

Chinese: 你冷静一下！
English: Calm down!
No!!!

Chinese: 在海瑟歇斯底里的大吼下罐子碎裂开来，而上面的束缚也被解开。
English: With a frantic scream, the jar shatters, and the magic binding her breaks.

Chinese: 快抓住她！
English: Grab her!

Chinese: 诶！
English: Huh!

Chinese: 等律回过神来想要用魔法再次禁锢她的时候，她已经钻入了杂物堆中的缝隙，眨眼就消失得无影无踪。
English: By the time Ritsu snaps out of it and tries to restrain her again, Hazel has already slipped into a gap in the pile of clutter and vanishes without a trace.

Chinese: 对不起，我反应慢了……
English: Sorry, I was too slow...

Chinese: 不是你的错，毕竟我也没想到她可以挣脱。
English: It's not your fault. I didn't know she could get away.

Chinese: 总之先把她找回来吧。
English: Anyway, let's find her.

English: none

English: Fueled by emotion, the goblin's attacks only escalate. Knowing the manor inside out, she uses everything she can to mess with us.

English: After a few run-ins, Ritsu and I start to catch on to her tricks and stop getting caught off guard like before. Still, she keeps us on edge with no room to relax.

Chinese: 这样下去不行，我们没那么多精力来一一应付她的把戏。
English: This can't go on. We don't have the time or energy to deal with every prank she throws at us.

Chinese: 那办法的话，我想想……
English: Let me see...

Chinese: 不是我说你们，怎么每次都能遇上些离谱的事？
English: Why are you always getting yourselves into such trouble?

Chinese: 这个声音……
English: That voice...

Chinese: 该不会……
English: Is that...

English: You never carry that busted lamp around, so if I wanted to get out and stretch my legs, I had to find a new ride, right?

Chinese: 看你自己怎么理解咯。
English: Depends on how you look at it.

Chinese: 你！

Chinese: 哎，别急嘛，我这不也是看你们半天解决不了问题，出来帮忙的。
English: Relax, okay? You've been at this forever and still haven't solved it, so I'm just here to help.

Chinese: （有人能帮忙当然很好，可如果是这家伙…… ）
English: (Having someone help is great and all... but if it's her...)

Chinese: 一想到之前的那些事，我心里就犯起了嘀咕。
English: Just thinking about our past run-ins makes me uneasy.

Chinese: [var=Actor]，我觉得她不是很靠谱。

Chinese: none

English: Ritsu is right, but having one more person around could only help. And to be fair, we've both seen what she's capable of.

Chinese: 没事，先试试也无妨。
English: It's alright. Let's give her a chance.

Chinese: 这才对嘛。毕竟只要是你们想的，不管是什么我都可以满足。

Chinese: 你还是用正常一点的方式吧，不然……
English: Will you please be normal or...

Chinese: 哎，行了行了，直接说你们的愿望吧。
English: Aw, never mind. Just tell me what you want.

Chinese: 让那只妖精不要再捣乱了。
English: Get that goblin to stop causing trouble.

Chinese: 噢，这个好办。

Chinese: 不过，在这之前把代价先支付了吧。
English: But you need to pay the price first.

English: Ugh, what price?

English: The price for the wish. Do you think my wonders and magic are free?

Chinese: （为什么她每次都不早说……）

Chinese: 好吧，那你要什么？

Chinese: 我看看，这次的话……
English: Let me see. This time...

Chinese: 啊哈，是你们两个之后一段时间里的快乐。

Chinese: 能不能说得明白点？
English: Can you be clearer?

Chinese: 就是字面的意思啊，这很难理解吗？
English: I mean it literally. Don't you understand?

Chinese: 我开始有点后悔自己的决定了，一个妖精本来就够麻烦了，现在又多了这玩意……
English: I start to regret it already. A goblin is troublesome enough, and now we have this spirit...

English: [var=Actor], shall we listen to her?

English: Forget it. Just stay put and behave.

English: Still hung up on what happened before, huh?

Chinese: 面对我不置可否的沉默，她也明白了是怎么回事。
English: I don't say anything, but my silence says it all.

Chinese: 那好吧，当我没说，反正你们请的救兵应该马上就到了。
English: Alright then, forget I offered. Besides, your backup should be here any second now.

Chinese: 我看得出律有事想说，显然她又陷入了某种莫名奇妙的纠结不敢开口。
English: I can tell she has something on her mind but is caught in one of her usual, inexplicable hesitations.

Chinese: 而我也只能边走边猜，摸不透她的心思。
English: And I'm left guessing in the dark.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 远处传来了悠扬的乐曲，似乎晚宴已经进入了舞会环节。
English: In the distance, soft music drifts from the ballroom. It seems the banquet has moved on to the dancing.

Chinese: 行在前方的律不自觉的放缓了脚步，精致的尖耳似乎在跟着旋律微微颤动。
English: Ritsu, walking slightly ahead, slows her pace unconsciously, the tips of her pointed ears twitching subtly to the rhythm.

Chinese: 律小姐，你愿意同我共舞一曲吗？
English: Miss Ritsu, would you honor me with a dance?

Chinese: 我向律伸出手。
English: I offer her my hand.

Chinese: 似乎是猜中了。
English: Looks like I guessed right.

Chinese: 嗯，我很乐意。
English: Mm, I'd be happy to.

Chinese: 律拉上我的手，我们共舞起来。
English: She takes my hand, and we begin to dance.

Chinese: 我有些惊讶，毕竟印象中上次和律跳完舞脚背肿了三天。
English: I'm surprised. Because last time we danced, my foot had been swollen for three days.

Chinese: 如今律的舞步虽然还是有些不熟练，但和曾经相比已经好了太多。
English: But now, her steps, while not perfect, are far more graceful.

Chinese: 至少要比只看过教学书的我要强，她拉着我，主导着舞步的节奏。
English: In fact, she's better than me, who learned dance mostly from books. She guides the rhythm, gently leading me through the motions.

Chinese: 这种感觉很奇妙，不知不觉，一曲结束，律松开手，行了个礼，笑盈盈的看着我。
English: There is something quietly magical about it. Before I know it, the song ends. Ritsu let go, gives a small curtsey, and smiles brightly at me.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 满足了？不再来一曲吗？
English: Satisfied? Do you want another dance?

Chinese: 嘿嘿，不用啦，时间不够，我也只练了这第一首曲子而已。
English: Hee hee. It's okay. We don't have the time. And I only practiced the first song.

Chinese: 这样啊，有些遗憾，那下次吧。
English: I see. What a pity. We can do it again next time.

Chinese: 嗯！
English: OK!

Chinese: 话说回来，之前你主动接过晚宴的规划工作，也是为了这个吗？
English: By the way, did you ask for the banquet preparation work for this?

Chinese: 也不是啦，那时候我还没想到舞会这回事呢，只是单纯的想帮你而已。
English: Not exactly. I didn't think of the dance back then. I simply wanted to help.

Chinese: 看来律还沉浸在刚刚的氛围里没完全清醒过来，说出了一些平时绝不会去承认的话。
English: Looks like Ritsu is still caught up in the moment as she says things she'd normally never admit.

Chinese: 那你这计划可称不上严密，你知道我不可能在舞会中出场的。
English: Then your plan wasn't exactly watertight. You know I'd never willingly show up on a dance floor.

Chinese: 嘿嘿，没想那么多啦，心血来潮就开始练习舞步了，你看，现在这不也——
English: Hehe, I didn't think that far. Just felt like practicing on a whim... and hey, didn't it turn out fine...

Chinese: 唔！那个……这可不是——
English: Hmm! Well... That's not...

Chinese: 好了好了，知道了，走吧，我的魔女大人。
English: Alright, alright. Got it. Let's go, Miss Nova.

Chinese: （欢快的嘶鸣）
English: (A bright, eager whinny)

Chinese: 闲谈间我们已经走到了龙厩，法拉斯的叫声和律的哀叹声形成了奇妙的和音。
English: We chat as we arrive at the dragon stables. Falas' cheerful screech blends perfectly with Ritsu's dramatic groan.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 律逃也似的跳上了龙车前座，我也紧跟着坐进车厢。
English: She scrambles into the driver's seat like she is fleeing the scene, and I follow close behind into the cabin.

Chinese: 看着律的背影，我由衷的期待起“下次”来。
English: Watching her from behind, I find myself truly looking forward to next time.

Chinese: 怎么了？律？
English: Is that a problem? Ritsu?

Chinese: 律转过身来，疑惑的看着我。
English: Ritsu turns to watch me in confusion.

Chinese: 嗯？什么怎么了？
English: Hmm? What is it?

Chinese: 总觉得，你有话想对我说。
English: I think you have something to tell me.

Chinese: 没，没啊，本魔女一向是有什么说什么的。
English: No, I don't. I'd speak if I want to.

Chinese: 你这个自我评价可不怎么客观。
English: That's not an objective judgment on yourself.

Chinese: 真没有什么想说的？
English: Really got nothing to tell me?

Chinese: 都说了没有啦！
English: I said no!

Chinese: 一定是你最近忙糊涂了！
English: You must be overloaded recently!

Chinese: 好啦！我们快回神谕司吧，报告什么的交给我，你起草下行动计划就休息去吧。
English: Fine! Let's get back to the Oracle Division. I'll prepare the report, and you should get some sleep right after writing an action plan.

Chinese: 真体贴，谢了，不过还是让我自己来吧。
English: Thanks, that's sweet. But I should do both.

Chinese: 哼！有那么不信任我吗？明明之前还让我接手纪要工作来着。
English: Hmph! Don't you have any faith in me? You even asked me to take minutes before.

Chinese: 这你就会错意了，我不信任人的表现可不是这样的。
English: Don't get me wrong. That's not how I treat people I don't believe.

Chinese: 如果说忙糊涂了，你的可能性更高吧，神谕司的工作之余，我看你也没怎么闲着。
English: If one of us is overloaded, it should be you. You don't take a break even after your job at the Oracle Division is done.

Chinese: 哪有！我只是，只是兴趣比较广泛罢了。
English: No way! I just... have so many hobbies.

Chinese: 虽然你平常嘴硬时的理由也不怎么样，但刚才这个真是格外的离谱。
English: That was an extremely bad excuse, even compared to your usual ones.

Chinese: 这或许也是你忙糊涂了的表现吧。
English: And that is the evidence of work overload.

Chinese: 律，你需要多关注下自己的状态啊。
English: Ritsu, be nice to yourself.

Chinese: 我状态很好！你刚才不也说过我今天做的不错吗？
English: I am! And you said I did a very good job today!

Chinese: 你现在就像是一架过载的魔导机关，的确是在某些方面超常发挥，但长久而言，这是会留下隐患的。
English: You're like an overloaded magic mechanism. It may be very effective but also very risky in the long run.

Chinese: 语毕，远方恰好传来新的舞曲，律停下脚步，露出思索的表情。
English: As we speak, the next song plays. Ritsu pauses, deep in thought.

Chinese: 唔… 其实，我没修习过魔导理论，回去之后我会找时间研究下的。
English: I've never studied magic theory. I'll find time to look into it.

Chinese: ……看来你今天的精力和神志已经消耗殆尽了。
English: Looks like you've exhausted your mind already today.

Chinese: 那我换种说法，这次晚宴后的舞会环节是你负责规划的吧？
English: Then answer this: you planned tonight's ball, right?

Chinese: 嗯，是的。
English: Yes, I did.

Chinese: 目前是第二首舞曲，接下来的四个曲目分别是什么？
English: We're on the second song. What are the next four?

Chinese: 斗争矜持，记忆长廊，悲怆君主，以及牵绊力量。
English: Dueling Restraint, Corridor of Memories, Grieving Monarch, and Bonded Power.

Chinese: 还记得为什么要这样安排吗？
English: Do you still remember why we arranged them so?

Chinese: 嗯，当时特地请教了圣乐团的俄尔普斯先生，这样安排主要是为了让舞会的节奏更为丰富，张弛有度。
English: Yes. We asked Mr. Orfey of the Holy Orchestra to make sure the ball has a rich and balanced rhythm.

Chinese: 很好，你近期就像是一直在跳每分144拍的圆舞曲，转的跟陀螺一样。
English: Good. You've been spinning like a top lately—144 beats per minute nonstop.

Chinese: ……我明白了，但是，我作为你的起居官——
English: I see. But as your chamberlain...

Chinese: 没什么好但是的，明天是你的假期，强制执行，但下午要陪我去西郊晒太阳，省的你自己又不知道跑去干嘛了。
English: No "buts." You're off tomorrow, that's an order. Just be ready to sunbathe with me in the western suburbs in the afternoon. Don't disappear again.

Chinese: 嗯。
English: Yeah.

Chinese: （抽出来看看）
English: (Pull it out to see.)

Chinese: 露出的部分似乎写着《血脉分析》，我将东西抽出二分之一，看到了完整的文字。
English: The exposed part reads "Bloodline Analysis". I pull it halfway out and see the full title.

Chinese: 阿塔利家族用于培养魔女的绝密资料？从上面的印记来看这本还是神赦司内部保存的原件。
English: Atali family's classified Nova training manual? Judging by the seal, it's an original from the Absolving Theocracy.

Chinese: 为什么律要拜托牧弄来这个？这东西对已经成为魔女的她来说应该没什么用才对。
English: Why did Ritsu ask Muu to get this? It shouldn't be of any use to someone who's already a Nova.

Chinese: 而且即使需要的话和我说一声不就得了，神谕司主的权限也足以随意调阅的。
English: And if she needs it, she can just ask me. My authority easily grants access.

Chinese: 我回来啦，你在看什么？
English: I'm back. What are you reading?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 你们怎么都走路没声啊！
English: Why do you all walk so quietly?

Chinese: 是你没注意到吧，嗯？我们？
English: You were just careless, huh? We?

Chinese: 牧刚才来过，这是她让我转交给你的东西。
English: Muu was here. And she asked me to give you this.

Chinese: 我把资料递给律，没掩饰看过的事实。
English: I hand the book to Ritsu without hiding the fact that I have looked through it.

Chinese: 啊！
English: Ahhh!

Chinese: 抱歉啊，其实我拿到的时候就——
English: Sorry, actually, when I got it I already...

Chinese: 啊啊啊！你别瞎想啊！我要这份资料没有别的意思，单纯的好奇而已！
English: Ahhhh! Don't get the wrong idea! I only wanted it out of curiosity, nothing more!

Chinese: 还没等我道歉完，就被律的怪话打断了。
English: She cuts me off before I can finish apologizing.

Chinese: 我不是想传承什么的，至少短期内都没有这样的打算，也不是我自己在魔女资质上有什么问题，你千万不要瞎想啊！
English: I'm not planning to pass anything down, at least not anytime soon. And it's not like I have issues with my own aptitude as a Nova, so seriously, don't overthink it!

Chinese: 你不说我本来没想那么多。
English: I wasn't... until you said all that.
What?!

Chinese: 是，为了你那次失控的事？
English: Is it because you lost control last time?

Chinese: 律沉默了片刻，细不可闻的嗯了一声。
English: After a short pause, Ritsu nods slightly.

Chinese: 我记得牧好像说过，和什么血脉返祖有关，你想多了解下相关的情况？
English: I remember Muu mentioning something like regression. Are you trying to know more?

Chinese: 律再次点头。
English: Ritsu gives another nod.

Chinese: 这有什么好瞒着我的，下次有这种事直接跟我说就好了，不用跑去麻烦牧的。
English: You can tell me about it, Ritsu. Next time, you can turn to me instead of Muu.

Chinese: 但是……
English: But...

Chinese: 我不是在强求你啦，只是表明下态度，你按自己的想法来就好。
English: I'm not giving you an order, but I do want you to know that you can act as you wish.
Hmm...

Chinese: 嗯！我会好好考虑的。
English: OK! I will think about it.

Chinese: 插曲结束，谈正题吧。
English: Now, let's get down to business.

Chinese: 啊！对！米娅那边又有新的进展了！
English: Ahhh! Yep! Mia made some progress!

Chinese: 刚刚你说律熬夜？
English: What did you say? Ritsu is staying up late?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 呃，就是，那个。
English: Ugh, yes.

Chinese: 啊，就是律在学习魔女棋嘛，她准备在魔女棋领域挑战审判长大人，每天都打谱打到很晚。
English: She is learning Nova chess. She analyzes the chess manuals late at night to challenge Lord Inquisitor.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 切，算了，说正事吧。
English: Phew, never mind. Let's cut to the chase.

Chinese: 我还是和你一起去吧。
English: I'm going with you.

Chinese: 你在说什么啊？神谕司之主这时候起身离席怕是全场的目光都会跟过来。
English: What are you talking about? You, Master of the Oracle Division, will get all the attention if you leave the seat now.

Chinese: 到时候对交流会有什么影响先不说，真有什么问题也肯定查不到了！
English: Even if that won't affect the event, we'll end up finding nothing.

Chinese: 我有自有办法变得不引人瞩目。
English: I know how to keep a low profile.

Chinese: 审判长大人又给了你什么神奇的魔法器了吗？能投影一个你坐在原位谈笑风生？
English: Did Lord Inquisitor give you another magical tool? Something that projects a lively image of you on the seat?

Chinese: 倒是没神奇到那个地步，有可能会对交流会产生一点点影响。
English: Not that magical and might still have some influence on the event.

Chinese: 那你还是安心坐着吧，我会小心的。
English: Then please stay where you are. I'll be careful.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 没等我再说，律就快步离开了。
English: Ritsu leaves quickly before I say anything else.

Chinese: 不得不承认，即使以隔壁神赦司严格的标准而言，律的驭车技术也是过关的。
English: I have to admit that Ritsu is a qualified driver even by the strict standards of the neighboring Absolving Theocracy.

English: Voiceover

English: Kuroro

Chinese: 安洁

Chinese: 午后时分，我与律相约于圣城的商业街相见，打算趁着假日放松早已疲惫不堪的身心……
English: In the afternoon, I arrange to meet Ritsu in the shopping street of the sacred city, hoping to take a break and unwind from all the stress...

Chinese: 是一个半兽人小女孩从背后抱住了我。
English: An Orccodro girl hugs me from behind.

Chinese: 克萝萝。
English: Kuroro.

Chinese: 她那条漂亮的毛茸茸的尾巴，好像充满了生气似的，不时地晃来晃去。尾巴尖儿在我的脖颈上扫来扫去。
English: Her furry, pretty tail wags lively from time to time. And the tip of her tail sweeps across my neck.

Chinese: 唔，看招。

Chinese: （抓住她的尾巴。）
English: (Grab her tail.)

Chinese: 哥哥，感觉痒痒的~
English: That tickles!

Chinese: 不能摸！
English: Hands off!

Chinese: 好了，小克萝萝快坐好，要说正事了。
English: Alright, Kuroro. Take a seat. We have work to do.

Chinese: 克萝萝要坐在哥哥旁边。
English: I want to sit by your side.

Chinese: （“还活着吗？律”的眼神。）
English: (The "Still alive, Ritsu?" glance)

Chinese: （结束了？时间不是很长啊。）
English: (Is it over? Not very long.)

Chinese: （都没心力和我眼神交锋了。看来她要恢复精神，是得一会儿了。）
English: (She doesn't have the energy for eye contact. Looks like she needs time to restore energy.)

Chinese: 尊贵的神谕司之主，魔女黑神月咏在此向您述职。
English: Dear Lord Oracle, I, Kurokami Tsukuyo, am here to report.

Chinese: 请开始吧，黑神前辈。
English: Go on, Kurokami.

Chinese: 很抱歉，经过近一个半月的调查，我们尚无法对星痕克萝萝进行有效的溯源工作。
English: Sadly, we failed to find the origin of Aster Kuroro after over a month's investigation.

Chinese: 嗯，那现在我们——
English: So, what is...

Chinese: 能够得出的结论是？
English: Our conclusion?

Chinese: 一：星痕克萝萝能不附身于魔女来独立进行活动，原因可能是其依存于侍主大人，可获得源源不断的能量补充。
English: First: A probable reason why Aster Kuroro can be independent from Novas is that Lord Oracle might have been her source of energy.

Chinese: 二：星痕克萝萝能够控制星痕为其所用。原因是其拥有控制精神的某种能力。
English: Second: The reason why Aster Kuroro can control the Aster... Is because she has some sort of mind control ability.

Chinese: 三：星痕与所附身魔女极少数情况下会出现心灵相通，但神谕司之主与星痕克萝萝之间的联系完全超乎常识。二人之间的联系极为强烈，思考共享，感官共有，一心同体。
English: Third: Occasionally, an Aster may become in sync with their Nova. Yet the connection between Lord Oracle and Aster Kuroro is something beyond. The bond is so strong that they share their mind and feelings.

Chinese: 关于克萝萝的溯源工作。上议院正在筹备更大规模的预言仪式。应该很快就会有结果。
English: About the origin of Kuroro... The Upper House is preparing a larger ritual for prophecy. We might have a conclusion soon.

Chinese: 第四纪元1750年融合月第三巡5日，魔女黑神月咏，述职完毕。
English: Nova Kagami Kurokami, reporting on Day 5, Period Three, Amalgam Month of 1750, the Era of Eternal Flame.
Hmm.

Chinese: 至少如果召唤法阵没炸，或者能复原现场的话，也多少能提供一些线索啊。
English: We might get some clues if the summoning array were still there or could be restored.

Chinese: 哦~
English: OK!

Chinese: 克萝萝（故意很小声）？
English: Kuroro (in whispers)?

Chinese: （揉揉毛茸茸的小脑袋）
English: (Rub her furry little head.)

Chinese: 感觉脑袋变得热乎乎的。
English: Warm and fuzzy.

Chinese: 在！
English: Yes.

Chinese: 哥哥，克萝萝在听呢。
English: I'm all ears.

Chinese: 那你说我们刚才在说什么？
English: Do you know what we were talking about?

Chinese: 呜呜。
English: Hmm!

Chinese: 好了好了，别呜呜了。
English: Come on. Stop the "hmm."

Chinese: 我们是在讨论，这个人见人爱，得意可爱的小狐狸到底是何方神圣？又在历史上的哪里占有一席之地？
English: We were wondering who this adorable, charming little fox is. And your origin in history.

Chinese: 那个……
English: Um...

Chinese: （“狠狠地”揉了揉克萝萝的脑袋）
English: ("Vigorously" rub Kuroro's head.)

Chinese: 啊……唔唔唔唔唔……
English: Ah... awwwwww...

Chinese: 不需要为此烦恼。
English: Don't worry about that.

Chinese: 克萝萝就是克萝萝——是哥哥姐姐的好伙伴。这个事实是不会变的。
English: Kuroro is Kuroro. I am your best friend. That is a solid fact.

Chinese: 嗯嗯！
English: Mm-hmm!

Chinese: 啦啦啦！
English: La la la!

Chinese: 嗯！
English: OK!

Chinese: 我认为是这样的。
English: That's how I see it.

Chinese: 哥哥，哥哥！
English: Brother, brother!

Chinese: 哥哥，好像还有什么东西没确认呢，去看看吧？
English: Hey, you missed something! Let's check it out!

Chinese: 东西？邮箱吗？你啊，心刚放下来，立马就坐不住啦？
English: What is it? My mailbox? You just relaxed for a second, and now you're already getting restless?

Chinese: 打开门。门口站着一位英姿飒爽的少女。
English: Open the door. A gallant young girl stands by the door.

Chinese: 没什么。我发了会儿呆。
English: It's OK. My mind was wandering.

Chinese: 少女向我鞠躬致意，然后退至一侧。
English: The girl bows and slides to the side.

Chinese: （欠身点头。）
English: (Bow slightly.)

Chinese: 黑神前辈可以更随意些。
English: Please be more at ease, Kurokami.

Chinese: 明白。
English: Understood.

Chinese: 你太慢啦!
English: You're too slow!

Chinese: 咳咳！
English: Ahem.

Chinese: 这笨精灵……
English: Stupid elf...

Chinese: 律！
English: Ritsu!

Chinese: 呜~
English: Aww!

Chinese: 律虽然讪讪地闭上了嘴，但还不忘用眼睛瞪了我一下。
English: Ritsu still gives me a stare even though she closes her mouth.

Chinese: 我向律眨眼，表示自己十分冤枉。
English: I wink at her, a signal of innocence.

Chinese: 我提醒过你了，用咳咳的声音。是你自己没注意到提醒。

English: Well, the date was set a bit early. I had to get up even earlier to prepare... so I just closed my eyes here for a bit.

Chinese: 在大部分人看来几乎完美的笑容中，多少还是能看出一丝强行锁在牢笼中的困倦。

Chinese: 那么，既然汇合了，我们就走吧~

Chinese: 总之，就是出了米德加尔，无论遇到什么都一直往南走下去。

Chinese: 原来如此……

Chinese: 虽然这种约会也可以接受……

Chinese: 不过那样的话，对玛莎来说，这次约会就是一场探险了——真的没关系吗？

English: Indeed, the air carries a refreshing scent— half from the wind and half from the Nova now walking closer than ever beside me.

English: Out here, away from the crowds and noise of Midgard, with nothing but open countryside around us, Marsha naturally draws just a bit nearer.

English: Finally, in a place where no one else was around, a delicate hand naturally slipped into mine, while Marsha's eyes focused on the thunderclouds forming on the horizon...

Chinese: 现在这位魔女正以温柔的力道轻握着我的手，令人诧异的是，那只常年执剑的手上，不但一点老茧都没有，还出奇的顺滑细腻……
English: Right now, this Nova is gently holding my hand. Despite wielding swords all the time, her hand is smooth and soft, with no calluses at all.

English: Question! Why do you keep staring at me when we're surrounded by natural scenery that we can't see in Midgard?

Chinese: 只是有些担心你的身体。
English: Just worried about your health.

English: Marsha, you've only recently recovered, and now you suddenly want to go on a day-long hike. I have to keep an eye on you.

English: Marsha casually picks up a flat stone from the ground and tosses it toward the calm lake. The stone dances, leaving behind thirteen ripples before sinking below.

Chinese: 嗯……比如——

English: "Since being spotted exiting Midgard's southern gate with a mysterious woman, Lord Oracle has not been seen again... "

Chinese: 魔女玛莎·伊利斯，米德加尔很多人都认识，哪里神秘啦……
English: Nova Marsha Ellis is well-known in Midgard. What's mysterious about that...

Chinese: 你是神谕司重要的侍主，您跟我的去的地方，可是“未知”哦，连您都不知道的地方，其他人就更不会知道了。
English: You're the head of the Oracle Division, and we're headed to the "unknown." If you don't know where you are, how could anyone else?

Chinese: 您不担心几天之后，米德加尔的报纸上会出现这种头版头条吗？
English: Aren't you worried that this kind of headline would appear in Midgard's newspaper in a few days?
