Chinese: 嗯……侍主大人回答得很干脆嘛。
English: Hmm... Lord Oracle, you didn't even hesitate.

Chinese: 那是当然，以现在我跟玛莎的关系，我对你的信任是无条件也无限制的。
English: Why would I? Given our relationship, I trust you unconditionally.

Chinese: 即使假设，玛莎真的准备让我好一段时间也没法回米德加尔，那我也更愿意相信你是有什么重要的目的，而非想要对我动坏心思。
English: Even if you were to keep me away from Midgard for a while, I'd think you had good reasons, instead of assuming you meant any harm.

Chinese: 侍主大人……
English: Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 你这样说的话，反倒显得是我不够信任您了。
English: Now I feel bad about not trusting you enough.

Chinese: 为了回应您的信任，我向您承认——
English: In return for your trust, I'll admit...

Chinese: ——不会有那种头版头条，我能独享一天的侍主大人就已经很满足了，所以，您一定能在明天回到办公室处理送来的新工作——
English: There won't be any headlines like that. Having you to myself for a whole day is more than enough. So, you will be back at your desk tomorrow to deal with the next stack of work.

Chinese: 我就说嘛。
English: I knew it.

Chinese: ——但有时候，我真的会对侍主大人动坏心思的哦~
English: But sometimes, I do get the urge to do something naughty to you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 好了！侍主大人，看到前面的那个村庄了吗？
English: All done! Lord Oracle, do you see that village up ahead?

Chinese: 在我将疑问提出来之前，被玛莎故意转移了话题。
English: Before I can even ask my question, Marsha has deliberately changed the subject.

Chinese: 我听说这个村庄有个地方卖的炸肉丸，好吃到连米德加尔城内最好的厨师也自叹不如，这也是我选择“往南”的原因之一。
English: I heard there's a place in that village that sells fried meatballs delicious enough to make the best chefs in Midgard City feel humbled. That's actually one of the reasons I chose to head south.

Chinese: 所以请侍主大人也注意一下空气中的味道，我们一起来探索哪里有“好吃的”香味吧~
English: So please, Lord Oracle, pay attention to the smells in the air. Let's track down this delicious food together!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 事实证明，这并不是一件难事，尽管有玛莎的干扰，但我们还是在一进入村庄时，就看到了散发这浓香的小摊位。
English: That turns out to be quite easy. Even with Marsha's distractions, we spot the food stall giving off that rich aroma as soon as we enter the village.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 好，给你钱。
English: Alright, here's the money.

Chinese: 多谢惠顾！
English: Thank you.

Chinese: 自己本来想要掏钱，但被玛莎以这是她的主意为由挡了下来。
English: I try to pay, but Marsha stops me, insisting that since it's her idea, it's her treat.

Chinese: 不得不说，就算在离开米德加尔之前已经吃了早餐，这股撩人的肉香也足以将人的馋虫再次勾出来。
English: Though we had breakfast before leaving Midgard, the irresistible aroma is more than enough to awaken anyone's appetite.

Chinese: 来，这是侍主大人的份。
English: Here, this one's for you, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 多谢……
English: Thanks...

Chinese: ……给我的这份比你这份多太多了吧。
English: This portion seems way bigger than yours.

Chinese: 没关系的，我这份已经足够了，男孩子嘛就应该多吃一点~
English: It's fine. Mine's enough. Boys should eat more.

Chinese: 用木签轻轻扎进一个炸肉丸，悦耳的冒油滋滋声立马就迸发出来，光是这样就足以驱散任何阴郁的情绪。
English: I gently pierce a fried meatball with a wooden skewer. The delightful sizzle is enough to chase away any gloomy mood.

Chinese: 更不要说那股油与肉结合浑然一体的独特香气，也许不够“优雅”，但在这种“热情”之下，又有谁能发自内心的去抗拒让胃收下这份佳肴呢？
English: And then there's that unique aroma of oil and meat. It might not be elegant, but it's definitely an irresistible temptation to all stomachs.

Chinese: 等一下。
English: Wait.

Chinese: none
English: none
Hoo... Hoo...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 好了，刚出炉的会有点烫，现在应该没问题了。
English: Alright, it's a bit hot fresh off the fryer, but it should be fine now.

Chinese: 玛莎靠近过来，撩起鬓发吐出的气息，让原本还在肉丸上升腾的白气消失了……
English: Marsha leans closer, brushing aside a lock of hair. The soft breath she exhales makes the steam rising from the meatball vanish...

Chinese: 啊呜。
English: Nom.

Chinese: 一口咬上去，牙齿堪称“丝滑”的把肉切了下来，完全体现了肉质有多么的柔软肥美，这种极致的细腻足见厨师在肉馅上下的功夫。
English: I take a bite, and the tender meat is "sliced off" by my teeth effortlessly. Such a delicate texture reveals just how much care the cook put into the filling.

Chinese: 而在味道上，浓厚香郁通过少量的汤汁的协助下，极速在口腔中扩散开来，但在精心调配的香料之下却绝无腻口之感。
English: The rich, meaty flavor spreads rapidly across my tongue with help from the savory juice. But the carefully balanced spices have made sure it doesn't feel greasy or overwhelming.

Chinese: 嗯，从表情看来，您也很满意嘛。
English: Hmm, judging by your expression, you like it too.

Chinese: 对这种美食还不满意的人那就是味觉有问题了。
English: Anyone would like it unless there's something wrong with their taste buds.

Chinese: 呼呼~享受得连嘴角流下油了都没注意到。
English: Hoo... The oil is dripping from the corner of your mouth.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 好啦，脸不要动。
English: Alright, hold still.

Chinese: 现在不擦干净，要是滴到衣服上，可就难洗了。
English: If you don't wipe it off now and it drips on your clothes, it'll be hard to clean.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 行了，擦掉啦。
English: There, it's gone.

Chinese: 怎么了？这样一直看着我……
English: Is that a problem? Why are you staring at me like that?

Chinese: ……就算是我，被这样一直盯着看也是会害羞的哦。
English: Even I get embarrassed when being stared at like that.

Chinese: 不，只是……感觉现在的玛莎……
English: It's just the way you are right now...

Chinese: 就像姐姐一样。
English: It feels like a big sister.

Chinese: 姐姐啊……
English: Big sister?

Chinese: 既然侍主大人都这么觉得了，那就叫一声姐姐大人来听一下？
English: Well, since you think so, how about calling me big sis once?

Chinese: 姐姐大人。
English: Big sis.
Yes!

Chinese: 姐姐大人。
English: Big sis.

Chinese: 姐姐大人。
English: Big sis.

Chinese: 好了，非常感谢，已经品鉴得足够了。虽然是我提出来的，但还是请不要继续这样捉弄我了。
English: Alright, thank you. I think I've had enough fun. Even though I brought it up, please don't tease me like that again.

Chinese: ……再这样下去，感觉心里就有什么奇怪的种子要萌发了……
English: If this keeps up, some strange little seed might start sprouting in my heart...

Chinese: 玛莎轻轻拍了拍手，在不知不觉间，她的那份炸肉丸已经都吃完了。
English: Marsha claps her hands softly. At some point, she's already finished her meatballs.

Chinese: 好了！这一顿就是我们的午餐了，但晚餐会在哪里吃，我就不知道了，这个村庄就是我熟知地方的边界。
English: All done! That's our lunch taken care of. As for dinner, I have no idea where we'll eat. This village is at the edge of the area I know well.

Chinese: 因为再往南，就没有路了。
English: Because beyond this point, there's no road.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 离开村庄朝着远离米德加尔的方向往南，沿着一条无法容纳两人并行的狭窄土路进入了一片看似平常的林子。
English: We leave the village and head south, away from Midgard. Following a narrow dirt path barely wide enough for two to walk side by side, we enter some woods.

Chinese: 有些滑，小心点。
English: It's slippery. Be careful.

Chinese: 在踏入那片由绿叶组成天棚、枯叶组成地毯的崎岖空间之前，玛莎稍稍施加了手上的力道……
English: Just before stepping into this rugged space with thick fallen leaves on the ground, Marsha tightens her grip on my hand slightly...

Chinese: 让牵着的两只手没那么容易分开，也因此更容易感受到对方的体温了。
English: It makes it harder for our joined hands to slip apart and easier for us to feel each other's warmth.

Chinese: 侍主大人……是不是有点紧张？
English: Lord Oracle... Are you nervous?

Chinese: 感觉您的手上，有很多汗……
English: I can feel sweat in your hand...

Chinese: 不都是玛莎流的汗吗？
English: Isn't that your sweat, Marsha?

Chinese: 我的汗……
English: My sweat...

Chinese: 啊，好像真的是这样……如果侍主大人觉得不舒服的话……
English: Huh, it really might be. If you're uncomfortable, I can...

Chinese: 没关系的。
English: It's OK.

Chinese: 呼呼~虽然很感谢您的体恤，不过我还是感觉自己搞砸了。
English: Phew... I appreciate you saying that, but I still feel like I messed up.

Chinese: 不过嘛，也没办法……侍主大人毕竟是特殊的……
English: Then again, it can't be helped... You are someone special, Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 等遇到了不错的地方，我们就稍微休息一下吧，我确实有些累了……
English: Once we find a good spot, let's take a short break. I'm a bit tired...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 等到玛莎停下了脚步时，在眼前铺开的，是用花组成的海洋，在明媚的日照下，微风推动的“花浪”让各种色彩不断交汇重叠，直至自己脚下。
English: Marsha finally stops before an ocean of flowers. Under the bright sunlight, the breeze pushes waves of colorful blossoms all the way to our feet.
Mmm!

Chinese: 侍主大人，我觉得就在这里休息好了，您感觉怎么样？
English: Lord Oracle, this seems like a good place to rest. What do you think?

Chinese: 比想象中的还要美。
English: Even more beautiful than I imagined.

Chinese: 是啊，五分钟前我还在担心，要是这一路上只有树林该怎么办……
English: Yeah, just five minutes ago, I was worried that it'd be just woods the whole way.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 来，侍主大人，这里——
English: Here, Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 玛莎跪坐在花海中，轻轻拍了拍自己的大腿，表达的意思不言而喻。
English: Marsha sits on her heels among the flowers and gently pats her lap. The message is perfectly clear.

Chinese: ——稍微休息一会儿吧，如果不介意我身上的汗味的话。
English: Rest here... if you don't mind the scent of my sweat.

Chinese: 放心吧，这里没有其他人。
English: Don't worry. There's no one else around.

Chinese: 那就失礼了。
English: Then I'll gladly accept.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 当身体平躺在湿润的草地，脑袋接触到玛莎那双被黑色过膝袜覆盖了一半的大腿上时，那种结实又不失柔软的感觉比预想中的还要舒适。
English: As I lie flat on the damp grass, my head comes to rest against Marsha's thigh, which is half-covered in black socks. It's firm and soft, even more comfortable than expected.

Chinese: 更不要说除了浓郁的花香之外，现在还能更明晰的闻到一种带有魅惑感的芳香……
English: And beyond the rich floral fragrance in the air, there's now a distinctive, alluring scent...

Chinese: 从一个不同寻常的角度近距离观察玛莎，确实会看到一些平时难以觉察的事物，譬如现在眼前的天空会被遮住了一大半从而无法细数行云。
English: Observing Marsha from an unusual angle up close reveals things normally hard to notice. Most of the sky is now blocked from view, making it impossible to count the drifting clouds above.

Chinese: 也许同样的道理在玛莎那边也通用，虽然看不见她的表情，至少在躺下的瞬间可以感觉到头后面的大腿绷紧了一秒钟。
English: Perhaps the same principle applies to Marsha. Though I can't see her face, I feel the muscles in her thigh tense the moment I lie down.
Hmm...

Chinese: 刚开始玛莎似乎显得有些不太自在，
English: At first, Marsha seems a little uneasy.

Chinese: 尽管看不见她的表情，但玛莎的右手在不知所措的换了几个摆放位置之后，最后选择了轻拢我贴在大腿上的头发。
English: I can't see her expression, but her right hand shifts around awkwardly a few times before finally settling on gently brushing my hair on her lap.

Chinese: 还行吧？要说是不舒服我也没办法咯。
English: Like it? It's not like I have any better option, though.

Chinese: 毕竟也没带椅子，这是我仅能提供的了，侍主大人习惯就好。
English: Didn't bring a chair. This is the best I can offer. You'll just have to make do, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 我可以这样躺到明天。
English: I could stay like this the whole day.

Chinese: 呼呼~您能满意就好。
English: I'm glad you like it.

Chinese: 不过可不能躺这么久，要是那么久都不见人，大家会着急的。
English: But you can't lie here that long. If you disappear for too long, people will start to worry.

Chinese: 要是以后也有机会享受到就好了……
English: It'd be nice if I could enjoy this again in the future...

Chinese: ……以后吗？
English: In the future?

Chinese: 我很高兴您居然还会期待这个，不过这种机会不是取决于我，而是取决于您哦。
English: I'm glad you'd look forward to that. But it depends on you, not me.

Chinese: 毕竟，我知道在您身边愿意为您膝枕的，远不止有我一个。
English: After all, I know I'm not the only one willing to offer their lap to you.

Chinese: 您也不必介意这些，侍主大人只需要知道——这个位置是永远只属于您的，就行了。
English: But you don't need to worry about that. All you need to know is that this spot is forever yours alone.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 玛莎……
English: Marsha...

Chinese: 嗯？
English: Hmm?

Chinese: ……为什么要一直玩弄我的耳垂？
English: Why are you playing with my earlobe?

Chinese: 呼呼~看您一直都没出声，我还以为您已经睡着了，手不知不觉就……
English: Phew... You weren't saying anything, so I thought you'd fallen asleep... My hand kind of just wandered...

Chinese: 我确实只是闭了眼睛没睡，但这种环境确实很容易让人忘记时间……已经过了多久了？
English: I was just resting my eyes, not asleep. It's easy to lose track of time in this setting, though... How long has it been?

Chinese: 放心好了，侍主大人不用想太多，好好享受现在就行，要是太在意时间可放松不了哦~
English: Don't worry about that. Just enjoy the moment, Lord Oracle. If you start thinking about time, you won't be able to relax.

Chinese: 话虽如此，不过同时失去了时间感与熟悉感之后，我感觉周围的就像是梦幻一样，分不清真假……
English: That may be true, but now that I've lost both my sense of time and familiarity, everything around me feels like a dream. I can't tell what's real.

Chinese: ……除了玛莎，是世界唯一的真实。
English: The only real thing I know for sure is you, Marsha.

Chinese: 您要是这么说的话，可就别怪我想要动坏心思了哦~
English: Saying things like that will make me have wicked thoughts.

Chinese: 什么坏心思？
English: What kind of wicked thoughts?

Chinese: 停止时间。
English: Stop time.

Chinese: 玛莎已经能用这么高水平的魔法了？
English: Marsha, you can already use magic that powerful?

Chinese: 当然用不了，所以只是想想罢了。
English: Of course not. That's why I say thoughts.

Chinese: 那玛莎至少也有过像我一样的梦幻感吧？
English: Marsha, you've had the same dreamlike feeling I just described, right?

Chinese: 那倒确实是有过，但恰好与您相反，我一直感觉周围很真实，曾经让我感觉梦幻的，是侍主大人。
English: I have, actually. But it's the opposite. The world around me always felt real, and you were the only thing that felt like a dream, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 为什么？
English: Why?

Chinese: 嗯~怎么说呢……
English: Hmm... how should I put it...

Chinese: 比如，有这么一个喜欢研究历史的人，她翻阅过许多历史书。
English: Well, imagine a history enthusiast who has read many books.

Chinese: 她本以为自己已经足够了解历史了，直到有一次她得到了一个机会，能翻阅那些被锁起来的。
English: She thought she knew the past well. Until one day, she's granted access to the documents that had always been locked away.

Chinese: 然后，她就了解到了许多与读到的完全不同的真相。
English: And suddenly, she discovers truths completely different from what she'd read.

Chinese: 比如历史书上有骑士宣称自己英勇的击败了残忍的巨人，其实只是他在臆想中挺起骑枪策马撞向了风车磨坊。
English: Like how a knight once claimed to have defeated a cruel giant, but the reality is that he was charging at a windmill in his delusions.

Chinese: 又比如历史书上有将军在战斗中中箭受了致命伤，在奇迹的加护下仍骑马持剑立于阵前，惊骇敌军，真相只是他的遗体被放在了马上。
English: Or how a general was said to have continued fighting on horseback after getting shot by an arrow in battle, when in truth, it was just his corpse propped up for show.

Chinese: 侍主大人可以猜猜看？在这种情况下，她会有什么样的感觉？
English: Lord Oracle, care to take a guess? What would she feel?
Hmm...

Chinese: 应该会有一种很强的撕裂感，既有的认知与现实的感受会产生强烈冲突，然后就会感觉……像是梦幻一般？
English: She'd feel a sharp sense of dissonance. Her knowledge clashes with reality, pulling her apart, and everything feels like a dream...

Chinese: 就是这样，侍主大人，我最初见到您时，就是这种感觉。
English: Exactly, Lord Oracle. That's how I felt the first time I saw you.

Chinese: 原来如此。
English: I see it now.

Chinese: 这就是玛莎在亲身身感受到的梦幻感……虽然很可能许多人都曾有过类似的感受，但作为历史爱好者的玛莎一定是她们中感受最强烈的。
English: That's the dreamlike sensation Marsha experienced... Others may have felt it too, but for history enthusiasts like Marsha, it hit especially hard.

Chinese: 好啦，侍主大人，虽然在这里待到天黑也不错，不过您不想看看再往南还有什么吗？
English: Alright, Lord Oracle, even though staying here until nightfall sounds nice, don't you want to see what else lies farther south?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 当我们进入山间开始上登时，落日正以相反的方向，穿过厚重的云层往地平线下沉。
English: As we begin our climb into the mountains, the sun sinks behind the clouds, descending slowly toward the horizon.

Chinese: 也许脚下曾经有一条完整的登山路通往南方，但在岁月的摧残下也仅剩一点残砖断石。
English: There might have once been a proper path up the mountain, but time has reduced it to crumbling stones.

Chinese: 真舒服啊~在身上的衣服都被汗水浸透之后，就感觉山上的风还蛮凉快的嘛。
English: Ah! Feels good! Now that my clothes are soaked in sweat, the mountain breeze actually feels kind of refreshing.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 侍主大人，这边！悬崖这边更舒服，还能看到我们刚才路过的地方！
English: Lord Oracle, over here! It feels even better here. You can see the path we just came from up on this cliff!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 按照玛莎的指引又向前走了几步，在距离天空只有一步的地方停了下来。
English: Following Marsha's lead, I take a few more steps and stop at a place where the sky feels only one step away.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 站在山崖边听着窃窃的风语，俯视米德加尔近郊这片宁静的葱绿色。
English: Standing at the edge of the cliff, I listen to the soft wind and gaze down at the outskirts of Midgard.

Chinese: 从刚才去过现在看上去如同棋盘般的小村庄，一直延伸到令人目眩的灼色地平线……
English: The peaceful, lush green stretches from the village we just passed all the way to the blinding, scorched horizon...

Chinese: 嗯，让我看看……米德加尔，被那边的山挡住了。
English: Hm, let me see... Midgard is hidden behind that mountain.

Chinese: 玛莎轻轻将下巴放到了我的肩膀上，与她白瓷般的脸颊距离之近，以至于能感受到她被徐风吹起的金色发梢，像是恶作剧般在自己脸上微微挠动。
English: Marsha gently rests her chin on my shoulder. Her fair cheek is so close that I can feel the tips of her blond hair brushing playfully against my face.

Chinese: 也因此，后背现在也跟玛莎的身体紧密贴合在了一起——
English: At the same time, her body presses closely against my back.

Chinese: 玛莎平时的打扮风格相当素雅端庄，被一身不失文雅又适合战斗的衣服掩盖着，因此很容易让人忽略她也有一副仿佛从艺术画中走出的好身材。
English: Marsha usually dresses in a modest and refined style. Her clothing, elegant and practical for combat, makes it easy to overlook just how wonderful her figure is.

Chinese: 这并不是指她在某个方面特别突出，而是一种整体上的完美平衡，该多的地方绝对不吝啬，该少的地方绝对不奢侈。
English: It's not that her body stands out in any specific part, but rather that it's well proportioned and balanced with precision.

Chinese: 即使以最严格的标准来评价，也堪称黄金比例。
English: Even the harshest critic would call it a golden ratio.

Chinese: 现在感觉怎么样？
English: How do you feel?

Chinese: 我不记得做了什么值得这么奢华的奖励。
English: I don't recall doing anything to deserve such a luxurious reward.

Chinese: 诶？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 我是问，看着我们一路都往南走到那么远的地方了，您现在感觉怎么样？
English: I'm asking how you feel after coming this far south with me.

Chinese: 哦，是说这个啊。
English: Oh, that's what you meant.

Chinese: 啊……原来如此。
English: Huh... I see.

Chinese: 背后和肩上的触感消失了，玛莎轻盈的转身，来到了旁边。
English: The feeling on my back and shoulder disappears as Marsha steps lightly to my side.

Chinese: 失礼了，只是个意外，我不是有意这么做的……
English: Pardon me, it was an accident, not intentional...

Chinese: 不过看侍主大人的反应和现在的样子，感觉好像还有些遗憾？
English: But judging by your reaction, Lord Oracle, it seems like you're a little disappointed?

Chinese: 那样的话……需要我再来一次吗？
English: So... would you like me to do it again?

Chinese: 现在就算了。
English: That won't be necessary.

Chinese: 说的也是呢，要是再刻意重复一遍就不算意外了。
English: Fair enough. If I did it on purpose, it wouldn't be an accident anymore.

Chinese: 不过我也没想到，一个白天的时间，我们能走到这么远。
English: Speaking of which, I didn't expect we'd make it this far in just one day.

Chinese: 但现在，也到了好孩子准备要回家的时间了吧？
English: Though now, I suppose it's time for good kids to start heading home, huh?

Chinese: 说的是呢……
English: You're right...

Chinese: 虽然玛莎的表情没什么太大变化，但还是频繁的眨了眨眼睛，再加上握着自己的手的张弛变化，明显在思考着什么。
English: Marsha's expression doesn't change much, but she blinks a few times and subtly adjusts the grip on my hand, clearly deep in thought.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 以后还有机会……今天就回去吧~
English: There will be other chances. Let's head back for today.

Chinese: 从时间来算，只要我们快一点，就能在午夜的钟声响起来之前躺到温暖的床上——
English: If we move quickly, we should be able to lie down on a warm bed before the midnight bell tolls.
Hmm?

Chinese: 玛莎像是要接什么东西一样抬起了手，随后我也感觉到了——
English: Marsha lifts her hand as if to catch something, and a moment later, I feel it too.

Chinese: 下雨了？
English: Is it raining?

Chinese: 呼呼~看来确实是这样呢。
English: Looks like so.

Chinese: 从这里回到最近的村子，至少也会让我们淋上两个小时的雨。
English: From here to the nearest village, we'll be walking in the rain for at least two hours.

Chinese: 侍主大人，该怎么办才好呢？
English: So, Lord Oracle, what should we do?

Chinese: 还能怎么办，只能先就近躲雨了。
English: What else? We find shelter nearby.

Chinese: （脱下外套盖在玛莎头上）
English: (Place my coat over Marsha's head)
Hmm...

Chinese: 这样姑且能先挡一会儿，最好还是在雨下大之前找到能躲雨的地方。
English: This will hold off the rain for a bit. But we really should find cover before it starts pouring.

Chinese: 外套给我了，那侍主大人怎么办，您不会以为我会就这样安心看着您淋雨吧？
English: You're giving me the coat? What about you? You can't expect me to watch you get wet.

Chinese: 如果一定要有人淋雨，那怎么选都不应该是某位刚刚才康复身体的小姐吧。
English: If someone has to get wet, it definitely shouldn't be the lady who just recovered from an illness.

Chinese: 我知道了，那我就只能这样了——
English: I understand. Then... I'll just do this.

Chinese: 嘿！
English: Hey!

Chinese: 刚才在悬崖边感受到的美好感觉又回来了，而且与刚才蜻蜓点水般的接触不同，这次更为柔软亲密，可谓是肆无忌惮。
English: That soft sensation from earlier at the cliff returns, only this time it's much more intimate, much less reserved.

Chinese: 披着我的外套，玛莎直接跳到了我的背上，纤细的双臂环住了我的脖子。
English: Wrapped in my coat, Marsha hops onto my back and wraps her slender arms around my neck.

Chinese: 虽然增加了一些重量，但确实这下就能让两个人都能暂时避一下一颗比一颗更大的雨珠了。
English: This means I have to carry some weight, but now both of us can stay shielded from the ever-larger raindrops.

Chinese: 走吧~侍主大人。
English: Let's go, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 无论如何——对不起。
English: Still, I'm sorry.

Chinese: 玛莎郑重的低下了头，水珠顺着发梢滴落到了地上，没有发出一丁点声响。
English: Marsha bows her head solemnly. Raindrops slide from her hair and fall to the ground silently.

Chinese: 原本说好了，会在今天之内我们会回到米德加尔——看来我要食言了。
English: We said we'd make it back to Midgard by today... Looks like I'm going to break that promise.

Chinese: 雨还要下很久，看来侍主大人今夜只能跟我在这里度过了。
English: The rain will last a while. It seems that you'll be spending the night here with me.

Chinese: 没关系，下雨也没办法——
English: It's okay. Can't help the weather...

Chinese: 等一下。
English: Wait.

Chinese: 玛莎，你知道今天会下雨吗？
English: Marsha, did you know it was going to rain today?

Chinese: 不知道哦~
English: No, I didn't.

Chinese: 你知道今天会下雨吧……
English: You knew it would rain, didn't you...

Chinese: 我不知道哦~
English: No, I didn't.

Chinese: 玛莎的回答没有一丝犹豫，似乎是问心无愧，也似乎是答案早就已经准备好了。
English: Marsha answers without any hesitation, either because she has nothing to hide or because she has rehearsed for that.

Chinese: 用魔法升起了一小堆篝火，加上寒冷的风雨也无法驱散这个小小的温暖给岩洞内的二人带来的庇护。
English: She uses magic to spark a small campfire in the cave, which offers us shelter from the cold wind and rain.

Chinese: 尽管在降雨开始的十分钟内就找到了这个岩洞，但在此之前雨水还是透过了已经完全浸湿的外套，让自己与玛莎都变得湿漉漉的。
English: Although we found the cave ten minutes after the rain started, the water still soaked through my coat, wetting both Marsha and me.

Chinese: 总之，当务之急是让自己和玛莎暖和干燥点，尤其玛莎。现在正在用捡到的枯枝编织的架子也是为了这个。
English: The immediate priority is to get ourselves warm and dry, especially Marsha. The rack we're weaving out of gathered dry branches is precisely for that.

Chinese: 算了……篝火是有了，对普通的露营来说有篝火就可以考虑晚饭了，但我们被大雨限制了。
English: Well... we've got a fire. Normally, that would mean we could cook dinner, but the heavy rain limits our options.

Chinese: 虽然走了一天挺累的，但今天也得少吃一顿了。
English: It's been a long and tiring day, yet it looks like we'll have to skip this meal.

Chinese: 会少吃一顿吗？我不这么认为哦~
English: Skip this meal? I don't think so.

Chinese: 哼哼~为什么不问问神奇的玛莎有什么方法呢？
English: Why not ask the amazing Marsha if she has a solution?

Chinese: （看看周围有什么可以吃的）
English: (Look around for anything edible)

Chinese: 不想淋雨是不可能找到吃的……除非你是指洞口地上的草和岩壁上的蘑菇。
English: We can't find food without getting soaked again, unless you mean the grass at the entrance or the mushrooms on the rock walls.

Chinese: 嘟嘟~回答错误！
English: Wrong answer!

Chinese: 我们俩只要不是牛马之类，草就不用想了。
English: We're not horses, so we can forget about eating grass.

Chinese: 蘑菇的话……虽然其中确实有能吃的品种，不过应该不包括这种鲜艳的蘑菇。
English: As for the mushrooms... while some kinds are edible, I doubt these brightly colored ones are among them.

Chinese: 要是我真的烤给您吃下去，估计几分钟内您就要抱怨——
English: If I grilled them for you, you'd probably be complaining in a few minutes.

Chinese: “玛莎，你算计我！”
English: "Marsha, you drugged me! "

Chinese: 但这已经是这附近最接近“食物”概念的东西了，玛莎还有什么主意？
English: But those mushrooms are the closest thing to "food" here. What do you have in mind, Marsha?

Chinese: 锵锵~如果不介意的话，就用这个作为晚餐吧~
English: Ta-da! If you don't mind, how about this for dinner?

Chinese: ……三明治？
English: A sandwich?

Chinese: 是玛莎做的吗？
English: Did you make it, Marsha?

Chinese: 嗯，是我一早做的，本来是想着如果到了村庄找不到炸肉丸就拿这个给您当午饭，没想到用到了晚饭上。
English: Yes, I made it early this morning. I was going to give it to you for lunch in case we couldn't find meatballs in the village, but I guess it's for dinner now.

Chinese: 尝尝看吧，我的手艺可能不如那几个擅长做饭女孩子好，但填饱肚子方面我还是有自信的。
English: Try it. I might not be one of the best cooks, but I'm confident that it can at least fill your stomach.

Chinese: 三明治被包在了布中，接过来时还稍微带些温的感觉，应该是玛莎的体温让它没凉。
English: The sandwich is wrapped in cloth. When I take it, it's still warm, probably preserved by Marsha's body heat.

Chinese: 啊呜。
English: Nom.

Chinese: ……怎么样？好吃吗？
English: How did it go? Is it good?

Chinese: 即使排除掉疲劳与饥饿对于美味的提升，这个三明治也相当好吃了。
English: The sandwich is genuinely delicious, not just because hunger and fatigue enhance flavor.

Chinese: 太失望了，为什么到今天才吃到这么好吃的东西。
English: I feel sad... Why is this the first time I've had something this good?

Chinese: 侍主大人……
English: Lord Oracle...

Chinese: 非常感谢您的夸奖，但还请您慎言。
English: Thank you for the compliment, but please be careful with your words.

Chinese: 要是哪一天我真的信了您的这种话，我可不知道自己会做出什么事情来哦。
English: If I actually take it seriously, I have no idea what I might end up doing.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 随着肚子逐渐填饱，暖和的感觉也逐渐在回归身体……
English: As my stomach fills, my body starts to feel warm...

Chinese: 架子做好了。
English: The rack is finally done.

Chinese: 终于可以先弄干一点了，玛莎，湿掉的衣服放在这个架子上，在火边烤着，但注意不要太靠近火免得烧到了衣服。
English: Time to get things drying. Marsha, hang your wet clothes on this rack by the fire. Just don't put them too close, or they might catch fire.

Chinese: 嗯，侍主大人也是，一直穿着湿衣服很容易生病的。
English: Right. Lord Oracle, you too. You might catch a cold if you stay in wet clothes.

Chinese: 遮雨的外套是彻底淋湿了，估计得烤个一晚上，裤子的材质还算比较防水，所以只需要烤烤上衣就好了。
English: The coat is completely soaked, and it'll probably need a whole night to dry. My pants are water-resistant, so just the top needs drying.

Chinese: 光滑的纽扣在变湿之后，比平时更难解开了，湿掉的衣服也沾在了皮肤上，不过也不全是因为雨水，汗水也不少。
English: The smooth buttons are harder to undo now that they're wet, and the damp fabric clings to my skin. It's not just the rain, but also the sweat.

Chinese: 玛莎也别愣着了，如果不想感冒的话最好早点把衣服弄干。
English: Don't just stand there, Marsha. If you don't want to get sick, start drying your clothes too.

Chinese: 欸……哦，知道了。
English: Eh... oh, got it.

Chinese: ……虽然从以前就这么觉得了，不过现在看到了我还是想再问一下——
English: Though I've always thought this, now that I see it again, I have to ask—

Chinese: 玛莎背过身去，但也可以看出她的耳朵比平时更红了。
English: Marsha turns her back to me, but I can still see that her ears are redder than usual.

Chinese: 尽管雨声嘈杂，然而衣服布料的摩擦声还是可以清晰入耳，被篝火映在岩壁上的影子动作有些放不开，但完全没有丝毫停顿。
English: Despite the noisy rain, I can hear the rustling of fabric. The fire casts her shadow on the cave wall. Her movements are a bit stiff, but she doesn't pause for a second.

Chinese: ——虽然平时侍主大人都待在办公室里，但还是有去健身的吧？
English: Lord Oracle, even though you stay in the office all the time, you still work out, don't you?

Chinese: 算是吧。
English: Pretty much.
Uh-huh.

Chinese: 玛莎很在意吗？
English: Marsha, do you care that much?

Chinese: 毕竟也会跟我有关，我当然会在意啦。
English: Of course I care, it concerns me too.

Chinese: 玛莎将脱下的衣服在空中甩了甩，沙砾般的水珠四溅开来，随后衣服就架到了树枝做的架子上。
English: Marsha gives her wet clothes a few quick shakes in the air, and water droplets scatter. Then, she drapes them over the rack.

Chinese: 虽然是水草丰茂的季节，但雨那么大还是有些冷的，接下来的话……
English: Despite the season, it's still cold when it rains. And now...

Chinese: 从视线的死角，玛莎像是猫一样慢慢靠近，然后——
English: From the edge of my vision, Marsha creeps in silently like a cat, and then—

Chinese: ……嘿咻！
English: Hey—phew!

Chinese: 自己的身上被压上了非常轻盈了重量，修剪整齐的指甲在自己的四肢轻划而过，湿润的肌肤紧密的贴了上来，相似的体温链接在了一起……
English: A soft, feather-light weight presses onto me. Trimmed nails graze gently across my arms and legs. Damp skin presses tightly against mine. Our similar body heat melts together, linking us.

Chinese: 轻柔的吐息吹进了耳朵里，今日所嗅到的芬芳从未如此令人心怡过，在心与心最接近的位置，似乎还能感受到彼此的心跳……
English: A warm breath tickles my ear. The scent I've been noticing all day has never felt so intoxicating. In this moment, I can almost feel her heartbeat next to mine.

Chinese: 这是一个必须体验之后才能明白的知识——当细腻的柔软感到达一定程度之后，是可以直击内心的。
English: This is something you have to experience to understand: when softness reaches a certain level of delicacy, it touches the soul directly.

Chinese: 这样两个人就都能暖和了~
English: Now we can both get warm this way.

Chinese: 确实好多了。
English: It really does help.

Chinese: 其实还远远没有冷到需要做到这种程度，但流淌在身上的水珠的确也随着逐渐升高的体温蒸腾得更快了。
English: It's not really cold enough to require this... but the beads of water on my skin are definitely evaporating faster as our shared body heat builds.
Shh...

Chinese: 雨好像还要下很久……
English: The rain shows no sign of stopping...

Chinese: 就这样，一直保持到，我们两个的衣服烤干为止吧。
English: Let's stay like this until our clothes are fully dry.

Chinese: 摇曳的篝火，将两人融为一道的影子映在了岩壁上，随着明暗的闪烁，就像一杯美酒一般颠簸晃动着。
English: Our merged shadow is cast onto the cave wall by the flickering fire, swaying like the wine in a shaking glass.

Chinese: 不时渗入岩洞中的疾风，将两人摆在一起衣服轻轻撩起，慢慢滑行，直至叠在了一起无法被吹动……
English: Occasional gusts of wind sneak into the cave, lifting our clothes. They slide slowly until they settle atop one another.

Chinese: 水珠顺着湿衣服的最下摆一滴一滴的流淌着，然后慢慢放缓……直到无法再汇成更多水珠为止。
English: Droplets drip one by one from the hems of our soaked clothes, gradually slowing until no more can form.

Chinese: 随后衣服的湿气也逐渐被热量剥离，变干，从最靠近篝火的地方开始，衣服的颜色变浅，变轻……但直至完全干燥，也没人从架子上取下。
English: Then, the heat begins to drive the moisture out. From the parts nearest the flames, the colors of the fabric gradually soften... But when they're dry, neither of us moves to take them back.

Chinese: 雨夜变得更加喧嚣，来自自然的洗礼之声，掩盖了除此之外的一切声音。
English: The rain outside grows louder, drowning out all other sound.

Chinese: none
English: none
Mmm... Haaah...

Chinese: 朝阳的光晖笼罩在回米德加尔的路上，让原本普通的石板路现在看去来像是一条黄金之路，随着日出来临的不光有光明，还有徐徐而至的温暖。
English: The golden light of dawn spills across the stone path back to Midgard. With sunrise comes not just brightness, but warmth that slowly filters in.

Chinese: 拖着略有些疲惫的身躯，在天蒙蒙亮的时候启程归途，等到了阳光普照之时，米德加尔城楼上的旗帜就出现在了远处视野中。
English: We begin the return journey at first light, still a bit tired. By the time the sun is shining fully, the flag atop Midgard City's gate tower appears on the horizon.

Chinese: 与昨天走过这条路时不同，这一次玛莎换成了用双手挽住了我的胳膊，姿势变化得非常自然而然，将两人之间最后一点空隙也填补上了。
English: Unlike yesterday, Marsha now links both arms around mine naturally, closing the last bit of space between us.

Chinese: 我在昨天出发的时候，也没想到约会会到现在才结束……
English: When we left yesterday, I never expected this date to last all the way until now...

Chinese: 还没结束呢，侍主大人，我们还没到米德加尔，别忘了返程也是约会的一部分。
English: It's not over yet, Lord Oracle. We're not back in Midgard yet. The return trip is part of the date too.

Chinese: 不过，既然侍主大人这么说了，那侍主大人也承认，这次的约会确实给侍主大人的留下了足够的印象吧~
English: But Lord Oracle... since you said that, you admit this date has left a strong enough impression, right?

Chinese: 算是吧。
English: Pretty much.

Chinese: 至少以后在想起“约会”这两个字时，今天应该会是最先记起来的几次之一了。
English: At the very least, when you think of the word "date," today will probably be one of the first days that come to mind.

Chinese: 当初我还犹豫了很久，看来没有选择最传统的约会计划是对的！
English: I spent a long time debating this, but now I know an untraditional date was the wise choice!

Chinese: 我知道的，侍主大人的约会经验到底有多么丰富——
English: I know how much dating experience you have...

Chinese: 啊，放心好啦~我没有指摘的意思，我可是比您想象中的还要明事理哦~
English: Huh, don't worry, I'm not judging. I'm actually more understanding than you'd expect.

Chinese: 但我跟侍主大人不一样，今天是我人生第一次约会……就算是我，也想让您记住我的这个重要的“第一次”。
English: But I'm not like you. This was my first date ever... and I want you to remember my special "first time."

Chinese: 要是我选择那些最为常见的套路，让侍主大人跟我一起去找个餐厅吃饭，然后逛逛公园或商店街什么的——
English: If I'd just gone with a generic plan, like dinner at some restaurant and a walk through the park or shopping district...

Chinese: ——大概侍主大人会在下次约会之前，就把今天的事情忘到极北之地去吧。
English: You'd probably have forgotten all about it before the next date.

Chinese: 所以，为了让今天能像钉子一样扎进您的记忆里，这就是我的选择！
English: So, to make sure today gets hammered into your memory like a nail... this was the date I chose!

Chinese: 我是觉得不错，但约会从来都是两个人的事情。
English: I think it turned out great. But a date is always about two people.

Chinese: 所以，玛莎觉得这一天怎么样？
English: So Marsha... what did you think of today?

Chinese: 我？我的话……
English: Me? Well...

Chinese: 我从来没有想过有一天能像现在这样感受您……
English: I never imagined I'd be able to feel you like this...

Chinese: 挽着自己胳膊的玛莎的手抱得更紧了，就像害怕松手了就有什么东西要消失了一样。
English: Marsha clutches my arm tighter as if afraid that something precious might vanish if she lets go.

Chinese: 您不知道吧，最开始见到您的我，是怀着对古代圣人的敬畏与崇敬向您问候的。
English: You know, when I first met you, I greeted you with awe and reverence as one would greet a sage of the ancient world.

Chinese: 那种不可思议的感觉我现在还记得很清楚，那是我跟您的故事的开始。
English: I still remember that incredible feeling now... That was the beginning of our story.

Chinese: 而在经历了那么多，与您度过了那么多个日夜之后……我比以前更加仰慕您，但已经没有那种遥不可及的感觉了。
English: After everything we've been through and all the times we've shared, I admire you even more. But the distance I once felt is gone.

Chinese: 您就在我的身边，我可以与您并肩而行，可以与您游历乡间，可以为您膝枕，可以与您俯瞰风景，可以像现在这样靠在您的胳膊上……
English: You're right here with me. I can walk with you, explore the countryside with you, have your head rest on my lap, enjoy the scenery with you, and lean on your arm just like this...

Chinese: 我知道侍主大人是个很受欢迎的人，我知道怀有跟我类似心情的人并不少。
English: I know how popular you are, Lord Oracle. I know I'm not the only one who feels this way.

Chinese: 因此我也知道，能像我一样，在您身边拥有一席之地，已经是一种许多人可望而不可求的恩惠了。
English: That is why I also know just having a chance to be by your side is a blessing many would long for but never get.

Chinese: 但除开魔女这个身份，我也只是个普通的女人而已，当然也会憧憬一个普通的女人会憧憬的事情。
English: But setting aside the fact that I'm a Nova, I'm still just a woman, and I dream the same dreams any regular woman would.

Chinese: 也许……我真心希望自己还有机会，能与您更进一步……
English: Maybe... deep down, I wish I could take our relationship to the next level...

Chinese: 这就是所有能告诉您的玛莎·伊利斯对这次约会的想法，更多的想法，恐怕我就必须保密了。
English: That's everything I, Marsha Ellis, can share about how I feel about this date. As for the rest... I'm afraid I'll have to keep it a secret.

Chinese: 除非……
English: Unless...

Chinese: 玛莎轻轻将一根手指按在了自己嘴唇上……
English: Marsha presses a finger gently to her lips.

Chinese: 娇嫩双唇被晨晖涂上了一层金色的唇膏，那种曾经感受过，按下去的那种吹弹可破的柔软感，比任何东西都要诱人……
English: The sunlight has cast a golden hue on her lips. I've felt that softness before, and it's more tempting than anything else...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: ……由不需要保密的您，来告诉我，我和您之后的故事……
English: You tell me what comes next in our story... You don't have to keep a secret...

Chinese: ……可以吗？
English: Would that be alright?

Chinese: 形象大使？这是做什么的？
English: Ambassadors? What does that entail?

Chinese: 作为顾客的代表，和我一起在店门口，向路过的大家讲述食物的美味，分享在店里用餐的感受就可以啦。
English: As our customer representatives, you just need to stand by me at the restaurant entrance and tell anyone who passes by how amazing our food is and share about your dining experience here.

Chinese: 这是小店多年的传统，每月都会选定一个时间，那时候最先走进店里的客人就是当月的“幸运顾客”，可以免费获得本店最精心准备的美食。
English: We've been doing this type of promotion for a long time. Every month, we choose a lucky customer who happens to walk in at just the right moment to enjoy our most exquisite meal for free.

Chinese: 听上去很不错，能将自己的喜悦分享给别人。这个我在行，侍主大人，你觉得怎么样？
English: It's wonderful to be able to spread the word about such a delighting place. I'm quite good at this sort of thing, Lord Oracle. What do you think?

Chinese: 我觉得可以答应
English: I think we should do it.

Chinese: 我就知道你会答应，哈哈……是不是气氛已经到位了，拒绝的话完全说不出口。
English: I had a feeling you'd be interested, haha... It just feels like the timing is perfect, and I can't say no.

Chinese: 并不是因为这样的理由，只是觉得答应下来也没什么。
English: It's not that. I just don't think it's a difficult task.

Chinese: 可不要逞强哦，侍主大人。
English: Don't push yourself, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 这件事可不像听起来那么轻松～
English: This isn't as straightforward as it seems.

Chinese: 不试试怎么知道呢？
English: How will you know if you don't try it?

Chinese: 话是这么说没错，不过，侍主大人，你还是在一旁等着吧，接下来的事情交给我就行了。
English: That's true, but, Lord Oracle, you might want to relax and let me handle things.

Chinese: 米娅微笑的看着我，虽然依旧是那幅开朗乐观的模样，但是眼眉之中似乎带着一丝隐秘的狡黠。
English: Mia gives me a smile. She seems upbeat and hopeful, but there is a glint of something more in her eyes.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 向店员要来了一份菜单，认真地翻阅后，米娅满脸认真地站到了门口。
English: After perusing the menu with care, Mia stands by the door with a serious look.

Chinese: 而活泼的店员小姐也跟着米娅走了过去。
English: The energetic waitress trails behind her.

Chinese: 虽然我并不参与宣传，但还是跟着米娅走向了门口。
English: Even though I am not directly involved in the promotion, I follow them to the door.

Chinese: 快来看啦，走过路过，不要错过，新鲜美味的河鱼，蒸煮烤炸应有尽有～
English: Come on in and give it a try. Stop by to taste them for yourself! Fresh river fish prepared in all sorts of ways—steamed, boiled, grilled, and fried.

Chinese: 在米娅吆喝的同时，奥卡兹少女也开始围绕着我们起舞。
English: As Mia calls out, the Ocatzian girls start dancing around us.

Chinese: 一瞬间，全场的目光都集在了米娅、店员……还有一旁的我的身上。
English: Suddenly, all eyes are on Mia, the waitress, and me.

Chinese: 尽管平常的时候，我已经习惯了他人的目光，但和那些看向侍主的崇敬目光不同，现在并不知晓我身份的路人们，目光充满了好奇与笑意。
English: While I'm used to being in the spotlight, this is unlike the usual respectful gazes. These are the curious and smiling looks from strangers.

Chinese: 这让我感到新奇的同时，也微妙地有些不适应。
English: It's new and slightly awkward.

Chinese: 米娅……？
English: Mia?

Chinese: 米娅似乎渐入佳境，吆喝地越发起劲，好在她还是及时地听到了我的声音。
English: Mia seems to be getting into the role and is calling out even louder. Luckily, she hears me just in time.

Chinese: 侍主大人，你先去里面等饭吧，等我这边弄好了就进去找你。
English: Lord Oracle, please go inside and wait for your meal. I'll find you when I'm done here.

Chinese: 察觉到我的不自在，米娅停下吆喝，笑着提出了建议。
English: Mia lowers her voice as she offers this suggestion with a smile, noticing my unease.

Chinese: 好吧……
English: OK...

Chinese: 实在是有些羞耻，我能感觉到仅仅是被那些异样的目光注视，身体就有些僵硬了。
English: It's pretty embarrassing. Just being looked at by those curious eyes makes my body tense up.

Chinese: （吆喝的事情还是交给米娅吧……）
English: (Let Mia do the promoting...)

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 离开了米娅的身边，我长长地出了一口气。
English: After stepping away from Mia, I let out a deep breath.

Chinese: （米娅的内心，真的是非常强大。）
English: (Mia is really quite brave.)

Chinese: 我不禁佩服起米娅的勇气。
English: I couldn't help but respect Mia's boldness.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 这位帅哥请跟我来~坐在窗边这个位置！
English: Sir, please come this way and take a seat by the window!

Chinese: 为什么是这里？
English: What's so special about this spot?

Chinese: 您长得这么帅气，坐在这里也是一道风景嘛。
English: You can light up the place just by sitting here, don't you think?

Chinese: ……好吧。
English: Fine.

Chinese: 我在店员安排的位置坐下，窗外就是米娅忙碌的身影。
English: I settle into the seat, catching a glimpse of Mia bustling about outside the window.

Chinese: 接下来，在米娅的努力下，路人们不断地向着店铺靠拢。
English: Mia's hustle draws more and more passersby as the day goes on.

English: none

English: Let me check... Ah, Grilled Mushrooms and Meat Skewers—both crowd-pleasers!

Chinese: 就是这个了！
English: Great, I'll have a taste!

English: none

English: Hey. I'm wondering...

Chinese: 不太想吃烧烤的？那……这道“鸡汤闷菌丝”怎么样，我强烈推荐哦！
English: Not in the mood for something grilled? How about Chicken and Mushroom Soup? It's a personal favorite of mine!

Chinese: 采用了特殊的本地菌丝，配上在森林中自由生长成熟的鸡肉熬汤，经过长时间的焖煮，得到的无上美味！
English: It's made with a special local mushrooms and free-range chicken, simmered slowly to create an unmatched flavor!

English: Mia's putting in great efforts, chatting up strangers like they're old friends. She doesn't seem shy, acting like... she knows everyone.

Chinese: 米娅。
English: Mia.

Chinese: 诶！侍主大人，有什么需要帮忙的地方吗？
English: Huh! Lord Oracle, need a hand with anything?

English: I grab the handkerchief and reach out the window to dab her sweat away.

Chinese: 你满头都是汗，辛苦了。
English: All sweaty. You've done well.

Chinese: 嘿嘿，小事一桩！谢啦，侍主大人！
English: It's nothing. Thanks, Lord Oracle!

English: none

English: Phew... Finally caught a break.

English: Thank you so much. Please rest inside. We've got a grand feast ready for you.

Chinese: 哈哈，怎么样，我们表现的很不错吧？
English: Haha, how did we do? Pretty good, huh?

Chinese: 简直堪称完美……不，远在意料之外的效果。就今天中午来到的客人数量都比之前一整天要多了，你们简直就是我们的幸运星！
English: Absolutely perfect... You exceeded all expectations. We've seen more customers this noon than all of a usual day. You are our lucky charms!

Chinese: 要不在这里多住上一些日子吧！
English: How about stick around a few more days?

Chinese: 我们会免费提供这期间所有住宿和用餐！
English: We'll cover all your meals and stays while you're here!

Chinese: 嗯……也不是不行？侍主大人，你怎么看？
English: Hmm... sounds like that could work. Lord Oracle, what do you think?

Chinese: 哦……抱歉，不可以。我们还有其他的工作，今天真的只是来度假的。
English: Oh... sorry, we can't stay. We've got other plans, actually—we're here for vacation.

Chinese: 嘿嘿……
English: Hehe...

Chinese: 似乎也知道自己的请求有些过分，店员挠了挠脑袋，展露出有些傻乎乎的笑容。
English: The waitress scratches her head, wearing a goofy grin, knowing her request is a tad over the top.

English: none

Chinese: 接着，她引领着我和米娅来到桌边落座。
English: She then guides Mia and me to a table to get seated.

Chinese: 哇，好丰盛！
English: Wow, incredible!

Chinese: 呈现在我们眼前的，是一桌名副其实的大餐。
English: What before us is an astonishing feast.

Chinese: 来自湖底深处的银鱼，森林深处难以采摘的罕见菌类，蔬菜中最为鲜嫩的菜心……
English: Silver fish from the depths of the lake, rare mushrooms from the heart of the forest, and the freshest greens...

Chinese: 在一张圆桌上，摆放着菜单上最昂贵的佳肴。
English: The table is adorned with the priciest cruisines.

Chinese: 这些可都是最上乘的食材制作的，而且最大程度保留了食材的本味。
English: These dishes are made from top-notch ingredients, highlighting their natural flavors.

Chinese: 考虑到两位的胃口，所以只安排了五道菜肴，要是觉得不够的话，可以随时告诉我们哦～
English: We've lined up five dishes for you. Feel free to ask for more if you need.

Chinese: 这样就足够好了。
English: This will do nicely.

Chinese: 浪费食物的行为，在米伦是不被允许的。
English: In Mirren, wasting food is always frowned upon.

Chinese: 而且，就只有两个人用餐而言，这样的规格其实已经很夸张了，即使在圣城也是很少见到这么丰盛的午餐。
English: For just two diners, this is already quite lavish, even by standards of the sacred city.

Chinese: 嗯，那么我就先退下啦，有什么需要请随时召唤我，只要摇动铃铛我就会立马到达哦～
English: I'll step out then. Ring the bell if you need anything.

Chinese: 店员指了指餐桌的中央，循着她的手指望去，一个系着可爱蝴蝶结的金色大铃铛进入了我的视线。
English: The waitress points to a golden bell at the center of the table, adorned with a cute bow.

Chinese: 等等！
English: Wait!

Chinese: 怎么了？
English: Is that a problem?

Chinese: 要不要一起用餐？
English: Care to join us?

Chinese: 欸？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 你刚才一直在我们身边跳舞，也一定很累了吧，也一起吃点东西补充体力吧！
English: You must be worn out from all that dancing. Come on, enjoy the dishes with us!

Chinese: 而且刚才能招揽到那么多客人，你的付出也功不可没，这也是你所应得的。
English: You played a huge role in attracting so many customers. You deserve a feast.
But...

Chinese: 店员小姐看上去已经心动了，但是还是有些犹豫。
English: The waitress seems tempted, yet hesitant.

Chinese: 而且，你刚刚才说了随时召唤，这么一点小小的要求，你应该不会拒绝我们吧？
English: You said you can help us with anything, right? This little favor isn't too much to ask, is it?

Chinese: 说着，米娅拿起了餐桌中央的铃铛，轻轻摇晃起来。
English: With that, Mia picks up the bell and gives it a gentle shake.

Chinese: “叮铃叮铃～”，清脆的声音随之响起。
English: "Ding ding." The bell chimes crisply.

Chinese: 好啦，既然您都这么说了，那我就恭敬不如从命了。
English: Alright, if you insist, I'll gladly join.

Chinese: 店员小姐随后也和我们坐在了一起。
English: The waitress takes a seat with us.

Chinese: ……两位客人。
English: Thank you very much.

Chinese: 虽然被米娅邀请入座，但是店员小姐的表情显然有些不自然。
English: After seats herself, the waitress looks somewhat uncomfortable.

Chinese: 这也是理所当然的，毕竟是刚刚才认识没多久的陌生人。
English: It's quite normal, given we've just met.

Chinese: 别在意，我们刚刚吆喝的时候，你不是还在一旁跳舞吗？
English: No worries. We've spent some time together when you were dancing, haven't we?

Chinese: 米娅主动打开了话题。
English: Mia starts the conversation to break the ice.

Chinese: 没多久，这位原本还有些羞涩的奥卡兹少女就被米娅所引导，开始和米娅热烈的交谈起来，餐桌上的氛围一下子就变得活跃了。
English: Before long, Mia draws out the initially shy Ocatzian girl. They start chatting up a storm, making the table buzz with energy.

Chinese: 就像是有某种魔力一般，米娅和这位素不相识的少女很快地成为了“朋友”。
English: It is almost magical how quickly Mia and the girl, a total stranger until now, hit it off.

Chinese: 怎么只看着我们，侍主大人是食物不合胃口吗？
English: Why watch us like that, Lord Oracle? Is something off with the food?

Chinese: 就在我观察她们的时候，米娅忽然将话题转向了我。
English: Mia suddenly swings the conversation my way.

Chinese: 同时，店员小姐也用非常担心的眼光看着我，似乎在担心我做出不好的评价。
English: The waitress gives me a worried glance, like she is bracing for a bad review.

Chinese: 品尝食物。
English: Give the food a try.

Chinese: 感觉怎么样？
English: How does it taste?

Chinese: 味道很不错。
English: It's really tasty.

Chinese: 太好啦！
English: That's great to hear!

Chinese: 店员松了口气。面对我，她仍然维持着最初的拘谨，神色间满是敬畏。
English: The waitress visibly relaxes. She is still a bit reserved around me, her expression filled with respect.

Chinese: 米娅显然也注意到了这一点。她的目光在我和店员之间一转，微笑着为我布菜。
English: Mia notices that too. With a smile, she serves me some more dishes.

Chinese: 那既然喜欢，就多吃一点吧，比如这个“清蒸银鱼”就很不错。
English: If you like it, help yourself to more. Try the Steamed Silver Fish. It's excellent.

Chinese: 这个很好吃。
English: This is really good.

Chinese: 在奥卡兹这是一道家常菜，但这里好像有特别的做法哦。
English: It's a household dish in Ocatzian, but they've got a unique twist on it here.

Chinese: 特别的做法是指什么？
English: What's special about it?

Chinese: 啊，这个就是小店的独门秘方了。因为是清蒸，所以事先的处理非常重要，我们会先……再……
English: Ah, that's our shop's secret recipe. The preparation is key. First, we... then...

Chinese: 这个我听过诶，用这种香料的奥卡兹比较少！你是经常接触行商所以知道吗？
English: I've heard about this technique before. It's rare to use this spice in Ocatzian! Are you familiar with it because you've met a lot of traders?

Chinese: 这倒不是，哈哈，这个香料就产自我们那边。
English: Not exactly, haha. This spice actually comes from my hometown.

Chinese: 侍主大人，您还记得您说这个店名很特别吗？这家店的名字，就和店员小姐的家乡有关哦！
English: Lord Oracle, you were intrigued the shop's name, weren't you? The name actually ties back to her hometown!

Chinese: 诶，这位客人觉得我们店的名字特别吗？
English: Oh, do you find our shop's name unique?

Chinese: 嗯，很好听。
English: Yes, it's quite poetic.

Chinese: 嘿嘿！这是我们家乡一个湖泊的名字，我们啊……
English: Hee hee! It's named after a lake back home. We...

Chinese: 原本只是看着她们的我被自然而然的带入进了谈话之中。
English: As I watch them, I find myself engaged in their conversation.

Chinese: 尽管我本来没有参与对话的打算，但米娅似乎不能允许我被冷落。
English: Even though I didn't intend to join in, Mia makes sure I am not left out.

Chinese: （这么做要花费巨大的精力吧，也不奇怪她为什么会有这么多朋友了。）
English: (It must take a lot of effort. No wonder she's so popular.)

Chinese: （这样真的不会疲惫吗？）
English: (Doesn't this ever wear her out?)

Chinese: 望着米娅开朗的笑容，我默默地想。
English: Watching Mia's cheerful smile, I can't help but wonder.

English: none

Chinese: 吃的好饱……肚子胀鼓鼓的……
English: I'm stuffed... My stomach's about to burst...

Chinese: 享用完美食，我和米娅离开餐馆，继续在村庄中游览。
English: After a fantastic meal, Mia and I leave the restaurant to keep exploring the village.

Chinese: 回忆起刚才店员小姐站在门口不停地挥手告别的情景，明明只是一顿饭的时间，但是米娅和那名少女就像是成为了多年的挚友一样。
English: Thinking back on the waitress waving goodbye so warmly, I find it incredible how Mia turned a meal into a friendship with that girl.

Chinese: 实在是不可思议。
English: It's truly astounding.

Chinese: 我和米娅打算继续我们的旅行，然而就在这时——
English: Mia and I are ready to move on when suddenly—

English: none

Chinese: 视线的远处忽然出现了一个娇小的白色身影，正随着人流，步伐轻快地朝着远处走去。
English: A short figure in white appears in the distance, moving briskly among the crowd.
(Could that be Kuroro?)

Chinese: 虽然距离较远，但是那个身影，看上去非常像是克萝萝。
English: From afar, it looks a lot like Kuroro.

Chinese: 我正打算上前询问，身旁的米娅似乎似乎也发现了什么，一下子变得兴奋起来。
English: Just as I am about to approach, Mia notices something and becomes excited.

Chinese: 她拉着我的手臂，不住地摇晃着。
English: She grabs my arm, shaking it excitedly.

Chinese: 侍主大人，快看，左边那棵树，看到了没有？
English: Lord Oracle, look at that tree to the left!

Chinese: 那可是第三纪元就已经伫立在那儿了，它的历史比这座村庄还要古老，就算是二三十个人环抱也围不住，很壮观吧！
English: That tree's been standing since the Era of Frost Veil, even older than the village itself. It is too wide for twenty or thirty people to wrap their arms around. Impressive, right?

Chinese: 嗯，确实很壮观。
English: Yeah, quite a sight.

Chinese: 您的回答完全没上心啊！
English: You don't sound very convinced!

Chinese: 从刚才起，你的视线就一直到处乱飘，侍主大人，是有什么在意的事吗？
English: You've been distracted since we got here, Lord Oracle. Is something on your mind?

Chinese: 我在想，你这么会交朋友，假期应该被朋友的邀请填得满满的才对。
English: I was just thinking about how easily you make friends. I'd imagine your vacations are filled with their invitations.

Chinese: 不可以是对侍主特别关注吗？毕竟关心侍主的状态，也是魔女的职责嘛。
English: Can't I be particularly concerned about you, Lord Oracle? Looking after you is part of a Nova's duty, after all.

Chinese: 我们第一次见面时，你还想躲我的工作呢。
English: When we first met, you tried to dodge these responsibilities.

Chinese: 态度转得太快也很可疑。
English: Such a quick change of heart seems suspicious.
Huh?

Chinese: 那就允许我先卖个关子，等时机合适的时候再告诉你吧！
English: I'll keep it under wraps for now. I'll tell you when the time is right!

Chinese: 我期待着。
English: I'm looking forward to it.

Chinese: 那么，接下来，我们就继续旅行吧～
English: So, shall we continue our adventure?

Chinese: 嗯。
English: Yeah.

Chinese: 还有，那边的木屋，是奥卡兹半兽人来到这里之后建造的，风格很特别，我带你过去看看。
English: See that cabin over there? It was built by the Ocatzian Orccodros after they settled here. It's quite unique. Follow me.

Chinese: 等等，米娅……
English: Hold on, Mia...

Chinese: 不等我说完，米娅就拉着我的手臂，朝着景点的方向快步跑去。
English: Before I can finish, Mia is already pulling me toward the canbin.

Chinese: 米娅的力气不小，我被她拉得趔趄，不得不加快步速跟上她。
English: Mia pulls quite hard—I nearly trip as I try to keep up with her pace.

Chinese: 等我稳住步伐再看周围时，那个疑似克萝萝的身影已经消失不见了。
English: When I finally catch my balance and look around, the figure resembling Kuroro has vanished.

Chinese: （或许，只是我看错了吧……）
English: (Maybe I made a wrong guess...)

Chinese: none
English: none

English: none

English: Mia hands me the jar of fireflies. Their faint glow, collected together, shine like a tiny lantern.

English: Wasn't expecting that, were you? You know, I first realized they could light up the path when I was very young...

English: none

English: Back when I ran away from home one night, I saw these little creatures for the first time. They flickered like tiny lanterns, helping me find my way in the dark.

English: none

Chinese: 那个，米娅……
English: Mia...

English: I gently shake the jar of fireflies.

Chinese: 和这么多人做朋友，一定很累吧？
English: Isn't it exhausting to be friends with so many people?

English: I hope I can be like these fireflies for you... actually, not just me.

English: Mia, where are you planning to go?

English: We're looking for a place to stay.

Chinese: 那我倒是知道一个好地方，比如……
English: I actually know some great spots, like...

English: Mia and the waitress start to chat.

English: Ah, I know! How about you stay at my place tonight?

Chinese: 在店员小姐的邀请下，我和米娅来到了她的家中。
English: Upon the waitress's invite, Mia and I visit her home.

Chinese: none
English: none

English: It was a rewarding day... I got to see so much views.

English: That's right, it's good to get out. Different places brings out different feelings.

English: For me, today was a perfect trip.

English: Mia beams at that response.

Chinese: 对我来说，这就可以了。
English: That's all I need to hear.

Chinese: 这确实是一趟完美的旅行，感谢你的一路陪伴，侍主大人。
English: It really was a perfect trip, thanks for being there, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 那么，早点睡，侍主大人，晚安。
English: Alright, try to get some sleep early tonight. Goodnight.

Chinese: none
English: none

English: Mia leaves with a gentle smile, closing the door behind her, leaving me alone in the room.

Chinese: （米娅这个笑容……）
English: (Mia's smile...)

English: There is true happiness in Mia's smile, yet it seems tinged with solitude.

English: Why does it feel that way? I haven't found the answer yet.

English: Wait here

English: Watching Mia blend in so well with the crowd, I hesitate before deciding not to interrupt her.

English: none

English: Before me flows a river running through the village, its shallow waters glittering under the sunlight.

Chinese: 几尾鱼儿在湖水之中惬意地游来游去。
English: A few fish dart comfortably through the water.

Chinese: （看上去是个垂钓的好地方）
English: (Looks like a perfect spot for fishing.)

Chinese: 侍主大人！
English: Lord Oracle!

Chinese: 怎么？和大家的交流结束啦？
English: What? Are you done chatting?

Chinese: 倒是没有，不过……相比这事，带着侍主大人游玩的重要性可高多了。
English: Not exactly, but... spending time with you is far more important.

Chinese: 所以就拜托大家让我早些离开了。
English: So I made my excuses to leave early.

Chinese: 我还以为你把我忘了呢……
English: I thought you had forgotten about me...

Chinese: 米娅吐了吐舌头。
English: Mia playfully sticks out her tongue.

Chinese: 抱歉啦，侍主，我现在就带您去别的地方走走！
English: Sorry, Lord Oracle. Let's continue our trip now!

Chinese: 继续跟着米娅
English: Follow Mia

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我们现在所在的地方，四周被绿色森林所包围。
English: We're currently surrounded by lush greenery.

English: Thick forest obscures our surroundings, with sunlight streaking through the gaps, illuminating the path. You can hear the sound of water coming from beyond the trees.

Chinese: 水声越来越近了，离瀑布不远啦。
English: The sound grows louder as we approach the waterfall.

Chinese: 侍主大人还好吗，累不累？
English: Are you getting tired, Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 我还好。
English: I'm doing fine.

Chinese: 米娅，还有侍主大人？
English: Mia, and Lord Oracle?

Chinese: 你们为何会在这里？
English: What brings you here?

Chinese: 诶？！你怎么会在这里……
English: Huh?! What are you doing here...

Chinese: 米娅因为吃惊而瞪大了眼睛。突然响起的声音，我和米娅并不陌生。
English: Mia's eyes widen in surprise. The voice is familiar to both Mia and me.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 你们在这里做什么？
English: What's the big gathering for?

Chinese: 呃，那个，我带侍主大人过来走走啦。
English: Uh, I just brought Lord Oracle here for a stroll.

Chinese: 只是过来走走？
English: Just a stroll?

Chinese: 黑神月咏皱起眉头。
English: Kurokami Tsukuyo frowns.

Chinese: 今天你、克萝萝和律，还有安洁，全都请假了。
English: Today, you, Kuroro, Ritsu, and Angie all took leaves.

Chinese: 我还以为你们出了什么问题，特意出来找你们……
English: I was worried something had happened, so I came looking for you...

Chinese: 现在你带着侍主大人出现在这里，“只是过来走走”？
English: And now I find you here with Lord Oracle, just strolling?

Chinese: 别那么严肃嘛黑神，我们也没料到你会在这时候工作结束……呃……没带你很抱歉？
English: Kurokami, don't be so stern. We didn't know you'd be off work now... uh... sorry for not telling you?

Chinese: 不，这没什么。不用向我道歉，确定你们没事就足够了。
English: It's fine. No need to apologize. Ensuring you're all safe is enough for me.

Chinese: 不用为这件事向我道歉，我并不在意。玩得愉快，我先回去了。
English: No need to apologize. Have fun, I'll be heading back now.

English: none

Chinese: 啊、等等，黑神，我们不是这个意思！
English: Wait, Kurokami, that's not what we meant!

Chinese: 黑神走得很快，看来是没有听到米娅挽留的话语。
English: Kurokami walks away quickly. Seems that she doesn't catch Mia's words.

Chinese: 米娅伸出挽回的手落下去，少见地露出了懊恼的神情。
English: Mia's outstretched hand drops, and she looks frustrated.

Chinese: 太糟糕了……我也没能说清楚……
English: This is awful... I didn't explain things properly...

Chinese: 所以现在到底是什么情况？
English: So, what exactly happened?

Chinese: 啊哈哈……这个嘛……
English: Haha... Well...

Chinese: 其实是我们给您安排了一场篝火晚会来着……律，安洁，克萝萝，都在布置会场。
English: We actually planned a bonfire party for you... Ritsu, Angie, and Kuroro have been setting it up.

English: We didn't expect Kurokami would make it back today, so the plan was to start the party with you and invite her tomorrow.

Chinese: 然而她提前回来了，所以才造就了这场意外？
English: But she returned early, making things awkward?

Chinese: 是啊，这下可糟糕了……
English: Yeah, it's quite a mess...

Chinese: 我没有和朋友闹矛盾的经验……
English: I've never really dealt with friend conflicts...

Chinese: ……你没和朋友闹过矛盾吗？
English: You've never had a conflict with any friend?

Chinese: 嗯，大家都只是……互相帮助的关系？
English: Well, we just... help each other out?

Chinese: （没有矛盾和碰撞，一旦出现问题便不知所措，这真的能叫做朋友吗……）
English: (No conflicts... When a problem arises, she's at a loss. Is that real friendship...)

Chinese: 总之，先追上去说明会比较好。
English: It might be best to catch up and explain.

Chinese: 侍主大人说得对，虽然不知道能不能成功……总之，一起追上去解释和道歉吧！
English: You're right, Lord Oracle. I'm not sure if it'll work, but an apologize won't hurt!

English: We catch up with Kurokami soon, explain everything to her, and Mia and I bring her back to the party.

Chinese: 尽管看起来解释成功了，但这场聚会始终弥漫着尴尬的气氛……
English: Although it seems like our explanation works, the atmosphere feels awkward...

Chinese: 最后，聚会早早结束了。

Chinese: 还是我们自己付钱吧
English: Let's just pay for it ourselves.

Chinese: 我摇了摇头。

Chinese: 唔……不过她看上去好像很需要我们的帮助欸……
English: Hmm... but she looks like in need of our help...

English: Please, this is a long-standing tradition at Lake & Moon. If you reject, bad unluck will haunt our shop for a whole month!

Chinese: 拜托了！

English: The poor waitress looks at us with tears in her eyes, bowing continuously.

English: It seems to be a Fontieran custom of requesting and apologizing, proving that this shop has preserved its Fontieran traditions well.

Chinese: 侍主大人，她看上去真的非常需要我们的帮助……
English: Lord Oracle, she looks like really in need of our help...

Chinese: ……好吧。

Chinese: 好耶！就知道侍主大人心软~

Chinese: 不过我去就好了！你在这等着，我去帮他们宣传宣传～

Chinese: 你已经迟到了。

Chinese: 她双手不安地绞在一起，又是愧疚又是沉重。

Chinese: 诶？！这可不……

Chinese: 好啦，这些花应该够了，接下来是……我看看有什么可用的，啊，就用草茎和藤蔓吧！
English: Alright! This should be enough. Next up is... let's see... uh, grass stems and vines should do!

Chinese: 制作花环需要那么多花吗？
English: Do you need that many flowers to make a flower crown?

Chinese: 难得有这样的机会，那就索性多做几个，老人家，我，还有你，每人做一个吧！
English: Well, since we've got the chance, let's just make three, one for the old lady, one for me, and one for you!

Chinese: 你想的倒是周到。
English: You really think things through.

Chinese: 那是当然……
English: Of course I do...

Chinese: 你还会做花环？
English: You can make flower crowns?

Chinese: 哈哈，我什么东西都会一点……
English: Haha, I can do a bit of everything...

Chinese: 好啦，闲话少说，你稍等一会，让我先把花环做好。
English: Enough chit-chat. Give me a minute. I'll get started.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 过了一会，收集到了足够的花朵、草茎、藤蔓，米娅和我回到了老人附近。
English: After gathering the flowers, vines and grass she needs, Mia and I return to the old lady.

Chinese: 然后米娅开始制作花环，她的双手出乎意料的灵巧，没过多久，三顶漂亮的花环就出现在了米娅的手中。
English: Mia begins weaving the flowers together. Her hands are very nimble, and before long, three beautiful crowns are complete.

Chinese: 我给您戴上吧！
English: Here, let me put this on you!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 米娅为老人戴上了花环。
English: Mia places a flower crown on the old lady's head.

Chinese: 然后是……
English: And next...

Chinese: 米娅将视线转向了我，并且拿着花环对着我不断矫正位置，似乎在考虑最佳的佩戴方式。
English: Mia turns to me, holding another crown and carefully adjusting its position in the air, trying to determine the best way to put it on me.

Chinese: 还是我自己来吧。
English: I'll do it myself.

Chinese: 别害羞嘛。
English: Don't be shy.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 终于选定了一个位置，米娅米娅来到了我的面前，伸手将花环戴在了我的脑袋上。
English: Finally deciding on the right angle, Mia steps up to me and gently places the crown on my head.

Chinese: 那之后，她还满意地看着我不停点头。
English: Then, she looks at me and nods with satisfaction.

Chinese: 接着，米娅为自己也戴上了花环。
English: After that, Mia puts the last crown on herself.

Chinese: 要不要去池子边看看，现在的你比之前更加帅气了！
English: Wanna check your reflection by the pond? You look even more handsome now!

Chinese: 不用了。
English: No need.

Chinese: 行吧，那我得去看看……
English: Alright, I'll take a look...

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我和老人站在院子入口，本以为会一直沉默下去，结果老人却忽然张开了口。
English: The old lady and I stand at the entrance to the yard. I assume she'll remain silent, but she suddenly speaks.

Chinese: 谢谢你们，年轻人。
English: Thank you, you two.

Chinese: 伊洛拉长大了，就应该是这副模样吧。
English: Ilora would look just like this if she'd grown up.

Chinese: 你们都是好孩子。
English: You're both good kids.

Chinese: 我回来啦，诶？你们在说些什么？
English: I'm back! Huh? What are you two talking about?

Chinese: 我有些困了，伊洛拉，你好好照顾客人。
English: I'm feeling a little sleepy now, Ilora. Take care of our guest.

Chinese: 唔，可是现在才刚刚傍晚哦？
English: But it's still only early evening...

Chinese: 人老了，比不了你们这些年轻人。
English: When you're old, you get tired easily.

Chinese: 我眼神复杂地看向老人，但是她仿佛并没有意识到我的目光。
English: I glance at the old lady with a complicated expression, but she doesn't seem to notice.

Chinese: 那我扶您上去吧！
English: I'll help you upstairs then!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 怎么了。
English: What is it?

Chinese: ……你说她会不会看出了我是假扮的？
English: Do you think she realized I was a fake?

Chinese: 最后被发现了。
English: She noticed eventually.

Chinese: 那我们的努力不全白费了吗？
English: So everything we did was for nothing?

Chinese: 没有白费。
English: No... not at all.

Chinese: 老人看上去也很开心。
English: The old lady looked truly happy.

Chinese: 米娅双手抱胸，咬着嘴唇思考了片刻。然后释然地一笑。
English: Mia crosses her arms and bites her lip in thought. Then she smiles.

Chinese: 是啊，虽然被看穿了，但是老人能开心就足够了，而且……
English: Yeah, she was happy, and that's what matters. Also...

Chinese: 米娅的表情变得有些害羞，然后用我几乎听不清的音量小声说道——
English: Mia blushes, and in a voice almost too quiet to hear, she murmurs—

Chinese: 今天，我也很开心。
English: I was happy today too.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 大懒虫，快起床啦！
English: Lazybones, get up already!

Chinese: 律？时间还早，让我再睡一会。
English: Ritsu? It's still early... just a little more sleep...

Chinese: 不早啦，米娅已经在楼下等了好一会了！她看上去很着急的样子……
English: It's not early anymore! Mia's been waiting downstairs for ages! She looks really anxious...

Chinese: 米娅很着急的样子？为什么？
English: Mia looks anxious? Why?

Chinese: 我哪知道，好啦，我去给你准备早餐，你快点洗漱完下楼吧！
English: How should I know? I'll go make you breakfast. Just wash up and head downstairs!

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 简单的洗漱之后，我走到了楼下。
English: After a quick wash, I come downstairs.

Chinese: 刚走到客厅，我就看到了一脸惴惴不安，似乎有很多话要说的米娅。
English: In the living room, I see Mia, who looks uneasy and seems to have a lot to say.

Chinese: 米娅，怎么了？
English: Mia, what's wrong?

Chinese: 我从圣殿得到消息，那位老婆婆……
English: I got news from the Sanctuary. That old lady...

Chinese: 她怎么了？
English: What does this have to do with her?

Chinese: 说是病的很重，我有点不敢相信……你可以陪我去看看吗？
English: They say her condition's gotten very serious. Will you come with me to see her?

Chinese: 可以。
English: Sure.

Chinese: 律，我和米娅有事要去做！
English: Ritsu, Mia and I have to head out now!

Chinese: 诶？这怎么行，早饭必须吃完！
English: Huh? No way! You have to finish your breakfast first!

Chinese: 诶……人呢？
English: Eh? Where are they?

Chinese: 在律从厨房走出来之前，我和米娅就已经走出了门，朝着莱德街道走去。
English: Before Ritsu could come out of the kitchen, Mia and I had left the house, heading toward Ryder Street.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我和米娅一起来到了莱德街道。
English: Mia and I arrive at Ryder Street.

Chinese: 然后，我们亲眼见证了——生命的凋零。
English: There, we witness with our own eyes the quiet fading of life.

Chinese: 虽然隐约有些预感，但是不久前还活生生的生命就这样在眼前变成冷冰冰的……遗体，我和米娅还是感到了无比的难过。
English: Even though a part of us had been expecting it, seeing the cold body of the old lady still makes us very sad.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 从老人家中离开。米娅难得的一路沉默着，一副心事重重的模样。
English: We leave the old lady's home. Mia remains unusually silent, looking preoccupied.

Chinese: 伸手在米娅眼前晃晃。
English: Wave my hand before Mia's eyes.

Chinese: 呀！……啊，怎么了？
English: Ah! Huh? What is it?

Chinese: 试着往前看。
English: Try to move on.

Chinese: 嗯。
English: Yeah.

Chinese: 米娅如此直接的答复让我有有些吃惊。
English: Mia's quick response surprises me.

Chinese: 你说的话我都明白，很久之前就明白了。
English: I understood everything you said. I've known for a long time now.

Chinese: 那你……刚刚……
English: But just now...

Chinese: 只是，怎么说呢……稍微需要些时间来调整心情，不用替我担心。
English: Well... I just needed a bit of time to adjust my feelings. No need to worry about me.

Chinese: 倒是你，自己也是一副难过的模样，却还反倒来安慰我。
English: You're clearly upset too, and yet here you are trying to comfort me.

Chinese: 米娅抓住了我的手。
English: Mia grabs my hand.

Chinese: 并无任何其他特殊的感情，只是单纯的温暖从她的手掌中传了过来，我这才意识到，自己的手竟然有些发冷。
English: There's nothing romantic in it, just a sincere warmth from her palm. Only then do I realize how cold my own hand had become.

Chinese: 你还记得刚刚看到的老人的模样吗？
English: Do you remember how the old lady looked just now?

Chinese: （模样吗？）
English: (How did she look?)

Chinese: 我回忆起刚刚看到的场景。
English: I recall what I just saw.

Chinese: 躺在床铺上的老人面带慈祥而温柔的微笑，头戴着米娅编制的花环，温暖的风从敞开的窗户吹入，花瓣和白发在风中轻轻摇曳。
English: On the bed, the old lady wore a gentle smile. The flower crown Mia had woven rested on her head. The breeze came in through the open window, stirring her silver hair and the flower petals.

Chinese: 我们的目的已经达成了，不是么？
English: Our goal was fulfilled, wasn't it?

Chinese: 嗯。
English: Yeah.

Chinese: （是的，老人是带着笑容与满心的喜悦离去的，所以我和米娅完全不用如此消沉，但是……）
English: (Yes. She passed with joy and peace, so there's no reason for us to be this sad... Still...)

Chinese: 呜呜！
English: Hmm!

Chinese: 诶？
English: Huh?

Chinese: 我和米娅转过身，看到了朝着我们跑过来的波奇。
English: Mia and I turn around and spot Pochi running toward us.

Chinese: 波奇！
English: Pochi!

Chinese: 呜呜！
English: Hmm!

Chinese: 小家伙对着我和米娅又蹦又跳。
English: The little one bounces energetically around us.

Chinese: 诶？嘴巴里咬着的是什么？
English: Huh? What's that in its mouth?

Chinese: 波奇的嘴巴里咬着的，是一封信件。米娅拿起信，和我一起阅读起来。
English: In Pochi's mouth is a letter. Mia takes it, and we read it together.

Chinese:
……
原谅我还无从知道你的姓名，那么我就用“伊洛拉”来称呼你了。
谢谢你，伊洛拉，还有你的朋友。
谢谢你陪着我重走了那段岁月，这些日子，我一直预感自己时日不多。但是，总是挂念着伊洛拉，心里空荡荡的。
直到你们出现了。
谢谢你们，让我看到了小伊洛拉长大的样子，她小时候啊，就是个活泼又开朗的孩子。
如果她长到和你那么大，一定也是你这副模样吧——
健康、元气，有着永不停歇的活力。
这样想着，我的胸口就已经被温暖填满了。
孩子，看到你的那一瞬间，我真的以为，是伊洛拉回来了，她回到这个家了。
English:
...
I never learned your name, so please allow me to call you Ilora.
Thank you, Ilora, and your friend.
Thank you for walking with me through those cherished days once more. I had a feeling that my time was drawing near. And yet, I couldn't stop thinking about Ilora. I felt empty inside.
Until you two appeared.
Thank you for letting me see what Ilora might have looked like all grown up. When she was a child, she was so lovely.
If she'd grown up, I'm sure she would've been just like you—
healthy, energetic, and brimming with vitality.
Just thinking about that fills my heart with warmth.
Sweetheart, the moment I saw you, I truly believed Ilora had returned home.

Chinese:
再次见到我那可爱的女儿，我真的很开心。
还能看到她长大后的模样，真是不可思议的奇迹——
抱歉，自顾自说了很多关于我自己的话。
我的故事已经结束了，在这最后的时光里，感谢还有你们的陪伴。
请不必为我悲伤，向前看吧。
你们的未来，还很长。
……
English:
I was so happy to see my sweet daughter once more...
And to see what she might have looked like grown up felt like a miracle.
Forgive me for rambling on about myself.
My story has come to its end. In these final days, I was lucky to have your company.
Please don't be sad. Move on.
You both still have long lives to live.
...

Chinese: 米娅将信件攥在手中，表情却整个放松了下来，她蹲下身，轻轻地揉了揉波奇的脑袋。
English: Mia clutches the letter in her hand, but her expression softens. She crouches down and rubs Pochi's head.

Chinese: 波奇，饿了没，我给你做好吃的！
English: Pochi, hungry? I'll make you something delicious!

Chinese: 呜呜……
English: Sniff...

Chinese: 像是听懂了米娅的话，波奇甩了甩脑袋，跑了。
English: As if understanding her words, Pochi shakes its head and bolts.

Chinese: 它又跑了！
English: There it goes again!

Chinese: 哈哈。
English: Haha.

Chinese: 哼，早晚让它尝尝！塞到它嘴里！
English: Hmph! I will make it eat my cooking! I will stuff it into its mouth!

Chinese: 那之后，波奇回到了老人为它寻找的新主人那里。只是，它为何对米娅的“魔法狗粮”如此抵触，似乎永远也得不到答案了……
English: After that, Pochi returns to the new owner the old lady found for it. As for why it hates Mia's magical dog food, that will forever remain a mystery...

Chinese: 不会被看破的。
English: She won't figure it out.

Chinese: 呼——有你这话我就放心了。
English: Whew, then I'm not worried.

Chinese: 话说，我发现今天你笑的次数有点多哦？
English: By the way, I noticed you've been laughing a lot today.

Chinese: 不会是在取笑我吧？
English: You're not secretly laughing at me, are you?

Chinese: 没有，只是米娅你很有趣。
English: No, it's just... Mia, you're really fun.

Chinese: 有趣？果然，你还是在取笑我吧？
English: Interesting? So you are making fun of me!

Chinese: 真的没有，米娅你要相信我。
English: I'm not! Really, Mia, you have to believe me.

Chinese: 嗯……那看来是我误会了，那你在笑什么？
English: Hm... then I must've misunderstood. But what were you laughing at?

Chinese: 就像我说的那样，觉得米娅你很有趣罢了。
English: Like I said, I just find you really fun, Mia.
Hmm...

Chinese: 直到分别，米娅依旧紧缩着眉毛，似乎在思索，自己究竟“有趣”在哪里。
English: When we part ways, Mia is still frowning, trying to figure out exactly what makes her so fun.

Chinese: 爬树
English: Climb the tree

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我走向了那大树，它非常高大，长满了郁郁葱葱的树叶。
English: I walk over to the big tree. It's tall and full of thick, lush leaves.

Chinese: 这个我擅长！
English: This is my specialty!

Chinese: 那还需要我帮忙吗？
English: So do you still need help?

Chinese: 不用啦，你就看着吧，让我给你露一手。
English: Nope! Just watch me. I'll show you what I can do!

Chinese: 米娅自信满满，她一路慢悠悠地走到了大树边——
English: Full of confidence, Mia strolls leisurely to the tree.

Chinese: 然后是双手往上一攀，脚一踩，三两下一气呵成，用行云流水般的动作，漂亮地爬上了树木顶端的枝干。
English: Then, she grabs the tree, places her foot, and in a few smooth motions, she climbs up to a high limb with grace and ease.

Chinese: 怎么样，我的动作很帅气吧！
English: How's that? Pretty cool, huh?

Chinese: 确实很帅气。
English: It is pretty cool.

Chinese: 那我给你表演个更帅气的！
English: I'll show you something even cooler!

Chinese: 米娅松开了抓住树干的手，双手叉腰地站在了树枝上。
English: Mia lets go of the tree and stands on the branch with her hands on her hips.

Chinese: 但是不巧的是，这时候，一阵风吹了过来——
English: But just then, a gust of wind blows through.

Chinese: 米娅，小心！
English: Mia, watch out!

Chinese: 我的话语还未落，米娅就失去了平衡，晃动着双手，这时候想要再抓住树干已经来不及了，她径直地朝着前方栽倒下来。
English: Before I finish, Mia loses her balance. She tries to grab the tree again but fails, falling straight forward.

Chinese: 我脚下一蹬，冲到了米娅的落点，然后——
English: I launch myself toward her landing point, and then—

Chinese: none
English: none
Hmm...

Chinese: 唔——米娅，你没事吧。
English: Ugh... Mia, are you okay?

Chinese: 抱歉，我……
English: Sorry, I...

Chinese: 你先起来。
English: Just get up first.

Chinese: 对不起！
English: Sorry!

Chinese: 呃，你还是先起来再说吧。
English: Uh, you should get up first...

Chinese: 啊，我马上……
English: Right, I'll get up...

Chinese: 米娅站起身，然后抓住我的手把我拉了起来。
English: Mia stands up, then grabs my hand and pulls me to my feet.

Chinese: 你没事吧？
English: You alright?

Chinese: 没什么大碍，米娅比看上去要轻巧不少。
English: I'm fine. Mia, you're lighter than you appear.

Chinese: 那是当然……等等，难道你一直觉得我很胖吗？
English: Of course I'm light... hang on, did you think I was fat all this time?!

Chinese: 哈哈……
English: Haha...

Chinese: 捉迷藏
English: Hide and Seek

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 捉迷藏？不会是想让我躲到水池里去吧？
English: Hide and seek? You're not expecting me to hide in the pond, are you?

Chinese: 倒也没那个必要。
English: No need for that.

Chinese: 那要怎么做？
English: Then how?

Chinese: 就在院子里躲吧。
English: Just hide somewhere in the yard.

Chinese: 好啊。
English: Sure.

Chinese: 那我转身，倒数一百，然后再来找你。
English: I'll turn around and count down from a hundred, then come find you.

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 我背向米娅，开始倒数。
English: I turn my back to Mia and start counting.

Chinese: 倒数结束后，我转过身，目光投向院子，搜寻起米娅的身影。
English: I turn around and scan the yard, searching for Mia.

Chinese: （米娅会躲在什么地方呢？）
English: (Where could Mia be hiding?)

Chinese: （树冠上？没有……那灌木丛里？也没有，柱子后面，还是没有。）
English: (The treetop? Nope. The bushes? Nope. Behind a pillar? Still no.)

Chinese: （难道，真的躲到水池里去了？）
English: (Don't tell me she did hide in the pond...)

Chinese: 四下搜寻了一番，我都没有发现米娅的踪迹，不由得将视线落到了水池之中。
English: I search everywhere but still can't find Mia. My eyes eventually land on the pond.

Chinese: （应该不会在那，而且……）
English: (She wouldn't go in there. Besides...)

Chinese: 清澈见底的池水中，并没有任何人的身影。
English: The water is crystal clear. No sign of anyone inside.

Chinese: （该如何是好？）
English: (What should I do now?)

Chinese: 我的视线在不停游弋着，从院子里的各处扫过……
English: My eyes sweep around the yard again...

Chinese: 呜呜？
English: Woof! Woof?

Chinese: 波奇待在在大树脚下的灌木丛旁，叫个不停。
English: Pochi is barking nonstop beside the bushes near the tree.

Chinese: （难道米娅藏在那？）
English: (Is Mia hiding there?)

Chinese: 虽然不像是能够藏人的地方，不过我还是走过去，拨开了灌木。
English: It doesn't look like a place someone could fit, but I walk over anyway and part the bushes.

Chinese: 只见在灌木丛的掩盖中，米娅躲在树木背面的树洞里，正一脸惊讶地看着我。
English: There, tucked behind the tree in a hollow, Mia stares at me in surprise.

Chinese: 波奇！！
English: Pochi!

Chinese: 呜呜~
English: Woof!

Chinese: 被米娅叫了名字，波奇开心地跑到米娅的身边蹭着它的小腿。
English: When Mia calls its name, Pochi runs over to her and nuzzles her leg happily.

Chinese: 这情形让米娅脸上的气愤变成了满脸的无奈。
English: Mia's initial anger melts into exasperation.

Chinese: 她叹了一口气，重新打起精神将视线转向了我这边。
English: She sighs, then straightens up and looks at me.

Chinese: 好啦，那么下面该我来找你了！
English: Alright, now it's my turn to find you!

Chinese: 已经花了挺久了，我们回老人的身边去吧。
English: We've spent quite a bit of time here. Let's head back to the lady.
What?!

Chinese: 有些不妥。
English: That might not be the best idea.

Chinese: 你还是想那么做对吗？
English: You still want to do that, don't you?

Chinese: none
English: none

Chinese: 那好吧，但是要记得下不为例。
English: Fine, but just this once. Don't make a habit of it.

Chinese: 嗯！

Chinese: 啊，小事而已，不劳侍主大人费心了。
English: Oh, it's a minor issue. I can handle it, Lord Oracle.

Chinese: 原本我司的帕拉小姐应该负责今日的协助巡查。
English: Parra from our division was scheduled to assist with patrols today.

English: But by chance, I saw her logged into Alchemy Workshop No. 3.

Chinese: 出于好奇，我沿途检查了各个巡查点的印记，发现印记的结构和她本人平常的习惯有些出入。

English: No, no! No problem! I'd be more than happy to ease the Kismet Division's workload.

English: By the time Mia and I finish her assignment, it's already late. Though we can't make it to the Princeton Cup, we have a good time.

English: Judging by Parra's expression, she is not okay.

English: Also, Mia often tells me how hard the Kismet Division staff work every day, so I'd like her to take point on this assignment as a gesture of support.

English: Well, allow me to thank you both on behalf of the Kismet Division then. I'll send the official paperwork to your office tomorrow.

English: Now, I've still got other business to attend to. Enjoy your Grace Day.

English: Ugh... Three days of patrol duty...

Chinese: 不错啦，就像今天这样走走逛逛有什么不好。
English: Could be worse. Just strolling around like we did today isn't that bad.

Chinese: 如果凯尔丝秉公处理的话，这事甚至都可以闹到牧那边去。
English: If Kelsi had gone strictly by the book, this could've escalated all the way to Muu.

Chinese: 到时候可就有你好果子吃了。
English: And trust me, you wouldn't want that.

Chinese: 我懂我懂~ 多谢你替我解围。
English: I know. Thanks for bailing me out.

English: Come on, the Princeton Cup's starting soon.

English: So, what do you think, Lord Oracle? Should I move these things to the dorms?

Chinese: 感觉这里没什么生活气息。

Chinese: 嗯……你会这么觉得也很正常。

English: In the photo, a couple stands side by side. The husband rests his hand on a longsword, and the wife carries a baby in her arms. Both smile with love and hope.

English: I hand the photo back to Mia and continue the conversation.

Chinese: 可以谈谈你对他们的印象吗？
English: Would you mind sharing your memories of them?

Chinese: 其实我对他们我谈不上什么印象啦，毕竟我从记事起就没见过他们了，在福利院的那段日子也没接触过什么有关家族的东西。
English: I don't have any real memories of them. I haven't seen them since I was old enough to remember. And during my time at the orphanage, I didn't learn much about the family either.

Chinese: 对他们的认识大多是自己调查来的，包括这张相片也是。
English: Most of what I know now, I dug up myself, including this photo.

Chinese: 母亲也是位魔女，但不清楚具体的职位，明面上的那份档案很怪，我也懒得去深究。
English: My mom was a Nova too, though I don't know her exact role. The public file on her is weird, and I didn't dig deeper.

Chinese: 详细的情况我有点记不清了，一会去书房找找记录，毕竟圣域巡使曾是霍洛韦尔家族的荣耀，我随口讲错了可不好。
English: For more details, I'll have to check the records in the study. It was once the pride of the Holowell family, so I don't want to get the facts wrong.

Chinese: 米娅伸了个懒腰。
English: Mia stretches.

Chinese: 呜~~哈！多亏你问了这些，让我想起不少以前的事情。
English: Mmm... haah! Thanks to your questions, a lot of memories are flooding back.

Chinese: 米娅利落的拿过几样东西。
English: Mia quickly gathers a few items.

Chinese: 比如这只兔子，据说是母亲亲手做给我的。在福利院的几年里也是它一直陪着我。
English: Like this bunny, my mom supposedly made it for me herself. It was with me throughout all my years at the orphanage.

Chinese: 米娅晃了晃先前那只黑白两色的玩偶。
English: Mia shakes the black-and-white bunny plush.

Chinese: 还有什么想问的吗？能帮我参谋了不？
English: Anything else you want to ask me? Ready to help me decide now?

Chinese: 这真的有必要吗？
English: Is this really necessary?

Chinese: 我们说好的嘛，我想听听你的建议。
English: We agreed, remember? I want to hear your opinion.

Chinese: 那带走这些吧。
English: Then take these.

Chinese: 听你的~
English: You got it.

Chinese: 米娅找来一只箱子，把挑好的东西都放了进去。
English: Mia grabs a box and carefully places the selected items inside.

Chinese: 走吧，去书房看看。
English: Let's go to the study.

English: Oh, that's because Ms. White never touches anything in the study.

English: Well, truthfully, it's for security concerns. Back when the Holowell family was at its peak, the family head would handle a lot of confidential documents here.

English: The level of secrecy was said to be on par with the vice chairs of the Three Divisions...

Chinese: 啊！对了，有关圣域巡使的资料！

Chinese:
……
我们亲爱的米娅，当你读到这封信的时候，应该已经有七岁大了吧？
你现在长大了，将来又想成为什么呢？
时间真的好快，一眨眼，你就变成了这么漂亮的小姑娘。
春天的时候，我们去野餐，你抿着嘴说只想吃肉，从爸爸的碗里抢走了最大的那块。
夏天时，我们在院子里建起小小的泳池，你跳进去，把妈妈的新衣服打得湿透。
秋天，我们回家的路上，你跑进一片枫树林，火红的枫叶围绕着你起舞，如梦似幻。

English:
...
Mia, by the time you read this, you must be seven years old, right?
You're growing up now. What do you dream of becoming someday?
Time really flies. You've become such a beautiful little girl.
In spring, we went for a picnic. You pouted and said you only wanted meat, snatching the biggest piece from Dad's plate.
In summer, we set up a tiny pool in the yard. You jumped right in and soaked Mom's brand-new clothes.
In fall, on the way home, you ran into a forest of maples. The fiery leaves danced around.
In winter, you bundled up in a thick coat, puffed white breath into the air, and showed off your giant snowballs.

Chinese:
……
不知这些幻想，我们有经历多少呢？
不知在你拆开这封信的时候，我们是否还天各一方呢？
对不起，我们是全世界最不称职的父母。
我们把你带到这个世界，我们是如此爱你，却又无法给你最多的爱。
米娅，我们的小太阳。
若你孤身一人……

English:
...
We don't know how many of these fantasies we truly shared.
Will we still be worlds apart when you open this letter?
We're sorry. We're the worst parents in the world.
We brought you into this world, but we couldn't give you all the love we wanted to.
Mia, our little sunshine.
If you're ever alone...
If sorrow finds you, please don't cry. Tears won't wash the sadness away; they only water the thorns in your heart.
If joy finds you, laugh out loud. Smiles are the most beautiful scenery, and happiness is meant to be shared.
Our darling.
Please give us a little more time. Once we fulfill our destiny, ■■■■, we'll never be apart again.
...

Chinese: 喂？喂？？嘿！

English: Hmm? That's your question? Were you even listening to me before?

Chinese: 咳，倾注到另一位霍洛韦尔的血脉上，这才称得上是传承。
English: Ahem... into another Holowell. Only then is the legacy truly carried on.

Chinese: 受教了，我之前一直以为魔女培养是神赦司来负责的……
English: I see. I always thought Nova training was the Absolving Theocracy's job.
