Chinese: 一番胡闹过后，沉重复杂的情绪彻底重置，米娅和我靠坐在墙边开始闲聊。
English: After some jokes, the heavy mood finally lifts. Mia and I sit against the wall, relaxing into small talk.

Chinese: 嗯，你猜的没错，审判长大人与我爸妈是旧识，好像我母亲还曾经当过大人的直属魔女。
English: Yeah, you guessed right. Lord Inquisitor knew my parents. I think my mother even served directly under her as a Nova.

Chinese: 在我刚进圣殿的那段时期，审判长大人给了我很多照顾，我很感谢她。
English: Back when I'd just joined the Sanctuary, Lord Inquisitor helped me a lot. I'm really grateful.

Chinese: 这栋宅子也是审判长大人带我来的，她领我走进地下时的情景我现在还记得很清楚。
English: Lord Inquisitor is also the one who brought me to this house. I still remember her leading me into the basement.

Chinese: 对了，能让这宅子保存至今，也是多亏了审判长大人向我介绍了怀特女士。
English: Oh, right, Lord Inquisitor also introduced me to Ms. White.

Chinese: 那个你之前提过的，负责日常维护的人？
English: The housekeeper you mentioned before?

Chinese: 是的，一位艾卡希恶魔，是个很温暖的长者。
English: Yes. An Akashic demon, a very kind and gentle elder.

Chinese: 当年她已经获得圣殿的成就勋章，从世袭工种的岗位上光荣退休了。
English: She'd earned the Sanctuary's Medal of Merit and retired honorably from her hereditary profession.

Chinese: 所以我去找她前没抱什么希望，已经做好了将整个宅子捐给圣城博物院的准备。
English: So I didn't have much hope when I went to see her. I was fully prepared to donate the estate to the Sacred City Museum.

Chinese: 然后她以私人身份接下了我这位七岁小女孩的委托，帮我守住了霍洛韦尔家族的祖宅。
English: But she accepted the commission as a private citizen from me, a seven-year-old girl. She helped me guard the Holowell ancestral home.

Chinese: 我问过她接下这份工作的理由，但她没正面回答我，于是我就暗中调查了她的过去。
English: I asked her once why she took the job, but she never gave me a direct answer. So I did my own digging.

Chinese: 喂！
English: Hey!

Chinese: 毕竟她对这所宅子尽心尽力的程度远超我的预期，可不只是日常的打扫和维护这么简单。
English: She was way more dedicated than I expected. It went way beyond daily cleaning and basic upkeep.

Chinese: 而且那时我还小，有些“调皮”也很正常。
English: And I was still a kid. Being a little mischievous was normal.

Chinese: 你知道的，艾卡希恶魔的寿命很长，要查年头久远的档案真是费了我好一番功夫。最后我大概找到了她帮我的理由。
English: You know how Akashic demons live for ages, right? Digging up old archives took me forever. But eventually, I think I figured out her reason.

Chinese: 她原本不是圣城的住民，是在一次混乱灾厄后流落到此的。
English: She wasn't originally from the sacred city. She ended up here after a Chaos disaster.

Chinese: 而那场混乱灾厄是霍洛韦尔家族负责解决及善后的。
English: And the Holowell family was the one that handled the crisis and its aftermath.

Chinese: 喔~ 真好啊，不失为一段佳话。
English: Whoa, that's a touching story.

Chinese: 是啊，而且我也想过，她不说可能是怕给年幼的我额外的压力，继承霍洛韦尔的压力……
English: Yeah. She didn't tell me probably because she didn't want to burden a child with the pressure of inheriting Holowell...

Chinese: 总之，可能就是出于这样的理由，她作为实际上的管家为霍洛韦尔家族服务了十年，直到上周。
English: Anyway, she served as the housekeeper of the Holowell family for ten whole years until just last week.

Chinese: （静静的看着米娅。）
English: (Watch Mia quietly)

Chinese: 寿终正寝，她因为早年受伤没有子嗣，最后的讣告是圣殿的公职人员转达给我的。
English: She passed away from old age. Since she had no children due to old injuries, the news was delivered to me by an official from the Sanctuary.

Chinese: 仔细想来，这次“搬家”的契机不是圣殿的政令，而是怀特女士。
English: Well, the real reason behind this move isn't the Sanctuary's directive. It's Ms. White.

Chinese: 话说完，米娅身子一挺，利落的站起身来。
English: Mia straightens up and rises swiftly to her feet.

Chinese: 好啦，时间也不早了，闲聊结束，对于最后这些东西，你的建议是？
English: Okay, it's getting late. Enough chit-chat. What's your take on this stuff?

Chinese: 刚刚，你反常的表现令我很在意。
English: You acting strange earlier really caught my attention.

Chinese: 嗯，我猜也是，上一个问题明显不太对劲。
English: Yeah, I figured. That last question you asked was clearly off.

Chinese: 啊？什么？想到什么？
English: Huh? What? Thinking of something?

English: 3 out of 10.

Chinese: 效果这么差吗，这招我是跟牧学的，看来装傻的确不太适合我。

English: (Stay)

Chinese: 你的反应好……普通。
English: Your reaction is so... calm.

Chinese: 你猜是谁把信塞到这里去的？

Chinese: 莫非你在期待我嚎啕大哭吗？哈哈哈哈。
English: What, were you hoping I'd burst into tears? Hahaha.

Chinese: 这封信是我七岁来圣殿时收到的。
English: I received this letter when I first arrived at the Sanctuary at age seven.

Chinese: 还记得当时我哭的稀里哗啦，吓得送信人半天不敢走来着！
English: I remember I wailed so hard that the messenger didn't dare come near me for a while!

Chinese: 但现在嘛，都已经过去了，人不能总活在过去是吧。
English: But now, it's all in the past. People shouldn't be stuck in the past forever.

English: (No mention of the letter)

English: It's nothing. I'm just genuinely curious about the Holowell family's history.

Chinese: 好吧，其实也没什么特别的啦。
English: Uh-huh, there's nothing all that special.

Chinese: 不用放眼希瑞安全境，就说在圣城米尔嘉德一地，类似的故事也是屡见不鲜的。
English: Stories like this are pretty common even within just Midgard, not to mention the entire Ciaran.

Chinese: 我在调查的最后没去取那份决定性的文件，毕竟结局已经呼之欲出了。
English: I didn't go get that decisive document at the end of my investigation, as the outcome was already plain to see.

Chinese: 凝视深渊的同时，也被深渊凝视什么的，很老套吧。
English: When you're staring into the abyss, it's staring back at you too. Cliché, right?

Chinese: 况且霍洛韦尔家族本就源自真正的“深渊”。
English: Besides, the Holowell family does originate from the real Abyss.

Chinese: 顽固的霍洛韦尔们不懂得变通，画地为牢，在看不到尽头的坚守和内耗中走向没落。
English: The stubborn Holowells never adapted. They drew boundaries around themselves, rotting away in endless endurance and internal conflict.

Chinese: 米娅顿了顿，拿过我手中的笔记抚摸了一下封底。

Chinese: 我认为这个尾声是整个故事中唯一的亮点。
English: I think the ending is the only real highlight of this whole story.

Chinese: 最后一任圣域巡使是位了不起的英才，他反向利用血脉的力量，让那位盘踞其中的黑暗意志在自己身上固化，最终斩断了宿命的轮回。
English: The last Holyscape Marshal was a brilliant talent. He used the power of bloodline in reverse to fix the dark will within himself, finally ending the cycle of fate.

Chinese: 英雄奇迹般的幸存了下来，救活他的圣殿也认为威胁已经被清除，霍洛韦尔家族已经从桎梏中解放，在圣殿的扶持下即将迎来复兴。
English: The hero miraculously survived. After saving him, the Sanctuary believed the threat was gone and that the Holowells were free of their chains, ready for a revival under the Sanctuary's support.

Chinese: 然而他自己似乎有不同的看法，自顾自的离开了圣城，最终客死他乡。
English: But he seemed to think differently. He left the sacred city and died in a foreign land.

English: Leave it here.

English: Oh, you're as sharp as ever.

English: Then let's leave it all here.

English: Uh... wait a sec?

English: Aren't you being a bit too decisive?

English: Huh? Haha, wasn't it your idea?

Chinese: 我没什么想法。

Chinese: 实际上，自从七岁时知晓自己的姓氏，并继承这座宅子也快十年了。
English: Since I learned my surname at age seven and inherited this estate, it's been almost ten years.

Chinese: 最初几年还会偶尔来看看，近两年回来的次数大概一只手就数得清了。
English: I used to drop by every now and then in the early years, but in the past two years? Not so often.

Chinese: 没什么特别的理由啦，毕竟平时不知道什么时候就会突然来任务，住在圣殿的宿舍里会方便许多。
English: No particular reason. It's just that you never know when a mission will pop up. It's much more convenient to live in the Sanctuary dorms.

Chinese: 而且这里也没有安洁。
English: And besides, Angie's not here.

Chinese: 跟我的卧室好像。

Chinese: 你未免也太诚实了！

Chinese: 对对对，就是这个意思。
English: Exactly! That's the idea.

Chinese: 已经足够震惊了。
English: Well, I'm already more than shocked.
